Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typnamen einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_name.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    rv_type_name = lo_typedescr->get_name( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_type_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_type_name.
    DATA lv_char TYPE char10 VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA lv_int TYPE i VALUE 123.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_type( ).

    DATA(lv_type_char) = lo_cut->get_type_name( lv_char ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type_char exp = 'C' ).

    DATA(lv_type_int) = lo_cut->get_type_name( lv_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type_int exp = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von RTTI, um den Typnamen einer Variablen zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` ist der Einstiegspunkt, um ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt zu erhalten, von dem dann der Name abgefragt werden kann. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme.
keywords: RTTI, Type Description, cl_abap_typedescr, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer vorgegebenen Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT-CARRID`, `SFLIGHT-CONNID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_CARR_ID' ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_CONN_ID' ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_table( ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( ).

    " Check if the table reference is valid
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_table_ref ).

    " Check the type of the created table
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lo_table_ref ) AS cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) AS cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit erstellt. Zuerst wird eine Strukturdefinition (`cl_abap_structdescr`) aus Komponenten erstellt, dann eine Tabellendefinition (`cl_abap_tabledescr`) basierend auf dieser Struktur. Schließlich wird mit `CREATE DATA` eine Referenz auf die dynamische Tabelle erzeugt. Dies ist essenziell für generische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Table, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle mit Daten aus der `SFLIGHT` Datenbanktabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_populate_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS populate_dynamic_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_populate_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD populate_dynamic_sflight.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_CARR_ID' ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_CONN_ID' ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_DATE' ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dyn_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line_ref) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <ls_dyn_line>.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @<ls_dyn_line>
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
      APPEND <ls_dyn_line> TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    ENDSELECT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_populate_dynamic_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_populate_dynamic_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_populate_table( ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = lo_cut->populate_dynamic_sflight( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dyn_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dyn_table> ) exp = 10 ).

    " Check content of the first row (example)
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_first_row> TYPE any,
                   <lv_carrid>    TYPE s_carr_id.
    ASSIGN <lt_dyn_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_first_row>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_first_row> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lv_carrid> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung um das Füllen mit Daten. Es nutzt Feld-Symbole, um auf die dynamische Tabelle und deren Zeilen zuzugreifen. Der `SELECT` Befehl mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @<ls_dyn_line>` ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten in eine dynamische Struktur zu laden, ohne die Feldnamen explizit zu kennen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Table, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, SELECT INTO CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Wert (z.B. `CARRID`) aus einer Zeile einer dynamisch erstellten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_dyn_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_carrid_from_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        io_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_index     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_dyn_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_carrid_from_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dyn_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_carrid>    TYPE s_carr_id.

    ASSIGN io_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR iv_index > lines( <lt_dyn_table> ) OR iv_index <= 0.
      " Handle error: table not assigned or index out of bounds
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <lt_dyn_table>[ iv_index ] TO <ls_dyn_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dyn_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_carrid = <lv_carrid>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_carrid.
    " Setup: Create and populate a dynamic table
    DATA(lo_populate) = NEW zcl_rtti_populate_table( ). " Re-use populate logic
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = lo_populate->populate_dynamic_sflight( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dyn_table> ).

    " Get a known CARRID from the first row
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_first_row> TYPE any,
                   <lv_expected_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
    ASSIGN <lt_dyn_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_first_row>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_first_row> TO <lv_expected_carrid>.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_read_dyn_table( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_carrid) = lo_cut->read_carrid_from_dynamic_table(
                               io_table_ref = lo_table_ref
                               iv_index     = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_carrid exp = <lv_expected_carrid> ).

    " Test invalid index
    DATA(lv_invalid_carrid) = lo_cut->read_carrid_from_dynamic_table(
                                 io_table_ref = lo_table_ref
                                 iv_index     = 999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_invalid_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Lesen von Daten aus einer dynamischen internen Tabelle. Der Zugriff erfolgt über Feld-Symbole, die auf die Tabelle und dann auf die gewünschte Zeile zeigen. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf einzelne Felder innerhalb der dynamischen Zeile, was für generische Lesevorgänge unerlässlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Table, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Read Data

      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <lt_dyn_table>[ iv_index ] TO <ls_dyn_line>.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_carrid FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_carrid.
    " Setup: Create and populate a dynamic table
    DATA(lo_populate) = NEW zcl_rtti_populate_table( ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = lo_populate->populate_dynamic_sflight( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dyn_table> ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_modify_dyn_table( ).
    DATA(lv_new_carrid) = 'LH'.

    lo_cut->modify_carrid_in_dynamic_table(
      io_table_ref  = lo_table_ref
      iv_index      = 1
      iv_new_carrid = lv_new_carrid ).

    " Verify modification
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_modified_row> TYPE any,
                   <lv_actual_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
    ASSIGN <lt_dyn_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_modified_row>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_modified_row> TO <lv_actual_carrid>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_actual_carrid> exp = lv_new_carrid ).

    " Test invalid index (should not modify)
    DATA(lv_original_carrid) = <lv_actual_carrid>.
    lo_cut->modify_carrid_in_dynamic_table(
      io_table_ref  = lo_table_ref
      iv_index      = 999
      iv_new_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_actual_carrid> exp = lv_original_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Zuweisung eines neuen Wertes an das Feld-Symbol `<lv_carrid>` aktualisiert direkt den Wert in der dynamischen Tabelle.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Table, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Modify Data

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Namen aller Komponenten einer dynamisch erstellten Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_names
      IMPORTING
        io_struct_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_names.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( io_struct_ref ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_component_names = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components ( ls_comp-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA ls_test_struct TYPE ty_test_struct.
    DATA(lo_struct_ref) = REF TO ls_test_struct.

Es verwendet `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` und einen `CAST` zu `cl_abap_structdescr`, um dann die Methode `get_components` aufzurufen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist eine moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Transformation von internen Tabellen.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit einem Feld-Symbol oder `cl_abap_tabledescr` für generische Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN io_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: table not assigned
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if field exists in the table line structure
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( io_table_ref ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: field not found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamic sort using FIELD-SYMBOLS
    SORT <lt_dyn_table> BY (iv_field_name).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_rtti_dyn_sort=>tt_sflight_data.
    lt_sflight = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = REF TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_sort( ).

    " Sort by CARRID
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( io_table_ref = lo_table_ref iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_sorted_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sorted_table>[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sorted_table>[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sorted_table>[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Sort by FLDATE
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( io_table_ref = lo_table_ref iv_field_name = 'FLDATE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sorted_table>[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sorted_table>[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sorted_table>[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250103' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle. Es verwendet ein Feld-Symbol, um auf die Tabelle zuzugreifen, und die `SORT ... BY (field_name)` Syntax, die ab ABAP 7.50 für dynamische Sortierung mit Feldnamen in Klammern verfügbar ist. Dies ist flexibler als statische Sortierung.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Sort, Internal Tables, FIELD-SYMBOLS, SORT BY (field_name)

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle, deren Struktur der einer bestehenden internen Tabelle entspricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_clone_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple,
           tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS clone_table_structure
      IMPORTING
        io_source_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_cloned_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_clone_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clone_table_structure.
    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( io_source_table_ref->* ).
    DATA(lo_cloned_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                     p_line_type = lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )
                                     p_table_kind = lo_source_table_descr->table_kind
                                     p_unique = lo_source_table_descr->is_unique
                                     p_key = lo_source_table_descr->get_keys( )
                                     p_with_header = lo_source_table_descr->has_header_line ).

    CREATE DATA ro_cloned_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_cloned_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_clone_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clone_table.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_rtti_clone_table=>tt_sflight_simple.
    lt_source = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_source_ref) = REF TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_clone_table( ).
    DATA(lo_cloned_ref) = lo_cut->clone_table_structure( lo_source_ref ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cloned_ref ).

    DATA(lo_source_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( lo_source_ref->* ).
    DATA(lo_cloned_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( lo_cloned_ref->* ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cloned_descr->get_name( ) exp = lo_source_descr->get_name( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cloned_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ) exp = lo_source_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man die Struktur einer bestehenden internen Tabelle dynamisch klont. Zuerst wird die Typbeschreibung der Quelltabelle mit `describe_by_data` ermittelt. Dann wird mit `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` eine neue Tabellenbeschreibung erstellt, die alle Eigenschaften der Quelltabelle übernimmt. Dies ist ideal für generische Funktionen, die mit verschiedenen Tabellentypen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Table, Clone Structure, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Aggregation (z.B. Zählung) auf einer dynamischen internen Tabelle durch, basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT` mit Feld-Symbolen und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg,
           tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_by_field
      IMPORTING
        io_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_by_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dyn_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_table_ref->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if field exists
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( io_table_ref ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_counts = REDUCE HASHED TABLE OF i FOR <ls_dyn_line> IN <lt_dyn_table>
                INIT lv_result TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                NEXT
                  ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dyn_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
                  IF sy-subrc = 0.
                    lv_result[ <lv_field_value> ] = lv_result[ <lv_field_value> ] + 1.
                  ENDIF.
                FINALLY
                  lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_by_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_by_field.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_rtti_dyn_aggregate=>tt_sflight_agg.
    lt_sflight = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = REF TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_aggregate( ).

    DATA(lt_counts_carrid) = lo_cut->count_by_field( io_table_ref = lo_table_ref iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_carrid[ 'AA' ] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_carrid[ 'LH' ] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_carrid[ 'UA' ] exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lt_counts_fldate) = lo_cut->count_by_field( io_table_ref = lo_table_ref iv_field_name = 'FLDATE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_fldate[ '20250101' ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_fldate[ '20250102' ] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_fldate[ '20250103' ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts_fldate[ '20250104' ] exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine dynamische Aggregation (Zählung) auf einer internen Tabelle. Es nutzt `REDUCE` in Kombination mit Feld-Symbolen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, um zur Laufzeit auf den Wert des Aggregationsfeldes zuzugreifen. Dies ermöglicht flexible Auswertungen ohne statische Feldnamen. `REDUCE` ist eine moderne ABAP-Syntax für kompakte Schleifen mit Ergebnisbildung.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Aggregation, REDUCE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Filterung einer internen Tabelle durch, basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen und Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen Ausdruck oder `LOOP AT` mit Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filter,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_filter,
           tt_sflight_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_source_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name       TYPE string
        iv_filter_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_filtered_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_source_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field_value>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_source_table_ref->* TO <lt_source_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a new dynamic table with the same structure as the source
    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_source_table> ).
    CREATE DATA ro_filtered_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_source_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_filtered_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_filtered_table_ref->* TO <lt_filtered_table>.

    " Check if field exists
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_field_value> = iv_filter_value.
        APPEND <ls_source_line> TO <lt_filtered_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_rtti_dyn_filter=>tt_sflight_filter.
    lt_sflight = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_source_ref) = REF TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_filter( ).

    DATA(lo_filtered_ref_aa) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamically(
                                  io_source_table_ref = lo_source_ref
                                  iv_field_name       = 'CARRID'
                                  iv_filter_value     = 'AA' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_filtered_aa> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_filtered_ref_aa->* TO <lt_filtered_aa>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_filtered_aa> ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_filtered_aa>[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    DATA(lo_filtered_ref_lh) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamically(
                                  io_source_table_ref = lo_source_ref
                                  iv_field_name       = 'CARRID'
                                  iv_filter_value     = 'LH' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_filtered_lh> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_filtered_ref_lh->* TO <lt_filtered_lh>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_filtered_lh> ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_filtered_lh>[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lo_filtered_ref_date) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamically(
                                    io_source_table_ref = lo_source_ref
                                    iv_field_name       = 'FLDATE'
                                    iv_filter_value     = '20250102' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_filtered_date> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_filtered_ref_date->* TO <lt_filtered_date>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_filtered_date> ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_filtered_date>[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Filterung einer internen Tabelle. Es erstellt zunächst eine neue dynamische Tabelle mit der gleichen Struktur wie die Quelltabelle. Dann wird die Quelltabelle mit `LOOP AT` und Feld-Symbolen durchlaufen. Der Wert des dynamisch angegebenen Feldes wird mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` abgerufen und mit dem Filterwert verglichen. Passende Zeilen werden in die neue Tabelle kopiert. Dies ist eine generische Lösung für Filteranforderungen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Filter, Internal Tables, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, LOOP AT

Instructions: Kombiniere Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT und SBOOK für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Datum. Füge eine Spalte hinzu, die die Datenquelle ('SFLIGHT' oder 'SBOOK') angibt.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... UNION ALL ...` und Literale für die Datenquelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             data_src TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, @'SFLIGHT' AS data_src
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, @'SBOOK' AS data_src
      FROM sbook
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_basic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_basic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_basic( ).
    " Testdaten einfügen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000001' customid = '1' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000001' ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).

    " Testdaten aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` in ABAP SQL ermöglicht das Kombinieren von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren `SELECT`-Anweisungen. Die `@`-Syntax für Hostvariablen und Literale ist modern und obligatorisch ab 7.50.
keywords: UNION ALL, ABAP SQL, SELECT, Hostvariable

Instructions: Kombiniere Flugdaten und Buchungsdaten, filtere nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und sortiere das Ergebnis nach Flugdatum und Verbindungs-ID.
hint: `UNION` erlaubt `WHERE` und `ORDER BY` Klauseln, die auf das Gesamtergebnis angewendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_filter_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             source   TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_filter_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, @'FLIGHT' AS source
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, @'BOOKING' AS source
      FROM sbook
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate ASC, connid ASC
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_filter_order FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_filter_order.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_filter_order( ).
    " Testdaten einfügen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250102'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250102'.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000001' customid = '1' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000001' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sorted_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).

    " Testdaten aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250102'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250102'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ORDER BY` kann direkt auf das Ergebnis der `UNION`-Operation angewendet werden, um eine konsistente Sortierung über alle kombinierten Datensätze hinweg zu gewährleisten.
keywords: UNION ALL, ORDER BY, ABAP SQL, SELECT

Instructions: Kombiniere Daten aus SFLIGHT und SCARR (Fluggesellschaften), wobei die Spaltennamen unterschiedlich sind, aber logisch zusammengehören. Verwende Aliase, um die Spalten anzugleichen. Entferne Duplikate.
hint: Verwende `AS` für Spaltenaliase in den `SELECT`-Anweisungen und `UNION` (ohne `ALL`) für Duplikatsentfernung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_alias DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             id   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             name TYPE scarr-carrname,
             type TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_carrier_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_alias IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_carrier_info.
    SELECT carrid AS id, carrid AS name, @'FLIGHT' AS type
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' " Beispiel-Filter
    UNION
    SELECT carrid AS id, carrname AS name, @'CARRIER' AS type
      FROM scarr
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' " Beispiel-Filter
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_alias FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_alias.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_alias( ).
    " Testdaten einfügen (falls nicht vorhanden)
    INSERT scarr FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' currcode = 'USD' url = 'http://www.aa.com' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_carrier_info( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ). " UNION entfernt Duplikate
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-type exp = 'CARRIER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-type exp = 'FLIGHT' ).

    " Testdaten aufräumen
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Spaltenaliase (`AS`) sind notwendig, wenn die Spaltennamen in den einzelnen `SELECT`-Anweisungen einer `UNION`-Operation nicht übereinstimmen, aber in der Ergebnisstruktur gleich benannt werden sollen. `UNION` (ohne `ALL`) entfernt Duplikate.
keywords: UNION, ALIAS, ABAP SQL, SELECT

Instructions: Ermittle die Gesamtzahl der Sitze und die belegten Sitze für Flüge und Buchungen separat pro Fluggesellschaft und kombiniere diese aggregierten Daten.
hint: Verwende `SUM` und `GROUP BY` in jeder `SELECT`-Anweisung vor dem `UNION ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_data,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             booked_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             data_source TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_agg_data.
    TYPES tt_agg_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_agg_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_data.
    SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_seats, SUM( seatsocc ) AS booked_seats, @'SFLIGHT' AS data_source
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, 0 AS total_seats, COUNT( * ) AS booked_seats, @'SBOOK' AS data_source " SBOOK hat keine seatsmax
      FROM sbook
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_agg FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_agg.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_agg( ).
    " Testdaten einfügen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'UA'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'UA'.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 price = '100' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 80 price = '100' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B737' ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B001' customid = '1' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000001' ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B002' customid = '2' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000002' ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B003' customid = '3' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000003' ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_data( ).

    DATA(ls_sflight_agg) = VALUE zcl_sql_union_agg=>ty_agg_data( ).
    DATA(ls_sbook_agg) = VALUE zcl_sql_union_agg=>ty_agg_data( ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE carrid = 'UA'.
      IF ls_item-data_source = 'SFLIGHT'.
        ls_sflight_agg = ls_item.
      ELSEIF ls_item-data_source = 'SBOOK'.
        ls_sbook_agg = ls_item.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_agg-total_seats exp = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_agg-booked_seats exp = 230 ).

CLASS zcl_sql_union_literal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Kombiniere die Top 3 Flüge mit den höchsten Preisen aus SFLIGHT mit den Top 3 Buchungen mit den höchsten Preisen aus SBOOK. Verwende `UP TO N ROWS` und `UNION ALL`.
hint: Wende `UP TO N ROWS` auf jede `SELECT`-Anweisung vor dem `UNION ALL` an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             source   TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_price_data.
    TYPES tt_price_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_priced_items
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_price_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_priced_items.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, @'FLIGHT' AS source
      FROM sflight
      ORDER BY price DESC
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, sum( loccur ) AS price, currency, @'BOOKING' AS source " loccur als Preis-Indikator
      FROM sbook
      GROUP BY carrid, connid, fldate, currency
      ORDER BY price DESC
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_n_union FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_union.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_top_n( ).
    " Testdaten einfügen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '500' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '600' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '700' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0004' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).

    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B001' customid = '1' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000001' loccur = 100 currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B002' customid = '2' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000002' loccur = 150 currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B003' customid = '3' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000003' loccur = 200 currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sbook FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B004' customid = '4' custtype = 'B' sm_id = '00000004' loccur = 50 currency = 'EUR' ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_priced_items( iv_top_n = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 6 ). " 3 Flüge + 3 Buchungen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = 700 ). " Höchster Flugpreis
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-price exp = 250 ). " Höchster Buchungspreis (100+150)

    " Testdaten aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    DELETE FROM sbook WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UP TO N ROWS` kann in jeder `SELECT`-Anweisung vor der `UNION`-Operation verwendet werden, um die Anzahl der zurückgegebenen Zeilen zu begrenzen. Dies ist nützlich für Top-N-Analysen.
keywords: UNION ALL, UP TO N ROWS, ABAP SQL, SELECT, Aggregation

Instructions: Kombiniere alle Fluggesellschaften aus SCARR mit allen Flugverbindungen aus SFLIGHT, die eine bestimmte Währung verwenden. Zeige die Fluggesellschafts-ID, den Namen und die Währung an.
hint: Verwende `UNION ALL` und stelle sicher, dass die Spaltenanzahl und -typen übereinstimmen. Verwende Aliase.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             id       TYPE scarr-carrid,
             name     TYPE scarr-carrname,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             source   TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_combined_data.
    TYPES tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_currency_related_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_combined_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_currency_related_data.
    SELECT carrid AS id, carrname AS name, currcode AS currency, @'CARRIER' AS source
      FROM scarr
      WHERE currcode = @iv_currency
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid AS id, connid AS name, currency, @'FLIGHT' AS source
      FROM sflight
      WHERE currency = @iv_currency
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_currency_union FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_union.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_currency( ).
    " Testdaten einfügen
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE currcode = 'USD'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE currency = 'USD'.
    INSERT scarr FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'US' carrname = 'US Airlines' currcode = 'USD' url = 'http://www.us.com' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'US' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_currency_related_data( iv_currency = 'USD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-currency exp = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-currency exp = 'USD' ).

    " Testdaten aufräumen
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE currcode = 'USD'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE currency = 'USD'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` kann verwendet werden, um Daten aus verschiedenen Tabellen zu kombinieren, die eine gemeinsame logische Verbindung (hier: Währung) haben, auch wenn die Bedeutung der Spalten (z.B. `name` als `carrname` oder `connid`) variiert. Aliase sind hier entscheidend.
keywords: UNION ALL, ABAP SQL, SELECT, Aliase, Währung

Instructions: Skalieren Sie ein Bild (als XSTRING) auf eine neue Breite von 100 Pixeln, wobei das Seitenverhältnis beibehalten wird. Geben Sie die ursprünglichen und neuen Dimensionen des Bildes aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_igs_image_converter` und die Methode `resize_image`. Die Dimensionen können Sie mit `get_image_properties` ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_resize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS resize_and_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_target_width  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_resized_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_img_resize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resize_and_display.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).
    DATA: lv_orig_width  TYPE i,
          lv_orig_height TYPE i,
          lv_orig_format TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Get original properties
        lo_converter->get_image_properties(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_xstring = iv_image_xstring
          IMPORTING
            e_image_width   = lv_orig_width
            e_image_height  = lv_orig_height
            e_image_format  = lv_orig_format
        ).

        cl_demo_output=>display_text(
          |Originalbild: Format '{ lv_orig_format }', Dimensionen { lv_orig_width }x{ lv_orig_height }|
        ).

        " Resize image
        lo_converter->resize_image(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_xstring = iv_image_xstring
            i_target_width  = iv_target_width
            i_keep_aspect   = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            e_image_xstring = rv_resized_xstring
        ).

        " Get new properties
        DATA: lv_new_width  TYPE i,
              lv_new_height TYPE i.
        lo_converter->get_image_properties(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_xstring = rv_resized_xstring
          IMPORTING
            e_image_width   = lv_new_width
            e_image_height  = lv_new_height
        ).

        cl_demo_output=>display_text(
          |Bild skaliert auf: { lv_new_width }x{ lv_new_height }|
        ).

      CATCH cx_igs_error INTO DATA(lx_igs_error).
        cl_demo_output=>display_text(
          |Fehler bei der Bildskalierung: { lx_igs_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Zeigen Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `GROUP BY` für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
           tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_and_display_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_display_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lt_avg_prices) = REDUCE tt_avg_price_by_carrier(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_avg_price_by_carrier( )
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
        LET total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                            INIT sum = 0
                            FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                            NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price )
            count_flights = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
        IN
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                                ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem String ausführt (z.B. Trimmen, Ersetzen, Großschreibung) und das Ergebnis zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining.
hint: Jede Methode sollte eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS replace IMPORTING iv_old TYPE string iv_new TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_current_string = condense( mv_current_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old IN mv_current_string WITH iv_new.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_current_string = to_upper( mv_current_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->trim( )->replace( iv_old = ',' iv_new = '' )->replace( iv_old = ' ' iv_new = '_' )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, und die Uhrzeit, die 2 Stunden und 15 Minuten in der Zukunft liegt, basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum und der Systemzeit. Geben Sie die Ergebnisse mit `cl_demo_output` aus.

CLASS zcl_date_time_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_and_display_future_dt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_display_future_dt.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_current_time) = sy-uzeit.

    " Calculate future date
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lv_current_date + 30.

    " Calculate future time (using time stamp for easier arithmetic)
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_timestamp).
    DATA(lv_future_timestamp) = lv_timestamp + ( 2 * 3600 ) + ( 15 * 60 ). " Add 2 hours and 15 minutes

    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_future_timestamp
      TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE DATA(lv_future_date_ts)
           TIME DATA(lv_future_time_ts).

    cl_demo_output=>display_text(
      |Aktuelles Datum: { lv_current_date DATE = USER }\n|
    && |Datum in 30 Tagen: { lv_future_date DATE = USER }\n|
    && |Aktuelle Uhrzeit: { lv_current_time TIME = USER }\n|
    && |Uhrzeit in 2h 15min: { lv_future_time_ts TIME = USER }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_time_calc( ).

    " We can verify the logic by re-calculating and comparing.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      cl_demo_output=>display_data(

          value = lt_future_flights
          name  = 'Zukünftige Flüge'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten aus SFLIGHT. Zeigen Sie die dynamische Tabelle mit `cl_demo_output` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die dynamische Typdefinition und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_dynamic_itab
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_dynamic_itab.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        " 1. Create dynamic structure
        DATA(lt_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
          FOR ls_fieldname IN it_fieldnames
          ( name = ls_fieldname, type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'STRING' ) )
        ).
        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

        " 2. Create dynamic table type
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

        " 3. Create dynamic table
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        " 4. Read data from SFLIGHT and fill dynamic table
        DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
        SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

        LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          CREATE DATA lr_line LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
          ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

          LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO DATA(<fs_sflight_field>).
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <fs_field> = <fs_sflight_field>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

        cl_demo_output=>display_data(
          EXPORTING
            value = <fs_table>
            name  = 'Dynamische SFLIGHT Tabelle'
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation_error cx_sy_table_creation_error cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_demo_output=>display_text(
          |Fehler bei der dynamischen Tabellenerstellung: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate aller Preise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die größer als 100 sind. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_and_display_sum_of_squares.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_display_sum_of_squares.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_sum_of_squares) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( price > 100 )
        NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-price ** 2 )
      ).

      cl_demo_output=>display_text(
        |Summe der Quadrate von Preisen > 100: { lv_sum_of_squares }|
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>display_text( 'Keine SFLIGHT Daten gefunden.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.

                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflights`, in der der Preis für Flüge über 500 EUR um 10% reduziert wird, ansonsten bleibt er gleich.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit dem `COND` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_cond_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             original_price TYPE s_price,
             adjusted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
        iv_discount_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_cond_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                     original_price = ls_sflight-price
                                     adjusted_price = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > iv_threshold
                                                              THEN ls_sflight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate )
                                                              ELSE ls_sflight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adjust_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjust_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_cond_price( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_cut->adjust_flight_prices( iv_threshold = 500 iv_discount_rate = '0.10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_adjusted ).
    LOOP AT lt_adjusted INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-original_price > 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-adjusted_price
          exp = ls_flight-original_price * '0.90'
          msg = 'Price should be discounted'
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-adjusted_price
          exp = ls_flight-original_price
          msg = 'Price should not be discounted'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte, inline-bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. In Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `VALUE` Operators kann man interne Tabellen mit dynamisch berechneten Feldern basierend auf Bedingungen erstellen.
keywords: FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, sflight, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA') aus `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                               FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).

    " Assuming some known values for LH and AA in sflight
    " These values might need adjustment based on actual sflight data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_lh exp = '10000.00' ). " Example value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_aa exp = '5000.00' ).  " Example value

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `SPFLI`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_origin_dest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_route,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_route.
    TYPES tt_flight_route TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_route WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_route
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_from TYPE s_from_cit
        iv_city_to   TYPE s_to_city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_route.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_origin_dest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_route.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    DATA: lt_all_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_all_spfli.

    DATA(lt_matching_spfli) = FILTER #( lt_all_spfli USING KEY primary_key
                                        WHERE cityfrom = iv_city_from AND cityto = iv_city_to ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights
                                   FOR ls_spfli IN lt_matching_spfli
                                   WHERE ( ls_sflight-carrid = ls_spfli-carrid AND ls_sflight-connid = ls_spfli-connid )
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                     cityfrom = ls_spfli-cityfrom
                                     cityto = ls_spfli-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_origin_dest( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_route( iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' iv_city_to = 'NEW YORK' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator erzeugt eine gefilterte Sicht auf eine interne Tabelle, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um zunächst relevante Flugverbindungen zu finden und dann die eigentlichen Flüge basierend auf diesen Verbindungen zu filtern. Die Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine elegante Transformation und Filterung.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering, sflight, spfli, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                            ( carrid       = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                              avg_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                                                       FOR member IN GROUP
                                                       NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summaries ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has 10 flights with total price 10000.00, avg 1000.00
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summaries[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-avg_price exp = '1000.00' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has 5 flights with total price 5000.00, avg 1000.00
    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summaries[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-avg_price exp = '1000.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` auf `GROUP` Membern vereinfachen die Berechnung von Aggregatwerten pro Gruppe.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables, REDUCE, sflight

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_margin,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             profit_margin TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_margin.
    TYPES tt_flight_margin TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_margin WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_profit_margins
      IMPORTING
        iv_margin_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_margin) TYPE tt_flight_margin.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_profit_margins.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights_with_margin = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                      LET lv_margin = ls_sflight-price * iv_margin_rate IN
                                      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                        connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                        price  = ls_sflight-price
                                        profit_margin = lv_margin ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sorted,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_sorted.
    TYPES tt_flight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_sorted WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights_sorted
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights_sorted.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_price_threshold )
                          ORDER BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                            price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    DATA: lv_prev_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE ' ',

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_itb_top_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,

CLASS zcl_itb_top_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_top_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                              FOR ls_member IN GROUP ORDER BY price DESCENDING
                              UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
                              ( carrid = ls_member-carrid
                                connid = ls_member-connid
                                fldate = ls_member-fldate
                                price  = ls_member-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_flight-price LE lv_prev_price ).

IN GROUP` und der `UP TO N ROWS` Klausel ermöglicht es, die Top N Elemente pro Gruppe zu extrahieren. CLASS zcl_itb_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) HAVING GROUP SIZE >= iv_min_flights
                            ( carrid       = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_min_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_having( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( 8 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carriers ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has 10 flights (>=8) and 'AA' has 5 flights (<8)
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      IF ls_carrier-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrier-flight_count exp = 10 ).
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_carrier-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lh_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_aa_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING` Klausel im `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ermöglicht es, Gruppen basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern, die auf Aggregatwerten der Gruppe basiert (hier `GROUP SIZE`). Dies ist analog zur `HAVING`-Klausel in SQL und bietet eine sehr mächtige Filteroption für gruppierte Daten.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Füllen einer internen Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen einmal mit einer klassischen LOOP-Anweisung und einmal mit einem FOR-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds()` für die Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_performance RETURNING VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtm_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_performance.
    DATA: lt_data_loop TYPE tt_data,
          lt_data_for  TYPE tt_data,
          lv_start     TYPE i,
          lv_end       TYPE i,
          lv_duration_loop TYPE i,
          lv_duration_for  TYPE i.

    CONSTANTS lc_num_entries TYPE i VALUE 100000.

    " Messung für LOOP
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lc_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = sy-index text = |Text { sy-index }| ) TO lt_data_loop.
    ENDDO.
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_loop = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Messung für FOR-Ausdruck
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_data_for = VALUE tt_data( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > lc_num_entries
                                 ( id = i text = |Text { i }| ) ).
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_for = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Ergebnisse speichern (für Unit Test)
    CREATE DATA rs_results LIKE TABLE OF i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_results> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_loop TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_for TO <fs_results>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_fill_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_fill_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtm_table_fill( ).
    DATA(lr_results) = lo_cut->measure_performance( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_results> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_results->* TO <fs_results>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_results> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_results> ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FOR`-Ausdrücken ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, interne Tabellen zu füllen oder zu transformieren. In vielen Fällen führt dies auch zu einer besseren Performance, da die ABAP-Laufzeitumgebung Optimierungen anwenden kann, die bei expliziten Schleifen nicht möglich sind. `cl_abap_runtime` ermöglicht präzise Messungen.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, SABP_RUNTIME, FOR, VALUE, Performance, Internal Tables, String Templates

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Lesen von Daten aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle. Vergleichen Sie eine klassische SELECT-Schleife mit einem SELECT-Statement, das alle Daten direkt in eine interne Tabelle liest.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds()` und die `INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data)`-Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_sql_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
