CLASS zcl_rtm_sql_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_sql_performance.
    DATA: lt_sflight_loop TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_sflight_into TYPE tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight      TYPE ty_sflight,
          lv_start        TYPE i,
          lv_end          TYPE i,
          lv_duration_loop TYPE i,
          lv_duration_into TYPE i.

    " Messung für klassische SELECT-Schleife
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight_loop.
    ENDSELECT.
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_loop = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Messung für SELECT INTO TABLE
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_into.
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_into = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Ergebnisse speichern
    CREATE DATA rs_results LIKE TABLE OF i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_results> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_loop TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_into TO <fs_results>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit für das Konkatenieren von 10.000 Strings. Vergleichen Sie die klassische CONCATENATE-Anweisung mit String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds()` und String-Templates (`|...|`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_string_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_string_performance RETURNING VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_rtm_string_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_string_performance.
    DATA: lv_string_concat TYPE string,
          lv_string_template TYPE string,
          lv_part          TYPE string VALUE 'Teilstring ',
          lv_start         TYPE i,
          lv_end           TYPE i,
          lv_duration_concat TYPE i,
          lv_duration_template TYPE i.

    CONSTANTS lc_num_iterations TYPE i VALUE 10000.

    " Messung für CONCATENATE
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lc_num_iterations TIMES.
      CONCATENATE lv_string_concat lv_part INTO lv_string_concat.
    ENDDO.
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_concat = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Messung für String-Templates
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lc_num_iterations TIMES.
      lv_string_template = |{ lv_string_template }{ lv_part }|.
    ENDDO.
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_template = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Ergebnisse speichern
    CREATE DATA rs_results LIKE TABLE OF i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_results> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_concat TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_template TO <fs_results>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lv_sum_loop TYPE i,
          lv_sum_reduce TYPE i,
          lv_start      TYPE i,
          lv_end        TYPE i,
          lv_duration_loop TYPE i,
          lv_duration_reduce TYPE i.

    CONSTANTS lc_num_entries TYPE i VALUE 100000.

    " Tabelle füllen
    lt_values = VALUE tt_values( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > lc_num_entries
                                 ( num = i ) ).

    " Messung für LOOP-Summation
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_values INTO DATA(ls_value).
      lv_sum_loop = lv_sum_loop + ls_value-num.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_loop = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Messung für REDUCE-Ausdruck
    lv_start = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_sum_reduce = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_value IN lt_values NEXT s = s + ls_value-num ).
    lv_end = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lv_duration_reduce = lv_end - lv_start.

    " Ergebnisse speichern
    CREATE DATA rs_results LIKE TABLE OF i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_results> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rs_results->* TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_loop TO <fs_results>.
    APPEND lv_duration_reduce TO <fs_results>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).

      lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer simulierten XLSX-Datei. Die Datei enthält eine einfache Tabelle mit zwei Spalten: 'ID' und 'Name'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` zum Lesen der XLSX-Datei. Da keine echte Datei eingelesen werden kann, wird der Inhalt simuliert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_simulated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_read_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_read_data,
           tt_read_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_read_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_simulated_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_xlsx_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_read_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_simulated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_simulated_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx TYPE REF TO cl_ehfnd_xlsx,
          lt_raw_data TYPE cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>ty_t_xlsx_data,
          lv_row      TYPE i,
          lv_col      TYPE i.

    " XLSX-Objekt erstellen
    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.

    " Simulierte XLSX-Daten laden (in einem echten Szenario käme dies von einer Datei)
    lo_xlsx->load_xlsx_data( iv_xlsx_xstring ).

    " Daten aus dem ersten Blatt lesen
    lo_xlsx->get_sheet_data(
      EXPORTING
        ip_sheet_index = 1 " Erstes Blatt
      IMPORTING
        ep_data        = lt_raw_data
    ).

    " Rohdaten in strukturierte Tabelle umwandeln
    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw_row).
      " Annahme: Erste Zeile ist Header, Daten beginnen ab Zeile 2
      IF sy-tabix = 1.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_read_data(
        id   = CONV i( ls_raw_row[ 1 ]-value ) " Spalte 1: ID
        name = ls_raw_row[ 2 ]-value " Spalte 2: Name
      ).
      APPEND ls_data TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` und die Methoden `add_sheet` und `set_active_sheet`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custid TYPE sbook-custid,
           END OF ty_booking,
           tt_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multi_sheet_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'MULTI_SHEET.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx TYPE REF TO cl_ehfnd_xlsx,
          lv_row  TYPE i,
          lv_col  TYPE i.

    " Daten für Flüge
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).

    " Daten für Buchungen
    DATA(lt_bookings) = VALUE tt_booking(
      ( bookid = '00000001' custid = '00000001' )
      ( bookid = '00000002' custid = '00000002' )
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.

    " Blatt 1: Flüge
    lo_xlsx->add_sheet( ip_sheet_name = 'Flüge' ).
    lo_xlsx->set_active_sheet( ip_sheet_name = 'Flüge' ).
    lv_row = 1. lv_col = 1.
    lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Connection' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Blatt 2: Buchungen
    lo_xlsx->add_sheet( ip_sheet_name = 'Buchungen' ).
    lo_xlsx->set_active_sheet( ip_sheet_name = 'Buchungen' ).
    lv_row = 1. lv_col = 1.
    lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Booking ID' ).
    lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = 'Customer ID' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    LOOP AT lt_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking).
      lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = ls_booking-bookid ).
      lo_xlsx->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = ls_booking-custid ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_xlsx_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie einen leeren ABAP-Editor auf einem Dynpro an. (Hinweis: Für einen vollständigen Test ist ein Dynpro mit Custom Control erforderlich.)
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_abapedit`. Die Instanziierung demonstriert die Verwendung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_editor
      IMPORTING
        iv_program_name TYPE syrepid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_editor.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_abap_editor      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.

    " Create custom container (assuming a screen with a custom control 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' exists)
    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' " This name must match a custom control on a screen
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error     = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        OTHERS         = 5.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create ABAP editor control
    CREATE OBJECT lo_abap_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Set initial text (optional)
    IF iv_program_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_source) = VALUE string_table( ).
      READ REPORT iv_program_name INTO lt_source.
      lo_abap_editor->set_text_as_r3table( lt_source ).
    ENDIF.

    " In a real program, you would now CALL SCREEN and handle events.
    " For this example, we just demonstrate object creation.
    CALL METHOD lo_abap_editor->free.
    CALL METHOD lo_custom_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von ABAP-Paketen, um nur diejenigen zu erhalten, die zu einer bestimmten Software Component gehören.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_packages` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_filter_by_swc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_swc,
             package_name TYPE devclass,
             software_comp TYPE as4comp,
           END OF ty_package_swc.
    TYPES ty_t_package_swc TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package_swc WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_packages_by_swc
      IMPORTING
        iv_software_component TYPE as4comp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_packages) TYPE ty_t_package_swc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_filter_by_swc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_packages_by_swc.
    DATA(lt_all_packages) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_packages( ).
    DATA(lt_package_details) = VALUE ty_t_package_swc( 
      FOR ls_package IN lt_all_packages
      LET ls_attributes = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes( ls_package-devclass ) IN
      ( package_name = ls_package-devclass,
        software_comp = ls_attributes[ name = 'SOFTWARE_COMPONENT' ]-value )
    ).

    rt_filtered_packages = FILTER #( lt_package_details WHERE software_comp = iv_software_component ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_packages ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste aller ABAP-Pakete, die einen bestimmten Präfix haben, und geben Sie deren Transport Layer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_packages` mit `FOR` und `COND` Expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_prefix_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_transport,
             package_name TYPE devclass,
             transport_layer TYPE trlayer,
           END OF ty_package_transport.
    TYPES ty_t_package_transport TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package_transport WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_packages_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_packages) TYPE ty_t_package_transport.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_prefix_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_packages_by_prefix.
    DATA(lt_all_packages) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_packages( ).

    rt_packages = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_package IN lt_all_packages
      WHERE ( CONV string( ls_package-devclass ) CS iv_prefix )
      LET ls_attributes = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes( ls_package-devclass ) IN
      ( package_name = ls_package-devclass,
        transport_layer = ls_attributes[ name = 'TRANSPORT_LAYER' ]-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie den Quellcode eines ABAP-Programms in den Editor und ermöglichen Sie das Speichern der Änderungen zurück ins Repository. (Hinweis: Speichern erfordert Berechtigungen und einen Transportauftrag.)
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_text_as_r3table` zum Laden und `get_text_as_r3table` in Kombination mit `INSERT REPORT` oder `UPDATE REPORT` zum Speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_load_save DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS load_and_save_program
      IMPORTING
        iv_program_name TYPE syrepid
        it_new_code     TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_load_save IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_and_save_program.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_abap_editor      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit,
          lt_current_code     TYPE string_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_abap_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Load existing program code
    READ REPORT iv_program_name INTO lt_current_code.
    lo_abap_editor->set_text_as_r3table( lt_current_code ).

    " Simulate changes or apply new code
    IF it_new_code IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_abap_editor->set_text_as_r3table( it_new_code ).
    ENDIF.

    " Get potentially changed code from editor
    lo_abap_editor->get_text_as_r3table( IMPORTING table = lt_current_code ).

    " Save changes back to repository (requires authorization and transport request)
    TRY.
        INSERT REPORT iv_program_name FROM lt_current_code.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_insert_report_error.
        " If program already exists, try UPDATE
        UPDATE REPORT iv_program_name FROM lt_current_code.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_update_report_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD lo_abap_editor->free.
    CALL METHOD lo_custom_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_load_and_save FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_load_and_save.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_load_save( ).
    DATA(lv_program_name) = 'Z_TEST_PROG_TEMP'.
    DATA(lt_test_code) = VALUE string_table(
      ( |REPORT Z_TEST_PROG_TEMP.| )
      ( |WRITE 'Hello from test program!'.| )
    ).

    " Create a dummy program for testing purposes
    INSERT REPORT lv_program_name FROM lt_test_code.

    DATA(lt_modified_code) = VALUE string_table(
      ( |REPORT Z_TEST_PROG_TEMP.| )
      ( |WRITE 'Hello from modified test program!'.| )
      ( |WRITE 'New line added.'.| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->load_and_save_program( iv_program_name = lv_program_name it_new_code = lt_modified_code ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    " Verify content after save
    DATA(lt_read_back_code) = VALUE string_table( ).
    READ REPORT lv_program_name INTO lt_read_back_code.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_back_code exp = lt_modified_code ).

    " Clean up the dummy program
    DELETE REPORT lv_program_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration des `cl_gui_abapedit` Controls mit dem ABAP Repository. Es demonstriert das Laden von Quellcode mittels `READ REPORT` in den Editor und das Speichern von Änderungen mittels `INSERT REPORT` oder `UPDATE REPORT` zurück ins Repository. Dies ist eine grundlegende Funktionalität für Entwicklungswerkzeuge.

Instructions: Berechne die verbleibende Menge, indem du eine Liste von Abzügen von einem Startwert subtrahierst. Nutze hierfür eine funktionale Reduktion.
hint: Verwende den REDUCE-Operator, um eine kumulative Subtraktion durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_remaining_quantity
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_quantity TYPE i
        it_deductions       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_quantity.
    rv_remaining = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = iv_initial_quantity
      FOR deduction IN it_deductions
      NEXT result = result - deduction
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei gegebenen Datumsangaben. Nutze hierfür moderne Datumsarithmetik.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date_from ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp_to)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date_to ).

    DATA(lv_difference_secs) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_secs(
      tstmp1 = lv_timestamp_to
      tstmp2 = lv_timestamp_from
    ).
    rv_days = lv_difference_secs / ( 24 * 3600 ). " Convert seconds to days
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS). Subtrahiere von der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität (SEATSMAX) die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (SEATSOCC) für einen bestimmten Flug und gib die verbleibenden freien Sitze zurück.
hint: Nutze eine Tabellenexpression, um direkt auf die Felder des gewünschten Eintrags zuzugreifen und die Subtraktion durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_seats_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_seats_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                      connid = iv_connid
                                      fldate = iv_fldate ].
        rv_free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_free_seats = -1.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Struktur mit Mengenfeldern. Erstelle eine neue Struktur, in der von einem bestimmten Mengenfeld ein fester Wert subtrahiert wurde, während andere Felder unverändert bleiben. Nutze hierfür den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit MAPPING und den VALUE-Konstruktor.
hint: Verwende CORRESPONDING #( BASE ... MAPPING ... ) und den VALUE-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_struct_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_quantity_data,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_quantity_data.

    METHODS subtract_from_quantity
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_quantity_data
        iv_deduction   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target_data) TYPE ty_quantity_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_quantity.
    rs_target_data = CORRESPONDING #( 
      BASE ( is_source_data )
      MAPPING quantity = quantity - iv_deduction
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).
    DATA(lv_deduction) = 20.

Hier wird eine neue Struktur erstellt, die auf der Basis der Quellstruktur liegt, aber das `quantity`-Feld wird direkt im `MAPPING`-Ausdruck subtrahiert. Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Bestellpositionen (Material, Menge). Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, die nur Positionen mit einer Menge größer als 10 enthält, und subtrahiere von diesen Mengen jeweils 5. Nutze hierfür eine FOR-Schleife mit WHERE-Klausel und den VALUE-Konstruktor.
hint: Verwende VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_order_item.
    TYPES tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_order_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_order_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_order_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_order_items.
    rt_processed_items = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_item IN it_source_items WHERE ( quantity > 10 )
      ( material = ls_item-material
        quantity = ls_item-quantity - 5 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_all_items_filtered FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_subtract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_subtract=>tt_order_items(
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 15 )
      ( material = 'B' quantity = 8 )
      ( material = 'C' quantity = 20 )
      ( material = 'D' quantity = 10 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_order_items( it_source_items = lt_source ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_subtract=>tt_order_items(
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 10 )
      ( material = 'C' quantity = 15 )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` Konstruktor, `FOR` Schleife und `WHERE` Klausel ermöglicht eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Transformation von internen Tabellen. Es werden nur die Zeilen verarbeitet, die der `WHERE`-Bedingung entsprechen, und die Subtraktion wird direkt während der Konstruktion der neuen Tabelle durchgeführt. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleifen.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Subtrahiere einen Wert von einer Ausgangsmenge nur dann, wenn die Ausgangsmenge einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Nutze hierfür den COND-Operator.
hint: Verwende COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
        iv_deduction     TYPE i
        iv_threshold     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_conditionally.
    rv_result = COND i(
      WHEN iv_initial_value > iv_threshold
      THEN iv_initial_value - iv_deduction
      ELSE iv_initial_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktivieren Sie ein XCO-Objekt (z.B. eine Klasse) programmatisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp=>object_activation->for(...)` und `execute()`. Beachten Sie, dass die Aktivierung einen Transportauftrag erfordern kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_object_activator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS activate_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sxco_object_type
        iv_object_name TYPE sxco_object_name

CLASS zcl_xco_object_activator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD activate_object.
    DATA(lo_activation_request) = xco_cp=>object_activation->for(
      iv_object_type = iv_object_type
      iv_object_name = iv_object_name

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_activate_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_activate_non_existent_object FOR TESTING RAISING cx_xco_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_activate_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_object_activator( ).
    DATA(lv_class_name) = 'ZCL_XCO_TEST_CLASS_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_transport_request) = 'DEVK900001'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch einen gültigen Transportauftrag

    " Vorbereitung: Eine Dummy-Klasse erstellen (muss im System existieren, um aktiviert zu werden)
    " In einem echten Szenario würde diese Klasse bereits existieren oder zuvor erstellt werden.
    " Hier nur zur Demonstration der Aktivierung.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste die Klasse vorher erstellt und dann aktiviert werden.
    " Da XCO-Objekte nicht einfach in Unit-Tests erstellt werden können, wird hier nur der Aufruf getestet.
    " Annahme: ZCL_XCO_DUMMY_CLASS existiert und ist inaktiv.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->activate_object(
          iv_object_type       = xco_cp=>object_type->abap_class
          iv_object_name       = 'ZCL_XCO_DUMMY_CLASS' " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine existierende, inaktive Klasse
          iv_transport_request = lv_transport_request
        ).
        " Wenn keine Ausnahme auftritt, war die Aktivierung erfolgreich (oder das Objekt war bereits aktiv).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Einfache Bestätigung, dass keine Ausnahme geworfen wurde
      CATCH cx_xco_exception INTO DATA(lx_xco).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Fehler bei der Aktivierung: { lx_xco->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_activate_non_existent_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_object_activator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_xco_exception ).
    lo_cut->activate_object(
      iv_object_type = xco_cp=>object_type->abap_class
      iv_object_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine Liste von Zahlen und addieren Sie nur die geraden Zahlen, bis die Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sum_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_until_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sum_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_until_threshold.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( it_numbers ).

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= iv_threshold AND lv_index <= lv_max_index.
      DATA(lv_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_number MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_number.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_sum = lv_current_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sum_threshold( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_until_threshold( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 6 ). "2 + 4 = 6, exceeds 5
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_threshold_exceed.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ). "10 exceeds 15
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_until_threshold( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_threshold = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `WHILE`-Schleife wird verwendet, um eine Liste von Zahlen zu verarbeiten, bis eine bestimmte Bedingung (Summe überschreitet Schwellenwert) erfüllt ist. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Tabellen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch nach einem vom Benutzer angegebenen Feld und einer Sortierreihenfolge (auf- oder absteigend).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit dynamischen Feldnamen und `ASCENDING`/`DESCENDING` als dynamische Option.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_direction  TYPE c LENGTH 1 " 'A' for ASCENDING, 'D' for DESCENDING
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_sflights_dynamic.
    rt_sorted_sflights = it_sflights. " Copy table for sorting

    IF iv_direction = 'A'.
      SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
    ELSEIF iv_direction = 'D'.
      SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
    ELSE.
      " Default to ascending if direction is invalid
      SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Aufgabenwarteschlange, die Aufgaben (Strings) verarbeitet, bis die Warteschlange leer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `DELETE TABLE` mit Index 1, um Elemente aus der Warteschlange zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_task_queue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_tasks
      IMPORTING
        it_tasks_queue TYPE tt_tasks
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE tt_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_task_queue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_tasks.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_tasks_queue.
    DATA(lt_processed) = VALUE tt_tasks( ).

    WHILE lines( lt_queue ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_task) = lt_queue[ 1 ].
      APPEND lv_task TO lt_processed.
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1. " Remove from front of queue
    ENDWHILE.
    rt_processed_tasks = lt_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle, die selbst eine geschachtelte Tabelle enthält, basierend auf einem Feld in der äußeren Tabelle und einem Feld in der inneren Tabelle (z.B. nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach dem Preis des ersten Fluges).
hint: Sortieren Sie zuerst die innere Tabelle, dann die äußere Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `flights[1]-price` für den Zugriff auf das erste Element der geschachtelten Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_nested_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_flights,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_airline_flights.
    TYPES: tt_airline_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_by_airline_and_first_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_airline_flights TYPE tt_airline_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_airline_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_nested_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_by_airline_and_first_flight_price.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_airline_flights.

    " First, sort the inner tables by price
    LOOP AT rt_sorted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_airline_flights>).
      SORT <fs_airline_flights>-flights BY price ASCENDING.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Then, sort the outer table by carrid and the price of the first flight
    SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING
                              flights[1]-price ASCENDING. " Access first element of nested table
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft eine bestimmte Ziffer in einer Zahl vorkommt, bis die Zahl 0 erreicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und den Modulo-Operator (`MOD`) sowie `DIV` für die Ziffernextraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_digit_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_digit_in_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
        iv_digit  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_digit_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_digit_in_number.
    DATA(lv_temp_number) = iv_number.
    rv_count = 0.

    WHILE lv_temp_number > 0.
      DATA(lv_current_digit) = lv_temp_number MOD 10.
      IF lv_current_digit = iv_digit.
        rv_count = rv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_temp_number = lv_temp_number DIV 10.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight`, sortieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und entfernen Sie dann direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate, um eine Liste eindeutiger Flugverbindungen zu erhalten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_connections) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connections.
    " Load data from sflight
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    " Sort by carrid and connid
    SORT lt_sflights_raw BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING.

    " Remove adjacent duplicates
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_sflights_raw COMPARING carrid connid.

    rt_unique_connections = lt_sflights_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_deduplicate( ).
    DATA(lt_unique) = lo_cut->get_unique_connections( ).

    " Assert that the count of unique connections is less than or equal to the raw count
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_raw_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_than_or_equal( act = lines( lt_unique ) exp = lv_raw_count ).

    " Assert that there are no duplicates in the result
    DATA(lt_check_duplicates) = lt_unique.
    SORT lt_check_duplicates BY carrid connid.

    " Create a mock scenario where there are no duplicates
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mock_sflights).
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) INTO TABLE @lt_mock_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'BB' connid = '001' ) INTO TABLE @lt_mock_sflights.

    " This test would ideally mock the SELECT statement, but for simplicity, we'll just check the logic.
    " The actual implementation uses SELECT, so this test is more conceptual.
    " For a real test, you'd need a test double for the database access.

    " Assuming get_unique_connections could be modified to accept an input table for testing

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen aus einem String, bis keine Änderungen mehr vorgenommen werden können. Dies ist eine vereinfachte Demonstration, da `CONDENSE` oder `STRIP` dies effizienter tun würden, aber hier soll `WHILE` demonstriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `FIND` und `REPLACE` oder String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_trim_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string_with_while
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_trim_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string_with_while.
    DATA(lv_current_string) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_previous_string) = ''.

    WHILE lv_current_string <> lv_previous_string.
      lv_previous_string = lv_current_string.

      " Remove leading spaces
      IF lv_current_string IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_current_string(1) = ` `.
        lv_current_string = lv_current_string+1.
      ENDIF.

      " Remove trailing spaces
      IF lv_current_string IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_current_string+strlen(lv_current_string)-1(1) = ` `.
        lv_current_string = lv_current_string( strlen(lv_current_string)-1 ).
      ENDIF.

    ENDWHILE.

    rv_trimmed_string = lv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum, aber mit einer benutzerdefinierten Sortierreihenfolge für die Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'LH' vor 'AA' vor allen anderen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit einer `AS TEXT` oder einer Hilfsspalte für die benutzerdefinierte Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_custom_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_custom,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             sort_key TYPE i, " Helper field for custom sort order
           END OF ty_sflight_custom.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_custom TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_custom WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_custom_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_custom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_custom_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_custom_sorted.
    " Load data from sflight
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    " Map raw data to custom structure and assign sort_key
    rt_sorted_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_custom(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
        sort_key = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' THEN 1
                           WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA' THEN 2
                           ELSE 3 ) " Custom order: LH=1, AA=2, Others=3
      )
    ).

    " Sort by custom sort_key, then by flight date
    SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY sort_key ASCENDING
                               fldate ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_custom,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             sort_key TYPE i,

    TYPES: tt_sflight_custom TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_custom WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_custom_sort_order FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_custom_sort_order.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_custom_order( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->get_sflights_custom_sorted( ).

    " Check if LH comes before AA, and AA before others
    DATA(lv_last_carrid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_last_sort_key) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF lv_last_sort_key = 0 OR ls_flight-sort_key >= lv_last_sort_key.
        " Order is correct or same sort key
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Incorrect sort order: { lv_last_carrid } ({ lv_last_sort_key }) followed by { ls_flight-carrid } ({ ls_flight-sort_key })| ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_last_sort_key = ls_flight-sort_key.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert specific positions if enough data exists and is predictable
    " This requires SFLIGHT to have specific data, which is not guaranteed.
    " A more robust test would use mocked data.
    " Example for mocked data (conceptual):
    DATA(lt_mock_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_custom(
      ( carrid = 'BA' fldate = '20250101' sort_key = 3 ) " Other
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250102' sort_key = 1 ) " LH
      ( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250103' sort_key = 2 ) " AA
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101' sort_key = 1 ) " LH
    ).
    " After sorting this mock data, the order should be:
    " LH 20250101, LH 20250102, AA 20250103, BA 20250101

    " Since we are using actual SFLIGHT, we can only check the general principle.
    " Find first LH, first AA, first other
    DATA(lv_first_lh_index) = 0.
    DATA(lv_first_aa_index) = 0.
    DATA(lv_first_other_index) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO ls_flight.
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND lv_first_lh_index = 0.
        lv_first_lh_index = sy-tabix.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' AND lv_first_aa_index = 0.
        lv_first_aa_index = sy-tabix.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid <> 'LH' AND ls_flight-carrid <> 'AA' AND lv_first_other_index = 0.
        lv_first_other_index = sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_first_lh_index > 0 AND lv_first_aa_index > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_first_lh_index < lv_first_aa_index
        msg = 'LH should appear before AA' ).
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_first_aa_index > 0 AND lv_first_other_index > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_first_aa_index < lv_first_other_index
        msg = 'AA should appear before other carriers' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen, indem Sie jede Zahl durch 2 teilen, bis sie kleiner als 1 ist. Sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse jeder Division in einer neuen Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Transformation und Sammlung der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_divide_until_one DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_divide_until_one IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rt_processed_data = VALUE #( FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
                                 LET lv_current_val = lv_number
                                     lt_intermediate_results = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34( )
                                 IN
                                   REDUCE decfloat34( INIT lv_temp_val = lv_current_val
                                                      WHILE lv_temp_val >= 1
                                                      NEXT lv_temp_val = lv_temp_val / 2
                                                      APPEND lv_temp_val TO lt_intermediate_results
                                                      RESULT lv_temp_val ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Wiederholungslogik mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife, die eine Operation bis zu einer maximalen Anzahl von Versuchen wiederholt oder bis sie erfolgreich ist. Simulieren Sie einen Fehler mit einer Zufallszahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit einem Zähler und einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_retry_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_retriable_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_unit_assert.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _simulate_failing_operation
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_retry_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_retriable_operation.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    DATA(lv_operation_successful) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries AND lv_operation_successful = abap_false.
      lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
      TRY.
          _simulate_failing_operation( ).
          lv_operation_successful = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_static_check.
          " Operation failed, will retry if max_retries not reached
          " In a real scenario, add a delay here (e.g., WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_success = lv_operation_successful.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_failing_operation.
    " Simulate a random failure
    DATA(lv_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 10 )->get_next( ).
    IF lv_random < 7. " 60% chance of failure
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_retry_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_retry_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_retry_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry_logic( ).
    " With enough retries, it should eventually succeed (probabilistically)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_retriable_operation( iv_max_retries = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result msg = 'Operation should eventually succeed with enough retries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_retry_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_retry_logic( ).
    " With very few retries, it might fail (probabilistically)
    " This test is non-deterministic, which is generally bad for unit tests.
    " For a deterministic test, _simulate_failing_operation would need to be mocked.
    " For demonstration, we accept the non-determinism here.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_retriable_operation( iv_max_retries = 1 ).
    " We can't assert false, as it might succeed on the first try.
    " Instead, we assert that it either succeeds or fails gracefully.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result OR act = NOT lv_result
      msg = 'Operation should either succeed or fail after 1 retry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine robuste Wiederholungslogik unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung. Die Schleife wird fortgesetzt, solange die maximale Anzahl von Versuchen nicht erreicht ist und die Operation nicht erfolgreich war. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder instabilen Diensten. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_int` zur Simulation von Zufallsfehlern ist ein modernes Feature.
keywords: WHILE, Retry Logic, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Random, ABAP_BOOL

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Stack-Datenstruktur, die Elemente (Strings) verarbeitet, bis der Stack leer ist. Die Elemente sollen in umgekehrter Reihenfolge der Eingabe verarbeitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und `DELETE TABLE` mit dem letzten Index, um Elemente vom Stack zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_stack_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_elements TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_stack
      IMPORTING
        it_input_stack TYPE tt_elements
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_elements) TYPE tt_elements.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_stack_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_stack.
    DATA(lt_stack) = it_input_stack.
    DATA(lt_processed) = VALUE tt_elements( ).

    WHILE lines( lt_stack ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_last_index) = lines( lt_stack ).
      DATA(lv_element) = lt_stack[ lv_last_index ].
      APPEND lv_element TO lt_processed.
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX lv_last_index. " Remove from top of stack
    ENDWHILE.
    rt_processed_elements = lt_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum, aber mit einer dynamisch generierten Sortierreihenfolge für die Fluggesellschaften, die zur Laufzeit über eine Mapping-Tabelle definiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Hilfsspalte und eine Mapping-Tabelle, um die dynamische Sortierreihenfolge zu implementieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mapped,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             sort_prio TYPE i, " Priority for dynamic sorting
           END OF ty_sflight_mapped.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mapped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mapped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_prio,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             prio   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_prio.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_prio TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid_prio
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_sflights_dynamic_sorted
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_priority TYPE tt_carrid_prio
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_mapped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_dynamic_sorted.
    " Load data from sflight
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    " Map raw data to custom structure and assign sort_prio based on input mapping
    rt_sorted_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_mapped(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      LET lv_prio = VALUE i( it_carrid_priority[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ]-prio OPTIONAL )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
        sort_prio = lv_prio " Use 0 if not found in mapping
      )
    ).

    " Sort by sort_prio (ascending), then by fldate (ascending)
    SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY sort_prio ASCENDING
                               fldate ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_mapped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mapped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_prio,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             prio   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_prio.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_prio TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid_prio
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS test_dynamic_sort_mapping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sort_partial_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sort_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_dynamic_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_priority_map) = VALUE tt_carrid_prio(
      ( carrid = 'LH' prio = 10 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' prio = 20 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' prio = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->get_sflights_dynamic_sorted( lt_priority_map ).

    " Check if LH comes before AA, and AA before BA based on priority
    DATA(lv_last_prio) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-sort_prio >= lv_last_prio.
        " Order is correct or same priority
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Incorrect sort order: { lv_last_prio } followed by { ls_flight-sort_prio }| ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_prio = ls_flight-sort_prio.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert specific order for known carriers (if they exist in SFLIGHT)
    DATA(lv_first_lh_prio) = 0.
    DATA(lv_first_aa_prio) = 0.
    DATA(lv_first_ba_prio) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO ls_flight.
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND lv_first_lh_prio = 0.
        lv_first_lh_prio = ls_flight-sort_prio.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' AND lv_first_aa_prio = 0.
        lv_first_aa_prio = ls_flight-sort_prio.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'BA' AND lv_first_ba_prio = 0.
        lv_first_ba_prio = ls_flight-sort_prio.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_first_lh_prio > 0 AND lv_first_aa_prio > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_first_lh_prio < lv_first_aa_prio
        msg = 'LH priority should be less than AA priority' ).
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_first_aa_prio > 0 AND lv_first_ba_prio > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_first_aa_prio < lv_first_ba_prio
        msg = 'AA priority should be less than BA priority' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_sort_partial_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_dynamic_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_priority_map) = VALUE tt_carrid_prio(
      ( carrid = 'LH' prio = 10 )
      ( carrid = 'XX' prio = 5 ) " A carrier not in SFLIGHT, or one that is but not in the map
    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->get_sflights_dynamic_sorted( lt_priority_map ).

    " All carriers not in the map should have sort_prio = 0 and appear first (default behavior of OPTIONAL)
    DATA(lv_first_mapped_prio) = 9999.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-sort_prio > 0.
        lv_first_mapped_prio = ls_flight-sort_prio.
        BREAK.
      ENDIF.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-sort_prio exp = 0
        msg = 'Unmapped carriers should have priority 0' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_first_mapped_prio exp = 10
      msg = 'First mapped carrier should have priority 10 (LH)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster für konfigurierbare Sortieranforderungen. `SORTED TABLE` und `OPTIONAL` sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Finden Sie die erste Zahl in einer Liste, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt (z.B. größer als 100), und beenden Sie die Suche, sobald diese gefunden wurde. Wenn keine Zahl die Bedingung erfüllt, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHILE` und `COND` oder `REDUCE` mit `WHILE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_find_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_number_above_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_find_first IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_number_above_threshold.
    rv_found_number = REDUCE i(
      INIT lv_result = 0 " Default value if not found
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
      WHILE lv_result = 0 " Continue as long as no number is found
      NEXT lv_result = COND i( WHEN lv_number > iv_threshold THEN lv_number ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum, aber verwenden Sie eine Lambda-Funktion für die Sortierung, um eine komplexe, einmalige Sortierlogik zu implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit einer `BY` Klausel, die eine Lambda-Funktion für den Vergleich nutzt (ABAP 7.55+).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_lambda DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_lambda_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_lambda IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_lambda_sorted.
    " Load data from sflight
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_sorted_sflights = lt_sflights_raw.

    " Sort using a lambda function: LH first, then AA, then others, then by fldate descending
    SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY (
      ( a, b ) =>
        LET prio_a = COND i( WHEN a-carrid = 'LH' THEN 1
                             WHEN a-carrid = 'AA' THEN 2
                             ELSE 3 )
            prio_b = COND i( WHEN b-carrid = 'LH' THEN 1
                             WHEN b-carrid = 'AA' THEN 2
                             ELSE 3 )
        IN
          IF prio_a < prio_b THEN -1 " a comes before b
          ELSEIF prio_a > prio_b THEN 1 " b comes before a
          ELSEIF a-fldate > b-fldate THEN -1 " if carrid same, sort fldate descending
          ELSEIF a-fldate < b-fldate THEN 1
          ELSE 0 " elements are equal
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_lambda_sort.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_lambda( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->get_sflights_lambda_sorted( ).

    " For deterministic testing, we'll use a local table.
    DATA(lt_local_data) = mt_test_data.

    SORT lt_local_data BY (
      ( a, b ) =>
        LET prio_a = COND i( WHEN a-carrid = 'LH' THEN 1
                             WHEN a-carrid = 'AA' THEN 2
                             ELSE 3 )
            prio_b = COND i( WHEN b-carrid = 'LH' THEN 1
                             WHEN b-carrid = 'AA' THEN 2
                             ELSE 3 )
        IN
          IF prio_a < prio_b THEN -1
          ELSEIF prio_a > prio_b THEN 1
          ELSEIF a-fldate > b-fldate THEN -1
          ELSEIF a-fldate < b-fldate THEN 1
          ELSE 0
    ).

    " Expected order:
    " LH 0401 20250103
    " LH 0400 20250101
    " AA 0017 20250102
    " AA 0018 20250101
    " BA 0900 20250101

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250103' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 4 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 4 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 5 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_local_data[ 5 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.55+ ermöglicht die Verwendung von Lambda-Funktionen direkt in der `SORT`-Anweisung. Dies bietet maximale Flexibilität für komplexe, ad-hoc Sortierlogiken, die nicht einfach durch Feldlisten oder `AS TEXT` abgebildet werden können. Die Lambda-Funktion definiert einen Vergleich zwischen zwei Zeilen (`a` und `b`) und gibt -1, 0 oder 1 zurück. `LET` und `COND` innerhalb der Lambda-Funktion sind ebenfalls moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: SORT, Lambda, Functional Programming, Custom Sort, Internal Tables, LET, COND

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Strings, indem Sie jeden String umkehren, bis ein String gefunden wird, der ein Palindrom ist. Sammeln Sie die umgekehrten Strings bis zu diesem Punkt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `REVERSE` und String-Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_reverse_until_palindrome DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_strings_until_palindrome
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reversed_strings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_reverse_until_palindrome IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_strings_until_palindrome.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( it_strings ).
    DATA(lv_palindrome_found) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_max_index AND lv_palindrome_found = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_current_string) = it_strings[ lv_index ].
      DATA(lv_reversed_string) = lv_current_string.
      REVERSE lv_reversed_string.

      APPEND lv_reversed_string TO rt_reversed_strings.

      IF lv_current_string = lv_reversed_string.
        lv_palindrome_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum, aber stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Flüge mit einem Preis über 200 Euro immer am Ende der Liste stehen, unabhängig von anderen Sortierkriterien.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus `FILTER` und `SORT` oder eine Hilfsspalte mit Priorität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_priority_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_priority_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_priority_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_priority_sorted.
    " Load data from sflight
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    " Separate flights into two groups: normal and high-price
    DATA(lt_normal_price_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_sflights_raw WHERE price <= 200
    ).
    DATA(lt_high_price_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_sflights_raw WHERE price > 200
    ).

    " Sort normal-price flights by carrid ascending, fldate ascending
    SORT lt_normal_price_flights BY carrid ASCENDING
                                    fldate ASCENDING.

    " Sort high-price flights by carrid ascending, fldate ascending
    SORT lt_high_price_flights BY carrid ASCENDING
                                  fldate ASCENDING.

    " Combine the sorted lists, with high-price flights at the end
    rt_sorted_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      BASE lt_normal_price_flights
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_high_price_flights ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    mt_test_data = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' fldate = '20250101' price = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 250 ) " High price
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0901' fldate = '20250102' price = 300 ) " High price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_priority_sort.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_priority_group( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->get_sflights_priority_sorted( ).

    " For deterministic testing, we'll use a local table.
    DATA(lt_local_data) = mt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_normal_price_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_local_data WHERE price <= 200
    ).
    DATA(lt_high_price_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_local_data WHERE price > 200
    ).

    SORT lt_normal_price_flights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.
    SORT lt_high_price_flights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.

    DATA(lt_expected_result) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      BASE lt_normal_price_flights
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_high_price_flights ( ls_flight )
    ).

    " Compare the result with the expected result
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sorted ) exp = lines( lt_expected_result ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO DATA(ls_actual).
      READ TABLE lt_expected_result INTO DATA(ls_expected) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-carrid exp = ls_expected-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-connid exp = ls_expected-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-fldate exp = ls_expected-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-price exp = ls_expected-price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Verify high-price flights are at the end
    DATA(lv_first_high_price_index) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO DATA(ls_flight_check).
      IF ls_flight_check-price > 200.
        lv_first_high_price_index = sy-tabix.
        BREAK.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_first_high_price_index > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO ls_flight_check FROM lv_first_high_price_index.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight_check-price > 200
          msg = 'All flights after the first high-price flight should also be high-price' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine Sortierung mit Prioritätsgruppen. Die Tabelle wird zuerst mit `FILTER` in zwei Gruppen aufgeteilt (normale und hochpreisige Flüge). Jede Gruppe wird separat sortiert und dann mit `VALUE BASE FOR` wieder zusammengeführt, wobei die hochpreisigen Flüge am Ende angehängt werden. Dies ist ein flexibles Muster für komplexe Sortieranforderungen, bei denen bestimmte Elemente eine feste Position haben sollen. `FILTER` und `VALUE BASE FOR` sind moderne ABAP-Konstrukte.
keywords: SORT, Priority Sort, Internal Tables, FILTER, VALUE, FOR, Grouping

CLASS zcl_divide_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_divide_cond IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um Summe und Anzahl zu aggregieren, und dann den `/`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid price = ls_sflight-price )
    ).

    rv_average_price = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT sum_price = 0.0
           count_flights = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
        count_flights = count_flights + 1
      FINALLY
        COND decfloat34( WHEN count_flights = 0 THEN 0 ELSE sum_price / count_flights )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) zur Berechnung des Durchschnittspreises. `REDUCE` aggregiert die Summe der Preise und die Anzahl der Flüge in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Die Division (`/`-Operator) erfolgt im `FINALLY`-Block, wobei `COND` verwendet wird, um eine Division durch Null zu verhindern, falls keine Flüge gefunden werden. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und kompakter Ansatz. Die `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Syntax zum Füllen der internen Tabelle ist ab 7.40 verfügbar, der `FINALLY` Block in `REDUCE` ab 7.50.

Instructions: Berechne für jede Fluggesellschaft den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis und speichere das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwende `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder direkte Aggregation mit `/`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_for_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_average_price,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_average_price.
    TYPES tt_average_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_average_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_average_prices) TYPE tt_average_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_for_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid price = ls_sflight-price )
    ).

    rt_average_prices = VALUE tt_average_price(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        average_price = REDUCE decfloat34(
          INIT sum_price = 0.0
               count_flights = 0
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT
            sum_price = sum_price + member-price
            count_flights = count_flights + 1
          FINALLY
            COND decfloat34( WHEN count_flights = 0 THEN 0 ELSE sum_price / count_flights )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_price_by_carrier FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_divide_for_group( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_avg_prices ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Ergebnistabelle ist ebenfalls modern.

Instructions: Führe eine Ganzzahldivision durch und ermittle den Rest.
hint: Nutze den `DIV` Operator für die Ganzzahldivision und den `MOD` Operator für den Rest.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_int_mod DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_division_result,
             quotient TYPE i,
             remainder TYPE i,
           END OF ty_division_result.

    METHODS perform_integer_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_division_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_int_mod IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_integer_division.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.

    rs_result = VALUE ty_division_result(
      quotient  = iv_numerator DIV iv_denominator
      remainder = iv_numerator MOD iv_denominator
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_integer_division_normal FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_integer_division_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_divide_int_mod( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->perform_integer_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-quotient exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-remainder exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_integer_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_divide_int_mod( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
      CHANGING
        act   = lo_cut->perform_integer_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Ganzzahldivision mit dem `DIV`-Operator und die Ermittlung des Rests mit dem `MOD`-Operator. Beide Operatoren sind seit langem in ABAP verfügbar, werden hier aber in einem modernen `VALUE`-Ausdruck gekapselt, um das Ergebnis als strukturierte Daten zurückzugeben. Die Fehlerbehandlung für Division durch Null erfolgt über eine Ausnahme.

CLASS zcl_date_format_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_ddmmyyyy.
    rv_formatted_date = |{ id_date DATE = USER }|. " Formats according to user settings
    " For a fixed format like DD.MM.YYYY, you might need to extract components or use a conversion exit.
    " Example for fixed DD.MM.YYYY (more explicit):
    DATA(lv_day)   = id_date+6(2).
    DATA(lv_month) = id_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_year)  = id_date+0(4).
    rv_formatted_date = |{ lv_day }.{ lv_month }.{ lv_year }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        id_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( id_date ).
    " CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER does not directly provide text, but a number (1=Monday, 7=Sunday).
    " We can map this to text using a CASE statement or a mapping table.
    rv_weekday_name = CASE lv_weekday_num
                        WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
                        WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
                        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                        WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                        WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                        WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                        WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
                        ELSE 'Unbekannt'
                      END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) mit `CARRID` und `CONNID` als eindeutigem Schlüssel. Füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights`. Greifen Sie dann effizient auf einen bestimmten Eintrag zu, indem Sie den Schlüssel direkt angeben.

CLASS zcl_ht_direct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.

CLASS zcl_ht_direct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rs_flight = lt_sflights[ KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights). Iterieren Sie effizient über alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs> WHERE ...` mit der Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_loop_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_std.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_loop_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND CORRESPONDING #( <fs_flight> ) TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Anweisung auf einer Hash-Tabelle ist sehr effizient, wenn die `WHERE`-Bedingung auf den Schlüsselkomponenten basiert. Hier wird die Hash-Tabelle `lt_sflights` einmalig gefüllt. Die Schleife iteriert dann direkt über die relevanten Einträge, ohne die gesamte Tabelle durchsuchen zu müssen, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in eine Hash-Tabelle um, die nur `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` enthält, und fügen Sie ein neues Feld `FLIGHT_ID` hinzu, das aus `CARRID` und `CONNID` besteht.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `VALUE #` Expression mit `FOR`, um die Transformation und die Erstellung der Hash-Tabelle in einem Schritt durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_map_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mapped,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_mapped.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mapped_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_mapped WITH UNIQUE KEY flight_id.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_mapped_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_map_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_mapped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
      ( flight_id = |{ ls_raw-carrid }-{ ls_raw-connid }|,
        carrid    = ls_raw-carrid,
        connid    = ls_raw-connid,
        fldate    = ls_raw-fldate ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_map_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_ht_map_transform=>tt_sflight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
