    DATA(ls_flight_aa) = lt_mapped_flights[ KEY flight_id = 'AA-0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-flight_id exp = 'AA-0017' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_lh) = lt_mapped_flights[ KEY flight_id = 'LH-0400' ].

Das neue Feld `FLIGHT_ID` wird direkt während der Iteration mit String-Templates (`|...|`) erzeugt. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in einer Hash-Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights).
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_calculate_total_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Hier wird die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) über alle Einträge der Hash-Tabelle berechnet. Dies ersetzt traditionelle `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen durch eine deklarative und funktionale Syntax, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.

CLASS zcl_st_binary_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_st_binary_search IMPLEMENTATION.

    ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle mit der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`, sortiert nach Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dabei eine `FOR GROUPS` Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ...` und `VALUE #` mit einer sortierten Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_st_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_count_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_std OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_source_flights) = it_flights.
    IF lt_source_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF ls_flight IN lt_source_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid     = <key>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_st_group_by=>tt_sflight_std( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flight_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_with_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_st_group_by=>tt_sflight_std(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].

Hier werden Flüge nach `carrid` gruppiert, und für jede Gruppe wird die Anzahl der Flüge (`GROUP SIZE`) ermittelt. CLASS zcl_st_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_std.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY carrid_connid WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine leere sortierte Tabelle für Flugdaten. Fügen Sie neue Einträge hinzu und löschen Sie bestehende Einträge effizient, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` und `DELETE TABLE ... FROM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_st_insert_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS manage_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_add    TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL
        it_flights_to_delete TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_managed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_insert_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manage_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_add ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_add>).
      INSERT <fs_add> INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_delete ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_delete>).
      DELETE TABLE lt_flights FROM <fs_delete>.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_managed_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_and_delete FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_and_delete.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_insert_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_add) = VALUE zcl_st_insert_delete=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_delete) = VALUE zcl_st_insert_delete=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->manage_flights(
      it_flights_to_add    = lt_add
      it_flights_to_delete = lt_delete
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'YY' connid = '0001' ] ).

    TRY.
        lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Flight AA-0017 should have been deleted' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Flight AA-0017 successfully deleted' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_insert_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_add) = VALUE zcl_st_insert_delete=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lo_cut->manage_flights( ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->manage_flights( it_flights_to_add = lt_add ).
    DATA(lv_lines_after_insert) = lines( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_initial_lines exp = lv_lines_after_insert ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` und `DELETE TABLE ... FROM` sind die Standardoperationen für das Hinzufügen und Entfernen von Einträgen in internen Tabellen. Bei sortierten Tabellen stellen diese Operationen sicher, dass die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehalten wird, was für nachfolgende Zugriffe mit `BINARY SEARCH` oder `LOOP AT ... WHERE` entscheidend ist. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in den Schleifen verbessert die Performance, da keine Daten kopiert werden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, DELETE, SFLIGHT, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer Hash-Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index (falls relevant, obwohl bei Hash-Tabellen der Index weniger Bedeutung hat).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` für die Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_index.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rv_index = LINE_INDEX( lt_sflights[ KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum starten. Das Ergebnis soll in einer sortierten Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft vorliegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit Aggregationsfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_st_group_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_agg,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_agg.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_agg_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_aggregations
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregations) TYPE tt_carrier_agg_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_group_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_aggregations.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_std(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_aggregations = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
        WHERE ( ls_flight-fldate > iv_min_fldate )
        GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid     = <key>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_seats  = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_flight-seatsocc ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_group_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregations) = lo_cut->get_carrier_aggregations( iv_min_fldate = '20000101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_aggregations ).
    DATA(ls_aa_agg) = lt_aggregations[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_agg-flight_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_agg-total_seats > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_carrier_aggregations_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_group_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregations) = lo_cut->get_carrier_aggregations( iv_min_fldate = '20500101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_aggregations ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `FOR GROUPS` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und einer verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Expression. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Gruppierungen und Aggregationen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Daten vor der Gruppierung, und `REDUCE` wird innerhalb jeder Gruppe verwendet, um die Summe der Sitze zu berechnen. Das Ergebnis wird direkt in eine sortierte Tabelle geschrieben, was die Effizienz weiter erhöht.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, WHERE, REDUCE, AGGREGATION, SFLIGHT, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Führen Sie zwei Hash-Tabellen von Flugdaten zusammen. Die zweite Tabelle soll dabei neue Einträge hinzufügen oder bestehende Einträge der ersten Tabelle aktualisieren.

CLASS zcl_ht_merge_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS merge_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_base_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

CLASS zcl_ht_merge_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_flight_data.
    rt_merged_flights = VALUE #( BASE it_base_flights
                                 FOR ls_new IN it_new_flights
                                 ( ls_new ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_std
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = it_flights.
    SORT lt_temp_flights BY carrid connid.

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_temp_flights COMPARING carrid connid.

    rt_unique_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_temp_flights ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Auslastung (belegte Sitze / maximale Sitze) aller Flüge in einer Hash-Tabelle. Das Ergebnis soll in einer Hash-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft vorliegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS ... IN ...` mit `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und anschließende Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_occupancy,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_occupancy.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_occupancy_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_occupancy WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_avg_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_carrier_occupancy_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_std(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
        GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid        = <key>-carrid
        avg_occupancy = COND f(
                          WHEN REDUCE i( INIT s_occ = 0 FOR ls_group IN GROUP NEXT s_occ = s_occ + ls_group-seatsocc ) > 0
                            AND REDUCE i( INIT s_max = 0 FOR ls_group IN GROUP NEXT s_max = s_max + ls_group-seatsmax ) > 0
                          THEN CONV f( REDUCE i( INIT s_occ = 0 FOR ls_group IN GROUP NEXT s_occ = s_occ + ls_group-seatsocc ) ) /
                               CONV f( REDUCE i( INIT s_max = 0 FOR ls_group IN GROUP NEXT s_max = s_max + ls_group-seatsmax ) )
                          ELSE 0 ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_avg_occupancy( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

        DATA(ls_xx_occ) = lt_occupancy[ KEY carrid = 'XX' ].

    ENDTRY.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine komplexe Aggregation mit `FOR GROUPS` und verschachtelten `REDUCE`-Expressionen. Für jede Fluggesellschaft werden die Summen der belegten und maximalen Sitze berechnet, um daraus die durchschnittliche Auslastung zu ermitteln. Die `COND f(...)` Expression wird verwendet, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden. Das Ergebnis wird in eine Hash-Tabelle geschrieben, was einen schnellen Zugriff auf die aggregierten Daten pro Fluggesellschaft ermöglicht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten. Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug die verbleibenden freien Sitze und fügen Sie diese Information als neues Feld hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... LET ...` um Zwischenberechnungen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_st_for_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_free_seats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_with_free_seats.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_free_seats_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_with_free_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_free_seats_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_for_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_std(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc IN
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
        connid    = ls_flight-connid
        fldate    = ls_flight-fldate
        free_seats = lv_free_seats ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_for_let( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_free_seats) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_with_free_seats ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flights_with_free_seats[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-free_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LET`-Expression innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen, die nur innerhalb des aktuellen Schleifendurchlaufs gültig sind. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Transformationen, indem Zwischenergebnisse klar benannt und wiederverwendet werden können. Hier wird `lv_free_seats` berechnet und dann im Ergebnis verwendet, was den Code sauberer macht. Das Ergebnis wird direkt in eine sortierte Tabelle geschrieben.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, LET, VALUE, TRANSFORMATION, SFLIGHT, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Sammeln Sie Flugdaten in einer sortierten Tabelle, um die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft zu aggregieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COLLECT` mit einer sortierten Tabelle, die einen eindeutigen Schlüssel auf `CARRID` hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_st_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS collect_flight_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_agg_std OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_seats) TYPE tt_sflight_agg_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_st_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_flight_seats.
    DATA(lt_source_flights) = it_raw_flights.
    IF lt_source_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_source_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_raw>).
      COLLECT <fs_raw> INTO rt_aggregated_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_collect_flight_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_collect_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_collect_with_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_flight_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->collect_flight_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_aggregated ).
    DATA(ls_aa_agg) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_agg-seatsocc > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_collect_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_input) = VALUE zcl_st_collect=>tt_sflight_agg_std( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->collect_flight_seats( lt_empty_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_aggregated ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_collect_with_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_st_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_st_collect=>tt_sflight_agg_std(
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->collect_flight_seats( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_aa_agg) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_agg-seatsocc exp = 150 ).
    DATA(ls_lh_agg) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_agg-seatsocc exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COLLECT`-Anweisung ist eine spezielle Form der Aggregation für interne Tabellen. Wenn sie auf eine sortierte Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel angewendet wird, aggregiert sie numerische Felder für Einträge mit identischen Schlüsselwerten. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Summen oder andere Aggregationen zu bilden, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, COLLECT, AGGREGATION, SUM, SFLIGHT, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (z.B. 'AA', '0017') in der Tabelle `sflights` existiert, ohne Daten zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `UP TO 1 ROWS` und `INTO @DATA(...)` oder `INTO @FINAL(...)` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_check_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_check_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO @FINAL(lv_dummy).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Test für existierenden Flug

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists_true msg = 'Flug AA 0017 sollte existieren' ).

    " Test für nicht existierenden Flug
    DATA(lv_exists_false) = lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_exists_false msg = 'Flug XX 9999 sollte nicht existieren' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt `SELECT SINGLE UP TO 1 ROWS` und `INTO @FINAL(lv_dummy)` um lediglich die Existenz eines Datensatzes zu prüfen, ohne unnötige Daten zu lesen. Die Verwendung von `sy-subrc` ist hier der effizienteste Weg, um das Ergebnis zu ermitteln. `abap_true` und `abap_false` sind moderne Konstanten für boolesche Werte.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS read_language_file

        iv_filename TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_lang_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier cl_cts_language_file_io oder eine ähnliche
    " spezialisierte Klasse für den Dateizugriff verwendet werden.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir den Inhalt.
    CASE iv_filename.
      WHEN 'MESSAGES.TXT'.
        CASE iv_language.
          WHEN 'D'.
            rv_content = |MSG_WELCOME=Willkommen in ABAP!\nMSG_GOODBYE=Auf Wiedersehen!|.
          WHEN 'E'.
            rv_content = |MSG_WELCOME=Welcome to ABAP!\nMSG_GOODBYE=Goodbye!|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_content = |Language { iv_language } not supported for { iv_filename }|.
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_content = |File { iv_filename } not found.|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie einen gegebenen String-Inhalt in eine simulierte Sprachdatei unter Verwendung einer Wrapper-Klasse, die die Funktionalität von `cl_cts_language_file_io` abstrahiert.
hint: Die Wrapper-Klasse sollte eine Methode zum Schreiben von Dateiinhalten haben. Für das Beispiel kann der 'Schreibvorgang' durch Speichern in einem internen Attribut simuliert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_file_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
        iv_content  TYPE string.

    METHODS get_simulated_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_entry,
             filename TYPE string,
             language TYPE sy-langu,
             content  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_entry,
           tt_file_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_simulated_files TYPE tt_file_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_language_file.
    DATA(ls_file_entry) = VALUE ty_file_entry(
      filename = iv_filename
      language = iv_language
      content  = iv_content
    ).

    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier cl_cts_language_file_io oder eine ähnliche
    " spezialisierte Klasse für den Dateizugriff verwendet werden.
    " Für dieses Beispiel speichern wir den Inhalt in einer internen Tabelle.
    APPEND ls_file_entry TO mt_simulated_files.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_simulated_content.
    READ TABLE mt_simulated_files INTO DATA(ls_found)
      WITH KEY filename = iv_filename language = iv_language.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_content = ls_found-content.
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie die Details eines einzelnen Fluges (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) aus `sflights` in einem lesbaren String unter Verwendung von String-Templates.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_flight_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_flight_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight AS sf
      INNER JOIN spfli AS sp ON sf~carrid = sp~carrid AND sf~connid = sp~connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE sf~carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND sf~connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_formatted_string = |Flug { ls_flight_data-carrid } { ls_flight_data-connid } am { ls_flight_data-fldate DATE = USER }\n|
                          && |Von: { ls_flight_data-cityfrom } Nach: { ls_flight_data-cityto }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_formatted_string = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben eine interne Tabelle von Flugschlüsseln (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer), lesen Sie für jeden Schlüssel die Flugdetails aus `sflights` und fügen Sie sie einer neuen internen Tabelle hinzu. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Schleifen (`FOR`) und `SELECT SINGLE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Quelltabelle zu iterieren und `SELECT SINGLE` für jeden Eintrag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,
           tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details_for_keys
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details_for_keys.
    rt_flight_details = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_key IN it_flight_keys
      ( LET ls_flight_data = VALUE ty_flight_detail(
            carrid = ls_key-carrid
            connid = ls_key-connid
          ) IN
          SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
            FROM sflight
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight_data
            WHERE carrid = @ls_key-carrid
              AND connid = @ls_key-connid.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ls_flight_data
          ENDIF
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife wird `SELECT SINGLE` verwendet, um für jeden Schlüssel die Details aus der Datenbank abzurufen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Konfiguration (z.B. einen Flugschlüssel) aus einer simulierten Sprachdatei liest und diesen dann verwendet, um einen Flug aus `sflights` zu lesen. Die Konfiguration soll in einem privaten Attribut gespeichert werden.
hint: Kapseln Sie die Logik in Methoden. Nutzen Sie die simulierte Dateilese-Klasse und `SELECT SINGLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_config_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_config,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_config.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_lang_file_reader TYPE REF TO zcl_lang_file_reader.

    METHODS load_and_get_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_data) TYPE ty_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_lang_file_reader TYPE REF TO zcl_lang_file_reader.
    DATA ms_flight_config    TYPE ty_flight_config.

    METHODS read_config_from_file
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_flight_config.

    METHODS get_flight_from_db
      IMPORTING
        is_config TYPE ty_flight_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_config_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_lang_file_reader = io_lang_file_reader.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_and_get_flight.
    ms_flight_config = read_config_from_file( ).
    rs_flight_data = get_flight_from_db( ms_flight_config ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_config_from_file.
    " Simulierte Konfiguration aus einer 'Sprachdatei'
    DATA(lv_file_content) = mo_lang_file_reader->read_language_file(
      iv_filename = 'FLIGHT_CONFIG.TXT'
      iv_language = sy-langu
    ).

    " Beispiel: Inhalt ist 'CARRID=LH;CONNID=0400'
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX 'CARRID=([^;]+);CONNID=(.+)' IN lv_file_content
      SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_carrid), DATA(lv_connid).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_config = VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid ).
    ELSE.
      " Default-Werte oder Fehlerbehandlung
      rs_config = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_from_db.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @is_config-carrid
        AND connid = @is_config-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Zählen der Anzahl der Passagiere für eine Liste von Flügen, indem Sie für jeden Flug die Passagierkapazität aus `sflights` mit `SELECT SINGLE` abrufen und die Summe mit `REDUCE` bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugschlüsseln und `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `SELECT SINGLE` im Iterationsschritt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_reduce_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_reduce_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_key IN it_flight_keys
      NEXT
        total = total + COND i(
          WHEN ( SELECT SINGLE seatsmax FROM sflight
                   INTO @DATA(lv_seatsmax)
                   WHERE carrid = @ls_key-carrid
                     AND connid = @ls_key-connid ) IS NOT INITIAL
            THEN lv_seatsmax
          ELSE 0
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_agg_reduce_select( ).

    DATA(lt_keys) = VALUE zcl_agg_reduce_select=>tt_flight_keys(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) " Annahme: seatsmax > 0
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) " Annahme: seatsmax > 0
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ) " Nicht existierender Flug
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_capacity) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsmax FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_lh_seats) WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_expected_capacity = lv_expected_capacity + lv_lh_seats. ENDIF.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsmax FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_aa_seats) WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_expected_capacity = lv_expected_capacity + lv_aa_seats. ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_capacity) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_flight_keys = lt_keys ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_capacity exp = lv_expected_capacity msg = 'Gesamtkapazität falsch berechnet' ).

    " Test mit leerer Schlüsseltabelle
    DATA(lt_empty_keys) = VALUE zcl_agg_reduce_select=>tt_flight_keys( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_capacity) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_flight_keys = lt_empty_keys ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_capacity exp = 0 msg = 'Kapazität für leere Tabelle sollte 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um die Gesamtkapazität von Flügen zu berechnen. Innerhalb der `NEXT`-Klausel wird für jeden Flugschlüssel ein `SELECT SINGLE` ausgeführt, um die `seatsmax` zu erhalten. Die `COND`-Expression stellt sicher, dass nur existierende Werte zur Summe addiert werden. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und effizienter Ansatz.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, FOR, SELECT SINGLE, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch ein Feld (z.B. 'PLANETYPE') eines bestimmten Fluges aus `sflights` basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)` und einem dynamischen Feldzugriff oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_field.
    DATA: ls_flight_data TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight_data
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader_ex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_flight_key_or_raise
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING

      RAISING
        zcx_flight_not_found.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader_ex IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid
      FROM sflight

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid
          iv_connid = iv_connid.
    ENDIF.

solution:
CLASS zcl_config_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_lang_file_reader TYPE REF TO zcl_lang_file_reader.

    METHODS get_valid_flight_keys_from_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_valid_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_lang_file_reader TYPE REF TO zcl_lang_file_reader.

    METHODS parse_config_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.

    METHODS is_flight_key_valid
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_lang_file_reader = io_lang_file_reader.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_valid_flight_keys_from_config.
    DATA(lv_config_content) = mo_lang_file_reader->read_language_file(
      iv_filename = iv_config_filename
      iv_language = sy-langu
    ).

    DATA(lt_raw_keys) = parse_config_content( lv_config_content ).

    rt_valid_keys = FILTER #( lt_raw_keys USING is_flight_key_valid( is_key = table_line ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD parse_config_content.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( FOR <line> IN CL_ABAP_STRING_UTILITIES=>SPLIT( iv_content SEPARATOR CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CR_LF ) WHERE ( <line> IS NOT INITIAL )
                                         ( <line> ) ).

    rt_parsed_keys = VALUE #(
      FOR <line> IN lt_lines
      LET lv_carrid = substring( val = <line> off = 0 len = 2 )
          lv_connid = substring( val = <line> off = 3 len = 4 ) IN
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_flight_key_valid.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(lv_dummy)
      WHERE carrid = @is_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_key-connid
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Anzahl der Monate berechnet, die benötigt werden, um ein Startkapital mit einem gegebenen monatlichen Zinssatz zu verdoppeln, unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife.

solution:
CLASS zcl_compound_interest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_months_to_double
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_amount TYPE decfloat16
        iv_monthly_rate   TYPE decfloat16 " e.g., 0.005 for 0.5%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_months)  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compound_interest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_months_to_double.
    DATA(lv_current_amount) = iv_initial_amount.
    DATA(lv_target_amount) = iv_initial_amount * 2.
    rv_months = 0.

    IF iv_initial_amount <= 0 OR iv_monthly_rate <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_current_amount < lv_target_amount.
      lv_current_amount = lv_current_amount * ( 1 + iv_monthly_rate ).
      rv_months = rv_months + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen verarbeitet. Entfernen Sie iterativ das erste Element und addieren Sie es zu einer Summe, solange die Tabelle nicht leer ist. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE NOT itab IS INITIAL` oder `WHILE line_exists( itab[ 1 ] )` und `DELETE TABLE itab INDEX 1`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers      TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)   TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA lt_local_numbers TYPE tt_numbers.
    lt_local_numbers = it_numbers.
    rv_sum = 0.

    WHILE lt_local_numbers IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_first_element) = lt_local_numbers[ 1 ].
      rv_sum = rv_sum + lv_first_element.
      DELETE TABLE lt_local_numbers INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_prefix_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numeric_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_numeric_prefix) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_prefix_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numeric_prefix.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    rv_numeric_prefix = ``.

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      DATA(lv_char) = iv_input_string+lv_offset(1).
      IF lv_char CA '0123456789'. " Check if character is a digit
        rv_numeric_prefix = rv_numeric_prefix && lv_char.
        lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine simulierte externe Operation mit einer bestimmten Fehlerwahrscheinlichkeit aufruft. Wiederholen Sie den Aufruf in einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis die Operation erfolgreich ist oder eine maximale Anzahl von Wiederholungen erreicht wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit Zähler und einer Bedingung für Erfolg oder maximale Versuche. Simulieren Sie Zufallsfehler mit `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_retry_mechanism DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation_with_retry
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
        iv_fail_chance TYPE i DEFAULT 50 " Percentage chance of failure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS simulate_external_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_fail_chance TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_retry_mechanism IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_retry.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries AND rv_success = abap_false.
      lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
      rv_success = simulate_external_call( iv_fail_chance = iv_fail_chance ).
      IF rv_success = abap_false.
        " Optional: Log retry attempt
        " cl_demo_output=>write( |Retry { lv_retries } failed.| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_external_call.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 100 ).
    DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_num > iv_fail_chance.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung einer Baumstruktur, indem Sie Elemente aus einer Liste entfernen und deren 'Kinder' zur Liste hinzufügen, solange die Liste nicht leer ist. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine interne Tabelle als 'Warteschlange' und `WHILE NOT itab IS INITIAL`. Simulieren Sie Kinder-Elemente mit einer Map.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_traversal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_node_id TYPE string.
    TYPES: tt_node_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_node_children TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_node_ids WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: ty_tree_structure TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_node_children WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS traverse_tree
      IMPORTING
        is_tree_definition TYPE ty_tree_structure
        iv_start_node      TYPE ty_node_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_traversed_nodes) TYPE tt_node_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_traversal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD traverse_tree.
    DATA lt_queue TYPE tt_node_ids.
    DATA ls_current_node TYPE ty_node_id.

    APPEND iv_start_node TO lt_queue.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO ls_current_node.
      DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.

      APPEND ls_current_node TO rt_traversed_nodes.

      IF is_tree_definition IS NOT INITIAL AND is_tree_definition-contains( ls_current_node ).
        DATA(lt_children) = is_tree_definition[ ls_current_node ].
        LOOP AT lt_children INTO DATA(lv_child_node).
          APPEND lv_child_node TO lt_queue.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_browser=>show_html` innerhalb der `WHILE`-Schleife und `cl_abap_browser=>set_close_on_commit( abap_false )` um das Fenster offen zu halten. Für den Test geben Sie den finalen HTML-String zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_while_browser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS run_dynamic_steps IMPORTING iv_num_steps TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_final_html) TYPE string. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_dynamic_while_browser IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD run_dynamic_steps. DATA(lv_current_step) = 0. DATA(lv_html_content) = ``. cl_abap_browser=>set_close_on_commit( abap_false ). " Keep browser open WHILE lv_current_step < iv_num_steps. lv_current_step = lv_current_step + 1. lv_html_content = |Dynamische Schritte| && |

Aktueller Schritt: { lv_current_step } von { iv_num_steps }

| && |

Verarbeitung läuft...

| && ||. cl_abap_browser=>show_html( html_string = lv_html_content ). " Simulate some work or delay WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. ENDWHILE. rv_final_html = |Dynamische Schritte| && |

Verarbeitung abgeschlossen!

| && |

Alle { iv_num_steps } Schritte wurden erfolgreich ausgeführt.

| && ||. cl_abap_browser=>show_html( html_string = rv_final_html ). cl_abap_browser=>set_close_on_commit( abap_true ). " Close browser on next commit ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_steps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_steps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_while_browser( ).
    DATA(lv_final_html) = lo_cut->run_dynamic_steps( iv_num_steps = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_final_html exp = 'Verarbeitung abgeschlossen!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_final_html exp = 'Alle 2 Schritte wurden erfolgreich ausgeführt.' ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strings verarbeitet. Entfernen Sie alle Duplikate und leeren Strings, solange die Tabelle nicht leer ist und die Anzahl der verbleibenden Elemente einen Schwellenwert überschreitet. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einer Bedingung, die die Anzahl der Zeilen prüft. Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS clean_and_filter_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_threshold   TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cleaned_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_and_filter_strings.
    DATA lt_working_strings TYPE tt_strings.
    lt_working_strings = it_raw_strings.

    " Remove empty strings first
    lt_working_strings = FILTER #( lt_working_strings WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Sort for DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    SORT lt_working_strings BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_working_strings COMPARING table_line.

    " Process with WHILE loop if threshold is exceeded
    WHILE lines( lt_working_strings ) > iv_threshold.
      " Simulate further processing or reduction
      " For this example, we just remove the last element until threshold is met
      DELETE TABLE lt_working_strings INDEX lines( lt_working_strings ).
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_cleaned_strings = lt_working_strings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cleaning_and_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_below_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleaning_and_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_cleaner( ).
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_table_cleaner=>tt_strings.
    APPEND 'A' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'B' TO lt_input.
    APPEND '' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'A' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'C' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'B' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'D' TO lt_input.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->clean_and_filter_strings( it_raw_strings = lt_input iv_threshold = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_below_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_cleaner( ).
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_table_cleaner=>tt_strings.
    APPEND 'X' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'Y' TO lt_input.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->clean_and_filter_strings( it_raw_strings = lt_input iv_threshold = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Y' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_cleaner( ).
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_table_cleaner=>tt_strings.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->clean_and_filter_strings( it_raw_strings = lt_input iv_threshold = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von modernen internen Tabellenoperationen (`FILTER`, `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`) mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife für eine bedingte Nachbearbeitung. Die `WHILE`-Schleife wird verwendet, um die Tabelle zu reduzieren, solange die Anzahl der Zeilen einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen eine Tabelle schrittweise verkleinert oder verarbeitet werden muss, bis eine bestimmte Größe erreicht ist.
keywords: WHILE, Loop, Internal Table, FILTER, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Data Cleaning, Threshold

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Datenbank-Cursor für die Tabelle `sflights`, lesen Sie die ersten 3 Flüge mit `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und schließen Sie den Cursor wieder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_with_cursor RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight.

    DO 3 TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus `sflights` für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA', indem Sie Daten in Paketen lesen und `REDUCE` verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_current_total TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO TABLE lt_flights PACKAGE SIZE 50.
      lv_current_total = REDUCE #( INIT sum = lv_current_total FOR flight IN lt_flights NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
    ENDSELECT.
    rv_total_price = lv_current_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS is_entry_cached IMPORTING iv_entry_id TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_cached) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_entry_cached.
    " In a real scenario, this would involve calling methods of CL_ESH_CA_CHECK

    "                rv_is_cached = lo_cache_checker->check_entry( iv_entry_id ).

    IF iv_entry_id = 'P123' OR iv_entry_id = 'P456'.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Überprüfung einer Liste von Einträgen im ESH-Cache und geben Sie zurück, welche davon gecacht sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Methode, die eine Tabelle von IDs akzeptiert und eine Tabelle von Cache-Status zurückgibt. In der Realität wäre dies eine Methode von `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_status,
             entry_id   TYPE string,
             is_cached  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_cache_status.
    TYPES: tt_cache_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_multiple_entries IMPORTING it_entry_ids TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_cache_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_multiple_entries.
    rt_status = VALUE #( FOR id IN it_entry_ids ( 
                              entry_id = id
                              is_cached = COND abap_bool( WHEN id = 'P123' OR id = 'P456' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
                            ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_ids) = VALUE string_table( ( 'P123' ) ( 'P789' ) ( 'P456' ) ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Überprüfung mehrerer Cache-Einträge unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE` und `COND`. In einer realen ESH-Anwendung würde man eine Methode von `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` aufrufen, die eine Liste von IDs verarbeiten kann, um den Cache-Status effizient abzufragen.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Überprüfung einer Liste von Einträgen im ESH-Cache und filtern Sie nur die nicht gecachten Einträge heraus.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Methode, die den Cache-Status abfragt, und anschließend den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_uncached_entries IMPORTING it_entry_ids TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_uncached_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_uncached_entries.
    " Simulate cache check results
    DATA(lt_all_status) = VALUE zcl_esh_cache_check_multi=>tt_cache_status(
                                 FOR id IN it_entry_ids ( 
                                   entry_id = id
                                   is_cached = COND abap_bool( WHEN id = 'P123' OR id = 'P456' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
                                 )
                               ).

    rt_uncached_ids = VALUE #( FOR status IN FILTER #( lt_all_status WHERE is_cached = abap_false ) ( status-entry_id ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_uncached) = lo_cut->get_uncached_entries( lt_ids ).

keywords: Cache, ESH, FILTER, Internal Table, COND

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Logik zur Cache-Invalidierung für bestimmte Einträge, basierend auf einer Liste von zu aktualisierenden IDs. Die Methode soll die IDs zurückgeben, für die eine Invalidierung 'erfolgreich' war.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Methode, die die Invalidierung simuliert. In der Realität würde man `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` oder verwandte Klassen verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_invalidate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invalidate_entries IMPORTING it_entry_ids TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_invalidated_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_invalidate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invalidate_entries.
    " In a real scenario, this would involve calling methods of CL_ESH_CA_CHECK
    " or other ESH cache management classes to invalidate entries.
    " For simulation, we'll assume some entries are successfully invalidated.
    rt_invalidated_ids = VALUE #( FOR id IN it_entry_ids
                                  WHERE ( id = 'P123' OR id = 'P789' ) " Simulate successful invalidation for these
                                  ( id ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalidate_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalidate_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_invalidate( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die zuerst prüft, ob Daten für eine Liste von IDs im Cache vorhanden sind. Für nicht gecachte IDs sollen die Daten 'beschafft' und dann als gecacht markiert werden. Geben Sie alle Daten zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie Cache-Check-Logik mit einer simulierten Datenbeschaffung und verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_data_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_entry,
             id   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_entry.
    TYPES: tt_data_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_data_with_cache IMPORTING it_requested_ids TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_data) TYPE tt_data_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_data_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_with_cache.
    DATA: lt_cached_status TYPE zcl_esh_cache_check_multi=>tt_cache_status.
    DATA: lt_uncached_ids TYPE string_table.
    DATA: lt_fetched_data TYPE tt_data_entries.
    DATA: lt_cached_data TYPE tt_data_entries.

    " 1. Simulate cache check
    lt_cached_status = NEW zcl_esh_cache_check_multi( )->check_multiple_entries( it_requested_ids ).

    " 2. Identify uncached IDs
    lt_uncached_ids = VALUE #( FOR status IN FILTER #( lt_cached_status WHERE is_cached = abap_false ) ( status-entry_id ) ).

    " 3. Simulate fetching data for uncached IDs
    IF lt_uncached_ids IS NOT INITIAL.
      " In a real scenario, this would be a database call or API call
      lt_fetched_data = VALUE #( FOR id IN lt_uncached_ids ( id = id value = |Data for { id } (fetched)| ) ).
      " Simulate marking as cached (e.g., by adding to a local cache or calling ESH cache update)
      " cl_esh_ca_check=>get_instance( )->add_to_cache( lt_fetched_data ).
    ENDIF.

    " 4. Simulate getting data from cache for cached IDs
    lt_cached_data = VALUE #( FOR status IN FILTER #( lt_cached_status WHERE is_cached = abap_true )
                              ( id = status-entry_id value = |Data for { status-entry_id } (cached)| ) ).

    " 5. Combine all data
    APPEND LINES OF lt_fetched_data TO rt_all_data.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_cached_data TO rt_all_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` für die zeilenweise Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
       WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `OPEN CURSOR` ausführt, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel und die zu selektierenden Felder zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `FROM (lv_table_name)` und `WHERE (lv_where_clause)` sowie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<fs_data>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name  TYPE tabname
        iv_where_clause TYPE string OPTIONAL
        it_fields      TYPE tt_field_names OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_select_fields TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_select_statement TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.

    IF it_fields IS INITIAL.
      lv_select_fields = '*'.
    ELSE.
      LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(lv_field).
        IF lv_select_fields IS INITIAL.
          lv_select_fields = lv_field.
        ELSE.
          lv_select_fields = lv_select_fields && `, ` && lv_field.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " Create dynamic internal table based on selected fields
    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_name( iv_table_name ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
        DATA(lt_dynamic_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table( ).

        LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
          READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND ls_component TO lt_dynamic_components.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_dynamic_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_data>.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error: structure not found
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    lv_select_statement = `SELECT ` && lv_select_fields && ` FROM ` && iv_table_name.
    IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_select_statement = lv_select_statement && ` WHERE ` && iv_where_clause.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_select_statement).

    DO.
      CREATE DATA lo_line LIKE LINE OF <fs_data>.
      ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <fs_line>.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @<fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_data>.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rt_data = lo_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_where) = `CARRID = 'LH' AND FLDATE > '20250101'`.

    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_data(

      it_fields = lt_fields
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( <fs_table> )
      msg = 'Should return some flights for LH'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die `OPEN CURSOR` verwendet und dabei eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall einer ungültigen `SELECT`-Anweisung oder eines Datenbankfehlers demonstriert.
hint: Überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_where_clause TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA: lv_select_statement TYPE string.

    lv_select_statement = `SELECT carrid, connid FROM ` && iv_table_name.
    IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_select_statement = lv_select_statement && ` WHERE ` && iv_where_clause.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_select_statement).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error opening cursor: Invalid statement or table not found.'.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_native_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_native_sql_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_open_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_open_sql_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` verwendet, um Daten in Batches zu verarbeiten, anstatt zeilenweise, um die Performance bei großen Datenmengen zu optimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE n`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_batch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflights_in_batches
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_batch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights_in_batches.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflights_package TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lv_total_processed TYPE i.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
       WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Process the package (e.g., log, update, transform)
      lv_total_processed = lv_total_processed + lines( lt_sflights_package ).
      CLEAR lt_sflights_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_processed_count = lv_total_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen generiert und diese dann für die Anzeige in einem ALV vorbereitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) zur dynamischen Tabellenerstellung und `cl_salv_table=>factory` zur ALV-Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_display_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_alv.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    DATA(lt_dynamic_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table( ).
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_sflight_struct) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
          DATA(ls_component) = lo_sflight_struct->get_component( lv_field_name ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_dynamic_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_dynamic_components IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No valid fields to display' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_dynamic_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA lo_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Fill with some dummy data (or real data from DB)
    SELECT (it_field_names) FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<fs_table>.

    IF lines( <fs_table> ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data found for selected fields' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table = <fs_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine dynamische interne Tabelle generiert und einen Feldkatalog für ein ALV erstellt, wobei die Spaltenüberschriften und Sichtbarkeit dynamisch festgelegt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` und manipulieren Sie den Feldkatalog über `cl_salv_columns_list`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             fieldname TYPE fieldname,
             coltext   TYPE lvc_coltext,
             visible   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_alv_with_fcat
      IMPORTING
        it_field_info TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv_with_fcat.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    DATA(lt_dynamic_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table( ).
    LOOP AT it_field_info INTO DATA(ls_field_info).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_sflight_struct) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
          DATA(ls_component) = lo_sflight_struct->get_component( ls_field_info-fieldname ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_dynamic_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_dynamic_components IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No valid fields to display' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_dynamic_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA lo_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    SELECT ( VALUE #( FOR ls_fld IN it_field_info WHERE ( visible = abap_true ) ( ls_fld-fieldname ) ) ) FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<fs_table>.

    IF lines( <fs_table> ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data found for selected fields' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table = <fs_table>
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        LOOP AT it_field_info INTO ls_field_info.
          TRY.
              DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( ls_field_info-fieldname ).
              lo_column->set_long_text( ls_field_info-coltext ).
              lo_column->set_medium_text( ls_field_info-coltext ).
              lo_column->set_short_text( ls_field_info-coltext ).
              lo_column->set_visible( ls_field_info-visible ).
            CATCH cx_salv_not_found.
              CONTINUE.
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
