Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit benutzerdefinierten Spalten (z.B. berechnete Felder) generiert und diese in einem ALV anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch erstellten `component_table` und füllen Sie die Daten entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_custom_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_field,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_custom_field.
    TYPES tt_custom_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_custom_cols
      IMPORTING
        it_custom_fields TYPE tt_custom_fields.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_custom_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_custom_cols.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.

    DATA(lt_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table( ).
    LOOP AT it_custom_fields INTO DATA(ls_custom_field).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_custom_field-name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( ls_custom_field-type )
      ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No custom fields defined' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA lo_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Fill with some dummy data for custom fields
    DO 3 TIMES.
      CREATE DATA lo_line LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT it_custom_fields INTO ls_custom_field.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_custom_field-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_custom_field-type.
            WHEN 'STRING'.
              <fs_field> = |Value { sy-index } for { ls_custom_field-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <fs_field> = sy-index * 100.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Default handling
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDDO.

    IF lines( <fs_table> ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data to display' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table = <fs_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_event_handler
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING
        row
        column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_event_handler.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
     WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No flights found for carrier' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_events) = mo_alv->get_event_manager( ).
        SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR lo_events.

        mo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA: lv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN mo_alv->get_data_ref( )->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX row.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_carrid = <fs_carrid>.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_connid = <fs_connid>.
        ENDIF.
        MESSAGE |Double-click on row { row }, Carrier: { lv_carrid }, Connection: { lv_connid }| TYPE 'I'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Monat des Flugdatums. Geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und String-Templates für die Monatsformatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             month    TYPE char2,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY (
      carrid = ls_flight-carrid
      month  = |{ ls_flight-fldate+4(2) }| " Extract month from date
      ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).

      DATA ls_summary TYPE ty_flight_summary.
      ls_summary-carrid = <fs_group>-carrid.
      ls_summary-month  = <fs_group>-month.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group> INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        ls_summary-num_flights = ls_summary-num_flights + 1.
        ls_summary-total_price = ls_summary-total_price + ls_group_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Further assertions could check specific group counts/sums if test data is controlled.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40, ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für Aggregationen und macht den Code lesbarer und wartbarer. String-Templates werden für die einfache Extraktion des Monats verwendet.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, sflights, String Templates, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge aus `sflights`, die in einem bestimmten Datumsbereich liegen, unter Verwendung eines funktionalen `FOR`-Ausdrucks und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` zum Filtern und `REDUCE` zum Summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_to   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_in_range.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-fldate BETWEEN iv_date_from AND iv_date_to )
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das X Arbeitstage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei Wochenenden (Samstag/Sonntag).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DATE` und eine Schleife, um Arbeitstage zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_num_days   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_day.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE d VALUE iv_start_date.
    DATA lv_days_added   TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lv_days_added < iv_num_days.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1. " Add one day
      DATA(lo_date) = cl_abap_date=>create_from_date( lv_current_date ).
      IF lo_date->get_weekday( ) <> 6 AND lo_date->get_weekday( ) <> 7. " Not Saturday (6) or Sunday (7)
        lv_days_added = lv_days_added + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_end_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise für Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und geben Sie Zwischensummen aus. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END OF`.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_subtotal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_subtotal_entry,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_subtotal_entry.
    TYPES tt_subtotal_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_subtotal_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_subtotals_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_subtotals) TYPE tt_subtotal_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_subtotal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_subtotals_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid.

    DATA lv_current_carrier_total TYPE sflight-price.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      AT NEW carrid.
        lv_current_carrier_total = 0.
      ENDAT.

      lv_current_carrier_total = lv_current_carrier_total + ls_flight-price.

      AT END OF carrid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_subtotal_entry(
          carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
          total_price = lv_current_carrier_total
        ) TO rt_subtotals.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_subtotals) = lo_subtotal->get_subtotals_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_subtotals ). " Assuming sflight has data
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Kontrollstrukturen innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Schleife sind klassische ABAP-Features, die jedoch mit modernen Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(ls_flight)`) immer noch effizient und lesbar eingesetzt werden können, um Zwischensummen oder Gruppenwechsel zu verarbeiten. Die Tabelle muss vor der Schleife nach dem Gruppierungsfeld sortiert werden.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in `sflights` um einen Prozentsatz. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Field-Symbols ermöglichen die direkte Modifikation von Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2. " e.g., 10.00 for 10%
    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight
      INTO rv_price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    DATA lv_original_price TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA lv_updated_price TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA lv_expected_price TYPE sflight-price.

    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. 
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO lv_original_price WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20251201'.
    ELSE.
      lv_original_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.

    lo_updater->update_flight_prices( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_percentage = 10.00 ).

    lv_updated_price = lo_updater->get_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20251201' ).
    lv_expected_price = lv_original_price * ( 1 + 10.00 / 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price exp = lv_expected_price ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20251201'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist die performanteste Art, interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Inhalt zu modifizieren, da keine Daten kopiert werden. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der Schleife filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen direkt, was die Effizienz weiter steigert.
keywords: LOOP, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, WHERE, Performance, sflights, Update

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`, die mindestens einen Flug mit einem Preis über 500 EUR haben. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `COND`-Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` um die Fluggesellschaften zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cond_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_price_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-price > 500 AND ls_flight-currency = 'EUR' )
      ( ls_flight-carrid ) 
    ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_carriers. " Remove duplicates
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_high_price_carriers FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_high_price_carriers.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_cond_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_filter->get_high_price_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carriers ). " Assuming sflight has data with prices > 500 EUR

    " Check if 'LH' (Lufthansa) is present if it typically has high-priced flights
    READ TABLE lt_carriers WITH KEY table_line = 'LH' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht das Erstellen neuer interner Tabellen durch Iteration und Filterung einer Quelltabelle. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Zeilen direkt. Die `VALUE`-Konstruktion mit `( ls_flight-carrid )` fügt nur die Fluggesellschaften zur Ergebnistabelle hinzu. `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` entfernt doppelte Einträge, um eine Liste eindeutiger Fluggesellschaften zu erhalten.
keywords: FOR, LOOP, Internal Tables, COND, sflights, Functional Programming, Filtering

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für jede Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um den Maximalwert pro Gruppe zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_flight.
    TYPES tt_max_price_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_max_price_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_max_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( REDUCE ty_max_price_flight(
          INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_price_flight( price = 0 )
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > max_flight-price THEN VALUE ty_max_price_flight( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate price = ls_flight-price ) ELSE max_flight )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_flight_max_price( ).
    DATA(lt_max_flights) = lo_finder->get_max_price_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_max_flights ). " Assuming sflight has data

    " Example: Check if a specific carrier has a max price (requires known test data)
    " READ TABLE lt_max_flights INTO DATA(ls_aa_max) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_max-price > 0 ).
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation komplexer Daten. Für jede Gruppe (Fluggesellschaft) wird der `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu finden. Der `COND`-Operator innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine bedingte Zuweisung, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein Feiertag ist, unter Berücksichtigung eines Fabrikkalenders. (Hinweis: Für dieses Beispiel wird ein einfacher Fabrikkalender angenommen, da `CL_RECA_DATE` nicht für allgemeine Feiertagsprüfungen gedacht ist. Stattdessen wird `CL_ABAP_DATE` und eine interne Tabelle für Feiertage verwendet.)

CLASS zcl_holiday_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_holiday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_holiday) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_holidays TYPE HASHED TABLE OF d WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_holiday_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    " Simulate a factory calendar with some holidays
    INSERT '20250101' INTO TABLE gt_holidays.
    INSERT '20251225' INTO TABLE gt_holidays.
    INSERT '20251226' INTO TABLE gt_holidays.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_holiday.
    READ TABLE gt_holidays WITH KEY table_line = iv_date TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_holiday = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_holiday = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_holiday_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->is_holiday( '20250101' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->is_holiday( '20251225' ) exp = abap_true ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren Flugdatum im aktuellen Monat liegt. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `COND` und `CL_ABAP_DATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_DATE` um den aktuellen Monat zu bestimmen und `FOR` zum Filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_current_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_current_month
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_current_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_current_month.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_current_date) = cl_abap_date=>create_from_date( lv_current_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_month) = lo_current_date->get_month( ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = lo_current_date->get_year( ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-fldate IS NOT INITIAL AND
              cl_abap_date=>create_from_date( ls_flight-fldate )->get_month( ) = lv_current_month AND
              cl_abap_date=>create_from_date( ls_flight-fldate )->get_year( ) = lv_current_year )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_current_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_current_month.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flights_current_month( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_filter->get_flights_current_month( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) >= 0 ).

    " Assuming there are flights in sflight for the current month, check if the first one matches
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_first_flight) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
      DATA(lo_current_date) = cl_abap_date=>create_from_date( lv_current_date ).
      DATA(lv_current_month) = lo_current_date->get_month( ).
      DATA(lv_current_year) = lo_current_date->get_year( ).

      DATA(lo_flight_date) = cl_abap_date=>create_from_date( ls_first_flight-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_flight_date->get_month( ) exp = lv_current_month ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_flight_date->get_year( ) exp = lv_current_year ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `VALUE`-Operator mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur Flüge des aktuellen Monats enthält. `CL_ABAP_DATE` wird verwendet, um Monat und Jahr des Flugdatums zu extrahieren und mit dem aktuellen Monat/Jahr zu vergleichen. Dies ist eine moderne, deklarative Art der Datenfilterung.
keywords: FOR, LOOP, Internal Tables, Date/Time, CL_ABAP_DATE, sflights, Functional Programming, Filtering

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Fluggesellschaften und der Anzahl ihrer Flüge, die nach dem aktuellen Datum liegen. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Zählung und filtern Sie nach dem Datum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flights_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_count
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flights_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_count.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = REDUCE i(
          INIT count = 0
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          WHERE ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum )
          NEXT count = count + 1
        )
      )
    ).
    DELETE rt_counts WHERE flight_count = 0. " Remove carriers with no future flights
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights_count.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_future_flights_count( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_counter->get_future_flights_count( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_counts ) >= 0 ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has future flights, check if its count is > 0
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_aa_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-flight_count >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR GROUPS OF` und `GROUP BY` mit einem inneren `REDUCE`-Ausdruck. Für jede Fluggesellschaft wird die Anzahl der Flüge gezählt, deren Datum nach dem aktuellen Systemdatum liegt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, aggregierte Daten mit komplexen Filterkriterien zu ermitteln.
keywords: FOR, GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, REDUCE, LOOP, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Date/Time, sflights, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_delete_old_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_old_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE fldate < sy-datum.

unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_old_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_old_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum - 10. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    ls_data-id = 123.
    ls_data-name = 'TestName'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    DATA(lv_id_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_id_value exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_name_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name_value exp = 'TestName' ).

    DATA(lv_invalid_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'INVALID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_invalid_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Feldsymbole ermöglichen den dynamischen Zugriff auf Datenobjekte zur Laufzeit. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist hierfür das zentrale Statement, um auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen, deren Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist essenziell für generische Frameworks.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, Structure

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüsselfeld.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...` nach dem Sortieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum + 1. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights. " Duplicate on key fields
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, vorausgesetzt, die Tabelle ist zuvor nach den Vergleichsfeldern sortiert. Dies ist performanter als eine manuelle Schleife mit `READ TABLE`.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, SORT

CLASS zcl_loop_with_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_prices

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine interne Tabelle zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und verarbeiten Sie deren Inhalt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN (table_name) TO <fs_table>` und `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        rv_count = rv_count + 1.
        " Hier könnte weitere Verarbeitung mit <fs_line> stattfinden
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_dynamic_table.
    DATA: gt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Füllen Sie gt_sflights mit Testdaten
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO gt_sflights.
    APPEND ls_flight TO gt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_access( ).

    " Wichtig: Die Tabelle muss global oder in einem sichtbaren Kontext deklariert sein
    " für den dynamischen ASSIGN.
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_table( 'GT_SFLIGHTS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_count_empty) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_empty exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf interne Tabellen mittels `ASSIGN (table_name) TO <fs_table>` ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die in generischen Programmen oder Frameworks verwendet wird, wenn der Name der zu verarbeitenden Tabelle erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. In Kombination mit `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>` ermöglicht dies eine flexible und performante Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN TABLE FIELD, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Feldsymbol in einem `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um eine komplexe Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_with_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
      WHERE ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc > 0 ) " Nur Flüge mit Passagieren berücksichtigen
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-seatsocc = 100. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0010'. ls_flight-seatsocc = 50. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '1000'. ls_flight-seatsocc = 0. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights. " Should be ignored

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_with_fs( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 150 ).

    " Test with empty table
    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren. Die Verwendung eines Feldsymbols (`FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights`) innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks ist die performanteste Art, auf die Zeilen der Tabelle zuzugreifen, da sie das Kopieren von Daten vermeidet und direkt mit dem Speicherbereich der Zeile arbeitet. Dies ist besonders vorteilhaft bei großen Tabellen und komplexen Aggregationen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gewichteten Durchschnitt einer Liste von Werten, wobei die Gewichte zufällig zwischen 0.1 und 1.0 liegen und die Summe der Gewichte 1.0 ergeben muss.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `cl_abap_random` für die Gewichte. Normalisieren Sie die Gewichte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value_weight,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             weight TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_value_weight.
    TYPES tt_value_weights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value_weight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_average.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    " Generate random weights and calculate their sum
    DATA(lt_raw_weights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( it_values )
      ( lo_random->float_in_range( low = '0.1' high = '1.0' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum_raw_weights) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = '0.0'
      FOR weight IN lt_raw_weights
      NEXT sum = sum + weight
    ).

    " Normalize weights and calculate weighted sum
    rv_weighted_average = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT weighted_sum = '0.0'
           idx         = 1
      FOR value IN it_values
      LET normalized_weight = lt_raw_weights[ idx ] / lv_sum_raw_weights IN
      NEXT weighted_sum = weighted_sum + ( value * normalized_weight )
           idx         = idx + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_weighted_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_average( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY( ( '10.0' ) ( '20.0' ) ( '30.0' ) ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg >= '10.0' AND lv_avg <= '30.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_average( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = '0.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um sowohl die Summe der zufällig generierten Rohgewichte als auch den gewichteten Durchschnitt zu berechnen. `cl_abap_random=>float_in_range` generiert die Gewichte. Der `LET`-Ausdruck innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Berechnung des normalisierten Gewichts und die Multiplikation mit dem Wert in einem kompakten Ausdruck.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Random, Aggregation, Decfloat, LET

CLASS zcl_conditional_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) zufällig durch.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_shuffled.
    TYPES tt_flights_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_flights) TYPE tt_flights_shuffled.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_key) = VALUE tt_flights_shuffled(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        random_key = lo_random->int_in_range( low = 1 high = 1000000 ) 
        carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid     = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate     = ls_sflight-fldate
      )
    ).

    SORT lt_flights_with_key BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_flights = lt_flights_with_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_1) = lo_cut->shuffle_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_2) = lo_cut->shuffle_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_1 ) exp = lines( sflights ) ).

    ENDIF.

Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` wird verwendet, um die neue Tabelle mit den zufälligen Schlüsseln zu erstellen. `cl_abap_random` generiert die Schlüssel.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges alphanumerisches Passwort einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Zeichensatz und wählen Sie Zeichen zufällig in einer `FOR`-Schleife mit String-Templates aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_charset TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_charset_len) = strlen( lc_charset ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    rv_password = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
      LET lv_random_index = lo_random->int_in_range( low = 0 high = lv_charset_len - 1 ) IN
      NEXT s = s && lc_charset+lv_random_index(1)
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_password FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_password_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_password.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_password_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 12 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_password ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password ) exp = 12 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_password_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_password_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_password_short) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password_short ) exp = 5 ).
    DATA(lv_password_long) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password_long ) exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird verwendet, um den Passwort-String iterativ aufzubauen. In jeder Iteration wird ein zufälliger Index generiert (`cl_abap_random`) und das entsprechende Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz ausgewählt und an den String angehängt. String-Templates (`s = s && ...`) sorgen für eine lesbare String-Verkettung.
keywords: Random, String Processing, REDUCE, String Templates, cl_abap_random

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonuswert basierend auf einem Basispunktwert und einem zufällig bestimmten Szenario (z.B. 'A', 'B', 'C'), das unterschiedliche Multiplikationsfaktoren hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator, um den Multiplikationsfaktor basierend auf einem zufälligen Szenario-String zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_bonus_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_bonus
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_points TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bonus) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_bonus_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_scenario_num) = lo_random->int_in_range( low = 1 high = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_scenario) = SWITCH string( lv_scenario_num
                                       WHEN 1 THEN 'A'
                                       WHEN 2 THEN 'B'
                                       WHEN 3 THEN 'C'
                                       ELSE 'A' ). 

    DATA(lv_factor) = SWITCH decfloat16( lv_scenario
                                         WHEN 'A' THEN '1.5'
                                         WHEN 'B' THEN '2.0'
                                         WHEN 'C' THEN '0.8'
                                         ELSE '1.0' ). 

    rv_bonus = iv_base_points * lv_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_bonus FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_bonus.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_bonus_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_base_points) = 100.
    DATA(lv_bonus) = lo_cut->calculate_bonus( lv_base_points ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_bonus ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_bonus >= ( lv_base_points * '0.8' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_bonus <= ( lv_base_points * '2.0' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator wird hier zweimal verwendet: einmal, um eine zufällige Zahl in einen Szenario-String umzuwandeln, und dann, um basierend auf diesem Szenario einen Multiplikationsfaktor zu bestimmen. Dies demonstriert die flexible und kompakte bedingte Logik in modernem ABAP, kombiniert mit `cl_abap_random` für die Szenario-Auswahl.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, MULTIPLY, Random, cl_abap_random

    TYPES tt_adjusted_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_adjusted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE tt_adjusted_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        DATA(lv_adjustment_factor) = lo_random->float_in_range( low = '0.95' high = '1.05' ).
        carrid         = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid         = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate         = ls_sflight-fldate
        original_price = ls_sflight-price
        adjusted_price = ls_sflight-price * lv_adjustment_factor
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Produkten mit Werten. Wählen Sie zufällig 3 Produkte aus den Top 5 Produkten (höchster Wert) aus und multiplizieren Sie deren Werte mit einem Bonusfaktor von 1.2.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT`, `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_random`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_top_n_random_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_random_bonus_to_top_n
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE tt_products
        iv_top_n        TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_select_count TYPE i DEFAULT 3
        iv_bonus_factor TYPE decfloat16 DEFAULT '1.2'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bonused_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_top_n_random_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_random_bonus_to_top_n.
    " 1. Sort products by value descending
    DATA(lt_sorted_products) = it_all_products.
    SORT lt_sorted_products BY value DESCENDING.

    " 2. Get top N products
    DATA(lt_top_n_products) = VALUE tt_products(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_top_n AND i <= lines( lt_sorted_products )
      ( lt_sorted_products[ i ] )
    ).

    IF lt_top_n_products IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Add random key for shuffling and select count
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_with_key,
             random_key TYPE i,
             product    TYPE ty_product,
           END OF ty_product_with_key.
    TYPES tt_products_with_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_with_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_products_with_key) = VALUE tt_products_with_key(
      FOR ls_product IN lt_top_n_products ( 
        random_key = lo_random->int_in_range( low = 1 high = 1000000 )
        product    = ls_product
      )
    ).

    " 4. Sort by random key and take the first 'iv_select_count'
    SORT lt_products_with_key BY random_key.

    DATA(lt_randomly_selected) = VALUE tt_products(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_select_count AND i <= lines( lt_products_with_key )
      ( lt_products_with_key[ i ]-product )
    ).

    " 5. Apply bonus factor to selected products
    rt_bonused_products = VALUE tt_products(
      FOR ls_product IN it_all_products
      LET ls_selected = lt_randomly_selected[ KEY id COMPONENTS id = ls_product-id ] IN
      ( COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN VALUE ty_product( id = ls_product-id value = ls_product-value * iv_bonus_factor )
                ELSE ls_product ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_bonus_top_n FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_products FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_bonus_top_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_top_n_random_bonus( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_top_n_random_bonus=>tt_products(
      ( id = 'P1' value = '100.0' )
      ( id = 'P2' value = '200.0' )
      ( id = 'P3' value = '50.0' )
      ( id = 'P4' value = '300.0' )
      ( id = 'P5' value = '150.0' )
      ( id = 'P6' value = '25.0' )
      ( id = 'P7' value = '400.0' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_bonused) = lo_cut->apply_random_bonus_to_top_n( it_all_products = lt_products iv_top_n = 3 iv_select_count = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_bonused ) exp = lines( lt_products ) ).

    DATA(lv_bonused_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_bonused INTO DATA(ls_bonused).
      DATA(ls_original) = lt_products[ KEY id COMPONENTS id = ls_bonused-id ].
      IF ls_bonused-value > ls_original-value.
        lv_bonused_count = lv_bonused_count + 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_bonused-value exp = ls_original-value * '1.2' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_bonused-value exp = ls_original-value ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_bonused_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_products.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_top_n_random_bonus( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_top_n_random_bonus=>tt_products( ).
    DATA(lt_bonused) = lo_cut->apply_random_bonus_to_top_n( it_all_products = lt_products ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_bonused ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel kombiniert mehrere moderne ABAP-Features: `SORT` für die Rangfolge, `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Extraktion der Top N und das Hinzufügen eines zufälligen Schlüssels, erneutes `SORT` für die zufällige Auswahl, und schließlich `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die bedingte Anwendung des Bonusfaktors. `cl_abap_random` ist entscheidend für die zufällige Auswahl.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORT, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, MULTIPLY, Random, COND

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen der maximalen und der aktuell belegten Sitzplatzanzahl (`SEATSMAX` - `SEATSOCC`) für jeden Flug in `SFLIGHTS` und summieren Sie diese Differenzen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `FOR` für die Iteration und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_free_seats.
    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid )
      NEXT total = total + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_calculate_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_reduce( ).

    " Test für 'LH'
    DATA(lv_expected_lh) = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0 FOR ls_f IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) NEXT total = total + ( ls_f-seatsmax - ls_f-seatsocc ) ).
    DATA(lv_result_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_free_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_lh,
      exp = lv_expected_lh,
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl freier Sitze für LH sollte übereinstimmen'
    ).

    " Test für 'AA'
    DATA(lv_expected_aa) = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0 FOR ls_f IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) NEXT total = total + ( ls_f-seatsmax - ls_f-seatsocc ) ).
    DATA(lv_result_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_free_seats( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_aa,
      exp = lv_expected_aa,
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl freier Sitze für AA sollte übereinstimmen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die Aggregation von Werten, die durch eine Subtraktion (`ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc`) berechnet werden. Dies ist ein modernes, funktionales Muster in ABAP, das den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `SFLIGHTS` die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und die Anzahl der freien Sitzplätze (`SEATSMAX` - `SEATSOCC`) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_itab_for_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flight_summaries
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flight_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_itab_for_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_flight_summaries.
        rt_flight_summaries = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_flight IN sflights
          ( carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
            connid     = ls_flight-connid
            free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) 
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_summaries,
      msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein'
    ).

    " Überprüfen eines spezifischen Eintrags, falls SFLIGHTS bekannte Daten hat
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = ls_summary-carrid AND connid = ls_summary-connid INTO @DATA(ls_flight_orig).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_summary-free_seats,
          exp = ls_flight_orig-seatsmax - ls_flight_orig-seatsocc,
          msg = 'Berechnete freie Sitze sollten mit den Originaldaten übereinstimmen'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Ausdruck in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Schleife ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die Subtraktion (`ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc`) wird direkt im Ausdruck für das Feld `free_seats` durchgeführt, was den Code sehr kompakt macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_string_template_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_string.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_free_seats) = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc.
      rv_info_string = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }: { lv_free_seats } freie Sitzplätze.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_info_string = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_sub( ).

    " Angenommen, Flug 'LH' '0400' existiert in SFLIGHTS
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' INTO @DATA(ls_flight_test).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_free) = ls_flight_test-seatsmax - ls_flight_test-seatsocc.
      DATA(lv_expected_string) = |Flug LH 0400: { lv_expected_free } freie Sitzplätze.|.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lo_cut->get_flight_info_string( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ),
        exp = lv_expected_string,
        msg = 'Formatierter String sollte übereinstimmen'
      ).

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie für einen Flug, ob die Anzahl der freien Sitzplätze unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Geben Sie 'Wenig freie Plätze' oder 'Genug freie Plätze' zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_free_seats_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid      TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_threshold   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_free_seats_status.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_free_seats) = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc.
      rv_status = COND string(
        WHEN lv_free_seats < iv_threshold THEN 'Wenig freie Plätze'
        ELSE 'Genug freie Plätze'
      ).
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_free_seats_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_free_seats_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_subtract( ).

    " Angenommen, Flug 'LH' '0400' existiert und hat freie Sitze
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' INTO @DATA(ls_flight_test).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_free_seats) = ls_flight_test-seatsmax - ls_flight_test-seatsocc.
      IF lv_free_seats < 10. " Beispiel-Schwellenwert
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lo_cut->check_free_seats_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_threshold = 10 ),
          exp = 'Wenig freie Plätze',
          msg = 'Sollte "Wenig freie Plätze" sein'
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lo_cut->check_free_seats_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_threshold = 10 ),
          exp = 'Genug freie Plätze',
          msg = 'Sollte "Genug freie Plätze" sein'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->check_free_seats_status( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_threshold = 5 ),
      exp = 'Flug nicht gefunden',
      msg = 'Fehlermeldung für nicht existierenden Flug sollte korrekt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Hier wird das Ergebnis einer Subtraktion als Bedingung verwendet, um den Status der freien Sitzplätze zu bestimmen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `SFLIGHTS` Tabelle nach Flügen, bei denen die Anzahl der freien Sitzplätze (`SEATSMAX` - `SEATSOCC`) unter einem bestimmten Wert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flights_low_capacity
          IMPORTING
            iv_threshold TYPE i
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_flights_low_capacity.
        DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
          carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
          seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax
          seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
        ) ).

        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
          lt_all_flights
          WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc < iv_threshold ) 
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_low_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_low_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_subtract( ).

    " Test mit einem Schwellenwert, der einige Flüge zurückgeben sollte (z.B. freie Sitze < 50)
    DATA(lt_low_capacity_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_low_capacity( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_low_capacity_flights,
      msg = 'Sollte Flüge mit geringer Kapazität finden'
    ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle zurückgegebenen Flüge die Kriterien erfüllen
    LOOP AT lt_low_capacity_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc < 50 ),
        msg = 'Freie Sitze sollten unter dem Schwellenwert liegen'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test mit einem sehr niedrigen Schwellenwert (sollte wenige oder keine Flüge zurückgeben)
    DATA(lt_very_low_threshold_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_low_capacity( 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_very_low_threshold_flights INTO ls_flight.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc < 0 ),
        msg = 'Freie Sitze sollten kleiner als 0 sein (unwahrscheinlich für reale Daten)'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern interner Tabellen. Hier wird eine Bedingung verwendet, die das Ergebnis einer Subtraktion (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) auswertet, um nur Flüge mit geringer Kapazität zu erhalten. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zahlen und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Variablen, die in einer Kette von Operationen verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CHAIN` Ausdruck für multiple Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chain_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_and_chain
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chain_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_chain.
    DATA: lv_diff TYPE i,
          lv_temp TYPE i.

    CHAIN.
      lv_diff = iv_val1 - iv_val2;
      lv_temp = lv_diff * 2;
      rv_result = lv_temp + 1.
    ENDCHAIN.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chain_subtract FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_subtract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chain_subtract( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_and_chain( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 3 ),
      exp = ( ( 10 - 3 ) * 2 ) + 1, " (7 * 2) + 1 = 15
      msg = 'Ergebnis für 10 - 3 sollte 15 sein'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_and_chain( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 8 ),
      exp = ( ( 5 - 8 ) * 2 ) + 1, " (-3 * 2) + 1 = -5
      msg = 'Ergebnis für 5 - 8 sollte -5 sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CHAIN` Ausdruck (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, mehrere Anweisungen, die sich auf dieselbe Variable beziehen oder logisch zusammengehören, kompakter zu schreiben. Hier wird eine Subtraktion als Teil einer Kette von Berechnungen verwendet, was die Lesbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: CHAIN, SUBTRACT, Arithmetic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen Zähler verwaltet. Implementieren Sie Methoden zum Hinzufügen, Subtrahieren und Abrufen des aktuellen Zählerstands, die Method Chaining ermöglichen.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` als Rückgabewert der Methoden zurück, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i DEFAULT 0.
    METHODS add       IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_counter.
    METHODS subtract  IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_counter.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_counter = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_counter = mv_counter - iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_counter_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_counter_chaining.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_counter( 10 ).

    " Test Method Chaining
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_counter->add( 5 )->subtract( 3 )->get_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 12, " 10 + 5 - 3 = 12
      msg = 'Verkettete Operationen sollten 12 ergeben'
    ).

    " Test individuelle Operationen
    lo_counter = NEW zcl_counter( 20 ).
    lo_counter->subtract( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_counter->get_value( ),
      exp = 10,
      msg = 'Subtraktion von 10 von 20 sollte 10 sein'
    ).

    lo_counter->add( 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_counter->get_value( ),
      exp = 17,
      msg = 'Addition von 7 zu 10 sollte 17 sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ist ein modernes objektorientiertes Muster, das die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes verbessert. Indem Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, können sie direkt nacheinander aufgerufen werden, was hier für Additions- und Subtraktionsoperationen demonstriert wird.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, SUBTRACT, Class

CLASS zcl_rest_status_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_category.
    rv_category = CASE iv_status_code.

                    WHEN 300 THRU 399 THEN '3xx Redirection'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR) und CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lr_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Example: Fill with data if structure matches sflight_key
        IF iv_struct_name = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATOR=>TY_SFLIGHT_KEY'.
          SELECT carrid, connid
            FROM sflight
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table>
            UP TO 5 ROWS.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object    TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    IF it_parameters IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_parameters = it_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        rv_result = 'Method called successfully'.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error calling method dynamically'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Datenbankabfrage auf die Tabelle SFLIGHT durch, bei der die WHERE-Klausel zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Bedingungen aufgebaut wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den dynamischen WHERE-Zusatz in SELECT-Anweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_conditions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    IF it_conditions IS INITIAL.
      " No conditions, return all or handle as error
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflight
        UP TO 10 ROWS.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Build dynamic WHERE clause
    LOOP AT it_conditions INTO DATA(lv_condition).
      IF lv_where_clause IS INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = lv_condition.
      ELSE.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ' AND ' && lv_condition.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflight
          WHERE (lv_where_clause)
          UP TO 10 ROWS.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid WHERE clause
        CLEAR rt_sflight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen Strukturtyp zur Laufzeit, basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und deren Datentypen.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE und CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR=>GET_P.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_definition,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " e.g., 'C(10)', 'I', 'D', 'P(5,2)'
           END OF ty_field_definition,
           tt_field_definition TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_definition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_structure_type
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE tt_field_definition
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_struct_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_structure_type.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
          lr_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      TRY.
          IF ls_field_def-type CS 'C('. 
            DATA(lv_len) = CONV i( substring( val = ls_field_def-type off = 2 len = strlen( ls_field_def-type ) - 3 ) ).
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = lv_len ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type CS 'P('. 
            DATA(lv_len_p) = CONV i( substring( val = ls_field_def-type off = 2 len = find( val = ls_field_def-type sub = ',' ) - 2 ) ).
            DATA(lv_dec_p) = CONV i( substring( val = ls_field_def-type off = find( val = ls_field_def-type sub = ',' ) + 1 len = strlen( ls_field_def-type ) - find( val = ls_field_def-type sub = ',' ) - 2 ) ).
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p( p_length = lv_len_p p_decimals = lv_dec_p ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type = 'I'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type = 'D'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type = 'T'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_t( ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type = 'STRING'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
          ELSE.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
          ENDIF.

          ls_component-type ?= lr_elem_descr.
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

        CATCH cx_sy_invalid_descr_type.
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          ro_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = lt_components ).
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation.
          CLEAR ro_struct_descr.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie eine Klasse dynamisch und greifen Sie anschließend dynamisch auf ein öffentliches Attribut dieser Instanz zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie CREATE OBJECT (dynamisch) und ASSIGN COMPONENT OF STRUCTURE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_attr_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_attr_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_attribute.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_attribute> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF STRUCTURE lo_object TO <lv_attribute>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <lv_attribute>.
        ELSE.
          rv_value = 'Attribute not found'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        rv_value = 'Class not found or instantiation error'.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie dynamisch die Eigenschaften eines Feldes auf einem Selektionsbildschirm zur Laufzeit (z.B. unsichtbar machen oder Eingabebereitschaft ändern).
hint: Nutzen Sie die interne Tabelle SCREEN und MODIFY SCREEN im Ereignis AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
solution:
REPORT z_dynamic_screen_manipulation.

PARAMETERS: p_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
            p_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_screen_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_screen_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_invisible  TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL
        iv_input      TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_screen_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_screen_field.
    LOOP AT SCREEN INTO DATA(ls_screen).
      IF ls_screen-name = iv_field_name.
        IF iv_invisible IS SUPPLIED.
          ls_screen-invisible = COND #( WHEN iv_invisible = abap_true THEN '1' ELSE '0' ).
        ENDIF.
        IF iv_input IS SUPPLIED.
          ls_screen-input = COND #( WHEN iv_input = abap_true THEN '1' ELSE '0' ).
        ENDIF.
        MODIFY SCREEN FROM ls_screen.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_dynamic_screen_modifier( ).
  IF p_carrid IS INITIAL.
    lo_modifier->modify_screen_field( iv_field_name = 'P_CONNID' iv_invisible = abap_true ).
  ELSE.
    lo_modifier->modify_screen_field( iv_field_name = 'P_CONNID' iv_invisible = abap_false ).
  ENDIF.

  IF p_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
    lo_modifier->modify_screen_field( iv_field_name = 'P_CARRID' iv_input = abap_false ).
  ELSE.
    lo_modifier->modify_screen_field( iv_field_name = 'P_CARRID' iv_input = abap_true ).
  ENDIF.
