Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei die Zeilenstruktur zur Laufzeit definiert wird und die Füllung mit modernen ABAP-Konstrukten (VALUE, FOR) erfolgt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI für die Typdefinition mit CREATE DATA und anschließendem Füllen über VALUE #( FOR ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " e.g., 'C(10)', 'I'
           END OF ty_field_def,
           tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE tt_field_def
        iv_num_rows   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
          lr_elem_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      TRY.
          IF ls_field_def-type = 'C(10)'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = 10 ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type = 'I'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
          ELSEIF ls_field_def-type = 'STRING'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
          ELSE.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
          ENDIF.
          ls_component-type ?= lr_elem_descr.
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_invalid_descr_type.
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = lt_components ).
        lr_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

        DATA(lt_temp_table) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data(
          FOR i = 1 UNTIL iv_num_rows + 1
          ( LET l_line_ref = NEW data( ) IN
              ASSIGN l_line_ref->* TO <ls_dynamic_line> IN PROGRAM (sy-repid)
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
                IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field1> = |Value { i }|. ENDIF.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
                IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field2> = i. ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
              l_line_ref
          )
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_temp_table INTO DATA(lr_temp_line).
          ASSIGN lr_temp_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
          APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_descr_ref_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        CLEAR ro_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem dynamisch definierten Primärschlüssel, basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE mit P_TABLE_KIND und P_KEY_DEF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table_with_key
      IMPORTING
        it_key_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_with_key.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_key_components TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_component_table.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_KEY=>TY_SFLIGHT_DATA' ).

    LOOP AT it_key_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_field_name ) TO lt_key_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
          p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
          p_key_def    = VALUE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_def_tab(
            ( key_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>keykind_primary
              components = lt_key_components )
          )
        ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE HASHED TABLE.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
            FROM sflight
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table>
            UP TO 5 ROWS.
        ENDIF.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein elementares Datenobjekt (z.B. vom Typ CHAR oder INT) mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Länge oder anderen Eigenschaften.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR=>GET_C, GET_I, etc. und CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_elem_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_kind TYPE string " e.g., 'C', 'I', 'STRING'
        iv_length    TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_decimals  TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_elem_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_element.
    DATA: lr_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    TRY.
        CASE iv_type_kind.
          WHEN 'C'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = COND #( WHEN iv_length IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_length ELSE 1 ) ).
          WHEN 'I'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
          WHEN 'STRING'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
          WHEN 'P'.
            lr_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p(
              p_length   = COND #( WHEN iv_length IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_length ELSE 1 )
              p_decimals = COND #( WHEN iv_decimals IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_decimals ELSE 0 )
            ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RETURN.
        ENDCASE.

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_elem_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_invalid_descr_type cx_sy_create_data_error.
        CLEAR ro_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflight` nach allen Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa).
hint: Nutzen Sie den modernen `FILTER`-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_filter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_filter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    rt_sflight = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden `sflight`-Eintrag die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`), Flugnummer (`connid`) und die Anzahl der freien Sitze (MaxSitze - BelegteSitze) enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
         free_seats TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_summary.
TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_value_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_value_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                          ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                            connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                            free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) in der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_lh_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_lh_seats.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 200.
    INSERT LINES OF lt_sflight_dummy INTO TABLE sflight.

hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für eine deklarative, mehrstufige Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_load_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_load_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = COND #( WHEN iv_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( iv_seatsocc * 100 ) / iv_seatsmax ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = COND #( WHEN lv_occupancy_percent > 90 THEN 'Voll'
                        WHEN lv_occupancy_percent > 70 THEN 'Fast Voll'
                        ELSE 'Verfügbar' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_load_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_load_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Voll' act = lo_cut->get_load_status( iv_seatsocc = 280 iv_seatsmax = 300 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Fast Voll' act = lo_cut->get_load_status( iv_seatsocc = 220 iv_seatsmax = 300 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Verfügbar' act = lo_cut->get_load_status( iv_seatsocc = 150 iv_seatsmax = 300 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Verfügbar' act = lo_cut->get_load_status( iv_seatsocc = 0 iv_seatsmax = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COND` ermöglicht die deklarative und komprimierte Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Kette von Bedingungen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu klassischen `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Strukturen und fördert die Lesbarkeit in komplexen Fallunterscheidungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie das Flugdatum (`fldate`) eines spezifischen Fluges (z.B. Carrier 'LH', Connection '0400', Date '19950228') aus `sflight`. Geben Sie 'Nicht gefunden' zurück, falls der Flug nicht existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ KEY ... ]`) mit dem `DEFAULT`-Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_exp_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_date_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fldate_or_default) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_exp_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date_with_default.
    DATA lt_sflight_all TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_all.

    rv_fldate_or_default = lt_sflight_all[
                                      KEY primary_key 
                                      COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid 
                                      connid = iv_connid 
                                      fldate = iv_fldate ]-fldate
                                      DEFAULT 'Nicht gefunden'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flight_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_date.
    DATA lt_sflight_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '19950228'.
    INSERT LINES OF lt_sflight_dummy INTO TABLE sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_exp_default( ).

    DATA(lv_found_date)    = lo_cut->get_flight_date_with_default( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '19950228' ).
    DATA(lv_not_found_date) = lo_cut->get_flight_date_with_default( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '19950228' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '19950228' act = lv_found_date msg = 'Flugdatum sollte gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Nicht gefunden' act = lv_not_found_date msg = 'Flugdatum sollte nicht gefunden werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke bieten eine kompakte Syntax für den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen interner Tabellen. Der `DEFAULT`-Zusatz, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50, eliminiert die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `LINE_EXISTS`-Prüfung und vereinfacht die Fehlerbehandlung bei nicht gefundenen Zeilen.
keywords: TABLE Expression, Internal Tables, Read Access, Default Value, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die Method Chaining-Technik nutzt, um eine 'Alert'-Nachricht zu konstruieren und zu simulieren. Implementieren Sie dabei ein flüssiges Interface.
hint: Geben Sie in den Setter-Methoden `ME` (`SELF`) zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alert_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_message   IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_alert_builder.
    METHODS set_recipient IMPORTING iv_recipient TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_alert_builder.
    METHODS send_alert    RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_message   TYPE string,
          mv_recipient TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alert_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_message.
    me->mv_message = iv_message.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_recipient.
    me->mv_recipient = iv_recipient.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD send_alert.
    " Hier würde die tatsächliche Logik zum Senden der Nachricht stehen (z.B. Log-Eintrag, API-Aufruf).
    " Wir simulieren es hier mit cl_demo_output.
    cl_demo_output=>write( |Alert to: { me->mv_recipient }, Message: { me->mv_message }| ).
    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_alert_builder FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alert_builder.
    DATA(lo_alert_builder) = NEW zcl_alert_builder( ).

    " Testen des Method Chaining
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_alert_builder->set_recipient( 'John Doe' )->set_message( 'Test Alert from ABAP!' )->send_alert( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = abap_true act = lv_success msg = 'Das Senden des Alerts sollte erfolgreich sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch als 'Fluent Interface' bekannt, verbessert die Lesbarkeit von Objektmethoden, indem es erlaubt, mehrere Aufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Jede Methode, die eine weitere Verkettung ermöglichen soll, gibt eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurück.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Logik eines HTTP-Service, der auf einen GET-Request reagiert und Flugdaten aus `sflight`als JSON zurückgibt. Optional können die Daten nach der Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus einem simulierten URL-Parameter gefiltert werden.
hint: Konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Generierung des JSON und die Behandlung von Request-Parametern. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_JSON` für die JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
       END OF ty_flight_data.
TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_http_flight_json_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_query_params TYPE string OPTIONAL " z.B. 'carrid=LH'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_response) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_flight_json_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_get_flights.
    DATA lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    " Simulieren des Parsens von Query-Parametern (wie von IF_HTTP_SERVER->REQUEST->GET_FORM_FIELD)
    IF iv_query_params IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND REGEX 'carrid=([A-Z]{2})' IN iv_query_params SUBMATCHES lv_carrid.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    IF lv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 10 ROWS " Limit for demo
        INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    " Serialisieren nach JSON mit cl_abap_conv_obj_json
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = NEW cl_abap_conv_obj_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_writer->serialize( EXPORTING data = lt_flights IMPORTING json = rv_json_response ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_json_response = |{ '{"error": "' && lx_root->get_text( ) && '"}' }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flights_json FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_get_flights_json_filtered FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_json.
    DATA lt_sflight_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AZ'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0100'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251123'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0200'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251124'.
    INSERT LINES OF lt_sflight_dummy INTO TABLE sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_flight_json_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_json_response) = lo_cut->handle_get_flights( '' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_init( lv_json_response(1) IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'JSON-Response sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'carrid' in = lv_json_response msg = 'Response sollte Flugdaten enthalten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'AZ' in = lv_json_response msg = 'Response sollte AZ-Flüge enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_json_filtered.
    DATA lt_sflight_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0300'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20251202'.
    INSERT LINES OF lt_sflight_dummy INTO TABLE sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_flight_json_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_json_response) = lo_cut->handle_get_flights( 'carrid=BA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_init( lv_json_response(1) IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'C-JSON-Response sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'BA' in = lv_json_response msg = 'Response sollte BA-Flüge enthalten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = 'UA' in = lv_json_response msg = 'Response sollte keine UA-Flüge enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel isoliert die Kernlogik für einen HTTP-Service, der JSON als Antwort liefert. Es zeigt, wie Request-Parameter verarbeitet und ABAP-Datenstrukturen mit `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_JSON` in JSON-Strings umgewandelt werden – ein fundamentaler Bestandteil moderner RESTful-Services in ABAP. Es simuliert die Funktionalität, ohne eine komplexe `IF_HTTP_EXTENSION`-Implementierung im Unit-Test vorauszusetzen.
keywords: HTTP, JSON, REST, cl_abap_conv_obj_json, Web Services, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Ordnen Sie Feldwerte von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur mit potenziell geänderten Feldnamen zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Ausdruck mit dem `MAPPING`-Zusatz.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
         field1 TYPE string,
         field2 TYPE i,
         common_field TYPE string,
       END OF ty_source.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
         target_field1 TYPE string,
         target_field2 TYPE i,
         common_field TYPE string,
         additional_field TYPE string,
       END OF ty_target.

CLASS zcl_mapping_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mapping_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structures.
    " Automatische Zuweisung gleichnamiger Felder und Umbenennung mit MAPPING
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING target_field1 = field1 target_field2 = field2 ).
    rs_target-additional_field = 'Mapped by ABAP'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_map_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structures.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE ty_source(  field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 common_field = 'Common' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mapping_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structures( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Hello' act = ls_target-target_field1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 123 act = ls_target-target_field2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Common' act = ls_target-common_field ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Mapped by ABAP' act = ls_target-additional_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Ausdruck ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu kopieren. Mit dem `MAPPING`-Zusatz können Sie Felder explizit umbenennen, falls die Quell- und Zielfelder unterschiedliche Namen haben, aber logisch zusammengehören. Dies ist kompakter als manuelle Zuweisungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Data Transfer, Structures, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge der Tabelle `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie dazu die GROUP BY-Erweiterung im FOR-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUPS OF ...` um die Gruppierung zu erreichen.
solution:
TYPES:
  BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
    carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
    total_seats TYPE i,
  END OF ty_flight_group.
TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_seats) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_grouped_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights BY ls_group-carrid
                                 ( carrid      = ls_group-carrid,
                                   total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_by_for FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_for.
    DATA lt_sflight_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_dummy ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 75.
    INSERT LINES OF lt_sflight_dummy INTO TABLE sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Es sollten 2 Gruppen gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'AA' act = lt_result[1]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 125 act = lt_result[1]-total_seats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = lt_result[2]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 300 act = lt_result[2]-total_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ab ABAP 7.55 ermöglicht das Gruppieren von internen Tabellen direkt in einem funktionalen Kontext. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder explizite `COLLECT`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, GROUPS OF, Grouping, Internal Tables, REDUCE, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINES OF` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             fromcity TYPE sflight-fromcity,
             tocity   TYPE sflight-tocity,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_fromcity TYPE sflight-fromcity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, deptime, arrtime, fromcity, tocity
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rv_count = LINES OF FILTER ty_sflights( lt_sflights WHERE fromcity = iv_fromcity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_filtered FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_flights_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_filtered_flights( 'FRANKFURT' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE fromcity = 'FRANKFURT' UP TO 100 ROWS INTO @lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Filtered count mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht das Filtern interner Tabellen direkt in einer Zeile, gefolgt von `LINES OF` zur Zählung der gefilterten Einträge. Dies ist eine moderne, lesbare und performante Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `COUNT`.
keywords: COUNT, FILTER, Internal Tables, LINES OF, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft ein bestimmtes Zeichen (z.B. 'A') in einem gegebenen String vorkommt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die eingebaute Funktion `COUNT_ANY_OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_char_in_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_char_in_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_char.
    rv_count = count_any_of( val = iv_text sub = iv_char ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_char FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_char_in_string( ).

    " Test case 1: Character exists multiple times
    DATA(lv_count1) = lo_cut->count_char( iv_text = 'ABAP IS GREAT' iv_char = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count1 exp = 2 msg = 'Count of A mismatch' ).

    " Test case 2: Character exists once
    DATA(lv_count2) = lo_cut->count_char( iv_text = 'ABAP' iv_char = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count2 exp = 1 msg = 'Count of B mismatch' ).

    " Test case 3: Character does not exist
    DATA(lv_count3) = lo_cut->count_char( iv_text = 'ABAP' iv_char = 'Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count3 exp = 0 msg = 'Count of Z mismatch' ).

    " Test case 4: Empty string
    DATA(lv_count4) = lo_cut->count_char( iv_text = '' iv_char = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count4 exp = 0 msg = 'Count in empty string mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COUNT_ANY_OF` ist eine leistungsstarke, eingebaute String-Funktion, die das Zählen von Zeichen oder Teilstrings in einem String erheblich vereinfacht und effizienter macht als manuelle Schleifen oder `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES`.
keywords: COUNT, String, COUNT_ANY_OF, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) in einer internen Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_distinct_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    rv_distinct_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_distinct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_distinct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_distinct_carrid( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE zcl_count_distinct_carrid=>ty_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights_test.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (`carrid`, `connid`, `fldate`) in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` existiert, ohne alle Daten zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE FOR SYSTEM_ID`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE FOR SYSTEM_ID
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, deren Abflugzeit nach 12:00:00 Uhr liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_late_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_late_departures
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_late_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_late_departures.
    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( deptime > '120000' )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_multiple_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sorted_flights ) exp = 1 msg = 'Table size after duplicate insert mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_table( ).
    DATA lt_sorted_flights TYPE zcl_insert_sorted_table=>ty_sorted_flights.

    lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( is_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'BB' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' ) CHANGING ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).
    lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( is_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' ) CHANGING ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).
    lo_cut->add_flight_to_sorted_table( is_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' ) CHANGING ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BB' msg = 'Third entry carrier mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '002' msg = 'Third entry connection mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für einen gegebenen String mit einem geheimen Schlüssel und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Hex-String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac=>create` mit `alg_sha256` und `cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring` für den Schlüssel. Konvertieren Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>xstring_to_string` zu Hex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( iv_key )
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac_for_char(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = iv_data
      IMPORTING
        ef_hmac = DATA(lv_hmac_xstring)
    ).
    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>xstring_to_string( xstring = lv_hmac_xstring encoding = 'HEX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verifizieren Sie einen gegebenen HMAC-SHA256 für einen String und einen Schlüssel. Die Methode soll 'true' zurückgeben, wenn der HMAC gültig ist, ansonsten 'false'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac` und die Methode `verify_hmac_for_char`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_ver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE string
        iv_key      TYPE string
        iv_hmac_hex TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_ver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_hmac.
    DATA(lv_hmac_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>string_to_xstring( iv_hmac_hex encoding = 'HEX' ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( iv_key )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_hmac->verify_hmac_for_char(
          EXPORTING
            if_data = iv_data
            if_hmac = lv_hmac_xstring
        ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle, die als String serialisiert wurde, unter Verwendung eines geheimen Schlüssels.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die interne Tabelle zu einem String (z.B. mit `cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_out`) und verwenden Sie dann `cl_abap_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_itab_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_hmac_for_itab
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_key     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_itab_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac_for_itab.
    DATA(lv_itab_string) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->write( it_sflight )->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( iv_key )
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac_for_char(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = lv_itab_string
      IMPORTING
        ef_hmac = DATA(lv_hmac_xstring)
    ).
    rv_hmac_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>xstring_to_string( xstring = lv_hmac_xstring encoding = 'HEX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_itab_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_itab_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) TYPE zcl_hmac_itab_gen=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251123' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_key)  = 'itab_secret'.
    DATA(lv_hmac_hex) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_for_itab( it_sflight = lt_sflight iv_key = lv_key ).

    " Due to serialization specifics, the expected HMAC needs to be calculated based on the exact string representation.
    " For this example, we'll assert that a non-empty HMAC is generated.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_hmac_hex ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_hmac_hex ) exp = 64 ). " SHA256 hex is 64 chars
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man einen HMAC für komplexere Daten wie interne Tabellen generiert. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle in einen String serialisiert, was mit `cl_abap_conv_ce` effizient möglich ist. Anschließend wird dieser String wie gewohnt mit `cl_abap_hmac` verarbeitet. Dies ist nützlich, um die Integrität von Datenpaketen zu gewährleisten, die aus strukturierten ABAP-Daten bestehen.
keywords: HMAC, SHA256, Internal Tables, Serialization, Cryptography, Security

    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " Dieser Test prüft primär die Syntax und die Existenz der Methode.
    " Die tatsächliche Konsolenausgabe kann in einem Unit-Test nicht direkt überprüft werden.
    lo_logger->zif_logger~log_message( 'Test message for console logger' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Interfaces ermöglichen die Definition von Verträgen für Klassen und fördern Polymorphie und lose Kopplung. Die `INTERFACES` Anweisung bindet die Klasse an das Interface.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights` Tabelle nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern dieser Flüge enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstruktors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_numbers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_numbers_by_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).
    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                 ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_numbers) = lo_cut->get_flight_numbers_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Assert that all returned entries are valid flight numbers for LH
    LOOP AT lt_flight_numbers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
      " Prüfen, ob die Flugnummer für LH in sflight existiert
      SELECT SINGLE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = @<fs_connid> INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flugnummer nicht für LH gefunden' act = ls_sflight_check IS NOT INITIAL ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Optional: Assert a minimum number of results
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Erwartete mindestens eine Flugnummer für LH' act = ( lines( lt_flight_numbers ) > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen, indem zuerst gefiltert und dann die gewünschten Felder extrahiert werden.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Interfaces `zif_readable` (mit `get_data`) und `zif_writeable` (mit `set_data`). Implementieren Sie beide Interfaces in einer Klasse `zcl_data_handler`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `INTERFACES` Anweisung mehrfach in der Klassendefinition, um mehrere Interfaces zu implementieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_readable PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_writeable PUBLIC.
  METHODS set_data IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_readable.
    INTERFACES zif_writeable.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_readable~get_data.
    rv_data = mv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_writeable~set_data.
    mv_data = iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_handler FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_handler.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_data_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_test_data) = 'Hello World'.

    lo_handler->zif_writeable~set_data( lv_test_data ).
    DATA(lv_read_data) = lo_handler->zif_readable~get_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Gelesene Daten sollten den geschriebenen Daten entsprechen'
      act = lv_read_data
      exp = lv_test_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine Klasse kann mehrere Interfaces implementieren, um verschiedene Verhaltensweisen oder 'Rollen' zu übernehmen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Flexibilität des Designs.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Multiple Interfaces, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in der `sflights` Tabelle ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer existiert, und geben Sie `abap_true` zurück, falls ja, sonst `abap_false`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit dem `COND` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_all_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_exists( ).
    " Annahme: 'LH' und '0400' existieren in sflight
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flug LH 0400 sollte existieren' act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flug XX 9999 sollte nicht existieren' act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit `COND` bietet eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, das Vorhandensein eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne eine Schleife oder `READ TABLE` verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `zif_calculation_strategy` mit einer Methode `calculate`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `zcl_add_strategy` und `zcl_multiply_strategy`. Erstellen Sie dann eine Klasse `zcl_calculator`, die eine Instanz von `zif_calculation_strategy` entgegennimmt und deren `calculate`-Methode aufruft.
hint: Nutzen Sie Polymorphie durch das Interface, um das Verhalten des Rechners dynamisch zu ändern (Strategy Pattern).
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      iv_val1 TYPE i
      iv_val2 TYPE i
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = mo_strategy->calculate( iv_val1 = iv_val1 iv_val2 = iv_val2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_strategy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply_strategy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_strategy.
    DATA(lo_add_strategy) = NEW zcl_add_strategy( ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( lo_add_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Addition fehlgeschlagen' act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_strategy.
    DATA(lo_multiply_strategy) = NEW zcl_multiply_strategy( ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( lo_multiply_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Multiplikation fehlgeschlagen' act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategy Pattern nutzt Interfaces, um Algorithmen in separate Klassen zu kapseln und sie austauschbar zu machen. Die `INTERFACES` Anweisung ist hierbei zentral für die Definition der Strategien.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in der `sflights` Tabelle, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen und eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität von mehr als 200 Passagieren haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einem `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_large_flights_from_ny
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_large_flights_from_ny.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND seatsmax > 200 )
                             NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_large_flights_from_ny( ).
    " Dieser Test geht von bestimmten Daten in sflight aus.
    " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten einfügen oder sflight mocken.
    " Annahme: Es gibt 2 solche Flüge für Demonstrationszwecke.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Falsche Anzahl großer Flüge von New York' act = lv_count exp = 2 ). " 'exp' an tatsächliche sflight-Daten anpassen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen, nachdem diese gefiltert wurden.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `zif_default_printer` mit einer Standardmethode `print_header` und einer abstrakten Methode `print_content`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `zcl_report_printer`, die nur `print_content` implementiert und die Standardimplementierung von `print_header` nutzt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `DEFAULT IGNORE` Klausel bei der Methoden-Definition im Interface für die Standardimplementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_default_printer PUBLIC.
  METHODS print_content IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
  METHODS print_header DEFAULT IGNORE. " Standardimplementierung, kann von der implementierenden Klasse ignoriert werden
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zif_default_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD print_header.
    WRITE / '--- Report Header ---'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_default_printer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_default_printer~print_content.
    WRITE / iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_printer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_printer.
    DATA(lo_printer) = NEW zcl_report_printer( ).
    " Aufruf der Standardmethode
    lo_printer->zif_default_printer~print_header( ).
    " Aufruf der implementierten Methode
    lo_printer->zif_default_printer~print_content( 'Dies ist der Berichtsinhalt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Methodenaufrufe sollten keine Ausnahme auslösen' ). " Platzhalter
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mit ABAP 7.55 können Interfaces Standardimplementierungen für Methoden bereitstellen (`DEFAULT IGNORE` oder `DEFAULT FAIL`), was die Flexibilität erhöht und die Notwendigkeit reduziert, alle Methoden in jeder implementierenden Klasse zu überschreiben.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, DEFAULT, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Klasse `zcl_flight_data` mit Attributen für Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle dieser Objekte und filtern Sie diese Tabelle nach Objekten, deren Fluggesellschaft 'UA' ist.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator kann auch auf Tabellen von Objektreferenzen angewendet werden, indem auf Attribute der Objekte zugegriffen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_ref,
             flight_obj TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_data,
           END OF ty_flight_ref.
    TYPES tt_flight_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ua_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_ua_flights) TYPE tt_flight_refs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ua_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_refs.

    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_ref( flight_obj = NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ) ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_ref( flight_obj = NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0010' ) ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_ref( flight_obj = NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0020' ) ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_ref( flight_obj = NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0030' ) ) TO lt_all_flights.

    rt_ua_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE flight_obj->mv_carrid = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_object_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_object_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_object_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_ua_flights) = lo_cut->get_ua_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erwartete 2 UA Flüge' act = lines( lt_ua_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    LOOP AT lt_ua_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_ref>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte UA sein' act = <fs_flight_ref>-flight_obj->mv_carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator kann auch verwendet werden, um Tabellen von Objektreferenzen zu filtern, indem direkt auf die Attribute der referenzierten Objekte zugegriffen wird. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für objektorientierte Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FILTER, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge der `sflights` Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` in Kombination mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_ny_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             ny_flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_ny_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_ny_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_ny_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_ny_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
                         ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
                           ny_flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                                       FOR ny_flight IN FILTER #( carrier_group WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
                                                       NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_filter_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_filter_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_ny_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " Annahme: Bestimmte Daten für 'LH' und 'AA' von 'NEW YORK' existieren
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE zcl_sflight_group_filter=>ty_carrier_ny_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_lh_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Falsche NY Fluganzahl für LH' act = ls_lh_count-ny_flight_count exp = 1 ). " 'exp' anpassen
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = VALUE zcl_sflight_group_filter=>ty_carrier_ny_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_aa_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Falsche NY Fluganzahl für AA' act = ls_aa_count-ny_flight_count exp = 1 ). " 'exp' anpassen
    ENDIF.

    " Optional: Gesamtzahl der Fluggesellschaften mit NY-Flügen prüfen, falls bekannt
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Erwartete mindestens eine Fluggesellschaft' act = ( lines( lt_counts ) > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Syntax in Kombination mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationsoperationen auf internen Tabellen in einer sehr funktionalen und ausdrucksstarken Weise.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `zif_predicate` mit einer Methode `check` (die einen String als Input nimmt und einen `abap_bool` zurückgibt). Implementieren Sie dieses Interface 'inline' in einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um eine Liste von Strings zu filtern.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Möglichkeit, Interfaces direkt in `FOR` Ausdrücken zu implementieren, um funktionale Prädikate zu erstellen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_predicate PUBLIC.
  METHODS check IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_string_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        io_predicate TYPE REF TO zif_predicate
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_strings.
    rt_filtered_strings = VALUE #( FOR string IN it_strings WHERE io_predicate->check( string ) = abap_true
                                   ( string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_with_predicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_predicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Apricot' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ).

    " Inline-Implementierung des Prädikat-Interfaces
    DATA(lo_predicate_starts_with_a) = NEW zif_predicate(
      METHODS check FOR zif_predicate~check IMPORTING iv_input RETURNING VALUE(rv_result).
        rv_result = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_input CP 'A*' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_strings) = lo_cut->filter_strings(
                                  it_strings = lt_input_strings
                                  io_predicate = lo_predicate_starts_with_a
                                ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erwartete 2 Strings, die mit A beginnen' act = lines( lt_filtered_strings ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster gefilterter String falsch' act = lt_filtered_strings[1] exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Zweiter gefilterter String falsch' act = lt_filtered_strings[2] exp = 'Apricot' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht die 'inline'-Implementierung von Interfaces, insbesondere für funktionale Interfaces (mit einer einzigen Methode), direkt in Ausdrücken wie `NEW zif_predicate(...)`. Dies ist ideal für die Erstellung von Prädikaten oder Callbacks und fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Functional Programming, FOR, Predicate, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `zif_utility` mit einer statischen Methode `get_version`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `zcl_app_utility` und rufen Sie die statische Methode auf.
hint: Statische Methoden in Interfaces werden direkt über den Interface-Namen aufgerufen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_utility PUBLIC.
  CLASS-METHODS get_version RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_app_utility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_utility.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights` Tabelle nach Flügen, die von 'BERLIN' abfliegen, und übertragen Sie die gefilterten Daten in eine neue Tabelle mit einer anderen Struktur, die nur Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Abflugort enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit `CORRESPONDING` und `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_berlin_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_berlin_flight_summary.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_summary = CORRESPONDING #( 
                   FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = 'BERLIN' )
                   MAPPING carrid = carrid
                           connid = connid
                           cityfrom = cityfrom
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das zuletzt hinzugefügte GOS-Dokument für ein Business-Objekt.
hint: Holen Sie alle Anlagen, sortieren Sie diese nach Erstellungsdatum absteigend und nehmen Sie den ersten Eintrag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_latest_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename    TYPE string,
             created_at  TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_id   TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_latest_attachment) TYPE ty_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_latest_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_attachment.
    DATA(lt_attachments) = cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_list(
      i_bus_obj_type = iv_bus_obj_type
      i_bus_obj_id   = iv_bus_obj_id
    ).

    IF lt_attachments IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT lt_attachments BY created_at DESCENDING.
      READ TABLE lt_attachments INDEX 1 INTO rs_latest_attachment.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer bestimmten Datei aus einem ZIP-Archiv (als XSTRING).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` zum Öffnen des Archivs und zum Lesen des Eintrags.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cont_read_zip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_from_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_file_content) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cont_read_zip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_from_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip->get_files( ).
    READ TABLE lt_files WITH KEY filename = iv_filename INTO DATA(ls_file_info).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lo_zip->get(
        EXPORTING
          name    = iv_filename
        IMPORTING
          content = rv_file_content
      ).
    ELSE.
      " File not found in ZIP
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_zip_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'File not found in ZIP archive'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_zip_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_zip_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cont_read_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_test_content) = 'This is a test file inside a zip.'.
    DATA(lv_test_filename) = 'test.txt'.
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring)   = ''.

    " Create a dummy ZIP file in memory for testing
    DATA(lo_zip_creator) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_creator->add(
      EXPORTING
        name    = lv_test_filename
        content = cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring(
                    EXPORTING
                      im_string   = lv_test_content
                      im_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                    RECEIVING
                      re_xstring  = DATA(lx_content_xstring)
                  )
    ).
    lv_zip_xstring = lo_zip_creator->save( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lx_read_content) = lo_cut->read_file_from_zip(
          iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring
          iv_filename    = lv_test_filename
        ).
        DATA(lv_read_string) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>xstring_to_string(
          EXPORTING
            im_xstring  = lx_read_content
            im_encoding = 'UTF-8'
          RECEIVING
            ex_string   = DATA(lv_string_read)
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_string_read
          exp = lv_test_content
          msg = 'Content read from ZIP should match original'
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_zip_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test for non-existent file
    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_file_from_zip(
          iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring
          iv_filename    = 'non_existent.txt'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_zip_error for non-existent file' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lx_zip_error ). " Assert that an exception was caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_zip` bietet eine vollständige API zum Erstellen, Lesen und Bearbeiten von ZIP-Archiven direkt im ABAP-System, was die Handhabung komprimierter Daten erheblich vereinfacht.

CLASS zcl_gos_total_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_total_size IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches ZIP-Archiv im Speicher, fügen Sie mehrere Textdateien hinzu und lesen Sie deren Inhalte wieder aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` zum Erstellen und Bearbeiten des Archivs und `cl_abap_container_utilities` für die String-XSTRING-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cont_create_zip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
             filename TYPE string,
             content  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_content.
    TYPES: tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_read_zip
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_read_files) TYPE tt_file_content
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cont_create_zip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip_creator) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      lo_zip_creator->add(
        EXPORTING
          name    = ls_file-filename
          content = cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring(
                      EXPORTING
                        im_string   = ls_file-content
                        im_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                      RECEIVING
                        re_xstring  = DATA(lx_content_xstring)
                    )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_zip_creator->save( ).

    DATA(lo_zip_reader) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_reader->load( lv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_zip_files) = lo_zip_reader->get_files( ).
    rt_read_files = VALUE #( FOR <fs_zip_file> IN lt_zip_files
                               LET lx_read_content = lo_zip_reader->get(
                                                         name = <fs_zip_file>-filename
                                                       )
                                   lv_read_string = cl_abap_container_utilities=>xstring_to_string(
                                                        im_xstring  = lx_read_content
                                                        im_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                                    )
                              IN ( filename = <fs_zip_file>-filename,
                                   content  = lv_read_string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_read_zip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_read_zip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cont_create_zip( ).
    DATA(lt_input_files) = VALUE zcl_cont_create_zip=>tt_file_content(
      ( filename = 'file1.txt' content = 'Content of file 1.' )
      ( filename = 'file2.txt' content = 'Another content.' )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_output_files) = lo_cut->create_and_read_zip( lt_input_files ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lines( lt_output_files )
          exp = 2
          msg = 'Should read 2 files from ZIP'
        ).

        READ TABLE lt_output_files WITH KEY filename = 'file1.txt' INTO DATA(ls_file1).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_file1-content
          exp = 'Content of file 1.'
          msg = 'Content of file1.txt should match'
        ).

        READ TABLE lt_output_files WITH KEY filename = 'file2.txt' INTO DATA(ls_file2).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_file2-content
          exp = 'Another content.'
          msg = 'Content of file2.txt should match'
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_zip_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die vollständige Funktionalität von `cl_abap_zip` zum Erstellen und Auslesen von Archiven im Speicher, kombiniert mit `cl_abap_container_utilities` für die Textkonvertierung. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `LET` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und funktionale Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: ZIP, Archive, Create, Read, XSTRING, cl_abap_zip, cl_abap_container_utilities, VALUE, FOR, LET

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gespeichert ist, und ändere dessen Wert.
hint: Nutze `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit einer Datenreferenz auf die Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field    TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        es_data     TYPE any STRUCTURE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    es_data = is_data.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE es_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_field_set FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_set.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data VALUE `{"FIELD1":"Old Value", "FIELD2":"Another Value"}`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).

    lo_cut->set_field_dynamically( EXPORTING is_data = ls_data iv_field = 'FIELD1' iv_new_value = 'New Value' IMPORTING es_data = ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 should be updated' act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'New Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 should be unchanged' act = ls_data-field2 exp = 'Another Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Feldzuweisung mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs_field>` in Kombination mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programmierung. Es erlaubt den Zugriff auf und die Manipulation von Strukturkomponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist effizient, da keine statische Typisierung zur Kompilierzeit erforderlich ist.
keywords: REF TO, FIELD-SYMBOLS, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein Datenobjekt (z.B. eine interne Tabelle oder eine Struktur mit Referenzen) 'tief' ist, d.h. Referenzen oder andere tiefe Komponenten enthält.

solution:
CLASS zcl_is_deep_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_deep.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string,
          lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_object TYPE REF TO zcl_is_deep_check.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_is_deep_check( ).

    DATA(lv_is_deep_string) = lo_cut->check_if_deep( REF #( lv_string ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'String should not be deep' act = lv_is_deep_string exp = abap_false ).

    " Object reference is deep
    lo_object = NEW zcl_is_deep_check( ).
    DATA(lv_is_deep_object) = lo_cut->check_if_deep( REF #( lo_object ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Object reference should be deep' act = lv_is_deep_object exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Flache Datenobjekte sind z.B. numerische Typen oder Strukturen ohne tiefe Komponenten. Diese Information ist wichtig für das Verständnis des Speicherverhaltens und bei der Entscheidung, ob eine tiefe Kopie erforderlich ist.

explanation: Die Funktion `CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES=>DEEP_COPY` ist unerlässlich, um eine vollständige, unabhängige Kopie eines Objekts zu erstellen, das Referenzen auf andere Objekte enthält. Eine einfache Zuweisung würde nur die Referenz kopieren (flache Kopie), was dazu führen würde, dass Original und Kopie dieselben Unterobjekte teilen. `DEEP_COPY` stellt sicher, dass alle referenzierten Objekte ebenfalls kopiert werden, was eine echte Unabhängigkeit gewährleistet.

Instructions: Schreibe eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Referenz entgegennimmt und die Anzahl ihrer Zeilen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze `TYPE REF TO DATA` für den Parameter und `ASSIGN (p_data_ref)->* TO <fs_table>` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_table_lines
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_lines) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_table_lines.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF <lt_any_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_lines = lines( <lt_any_table> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_generic_table_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_table_count.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_string  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 3 ROWS.
    APPEND 'Hello' TO lt_string.
    APPEND 'World' TO lt_string.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_counter( ).

    DATA(lv_sflight_lines) = lo_cut->count_table_lines( REF #( lt_sflight ) ).
    DATA(lv_string_lines) = lo_cut->count_table_lines( REF #( lt_string ) ).
    DATA(lv_empty_lines) = lo_cut->count_table_lines( REF #( NEW string_table( ) ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'SFLIGHT lines should be 3' act = lv_sflight_lines exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'STRING lines should be 2' act = lv_string_lines exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Empty table should have 0 lines' act = lv_empty_lines exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert generische Programmierung in ABAP. Durch die Verwendung von `TYPE REF TO DATA` kann die Methode eine Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs entgegennehmen. Der Zugriff auf die tatsächlichen Daten erfolgt über ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` (`ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>`). Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung hochflexibler und wiederverwendbarer Funktionen, die unabhängig vom konkreten Tabellentyp arbeiten.
keywords: GENERIC PROGRAMMING, REF TO, FIELD-SYMBOLS, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING
