Instructions: Rufe eine Methode dynamisch auf einem Objekt auf, dessen Typ und Methodenname zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS set_status IMPORTING iv_new_status TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

    mv_status = iv_new_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object    TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NEW_STATUS'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., method not found or wrong parameters
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic method call failed' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (object_ref)->(method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE ...` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für hochflexible Architekturen. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über eine Tabelle von Referenzen (`abap_parmbind_tab`).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf der HTTP-Methode (GET, POST) unterschiedliche Aktionen simuliert, wie sie in einem ICF-Handler vorkommen würden. Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN` für die Steuerung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE iv_http_method WHEN 'GET' THEN ... WHEN 'POST' THEN ... ENDCASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_multi_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_http_method TYPE string " e.g., 'GET', 'POST'
        iv_request_body TYPE string OPTIONAL " For POST requests
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_multi_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_request.
    CASE iv_http_method.
      WHEN 'GET'.
        rv_response_message = 'GET request received. Returning data...'.
      WHEN 'POST'.
        IF iv_request_body IS NOT INITIAL.
          rv_response_message = |POST request received with body: { iv_request_body }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_response_message = 'POST request received without body.'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_response_message = |Unsupported HTTP method: { iv_http_method }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten ein und transformieren Sie diese in eine neue Struktur. Verwenden Sie dabei `REDUCE` und `WHEN` innerhalb einer `COND`-Expression, um den Preis basierend auf der Währung zu konvertieren (z.B. EUR in USD).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation/Transformation und `COND` mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_transform_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price_usd TYPE s_price, " Price always in USD
           END OF ty_sflight_converted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_converted) TYPE tt_sflight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_transform_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate_eur_usd) = '1.08'. " Example rate

    rt_sflights_converted = REDUCE tt_sflight_converted(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_converted( )
      FOR ls_raw IN it_sflights_raw
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight_converted(
                      BASE result
                      ( carrid    = ls_raw-carrid
                        connid    = ls_raw-connid
                        fldate    = ls_raw-fldate
                        price_usd = COND #( 
                                      WHEN ls_raw-currency = 'EUR' THEN ls_raw-price * lv_exchange_rate_eur_usd
                                      WHEN ls_raw-currency = 'USD' THEN ls_raw-price
                                      ELSE '0.00' " Default for unknown currency
                                    )
                      )
                    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_transform_reduce( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE zcl_csv_transform_reduce=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA(lt_sflights_converted) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_sflights_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sflights_converted )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Expected 3 converted rows' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_converted INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_sflight_eur).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_eur-price_usd exp = '108.00' ). " 100 * 1.08

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_converted INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_sflight_usd).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_usd-price_usd exp = '250.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_converted INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_sflight_gbp).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_gbp-price_usd exp = '0.00' ). " Unknown currency
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `REDUCE`-Anweisung, um eine interne Tabelle zu transformieren. Innerhalb von `REDUCE` wird eine `COND`-Expression mit `WHEN` verwendet, um bedingt den Preis basierend auf der Währung umzurechnen. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und kompakter Ansatz.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft oder Flüge über einem bestimmten Preis zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `WHEN` in der Filterbedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die `WHEN` oder `COND` für komplexe Bedingungen enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_price   TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
        iv_carrier     TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_criteria.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      it_all_flights
      WHERE (
        ( iv_min_price IS INITIAL OR price >= iv_min_price ) AND
        ( iv_carrier IS INITIAL OR carrid = iv_carrier )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_min_price = '150.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `WHEN` innerhalb einer `COND`-Expression für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und Aggregationsfunktionen. `WHEN` kann für bedingte Berechnungen innerhalb der Schleife verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum = '0.00'
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid        = ls_group_key-carrid
        average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ELSE '0.00' )
        flight_count  = lv_flight_count
      ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die das Parsen eines CSV-Strings simuliert und dabei verschiedene Ausnahmen abfängt. Nutzen Sie `CATCH ... INTO ... WHEN` um spezifisch auf unterschiedliche Fehlertypen zu reagieren und entsprechende Fehlermeldungen zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_... INTO ... WHEN` für die Ausnahmebehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_csv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_csv_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE REF TO data " Internal table or error message
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_csv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_csv_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string(
                           i_string = iv_csv_string
                           i_separator = ';' ).
        lo_csv_parser->parse(
          EXPORTING
            i_header_line = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            e_table = lt_sflights ).

        GET REFERENCE OF lt_sflights INTO rs_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_convert_codepage_error INTO DATA(lx_codepage).
        ev_error_message = |Codepage conversion error: { lx_codepage->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_access INTO DATA(lx_file_access).
        ev_error_message = |File access error during CSV parsing: { lx_file_access->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_read_src_line INTO DATA(lx_read_src).
        ev_error_message = |Error reading source line in CSV: { lx_read_src->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        ev_error_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter unterschiedliche HTTP-Response-Header setzt, wie es in einem ICF-Handler für `SHTTP` üblich wäre. Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN` für die Header-Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` für den Parameter und setzen Sie Header entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_conditional_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_header,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_header.
    TYPES tt_http_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_http_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_response_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_content_type_request TYPE string " e.g., 'CSV', 'JSON', 'XML'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_headers) TYPE tt_http_headers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_conditional_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_response_headers.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Cache-Control' value = 'no-cache' ) TO rt_headers.

    CASE iv_content_type_request.
      WHEN 'CSV'.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/csv; charset=utf-8' ) TO rt_headers.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Content-Disposition' value = 'attachment; filename="data.csv"' ) TO rt_headers.
      WHEN 'JSON'.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8' ) TO rt_headers.
      WHEN 'XML'.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/xml; charset=utf-8' ) TO rt_headers.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' ) TO rt_headers.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Markieren Sie Zeilen als gültig oder ungültig basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (z.B. Preis > 0, Währung ist EUR/USD). Nutzen Sie `COND` mit `WHEN` für die Validierungslogik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen, um komplexe Validierungsregeln zu implementieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_data_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_validated_sflight,
             sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight,
             is_valid     TYPE abap_bool,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_validated_sflight.
    TYPES tt_validated_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_validated_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_validated_flights) TYPE tt_validated_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_data_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_data.
    rt_validated_flights = VALUE tt_validated_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      LET lv_error_msg = COND string(
                             WHEN ls_flight-price <= 0 THEN 'Price must be greater than 0.'
                             WHEN ls_flight-currency <> 'EUR' AND ls_flight-currency <> 'USD' THEN 'Currency must be EUR or USD.'
                             ELSE ''
                           )
      IN ( sflight_data  = ls_flight
           is_valid      = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_error_msg IS INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
           error_message = lv_error_msg )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen URL-Parameter (z.B. `format=csv` oder `format=json`) auswertet und basierend darauf unterschiedliche Datenformate (CSV oder JSON) simuliert. Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN` für die Formatwahl.
hint: Parsen Sie den URL-Parameter und verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN` zur Auswahl des Datenformats.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_content_negotiation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_format   TYPE string " e.g., 'csv', 'json'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_convert_codepage_error
        cx_sy_file_access
        cx_sy_read_src_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_content_negotiation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_data.
    CASE iv_format.
      WHEN 'csv'.
        DATA(lo_csv_generator) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_table(
                                   i_table = it_sflights
                                   i_separator = ';' ).
        rv_output_string = lo_csv_generator->get_string( i_header_line = abap_true ).
      WHEN 'json'.
        " Simulate JSON generation (simplified)
        DATA(lv_json_string) = '['.
        LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lv_json_string = lv_json_string &&
                           |{ `{"carrid":"` && ls_flight-carrid && `","connid":"` && ls_flight-connid &&
                           `","fldate":"` && ls_flight-fldate && `","price":` && ls_flight-price &&
                           `,"currency":"` && ls_flight-currency && `"}` }|.
          IF sy-tabix < lines( it_sflights ).
            lv_json_string = lv_json_string && ','.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        lv_json_string = lv_json_string && ']'.
        rv_output_string = lv_json_string.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_output_string = 'Unsupported format requested.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_cond_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_selected_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_cond_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_selected_flights.
    rt_selected_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
      WHERE ( COND abap_bool(
                WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN abap_true
                WHEN ls_flight-price > '200.00' THEN abap_true
                ELSE abap_false
              ) )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen vollständigen ICF-Roundtrip, bei dem ein CSV-String empfangen, verarbeitet und dann ein neuer CSV-String als Antwort zurückgegeben wird. Nutzen Sie `CL_ICF_CSV` für beide Schritte und `CASE WHEN` für die Logik.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die Parsing- und Generierungslogik von `CL_ICF_CSV` in einer Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_csv_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS handle_csv_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_request_csv TYPE string
        iv_operation   TYPE string " e.g., 'PROCESS_AND_RETURN', 'ECHO'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_csv) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_convert_codepage_error
        cx_sy_file_access
        cx_sy_read_src_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_csv_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_csv_request.
    DATA: lt_received_flights TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_processed_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Parse incoming CSV
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string(
                             i_string = iv_request_csv
                             i_separator = ';' ).
    lo_csv_parser->parse(
      EXPORTING
        i_header_line = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lt_received_flights ).

    CASE iv_operation.
      WHEN 'PROCESS_AND_RETURN'.
        " Simulate some processing, e.g., filter for LH flights
        lt_processed_flights = FILTER #( lt_received_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
      WHEN 'ECHO'.
        " Just echo back the received data
        lt_processed_flights = lt_received_flights.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unsupported operation
        rv_response_csv = 'Error: Unsupported operation.'.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    " Generate response CSV
    DATA(lo_csv_generator) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_table(
                               i_table = lt_processed_flights
                               i_separator = ';' ).
    rv_response_csv = lo_csv_generator->get_string( i_header_line = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit dynamischen Spaltennamen (z.B. aus einem CSV-Header) verarbeitet. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` in Kombination mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit dem Spaltennamen als String und `CASE WHEN` für die Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_dynamic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapped_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             value  TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapped_data.
    TYPES tt_mapped_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapped_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_dynamic_csv_data
      IMPORTING
        it_dynamic_data TYPE tt_dynamic_data
        it_header_map   TYPE string_table " e.g., 'FIELD1', 'FIELD2', 'FIELD3'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_data) TYPE tt_mapped_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_dynamic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamic_csv_data.
    DATA: lv_id_col     TYPE string,
          lv_value_col  TYPE string,
          lv_status_col TYPE string.

    " Determine column names based on header map (simplified for demo)
    " In a real scenario, this would involve more robust header parsing
    IF lines( it_header_map ) >= 3.
      lv_id_col     = it_header_map[ 1 ].
      lv_value_col  = it_header_map[ 2 ].
      lv_status_col = it_header_map[ 3 ].
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_dynamic_data INTO DATA(ls_dynamic).
      DATA(ls_mapped) = VALUE ty_mapped_data( ).

      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

      " Dynamic assignment for ID
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_id_col OF STRUCTURE ls_dynamic TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_mapped-id = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.

      " Dynamic assignment for Value
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_value_col OF STRUCTURE ls_dynamic TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_mapped-value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.

      " Dynamic assignment for Status with conditional logic
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_status_col OF STRUCTURE ls_dynamic TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_mapped-status = SWITCH #( <fs_field>
                                     WHEN '1' THEN 'Active'
                                     WHEN '0' THEN 'Inactive'
                                     ELSE 'Unknown' ).
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_mapped TO rt_mapped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_dynamic_mapping( ).
    DATA: lt_dynamic_data TYPE zcl_csv_dynamic_mapping=>tt_dynamic_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'ITEM_001' field2 = 'Value A' field3 = '1' ) TO lt_dynamic_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'ITEM_002' field2 = 'Value B' field3 = '0' ) TO lt_dynamic_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'ITEM_003' field2 = 'Value C' field3 = '9' ) TO lt_dynamic_data.

    DATA(lt_header_map) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD2' ) ( 'FIELD3' ) ).

    DATA(lt_mapped_data) = lo_cut->map_dynamic_csv_data(
                              it_dynamic_data = lt_dynamic_data
                              it_header_map   = lt_header_map ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_mapped_data ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_mapped_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_mapped1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped1-id exp = 'ITEM_001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped1-value exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped1-status exp = 'Active' ).

    READ TABLE lt_mapped_data INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_mapped2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped2-id exp = 'ITEM_002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped2-status exp = 'Inactive' ).

    READ TABLE lt_mapped_data INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_mapped3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped3-id exp = 'ITEM_003' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_mapped3-status exp = 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit dynamischen Spaltennamen umgeht, wie sie oft beim Parsen von CSV-Dateien mit variablen Headern vorkommen. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Felder zur Laufzeit, und `SWITCH WHEN` wird für die bedingte Transformation des Statusfeldes verwendet.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.

    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,

CLASS zcl_group_by_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_group_by_max_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_group_by_max_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_dates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid

CLASS zcl_group_by_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT Daten, um nur die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zu enthalten, und fügen Sie ein Präfix zur Flugnummer hinzu. Nutzen Sie den FOR Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... IN ....
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights IMPORTING it_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights_transformed) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights.
    rt_sflights_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights_raw
                                           ( airline = ls_flight-carrid
                                             flight_id = |FL-{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE zcl_for_operator=>tt_sflight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_sflights( lt_raw_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-airline exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'FL-00000400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-airline exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_id exp = 'FL-00000017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, indem er eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Elementen einer Quelltabelle erstellt. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu LOOP AT ... INTO ... APPEND ...

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT Daten unter Verwendung des REDUCE Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE ... FOR ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator=>tt_sflight_seats(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' seatsmax = 150 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( lt_flight_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 450 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Datenstruktur aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, die für die Anzeige in einem Baum (z.B. `cl_gui_simple_tree`) geeignet ist. Die Struktur soll Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Verbindungsnummer gruppieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `FOR` Schleifen mit Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key TYPE string,
        text     TYPE string,
        is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
        parent_key TYPE string,
        level    TYPE i,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_tree_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS car_group.
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrid_key) = |CARR_{ lv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node(
        node_key = lv_carrid_key
        text     = |Airline: { car_group-carrid }|
        is_folder = abap_true
        parent_key = ''
        level    = 1
        carrid   = car_group-carrid
      ) TO rt_tree_data.

      LOOP AT GROUP car_group INTO DATA(ls_sflight_in_car) GROUP BY ( connid = ls_sflight_in_car-connid ) ASCENDING AS conn_group.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        DATA(lv_connid_key) = |CONN_{ lv_node_counter }|.
        APPEND VALUE ty_node(
          node_key = lv_connid_key
          text     = |Connection: { conn_group-connid }|
          is_folder = abap_true
          parent_key = lv_carrid_key
          level    = 2
          connid   = conn_group-connid
          carrid   = conn_group-carrid
        ) TO rt_tree_data.

        LOOP AT GROUP conn_group INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_node(
            node_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_counter }|
            text     = |Flight: { ls_flight-fldate } - { ls_flight-planetype }|
            is_folder = abap_false
            parent_key = lv_connid_key
            level    = 3
            connid   = ls_flight-connid
            carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
          ) TO rt_tree_data.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_tree_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->get_sflight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_tree_data ). " Assumes sflight table has data

    " Check for at least one level 1 node (airline)
    DATA(lv_level1_nodes) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE level = 1.
      lv_level1_nodes = lv_level1_nodes + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_level1_nodes > 0 ).

    " Check for parent-child relationships (simple check)
    DATA(lv_has_children) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data INTO ls_node WHERE level = 2.
      READ TABLE lt_tree_data WITH KEY node_key = ls_node-parent_key INTO DATA(ls_parent).
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_parent-level = 1.
        lv_has_children = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_children ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode demonstriert die Erstellung einer hierarchischen Datenstruktur aus flachen Datenbanktabellen (`sflight`) unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax wie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`, `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Ausdrücken. Dies ist eine typische Vorbereitung für UI-Komponenten wie `cl_gui_simple_tree`, die hierarchische Daten erwarten. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische Textgenerierung verwendet.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, VALUE, String Templates, Hierarchical Data, Tree Control

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine bestehende hierarchische Baumstruktur, um nur Knoten anzuzeigen, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen (z.B. Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key TYPE string,
        text     TYPE string,
        is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
        parent_key TYPE string,
        level    TYPE i,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_nodes_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes TYPE tt_nodes
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_nodes_by_carrid.
    " Filter all nodes that match the carrid or are parents of matching nodes
    rt_filtered_nodes = FILTER #( it_all_nodes USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid OR
                                                           ( is_folder = abap_true AND
                                                             EXISTS it_all_nodes[ parent_key = node_key AND carrid = iv_carrid ] ) ).
    " This filter is simplified and might need more complex logic for full hierarchical filtering
    " (e.g., including all parents of a matching child, even if the parent itself doesn't match the carrid)
    " For a true hierarchical filter, a recursive approach or multiple passes might be needed.
    " For this example, we assume direct match or direct parent of a direct match.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_nodes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_nodes.
    DATA(lo_data_generator) = NEW zcl_tree_sflight_data( ). " Re-use data generator from previous example
    DATA(lt_all_nodes) = lo_data_generator->get_sflight_tree_data( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_filter_nodes( ).

    " Test with a known airline (e.g., 'LH')
    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->filter_nodes_by_carrid( it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered_lh ).

    " Verify all remaining nodes are related to 'LH'
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_lh INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_node-carrid <> 'LH'.
        " This check is simplified. A full check would need to verify if it's a parent of an 'LH' node.
        " For this example, we assume direct carrid match for non-folder nodes.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Node { ls_node-node_key } has unexpected carrid { ls_node-carrid }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a non-existent airline
    DATA(lt_filtered_xx) = lo_cut->filter_nodes_by_carrid( it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_xx ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle von Baumknoten basierend auf einem Kriterium zu filtern. Es zeigt, wie man mit modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken effizient Datenmengen reduzieren kann, was für die dynamische Anpassung von UI-Anzeigen nützlich ist. Die `EXISTS`-Prüfung innerhalb des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Bedingung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Table Expressions, Tree Control, Data Filtering

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jede Flugverbindung und Fluggesellschaft in der hierarchischen Baumstruktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_aggregate_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node_with_pax,
        node_key TYPE string,
        text     TYPE string,
        is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
        parent_key TYPE string,
        level    TYPE i,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_passengers TYPE i,
      END OF ty_node_with_pax,
      tt_nodes_with_pax TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_with_pax WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_tree_with_pax
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_nodes_with_pax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_aggregate_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_tree_with_pax.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    " First, calculate total passengers per connection
    DATA(lt_conn_pax) = VALUE tt_nodes_with_pax(
      FOR car_group IN GROUP BY ( carrid = car_group-carrid ) OF lt_sflights
      (
        FOR conn_group IN GROUP BY ( connid = conn_group-connid ) OF car_group
        (
          node_key = |CONN_{ conn_group-carrid }_{ conn_group-connid }|,
          connid = conn_group-connid,
          carrid = conn_group-carrid,
          total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                       FOR flight IN conn_group
                                       NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc )
        )
      )
    ).

    " Now build the hierarchical structure, adding aggregated data
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS car_group.
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrid_key) = |CARR_{ lv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_node_with_pax(
        node_key = lv_carrid_key
        text     = |Airline: { car_group-carrid }|
        is_folder = abap_true
        parent_key = ''
        level    = 1
        carrid   = car_group-carrid
        total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR conn_pax IN lt_conn_pax WHERE ( carrid = car_group-carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + conn_pax-total_passengers )
      ) TO rt_tree_data.

      LOOP AT GROUP car_group INTO DATA(ls_sflight_in_car) GROUP BY ( connid = ls_sflight_in_car-connid ) ASCENDING AS conn_group.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        DATA(lv_connid_key) = |CONN_{ lv_node_counter }|.
        DATA(lv_conn_pax_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR conn_pax IN lt_conn_pax WHERE ( carrid = conn_group-carrid AND connid = conn_group-connid )
                                          NEXT sum = sum + conn_pax-total_passengers ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_node_with_pax(
          node_key = lv_connid_key
          text     = |Connection: { conn_group-connid } (Pax: { lv_conn_pax_sum })|
          is_folder = abap_true
          parent_key = lv_carrid_key
          level    = 2
          connid   = conn_group-connid
          carrid   = conn_group-carrid
          total_passengers = lv_conn_pax_sum
        ) TO rt_tree_data.

        LOOP AT GROUP conn_group INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_node_with_pax(
            node_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_counter }|
            text     = |Flight: { ls_flight-fldate } - { ls_flight-planetype } (Pax: { ls_flight-seatsocc })|
            is_folder = abap_false
            parent_key = lv_connid_key
            level    = 3
            connid   = ls_flight-connid
            carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
            total_passengers = ls_flight-seatsocc
          ) TO rt_tree_data.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_aggregate_data( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->get_sflight_tree_with_pax( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_tree_data ).

    " Find a specific connection and check its passenger count
    DATA(ls_conn_node) = lt_tree_data[ level = 2 AND carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' DEFAULT `(total_passengers = -1)` ].
    IF ls_conn_node-total_passengers = -1.
      " If no such node, it might be due to test data, skip specific assertion
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test data for LH 0400 not found, cannot verify passenger count.' ).
    ELSE.
      " Assuming LH 0400 has some passengers, check if it's positive
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_conn_node-total_passengers > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check if a parent node's passenger count is sum of its children (simplified)
    DATA(ls_carr_node) = lt_tree_data[ level = 1 AND carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT `(total_passengers = -1)` ].
    IF ls_carr_node-total_passengers = -1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test data for LH airline not found, cannot verify passenger count.' ).
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_sum_children_pax) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR child_node IN lt_tree_data WHERE ( parent_key = ls_carr_node-node_key AND level = 2 )
                                            NEXT sum = sum + child_node-total_passengers ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carr_node-total_passengers exp = lv_sum_children_pax ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb einer hierarchischen Struktur. Es verwendet `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und `WHERE`-Klauseln, um die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere auf verschiedenen Ebenen des Baumes zu berechnen. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für die Datenaufbereitung, das die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Ausdrücke in modernem ABAP zeigt.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Table Expressions, Aggregation, Tree Control

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch Baumknoten basierend auf einer Liste von Objekten und deren Eigenschaften generiert, wobei die Hierarchie durch eine Pfadangabe definiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und String-Operationen, um Pfade zu zerlegen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_input_object,
        id   TYPE string,
        path TYPE string, " e.g., 'Category1/SubcategoryA/ItemX'
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_input_object,
      tt_input_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key TYPE string,
        text     TYPE string,
        is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
        parent_key TYPE string,
        level    TYPE i,
        original_id TYPE string,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_tree_from_paths
      IMPORTING
        it_input_objects TYPE tt_input_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_tree_from_paths.
    DATA(lt_all_paths) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_obj IN it_input_objects
      ( ls_obj-path )
    ).

    DATA(lt_unique_paths) = VALUE string_table( FOR path IN lt_all_paths ( path ) GROUP BY path ).

    DATA(lt_path_segments) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string_table WITH EMPTY KEY(
      FOR path IN lt_unique_paths
      ( CONV string_table( SPLIT path AT '/' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lt_processed_nodes) TYPE tt_nodes.

    LOOP AT lt_path_segments INTO DATA(ls_segments).
      DATA(lv_current_parent_key) = ''.
      DATA(lv_current_path) = ''.
      DATA(lv_current_level) = 0.

      LOOP AT ls_segments INTO DATA(lv_segment).
        lv_current_level = lv_current_level + 1.
        IF lv_current_path IS INITIAL.
          lv_current_path = lv_segment.
        ELSE.
          lv_current_path = |{ lv_current_path }/{ lv_segment }|.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_node_key) = lv_current_path. " Use path as unique key for simplicity

        READ TABLE lt_processed_nodes WITH KEY node_key = lv_node_key TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Node not yet added
          lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_node(
            node_key = lv_node_key
            text      = lv_segment
            is_folder = abap_true " Assume all intermediate nodes are folders
            parent_key = lv_current_parent_key
            level    = lv_current_level
          ) TO lt_processed_nodes.
        ENDIF.
        lv_current_parent_key = lv_node_key.
      ENDLOOP.

      " Add the actual item node
      DATA(ls_final_object) = it_input_objects[ path = lv_current_path DEFAULT `(id = '', path = '', value = '')` ].
      IF ls_final_object-id IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_node(
          node_key = |ITEM_{ lv_node_counter }|
          text      = ls_final_object-value
          is_folder = abap_false
          parent_key = lv_current_parent_key
          level    = lv_current_level + 1
          original_id = ls_final_object-id
        ) TO lt_processed_nodes.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_tree_data = lt_processed_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von ausgewählten Baumknoten-Schlüsseln und extrahieren Sie die zugehörigen Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `IN` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_process_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_node,
        node_key TYPE string,
        text     TYPE string,
        is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
        parent_key TYPE string,
        level    TYPE i,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_node,
      tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_selected_nodes
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes      TYPE tt_nodes
        it_selected_keys  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_process_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_selected_nodes.
    rt_selected_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_key IN it_selected_keys
      LET ls_node = it_all_nodes[ KEY primary_key node_key = lv_key DEFAULT `( )` ] IN
      " Only process actual flight nodes (level 3)
      IF ls_node-level = 3 AND ls_node-carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_node-connid IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_node-fldate IS NOT INITIAL.
        ( VALUE sflight(
            carrid = ls_node-carrid
            connid = ls_node-connid
            fldate = ls_node-fldate
          ) )
      ENDIF
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_selection.
    DATA(lo_data_generator) = NEW zcl_tree_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_all_nodes) = lo_data_generator->get_sflight_tree_data( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_process_selection( ).

    " Select some flight nodes
    DATA(lt_selected_keys) = VALUE string_table( ).
    LOOP AT lt_all_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE level = 3.
      APPEND ls_node-node_key TO lt_selected_keys.
      IF lines( lt_selected_keys ) >= 2. " Take first two flight nodes
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_selected_keys ) >= 2 ). " Ensure we have at least 2 keys

    DATA(lt_selected_flights) = lo_cut->process_selected_nodes(
      it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes
      it_selected_keys = lt_selected_keys
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_selected_flights ) exp = lines( lt_selected_keys ) ).

    " Verify content of a selected flight
    DATA(ls_first_selected_flight) = lt_selected_flights[ 1 ].
    DATA(ls_first_node) = lt_all_nodes[ node_key = lt_selected_keys[ 1 ] ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_selected_flight-carrid exp = ls_first_node-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_selected_flight-connid exp = ls_first_node-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_selected_flight-fldate exp = ls_first_node-fldate ).

    " Test with empty selection
    DATA(lt_empty_selection) = lo_cut->process_selected_nodes(
      it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik zur dynamischen Auswahl eines UI5-Themes basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum (z.B. ein "Holiday"-Theme im Dezember).

solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_theme
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_theme_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_theme.
    DATA(lv_date) = COND sy-datum( WHEN iv_date IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_date ELSE sy-datum ).
    DATA(lv_month) = lv_date+4(2).

    rv_theme_name = SWITCH string( lv_month
                                  WHEN '12' THEN 'sap_fiori_3_dark_holiday' " Example holiday theme
                                  WHEN '01' THEN 'sap_fiori_3_light_winter' " Example winter theme
                                  WHEN '07' THEN 'sap_fiori_3_light_summer' " Example summer theme
                                  ELSE 'sap_fiori_3' ). " Default theme
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_css_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        name  TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_ui5_css_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_css_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ''
                                   FOR ls_attr IN it_attributes

    rv_css_string = cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim_trailing( rv_css_string ). " Remove trailing space
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Theme-Konfigurationseinträgen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle erforderlichen Eigenschaften vorhanden sind und gültige Werte haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_theme_property,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_theme_property,
      tt_theme_properties TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_property WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_theme_config
      IMPORTING
        it_config TYPE tt_theme_properties
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_theme_config.
    " Define required properties and their validation logic
    DATA(lt_required_props) = VALUE tt_theme_properties(
      ( name = 'primaryColor' value = 'HEX_COLOR' ) " Placeholder for validation type
      ( name = 'fontSize' value = 'PX_VALUE' )
      ( name = 'fontFamily' value = 'STRING' )
    ).

    rb_is_valid = abap_true.

    LOOP AT lt_required_props INTO DATA(ls_req_prop).
      DATA(ls_config_entry) = it_config[ KEY primary_key name = ls_req_prop-name DEFAULT `( )` ].
      IF ls_config_entry-name IS INITIAL. " Property not found
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      " Basic value validation using SWITCH
      DATA(lv_is_value_valid) = SWITCH abap_bool( ls_req_prop-value
                                                  WHEN 'HEX_COLOR' THEN xsdbool( ls_config_entry-value CO '#0123456789ABCDEFabcdef' AND strlen( ls_config_entry-value ) = 7 )
                                                  WHEN 'PX_VALUE'  THEN xsdbool( ls_config_entry-value CP '*px' AND ls_config_entry-value+0(strlen( ls_config_entry-value ) - 2) CA '0123456789' )
                                                  WHEN 'STRING'    THEN xsdbool( ls_config_entry-value IS NOT INITIAL )
                                                  ELSE abap_false ).
      IF lv_is_value_valid = abap_false.
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie ein Datum in ein String-Format, das von einem ausgewählten UI5-Theme abhängt (z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD' für ein technisches Theme, 'DD.MM.YYYY' für ein Business-Theme).
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_theme_settings,
        theme_name TYPE string,
        date_format_key TYPE string, " e.g., 'TECHNICAL', 'BUSINESS'
      END OF ty_theme_settings.

    METHODS format_date_by_theme
      IMPORTING
        iv_date         TYPE sy-datum
        is_theme_settings TYPE ty_theme_settings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_by_theme.
    rv_formatted_date = SWITCH string( is_theme_settings-date_format_key
                                      WHEN 'TECHNICAL' THEN |{ iv_date(4) }-{ iv_date+4(2) }-{ iv_date+6(2) }|
                                      WHEN 'BUSINESS'  THEN |{ iv_date+6(2) }. { iv_date+4(2) }. { iv_date(4) }|
                                      WHEN 'US_SHORT'  THEN |{ iv_date+4(2) }/{ iv_date+6(2) }/{ iv_date(4) }|
                                      ELSE |{ iv_date }| ). " Default to internal format
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) an einem Objekt, um mehrere Operationen in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_add   TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply_value IMPORTING iv_mult  TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).

    " Chained calls: (5 + 3) * 2 = 16
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value( 5 )->add_value( 3 )->multiply_value( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ).

    " Another chained call: (10 * 0) + 100 = 100
    lv_result = lo_calculator->set_value( 10 )->multiply_value( 0 )->add_value( 100 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 100 ).

    " Test individual calls
    lo_calculator->set_value( 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_result( ) exp = 7 ).
    lo_calculator->add_value( 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_result( ) exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das "Method Chaining", eine Technik, bei der mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren und lesbareren Code, insbesondere bei Builder-Pattern oder Fluent Interfaces.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, RETURN, ME

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten zwischen internen Tabellen oder Strukturen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, aber ähnlicher Semantik, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        flight_id   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connection_nr TYPE sflight-connid,
        flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
        occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        additional_field TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_data,
      tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflight_data.
    rt_target_data = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_data MAPPING airline_id = flight_id
                                                              connid = connection_nr
                                                              occupied_seats = seats_occupied
                                                              EXCEPT additional_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>tt_source_data(
      ( flight_id = 'LH', connection_nr = '0400', flight_date = '20251124', seats_occupied = 150 )
      ( flight_id = 'AA', connection_nr = '0010', flight_date = '20251125', seats_occupied = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_sflight_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    " Verify first entry
    DATA(ls_target_entry) = lt_target[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-fldate exp = '20251124' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-occupied_seats exp = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target_entry-additional_field ). " Should be initial as it's not mapped

    " Verify second entry
    ls_target_entry = lt_target[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-connid exp = '0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-fldate exp = '20251125' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_entry-occupied_seats exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, aber ähnlicher Struktur, effizient zu kopieren. Die `MAPPING`-Klausel erlaubt die explizite Zuordnung von Feldern, während `EXCEPT` Felder ausschließt, die nicht kopiert werden sollen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und lesbare Methode zur Datenübertragung und -transformation in modernem ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, Data Transformation, CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, EXCEPT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators und füllen Sie diese mit mindestens drei Einträgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( ( ... ) ( ... ) ... ) zur Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flugnummer (connid) und Datum (fldate) enthält, unter Verwendung des FOR-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` in Kombination mit `VALUE #( ... )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                             ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
                               fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_flight_creator( ). " Reusing creator from itab_001
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_creator->get_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summaries ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 summaries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[1]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First summary connid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[3]-fldate exp = '20251125' msg = 'Third summary fldate mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur oder Tabelle, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP` Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Transformation, Data Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (seatsocc) aus einer Flugtabelle mit dem REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ...` um eine Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                         RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_flight_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_creator->get_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_occupied_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 870 msg = 'Total occupied seats mismatch' ). " 120 + 300 + 450 = 870
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen, und ersetzt oft explizite `LOOP` und `COMPUTE` Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, COMPUTE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Flugtabelle, um nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' anzuzeigen, unter Verwendung des FILTER-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )` für die deklarative Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_flight_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_creator->get_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 filtered flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Filtered carrier mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft performanter als eine explizite `LOOP` mit `DELETE` oder `COLLECT`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, WHERE, Data Filtering

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Nachricht mit Flugdetails (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie Backticks `` ` `` und ` { ... } ` für die Platzhalter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.

    METHODS format_flight_info IMPORTING is_flight TYPE ty_flight
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } am { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER } hat { is_flight-seatsocc } von { is_flight-seatsmax } Sitzen belegt.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_flight_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_info.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_string_formatter=>ty_flight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 150
    ).

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_string_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_flight_info( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_formatted needle = 'LH 0400' msg = 'Carrier and connection missing' ).
