explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine moderne und sehr lesbare Methode zur dynamischen Erstellung von Strings. Sie erlauben das direkte Einbetten von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{ ... }`) sowie Formatierungsoptionen (z.B. `DATE = USER`), was die String-Konkatenation erheblich vereinfacht und verbessert.
keywords: String Template, String Processing, Concatenation, Formatting

Instructions: Weisen Sie basierend auf der Auslastung eines Fluges einen Status ('Voll', 'Teilweise', 'Leer') zu, unter Verwendung des COND-Operators. 'Voll' bei >90% Auslastung, 'Teilweise' bei >50%, sonst 'Leer'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_occupancy_status IMPORTING iv_seats_occupied TYPE s_seatsocc
                                          iv_seats_max      TYPE s_seatsmax
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seats_max > 0 THEN ( iv_seats_occupied * 100 ) / iv_seats_max ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percent > 90 THEN 'Voll'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percent > 50 THEN 'Teilweise'
      ELSE 'Leer'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_occupancy_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_status.
    DATA(lo_status) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 140 iv_seats_max = 150 ) exp = 'Voll' msg = 'Status for >90% failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 100 iv_seats_max = 150 ) exp = 'Teilweise' msg = 'Status for >50% failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 50 iv_seats_max = 150 ) exp = 'Leer' msg = 'Status for <=50% failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_occupancy_status( iv_seats_occupied = 0 iv_seats_max = 0 ) exp = 'Leer' msg = 'Status for zero max seats failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er ersetzt die traditionelle `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Struktur für einfache Zuweisungen und macht den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Assignment, Expression

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Preisbereich eines Fluges basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft mit dem SWITCH-Operator. Z.B. 'LH' -> 'Premium', 'UA' -> 'Standard', 'AA' -> 'Budget', sonst 'Unbekannt'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH #( ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` für Mehrfachbedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_range_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                         RETURNING VALUE(rv_price_range) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_range_by_carrier.
    rv_price_range = SWITCH string( iv_carrid
      WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Premium'
      WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Standard'
      WHEN 'AA' THEN 'Budget'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_range.
    DATA(lo_price_range) = NEW zcl_flight_price_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_price_range->get_price_range_by_carrier( 'LH' ) exp = 'Premium' msg = 'LH price range mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_price_range->get_price_range_by_carrier( 'UA' ) exp = 'Standard' msg = 'UA price range mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_price_range->get_price_range_by_carrier( 'AA' ) exp = 'Budget' msg = 'AA price range mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_price_range->get_price_range_by_carrier( 'XX' ) exp = 'Unbekannt' msg = 'Unknown carrier price range mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine Erweiterung des `COND`-Operators und ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf mehreren möglichen Werten einer Eingabevariable. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und moderne Alternative zu langen `CASE` oder `IF ... ELSE IF` Konstrukten.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Assignment, Expression

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle zu, um die Fluggesellschaft (carrid) eines bestimmten Fluges (connid) zu erhalten, unter Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `itab[ KEY name = value ]-component` und den `DEFAULT`-Zusatz für den Fehlerfall.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY connid.

    METHODS get_carrier_by_connid IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                          iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_by_connid.
    rv_carrid = it_flights[ KEY connid = iv_connid ]-carrid DEFAULT 'N/A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_flight_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_raw) = lo_creator->get_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_table_expression=>tt_flights( FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_raw ( ls_flight ) ).

    DATA(lo_expr) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_expr->get_carrier_by_connid( it_flights = lt_flights iv_connid = '0400' ) exp = 'LH' msg = 'Existing flight carrier mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_expr->get_carrier_by_connid( it_flights = lt_flights iv_connid = '9999' ) exp = 'N/A' msg = 'Non-existing flight carrier mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten und typsicheren Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit dem `DEFAULT`-Zusatz kann elegant auf den Fall reagiert werden, dass ein Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, ohne eine Ausnahme abfangen zu müssen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion für den Umgang mit internen Tabellen.
keywords: Table Expression, Internal Table, KEY, DEFAULT, Data Access

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur mit teilweise übereinstimmenden Feldnamen unter Verwendung des CORRESPONDING-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` für den Datenabgleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             airline   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             other_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             new_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source_data
                       RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING connid = flight_id
                                           carrid = airline
                                           fldate = flight_date ).
    rs_target-new_field = 'Mapped Data'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_op=>ty_source_data(
      flight_id = '0400' airline = 'LH' flight_date = '20251124' other_field = 'Some Value'
    ).

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_corresponding_op( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrid mismatch' ).

Mit dem `MAPPING`-Zusatz können abweichende Feldnamen explizit zugeordnet werden, was den Code sauberer und wartbarer macht als manuelle Zuweisungen.

Instructions: Finden Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH'), die mehr als 100 belegte Sitze haben, in einer funktionalen Kette. Runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `FOR`, `REDUCE` und `COMPUTE` in einer Kette.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_for_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                                iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
                                                iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
                                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc > iv_min_seats ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_occupancy_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
                                                      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                                        NEXT sum = sum + ( COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) ) ).

    rv_avg_occupancy = lv_total_occupancy_sum / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    rv_avg_occupancy = round( val = rv_avg_occupancy dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_flight_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_creator->get_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_chain) = NEW zcl_functional_chain( ).

    " Add more flights for better test coverage
    APPEND VALUE zcl_functional_chain=>ty_flight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251124' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 140 seatsmax = 150
    ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_functional_chain=>ty_flight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251124' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 150
    ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_chain->get_avg_occupancy_for_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                            iv_carrid = 'LH'
                                                            iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    " LH 0400: 120/150 = 0.8
    " LH 0401: 140/150 = 0.9333...
    " LH 0402: 80/150 (filtered out as seatsocc <= 100)
    " Average = (0.8 + 0.9333) / 2 = 0.8666... rounded to 0.87
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = '0.87' msg = 'Average occupancy mismatch' ).

    DATA(lv_avg_no_match) = lo_chain->get_avg_occupancy_for_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                                    iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                                                    iv_min_seats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_no_match exp = '0.00' msg = 'Average occupancy for no match should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Verkettung moderner ABAP-Operatoren (`FILTER`, `REDUCE`, `COND`) und funktionaler Methoden (`round`) zur Durchführung komplexer Datenverarbeitungsaufgaben in einer einzigen, flüssigen und deklarativen Kette. Dies führt zu extrem kompaktem, lesbarem und wartbarem Code, der die Intentionalität der Operation klar widerspiegelt.
keywords: Functional Programming, Chaining, FILTER, REDUCE, COND, COMPUTE, Data Analysis, Advanced

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes einer Struktur zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_field_type IMPORTING is_data    TYPE any
                                        iv_field_name TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.

    TRY.
        lo_data_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_data_descr.

        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WHERE name = iv_field_name.
          rv_type_name = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_type_name = 'Field not found'.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_type_name = 'Input is not a structure'.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        rv_type_name = 'Error describing data'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_type.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_rtti_inspector=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124'
    ).

    DATA(lo_inspector) = NEW zcl_rtti_inspector( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_inspector->get_field_type( is_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ) exp = 'S_CARR_ID' msg = 'CARRID type mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_inspector->get_field_type( is_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'FLDATE' ) exp = 'S_DATE' msg = 'FLDATE type mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_inspector->get_field_type( is_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ) exp = 'Field not found' msg = 'Non-existent field check failed' ).

    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_inspector->get_field_type( is_data = lv_string iv_field_name = 'ANY' ) exp = 'Input is not a structure' msg = 'Non-structure input check failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen und -strukturen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` bieten moderne, objektorientierte Schnittstellen für diese Funktionalität.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Information, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einem Konstruktor, der Parameter entgegennimmt, und demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung mit dem Inline-Deklarationsoperator `NEW`.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne LOOP-Syntax mit WHERE-Klausel und DATA-Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(wa) WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom DEFAULT 'FRA'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND cityfrom = iv_cityfrom.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight(
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_flight-cityto
      ) TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Initial check, as SFLIGHTS might be empty or not contain 'LH' from 'FRA'

    " Add some test data to sflight if needed for robust testing, or mock the SELECT
    " For this example, we assume sflight might be empty or contain data.
    " A more robust test would insert test data or use a test double.

    " Example with expected data (if we knew 'AA' from 'NYC' exists)
    " DATA(lt_result_aa) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'AA' iv_cityfrom = 'NYC' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result_aa ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(wa) WHERE ...` Syntax ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Iteration über interne Tabellen mit direkter Filterung und Inline-Deklaration der Arbeitszeile. `VALUE #(...)` wird für die direkte Konstruktion der Ergebniszeile verwendet.
keywords: LOOP, WHERE, DATA, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Filtering

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus SFLIGHTS enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_future_flight.
    TYPES tt_future_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_future_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Assert that all flights in the result are indeed in the future
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_future_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_future_flight-fldate > sy-datum ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks filtert die Quelldaten effizient, bevor die Zieltabelle konstruiert wird.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Filtering, Date

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #(...) FOR ... IN ... NEXT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrier = 'AA' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has some flights with prices, or mock data.
    " For a real test, insert known data into SFLIGHTS or use a test double.
    " Example: If 'AA' has two flights with prices 100 and 200, expected is 300.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 300 ).

    " For now, just assert it's not negative (prices should be positive)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum_price`) und iteriert über eine interne Tabelle, wobei er in jedem Schritt die Variable aktualisiert. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Summen, Zähler oder andere Aggregationen zu bilden.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Math, LOOP

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität (SEATSMAX) haben. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #(...) FROM ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_capacity_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      FROM lt_sflights
      WHERE seatsmax >= iv_min_capacity
      ( carrid = carrid, connid = connid, seatsmax = seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_high_capacity_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_high_capacity_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_capacity_flights( iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    " Assert that all flights in the result meet the minimum capacity
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-seatsmax >= 200 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Instructions: Serialisieren Sie ein einfaches ABAP-Objekt in ein JSON-Format und deserialisieren Sie es anschließend zurück in ein Objekt. Verwenden Sie dafür `cl_abap_conv_obj`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj=>create(...)` und die Methoden `serialize` und `deserialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_serializable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_value1 TYPE string,
          mv_value2 TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE string
        iv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_serializable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_value1 = iv_value1.
    me->mv_value2 = iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_object
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_type        TYPE cl_abap_typedescr=>type_kind
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_object) TYPE REF TO object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_object.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create(
      EXPORTING
        obj = io_object
        type = cl_abap_conv_obj=>type_json
    ).
    lo_converter->serialize( IMPORTING json_string = rv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_object.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_type ).
    CREATE OBJECT ro_object TYPE (lo_type_descr->get_name()).

    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create(
      EXPORTING
        obj = ro_object
        type = cl_abap_conv_obj=>type_json
    ).
    lo_converter->deserialize( EXPORTING json_string = iv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialization_deserialization.
    DATA(lo_original_obj) = NEW zcl_demo_serializable( iv_value1 = 'Hello World' iv_value2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_object_serializer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lo_deserialized_obj) = CAST zcl_demo_serializable(

    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `|... {variable} ...|`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_string.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_flight_string = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_flight_string = |Flug { iv_carrier } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (SFLIGHTS) basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze (SEATSOCC - SEATSMAX). Wenn mehr als 50% der Sitze frei sind, ist der Status 'Verfügbar', sonst 'Begrenzt'. Verwenden Sie dabei den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN condition1 THEN result1 WHEN condition2 THEN result2 ELSE default_result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_free_seats_ratio) = ( ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax.

      rv_status = COND string(
        WHEN lv_free_seats_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'Verfügbar'
        ELSE 'Begrenzt'
      ).
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    " Test case: Available (e.g., 100 max, 20 occupied -> 80% free)
    " For a real test, insert known data into SFLIGHTS or use a test double.
    " Assuming a flight 'AA' '0017' exists with seatsmax=100, seatsocc=20
    DATA(lv_status_available) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_carrier = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_available exp = 'Verfügbar' ).

    " Test case: Limited (e.g., 100 max, 60 occupied -> 40% free)
    " Assuming a flight 'LH' '0400' exists with seatsmax=100, seatsocc=60
    DATA(lv_status_limited) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_limited exp = 'Begrenzt' ).

    " Test case: Not found
    DATA(lv_status_not_found) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_carrier = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_not_found exp = 'Flug nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, insbesondere bei der Zuweisung von Werten.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHTS, IF, Status

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.

CLASS zcl_modern_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_modern_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    " Konvertierung in den gewünschten Typ, falls nötig, hier direkt CORRESPONDING
    rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich, macht den Code kürzer und lesbarer. `CORRESPONDING #()` wird hier verwendet, um die Felder der internen Tabelle in den Zieltyp zu mappen.

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHTS) über einen Tabellenausdruck zu, basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Wenn die Zeile nicht existiert, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `itab[ KEY name COMPONENTS ... ]` oder `itab[ index ]` mit `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_info
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_city_info
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_info) TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_city_info.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_info.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        rs_flight_info = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_flight_key-carrid,
                                                          connid = is_flight_key-connid ].
    CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
      rs_flight_info = VALUE ty_flight_info(
        carrid   = is_flight_key-carrid
        connid   = is_flight_key-connid
        cityfrom = 'UNKNOWN'
        cityto   = 'UNKNOWN'
      ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` kann elegant auf das Nichtvorhandensein einer Zeile reagiert und ein Standardwert zugewiesen werden, was den Code robuster macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um eine Flugnummer zu validieren und dann zu formatieren. Verwenden Sie dabei den `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung und Methodenverkettung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW class( )->method1( )->method2( )`.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_formatter
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_value.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_connid) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_connid.
    IF iv_connid IS INITIAL OR NOT iv_connid CO '0123456789'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Flugnummer darf nicht leer sein und muss numerisch sein.'.
    ENDIF.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_connid.
    rv_formatted_connid = |FL-{ me->mv_connid ALPHA = OUT }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit Methoden, die eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz zurückgeben (`ro_self = me`), können Methodenaufrufe verkettet werden. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Abflugort (CITYFROM) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Abflugort. Verwenden Sie dabei `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( field1, field2 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_city.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-cityfrom
      ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        cityfrom = ls_group_key-cityfrom
        flight_count = lv_count
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_by_city FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_city.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_city( ).

    " Assert that the counts are positive for existing cities
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Example: If 'FRANKFURT' has 5 flights
    " DATA(ls_frankfurt) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' DEFAULT VALUE ty_flight_count( ) ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_frankfurt-flight_count exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf bestimmten Feldern. Innerhalb der äußeren Schleife kann mit `LOOP AT GROUP` über die Elemente der aktuellen Gruppe iteriert werden, um Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Alternative zu `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukten.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes einer Struktur (z.B. SFLIGHTS-CARRID) zur Laufzeit und geben Sie dessen Datentyp-Kategorie aus. Verwenden Sie dabei RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_descr(...)` und `get_components()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_category.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components INTO ls_component WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_type_category = ls_component-type->type_kind_name.
        ELSE.
          rv_type_category = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
        ENDIF.

    CATCH cx_sy_invalid_type.
      rv_type_category = 'Struktur nicht gefunden'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) und geben Sie für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aus. Verwenden Sie dabei `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_wa>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_field_symbol DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_field_symbol IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      APPEND |Fluggesellschaft: { <fs_flight>-carrid }, Flugnummer: { <fs_flight>-connid }| TO rt_processed_strings.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight      TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_field_symbol( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Fluggesellschaft: AA, Flugnummer: 0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Fluggesellschaft: LH, Flugnummer: 0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` Syntax ist die performanteste Art, über interne Tabellen zu iterieren, da keine Daten kopiert werden. Die Inline-Deklaration des Feldsymbols (`<fs_flight>`) macht den Code zudem sehr kompakt und lesbar. Dies ist die bevorzugte Methode, wenn die Zeile direkt modifiziert oder performant gelesen werden soll.
keywords: LOOP, Field-Symbol, Internal Tables, Performance, SFLIGHTS, String Templates

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter akzeptieren und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)` und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
        iv_param      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming method has an input parameter named IV_INPUT
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    DATA: lt_return_value TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_return_value TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_return_value-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'. " Assuming method has a return parameter named RV_OUTPUT
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_return_value-value.
    APPEND ls_return_value TO lt_return_value.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS FROM PARAMETER-TABLE lt_return_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Handle error
        rv_result = 'ERROR: Dynamic call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. einer Datenbanktabelle oder einem Dictionary-Typ) und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE clike " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

        IF <lt_table> IS BOUND.
          " Fill with some dummy data (simplified for demonstration)
          CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_struct_name) INTO DATA(lr_line).
          ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_line>.

          IF <ls_line> IS BOUND.
            " This part is highly dependent on the structure.
            " For SFLIGHT, we can try to set some fields.
            " This is a generic example, actual field setting would need more RTTI.
            TRY.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
                IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
                IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0001'. ENDIF.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
                IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
                APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
                IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
                IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
                IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum + 1. ENDIF.
                APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
              CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
                " Field not found in structure
            ENDTRY.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error if structure not found
      CATCH cx_sy_table_creation_error.
        " Handle error if table creation fails
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_sflight_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <lt_sflight> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_sflight> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
    IF <ls_sflight> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_sflight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'AA' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_invalid_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_STRUCT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lr_invalid_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ermöglicht die vollständige dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit.
keywords: DYNAMIC, INTERNAL TABLE, RTTI, CREATE DATA, TABLEDESCR

  ENDMETHOD.

        DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>get_object_descr( io_object ).

    " Does not implement zif_test_interface

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_implements_test( ).
    DATA(lo_obj_implements) = NEW zcl_implements_test( ).
    DATA(lo_obj_not_implements) = NEW zcl_not_implements_test( ).

    DATA(lb_result_implements) = lo_cut->check_interface_implementation(
      io_object       = lo_obj_implements
      iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE'

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Namen und Typen aller Parameter einer bestimmten Methode einer Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr`, `get_methods` und `get_parameters` mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string, " e.g., 'IMPORTING', 'EXPORTING', 'CHANGING', 'RETURNING'
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES: tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_method_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parameters) TYPE tt_parameter_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        READ TABLE lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method) WITH KEY name = iv_method_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_method_descr ?= ls_method-descr.
          DATA(lt_params) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

          rt_parameters = VALUE #( FOR ls_param IN lt_params ( 
                                     name = ls_param-name
                                     type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( )
                                     kind = SWITCH string( ls_param-kind
                                                          WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>importing THEN 'IMPORTING'
                                                          WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>exporting THEN 'EXPORTING'
                                                          WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>changing  THEN 'CHANGING'
                                                          WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>returning THEN 'RETURNING'
                                                          ELSE 'UNKNOWN' ) 
                                   ) ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur kopiert, wobei nur Attribute mit gleichem Namen und kompatiblem Typ übertragen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_matching_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE any STRUCTURE
      CHANGING
        cs_target TYPE any STRUCTURE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_matching_fields.
    DATA: lo_source_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_target_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_source_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source ).
        lo_target_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( cs_target ).

        DATA(lt_source_components) = lo_source_descr->get_components( ).
        DATA(lt_target_components) = lo_target_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_source_components INTO DATA(ls_source_comp).
          READ TABLE lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_comp)
            WITH KEY name = ls_source_comp-name.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Check if types are compatible (simplified check, more robust check would involve type_kind)
            IF ls_source_comp-type_descr->get_name( ) = ls_target_comp-type_descr->get_name( ).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_source_comp-name OF STRUCTURE is_source TO <fs_source_field>.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE cs_target TO <fs_target_field>.

              IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die die Wertemenge (Value Help) für ein gegebenes Data Element zur Laufzeit ermittelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr` und `get_ddic_field_info`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_value_help DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value_help_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_value_help_entry.
    TYPES: tt_value_help_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value_help_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_value_help_for_data_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_element TYPE clike " e.g., 'S_CARR_ID'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_value_help) TYPE tt_value_help_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_value_help IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_help_for_data_element.
    DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_elem_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_data_element ).
        DATA(ls_ddic_field_info) = lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_field_info( ).

        IF ls_ddic_field_info-domname IS NOT INITIAL.
          " Get fixed values from domain
          DATA(lt_dd07v) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.
          SELECT * FROM dd07v INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
            WHERE domname = ls_ddic_field_info-domname
            AND   as4local = 'A' " Active version
            ORDER BY valpos.

          LOOP AT lt_dd07v INTO DATA(ls_dd07v).
            APPEND VALUE ty_value_help_entry(
              key   = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l
              value = ls_dd07v-ddtext
            ) TO rt_value_help.
          ENDLOOP.
        ELSEIF ls_ddic_field_info-shlpname IS NOT INITIAL.
          " For search helps, it's more complex and would involve function modules like F4IF_FIELD_VALUE_REQUEST
          " or CL_F4_HELP_REQUEST. For this example, we'll just indicate it.
          APPEND VALUE ty_value_help_entry(
            key   = 'SEARCH_HELP'
            value = ls_ddic_field_info-shlpname
          ) TO rt_value_help.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error if data element not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_data1 TYPE any
        iv_data2 TYPE any

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_equal.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data( iv_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data( iv_data2 ).
    rb_equal = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_descr1->get_name( ) = lo_descr2->get_name( ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_string> ).
    <fs_string> = 'Dynamic String'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_string> exp = 'Dynamic String' ).

    DATA(lr_sflight) = lo_cut->create_data_reference( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_sflight ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight->* TO <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_sflight> ).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AZ'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = 'AZ' ).

    DATA(lr_invalid) = lo_cut->create_data_reference( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lr_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CREATE DATA` Anweisung mit `TYPE (type_name)` ermöglicht die dynamische Erstellung von Datenreferenzen auf beliebige Datentypen, was für generische Datenverarbeitung und Metaprogrammierung unerlässlich ist.
keywords: DYNAMIC, DATA REFERENCE, CREATE DATA, RTTI

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle Komponenten (Felder) einer gegebenen Struktur, inklusive deren Namen und Typen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_components` mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE clike " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_components = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components ( 
                                   name = ls_comp-name
                                   type = ls_comp-type_descr->get_name( ) 
                                 ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Hashed Table von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) und greife effizient auf einen Eintrag per Schlüssel zu.
hint: Nutze `TYPES HASHED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`. Verwende `VALUE #` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO rs_flight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere Flugdaten nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. Preis über einem Schwellenwert) und sammle die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Hashed Table.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` und `VALUE #` für die Initialisierung.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (

        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    rt_expensive_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer Hashed Table.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für 'AA' in SFLIGHTS, z.B. 2 Flüge mit Preis 100 und 200
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    " Der erwartete Wert hängt von den Testdaten ab. Hier ein Beispielwert.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 1000.00 ). " Beispielwert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'ZZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Art, Summen, Zählungen oder andere Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Hashed Table zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und ändere dessen Wert.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_dynamically.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    READ TABLE lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Hier müsste eine Typkonvertierung stattfinden, je nach Feldtyp
        " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, es ist ein Preis oder String-Feld
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
            rb_success = abap_true.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            rb_success = abap_false.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_price_dynamically FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_field_dynamically( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_field_name = 'PRICE' iv_new_value = '999.99' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_field_dynamically( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_new_value = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).

explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Felder einer internen Tabelle mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` ist eine mächtige Funktion für generische Verarbeitungen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn Feldnamen zur Laufzeit variieren können.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, ASSIGN COMPONENT, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Aktualisiere die Preise von Flügen in einer Hashed Table basierend auf einer externen Preistabelle, die nur die Schlüssel und den neuen Preis enthält.
hint: Nutze `FOR ... IN ...` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_price_update.
    TYPES: tt_price_update TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_price_update WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_price_updates TYPE tt_price_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    rt_updated_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      LET ls_update = it_price_updates[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ] IN
      ( COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN CORRESPONDING ty_sflight( ls_flight EXCEPT price ) price = ls_update-new_price
                ELSE ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_update_if_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_update=>tt_price_update(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '123.45' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->update_flight_prices( lt_updates ).

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '123.45' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_update_if_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_update=>tt_price_update(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250101' new_price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->update_flight_prices( lt_updates ).

    " Originalpreis sollte unverändert sein, wenn kein Update-Eintrag gefunden wurde
    DATA(ls_original_flight) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_original_flight-price exp = '471.00' ). " Annahme: Originalpreis von AA 0017 20250101 ist 471.00
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR ... IN ...`, `LET` und `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Aktualisierung von internen Tabellen. Der `COND` Operator wird verwendet, um bedingt Werte zuzuweisen, basierend darauf, ob ein passender Eintrag in der Update-Tabelle gefunden wurde.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, LET, CORRESPONDING, COND, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstelle einen Anwendungslog mit `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` und füge eine Erfolgs- und eine Fehlermeldung hinzu.

CLASS zcl_app_log_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_app_log_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_messages.
    ro_log_handle = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    " Erfolgsmeldung hinzufügen (Nachrichtenklasse BL, Nachricht 001: 'Application log &1 saved')
    ro_log_handle->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = 'BL'
        i_msgno = '001'
        i_msgv1 = 'Testlog_Success'
    ).

    " Fehlermeldung hinzufügen (Nachrichtenklasse BL, Nachricht 002: 'Error in application log &1')
    ro_log_handle->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = 'BL'
        i_msgno = '002'
        i_msgv1 = 'Testlog_Error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese alle Fehlermeldungen aus einem bestehenden Anwendungslog-Objekt aus und gib sie zurück.

CLASS zcl_app_log_read_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
             msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv1,
             msgv2 TYPE bal_msgv2,
             msgv3 TYPE bal_msgv3,
             msgv4 TYPE bal_msgv4,
           END OF ty_log_message.
    TYPES: tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_log_handle TYPE REF TO cl_bal_logobj
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.

CLASS zcl_app_log_read_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    CHECK io_log_handle IS BOUND.

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_log_handle->get_messages( ).

    rt_error_messages = FILTER #( lt_all_messages WHERE msgty = 'E' OR msgty = 'A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine Gruppierung von Flugdaten in einer Hashed Table durch und berechne für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ls_flight_entry-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight_entry-carrid
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

    " Annahme: 'AA' hat mindestens einen Flug in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_grouping=>ty_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_aa_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Funktion, die es ermöglicht, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchzuführen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstelle einen Anwendungslog mit einer komplexen Struktur, indem du Unterlogs verwendest, um zusammengehörige Meldungen zu gruppieren.

CLASS zcl_app_log_sublog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD create_log_with_sublogs.
    ro_main_log = NEW cl_bal_logobj(
      i_log_object    = 'ZTEST'
      i_log_subobject = 'SUBLOG_DEMO'
      i_external_number = |MAIN_{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|

    ).

    ro_main_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgid = 'BL'
        i_msgno = '001'

    ).

    DATA(lo_sublog1) = NEW cl_bal_logobj(
      i_log_object    = 'ZTEST'
      i_log_subobject = 'SUBLOG_DEMO'
      i_external_number = |SUB1_{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|
      i_log_header_text = 'Unterlog 1: Datenprüfung'
    ).
    lo_sublog1->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'BL' i_msgno = '004' i_msgv1 = 'Daten unvollständig' ).
    ro_main_log->add_sublog( lo_sublog1 ).

    DATA(lo_sublog2) = NEW cl_bal_logobj(
      i_log_object    = 'ZTEST'
      i_log_subobject = 'SUBLOG_DEMO'
      i_external_number = |SUB2_{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|
      i_log_header_text = 'Unterlog 2: Datenverarbeitung'
    ).
    lo_sublog2->add_message( i_msgty = 'S' i_msgid = 'BL' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Verarbeitung erfolgreich' ).
    ro_main_log->add_sublog( lo_sublog2 ).

    ro_main_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgid = 'BL'
        i_msgno = '001'
        i_msgv1 = 'Ende Hauptverarbeitung'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
