Instructions: Führe eine 'Left Outer Join'-ähnliche Operation zwischen einer Hashed Table von Flügen und einer Hashed Table von Fluggesellschaften durch, um Fluggesellschaftsnamen hinzuzufügen.
hint: Nutze `FOR ... IN ...` mit `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` für den Lookup.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES: tt_scarr_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE tt_flight_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_hashed(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price
      )
    ).

    DATA(lt_scarr) = VALUE tt_scarr_hashed(
      FOR ls_scarr IN scarr (
        carrid   = ls_scarr-carrid
        carrname = ls_scarr-carrname
      )
    ).

    rt_flights_with_name = VALUE tt_flight_with_name(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price  = ls_flight-price
        carrname = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_scarr[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) THEN lt_scarr[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-carrname ELSE '' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_flights_with_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_join_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_name( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ). " Annahme: 'AA' ist American Airlines
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_join_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_name( ).

    " Erstelle einen Dummy-Flug, der keine passende Fluggesellschaft hat
    DATA(ls_dummy_flight) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_join=>ty_flight_with_name(
      carrid = 'ZZ'
      connid = '9999'
      fldate = '20250101'
      price  = '100.00'
      carrname = ''
    ).
    APPEND ls_dummy_flight TO lt_result.

    DATA(ls_flight_zz) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_zz-carrname exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine 'Left Outer Join'-ähnliche Operation kann in modernem ABAP elegant mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und dem `COND`-Operator realisiert werden. `LINE_EXISTS` prüft effizient, ob ein passender Eintrag in der Lookup-Tabelle vorhanden ist, bevor auf dessen Felder zugegriffen wird, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, COND, LINE_EXISTS, JOIN, SFLIGHTS, SCARR

Instructions: Implementiere eine zentrale Fehlerbehandlung, die alle aufgetretenen Ausnahmen in einem `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` sammelt und am Ende des Prozesses anzeigt.
hint: Nutze `TRY ... CATCH ...` Blöcke und `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` zur Fehlerprotokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_central_error_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_with_error_logging
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_log_handle) TYPE REF TO cl_bal_logobj.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_central_error_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_error_logging.
    ro_log_handle = NEW cl_bal_logobj(
      i_log_object    = 'ZERR'
      i_log_subobject = 'CENTRAL'
      i_external_number = |ERR_{ sy-datum }{ sy-uzeit }|
      i_log_header_text = 'Zentrale Fehlerprotokollierung'
    ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_input_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zero_divide.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_input_value.
        ro_log_handle->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_msgty = 'S'
            i_msgid = 'BL'
            i_msgno = '001'
            i_msgv1 = |Berechnung erfolgreich: { lv_result }|
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        ro_log_handle->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_msgty = 'E'
            i_msgid = 'BL'
            i_msgno = '002'
            i_msgv1 = 'Arithmetischer Fehler'
            i_msgv2 = lx_arith->get_text( )
        ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        ro_log_handle->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_msgty = 'E'
            i_msgid = 'BL'
            i_msgno = '002'
            i_msgv1 = 'Unbekannter Fehler'
            i_msgv2 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Log speichern und anzeigen (optional)
    ro_log_handle->save( ).
    " cl_bal_log_display=>display_log( i_log_handle = ro_log_handle->get_log_handle( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_central_error_log( ).
    DATA(lo_log) = lo_cut->process_data_with_error_logging( 10 ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_central_error_log( ).
    DATA(lo_log) = lo_cut->process_data_with_error_logging( 0 ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'CX_SY_ZERO_DIVIDE' act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv2 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse, die Instanzen eines Nachrichtensammlers (`CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST`) bereitstellt und Nachrichten sammelt. Demonstrieren Sie das Hinzufügen verschiedener Nachrichtentypen (E, W, S).
hint: Nutzen Sie eine statische Factory-Methode und die Klasse `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_message_list RETURNING VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO cl_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_list.
    ro_message_list = NEW cl_reca_message_list( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO cl_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    ro_message_list = zcl_msg_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '001'
        i_msgv1 = 'Wert ist initial' ).
    ELSEIF iv_value < 0.
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'W'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '002'
        i_msgv1 = 'Wert ist negativ' ).
    ELSE.
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '003'
        i_msgv1 = 'Wert ist gültig' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die maximale Kapazität von Flügen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält, deren maximale Kapazität größer als 200 ist. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator und den `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( max_seats > 200 )
        ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid    = ls_sflight-connid
          max_seats = ls_sflight-max_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_selection.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_processor->get_large_capacity_flights( ).

    " Assert that all selected flights have max_seats > 200
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-max_seats > 200 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the number of entries is correct (assuming SFLIGHTS data)
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE max_seats > 200 INTO lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge direkt im Ausdruck, was zu sehr lesbarem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, WHERE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazitäten aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE type( INIT result = initial_value FOR ... NEXT result = result + value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT lv_sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_flight-max_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte für den Status ('Active' oder 'Inactive') hinzu, basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE #( ... )` und `COND` für die Statuszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid   = ls_sflight-connid
          seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
          status   = COND string(
                       WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc > 0 THEN 'Active'
                       ELSE 'Inactive' )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_enricher) = NEW zcl_flight_status_enricher( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_status) = lo_enricher->get_flights_with_status( ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_status INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seatsocc > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Active' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Inactive' ).

    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_with_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Transformation und Anreicherung von Daten.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid          = ls_group-carrid
        total_seats_occ = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT s = s + ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_sum.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_demo->get_flight_summaries( ).

    " Assert that the sum for a specific carrier is correct (example for 'LH')
    DATA(lv_expected_lh_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_lh_sum.

    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats_occ exp = lv_expected_lh_sum ).
    ELSE.
      " If 'LH' is not in SFLIGHTS, this test might need adjustment or a mock.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Carrier LH not found in SFLIGHTS or summary.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Ensure some summaries exist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summaries ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können Aggregationen für jede Gruppe direkt im Ausdruck durchgeführt werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem gegebenen String und finden Sie die Position des ersten Vorkommens.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` und `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_replaced_string TYPE string
        ev_first_occurrence_pos TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    ev_replaced_string = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_substring IN ev_replaced_string WITH iv_new_substring.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_new_substring IN ev_replaced_string MATCH OFFSET ev_first_occurrence_pos.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ev_first_occurrence_pos = -1. " Not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_find FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_find.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA: lv_replaced_string TYPE string,
          lv_first_occurrence_pos TYPE i.

    lo_cut->process_string(
      EXPORTING
        iv_input_string = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP'
        iv_old_substring = 'Hello'
        iv_new_substring = 'Hi'
      IMPORTING
        ev_replaced_string = lv_replaced_string
        ev_first_occurrence_pos = lv_first_occurrence_pos
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_replaced_string exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_first_occurrence_pos exp = 0 ).

    lo_cut->process_string(
      EXPORTING
        iv_input_string = 'NoMatchHere'
        iv_old_substring = 'XYZ'
        iv_new_substring = 'ABC'
      IMPORTING
        ev_replaced_string = lv_replaced_string
        ev_first_occurrence_pos = lv_first_occurrence_pos
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_first_occurrence_pos exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` und `FIND` sind effiziente und lesbare Anweisungen für die String-Manipulation. Sie sind Teil der modernen ABAP-Syntax für die Bearbeitung von Textdaten.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, FIND

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflights`.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze im Verhältnis zur Gesamtkapazität.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` und `SWITCH` für kompakte bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occupied TYPE s_seatsocc
        iv_seats_max      TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seats_max > 0 THEN ( iv_seats_occupied / iv_seats_max ) * 100 ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = SWITCH string( lv_occupancy_rate
                               WHEN BETWEEN 0 AND 50 THEN 'Low Occupancy'
                               WHEN BETWEEN 51 AND 80 THEN 'Medium Occupancy'
                               WHEN BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'High Occupancy'
                               ELSE 'Invalid Data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 50, 100 ) exp = 'Low Occupancy' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 70, 100 ) exp = 'Medium Occupancy' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 90, 100 ) exp = 'High Occupancy' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 110, 100 ) exp = 'Invalid Data' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0018'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Es ersetzt die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und `COLLECT` Anweisungen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Grouping, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahmebehandlung bei der Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit der vordefinierten Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = #( lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ) ) EXP = cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `TRY...CATCH` ist der Standardmechanismus zur Ausnahmebehandlung in modernem ABAP. Es ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung. `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` ist die moderne Art, Ausnahmen auszulösen.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Exceptions, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Fügen Sie Datensätze in eine interne Tabelle ein, wobei Duplikate basierend auf einem Schlüssel ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` oder `VALUE #( ... FOR ... )` mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_inserter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_unique_data
      IMPORTING
        it_new_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      CHANGING
        ct_target_table TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_inserter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_data.
    LOOP AT it_new_data INTO DATA(ls_new_entry).
      INSERT ls_new_entry INTO TABLE ct_target_table ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_unique FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_unique.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_table_inserter=>tt_data,
          lt_new_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_table_inserter=>ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'KEY1' value_field = 'Value A' ) TO lt_target.

    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'KEY1' value_field = 'Value B' ) TO lt_new_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'KEY2' value_field = 'Value C' ) TO lt_new_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_inserter( ).
    lo_cut->insert_unique_data( EXPORTING it_new_data = lt_new_data CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ key_field = 'KEY1' ]-value_field exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ key_field = 'KEY2' ]-value_field exp = 'Value C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` ist die effiziente und explizite Methode, um Datensätze in eine interne Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel einzufügen und Duplikate zu ignorieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Sorted oder Hashed Tables.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, Duplicates, Sorted Table

Instructions: Berechne den SHA256-Hash eines gegebenen Strings und gib ihn als XSTRING zurück. Demonstriere die Verwendung von BINARY-Daten in modernen ABAP-Kontexten.
hint: Nutze die Klasse `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` mit der Methode `CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sha256_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sha256_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_hash.
    rv_hash_xstring = cl_abap_message_digest=>calculate_hash_for_char(
      iv_algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
      iv_data      = iv_input_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_hash_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hash_calculation.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = NEW zcl_sha256_hasher( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = 'A591A6D40BF420404A04A3223523072C202180BAAEF55F63E3A96700596EE241'.
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_xstring) = lo_hasher->calculate_sha256_hash( lv_test_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_actual_hash_xstring msg = 'Hash should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = xco_cp_string=>string( lv_actual_hash_xstring )->to_upper( )->value( ) exp = lv_expected_hash msg = 'Calculated hash does not match expected hash' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` bietet eine moderne und sichere Möglichkeit, verschiedene Hash-Algorithmen (wie SHA256) direkt in ABAP zu verwenden. Die Methode `CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR` akzeptiert einen String und gibt einen XSTRING zurück, was die Verarbeitung von BINARY-Daten für Sicherheitszwecke vereinfacht. Die Umwandlung des XSTRING in einen Hex-String für den Vergleich erfolgt hier beispielhaft mit `xco_cp_string=>string( lv_actual_hash_xstring )->to_upper( )->value( )`, um die Interaktion mit XCO-Bibliotheken zu zeigen, die oft solche Konvertierungen erfordern.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, HASH, SHA256, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, XCO_CP

Instructions: Kodiere einen XSTRING in Base64 und dekodiere ihn zurück. Dies ist eine gängige Operation beim Umgang mit BINARY-Daten in Web-APIs.

CLASS zcl_base64_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        ix_input TYPE xstring

        iv_base64_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_decoded_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base64_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encode_xstring_to_base64.
    rv_base64_string = cl_http_utility=>encode_base64( ix_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decode_base64_to_xstring.
    rx_decoded_xstring = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( iv_base64_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_base64_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_base64_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_base64_converter( ).
    DATA(lx_original) = '48656C6C6F20576F726C64'X. "'Hello World' in hex
    DATA(lv_expected_base64) = 'SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ='.

    DATA(lv_encoded) = lo_converter->encode_xstring_to_base64( lx_original ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_encoded exp = lv_expected_base64 msg = 'Encoding failed' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `CL_HTTP_UTILITY`-Klasse bietet einfache und effiziente Methoden für die Base64-Kodierung und -Dekodierung von XSTRINGs. Dies ist eine Standardanforderung beim Senden oder Empfangen von BINARY-Daten (z.B. Bildern, Dokumenten) über HTTP-Protokolle, insbesondere in Cloud-Integrationen, wo Daten oft als Base64-kodierte Strings in JSON-Payloads eingebettet sind.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, BASE64, ENCODE, DECODE, CL_HTTP_UTILITY

Instructions: Führe einen HTTP GET-Request zu einer externen URL aus und verarbeite die Antwort. Dies simuliert die Art von Netzwerkaufruf, die `xco_cp` intern für Cloud-Interaktionen verwenden würde.
hint: Nutze die Klasse `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für den HTTP-Request.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_get_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_get_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        others     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        others = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        others = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
      rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Die Klasse `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` ist das Standardwerkzeug in ABAP für die Durchführung von HTTP-Anfragen. Sie ermöglicht die Kommunikation mit externen REST-Services, wie sie in Cloud-Szenarien üblich sind. `xco_cp` würde diese Funktionalität kapseln und eine vereinfachte API für Cloud-spezifische HTTP-Aufrufe bereitstellen. Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegenden Schritte: Client erstellen, Methode setzen, Anfrage senden, Antwort empfangen und verarbeiten.

Instructions: Sende einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem binären (XSTRING) Payload, z.B. ein Base64-kodiertes Bild, an eine externe URL. Dies ist relevant für Cloud-Services, die BINARY-Daten erwarten.
hint: Nutze `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für den Request und `CL_HTTP_UTILITY` für die Base64-Kodierung des XSTRING-Payloads.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_binary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_post_binary_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url        TYPE string
        ix_payload    TYPE xstring

CLASS zcl_http_post_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_post_binary_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
      rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_post_binary_request.

    TRY.

      CATCH cx_static_check.

explanation: Das Senden von BINARY-Daten (XSTRING) in einem HTTP POST-Request ist eine häufige Anforderung für Cloud-Services, z.B. beim Hochladen von Dateien. `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` ermöglicht das Setzen des XSTRING-Payloads direkt mit `set_data()`. Der `Content-Type` Header ist entscheidend, um dem Server mitzuteilen, welche Art von Daten gesendet wird. `xco_cp` würde diese Komplexität abstrahieren und eine einfachere Schnittstelle für solche Upload-Szenarien bieten.

Instructions: Konkateniere eine Tabelle von XSTRINGs zu einem einzelnen XSTRING unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Dies demonstriert moderne Aggregation von BINARY-Daten.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einem initialen XSTRING-Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_xstring_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_xstrings
      IMPORTING
        it_xstrings TYPE ty_xstring_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_concatenated) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_xstrings.
    rx_concatenated = REDUCE xstring(
      INIT result = ''X
      FOR  xstr IN it_xstrings
      NEXT result = result && xstr
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_xstring_reduction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_reduction.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_xstring_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_test_xstrings) = VALUE zcl_xstring_reducer=>ty_xstring_table(
      ( '01'X )
      ( '02'X )
      ( '03'X )
    ).
    DATA(lx_expected) = '010203'X.

    DATA(lx_actual) = lo_reducer->concatenate_xstrings( lt_test_xstrings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_actual exp = lx_expected msg = 'XSTRING reduction failed' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_xstrings) = VALUE zcl_xstring_reducer=>ty_xstring_table( ).
    DATA(lx_empty_result) = lo_reducer->concatenate_xstrings( lt_empty_xstrings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_empty_result exp = ''X msg = 'Empty table reduction failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.40), um interne Tabellen zu einem einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um eine Tabelle von XSTRINGs effizient zu einem einzigen XSTRING zu verketten. Die `INIT`-Klausel setzt den Startwert, und die `NEXT`-Klausel definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies ist eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu traditionellen Schleifen.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Extrahiere einen Wert aus einem JSON-String basierend auf einem dynamisch übergebenen Pfad. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der JSON-Antworten von Cloud-APIs variieren kann und `xco_cp` solche Pfadzugriffe vereinfachen würde.
hint: Nutze die Klasse `CL_ABAP_JSON_UTILITIES` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit dynamischem Pfad. Hier wird `CL_ABAP_JSON_UTILITIES` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_path_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_by_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_json_path   TYPE string "e.g., '$.data.item[0].value'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_path_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_by_path.
    DATA: lo_json_parser TYPE REF TO cl_abap_json_parser,
          lo_json_node   TYPE REF TO if_abap_json_node.

    lo_json_parser = cl_abap_json_parser=>create(
      iv_json = iv_json_string
    ).

    lo_json_node = lo_json_parser->parse( ).

    TRY.
        lo_json_node = lo_json_node->get_node_by_path( iv_json_path ).
        rv_value = lo_json_node->get_string( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_json_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_json_path_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_path FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_path_access.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_json_path_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_json_data) = '{"header":{"version":"1.0"},"data":[{"id":1,"value":"first"},{"id":2,"value":"second"}]} '.

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_accessor->get_value_by_path( iv_json_string = lv_json_data iv_json_path = '$.data[0].value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'first' msg = 'Value for data[0].value mismatch' ).

    lv_value = lo_accessor->get_value_by_path( iv_json_string = lv_json_data iv_json_path = '$.header.version' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = '1.0' msg = 'Value for header.version mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_path.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_json_path_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_json_data) = '{"key":"value"}'.

    TRY.
        lo_accessor->get_value_by_path( iv_json_string = lv_json_data iv_json_path = '$.nonexistent' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_json_error for invalid path' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_json_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for invalid path' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_JSON_PARSER` und die zugehörigen Interfaces (`IF_ABAP_JSON_NODE`) bieten eine robuste Möglichkeit, JSON-Strings zu parsen und über Pfade auf einzelne Werte zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Struktur von JSON-Antworten dynamisch ist oder nur bestimmte Teile der Antwort benötigt werden. `xco_cp` würde solche Pfadzugriffe für Cloud-API-Antworten vereinfachen und eine typsichere Schnittstelle bieten, aber die hier gezeigte Methode ist die zugrunde liegende Standard-ABAP-Funktionalität.
keywords: XCO_CP, JSON, DYNAMIC, PATH, API, CL_ABAP_JSON_PARSER, CLOUD

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, die ein XSTRING-Feld enthalten, basierend auf einem Teil des XSTRING-Inhalts. Nutze den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwende den `FILTER`-Operator und die `CONTAINS`-Funktion für XSTRINGs (oder einen Vergleich mit Wildcards, falls `CONTAINS` nicht direkt für XSTRING verfügbar ist, hier direkter Vergleich).
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             content TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_xstring_content
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE ty_data_table
        ix_search_term TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_xstring_content.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE content = ix_search_term ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_xstring_filtering FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_filtering.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_xstring_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_xstring_filter=>ty_data_table(
      ( id = 1 content = '010203'X )
      ( id = 2 content = '040506'X )
      ( id = 3 content = '010203'X )
      ( id = 4 content = '070809'X )
    ).
    DATA(lx_search) = '010203'X.

    DATA(lt_actual_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_by_xstring_content( it_data = lt_test_data ix_search_term = lx_search ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'First filtered ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_filtered[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 msg = 'Second filtered ID mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In diesem Beispiel wird eine Tabelle von Strukturen, die ein XSTRING-Feld enthalten, basierend auf dem exakten XSTRING-Inhalt gefiltert. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. Für komplexere Teilstring-Suchen in XSTRINGs müsste man ggf. eine Hilfsmethode oder eine Schleife verwenden, da `CONTAINS` nicht direkt für XSTRINGs verfügbar ist.

Anstatt `APPEND` oder `INSERT` in einer Schleife zu verwenden, können alle Einträge direkt bei der Deklaration oder Zuweisung angegeben werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für kleine, feste Datenmengen oder für Testdaten und verbessert die Code-Klarheit erheblich, auch für Tabellen, die BINARY-Daten (XSTRING) enthalten.

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String in einen XSTRING und umgekehrt, unter Berücksichtigung der Codierung. Dies ist oft notwendig, wenn Textdaten als BINARY-Payloads in Cloud-APIs gesendet oder empfangen werden und `xco_cp` solche Konvertierungen intern handhabt.
hint: Nutze die Klasse `CL_ABAP_ENCODING` oder `CL_ABAP_CONV_CODEPAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_xstring_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.

    METHODS xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        ix_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_xstring_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD string_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out(
      codepage = iv_codepage
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        data   = iv_string
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rx_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD xstring_to_string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in(
      codepage = iv_codepage
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        buffer = ix_xstring
      IMPORTING
        data   = rv_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_string_xstring_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_xstring_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_string_xstring_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hallo Welt!'.
    DATA(lv_codepage) = 'UTF-8'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lx_converted_xstring) = lo_converter->string_to_xstring( iv_string = lv_original_string iv_codepage = lv_codepage ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_converted_xstring msg = 'XSTRING should not be initial' ).

        DATA(lv_back_to_string) = lo_converter->xstring_to_string( ix_xstring = lx_converted_xstring iv_codepage = lv_codepage ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back_to_string exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Conversion back to string failed' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Conversion error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_CONV_CODEPAGE` (oder `CL_ABAP_ENCODING` für einfachere Fälle) sind essenziell für die Umwandlung zwischen Text-Strings und BINARY-XSTRINGs unter Angabe einer Codepage. Dies ist ein häufiges Szenario in der Cloud-Integration, wo Textdaten (z.B. JSON-Payloads) oft als XSTRINGs über HTTP gesendet oder empfangen werden müssen. `xco_cp` würde diese Konvertierungen im Hintergrund durchführen, um die Handhabung für den Entwickler zu vereinfachen.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, STRING, CONVERSION, CODEPAGE, CL_ABAP_CONV_CODEPAGE, XCO_CP

Instructions: Verwende `xco_cp_http=>client` (simuliert) um einen HTTP-Client zu erstellen und Header zu setzen. Dies zeigt die Vorbereitung für einen Cloud-API-Aufruf.
hint: Simuliere die Verwendung von `xco_cp_http=>client` durch die direkte Nutzung von `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` und das Setzen von Headern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_http_client_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_set_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        it_headers TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_http_client) TYPE REF TO if_http_client
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_http_client_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_headers.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = ro_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        others     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_headers INTO DATA(lv_header_line).

Instructions: Verwende `xco_cp_http=>client` (simuliert) um einen HTTP-Client zu erstellen und einen JSON-Payload als XSTRING zu senden. Dies kombiniert BINARY-Daten mit Cloud-Kommunikation.
hint: Nutze `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für den Request und `CL_ABAP_CONV_CODEPAGE` zur Umwandlung des JSON-Strings in XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS post_json_payload
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_payload.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lx_json_payload TYPE xstring,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    " Convert JSON string to XSTRING (UTF-8)
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
        lo_conv->convert( EXPORTING data = iv_json_string IMPORTING buffer = lx_json_payload ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_conv_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        others     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_data( lx_json_payload ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        others = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        others = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
      rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `xco_cp_http=>client` (simuliert) um einen HTTP-Client zu erstellen und einen Fehlerfall bei der HTTP-Kommunikation abzufangen. Dies ist wichtig für robuste Cloud-Integrationen.
hint: Nutze `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` und fange die Ausnahmen `CX_HTTP_CLIENT_ERROR` oder `CX_HTTP_DESTINATION_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_http_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_faulty_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_http_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_faulty_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url        = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client     = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            others     = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            others = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            others = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 400.
          rv_error_message = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_error_message = 'Request successful (unexpected for faulty URL)'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close_connection( ).

      CATCH cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_client_error).
        rv_error_message = |HTTP Client Error: { lx_client_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_destination_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rv_error_message = |HTTP Destination Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_error).
        rv_error_message = |General HTTP Error: { lx_static_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_last_day_of_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_last_day( ).
    DATA(lv_result_date) = lo_cut->get_last_day_of_current_month( ).

    " Calculate expected last day of current month manually for assertion
    DATA(lv_year)  TYPE sy-year  VALUE sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_month) TYPE sy-monat VALUE sy-datum+4(2).
    DATA(lv_day)   TYPE sy-day   VALUE '01'.
    DATA(lv_first_day_next_month) TYPE sy-datum.

    IF lv_month = '12'.
      lv_year = lv_year + 1.
      lv_month = '01'.
    ELSE.
      lv_month = lv_month + 1.
    ENDIF.
    CONCATENATE lv_year lv_month lv_day INTO lv_first_day_next_month.
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = lv_first_day_next_month - 1.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should be the last day of the current month' act = lv_result_date exp = lv_expected_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_next_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_month_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_first_day_current_month) = cl_reca_date=>get_first_day_of_month( sy-datum ).
    DATA(lv_first_day_next_month) = cl_reca_date=>add_months( id_date = lv_first_day_current_month id_months = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_last_day_next_month) = cl_reca_date=>get_last_day_of_month( lv_first_day_next_month ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate >= lv_first_day_next_month AND fldate <= lv_last_day_next_month ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität haben und deren Flugdatum in einem gegebenen Zeitraum liegt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der passenden Flüge zu zählen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE` und Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_capacity_and_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        id_start_date   TYPE sy-datum
        id_end_date     TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_capacity_and_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate seatsocc seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsmax >= iv_min_capacity
                                                               AND fldate >= id_start_date
                                                               AND fldate <= id_end_date )
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_start_date) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_end_date) = sy-datum + 365.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_capacity_and_date( iv_min_capacity = 100 id_start_date = lv_start_date id_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should find some flights' act = xsdbool( lv_result > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem TXT-Anhang, dessen Inhalt aus einer internen Tabelle stammt. Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_utilities` für die Anlage und den Versand.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_utilities=>add_attachment_from_string` oder ähnliche Methoden, um den Anhang zu erstellen und dann `send_mail`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_with_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_text_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE string
        it_attachment_lines TYPE string_table
        iv_attachment_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_with_text_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_text_attachment.
    DATA: lo_bcs TYPE REF TO cl_bcs.
    DATA: lo_document TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lv_body TYPE string VALUE 'Siehe Anhang für Details.'.

    TRY.
        " Umwandlung der String-Tabelle in einen einzelnen String und dann in XSTRING
        DATA(lv_attachment_string) = REDUCE string(
            INIT s = ||
            FOR <line> IN it_attachment_lines
            NEXT s = |{ s }{ <line> }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
        ).
        lv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( lv_attachment_string ).

        " Dokument erstellen
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = lv_body
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        " Anhang hinzufügen
        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
          i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_xstring )
          i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
          i_xstring            = lv_xstring
        ).

        lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        " Empfänger hinzufügen
        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
          iv_recipient_email
        ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_bcs->send( ).

        COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs_ex).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_ex->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie den Sendestatus einer über BCS versendeten E-Mail. Nutzen Sie die Funktionalität, um den Status einer versendeten Nachricht zu ermitteln.
hint: Nach dem Senden liefert `cl_bcs->send` einen Status. Alternativ kann mittels Nachrichten-ID der Status später abgefragt werden (obwohl `cl_bcs_utilities` hier meist nur Hilfsfunktionen bietet, ist das Prinzip relevant).
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_check_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_status,
             object_id TYPE soobj_id,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message_status.

    METHODS send_and_get_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE string
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status)   TYPE ty_message_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_check_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_and_get_status.
    DATA: lo_bcs TYPE REF TO cl_bcs.
    DATA: lo_document TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs.
    DATA: lv_object_id TYPE soobj_id.

    CLEAR rs_status.

    TRY.
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = iv_body
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).
        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
        lo_bcs->send( ).

        COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

        " Nach dem COMMIT WORK ist der Object_ID des versendeten Dokuments verfügbar
        lv_object_id = lo_bcs->get_document_id( ).
        rs_status-object_id = lv_object_id.

        " Für einen echten Status müssen Sie möglicherweise eine Query auf SOST/SOOD durchführen
        " oder Funktionen wie SO_DOCUMENT_READ_API1 verwenden.
        " Hier eine vereinfachte Annahme, dass der Send-Aufruf erfolgreich war.
        rs_status-status = |Sent (ID: { lv_object_id })|.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs_ex).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_ex->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rs_status-status = |Error: { lx_bcs_ex->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_send_and_get_status FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_and_get_status.
    DATA(lo_sender) = NEW zcl_bcs_check_status( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'status_test@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_subject) = |Status Check Email|.
    DATA(lv_body) = |This email is for status checking.|.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_sender->send_and_get_status(
      iv_recipient_email = lv_recipient
      iv_subject = lv_subject
      iv_body = lv_body
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Object ID should not be initial after sending' act = ls_result-object_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( msg = 'Status should indicate sent' act = ls_result-status exp = 'Sent' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zwar bietet `cl_bcs_utilities` selbst keine direkte Statusabfrage für bereits versendete Nachrichten, aber nach dem Aufruf von `cl_bcs->send` kann die `object_id` des Dokuments ermittelt werden. Diese ID ist dann der Schlüssel, um den tatsächlichen Versandstatus in Transaktionen wie SOST oder über andere APIs zu prüfen. Das Beispiel zeigt, wie die ID nach dem Versand zur weiteren Verarbeitung abgerufen wird. Realistische Statusabfragen würden externe Tools oder weitere API-Aufrufe (z.B. auf der Basis der `object_id`) erfordern, was hier aus Komplexitätsgründen abstrahiert wird.
keywords: BCS, E-Mail, Status, object_id, SOST, cl_bcs

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             file_name TYPE sood_objdes,
             file_type TYPE sood_objtp,

CLASS zcl_gos_download_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attachment_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid

CLASS zcl_gos_download_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_content.
    DATA: lt_content TYPE cl_gos_attachment_query=>ty_content_tab.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query(
          ip_object_type = iv_object_type
          ip_object_key  = iv_object_key
        ).

        lo_gos_query->get_attachment_content(
          EXPORTING
            ip_srm_loio_guid = iv_srm_loio_guid
          IMPORTING
            ep_content       = lt_content
        ).

        " Konvertiere CL_GOS_ATTACHMENT_QUERY=>ty_content_tab (XSTRING's) zu einem einzelnen XSTRING
        rv_xstring = REDUCE xstring(
            INIT x = ''
            FOR <xline> IN lt_content
            NEXT x = x && <xline>
        ).

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Leeres XSTRING im Fehlerfall
        rv_xstring = ''_X.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_metadata DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_metadata,
             srm_loio_guid TYPE go_loio_guid, " Global Unique ID des logischen Objekts
             file_name     TYPE sood_objdes,  " Dateiname (Beschreibung)
             file_type     TYPE sood_objtp,   " Dateityp (z.B. PDF, XLS)
             file_size     TYPE sood_objlen,  " Dateigröße in Bytes

             created_at    TYPE timestampl,   " Erstellungszeitpunkt

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_metadata IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_attachment_metadata.
    DATA: lt_all_attachments TYPE cl_gos_attachment_query=>ty_attachment_tab.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query(
          ip_object_type = iv_object_type

        lt_all_attachments = lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list( ).

                                       file_type     = <att>-file_type

                                       created_at    = <att>-created_at ) ).

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_summary,
             file_name     TYPE sood_objdes,
             created_at    TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_summary.
    TYPES: ty_attachment_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfgrabid
        iv_date_from   TYPE datn
        iv_date_to     TYPE datn
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_summary) TYPE ty_attachment_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments_by_date.
    DATA: lt_all_attachments TYPE cl_gos_attachment_query=>ty_attachment_tab.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query(
          ip_object_type = iv_object_type
          ip_object_key  = iv_object_key
        ).

        lt_all_attachments = lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list( ).

        " Timestamp-Umgrenzungen für den Vergleich erstellen
        DATA(lv_ts_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_timestamp_from_date_and_time(
          iv_date = iv_date_from
          iv_time = '000000'
        ).
        DATA(lv_ts_to) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_timestamp_from_date_and_time(
          iv_date = iv_date_to
          iv_time = '235959'
        ).

        " Filtern und Mappen in einem Schritt mit FOR ... IN ... WHERE
        rt_filtered_summary = VALUE #( FOR <att> IN lt_all_attachments
                                      WHERE ( created_at BETWEEN lv_ts_from AND lv_ts_to )
                                      ( file_name  = <att>-file_name
                                        created_at = <att>-created_at ) ).

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Leere Tabelle im Fehlerfall
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Flugpreis über 500 liegt. Protokollieren Sie jeden gefundenen Flug und eine Zusammenfassung im Application Log (BAL).
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit einer `WHERE` Klausel und einer geschachtelten `IF` Anweisung für die Bedingungen. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG` zum Protokollieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_log_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_log_flights.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    " Create a new Application Log object
    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZFLIGHT' subobject = 'FILTER' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight_raw
        WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND price > 500 )
        ( 
          " Nested logic: Log message based on condition
          IF flight-currency = 'EUR'.
            cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
              EXPORTING
                i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
                i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                                  msgty = 'I'
                                  msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  msgno = '000'
                                  msgv1 = |Flug { flight-carrid } { flight-connid } von { flight-cityfrom } gefunden.|
                                  msgv2 = |Preis: { flight-price } { flight-currency }|
                                )
            ).
          ELSE.
            cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
              EXPORTING
                i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
                i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                                  msgty = 'W'
                                  msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
                                  msgno = '000'
                                  msgv1 = |Flug { flight-carrid } { flight-connid } von { flight-cityfrom } gefunden (andere Währung).|
                                  msgv2 = |Preis: { flight-price } { flight-currency }|
                                )
            ).
          ENDIF.
          flight
        )
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'S'
                          msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
                          msgno = '000'
                          msgv1 = |Filterung abgeschlossen. { lines( rt_filtered_flights ) } Flüge gefunden.|
                        )
    ).

    " Save the log
    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             total_price TYPE sflight-price,

    TYPES tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_log_prices
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_log_prices.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZFLIGHT' subobject = 'AGGREGATE' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    rt_aggregated_prices = REDUCE #( 
      INIT totals = VALUE tt_carrier_total()
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight_raw BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      NEXT totals = VALUE tt_carrier_total(
        BASE totals
        (
          carrid      = carrid
          total_price = REDUCE #( 
                          INIT sum_price = 0
                          FOR member IN GROUP
                          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
                        )
        )
      )
    ).

    LOOP AT rt_aggregated_prices INTO DATA(ls_total).
      cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
          i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                            msgty = 'I'
                            msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
                            msgno = '001'
                            msgv1 = |Fluggesellschaft { ls_total-carrid }: Gesamtpreis { ls_total-total_price }|
                          )
      ).
      IF ls_total-total_price > 10000.
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'W'
                              msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
                              msgno = '002'
                              msgv1 = |Warnung: Gesamtpreis für { ls_total-carrid } übersteigt 10000.|
                            )
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'S'
                          msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
                          msgno = '000'
                          msgv1 = |Aggregation abgeschlossen. { lines( rt_aggregated_prices ) } Fluggesellschaften verarbeitet.|
                        )
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Definieren Sie eine tiefe Struktur mit einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `FOR` Expressions und `CL_BAL_LOG` für die Protokollierung der geschachtelten Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_nested_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES tt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_bookings,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookings TYPE tt_bookings,
           END OF ty_flight_with_bookings.
    TYPES tt_flights_with_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_bookings WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_nested_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flights_with_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_nested_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_nested_data.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZNESTED' subobject = 'DATA' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS " Limit for example
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    rt_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
      ( 
        carrid   = flight_raw-carrid,
        connid   = flight_raw-connid,
        fldate   = flight_raw-fldate,
        bookings = VALUE tt_bookings(
          FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 2 " Simulate 2 bookings per flight
          ( 
            bookid   = |{ flight_raw-carrid }{ flight_raw-connid }{ i }|,
            custtype = COND string( WHEN i = 1 THEN 'B' ELSE 'E' )
          )
        )
      )
    ).

    LOOP AT rt_data INTO DATA(ls_flight_data).
      cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
          i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                            msgty = 'I'
                            msgid = 'ZNESTED'
                            msgno = '001'
                            msgv1 = |Flug { ls_flight_data-carrid } { ls_flight_data-connid } verarbeitet.|
                            msgv2 = |Buchungen: { lines( ls_flight_data-bookings ) }|
                          )
      ).
      LOOP AT ls_flight_data-bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking).
        IF ls_booking-custtype IS INITIAL.
          cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
            EXPORTING
              i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
              i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                                msgty = 'E'
                                msgid = 'ZNESTED'
                                msgno = '002'
                                msgv1 = |Fehler: Buchung { ls_booking-bookid } hat keinen Kundentyp.|
                              )
          ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'S'
                          msgid = 'ZNESTED'
                          msgno = '000'
                          msgv1 = |Verarbeitung geschachtelter Daten abgeschlossen.|
                        )
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (Abflugort, Zielort, Datum). Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `COND` Ausdrücke. Protokollieren Sie den ermittelten Status im Application Log (BAL).
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `COND` Expression mit mehreren `WHEN` Bedingungen, die wiederum weitere `COND` Ausdrücke enthalten können. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flight_status TYPE string.

    METHODS get_flight_status_and_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE ty_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_and_log.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZCOND' subobject = 'FLIGHT' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    rv_status = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' THEN
        COND #( 
          WHEN iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK' THEN
            COND #( 
              WHEN iv_fldate < sy-datum THEN 'ABGESCHLOSSEN'
              WHEN iv_fldate = sy-datum THEN 'HEUTE'
              ELSE 'GEPLANT'
            )
          WHEN iv_cityto = 'LONDON' THEN 'EUROPA_FLUG'
          ELSE 'UNBEKANNTES_ZIEL'
        )
      WHEN iv_cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' THEN 'USA_ABFLUG'
      ELSE 'UNBEKANNTER_ABFLUG'
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'I'
                          msgid = 'ZCOND'
                          msgno = '001'
                          msgv1 = |Flug von { iv_cityfrom } nach { iv_cityto } am { iv_fldate }|
                          msgv2 = |Status: { rv_status }|
                        )
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_nested_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status_and_log( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK' iv_fldate = sy-datum - 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'ABGESCHLOSSEN' ).

    lv_status = lo_cut->get_flight_status_and_log( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK' iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'HEUTE' ).

    lv_status = lo_cut->get_flight_status_and_log( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_cityto = 'LONDON' iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'EUROPA_FLUG' ).

    lv_status = lo_cut->get_flight_status_and_log( iv_cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' iv_cityto = 'FRANKFURT' iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'USA_ABFLUG' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Der Status eines Fluges wird basierend auf mehreren geschachtelten Bedingungen ermittelt. Die Integration mit `CL_BAL_LOG` sorgt dafür, dass der ermittelte Status zusammen mit den Eingabeparametern im Application Log protokolliert wird, was die Nachvollziehbarkeit der Statusbestimmung verbessert.
