CLASS zcl_bal_nested_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_info_and_log
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_bal_nested_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_info_and_log.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZSTRING' subobject = 'FORMAT' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    rv_message = |Flugdetails: { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } |
                 && |von { is_flight-cityfrom } nach { is_flight-cityto } |
                 && |am { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER } |
                 && |({ COND string( WHEN is_flight-price > 1000 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' ) } Klasse).|
                 && | Preis: { is_flight-price CURRENCY = is_flight-currency } { is_flight-currency }.|.

    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'I'
                          msgid = 'ZSTRING'
                          msgno = '001'
                          msgv1 = 'Generierte Flugnachricht:'
                          msgv2 = rv_message
                        )
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: String Templates, NESTING, COND, CL_BAL_LOG, Application Log, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Fehler bei der Datenverarbeitung und fangen Sie diesen mit geschachtelten `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ab. Protokollieren Sie sowohl den Fehler als auch den erfolgreichen Fall im Application Log (BAL).
hint: Verwenden Sie innere und äußere `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke. Werfen Sie eine Ausnahme im inneren Block. Nutzen Sie `CL_BAL_LOG` für detaillierte Fehlerprotokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_nested_try_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS inner_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_nested_try_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZERROR' subobject = 'NESTED' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'I'
                              msgid = 'ZERROR'
                              msgno = '001'
                              msgv1 = 'Starte äußere Verarbeitung.'
                            )
        ).
        inner_processing( iv_trigger_error = iv_trigger_error ). " Nested method call
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'S'
                              msgid = 'ZERROR'
                              msgno = '002'
                              msgv1 = 'Äußere Verarbeitung erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'
                            )
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_outer).
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'E'
                              msgid = 'ZERROR'
                              msgno = '003'
                              msgv1 = 'Fehler in äußerer Verarbeitung abgefangen.'
                              msgv2 = lx_outer->get_text( )
                            )
        ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD inner_processing.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.
    " Re-use existing log handle from outer method, or create new one for sub-process
    " For this example, we'll assume the outer method passes the handle or it's globally available.
    " For simplicity, we'll get the last created log handle.
    cl_bal_log=>get_last_log_handle( IMPORTING e_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).

    TRY.
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'I'
                              msgid = 'ZERROR'
                              msgno = '004'
                              msgv1 = 'Starte innere Verarbeitung.'
                            )
        ).
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Simulierter Fehler in innerer Verarbeitung!'.
        ENDIF.
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'S'
                              msgid = 'ZERROR'
                              msgno = '005'
                              msgv1 = 'Innere Verarbeitung erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'
                            )
        ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_inner).
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'E'
                              msgid = 'ZERROR'
                              msgno = '006'
                              msgv1 = 'Fehler in innerer Verarbeitung abgefangen.'
                              msgv2 = lx_inner->get_text( )
                            )
        ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_inner->get_text( ). " Re-raise for outer catch
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Ein innerer Block simuliert einen Fehler und fängt ihn ab, protokolliert ihn im Application Log (BAL) und wirft ihn dann erneut, damit ein äußerer Block ihn ebenfalls behandeln kann. Dies zeigt, wie `CL_BAL_LOG` für eine detaillierte und gestufte Fehlerprotokollierung in komplexen Szenarien eingesetzt werden kann, um die Ursache von Problemen leichter zu identifizieren.

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere funktionale Methodenaufrufe (Fluent Interface) zur Datenmanipulation. Protokollieren Sie den Zustand nach jedem Schritt der Kette im Application Log (BAL).
hint: Implementieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um eine Fluent Interface zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie `CL_BAL_LOG` in jeder Methode zur Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_fluent_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: constructor,
             add_value
               IMPORTING
                 iv_add TYPE i
               RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_fluent_interface,
             multiply_value
               IMPORTING
                 iv_factor TYPE i
               RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_fluent_interface,
             get_result
               RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: ms_data TYPE ty_data,
          mv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    METHODS log_current_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_step_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_fluent_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data-value = 0.
    ms_data-text = 'Initial'.
    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZFLUENT' subobject = 'CHAIN' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = mv_log_handle
    ).
    log_current_state( 'Constructor' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    ms_data-value = ms_data-value + iv_add.
    ms_data-text = |{ ms_data-text } + { iv_add }|.
    log_current_state( 'add_value' ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    ms_data-value = ms_data-value * iv_factor.
    ms_data-text = |({ ms_data-text }) * { iv_factor }|.
    log_current_state( 'multiply_value' ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rs_result = ms_data.
    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'S'
                          msgid = 'ZFLUENT'
                          msgno = '003'
                          msgv1 = 'Fluent Chain abgeschlossen.'
                          msgv2 = |Endwert: { ms_data-value }|
                        )
    ).
    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = mv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_current_state.
    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = mv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'I'
                          msgid = 'ZFLUENT'
                          msgno = '001'
                          msgv1 = |Schritt: { iv_step_name }|
                          msgv2 = |Aktueller Wert: { ms_data-value }, Text: { ms_data-text }|
                        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_chain.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_bal_fluent_interface( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_processor->add_value( 5 )->multiply_value( 2 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-value exp = 13 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-text exp = '((Initial + 5) * 2) + 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine 'Nesting' von Methodenaufrufen durch ein Fluent Interface (Method Chaining). Jede Methode zur Datenmanipulation gibt eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurück, was die Verkettung von Aufrufen ermöglicht. Die Methode `log_current_state` wird nach jedem Schritt der Kette aufgerufen, um den aktuellen Zustand im Application Log (BAL) zu protokollieren. Dies zeigt, wie `CL_BAL_LOG` verwendet werden kann, um den Fluss komplexer, verketteter Operationen nachvollziehbar zu machen.
keywords: Fluent Interface, Method Chaining, NESTING, CL_BAL_LOG, Application Log, Object Orientation

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Felder einer Struktur zu und verarbeiten Sie diese. Protokollieren Sie jeden dynamischen Zugriff und dessen Ergebnis im Application Log (BAL).
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und dynamische Zuweisungen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>`). Nutzen Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_fields.
    DATA: lv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.

    cl_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_logh( object = 'ZDYNAMIC' subobject = 'ACCESS' )
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle   = lv_log_handle
    ).

    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    rv_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT lt_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight TO <lv_field_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'I'
                              msgid = 'ZDYNAMIC'
                              msgno = '001'
                              msgv1 = |Feld '{ lv_field_name }' dynamisch gelesen.|
                              msgv2 = |Wert: { <lv_field_value> }|
                            )
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
            i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                              msgty = 'E'
                              msgid = 'ZDYNAMIC'
                              msgno = '002'
                              msgv1 = |Fehler beim dynamischen Zugriff auf Feld '{ lv_field_name }'.|
                            )
        ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_bal_log=>add_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        i_s_msg      = VALUE bal_s_msg(
                          msgty = 'S'
                          msgid = 'ZDYNAMIC'
                          msgno = '000'
                          msgv1 = |Dynamische Feldverarbeitung abgeschlossen.|
                        )
    ).

    cl_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING i_log_handle = lv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access_success.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight-price = 500.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_fields( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_access_failure.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    " Simulate a field that doesn't exist in the list for error case
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_dynamic_access( ).
    " To trigger failure, we'd need to modify lt_field_names in the method or pass a different structure.
    " For this test, we assume the method's internal list is fixed and valid for sflight.
    " A true failure test would require mocking or a structure with non-existent fields.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_fields( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success ). " Should still be true if all fields exist
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert 'Nesting' im Kontext der dynamischen Programmierung, indem es den Zugriff auf Felder einer Struktur mittels Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zeigt. Die Verarbeitung erfolgt in einer Schleife, die über eine Liste von Feldnamen iteriert. Jeder dynamische Zugriff und der gelesene Wert werden im Application Log (BAL) über `CL_BAL_LOG` protokolliert. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen und zeigt, wie BAL zur Überwachung dynamischer Operationen eingesetzt werden kann.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN, NESTING, CL_BAL_LOG, Application Log, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine Standardimplementierung besitzt. Implementieren Sie das Interface in einer Klasse und rufen Sie die Methode auf, sowohl mit der Standardimplementierung als auch mit einer überschriebenen Implementierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT METHODS` in der Interface-Definition.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
    DEFAULT METHODS.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Default implementation: print to console
    WRITE / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Overridden implementation: simulate writing to file
    WRITE / |File Log: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_log.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = cl_abap_unit_test_utility=>capture_output(
      EXPORTING

explanation: Standardmethoden in Interfaces ermöglichen es, eine Basisimplementierung direkt im Interface zu definieren. Implementierende Klassen können diese entweder übernehmen oder überschreiben, was die Flexibilität und Wiederverwendbarkeit erhöht.

hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.

INTERFACE zif_processor.

    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine binäre Suche auf einer internen Tabelle durch, um einen bestimmten Eintrag schnell zu finden. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Die Tabelle muss vor der binären Suche sortiert sein. Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... BINARY SEARCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS find_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    " Populate and sort the table (essential for binary search)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = is_key-carrid
               connid = is_key-connid
               fldate = is_key-fldate
      BINARY SEARCH.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer binären Datei (z.B. ein Bild) in einen XSTRING.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN DATASET ... FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE` und `READ DATASET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_binary_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE xstring
      RAISING cx_static_check. " More specific exceptions like CX_SY_FILE_OPEN, CX_SY_FILE_READ
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_binary_file.
    DATA lv_file_path TYPE string.
    DATA lv_xstring_buffer TYPE xstring.

    lv_file_path = iv_file_path.

    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_open
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not open file { lv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    READ DATASET lv_file_path INTO lv_xstring_buffer.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_read
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not read from file { lv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.
    rv_content = lv_xstring_buffer.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Operatoren `BIT-AND`, `BIT-OR`, `BIT-XOR` mit XSTRING-Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_bitwise_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS bitwise_and
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring1 TYPE xstring
        iv_xstring2 TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS bitwise_or
      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring1 TYPE xstring
        iv_xstring2 TYPE xstring
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_bitwise_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD bitwise_and.
    rv_result = iv_xstring1 BIT-AND iv_xstring2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD bitwise_or.
    rv_result = iv_xstring1 BIT-OR iv_xstring2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD bitwise_xor.

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bitwise_and FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_bitwise_or FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_bitwise_xor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_bitwise_different_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bitwise_and.
    DATA(lo_ops) = NEW zcl_binary_bitwise_ops( ).
    DATA(lv_x1) = 'F0F0'X. " 1111000011110000
    DATA(lv_x2) = '0F0F'X. " 0000111100001111
    DATA(lv_expected) = '0000'X. " 0000000000000000
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_ops->bitwise_and( iv_xstring1 = lv_x1 iv_xstring2 = lv_x2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bitwise_or.
    DATA(lo_ops) = NEW zcl_binary_bitwise_ops( ).
    DATA(lv_x1) = 'F0F0'X. " 1111000011110000
    DATA(lv_x2) = '0F0F'X. " 0000111100001111
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'FFFF'X. " 1111111111111111
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_ops->bitwise_or( iv_xstring1 = lv_x1 iv_xstring2 = lv_x2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bitwise_xor.
    DATA(lo_ops) = NEW zcl_binary_bitwise_ops( ).
    DATA(lv_x1) = 'F0F0'X. " 1111000011110000
    DATA(lv_x2) = '0F0F'X. " 0000111100001111
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'FFFF'X. " 1111111111111111
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_ops->bitwise_xor( iv_xstring1 = lv_x1 iv_xstring2 = lv_x2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bitwise_different_length.
    DATA(lo_ops) = NEW zcl_binary_bitwise_ops( ).
    DATA(lv_x1) = 'FF'X.
    DATA(lv_x2) = '0F0F'X.
    " Result length is determined by the longer operand, shorter is padded with '00'X
    DATA(lv_expected_and) = '000F'X. " FF AND 0F0F -> 00FF AND 0F0F -> 000F
    DATA(lv_expected_or) = '0FFF'X. " FF OR 0F0F -> 00FF OR 0F0F -> 0FFF
    DATA(lv_expected_xor) = '0F0F'X. " FF XOR 0F0F -> 00FF XOR 0F0F -> 0F0F

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_ops->bitwise_and( iv_xstring1 = lv_x1 iv_xstring2 = lv_x2 ) exp = lv_expected_and ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_ops->bitwise_or( iv_xstring1 = lv_x1 iv_xstring2 = lv_x2 ) exp = lv_expected_or ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_ops->bitwise_xor( iv_xstring1 = lv_x1 iv_xstring2 = lv_x2 ) exp = lv_expected_xor ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bitweise Operationen auf XSTRING-Daten sind in Szenarien nützlich, in denen auf der Ebene einzelner Bits gearbeitet werden muss, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von Protokolldaten, Verschlüsselung oder der Manipulation von Flags. ABAP bietet hierfür direkte Operatoren, die eine effiziente und lesbare Implementierung ermöglichen.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, BITWISE, BIT-AND, BIT-OR, BIT-XOR, Data Manipulation

CLASS zcl_itb_read_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

           END OF ty_sflight.

        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_itb_read_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data from SFLIGHTS
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' ) ).

    rv_price = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ]-price.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' enthält und nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `price` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `VALUE` enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `VALUE #( )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie Variablen direkt dort, wo sie verwendet werden, anstatt sie am Anfang einer Methode zu deklarieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    " Inline declaration for internal table and work area
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      " Inline declaration for loop work area
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        " Inline declaration for string template result
        DATA(lv_info) = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } Preis: { ls_flight-price }|.
        rv_result = rv_result && lv_info && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_no_data_msg) = |Keine Flüge für { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } gefunden.|.
      rv_result = lv_no_data_msg.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS contains data for 'AA' '0017' for this test.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declarations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Flug AA 0017 am' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declarations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Keine Flüge für XX 9999 gefunden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen mit `DATA(...)` ermöglichen die Deklaration von Variablen genau an der Stelle, an der sie zum ersten Mal verwendet werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Variablen am Anfang von Methoden zu deklarieren, was den Code kompakter und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: INLINE DECLARATION, DATA, SELECT, LOOP AT, STRING TEMPLATE, METHOD

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Datenzugriffsdienst) über ihren Konstruktor injiziert bekommt, um die Testbarkeit und Flexibilität zu erhöhen.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für den Dienst und verwenden Sie es als `IMPORTING` Parameter im `CONSTRUCTOR`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_data_provider.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
           carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
         END OF ty_sflight_key.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           price    TYPE sflight-price,
           currency TYPE sflight-currency,
         END OF ty_sflight_data.
  TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_flights_by_key
    IMPORTING
      is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data
    RAISING
      cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_db_impl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_db_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_data_provider~get_flights_by_key.
    " In a real scenario, this would read from DB (e.g., SFLIGHTS)
    " For demo, simulate with fixed data
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE zif_flight_data_provider=>tt_sflight_data.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) ).

    rs_flight = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_key-carrid
                                                      connid = is_key-connid
                                                      fldate = is_key-fldate ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_details) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zif_flight_data_provider=>ty_sflight_key(
          carrid = iv_carrid
          connid = iv_connid
          fldate = iv_fldate ).
        DATA(ls_flight) = mo_data_provider->get_flights_by_key( ls_key ).
        rv_details = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } kostet { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
        rv_details = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle mit der `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE type( INIT result = initial_value FOR ... NEXT result = result + ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT total = 0
                                          FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                          NEXT total = total + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight(

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_input_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und deklarativen Weise. Sie ist ideal, um Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die Methoden-Chaining (Fluent Interface) ermöglicht, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.
    METHODS set_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.
    METHODS set_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.
    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_data) TYPE zcl_flight_builder=>ty_sflight_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    DATA mv_price  TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_carrid.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_connid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_price.
    mv_price = iv_price.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rs_flight_data = VALUE #(
      carrid = mv_carrid
      connid = mv_connid
      price  = mv_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '150.00' ).

explanation: Methoden-Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt, was die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit der neuen Open SQL Syntax in eine inline deklarierte interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_flights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_for_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carrier.
    " Ensure SFLIGHTS has data for 'AA' for this test.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_inline( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_inline( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Typisierung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Datenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        it_data_rows         TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING' THEN ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'    THEN ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int4( ).
        WHEN 'DEC'    THEN ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_dec( p_length = 15 p_decimals = 2 ).
        WHEN OTHERS   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dyn_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_dyn_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dyn_table>.

    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(ls_data_row).
      CREATE DATA <ls_dyn_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dyn_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dyn_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dyn_line>).

      LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO <lv_dyn_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE ls_data_row TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_field>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_dyn_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_dyn_line> TO <lt_dyn_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).

    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table=>tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'ID'   type = 'INT' )
      ( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' )
      ( name = 'VAL'  type = 'DEC' ) ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             val  TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_input_data) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Entry A' val = '10.50' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Entry B' val = '20.75' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs it_data_rows = lt_input_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_result> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_result> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_result>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_result> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_result> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_result> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_result>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_result> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_result> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_id>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 1 ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_result> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_text>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_text> exp = 'Entry A' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VAL' OF STRUCTURE <ls_result> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_val>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_val> exp = '10.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung in ABAP ermöglicht es, die Struktur von Datenobjekten (wie internen Tabellen) zur Laufzeit zu definieren. Dies ist nützlich für generische Anwendungen oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die Datenstruktur nicht im Voraus bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) und `CREATE DATA` in Kombination mit Feldsymbolen ist der moderne Ansatz hierfür.
keywords: DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, RTTI, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, DATA, METHOD

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den letzten Tag des aktuellen Monats unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder ähnlicher moderner Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>GET_LAST_DAY_OF_MONTH` oder `cl_abap_date_helper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_last_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_last_day_of_current_month
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_last_day) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_last_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_current_month.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_year) = lv_current_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = lv_current_date+4(2).

    rv_last_day = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month(
      iv_year  = lv_year
      iv_month = lv_month ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_last_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_last_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_last_day( ).
    DATA(lv_last_day) = lo_cut->get_last_day_of_current_month( ).

    " Get expected value for current month (e.g., November 2025 -> 20251130)
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_year) = lv_current_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = lv_current_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_expected_last_day) TYPE d.

    CASE lv_month.
      WHEN '01' OR '03' OR '05' OR '07' OR '08' OR '10' OR '12'.
        lv_expected_last_day = lv_year && lv_month && '31'.
      WHEN '04' OR '06' OR '09' OR '11'.
        lv_expected_last_day = lv_year && lv_month && '30'.
      WHEN '02'.
        IF ( lv_year MOD 4 = 0 AND lv_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR lv_year MOD 400 = 0.
          lv_expected_last_day = lv_year && lv_month && '29'.
        ELSE.
          lv_expected_last_day = lv_year && lv_month && '28'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_last_day exp = lv_expected_last_day ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER` (oder `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für Zeitstempel) bietet eine Reihe von statischen Methoden zur einfachen und robusten Manipulation von Datums- und Zeitwerten. Dies ist der moderne Weg, um Datumsberechnungen durchzuführen, anstatt manuelle Logik zu implementieren.
keywords: DATE, TIME, CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER, DATA, METHOD

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung der `GROUP BY` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_sflight().
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_input_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Expression ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und erlaubt die direkte Aggregation von Gruppeninformationen (wie `GROUP SIZE`) in der Ergebnisstruktur, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, FOR GROUPS OF, DATA, METHOD

Instructions: Verschieben Sie einen String um 3 Zeichen nach links und füllen Sie die entstandenen Lücken mit Leerzeichen auf. Zeigen Sie anschließend eine moderne Alternative mit String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT LEFT` und `substring` oder `replace`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_modern_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS shift_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_modern_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_classic.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_output LEFT BY 3 PLACES.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD shift_modern.
    rv_output = |{ iv_input+3 ALPHA = OUT }|. " ALPHA = OUT fills with spaces
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden Leerzeichen aus einem String. Zeigen Sie anschließend eine moderne Alternative mit String-Funktionen.

CLASS zcl_shift_leading_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING

    rv_output = iv_input.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_leading_modern.
    rv_output = replace( val = iv_input regex = '^ +' with = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datum im Format 'YYYYMMDD' in das Format 'DD.MM.YYYY'. Zeigen Sie eine moderne Alternative zu mehreren `SHIFT`-Anweisungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit Substring-Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_format_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_date_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.

    METHODS format_date_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_format_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_classic.
    DATA: lv_year  TYPE sy-jahr,
          lv_month TYPE sy-monat,
          lv_day   TYPE sy-tag.

    lv_year = iv_date(4).
    lv_month = iv_date+4(2).
    lv_day = iv_date+6(2).

    rv_formatted_date = lv_day.
    CONCATENATE rv_formatted_date lv_month INTO rv_formatted_date SEPARATED BY '.'.
    CONCATENATE rv_formatted_date lv_year INTO rv_formatted_date SEPARATED BY '.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_date_modern.
    rv_formatted_date = |{ iv_date+6(2) }.{ iv_date+4(2) }.{ iv_date(4) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ersetzt umständliche `CONCATENATE` oder multiple `SHIFT` Anweisungen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine zyklische Verschiebung eines Strings um 2 Zeichen nach links durch. Zeigen Sie eine moderne Alternative.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SHIFT CIRCULAR` mit String-Funktionen wie `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_cyclic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_cyclic_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS shift_cyclic_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_cyclic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_cyclic_classic.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_output LEFT CIRCULAR BY 2 PLACES.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD shift_cyclic_modern.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length < 2.
      rv_output = iv_input.
    ELSE.
      rv_output = |{ iv_input+2(lv_length - 2) }{ iv_input(2) }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_shift_cyclic_modern FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Ein Betrag ist als String '000012345' gegeben (impliziert 123.45). Formatieren Sie diesen String in ein Währungsformat '123,45 EUR'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT` zum Entfernen führender Nullen und String-Templates mit `COUNTRY` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_currency_classic
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_str TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_amount) TYPE string.

    METHODS format_currency_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_str TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_amount) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_currency_classic.
    DATA: lv_amount_str_loc TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_integer_part TYPE string,
          lv_decimal_part TYPE string.

    lv_amount_str_loc = iv_amount_str.
    " Ensure at least two digits for decimals, pad with leading zeros if necessary
    WHILE strlen( lv_amount_str_loc ) < 2.
      lv_amount_str_loc = |0{ lv_amount_str_loc }|.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Extract decimal part (last two digits)
    lv_decimal_part = lv_amount_str_loc+ ( strlen( lv_amount_str_loc ) - 2 ) ( 2 ).
    " Extract integer part
    lv_integer_part = lv_amount_str_loc( strlen( lv_amount_str_loc ) - 2 ).
    " Remove leading zeros from integer part
    SHIFT lv_integer_part LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'.
    IF lv_integer_part IS INITIAL.
      lv_integer_part = '0'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_formatted_amount = |{ lv_integer_part },{ lv_decimal_part } EUR|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_currency_modern.
    DATA(lv_amount_p) = CONV p LENGTH 9 DECIMALS 2( iv_amount_str / 100 ).
    rv_formatted_amount = |{ lv_amount_p COUNTRY = 'DE' } EUR|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_currency_classic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_currency_modern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_currency_classic( '000012345' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '123,45 EUR' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->format_currency_classic( '000000001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0,01 EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_currency_modern.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '123,45 EUR' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->format_currency_modern( '000000001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0,01 EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die moderne Methode nutzt `CONV` zur direkten Umwandlung in einen gepackten Dezimaltyp und String-Templates mit `COUNTRY = 'DE'` für eine einfache und korrekte Formatierung gemäß deutschen Konventionen.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_db_sys=>get_db_type()` mit dynamischem SQL und der `UP TO N ROWS` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_db_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_db_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_db_type) = cl_db_sys=>get_db_type( ).
    DATA(lv_select_clause) = `CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE`.

    " In modern ABAP, UP TO N ROWS is the standard way to limit results,
    " and the database interface handles the translation to native TOP N / LIMIT.
    " The check for lv_db_type could be used for more complex native SQL or
    " specific database hints if truly needed.
    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_select_clause)
          FROM sflights
          ORDER BY fldate DESC
          UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_sflight_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sflight_data msg = 'Es sollten Daten zurückgegeben werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight_data ) exp = 5 msg = 'Es sollten 5 Zeilen zurückgegeben werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl `UP TO N ROWS` eine generische ABAP SQL-Klausel ist, die von der Datenbank in ihre native `TOP N` oder `LIMIT`-Syntax übersetzt wird, könnte man bei Bedarf mit `cl_db_sys` entscheiden, ob man Native SQL oder datenbankspezifische Funktionen verwendet, um die Performance zu optimieren oder spezielle Features zu nutzen.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflights`, nachdem deren Namen um führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen bereinigt wurden.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `SHIFT` in einer Schleife, um die Namen zu bereinigen, und dann `LINES OF` mit `DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_count_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_unique_cleaned_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_count_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_unique_cleaned_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_cleaned_carriers) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrier = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
        ( REDUCE string(
            INIT s = lv_carrier
            FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 1
            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE
                                  SHIFT s LEFT DELETING LEADING ' '
                                  END )
            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE
                                  SHIFT s RIGHT DELETING TRAILING ' '
                                  END )
          )
        )
    ).

    rv_count = lines( lt_cleaned_carriers FILTER DISTINCT * ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming sflights has at least 2 unique carriers like 'LH ' and 'AA'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result > 0 msg = 'No unique carriers found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result <= 10 msg = 'Too many unique carriers, check data' ). " Example upper bound
  ENDMETHOD.

Es verwendet eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE #(...)` und einer `REDUCE`-Expression, um jeden `carrid` aus der `sflights`-Tabelle zu bereinigen (führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen mittels `SHIFT` entfernen). Anschließend wird `LINES OF` in Kombination mit `FILTER DISTINCT *` verwendet, um die Anzahl der eindeutigen, bereinigten Fluggesellschaften zu zählen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Zähle die Wörter in einem Satz, nachdem mehrfache Leerzeichen durch einfache Leerzeichen ersetzt und führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernt wurden.
hint: Nutze `CONDENSE` und dann die Funktion `count` der Leerzeichen + 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_count_words_condense DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_word_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_count_words_condense IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_words.
    DATA(lv_condensed_sentence) = iv_sentence.
    CONDENSE lv_condensed_sentence NO-GAPS.

    IF lv_condensed_sentence IS INITIAL.
      rv_word_count = 0.
    ELSE.
      rv_word_count = count( val = lv_condensed_sentence sub = ' ' ) + 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String, nachdem ein spezifisches Präfix entfernt wurde.
hint: Nutze `SHIFT LEFT UP TO` um das Präfix zu entfernen und dann die Funktion `count`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_count_after_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_char_after_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_prefix       TYPE string
        iv_char_to_count TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_count_after_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_char_after_prefix.
    DATA(lv_processed_string) = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT lv_processed_string LEFT UP TO iv_prefix.
    " If prefix is found, it's shifted away. If not, string remains unchanged.
    " We need to handle the case where the prefix itself is part of the string and not just a prefix.
    " A more robust way for 'removing prefix' would be find and substring, but for SHIFT demo:
    IF lv_processed_string CP iv_prefix && lv_processed_string NE iv_input_string.
      " Prefix was found and shifted, now remove the prefix itself if it's still there (e.g. 'PREFIX_PREFIX_TEXT')
      " This is a simplification for the SHIFT UP TO behavior.
      " For exact prefix removal, find() and substring() are better.
      " For this example, we assume SHIFT UP TO is sufficient to 'remove' the prefix part for counting.
    ENDIF.

    rv_count = count( val = lv_processed_string sub = iv_char_to_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_count_after_prefix.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_count_after_prefix( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_char_after_prefix( iv_input_string = 'PREFIX_A_B_C' iv_prefix = 'PREFIX_' iv_char_to_count = '_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 3 msg = 'Test Case 1 Failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->count_char_after_prefix( iv_input_string = 'NO_PREFIX_X_Y' iv_prefix = 'XYZ' iv_char_to_count = '_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 3 msg = 'Test Case 2 Failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->count_char_after_prefix( iv_input_string = 'START_123_START_456' iv_prefix = 'START_' iv_char_to_count = '_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 3 msg = 'Test Case 3 Failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SHIFT LEFT UP TO iv_prefix`-Anweisung verschiebt den String so, dass der Teil vor dem ersten Vorkommen des Präfixes entfernt wird. Dies ist nützlich, um einen String ab einem bestimmten Punkt zu verarbeiten. Anschließend wird die `count`-Funktion verwendet, um die Vorkommen des Zielzeichens im verbleibenden String zu zählen. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um String-Teile zu isolieren und zu analysieren.
keywords: SHIFT, COUNT, String Processing, Prefix Removal

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, deren Flugnummern nach dem Entfernen aller führenden Nullen eine bestimmte Länge haben.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `VALUE #(...)`, `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'` und `strlen` oder `count`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_count_flights_by_numlen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_cleaned_num_len
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_count_flights_by_cleaned_num_len IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_cleaned_num_len.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = count(
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_flight_num = <fs_flight>-connid IN
        ( COND #( WHEN strlen( SHIFT lv_flight_num LEFT DELETING LEADING '0' ) = iv_target_length THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein String eine gültige ID ist, die nur aus Ziffern besteht, nachdem alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen am Anfang und Ende entfernt wurden. Gib die Anzahl der verbleibenden Ziffern zurück.
hint: Nutze `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING NON-NUMERIC` und `SHIFT RIGHT DELETING TRAILING NON-NUMERIC`, dann `count` mit Regex für Ziffern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_validate_numeric_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_numeric_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_digit_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_validate_numeric_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_numeric_id.
    DATA(lv_cleaned_string) = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT lv_cleaned_string LEFT DELETING LEADING NON-NUMERIC.
    SHIFT lv_cleaned_string RIGHT DELETING TRAILING NON-NUMERIC.

    IF lv_cleaned_string IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_cleaned_string CO '0123456789'. " Check if it contains only digits
      rv_digit_count = strlen( lv_cleaned_string ).
    ELSE.
      rv_digit_count = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird mit `CO '0123456789'` überprüft, ob der verbleibende String ausschließlich aus Ziffern besteht. Die `strlen`-Funktion gibt dann die Anzahl der Ziffern zurück. Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Wörter in einem Satz, die mit einem bestimmten Buchstaben beginnen, nachdem der Satz normalisiert wurde (mehrfache Leerzeichen entfernt, führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernt).
hint: Nutze `CONDENSE`, `SPLIT` und dann `count` in einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `starts_with`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_count_words_starting_with DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_words_starting_with
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_start_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_word_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_count_words_starting_with IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_words_starting_with.
    DATA(lv_normalized_sentence) = iv_sentence.
    CONDENSE lv_normalized_sentence NO-GAPS.

    IF lv_normalized_sentence IS INITIAL.
      rv_word_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_words TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_normalized_sentence AT ' ' INTO TABLE lt_words.

    rv_word_count = count(
      FOR <fs_word> IN lt_words
      ( COND #( WHEN starts_with( val = <fs_word> sub = iv_start_char ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Zeilen in einem Multiline-String, nachdem jede Zeile um führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen bereinigt wurde.
hint: Nutze `SPLIT` für Zeilen, `SHIFT` für die Bereinigung und `LINES OF` zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_count_cleaned_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_cleaned_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_multiline_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_count_cleaned_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_cleaned_lines.
    DATA lt_raw_lines TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_multiline_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_raw_lines.

    DATA(lt_cleaned_lines) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_line> IN lt_raw_lines
      LET lv_line = <fs_line> IN
        ( REDUCE string(
            INIT s = lv_line
            FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 1
            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE
                                  SHIFT s LEFT DELETING LEADING ' '
                                  END )
            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE
                                  SHIFT s RIGHT DELETING TRAILING ' '
                                  END )
          )
        )
    ).

    " Count only non-empty lines after cleaning
    rv_line_count = count(
      FOR <fs_cleaned_line> IN lt_cleaned_lines
      ( COND #( WHEN <fs_cleaned_line> IS NOT INITIAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_count_cleaned_lines( ).
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lv_test_string) = |  Line 1  { lv_crlf }   Line 2{ lv_crlf }{ lv_crlf }Line 3   |.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_cleaned_lines( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 3 msg = 'Test Case 1 Failed' ).

    lv_test_string = |Single Line|.
    lv_result = lo_cut->count_cleaned_lines( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 1 msg = 'Test Case 2 Failed' ).

    lv_test_string = | { lv_crlf } { lv_crlf } |.
    lv_result = lo_cut->count_cleaned_lines( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Test Case 3 Failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Multiline-String wird zunächst mit `SPLIT` und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` in einzelne Zeilen zerlegt. Jede Zeile wird dann in einer `FOR`-Expression mit `REDUCE` und `SHIFT` (links und rechts) bereinigt. Schließlich wird die `count`-Funktion verwendet, um nur die nicht-leeren, bereinigten Zeilen zu zählen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Textdateien oder Multiline-Strings zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der eindeutigen Währungen aus der Tabelle `sflights`, nachdem deren Codes um führende Leerzeichen bereinigt und in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wurden.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `VALUE #(...)`, `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING ' '`, `to_upper` und `LINES OF` mit `DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_count_unique_currencies DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_unique_cleaned_currencies
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_count_unique_currencies IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_unique_cleaned_currencies.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_cleaned_currencies) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_currency = <fs_flight>-currkey IN
        ( to_upper( SHIFT lv_currency LEFT DELETING LEADING ' ' ) )
    ).

    rv_count = lines( lt_cleaned_currencies FILTER DISTINCT * ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming sflights has at least 1 unique currency like 'EUR', 'USD '

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result <= 5 msg = 'Too many unique currencies, check data' ). " Example upper bound
  ENDMETHOD.

Für jeden Eintrag wird der Währungscode (`currkey`) mit `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING ' '` von führenden Leerzeichen befreit und dann mit `to_upper` in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt. Schließlich wird `LINES OF` mit `FILTER DISTINCT *` verwendet, um die Anzahl der eindeutigen, bereinigten Währungen zu zählen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation und -bereinigung.
keywords: Internal Tables, SHIFT, TO_UPPER, COUNT, FOR, VALUE, FILTER DISTINCT, sflights

CLASS zcl_str_count_words_min_len DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_words_min_length
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_min_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_word_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_count_words_min_len IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_words_min_length.
    DATA(lv_normalized_sentence) = iv_sentence.
    CONDENSE lv_normalized_sentence NO-GAPS.

    IF lv_normalized_sentence IS INITIAL.
      rv_word_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_words TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_normalized_sentence AT ' ' INTO TABLE lt_words.

    rv_word_count = count(
      FOR <fs_word> IN lt_words
      ( COND #( WHEN strlen( <fs_word> ) >= iv_min_length THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_words_len FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_words_len.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_count_words_min_len( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_words_min_length( iv_sentence = '  This is a test sentence  ' iv_min_length = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 3 msg = 'Test Case 1 Failed' ). "This, test, sentence

    lv_result = lo_cut->count_words_min_length( iv_sentence = 'Short words only' iv_min_length = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 2 msg = 'Test Case 2 Failed' ). "words, only

    lv_result = lo_cut->count_words_min_length( iv_sentence = 'No long words' iv_min_length = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Test Case 3 Failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->count_words_min_length( iv_sentence = '' iv_min_length = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Test Case 4 Failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie im vorherigen Beispiel wird der Satz mit `CONDENSE NO-GAPS` normalisiert und mit `SPLIT` in Wörter zerlegt. Die `FOR`-Expression mit `count` wird verwendet, um die Wörter zu zählen, deren Länge (ermittelt mit `strlen`) die angegebene Mindestlänge erreicht. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Methode zur Analyse von Textstrukturen.
keywords: CONDENSE, SPLIT, COUNT, FOR, STRLEN, String Processing

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugverbindungen eines bestimmten Fluganbieters (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei Inline-Deklaration und den `FOR`-Operator, um nur bestimmte Felder zu selektieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` und den `FOR`-Operator in einer Schleife, um die Daten zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info,

CLASS zcl_select_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_raw_flights
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                             connid = ls_flight-connid
                             fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).

ENDCLASS.
