Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` und fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die den Status der Flugverbindung basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Plätze (`seatsocc` und `seatsmax`) als 'Available', 'Limited' oder 'Full' anzeigt. Nutzen Sie dafür eine `CASE`-Expression im `SELECT`-Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS ...` direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_case_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status,
           tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_case_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE
             WHEN seatsmax - seatsocc > 10 THEN 'Available'
             WHEN seatsmax - seatsocc > 0  THEN 'Limited'
             ELSE 'Full'
           END AS status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_case_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_status ) msg = 'Should retrieve flight statuses' ).

    DATA(ls_full) = VALUE #( lt_status[ status = 'Full' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_full IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_full-status exp = 'Full' msg = 'Should find a flight with status Full' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_available) = VALUE #( lt_status[ status = 'Available' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_available IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_available-status exp = 'Available' msg = 'Should find a flight with status Available' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: SQL-Expressions wie `CASE` direkt im `SELECT`-Statement ermöglichen es, Daten bereits auf der Datenbankebene zu transformieren. Dies reduziert den Datenverkehr zwischen Datenbank und Applikationsserver und vereinfacht den ABAP-Code, da keine nachträgliche Verarbeitung in Schleifen notwendig ist. Verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, SQL Expression, sflights, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Flugverbindungen von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste. Nutzen Sie dafür den `UNION ALL`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei `SELECT`-Statements, die durch `UNION ALL` verbunden sind. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Feldlisten kompatibel sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_union,
           tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid1 TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrid2 TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid2
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( iv_carrid1 = 'AA' iv_carrid2 = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_combined ) msg = 'Should retrieve combined flights' ).

    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_combined INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_count_aa exp = 0 msg = 'Should contain AA flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_count_lh exp = 0 msg = 'Should contain LH flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION ALL`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das effiziente Kombinieren von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren `SELECT`-Statements direkt auf der Datenbank. Dies ist performanter als das manuelle Zusammenführen von internen Tabellen im Applikationsserver.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, sflights, SQL Operations

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Plätze (`seatsocc`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse so, dass nur Fluggesellschaften angezeigt werden, deren durchschnittliche Belegung über einem bestimmten Wert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY carrid` und `HAVING AVG(seatsocc) > ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_seatsocc TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_occupancy,
           tt_avg_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_occupancy_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_avg_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING AVG( seatsocc ) > @iv_min_avg_occupancy
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_high_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_group_having( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_occupancy_carriers( '100' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_carriers ) msg = 'Should retrieve carriers with high occupancy' ).

    DATA(ls_carrier) = VALUE #( lt_carriers[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_carrier-avg_seatsocc > 100 ) msg = 'LH average occupancy should be > 100' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`- und `HAVING`-Klauseln ermöglichen es, Aggregationsfunktionen (wie `AVG`, `SUM`, `COUNT`) direkt auf der Datenbank auszuführen und die Ergebnisse basierend auf diesen Aggregationen zu filtern. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter als die Aggregation und Filterung im ABAP-Programm.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, HAVING, AVG, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` und die entsprechenden Währungsinformationen aus `scurx` (Währungstexte), auch wenn keine passende Währung gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `scurx` auf dem Feld `curr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_currency,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             curr     TYPE s_curr,
             ltext    TYPE scurx-ltext,
           END OF ty_flight_currency,
           tt_flight_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_currency.
    SELECT f~carrid, f~connid, f~fldate, f~curr, c~ltext
      FROM sflights AS f
      LEFT OUTER JOIN scurx AS c ON f~curr = c~curr
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_left_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_currency( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should retrieve flights with currency info' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_with_curr) = VALUE #( lt_flights[ ltext IS NOT INITIAL ] OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_with_curr msg = 'Should find at least one flight with currency text' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_without_curr) = VALUE #( lt_flights[ ltext IS INITIAL ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_flight_without_curr IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight_without_curr-ltext msg = 'Should find at least one flight without currency text (due to LEFT OUTER JOIN)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um Daten aus mehreren Tabellen zu verknüpfen, wobei alle Einträge der linken Tabelle erhalten bleiben, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle gefunden werden. Dies ist eine Standard-SQL-Funktionalität, die in ABAP ab Version 7.40+ voll unterstützt wird und die Datenbeschaffung erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: SELECT, LEFT OUTER JOIN, sflights, scurx, Joins

Instructions: Wählen Sie die dritte Seite von Flugverbindungen (jeweils 5 Einträge pro Seite) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, sortiert nach `carrid` und `connid`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ORDER BY`, `OFFSET` und `LIMIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_page,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_page,
           tt_flight_page TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_page WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_number TYPE i
        iv_page_size   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_page.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_page.
    DATA(lv_offset) = ( iv_page_number - 1 ) * iv_page_size.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      ORDER BY carrid, connid
      OFFSET @lv_offset ROWS
      UP TO @iv_page_size ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_pagination FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pagination.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_pagination( ).
    DATA(lt_page3) = lo_cut->get_flight_page( iv_page_number = 3 iv_page_size = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page3 ) exp = 5 msg = 'Page 3 should have 5 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_page3[ 1 ]-carrid msg = 'First entry should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `OFFSET`- und `UP TO N ROWS` (oder `LIMIT`) Klauseln (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50 für `OFFSET/LIMIT`) ermöglichen eine effiziente Paginierung von Datenbankergebnissen direkt auf der Datenbank. Dies ist entscheidend für die Performance bei großen Datenmengen, da nur die benötigten Datensätze übertragen werden.
keywords: SELECT, OFFSET, LIMIT, ORDER BY, sflights, Pagination

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine tiefe Kopie eines komplexen Objekts, das eine interne Tabelle enthält, um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen an der Kopie das Original nicht beeinflussen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    DATA mt_items TYPE tt_items.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string.

    METHODS add_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_item.
    APPEND VALUE ty_item( id = iv_id text = iv_text ) TO mt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deep_copy_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_deep_copy
      IMPORTING
        io_source TYPE REF TO zcl_complex_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_target) TYPE REF TO zcl_complex_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deep_copy_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_deep_copy.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_target.
    cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy(
      EXPORTING
        p_source = io_source
      IMPORTING
        p_target = ro_target
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_deep_copy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deep_copy.
    DATA(lo_original) = NEW zcl_complex_data( 'Original Object' ).
    lo_original->add_item( id = 1 text = 'Item 1' ).
    lo_original->add_item( id = 2 text = 'Item 2' ).

    DATA(lo_copier) = NEW zcl_deep_copy_demo( ).
    DATA(lo_copy) = lo_copier->perform_deep_copy( lo_original ).

    " Assert that the copy is not the same instance as the original
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lo_original exp = lo_copy msg = 'Objects should be different instances' ).

    " Modify the copy
    lo_copy->mv_name = 'Copied Object'.
    DELETE lo_copy->mt_items INDEX 1.
    lo_copy->add_item( id = 3 text = 'New Item' ).

    " Assert that original is unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_original->mv_name exp = 'Original Object' msg = 'Original name should be unchanged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_original->mt_items ) exp = 2 msg = 'Original items count should be unchanged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_original->mt_items[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Item 1' msg = 'Original first item should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy` ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um eine vollständige, unabhängige Kopie eines Objekts zu erstellen, einschließlich aller referenzierten Unterobjekte und interner Tabellen. Dies ist entscheidend, wenn man sicherstellen möchte, dass Änderungen an einer Objektinstanz keine unbeabsichtigten Seiteneffekte auf andere Instanzen haben.
keywords: cl_abap_memory_utilities, deep_copy, Object Orientation, Memory Management

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle nach dem Füllen mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_memory_consumption DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_memory_usage
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_memory_bytes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_memory_consumption IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_memory_usage.
    DATA lt_local_table TYPE tt_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( field1 = |Entry { sy-index }| field2 = sy-index ) TO lt_local_table.
    ENDDO.

    rv_memory_bytes = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_local_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_memory_usage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist nützlich für Performance-Analysen und die Optimierung des Speicherbedarfs, insbesondere bei großen internen Tabellen oder komplexen Objekten.
keywords: cl_abap_memory_utilities, get_memory_consumption, Memory, Performance, Internal Tables

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` und erstellen Sie eine neue Spalte, die `carrid` und `connid` als einen einzigen String im Format 'CARRID-CONNID' zusammenführt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_concat_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,

    METHODS get_flights_with_concat_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_concat_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_concat_id.
    SELECT CONCAT( CONCAT( carrid, '-' ), connid ) AS flight_key, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_concat_id FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Die SQL-Funktion `CONCAT` (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das direkte Verketten von Strings auf der Datenbank. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um zusammengesetzte Schlüssel oder Beschreibungen zu erstellen, ohne die Daten erst in ABAP verarbeiten zu müssen. Alternativ könnten auch String-Templates in ABAP verwendet werden, aber die Datenbankfunktion ist oft performanter.
keywords: SELECT, CONCAT, String Templates, SQL Expression, sflights, String Processing

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flugverbindungen pro Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaften aus, die mehr als 100 Verbindungen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT(*)` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_count_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count,
           tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_volume_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_count_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_volume_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_high_volume_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_volume_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_count_having( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_high_volume_carriers( 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_carriers ) msg = 'Should retrieve carriers with more than 100 flights' ).

    DATA(ls_carrier) = VALUE #( lt_carriers[ carrid = 'AA' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_carrier-flight_count > 100 ) msg = 'AA should have more than 100 flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `COUNT(*)` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`, um Aggregationsergebnisse direkt auf der Datenbank zu filtern. Dies ist ein Standard-SQL-Muster, das in ABAP ab 7.40+ effizient genutzt werden kann, um nur relevante aggregierte Daten zu laden.
keywords: SELECT, COUNT, GROUP BY, HAVING, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` aus, deren Flugdatum (`fldate`) in der Zukunft liegt, basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_future_flights( ).

    " Since sflights is a demo table, future flights might not exist or be limited.

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.

Dies vermeidet das Laden unnötiger Daten in den Applikationsserver.
keywords: SELECT, WHERE, sy-datum, sflights, Date/Time

Instructions: Deklarieren und füllen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Die Tabelle soll nach Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Flugdatum eindeutig sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ... SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `SELECT * INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS get_sorted_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_sflights.
    " Die SELECT-Anweisung füllt die sortierte Tabelle direkt und stellt die Sortierung sicher.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sorted_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_fill( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_sflights ) ).

    " Überprüfung der Sortierung (vereinfacht, da UNIQUE KEY dies sicherstellt)
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) = '00000000'.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-carrid > lv_prev_carrid OR
                                                ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid > lv_prev_connid ) OR
                                                ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid = lv_prev_connid AND ls_flight-fldate >= lv_prev_fldate ) ) ).
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle immer nach den angegebenen Schlüsselfeldern sortiert ist und keine doppelten Einträge enthält. Die `SELECT * INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` Syntax ist eine moderne Art, Daten direkt in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen, wobei die Sortierung automatisch beachtet wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, SELECT, INTERNAL TABLES, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle basierend auf dem vollständigen Schlüssel. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... INTO ...` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder verwenden Sie den Tabellen-Ausdruck `itab[ key ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS read_sflight_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_entry.
    " Direkter Zugriff auf sortierte Tabelle über den Schlüssel ist performant.
    READ TABLE im_sflights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate INTO rs_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_existing_entry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_entry RAISING cx_sy_read_error FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_read=>tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250102'. ls_sflight-price = '200.00'.
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->read_sflight_entry(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      im_sflights = mt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      ACT = lo_cut->read_sflight_entry(
        iv_carrid = 'XX'
        iv_connid = '9999'
        iv_fldate = '20250101'
        im_sflights = mt_sflights
      )
      EXPECTED_EXCEPTION_TYPE = cx_sy_read_error
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` Befehl ist für sortierte Tabellen hochoptimiert, da er einen binären Suchalgorithmus verwenden kann. Dies ermöglicht einen sehr schnellen Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen. Die Verwendung von Exceptions für Fehlerfälle ist eine moderne und robuste Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: READ TABLE, SORTED TABLE, KEY ACCESS, EXCEPTION

Instructions: Iterieren Sie effizient über eine sortierte interne Tabelle und filtern Sie Einträge nach einem Kriterium (z.B. alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...) WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    " Der WHERE-Zusatz bei LOOP AT nutzt die Sortierung der Tabelle.
    LOOP AT im_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_loop=>tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'. INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250102'. INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250102'. INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' im_sflights = mt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `WHERE`-Zusatz in einer `LOOP AT`-Anweisung auf einer sortierten Tabelle nutzt die Sortierung, um die Iteration zu optimieren. Das System kann die Suche nach dem ersten passenden Eintrag beschleunigen und die Schleife beenden, sobald keine weiteren passenden Einträge mehr gefunden werden können, was die Performance verbessert.
keywords: LOOP AT, SORTED TABLE, WHERE, INTERNAL TABLES

Instructions: Ändern Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Flugeintrags in einer sortierten internen Tabelle. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierung erhalten bleibt (durch Änderung eines Nicht-Schlüsselfeldes).
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs> WITH KEY ...` und ändern Sie das Feld über das Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS modify_sflight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_sflight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    " Lesen des Eintrags über den Schlüssel und Zuweisung an ein Feldsymbol.
    READ TABLE ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price. " Änderung des Nicht-Schlüsselfeldes.
      rv_modified = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_modified = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_existing_entry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing_entry FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_modified) = lo_cut->modify_sflight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = '150.00'
      CHANGING ct_sflights = mt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_modified ).
    DATA(ls_result) = mt_sflights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_modified) = lo_cut->modify_sflight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = '200.00'
      CHANGING ct_sflights = mt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_modified ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Ändern von Nicht-Schlüsselfeldern in einer sortierten Tabelle über ein Feldsymbol, das durch `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING` gewonnen wurde, ist effizient und erhält die Sortierung. Wenn Schlüsselfelder geändert werden müssten, wäre ein `DELETE` und anschließendes `INSERT` erforderlich, um die Sortierung zu gewährleisten.
keywords: MODIFY TABLE, SORTED TABLE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, READ TABLE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle nach mehreren Kriterien (z.B. Fluggesellschaft und Mindestpreis) und erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_criteria.
    " Der FILTER-Operator erstellt eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Kriterien.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( im_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_filter=>tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'. INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250102'. ls_sflight-price = '250.00'. INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-fldate = '20250102'. ls_sflight-price = '120.00'. INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_min_price = '150.00'
      im_sflights = mt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und sehr prägnante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die den angegebenen Bedingungen entsprechen. Für sortierte Tabellen kann dies intern optimiert werden.
keywords: FILTER, SORTED TABLE, INTERNAL TABLES, CONDITIONAL LOGIC

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder (z.B. Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Preis) aus einer bestehenden sortierten Tabelle enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS create_summary_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise für Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers in einer sortierten Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE ... INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    " REDUCE aggregiert Werte aus einer internen Tabelle.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                           FOR ls_flight IN im_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                           NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie effizient, ob ein Eintrag mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel in einer sortierten Tabelle existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit einem Tabellen-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    " LINE_EXISTS prüft effizient die Existenz eines Eintrags über den Schlüssel.
    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( im_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    ms_sflight_original-carrid = 'LH'.
    ms_sflight_original-connid = '0400'.
    ms_sflight_original-fldate = '20250101'.
    ms_sflight_original-price = '100.00'.

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF ms_sflight_original INTO lr_data.

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_data      = lr_data
      IMPORTING
        ex_container = mv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_to_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_container_dyn_deserialize( ).
    " Typbeschreibung zur Laufzeit ermitteln
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ms_sflight_original ).
    DATA(lr_deserialized_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_xstring_to_dynamic(
      im_xstring    = mv_xstring
      im_type_descr = lo_type_descr
    ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_deserialized_data->* TO <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_sflight> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = ms_sflight_original-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-price exp = ms_sflight_original-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` kann eine Typbeschreibung gewonnen werden, die dann mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` verwendet wird, um ein passendes Datenobjekt zu erzeugen. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP.

CLASS zcl_container_deep_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             details TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_deep_structure
      IMPORTING
        im_deep_data TYPE tt_carrier_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS deserialize_deep_structure
      IMPORTING
        im_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_deep_data) TYPE tt_carrier_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_deserialization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_deep_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_deep_structure.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_data      = im_deep_data
      IMPORTING
        ex_container = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_deep_structure.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_container = im_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ex_data      = rt_deep_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA: ls_carrier_info TYPE zcl_container_deep_struct=>ty_carrier_info,
          ls_flight_detail TYPE zcl_container_deep_struct=>ty_flight_detail.

    ls_carrier_info-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_carrier_info-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight_detail-fldate = '20250101'.
    ls_flight_detail-price = '100.00'.

    ls_flight_detail-fldate = '20250102'.
    ls_flight_detail-price = '120.00'.
    APPEND ls_flight_detail TO ls_carrier_info-details.

    CLEAR ls_carrier_info.

    ls_carrier_info-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_carrier_info-connid = '0017'.
    ls_flight_detail-fldate = '20250103'.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->serialize_deep_structure( im_deep_data = mt_deep_data_original ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_deserialized) = lo_cut->deserialize_deep_structure( im_xstring = lv_xstring ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in ein XML-Format, indem Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities` zur Serialisierung in XSTRING und anschließend `cl_abap_conv_xstring_to_string` zur Umwandlung in einen String verwenden.
hint: Serialisieren Sie zuerst zu XSTRING, dann XSTRING zu String. Beachten Sie die Codepage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_container_to_xml DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS convert_sflights_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        im_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_to_xml IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_xml.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " 1. Serialisierung der internen Tabelle in XSTRING
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_data      = im_sflights
      IMPORTING
        ex_container = lv_xstring
    ).

    " 2. Konvertierung des XSTRING in einen String (XML)
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_xstring_to_string=>create(
      EXPORTING
        encoding = 'UTF-8' " Wichtig für XML-Kompatibilität
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        in  = lv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        out = rv_xml_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen XML-String (zuerst in XSTRING umgewandelt) zurück in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_string_to_xstring` und dann `cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_container_from_xml DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS convert_xml_to_sflights
      IMPORTING
        im_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error,
        cx_sy_deserialization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_from_xml IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xml_to_sflights.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " 1. Konvertierung des XML-Strings in XSTRING
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_string_to_xstring=>create(
      EXPORTING
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        in  = im_xml_string
      IMPORTING
        out = lv_xstring
    ).

    " 2. Deserialisierung des XSTRING in die interne Tabelle
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_container = lv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ex_data      = rt_sflights
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Netto-Summe einer Liste von Transaktionen (Einnahmen und Ausgaben), indem Sie Ausgaben von Einnahmen subtrahieren, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_net_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transaction,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             type   TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'I' for Income, 'E' for Expense
           END OF ty_transaction,
           ty_transactions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transaction WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_net_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_transactions TYPE ty_transactions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_sum) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_net_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_sum.
    rv_net_sum = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                           FOR <fs_trans> IN it_transactions
                           NEXT sum = COND #( WHEN <fs_trans>-type = 'I' THEN sum + <fs_trans>-amount
                                              WHEN <fs_trans>-type = 'E' THEN sum - <fs_trans>-amount
                                              ELSE sum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Position in einer Bestandsliste den verbleibenden Bestand nach Abzug einer Verkaufsmenge berechnet. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden zu generieren und dabei Berechnungen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_stock_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stock_item,
             material TYPE matnr,
             stock    TYPE i,
             sold     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_stock_item,
           ty_stock_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_stock_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_remaining_stock,
             material        TYPE matnr,
             remaining_stock TYPE i,
           END OF ty_remaining_stock,
           ty_remaining_stocks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_remaining_stock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_stock
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_stock TYPE ty_stock_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_stock) TYPE ty_remaining_stocks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_stock_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_stock.
    rt_remaining_stock = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_initial_stock
                                  ( material = ls_item-material
                                    remaining_stock = ls_item-stock - ls_item-sold ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_active_docs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document,
             document_id   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             creation_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_document,
           ty_documents TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

        iv_cutoff_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_documents) TYPE ty_documents.

CLASS zcl_filter_active_docs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_documents.
    rt_active_documents = FILTER #( it_all_documents USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE creation_date > iv_cutoff_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle in eine intern deklarierte interne Tabelle ein, wobei Sie nur Flüge nach einem bestimmten Datum und mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft auswählen. Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL Syntax mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...) WHERE ...` mit inline Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_date    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_criteria.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
        AND fldate >= @iv_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_date) = '20250101'. " Assuming some flights exist after this date for LH

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_criteria( iv_carrier = lv_carrier iv_date = lv_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

explanation: Moderne Open SQL Syntax erlaubt die Verwendung von Host-Variablen mit dem `@`-Präfix direkt in der WHERE-Klausel und die Inline-Deklaration der Zieltabelle (`@rt_flights`). `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` füllt die interne Tabelle automatisch mit passenden Feldern, was den Code vereinfacht und Fehler reduziert. Dies ist entscheidend für effizienten Datenbankzugriff, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen, wie sie im Kontext von Data Aging auftreten können.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null verhindert und eine eigene, klassenbasierte Exception auslöst, falls dies versucht wird. Die aufrufende Methode soll diese Exception fangen und eine Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Exception-Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH` Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_division_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS lcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        lcx_division_by_zero.

    METHODS perform_division_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_division_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  CLASS lcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          textid = lcx_division_by_zero=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division_safe.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
        rv_message = |Division successful: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH lcx_division_by_zero.
        rv_message = |Error: Division by zero is not allowed!|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_message = |Error: An arithmetic error occurred (e.g., overflow).|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).

    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Successful division incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = `lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 )`
                                        exp_class = 'ZCL_DIVISION_HANDLER=>LCX_DIVISION_BY_ZERO'
                                        msg = 'Division by zero should raise custom exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_safe.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).

explanation: Klassenbasierte Exceptions (ab ABAP 7.40) bieten ein strukturiertes und robustes Fehlerbehandlungsmodell. Durch die Definition eigener Exception-Klassen kann man spezifische Fehlerzustände klar kommunizieren und behandeln. Dies ist unerlässlich für die Stabilität von Anwendungen, insbesondere bei kritischen Prozessen wie der Datenverarbeitung oder -alterung, wo Fehler präzise abgefangen werden müssen.
keywords: Exceptions, TRY CATCH, Error Handling, Class-based Exceptions

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Klasse, die eine 'fluent interface' für die Konfiguration eines Berichts zur Datenalterung bietet, indem Konfigurationsmethoden `ME` zurückgeben.
hint: Lassen Sie Konfigurationsmethoden `ME` zurückgeben, um sie verketten zu können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_report_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_object_name TYPE string,
           ty_date_range  TYPE RANGE OF sy-datum.

    METHODS set_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object TYPE ty_object_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_report_config.

    METHODS set_date_range
      IMPORTING
        is_date_range TYPE ty_date_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_report_config.

    METHODS execute_report
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_object TYPE ty_object_name.
    DATA ms_date_range TYPE ty_date_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_report_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_object.
    mv_object = iv_object.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_date_range.
    ms_date_range = is_date_range.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_report.
    IF mv_object IS INITIAL OR ms_date_range IS INITIAL.
      rv_status_message = 'Error: Report not fully configured.'.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate report execution with configured parameters
      DATA(lv_from_date) = ms_date_range-low.
      DATA(lv_to_date) = ms_date_range-high.
      rv_status_message = |Report for object '{ mv_object }' from { lv_from_date DATE = USER } to { lv_to_date DATE = USER } executed successfully.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP AT` Anweisung, um Flüge aus der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit der `GROUP SIZE` Option.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           ty_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts msg = 'Should find flight groups' ).

    " Check if at least one carrier has a count > 0
    DATA(lv_found_positive_count) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_group).
      IF ls_group-flight_count > 0.
        lv_found_positive_count = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_positive_count msg = 'At least one carrier should have flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP AT` Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt im LOOP. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Alternative zu manuellen Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und vereinfacht Aggregationen erheblich. Die `GROUP SIZE` Option liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

hint: Verwenden Sie die Klassen `CL_SQL_CONNECTION`, `CL_SQL_STATEMENT` und `CL_SQL_RESULT_SET` für ADBC.
solution:
CLASS zcl_adbc_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_result,
           ty_sflight_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE ty_sflight_results
      RAISING
        cx_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_adbc_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lo_connection TYPE REF TO cl_sql_connection,
          lo_statement  TYPE REF TO cl_sql_statement,
          lo_result_set TYPE REF TO cl_sql_result_set.

    DATA(lv_sql_query) = |SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.

    TRY.
        lo_connection = cl_sql_connection=>get_connection( ).
        lo_statement = lo_connection->create_statement( ).
        lo_result_set = lo_statement->execute_query( lv_sql_query ).

        lo_result_set->set_param_table( REF #( rt_results ) ).
        lo_result_set->next_package( ).

        lo_result_set->close( ).
        lo_connection->close( ).

      CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_select_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select_invalid_where FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select_no_results FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_adbc_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `carrid = 'LH' AND fldate >= '20250101'`.

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select( lv_where ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Should retrieve some flights' ).
        LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_result-fldate >= '20250101' ) msg = 'Flight date before cutoff' ).
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |SQL Exception: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_select_invalid_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_adbc_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `carrid = 'LH' AND non_existent_field = 'X'`.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = `lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select( lv_where )`
                                        exp_class = 'CX_SQL_EXCEPTION'
                                        msg = 'Invalid WHERE clause should raise SQL exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_select_no_results.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_adbc_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `carrid = 'XX' AND fldate = '19000101'`.

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select( lv_where ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'Should retrieve no flights' ).
      CATCH cx_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |SQL Exception: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ADBC (ABAP Database Connectivity) ermöglicht die Ausführung von dynamischem SQL (ab ABAP 7.40), bei dem Teile der Abfrage, wie die WHERE-Klausel, zur Laufzeit als Strings konstruiert werden können. Dies bietet maximale Flexibilität beim Zugriff auf Datenbanken und ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen Abfragekriterien stark variieren oder aus externen Quellen stammen. Im Kontext von Data Aging könnte dies für den flexiblen Zugriff auf aktive oder gealterte Datenpartitionen verwendet werden.
keywords: ADBC, Dynamic SQL, Database Access, Dynamic Programming, Data Aging (conceptual)

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur zu lesen und deren Werte in einer internen Tabelle zu speichern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für die Typbeschreibung und Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_value,
           ty_component_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_component_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_values) TYPE ty_component_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_component_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    IF ir_data IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ) AS cl_abap_structdescr.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name
                        value = |{ <fs_component> }| ) TO rt_component_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_simple_struct FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_struct_with_initial_ref FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_empty_struct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_simple_struct.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE ty_test_struct.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_test_data-field3 = '20251124'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_component_values) = lo_cut->get_struct_component_values( REF #( ls_test_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_component_values ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of components' ).

    READ TABLE lt_component_values WITH KEY name = 'FIELD1' INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-value exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 value incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_component_values WITH KEY name = 'FIELD2' INTO DATA(ls_comp2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp2-value exp = '123' msg = 'Field2 value incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_component_values WITH KEY name = 'FIELD3' INTO DATA(ls_comp3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp3-value exp = '20251124' msg = 'Field3 value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_struct_with_initial_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_reader( ).
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = `lo_cut->get_struct_component_values( lr_data )`
                                        exp_class = 'CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL'
                                        msg = 'Initial reference should raise exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_empty_struct.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_empty_struct,
           END OF ty_empty_struct.
    DATA: ls_empty_data TYPE ty_empty_struct.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_component_values) = lo_cut->get_struct_component_values( REF #( ls_empty_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_component_values msg = 'Empty struct should return empty table' ).
  ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, die Struktur und Eigenschaften von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit dynamisch zu analysieren (ab ABAP 7.40). Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, z.B. bei der Implementierung von Tools oder bei der Verarbeitung von Daten aus flexiblen Schnittstellen. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` ist der moderne Weg, um diese Informationen zu erhalten.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Description, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine Liste von Zahlen, die als String-Template generiert wurden, und dekomprimieren Sie sie anschließend wieder.
hint: Kombinieren Sie String-Templates für die Eingabe mit FOR-Expressions und den Methoden von /UI2/CL_NUMBER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_num_template_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers_from_template
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_num TYPE i
        iv_count     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_original_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_num_template_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers_from_template.
    DATA lt_generated_numbers TYPE string_table.
    DATA lt_compressed_numbers TYPE string_table.
    DATA lt_decompressed_numbers TYPE string_table.

    " Generate numbers using a FOR loop and String Templates
    lt_generated_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR i = 0 UNTIL iv_count
      ( |{ iv_start_num + i }| )
    ).

    " Compress the generated numbers
    lt_compressed_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR num IN lt_generated_numbers
      ( /ui2/cl_number=>compress_number( num ) )
    ).

    " Decompress the numbers
    lt_decompressed_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR comp_num IN lt_compressed_numbers
      ( /ui2/cl_number=>decompress_number( comp_num ) )
    ).

    rt_original_numbers = lt_decompressed_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->process_numbers_from_template( iv_start_num = lv_start iv_count = lv_count ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table(

      ( |{ lv_start + i }| )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Dekomprimierte Zahlen sollten den ursprünglich generierten Zahlen entsprechen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine Zahl nur, wenn sie eine bestimmte Länge überschreitet, andernfalls geben Sie die Originalzahl zurück. Verwenden Sie /UI2/CL_NUMBER und eine COND-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND string(...)` mit einer Bedingung, die die Länge der Eingabezahl prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_num_cond_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS conditional_compress
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE string
        iv_min_length TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_number) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_num_cond_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD conditional_compress.
    rv_processed_number = COND string(
      WHEN strlen( iv_number ) > iv_min_length
      THEN /ui2/cl_number=>compress_number( iv_number )
      ELSE iv_number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_compress FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_compress.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_ui2_num_cond_compress( ).

    " Testfall 1: Zahl ist länger als Mindestlänge, sollte komprimiert werden
    DATA(lv_long_num) = '123456789'.
    DATA(lv_compressed_long) = lo_processor->conditional_compress( lv_long_num ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( strlen( lv_compressed_long ) < strlen( lv_long_num ) ) msg = 'Lange Zahl sollte komprimiert werden' ).

    " Testfall 2: Zahl ist kürzer als Mindestlänge, sollte nicht komprimiert werden
    DATA(lv_short_num) = '123'.
    DATA(lv_uncompressed_short) = lo_processor->conditional_compress( lv_short_num ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_uncompressed_short exp = lv_short_num msg = 'Kurze Zahl sollte nicht komprimiert werden' ).

    " Testfall 3: Zahl hat genau die Mindestlänge, sollte nicht komprimiert werden
    DATA(lv_exact_num) = '12345'.
    DATA(lv_uncompressed_exact) = lo_processor->conditional_compress( lv_exact_num ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_uncompressed_exact exp = lv_exact_num msg = 'Zahl mit exakter Länge sollte nicht komprimiert werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine elegante und kompakte Implementierung von bedingter Logik. Hier wird sie verwendet, um zu entscheiden, ob eine Zahl basierend auf ihrer Länge komprimiert werden soll, was die Lesbarkeit des Codes verbessert und Boilerplate-Code reduziert.
keywords: /UI2/CL_NUMBER, COMPRESS_NUMBER, COND, Conditional Logic, String Length

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_count_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle nicht leer ist, wenn Daten vorhanden sind

    " Beispiel-Assertion für einen bekannten Carrier (angenommen 'LH' existiert)
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    IF ls_lh_count IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH Flüge sollten gezählt werden' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Robusterer Test: Überprüfen der Gesamtzahl der Flüge
    DATA(lv_total_flights_in_result) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lv_total_flights_in_result = lv_total_flights_in_result + ls_entry-flight_count.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_expected_total_from_db) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_total_from_db.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_flights_in_result exp = lv_expected_total_from_db msg = 'Gesamtzahl der Flüge stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` zur Gruppierung von Daten in einer internen Tabelle. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe, was eine effiziente Zählung ermöglicht. Die Syntax ist kompakt und gut lesbar und nutzt moderne Inline-Deklarationen.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, LOOP, GROUP SIZE, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für jede eindeutige Flugverbindung (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Berücksichtigen Sie nur Flüge in 'EUR'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_connection_price.
    TYPES tt_connection_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_prices
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_total_prices) TYPE tt_connection_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                 connid = ls_flight-connid )
      INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR <member> IN GROUP group_key WHERE ( currency = 'EUR' )
        NEXT s = s + <member>-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid
                      connid = group_key-connid
                      total_price = lv_sum_price ) TO rt_total_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle nicht leer ist, wenn Daten vorhanden sind

    " Beispiel-Assertion für eine spezifische Verbindung (angenommen 'LH' '0400' existiert und hat EUR Preise)
    DATA(ls_test_conn) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    IF ls_test_conn IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_test_conn-total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH 0400 sollte berechnet werden' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Robusterer Test: Überprüfen, ob mindestens ein Eintrag einen Preis hat
    DATA(lv_has_price) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE total_price > 0.
      lv_has_price = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_price msg = 'Mindestens eine Verbindung sollte einen Gesamtpreis > 0 haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator. `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten innerhalb jeder Gruppe in einer einzigen Anweisung, hier zur Summenbildung der Flugpreise. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb von `REDUCE` filtert zusätzlich nach der Währung, was die Flexibilität erhöht. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Syntax.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum, WHERE

CLASS zcl_grp_collect_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

      APPEND VALUE #( fldate = group_key-fldate
                      connids = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle nicht leer ist, wenn Daten vorhanden sind
