Instructions: Finden Sie für jedes Ziel (Ankunftsflughafen) den teuersten Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`, sortieren Sie die Gruppe und lesen Sie das erste Element.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_most_expensive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_expensive_flight,
             airpfrom TYPE s_airp_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_expensive_flight.
    TYPES tt_expensive_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_expensive_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_most_expensive_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_expensive_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_most_expensive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_most_expensive_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-airpfrom ASCENDING INTO DATA(group_key).
      SORT GROUP group_key BY price DESCENDING.
      READ TABLE GROUP group_key INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_most_expensive).

      APPEND VALUE #( airpfrom = group_key-airpfrom
                      carrid = ls_most_expensive-carrid
                      connid = ls_most_expensive-connid
                      price = ls_most_expensive-price
                      currency = ls_most_expensive-currency ) TO rt_expensive_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_most_expensive_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_most_expensive_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_most_expensive( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_most_expensive_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle nicht leer ist, wenn Daten vorhanden sind

    " Beispiel-Assertion für einen spezifischen Abflugort (angenommen 'FRANKFURT' existiert)
    DATA(ls_frankfurt_exp) = lt_result[ KEY airpfrom COMPONENTS airpfrom = 'FRANKFURT' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    IF ls_frankfurt_exp IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_frankfurt_exp-price exp = 0 msg = 'Der teuerste Flug von FRANKFURT sollte einen Preis haben' ).
      " Weitere Prüfungen könnten den Vergleich mit dem manuell ermittelten Maximalpreis für 'FRANKFURT' umfassen
    ENDIF.

    " Robusterer Test: Überprüfen, ob irgendein Eintrag einen Preis hat
    DATA(lv_has_price) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE price > 0.
      lv_has_price = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_price msg = 'Mindestens ein Ziel sollte einen teuersten Flug mit Preis > 0 haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `GROUP BY`. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird die interne Tabelle mit `SORT GROUP` nach dem Preis absteigend sortiert. Anschließend wird mit `READ TABLE GROUP INDEX 1` der teuerste Flug der Gruppe ermittelt. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Top-N-Elemente pro Gruppe zu finden, und nutzt moderne Inline-Deklarationen.
keywords: GROUP BY, SORT, Internal Tables, Max, Aggregation, Read Table Group

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Jahr und Monat des Flugdatums und zählen Sie die Anzahl der verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften, die in diesem Zeitraum Flüge durchgeführt haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit abgeleiteten Feldern für die Gruppierung und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` für die Zählung eindeutiger Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_month_carrier_count,
             year TYPE char4,
             month TYPE char2,
             distinct_carrier_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_month_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_month_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_month_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_carriers_by_month
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_month_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers_by_month.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ( year = ls_flight-fldate(4)
                 month = ls_flight-fldate+4(2) )
      INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(lt_carriers_in_group) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id(
        FOR <member> IN GROUP group_key
        ( <member>-carrid )
      ).
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_carriers_in_group.

      APPEND VALUE #( year = group_key-year
                      month = group_key-month
                      distinct_carrier_count = lines( lt_carriers_in_group ) ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_distinct_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_distinct_carriers_by_month( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle nicht leer ist, wenn Daten vorhanden sind

    " Beispiel-Assertion für einen spezifischen Monat (angenommen '2025' '11' hat Daten)
    DATA(ls_test_month) = lt_result[ KEY year COMPONENTS year = '2025' month = '11' DEFAULT VALUE #( ) ].
    IF ls_test_month IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_test_month-distinct_carrier_count exp = 0 msg = 'Eindeutige Carrier sollten für 2025/11 gezählt werden' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Robusterer Test: Überprüfen, ob irgendein Eintrag einen Zähler > 0 hat
    DATA(lv_has_count) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE distinct_carrier_count > 0.
      lv_has_count = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_count msg = 'Mindestens ein Monat sollte eindeutige Carrier-Zähler > 0 haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Gruppierung nach abgeleiteten Feldern (Jahr und Monat aus dem Flugdatum). Innerhalb jeder Gruppe werden alle Fluggesellschaften gesammelt und anschließend mit `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` die eindeutigen gezählt. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Methode zur Analyse von Daten nach komplexeren Kriterien und nutzt die Stärke von `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: GROUP BY, Date, Internal Tables, Distinct, Aggregation, Derived Fields, Value Operator, For Expression

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle gültigen E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und eine geeignete E-Mail-Regex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fnd_extract_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_emails TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_emails.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnd_extract_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    " Eine gängige Regex für E-Mail-Adressen (vereinfacht)
    CONSTANTS lc_email_regex TYPE string VALUE '\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lc_email_regex
      IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_results).

    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Finden Sie das Wort 'Flug' in einem Satz und geben Sie das Wort zurück, das direkt davor steht. Wenn 'Flug' das erste Wort ist, geben Sie einen leeren String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` und String-Operationen wie Slicing und `FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fnd_word_before DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_word_before
      IMPORTING iv_sentence TYPE string
                iv_search_word TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_word_before) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnd_word_before IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_word_before.
    FIND iv_search_word IN iv_sentence MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_offset > 0.
      DATA(lv_part_before) = iv_sentence(lv_offset).
      FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF ' ' IN lv_part_before MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_space_offset).

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_word_before = lv_part_before+lv_space_offset+1.
      ELSE.
        " Wenn kein Leerzeichen gefunden wurde, ist das Wort das erste im Teil vor dem Suchwort
        rv_word_before = lv_part_before.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Test case 4: Wort nach Satzzeichen
    DATA(lv_result4) = lo_cut->get_word_before( iv_sentence = 'Ein langer, Flug ist anstrengend.' iv_search_word = 'Flug' ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine leere Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein und weisen Sie diese einem Feldsymbol zu, um sie direkt zu bearbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE ... ASSIGNING <FS>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_initial_and_fill
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_initial_and_fill.
    DATA(lt_local_table) = VALUE tt_data( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ty_data.

    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO TABLE lt_local_table ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_data>-id = iv_id.
      <fs_data>-text = iv_text.
    ENDIF.
    rt_table = lt_local_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_initial_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_initial_and_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_initial( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_initial_and_fill( iv_id = 10 iv_text = 'New Entry' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Table should contain one line'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id
      exp = 10
      msg = 'ID of the first line should be 10'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-text
      exp = 'New Entry'
      msg = 'Text of the first line should be New Entry'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einfügen einer Initialzeile mit `ASSIGNING <FS>` ist eine performante Methode, um eine neue Zeile zu erstellen und sofort mit Daten zu füllen, ohne eine temporäre Arbeitszeile verwenden zu müssen. Dies vermeidet unnötige Datenkopien.
keywords: INSERT INITIAL LINE, ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Table, Performance

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Flugverbindung in die Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS ein, wobei die Daten für die Arbeitszeile mit dem VALUE-Operator erstellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie INSERT INTO <db_table> VALUES @<work_area> und den VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_data.
    DATA(ls_sflights) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
      planetype = 'BOEING747' " Example default
      seatsmax  = 300
      seatsocc  = 0
    ).

    INSERT INTO sflights VALUES @ls_sflights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid)   = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid)   = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate)   = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_price)    = '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_currency) = 'EUR'.

    " Clean up potential existing entry before test
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_data(
      iv_carrid   = lv_carrid
      iv_connid   = lv_connid
      iv_fldate   = lv_fldate
      iv_price    = lv_price
      iv_currency = lv_currency
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Insert into SFLIGHTS should be successful'
    ).

    " Verify insertion
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc
      msg = 'Entry should exist in SFLIGHTS'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_check-price
      exp = lv_price
      msg = 'Price should match'
    ).

    " Clean up after test
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT`-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen ist seit langem etabliert. Die Modernität kommt hier durch die Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators zur direkten Konstruktion der Arbeitszeile, die dann mit der Inline-Deklaration `@ls_sflights` und dem `@`-Escape-Zeichen für Hostvariablen in die Datenbank eingefügt wird.
keywords: INSERT DATABASE, VALUE, Host Variable, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Fügen Sie nur die Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, indem Sie den FILTER-Operator verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den FILTER-Operator mit INSERT LINES OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_filtered_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_data
        iv_min_id       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_filtered_lines.
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_data( ).

    INSERT LINES OF FILTER #( it_source_table WHERE id > iv_min_id ) INTO TABLE lt_target.
    rt_target_table = lt_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_filtered_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_filtered_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_it_insert_filter=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Low' )
      ( id = 5 text = 'Medium' )
      ( id = 10 text = 'High' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_filtered_lines(
      it_source_table = lt_source
      iv_min_id       = 3
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Target table should contain two filtered lines'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id
      exp = 5
      msg = 'First filtered ID should be 5'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id
      exp = 10
      msg = 'Second filtered ID should be 10'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40, hier 7.50 für komplexere Szenarien) ermöglicht das einfache Filtern von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `INSERT LINES OF` können so nur die relevanten Zeilen effizient in eine andere Tabelle eingefügt werden, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: INSERT LINES OF, FILTER, Internal Table, Conditional

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Zeile, deren Werte aus einer Berechnung oder Transformation anderer Daten stammen, und fügen Sie diese in eine interne Tabelle ein. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen FOR-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck innerhalb des VALUE-Operators für die Zeilenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_for_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_input.
    TYPES tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_output,
             original_value TYPE i,
             squared_value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_output.
    TYPES tt_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_calculated_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_input_values TYPE tt_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_table) TYPE tt_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_for_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_calculated_lines.
    " Using FOR expression to create a new table directly, then inserting its lines.
    " Alternatively, one could insert line by line within a FOR loop.
    DATA(lt_calculated_lines) = VALUE tt_output(
      FOR <wa> IN it_input_values
      ( original_value = <wa>-value
        squared_value  = <wa>-value * <wa>-value )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF lt_calculated_lines INTO TABLE rt_output_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_calculated_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_calculated_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_for_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_insert_for_expr=>tt_input(
      ( value = 2 )
      ( value = 3 )
      ( value = 4 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_calculated_lines( it_input_values = lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Output table should contain three lines'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-original_value
      exp = 2
      msg = 'First original value should be 2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-squared_value
      exp = 4
      msg = 'First squared value should be 4'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ]-original_value
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Third original value should be 4'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ]-squared_value
      exp = 16
      msg = 'Third squared value should be 16'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Transformation von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine neue Zieltabelle in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine temporäre Tabelle mit berechneten Werten zu füllen, deren Zeilen dann mit `INSERT LINES OF` in die Ergebnis-Tabelle eingefügt werden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: INSERT LINES OF, FOR Expression, VALUE, Internal Table, Transformation

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein und demonstrieren Sie, dass die Tabelle automatisch sortiert bleibt.
hint: Definieren Sie eine SORTED TABLE und verwenden Sie INSERT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data
                      WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field. " Unique key for clear sorting behavior

    METHODS insert_into_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE i
        iv_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_into_sorted_table.
    INSERT VALUE ty_data( key_field = iv_key value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE ct_table.
    " No explicit sort needed, table remains sorted by key_field
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_into_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_into_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_table) = zcl_it_insert_sorted=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 10 value = 'Ten' )
      ( key_field = 30 value = 'Thirty' )
    ).

    lo_cut->insert_into_sorted_table(
      EXPORTING iv_key = 20 iv_value = 'Twenty'
      CHANGING  ct_table = lt_sorted_table
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sorted_table )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Table should contain three lines'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_table[ 1 ]-key_field
      exp = 10
      msg = 'First element key should be 10'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_table[ 2 ]-key_field
      exp = 20
      msg = 'Second element key should be 20 (inserted and sorted)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_table[ 3 ]-key_field
      exp = 30
      msg = 'Third element key should be 30'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Sortierte Tabellen (`SORTED TABLE`) behalten ihre Sortierreihenfolge automatisch bei, wenn Zeilen eingefügt werden. Das `INSERT`-Statement platziert die neue Zeile an der korrekten Position, ohne dass ein explizites `SORT`-Statement erforderlich ist. Dies ist effizient für Tabellen, die immer sortiert sein müssen.
keywords: INSERT, SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, Automatic Sorting

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine Hash-Tabelle ein und überprüfen Sie die Performance beim Zugriff über den Hash-Schlüssel.
hint: Definieren Sie eine HASHED TABLE und verwenden Sie INSERT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_hashed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data
                      WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_into_hashed_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_hashed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_into_hashed_table.
    INSERT VALUE ty_data( key_field = iv_key value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE ct_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_into_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_into_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_hashed( ).
    DATA(lt_hashed_table) = zcl_it_insert_hashed=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Apple' )
      ( key_field = 'C' value = 'Cherry' )
    ).

    lo_cut->insert_into_hashed_table(
      EXPORTING iv_key = 'B' iv_value = 'Banana'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_hashed_table )
      exp = 3

    READ TABLE lt_hashed_table WITH TABLE KEY key_field = 'B' INTO DATA(ls_found).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc
      msg = 'Entry with key B should be found'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_found-value
      exp = 'Banana'
      msg = 'Value for key B should be Banana'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hash-Tabellen (`HASHED TABLE`) bieten den schnellsten Zugriff auf Zeilen über ihren eindeutigen Schlüssel, da die Position der Zeile direkt über eine Hash-Funktion berechnet wird. Das `INSERT`-Statement fügt die Zeile effizient ein und gewährleistet die Integrität des Hash-Schlüssels.
keywords: INSERT, HASHED TABLE, Internal Table, Key Access

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Verhalten von INSERT bei einer sortierten Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel, wenn versucht wird, eine Zeile mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel einzufügen.
hint: Beachten Sie den Wert von SY-SUBRC nach dem INSERT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_unique_fail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data
                      WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_duplicate_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE i
        iv_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_subrc) TYPE sy-subrc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_unique_fail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_duplicate_key.
    INSERT VALUE ty_data( key_field = iv_key value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE ct_table.
    rv_subrc = sy-subrc.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_duplicate_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_unique_fail( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_table) = zcl_it_insert_unique_fail=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 10 value = 'Original' )
    ).

    " First insert should be successful
    DATA(lv_subrc_first) = lo_cut->insert_duplicate_key(
      EXPORTING iv_key = 20 iv_value = 'New Entry'
      CHANGING  ct_table = lt_unique_table
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_subrc_first
      msg = 'First insert should be successful (SY-SUBRC = 0)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_table )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Table should contain two lines after first insert'
    ).

    " Attempt to insert a duplicate key
    DATA(lv_subrc_duplicate) = lo_cut->insert_duplicate_key(
      EXPORTING iv_key = 10 iv_value = 'Duplicate Attempt'
      CHANGING  ct_table = lt_unique_table
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_subrc_duplicate
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Insert with duplicate key should fail (SY-SUBRC = 4)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_table )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Table size should remain 2 after failed insert'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_unique_table[ 1 ]-value
      exp = 'Original'
      msg = 'Original value for key 10 should not be overwritten'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei internen Tabellen mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) führt der Versuch, eine Zeile mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel einzufügen, zu einem Laufzeitfehler (SY-SUBRC = 4). Dies ist ein wichtiges Verhalten für die Datenintegrität und muss bei der Programmierung berücksichtigt werden. Der `VALUE`-Operator wird hier zur kompakten Zeilendefinition verwendet.
keywords: INSERT, UNIQUE KEY, SORTED TABLE, SY-SUBRC, Error Handling, Internal Table

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die eine Referenz auf ein Objekt enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den INSERT-Befehl mit einer Datenstruktur, die einen Referenztyp enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             object TYPE REF TO if_abap_behv_message,
           END OF ty_object_data.
    TYPES tt_object_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_object_reference
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
        io_object TYPE REF TO if_abap_behv_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_table) TYPE tt_object_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_object_reference.
    DATA(lt_local_table) = VALUE tt_object_data( ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_object_data( id = iv_id object = io_object ) INTO TABLE lt_local_table.
    rt_table = lt_local_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_object_reference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_object_reference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_insert_ref( ).
    DATA(lo_message_object) = CAST if_abap_behv_message( NEW zcl_it_insert_ref( ) ). " Use CUT itself as a dummy object

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_object_reference(
      iv_id = 1
      io_object = lo_message_object
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Table should contain one line'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-object
      msg = 'Object reference should not be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id
      exp = 1
      msg = 'ID of the first line should be 1'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einfügen von Zeilen, die Objektreferenzen enthalten, ist ein grundlegendes Konzept in der objektorientierten Programmierung mit ABAP. Der `INSERT`-Befehl funktioniert hier nahtlos mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine Struktur mit der Objektreferenz zu erstellen und in die interne Tabelle einzufügen. Dies ermöglicht die Verwaltung von Objekten in Tabellenstrukturen.
keywords: INSERT, Object Reference, Internal Table, Object Orientation

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die eine Tabelle als Komponente enthält (Tabelle in Tabelle).

solution:

    INSERT VALUE ty_outer_data( header_id = iv_header_id items = it_items ) INTO TABLE lt_local_table.
    rt_table = lt_local_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldkatalog für eine ALV-Anzeige, wobei die Felder und deren Eigenschaften zur Laufzeit definiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und füllen Sie den Feldkatalog (`LVC_T_FCAT`) manuell.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_dynamic_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_fcat         TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    " 1. Define field catalog dynamically
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_fcat>).
    <ls_fcat>-fieldname = 'FIELD1'.
    <ls_fcat>-inttype   = 'C'.
    <ls_fcat>-intlen    = 10.
    <ls_fcat>-coltext   = 'Text Field'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_fcat ASSIGNING <ls_fcat>.
    <ls_fcat>-fieldname = 'FIELD2'.
    <ls_fcat>-inttype   = 'I'.
    <ls_fcat>-intlen    = 4.
    <ls_fcat>-coltext   = 'Number Field'.

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table based on field catalog
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create
      EXPORTING
        i_field_catalog = lt_fcat.

    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 3. Populate the dynamic table
    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    DO 3 TIMES.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
        <lv_field2> = sy-index * 100.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " 4. Display the dynamic table using CL_SALV_TABLE
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
    ).

    lo_salv_table->display( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit benutzerdefinierten Daten, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen generiert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " C, I, D, T, P, F
             len  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_display_custom_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_custom_alv.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    " 1. Build components table for RTTI
    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_component>).
      <ls_component>-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'C'.
          <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = ls_field_def-len ).
        WHEN 'I'.
          <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN 'D'.
          <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
        WHEN 'T'.
          <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_t( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle other types or raise error
          <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = 20 ).
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table using CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE with RTTI
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create
      EXPORTING
        i_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 3. Populate the dynamic table with some sample data
    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    DO 2 TIMES.
      LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_field_def-type.
            WHEN 'C'.
              <lv_field_value> = |Char { sy-index }-{ ls_field_def-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <lv_field_value> = sy-index * 10 + sy-tabix.
            WHEN 'D'.
              <lv_field_value> = sy-datum.
            WHEN 'T'.
              <lv_field_value> = sy-uzeit.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.

    " 4. Display the dynamic table
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
    ).

    lo_salv_table->display( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_custom_alv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dynamic_alv_rtti=>tt_field_def.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_field_defs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_field_def>).

Dies ist die flexibelste Methode, um ALVs zu generieren, wenn weder die Datenstruktur noch ein Referenztyp bekannt sind.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachgestellte Leerzeichen aus einem String und vergleichen Sie die Methode `SHIFT` mit modernen String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT ... DELETING LEADING/TRAILING` und die String-Funktion `strip`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_vs_string_func DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_spaces_shift
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_shift) TYPE string.

    METHODS remove_spaces_strip
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_strip) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_vs_string_func IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_spaces_shift.
    rv_cleaned_shift = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_cleaned_shift LEFT DELETING LEADING space.
    SHIFT rv_cleaned_shift RIGHT DELETING TRAILING space.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_spaces_strip.
    rv_cleaned_strip = strip( val = iv_input leading = abap_true trailing = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_vs_string_func( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = '   Hello World   '.

    DATA(lv_result_shift) = lo_cut->remove_spaces_shift( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_shift exp = 'Hello World' ).

    DATA(lv_result_strip) = lo_cut->remove_spaces_strip( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_strip exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die traditionelle `SHIFT` Anweisung mit der modernen String-Funktion `strip` (ab ABAP 7.50). Während `SHIFT` präzise Kontrolle über das Entfernen von Zeichen bietet, ist `strip` oft lesbarer und kürzer für gängige Aufgaben wie das Entfernen von führenden und nachgestellten Leerzeichen.
keywords: SHIFT, String Processing, strip, String Functions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Untermenge der Felder von `SFLIGHT` und zeigen Sie diese an. Die auszuwählenden Felder sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und RTTI, um die Struktur der dynamischen Tabelle zu definieren, und `SELECT ... CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_subset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_subset_alv
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>name_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_subset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_subset_alv.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_sflight_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <lt_sflight_source> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " 1. Get description of SFLIGHT structure
    lo_sflight_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " 2. Build components table for dynamic structure based on requested fields
    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      DATA(ls_component_source) = lo_sflight_descr->get_component( lv_fieldname ).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_component>).
      <ls_component>-name = ls_component_source-name.
      <ls_component>-type = ls_component_source-type.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create
      EXPORTING
        i_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Select data into a temporary table and then move to dynamic table
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_sflight_source>.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_sflight_source> UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " 5. Move data from source table to dynamic target table
    <lt_dynamic_table> = CORRESPONDING #( <lt_sflight_source> ).

    " 6. Display the dynamic table
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
    ).

    lo_salv_table->display( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens aus einem String, sowohl mit `SHIFT` als auch mit modernen String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT ... DELETING ALL OCCURRENCES` und die String-Funktion `replace`.

CLASS zcl_shift_vs_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_char_shift
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
        iv_char   TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_shift) TYPE string.

    METHODS remove_char_replace
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
        iv_char   TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_replace) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_vs_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_char_shift.
    rv_cleaned_shift = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_cleaned_shift LEFT DELETING ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_char.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_char_replace.
    rv_cleaned_replace = replace( val = iv_input old = iv_char new = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_vs_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'A-B-C-D'.
    DATA(lv_char_to_remove) = '-'.

    DATA(lv_result_shift) = lo_cut->remove_char_shift( iv_input = lv_input iv_char = lv_char_to_remove ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert zwei Wege, um alle Vorkommen eines Zeichens aus einem String zu entfernen: die traditionelle `SHIFT ... DELETING ALL OCCURRENCES` Anweisung und die moderne String-Funktion `replace`. Die `replace`-Funktion ist oft prägnanter und lesbarer für diese Aufgabe.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer beliebigen Referenzstruktur abgeleitet wird, und fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte hinzu. Zeigen Sie die Tabelle an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` mit `i_struct_descr` und manipulieren Sie die Komponentenliste des `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_add_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_alv
      IMPORTING
        i_ref_struct_name TYPE tabname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_add_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_alv.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_ref_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lt_source_table>  TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " 1. Get components of the reference structure
    lo_ref_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( i_ref_struct_name ).
    lt_components = lo_ref_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Add a new component (column)
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_component>).
    <ls_component>-name = 'NEW_FIELD'.
    <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = 20 ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table with the modified structure
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create
      EXPORTING
        i_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Populate with data from source (e.g., SFLIGHT) and fill new column
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_source_table>.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_source_table> UP TO 3 ROWS.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_source_line>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      " Move existing fields
      <ls_dynamic_line> = CORRESPONDING #( <ls_source_line> ).
      " Fill new field
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NEW_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_new_field>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_new_field> = |Added Data { sy-tabix }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 5. Display the dynamic table
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
    ).

    lo_salv_table->display( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_column FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_column.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_add_col( ).
    lo_cut->create_and_display_alv( i_ref_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Dummy-Assert
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es wird eine bestehende Struktur (`SFLIGHT`) als Basis genommen, deren Komponentenliste dynamisch erweitert und dann eine neue interne Tabelle mit dieser modifizierten Struktur erstellt. Dies ist ideal, um flexible ALV-Berichte zu generieren, die zur Laufzeit um zusätzliche Informationen ergänzt werden müssen.
keywords: cl_alv_table_create, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, ALV, CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen aus einem String, die sich zwischen Wörtern befinden, sodass nur ein einzelnes Leerzeichen zwischen Wörtern verbleibt. Vergleichen Sie `SHIFT` mit `CONDENSE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT ... DELETING LEADING/TRAILING` in Kombination mit `CONDENSE` oder `replace` mit Regex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_condense_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_spaces_shift_condense
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS clean_spaces_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_condense_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_spaces_shift_condense.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_cleaned_string LEFT DELETING LEADING space.
    SHIFT rv_cleaned_string RIGHT DELETING TRAILING space.
    CONDENSE rv_cleaned_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD clean_spaces_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_regex.
    DATA(lo_matcher) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_matcher.

    " Replace multiple spaces with a single space
    CREATE OBJECT lo_regex EXPORTING pattern = '\s+' ignore_case = abap_true.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_matcher EXPORTING regex = lo_regex text = iv_input.
    rv_cleaned_string = lo_matcher->replace( new = ' ' ).

    " Trim leading/trailing spaces
    rv_cleaned_string = strip( val = rv_cleaned_string leading = abap_true trailing = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_clean_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_condense_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = '   Hello   World   ABAP   '.

    DATA(lv_result_shift_condense) = lo_cut->clean_spaces_shift_condense( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_shift_condense exp = 'Hello World ABAP' ).

    DATA(lv_result_regex) = lo_cut->clean_spaces_regex( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_regex exp = 'Hello World ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt zwei Ansätze zur Normalisierung von Leerzeichen in einem String. Die Kombination aus `SHIFT` und `CONDENSE` ist eine klassische Methode. Die moderne Alternative verwendet reguläre Ausdrücke (`cl_abap_regex`, `cl_abap_matcher`) und die `strip`-Funktion, was oft flexibler und ausdrucksstärker ist, insbesondere bei komplexeren Mustererkennungen.
keywords: SHIFT, CONDENSE, String Processing, REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, CL_ABAP_MATCHER, strip

Instructions: Verschieben Sie einen String nach rechts, wobei die freigewordenen Positionen mit einem bestimmten Zeichen gefüllt werden.

        iv_fill_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_fill IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_shifted_string = iv_input.
    SHIFT rv_shifted_string BY iv_places PLACES RIGHT FILLING iv_fill_char.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shift_right_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_right_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_fill( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->shift_right_fill( iv_input = 'ABCDEFG' iv_places = 3 iv_fill_char = '*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '***ABCD' ).

Dies ist nützlich für die Formatierung von Strings, z.B. zum Auffüllen mit Nullen oder anderen Platzhaltern.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit aus einer beliebigen Referenzstruktur abgeleitet wird. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT` und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte hinzu, die zur Laufzeit definiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` mit `i_struct_descr`, manipulieren Sie die Komponentenliste und nutzen Sie Feld-Symbole für die dynamische Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_calc_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_alv
      IMPORTING
        i_ref_struct_name TYPE tabname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_calc_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_alv.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_ref_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lt_source_table>  TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " 1. Get components of the reference structure
    lo_ref_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( i_ref_struct_name ).
    lt_components = lo_ref_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " 2. Add a new calculated component (column)
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_component>).
    <ls_component>-name = 'FLIGHT_DURATION'.
    <ls_component>-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table with the modified structure
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create
      EXPORTING
        i_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lr_data
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Populate with data from SFLIGHT and calculate new column
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_source_table>.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_source_table> UP TO 3 ROWS.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_source_line>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      " Move existing fields
      <ls_dynamic_line> = CORRESPONDING #( <ls_source_line> ).

      " Calculate and fill new field
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DEPTIME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_deptime>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ARRTIME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_arrtime>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLIGHT_DURATION' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_duration>).

      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_deptime> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_arrtime> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
        DATA(lv_dep_sec) = <lv_deptime>+0(2) * 3600 + <lv_deptime>+2(2) * 60 + <lv_deptime>+4(2).
        DATA(lv_arr_sec) = <lv_arrtime>+0(2) * 3600 + <lv_arrtime>+2(2) * 60 + <lv_arrtime>+4(2).
        <lv_duration> = ( lv_arr_sec - lv_dep_sec ) / 60. " Duration in minutes
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 5. Display the dynamic table
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
    ).

    lo_salv_table->display( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculated_column FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculated_column.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_calc_col( ).
    lo_cut->create_and_display_alv( i_ref_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Dummy-Assert
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung um eine berechnete Spalte. Die Struktur wird aus einer Referenzstruktur abgeleitet und um ein neues Feld erweitert. Anschließend werden die Daten aus der Quelle gelesen, in die dynamische Tabelle verschoben und die neue Spalte mit zur Laufzeit berechneten Werten gefüllt. Dies zeigt die volle Flexibilität von `cl_alv_table_create` in Verbindung mit RTTI und Feld-Symbolen.
keywords: cl_alv_table_create, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, ALV, CORRESPONDING, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String nur aus numerischen Zeichen besteht, sowohl mit `SHIFT` als auch mit modernen String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT ... LEFT DELETING NON-NUMERIC` und die String-Funktion `matches` mit Regex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_is_numeric DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_numeric_shift
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS is_numeric_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_is_numeric IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_numeric_shift.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    SHIFT lv_temp LEFT DELETING NON-NUMERIC.
    IF lv_temp = iv_input.
      rv_is_numeric = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_numeric = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_numeric_regex.
    rv_is_numeric = matches( val = iv_input regex = '^\d+$' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_numeric FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_numeric.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_is_numeric( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_numeric_shift( '12345' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_numeric_shift( '123A45' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_numeric_shift( '' ) exp = abap_true ). " Empty string is considered numeric by SHIFT

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_numeric_regex( '12345' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_numeric_regex( '123A45' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_numeric_regex( '' ) exp = abap_false ). " Empty string is not numeric by regex ^\d+$
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt zwei Methoden zur Überprüfung, ob ein String rein numerisch ist. Die `SHIFT ... DELETING NON-NUMERIC` Anweisung entfernt alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen; ein Vergleich mit dem Originalstring zeigt dann, ob Änderungen vorgenommen wurden. Die moderne `matches`-Funktion mit einem regulären Ausdruck (`^\d+$`) ist oft präziser und flexibler, da sie auch leere Strings oder spezifische numerische Formate berücksichtigen kann.
keywords: SHIFT, String Processing, DELETING NON-NUMERIC, matches, REGEX, String Functions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der auf eine GET-Anfrage mit einer einfachen HTML-Seite antwortet, die 'Hello World' anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_HTTP_SERVER->REQUEST und CL_HTTP_SERVER->RESPONSE, um die Anfrage zu verarbeiten und die Antwort zu senden. Kapseln Sie die HTML-Generierung in einer separaten Methode für bessere Testbarkeit.

CLASS zcl_http_hello_world DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. INTERFACES if_http_extension. METHODS get_hello_world_html RETURNING VALUE(rv_html) TYPE string. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_http_hello_world IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request. DATA(lv_html) = get_hello_world_html( ). server->response->set_cdata( lv_html ). server->response->set_content_type( 'text/html' ). server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ). server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Cache-Control' value = 'no-cache' ). ENDMETHOD. METHOD get_hello_world_html. rv_html = |Hello

Hello World!

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der eine POST-Anfrage mit einem JSON-Payload entgegennimmt (z.B. {"message": "Hello"}). Der Service soll den empfangenen JSON-Inhalt parsen und eine JSON-Antwort mit einer Bestätigung zurückgeben (z.B. {"status": "received", "your_message": "Hello"}).
hint: Verwenden Sie SERVER->REQUEST->GET_CDATA() für den Request-Body und /UI2/CL_JSON für JSON-Verarbeitung. CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE ist für die Konvertierung des Request-Bodys notwendig.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_request.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response,
             status      TYPE string,
             your_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response.

    METHODS process_json_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_payload TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_response) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_request_body_x) = server->request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA(lv_request_body) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_request_body_x ).

    DATA(lv_json_response) = process_json_request( lv_json_payload = lv_request_body ).

    server->response->set_cdata( lv_json_response ).
    server->response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Cache-Control' value = 'no-cache' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_json_request.
    DATA: ls_request  TYPE ty_request,
          ls_response TYPE ty_response.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_payload CHANGING data = ls_request ).
        ls_response-status = 'received'.
        ls_response-your_message = ls_request-message.
        rv_json_response = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_response ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error.
        ls_response-status = 'error'.
        ls_response-your_message = 'Invalid JSON payload'.
        rv_json_response = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_response ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der eine statische CSS-Datei aus dem MIME-Repository (z.B. /SAP/PUBLIC/Z_MY_CSS.CSS) ausliefert. Der Content-Type soll korrekt gesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_MIME_REPOSITORY_API zum Lesen der Datei und SERVER->RESPONSE->SET_DATA() sowie SET_CONTENT_TYPE().
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_serve_css DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
    METHODS get_css_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_css_content) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_serve_css IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_mime_path) = '/SAP/PUBLIC/Z_MY_CSS.CSS'. " Example path, ensure it exists or create it
    DATA(lv_css_xstring) = get_css_content( lv_mime_path ).

    IF lv_css_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      server->response->set_data( lv_css_xstring ).
      server->response->set_content_type( 'text/css' ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ELSE.
      server->response->set_status( code = 404 reason = 'Not Found' ).
      server->response->set_cdata( 'CSS file not found.' ).
      server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
    ENDIF.
    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Cache-Control' value = 'public, max-age=3600' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_css_content.
    DATA: lo_mime_api TYPE REF TO cl_mime_repository_api,
          lv_content  TYPE xstring.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_mime_api.
    TRY.
        lo_mime_api->get(
          EXPORTING
            i_url     = iv_mime_path
          IMPORTING
            e_content = lv_content
        ).
        rv_css_content = lv_content.
      CATCH cx_mime_repository_exception.
        CLEAR rv_css_content.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der bei einer ungültigen Anfrage (z.B. fehlender Pflichtparameter) einen HTTP-Statuscode 400 (Bad Request) mit einer aussagekräftigen Fehlermeldung als JSON zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie SERVER->RESPONSE->SET_STATUS() und /UI2/CL_JSON für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_response,
             error_code TYPE string,
             message    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error_response.

    METHODS get_error_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_param) = server->request->get_form_field( 'required_param' ).

    IF lv_param IS INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_error_json) = get_error_json( 'Missing required parameter: required_param' ).
      server->response->set_cdata( lv_error_json ).
      server->response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
    ELSE.
      server->response->set_cdata( |{"status":"success","param_value":"{ lv_param }"}| ).
      server->response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ENDIF.
    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Cache-Control' value = 'no-cache' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_error_json.
    DATA: ls_error TYPE ty_error_response.
    ls_error-error_code = 'BAD_REQUEST'.
    ls_error-message = iv_message.
    rv_json = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie CL_SALV_EX_UTIL=>IF_SALV_BS_UTIL_SERVICE~EXPORT_TO_CSV und dynamische Feldzugriffe mit FIELD-SYMBOLS oder Komponentenoperatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_dynamic_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight_data
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_csv.
    DATA: lt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_header       TYPE string,
          lv_row          TYPE string.

    " Build header row
    lv_header = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_field_names NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && ';' && field ) ).
    APPEND lv_header TO lt_dynamic_data.

    " Build data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_row = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_field_names
                              NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <fs_sflight>-({field}) }|
                                                    ELSE s && ';' && |{ <fs_sflight>-({field}) }| ) ).
      APPEND lv_row TO lt_dynamic_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_salv_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>get_instance( ).
    rv_csv_string = lo_salv_util->if_salv_bs_util_service~export_to_csv(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_data = lt_dynamic_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_with_ddic_headers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_ddic_header_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_with_ddic_headers.
    DATA: lt_csv_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_header   TYPE string.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_sflights[ 1 ] ) ).

    lv_header = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR comp IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp-ddic_label
        ELSE s && ';' && comp-ddic_label
      )
    ).
    APPEND lv_header TO lt_csv_data.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      DATA(lv_row) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR comp IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <fs_sflight>-({comp-name}) }|
          ELSE s && ';' && |{ <fs_sflight>-({comp-name}) }|
        )
      ).
      APPEND lv_row TO lt_csv_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_salv_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>get_instance( ).
    rv_csv_string = lo_salv_util->if_salv_bs_util_service~export_to_csv(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_data = lt_csv_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_current_datetime FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_current_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_get_current_datetime( ).
    DATA(ls_current_datetime) = lo_cut->get_current_system_datetime( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_current_datetime-date,
      exp = sy-datum,
      msg = 'Current date is not today'
    ).

    DATA(lv_current_time_sy) = sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_current_time_actual) = ls_current_datetime-time.
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
                                  tstmp1 = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time(
                                              iv_date = sy-datum,
                                              iv_time = lv_current_time_actual ),
                                  tstmp2 = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date_time(
                                              iv_date = sy-datum,
                                              iv_time = lv_current_time_sy ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_diff_seconds < 60 AND lv_diff_seconds > -60 ),
      msg = 'Current time is not close to system time'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine hierarchische Datenstruktur für einen Column Tree Control vor, indem Sie Fluggesellschaften und deren eindeutige Verbindungen aus SFLIGHT abrufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` für die hierarchische Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_id   TYPE string,
             parent_id TYPE string,
             text      TYPE string,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( 
      ( node_id = 'ROOT' parent_id = '' text = 'Fluggesellschaften' is_folder = abap_true ) 
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = <carrier_group>-carrid ) 
      LET carrier_id = <carrier_group>-carrid IN 
      ( node_id = carrier_id parent_id = 'ROOT' text = carrier_id is_folder = abap_true ) 
      ( REDUCE zcl_tree_data_prep=>tt_nodes(
          INIT nodes = VALUE zcl_tree_data_prep=>tt_nodes( )
          FOR <flight> IN <carrier_group>
          LET flight_id = |{ <flight>-carrid }-{ <flight>-connid }-{ <flight>-fldate DATE = ISO }| IN
          NEXT nodes = VALUE #( BASE nodes
                                ( node_id = flight_id parent_id = carrier_id text = |Flug { <flight>-connid } am { <flight>-fldate DATE = USER }| is_folder = abap_false ) ) 
        ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_flight_tree_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_tree_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_tree_data[ node_id = 'ROOT' ] ) ).

    DATA(lv_carrier_nodes) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE parent_id = 'ROOT'.
      lv_carrier_nodes = lv_carrier_nodes + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_carrier_nodes > 0 ).

    DATA(lv_flight_nodes) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data INTO ls_node WHERE parent_id IS NOT INITIAL AND parent_id <> 'ROOT' AND is_folder = abap_false.
      lv_flight_nodes = lv_flight_nodes + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_flight_nodes > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` zur Erstellung komplexer, hierarchischer Datenstrukturen aus flachen Tabellen. Dies ist ideal für die Vorbereitung von Daten für UI-Elemente wie den `cl_gui_column_tree` und nutzt moderne String-Templates für die Knotentexte.
keywords: cl_gui_column_tree, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, ABAP SQL, Hierarchical Data, String Templates

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten in ein Format, das für die Anzeige in einem Baum geeignet ist, z.B. durch Hinzufügen einer eindeutigen ID für jeden Knoten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_data_transformation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_simple,
             id     TYPE string,
             parent TYPE string,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node_simple.
    TYPES tt_tree_node_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_to_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_transformation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_to_tree_nodes.
    rt_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_raw_flights 
      LET node_id = |FLIGHT_{ sy-tabix }| IN 
      ( id = node_id parent = flight-carrid text = |Flug { flight-connid } am { flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) 
    ).
    rt_nodes = VALUE #( BASE rt_nodes 
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF it_raw_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = <carrier_group>-carrid ) 
      ( id = <carrier_group>-carrid parent = 'ROOT' text = <carrier_group>-carrid ) 
    ).
    rt_nodes = VALUE #( BASE rt_nodes 
      ( id = 'ROOT' parent = '' text = 'Alle Flüge' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT DISTINCT`-Abfrage auf einer beliebigen Tabelle mit einer dynamisch übergebenen Feldliste durch.
hint: Nutzen Sie dynamisches Open SQL mit `(field_list)` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_distinct_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_field_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_distinct_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_dynamic.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any TABLE.

    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_table_name) WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    TRY.
        SELECT DISTINCT (iv_field_list)
          FROM (iv_table_name)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<fs_data>.

        LOOP AT <fs_data> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
          APPEND REF TO <fs_line> TO rt_result.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_osql_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_osql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result_refs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lt_result_refs[ 1 ]->* TO <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_line> ).

    " Check if the structure contains CARRID and CONNID
    DATA(lr_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_line> ).

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle eindeutigen Währungen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten in einem String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_distinct_currencies_string
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_currencies_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_currencies_string.
    rv_currencies_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR GROUPS <wa> OF it_flight_data GROUP BY ( currency = <wa>-currency )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <wa>-currency ELSE s && `,` && <wa>-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_distinct_currencies_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_distinct_currencies_string.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_reduce_distinct_string=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_distinct_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_distinct_currencies_string( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'USD,EUR,GBP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS` kann man hier elegant eine Liste eindeutiger Werte sammeln und zu einem String zusammenfügen, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, String Processing

CLASS zcl_distinct_count_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_count_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF it_raw_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = <carrier_group>-carrid ) 
      ( carrid = <carrier_group>-carrid, flight_count = count( <carrier_group> ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_distinct_count_itab=>ty_flight_raw.
