Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, dessen Einträge dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle generiert werden, z.B. basierend auf Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression in Kombination mit modernem Open SQL, um die Menüeinträge zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_menu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu
      RAISING
        cx_ctmenu_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    " Fetch unique carrier IDs from SFLIGHTS using modern Open SQL and VALUE/FOR
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( sflight-carrid ) ).

    IF lt_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ALL' text = 'Alle Fluggesellschaften' ).
      ro_menu->add_separator( ).

      " Add dynamic menu items using LOOP and String Templates
      LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
        ro_menu->add_function( fcode = |CARR_{ lv_carrier }| text = |Details für { lv_carrier }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'NO_DATA' text = 'Keine Fluggesellschaften gefunden' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Um dynamische Menüeinträge korrekt zu testen, müsste man die SFLIGHTS-Daten mocken

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü und demonstrieren Sie die Registrierung eines Event-Handlers für die Menüauswahl (konzeptionell).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `set_handler_for_event` des Menüobjekts, um einen Event-Handler zu registrieren. Der Event-Handler muss eine Methode mit der Signatur des Ereignisses `function_selected` sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS function_selected EXPORTING VALUE(e_fcode) TYPE syfcode.

    METHODS create_menu_and_register_handler
      IMPORTING
        io_event_receiver TYPE REF TO object " Object that will handle the event
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu
      RAISING
        cx_ctmenu_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_function_selected FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_menu_and_register_handler.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ACTION1' text = 'Aktion 1' ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ACTION2' text = 'Aktion 2' ).

    " Register the event handler
    SET HANDLER io_event_receiver->handle_function_selected FOR ro_menu.

    " In a real Dynpro scenario, the menu would be displayed and the event
    " would be triggered by user interaction.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_function_selected.
    " This method would be called when a menu item is selected.
    " In a real application, specific logic would be implemented here.
    " For demonstration, we just simulate a log entry.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Menu function selected: { fcode }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, bei dem die Verfügbarkeit (aktiv/inaktiv) bestimmter Menüeinträge dynamisch basierend auf einer Bedingung gesteuert wird. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine `COND` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `set_function_enabled` von `cl_ctmenu` und eine `COND` Expression, um den Status zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_conditional_menu
      IMPORTING
        iv_is_editable TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu
      RAISING
        cx_ctmenu_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_conditional_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'VIEW' text = 'Anzeigen' ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'EDIT' text = 'Bearbeiten' ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SAVE' text = 'Speichern' ).

    " Dynamically enable/disable 'Edit' and 'Save' based on iv_is_editable
    ro_menu->set_function_enabled(
      fcode   = 'EDIT'
      enabled = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_is_editable = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).

    ro_menu->set_function_enabled(
      fcode   = 'SAVE'
      enabled = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_is_editable = abap_true THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_obj_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_obj_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_item_array.
    DATA(lo_json_array) = cl_clb_json=>parse_json( iv_json_string ).

      DATA(ls_item) = VALUE ty_item(
        id   = lo_element->get_string_value( 'id' )
        name = lo_element->get_string_value( 'name' )
      ).
      APPEND ls_item TO rt_items.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen gegebenen Zeitstempel unter Berücksichtigung einer spezifischen Zeitzone.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dtm_timezone_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_timestamp_with_tz
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_tzone     TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_ts) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dtm_timezone_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_timestamp_with_tz.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    " Convert timestamp to date and time in target timezone
    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_dt(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = iv_timestamp
        iv_tzone = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = lv_date
        ev_time  = lv_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_date) = cl_abap_datfm=>conv_date_int_to_ext(
                                 iv_date = lv_date
                                 iv_format_according_to = cl_abap_datfm=>user ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_time) = cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
                                 iv_time = lv_time
                                 iv_format_according_to = cl_abap_timefm=>user ).

    rv_formatted_ts = |{ lv_formatted_date } { lv_formatted_time } { iv_tzone }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_timestamp_with_tz FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_timestamp_with_tz.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dtm_timezone_format( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = '20251124100000'. " 24.11.2025 10:00:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_tzone_berlin) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (UTC+1)

    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->format_timestamp_with_tz(
                                 iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp
                                 iv_tzone     = lv_tzone_berlin ).
    " Expected: 24.11.2025 11:00:00 CET (assuming CET is +1h from UTC)
    " This test is sensitive to system time zone settings and daylight saving.
    " For a robust test, one might need to mock cl_abap_tstmp or use fixed values.
    " For simplicity, we'll check for expected parts.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_formatted exp = '24.11.2025' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_formatted exp = '11:00' ). " Assuming CET is +1h
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_formatted exp = 'CET' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Konvertierung eines Zeitstempels in ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einer spezifischen Zeitzone mit CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CONVERT_TSTMP_TO_DT und die anschließende Formatierung mit CL_ABAP_DATFM und CL_ABAP_TIMEFM. Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die globale Benutzer unterstützen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ISO-8859-1 kodierten String in das interne ABAP-Format. Fangen Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und `TRY...CATCH` für Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_iso_to_internal
      IMPORTING
        iv_iso_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_internal_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_iso IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_iso_to_internal.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
        lo_conv->read( EXPORTING input = iv_iso_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_internal_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        " Log error or re-raise with more context
        MESSAGE lx_conv->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_iso( ).
    " Example: 'Testäöü' in ISO-8859-1 hex: 54 65 73 74 E4 F6 FC
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) = '54657374E4F6FC'.
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Testäöü'.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_iso_to_internal( lv_iso_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_string exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_iso_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_iso( ).
    " Invalid byte sequence for ISO-8859-1 (e.g., a multi-byte UTF-8 char)
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = 'C3BC'. " This is 'ü' in UTF-8, but invalid in ISO-8859-1 if treated as single byte

    " Expecting an exception
    lo_cut->convert_iso_to_internal( lv_invalid_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_conversion_codepage exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `xstring`-Werten (UTF-8) in eine Tabelle von `string`-Werten. Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_table
      IMPORTING
        it_xstrings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_table.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

    rt_strings = VALUE #( FOR ls_xstring IN it_xstrings
                              LET lv_string_converted TYPE string = '' IN
                                ( lo_conv->read( EXPORTING input = ls_xstring IMPORTING data = lv_string_converted ) )
                                ( lv_string_converted ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_table( ).
    DATA: lt_xstrings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring,
          lt_expected_strings TYPE string_table.

    " 'Hello' in UTF-8 hex: 48 65 6C 6C 6F
    APPEND '48656C6C6F' TO lt_xstrings.
    APPEND 'Hello' TO lt_expected_strings.

    " 'World' in UTF-8 hex: 57 6F 72 6C 64
    APPEND '576F726C64' TO lt_xstrings.
    APPEND 'World' TO lt_expected_strings.

    DATA(lt_converted_strings) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_table( lt_xstrings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted_strings ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted_strings exp = lt_expected_strings ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination von `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` mit einer `FOR`-Expression für interne Tabellen. Dies ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Konvertierung einer ganzen Tabelle von Werten, ohne explizite Schleifen. Die `LET`-Expression wird verwendet, um das Ergebnis der `read`-Methode temporär zu speichern.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, FOR Expression, Internal Tables, xstring, string, Konvertierung, UTF-8

  METHOD test_convert_with_repl.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_with_repl( ).
    " Invalid UTF-8 sequence (C3 is start of 2-byte char, but not followed by valid byte)
    DATA(lv_invalid_utf8_xstring) = '48656C6C6FC3'. " 'Hello' + invalid byte

    " Convert from UTF-8, expect '#' for invalid char

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen CSV-String in eine interne Tabelle von Strings. Jede Zeile des CSV-Strings soll ein Eintrag in der internen Tabelle sein, und die Spalten sollen als einzelne Felder behandelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string` und anschließend `get_table_from_csv`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_csv_line,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_csv_line.
    TYPES tt_csv_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_csv_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_csv_table) TYPE tt_csv_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string( iv_csv_data ).
    DATA(lt_raw_table) = lo_csv_parser->get_table_from_csv( ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw_line>).
      DATA(ls_csv_line) = VALUE ty_csv_line(
        col1 = <fs_raw_line>[ 1 ]
        col2 = <fs_raw_line>[ 2 ]

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit einer Kopfzeile in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle, wobei die Spalten anhand der Kopfzeile automatisch den Feldern der Struktur zugeordnet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv` mit `set_header_line` und `get_table_from_csv_with_header`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_header_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_with_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_table) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_header_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_header.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string( iv_csv_data ).
    lo_csv_parser->set_header_line( abap_true ).

    " get_table_from_csv_with_header requires a table type with a header line
    " or a structured table type where column names match field names.
    " We use a dummy table to get the data and then map it.
    DATA lt_raw_data TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.
    lo_csv_parser->get_table_from_csv_with_header(
      IMPORTING
        et_csv_table = lt_raw_data
    ).

    " Manual mapping for demonstration, in real scenarios,
    " the structure fields would ideally match the header names directly
    " for automatic mapping if using other CSV libraries or more complex logic.
    " For cl_icf_csv, we get a table of string_table, so we map manually.
    DATA(lt_header) = lt_raw_data[ 1 ]. " First line is header
    DATA(lv_carrid_idx) = 0.
    DATA(lv_connid_idx) = 0.
    DATA(lv_cityfrom_idx) = 0.
    DATA(lv_cityto_idx) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_header INTO DATA(lv_header_col).
      CASE lv_header_col.
        WHEN 'CARRID'. lv_carrid_idx = sy-tabix.
        WHEN 'CONNID'. lv_connid_idx = sy-tabix.
        WHEN 'CITYFROM'. lv_cityfrom_idx = sy-tabix.
        WHEN 'CITYTO'. lv_cityto_idx = sy-tabix.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data FROM 2 INTO DATA(ls_raw_line).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
        carrid = ls_raw_line[ lv_carrid_idx ]
        connid = ls_raw_line[ lv_connid_idx ]
        cityfrom = ls_raw_line[ lv_cityfrom_idx ]
        cityto = ls_raw_line[ lv_cityto_idx ]
      ) TO rt_flight_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_quantity_unit
      IMPORTING
        iv_quantity TYPE p DECIMALS 3
        iv_unit_from TYPE meins
        iv_unit_to TYPE meins
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_quantity) TYPE p DECIMALS 3.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_quantity_unit.
    DATA lv_quantity_in_base TYPE p DECIMALS 3.
    DATA lv_unit_base TYPE meins.

    " Convert to base unit first (e.g., KG to G, then G to LB)
    CONVERT QUANTITY iv_quantity
      UNIT iv_unit_from
      INTO BASE UNIT lv_unit_base
      QUANTITY lv_quantity_in_base.

    " Convert from base unit to target unit
    CONVERT QUANTITY lv_quantity_in_base
      UNIT lv_unit_base
      INTO UNIT iv_unit_to
      QUANTITY rv_converted_quantity.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        DATA(lo_circle) = CAST zcl_circle( io_generic_shape ).

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.

    DATA(lo_generic_shape) = CAST zcl_base_shape( lo_circle_instance ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cast_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_downcast( lo_generic_shape ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Successfully downcasted to Circle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Radius: 10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_downcast.
    DATA(lo_another_shape) = NEW zcl_base_shape( ). " Assuming a concrete base shape or another derived shape
    " For simplicity, let's just use a base shape instance if base is not abstract
    " If base is abstract, we'd need another concrete class, e.g., zcl_square
    " For this example, let's assume zcl_base_shape can be instantiated or use a dummy.
    " If zcl_base_shape is abstract, this test would need a different concrete class.
    " Let's create a dummy class for a failed cast.
    CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_shape PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_name REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_name. rv_name = 'Square'. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_square_instance) = NEW zcl_square( ).
    DATA(lo_generic_shape) = CAST zcl_base_shape( lo_square_instance ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cast_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_downcast( lo_generic_shape ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Downcasting failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Actual type: ZCL_SQUARE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CAST` Operator ermöglicht das Downcasting von Objektreferenzen, d.h. die Zuweisung einer Referenz auf eine Oberklasse zu einer Referenz auf eine Unterklasse. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in der objektorientierten Programmierung, muss aber sicher gehandhabt werden. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error` ist entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler abzufangen, falls das Objekt nicht vom erwarteten Typ ist. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Methode für dynamische Typumwandlungen bei Objekten.
keywords: CAST, Object Orientation, Downcasting, Dynamic Programming, TRY...CATCH, CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung und berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Gruppe. Konvertieren Sie das Ergebnis in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_and_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_group
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_and_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_group.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR <member> IN group_key
        NEXT s = s + <member>-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        connid = group_key-connid
        avg_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ) " Avoid division by zero
      ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_avg_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_avg_price.
    DATA lt_test_sflights TYPE zcl_group_and_convert=>tt_sflight_full.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251203' price = '220.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251204' price = '240.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_and_convert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_price_by_group( lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_avg) = VALUE zcl_group_and_convert=>ty_avg_price( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' avg_price = '125.00' ).
    DATA(ls_aa_avg) = VALUE zcl_group_and_convert=>ty_avg_price( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' avg_price = '220.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = ls_lh_avg-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = ls_lh_avg-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-avg_price exp = ls_lh_avg-avg_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = ls_aa_avg-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = ls_aa_avg-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-avg_price exp = ls_aa_avg-avg_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) können Aggregationen wie Summen oder Durchschnitte innerhalb jeder Gruppe sehr kompakt berechnet werden. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code, der die Datenverarbeitung in internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht und beschleunigt.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen numerischen Wert vom Typ `DECFLOAT34` in einen `P`-Typ mit zwei Dezimalstellen und umgekehrt, um die Präzisionsunterschiede zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CONV` Operator und beachten Sie die Typdefinitionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_decfloat_to_p DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decfloat_to_packed
      IMPORTING
        iv_decfloat TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_packed) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    METHODS packed_to_decfloat
      IMPORTING
        iv_packed TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decfloat) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_decfloat_to_p IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decfloat_to_packed.
    rv_packed = CONV p( iv_decfloat ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD packed_to_decfloat.
    rv_decfloat = CONV decfloat34( iv_packed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_decfloat_to_packed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_packed_to_decfloat FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_precision_loss FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decfloat_to_packed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_decfloat_to_p( ).
    DATA(lv_decfloat_val) = '123.456789'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->decfloat_to_packed( lv_decfloat_val ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '123.46' ). " Rounded
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_packed_to_decfloat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_decfloat_to_p( ).
    DATA(lv_packed_val) = '987.65'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->packed_to_decfloat( lv_packed_val ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '987.65' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_precision_loss.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_decfloat_to_p( ).
    DATA(lv_original_decfloat) = '1.234567890123456789012345678901234'.
    DATA(lv_packed) = lo_cut->decfloat_to_packed( lv_original_decfloat ).
    DATA(lv_back_to_decfloat) = lo_cut->packed_to_decfloat( lv_packed ).

    " Assert that precision is lost during the conversion to packed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_packed exp = '1.23' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back_to_decfloat exp = '1.23' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_back_to_decfloat exp = lv_original_decfloat ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung zwischen `DECFLOAT34` (dezimale Gleitkommazahl mit hoher Präzision) und `P`-Typ (gepackte Zahl mit fester Dezimalstellenanzahl) ist wichtig, um die Auswirkungen von Präzision und Rundung zu verstehen. Der `CONV` Operator ermöglicht diese Umwandlungen direkt. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass beim Konvertieren von `DECFLOAT34` zu `P` Präzision verloren gehen kann, da der `P`-Typ eine feste Anzahl von Dezimalstellen hat und rundet. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Konzept im Umgang mit numerischen Datentypen in ABAP.
keywords: CONV, DECFLOAT34, P-Type, Packed Number, Precision, Rounding, Data Types, Math

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Feldnamen und deren Typen einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_table_line_type`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
      END OF ty_component_info,
      tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_components
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_info) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA:
      lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
      lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
      lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
    lo_line_descr  ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    lt_components  = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = <fs_component>-name
        type = <fs_component>-type_descr_ref->get_absolute_name( )
      ) TO rt_component_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Strukturdefinition und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p_by_name` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA:
      lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
      lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
      lr_data         TYPE REF TO data,
      lr_line         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
      <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lo_table_descr  ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        CREATE DATA lr_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

        " Fill with some dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
        IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_connid>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = '0017'. ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String vorliegt, und nutzen Sie dabei RTTI zur Validierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_p_by_object` und `get_method_parameter_list` zur Validierung, dann `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_hello_world RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_goodbye RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA:
      lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
      lt_parameters  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>parameter_table,
      lr_result      TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>get_p_by_object( io_object ).
        " Check if method exists and has no parameters for simplicity
        lt_parameters = lo_class_descr->get_method_parameter_list( iv_method_name ).
        IF lines( lt_parameters ) > 0.
          " For this example, we only allow methods without parameters
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        ENDIF.

        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULTS lr_result.
        ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <fs_result>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = <fs_result>.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found, call failed or wrong parameters.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error. " If object is not a class
        rv_result = 'Error: Object is not a class or RTTI failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_hello_world.
    rv_text = 'Hello World!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_goodbye.
    rv_text = 'Goodbye!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_method( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'GET_HELLO_WORLD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Hello World!' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'GET_GOODBYE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'Goodbye!' ).

    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_error exp = 'Error: Method not found, call failed or wrong parameters.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_classdescr` zur Validierung der Methode vor dem Aufruf. Man kann prüfen, ob die Methode existiert und welche Parameter sie erwartet. Dies erhöht die Robustheit des dynamischen Aufrufs und ist ein fortgeschrittener Einsatz von RTTI.
keywords: RTTI, CALL METHOD, dynamisch, cl_abap_classdescr, get_method_parameter_list

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und transformieren, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_sflight_reduced,
      tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_value.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( it_sflight = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen zu verwenden, wird die Zieltabelle direkt mit den gewünschten Daten initialisiert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Table Comprehension, Filter, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugdauern (TRAVELTIME) für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_travel_time
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_time) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_travel_time.
    rv_total_time = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_time = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_time = sum_time + ls_flight-traveltime
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' traveltime = 100 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' traveltime = 50 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' traveltime = 120 ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_time) = lo_cut->get_total_travel_time( it_sflight = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_time exp = 220 ).

    lv_total_time = lo_cut->get_total_travel_time( it_sflight = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_time exp = 50 ).

    lv_total_time = lo_cut->get_total_travel_time( it_sflight = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_time exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen und Reduktionen von internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem sie über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP ... ENDLOOP`-Konstrukten mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Summe

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestflugdauer (TRAVELTIME) überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FILTER`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_long_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_travel_time TYPE sflight-traveltime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_long_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_long_flights.
    rt_long_flights = FILTER #( it_sflight WHERE traveltime > iv_min_travel_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' traveltime = 100 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' traveltime = 50 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' traveltime = 120 ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_long_flights( it_sflight = lt_sflight iv_min_travel_time = 100 ).

explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Sie ist deutlich kürzer und lesbarer als ein `LOOP ... WHERE ... APPEND`-Konstrukt und wird intern optimiert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Filterung, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der Flugdetails (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf der Flugdauer, unter Verwendung einer `COND`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_travel_time < 60 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN iv_travel_time >= 60 AND iv_travel_time <= 120 THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Abgesagt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.

    " For a real unit test, you'd typically use test doubles or inject data.
    " Here, we assume SFLIGHT has at least some entries for LH and AA.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen aller Komponenten einer gegebenen ABAP-Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_COMPONENTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS get_field_names
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_names.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_field_names.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_names.
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_rtti_get_fields=>ty_s_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_get_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = lo_cut->get_field_names( ls_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_field_names )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of fields'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_field_names[ 1 ]
      exp = 'FIELD1'
      msg = 'First field name is incorrect'
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein Datenobjekt basierend auf der Typbeschreibung einer vorhandenen Struktur und füllen Sie es mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE_DATA` und Feld-Symbole für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
             id   TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_source.

    METHODS create_and_fill_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_data TYPE ty_s_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_data.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_source_data ).
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_data TYPE HANDLE lo_structdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component>    TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_data>.

    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_data> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE iv_source_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_component>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_component> = <fs_source_component>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei beliebige Strukturen dynamisch. Die Methode soll `TRUE` zurückgeben, wenn alle gemeinsamen Komponenten (gleicher Name und gleicher Typ) auch gleiche Werte haben, ansonsten `FALSE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für beide Strukturen und vergleichen Sie Komponenten über Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data1,
             id    TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data1.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data2,
             id    TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             value TYPE i,
             extra TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data2.

    METHODS compare_common_fields
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct1 TYPE any
        iv_struct2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_common_fields.
    rv_equal = abap_true.

    DATA(lo_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_struct1 ) ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_struct2 ) ).

    DATA(lt_components1) = lo_descr1->get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components2) = lo_descr2->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) WITH KEY name = ls_comp1-name.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Common component found
        IF ls_comp1-type_descr->type_kind = ls_comp2-type_descr->type_kind. " Same type kind
          FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_val1> TYPE any,
                         <fs_val2> TYPE any.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp1-name OF STRUCTURE iv_struct1 TO <fs_val1>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp2-name OF STRUCTURE iv_struct2 TO <fs_val2>.

          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_val1> <> <fs_val2>.
            rv_equal = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_equal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_different_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_different_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_partial_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_equal.
    DATA: ls_data1 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data1,
          ls_data2 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data2.
    ls_data1-id = 'A'. ls_data1-value = 10. ls_data1-text = 'Hello'.
    ls_data2-id = 'A'. ls_data2-value = 10. ls_data2-extra = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lv_equal) = lo_cut->compare_common_fields( iv_struct1 = ls_data1 iv_struct2 = ls_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_equal exp = abap_true msg = 'Should be equal for common fields' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_different_value.
    DATA: ls_data1 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data1,
          ls_data2 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data2.
    ls_data1-id = 'A'. ls_data1-value = 10. ls_data1-text = 'Hello'.
    ls_data2-id = 'A'. ls_data2-value = 20. ls_data2-extra = 'World'. " Value differs

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lv_equal) = lo_cut->compare_common_fields( iv_struct1 = ls_data1 iv_struct2 = ls_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_equal exp = abap_false msg = 'Should be different due to value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_different_type.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data3,
             id    TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             value TYPE string, " Different type
           END OF ty_s_data3.
    DATA: ls_data1 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data1,
          ls_data3 TYPE ty_s_data3.
    ls_data1-id = 'A'. ls_data1-value = 10.
    ls_data3-id = 'A'. ls_data3-value = '10'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lv_equal) = lo_cut->compare_common_fields( iv_struct1 = ls_data1 iv_struct2 = ls_data3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_equal exp = abap_true msg = 'Should be true as VALUE has different type_kind' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_partial_match.
    DATA: ls_data1 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data1,
          ls_data2 TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_structs=>ty_s_data2.
    ls_data1-id = 'X'. ls_data1-value = 10. ls_data1-text = 'Hello'.
    ls_data2-id = 'Y'. ls_data2-value = 10. ls_data2-extra = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_structs( ).
    DATA(lv_equal) = lo_cut->compare_common_fields( iv_struct1 = ls_data1 iv_struct2 = ls_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_equal exp = abap_false msg = 'Should be different due to ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt RTTI, um die Komponenten zweier Strukturen zu extrahieren.         rv_message = |Es ist ein Fehler aufgetreten.|.
      WHEN gc_status-in_progress.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine Konstante, um den Namen einer Strukturkomponente zu definieren, die dynamisch über RTTI ausgelesen werden soll. Die Methode soll den Wert dieser Komponente zurückgeben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` für den Feldnamen mit `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_const_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_field_to_read TYPE string VALUE 'TEXT'.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_s_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_const_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT gc_field_to_read OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Feld '{ gc_field_to_read }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Struktur eine bestimmte Komponente (Feld) enthält, deren Name als Konstante definiert ist.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_target_field TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD_A'.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_non_existent_field TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD_C'.

      IMPORTING

        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_field.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).

    READ TABLE lo_structdescr->get_components( ) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_contains = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_contains = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Zeile der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` ausliest, wobei der Feldname als Konstante übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` für `SFLIGHTS`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und Feld-Symbole mit dem konstanten Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_sflights_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_field_to_read TYPE string VALUE 'PLANETYPE'.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_non_existent_field TYPE string VALUE 'NON_FIELD'.

    METHODS get_sflight_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_sflights_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_field_value.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflight ).
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_component_value>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_component_value>.
      ELSE.
        rv_value = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden in SFLIGHTS.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Kein Eintrag für Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate } gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_sorted_sflights = it_sflights.

    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    READ TABLE lo_line_descr->get_components( ) WITH KEY name = iv_sort_field TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. " Field exists
      SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY (iv_sort_field).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_filter_field TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID'.

    METHODS filter_sflights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_filter_field TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_sflights ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    READ TABLE lo_line_descr->get_components( ) WITH KEY name = iv_filter_field TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. " Field exists
      rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE (iv_filter_field) = iv_filter_value ).
    ELSE.
      rt_filtered_sflights = it_sflights. " Return original table if field does not exist
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Nachrichten eines bestimmten Anwendungslogs aus und transformieren Sie sie in eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie GET_MESSAGES und den VALUE Operator mit FOR Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_log_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE balloghndl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_log_messages.
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = cl_bal_logobj=>get_messages( i_log_handle = iv_log_handle ).

    rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR <message> IN lt_bal_messages
                            ( msgid = <message>-msgid
                              msgno = <message>-msgno
                              msgty = <message>-msgty
                              msgv1 = <message>-msgv1
                              msgv2 = <message>-msgv2
                              msgv3 = <message>-msgv3
                              msgv4 = <message>-msgv4 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_logobj=>create_log(
      i_object    = 'ZTEST'
      i_subobject = 'READ'
      i_extnumber = '002'
    ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_message(
      i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      i_msgid      = 'SY'
      i_msgno      = '000'
      i_msgty      = 'I'
      i_msgv1      = 'Test Message 1'
    ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_message(
      i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      i_msgid      = 'SY'
      i_msgno      = '001'
      i_msgty      = 'W'
      i_msgv1      = 'Test Message 2'
    ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>save_log( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->read_log_messages( iv_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Test Message 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert das Auslesen von Nachrichten aus einem Anwendungslog mit GET_MESSAGES. Die Transformation der internen BAL-Struktur in eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur erfolgt effizient mit einem VALUE Operator und FOR Iteration, was eine moderne Art der Tabellenverarbeitung darstellt.

hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_CFW=>IS_VALID.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_is_valid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_control_validity
      IMPORTING
        io_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cfw_is_valid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_control_validity.
    IF io_control IS BOUND.
      rv_is_valid = cl_gui_cfw=>is_valid( i_control = io_control ).
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_valid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_cfw_is_valid( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid_null) = lo_cut->check_control_validity( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_valid_null msg = 'Null control should not be valid' ).

    " Cannot easily create a valid CL_GUI_CONTROL instance in a unit test
    " without a full GUI context. We test the 'IS BOUND' check.
    DATA lo_dummy_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_dummy_control TYPE cl_gui_control.
    DATA(lv_is_valid_dummy) = lo_cut->check_control_validity( io_control = lo_dummy_control ).
    " In a unit test, even a created dummy control might not be 'valid' in CFW context
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_valid_dummy msg = 'Dummy control should not be valid in unit test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die Verwendung von CL_GUI_CFW=>IS_VALID, um die Gültigkeit eines GUI-Control-Objekts zu überprüfen. Dies ist nützlich in dynamischen Szenarien, um sicherzustellen, dass Operationen nur auf aktiven Controls ausgeführt werden. Die Prüfung auf IS BOUND ist eine moderne Praxis.
keywords: CL_GUI_CFW, IS_VALID, GUI Controls, Dynamic Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der 'Likes' für alle Beiträge in einer Kollaborationsgruppe. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_clb_likes_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post,
             id     TYPE string,
             likes  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post.
    TYPES tt_posts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_post WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_likes
      IMPORTING
        it_posts TYPE tt_posts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_likes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_likes_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_likes.
    rv_total_likes = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR post IN it_posts
      NEXT sum = sum + post-likes
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_likes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_posts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_likes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_likes_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_posts) = VALUE zcl_clb_likes_aggregator=>tt_posts(
      ( id = 'P001' likes = 10 )
      ( id = 'P002' likes = 25 )
      ( id = 'P003' likes = 5 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_likes) = lo_cut->calculate_total_likes( lt_posts ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_likes exp = 40 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_posts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_likes_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_posts) = VALUE zcl_clb_likes_aggregator=>tt_posts( ).

    DATA(lv_total_likes) = lo_cut->calculate_total_likes( lt_posts ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_likes exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. Er ist sehr mächtig für Summierungen, Zählungen oder das Erstellen komplexer neuer Strukturen aus bestehenden Daten.
keywords: REDUCE, Data Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Collaboration

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von 3D-Objekt-Eigenschaften aus einer Rohdatenquelle, wobei Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` Expressions verwenden, um die Daten zu transformieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dv_object_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             material_id TYPE string,
             x_coord     TYPE f,
             y_coord     TYPE f,
             z_coord     TYPE f,
             color_code  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_prop,
             object_name TYPE string,
             position    TYPE string,
             color       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_3d_object_prop.
    TYPES tt_3d_object_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_3d_object_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_raw_to_3d_props
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE tt_raw_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_3d_props) TYPE tt_3d_object_prop.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_object_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_raw_to_3d_props.
    rt_3d_props = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
                            ( object_name = ls_raw-material_id,
                              position    = |{ ls_raw-x_coord },{ ls_raw-y_coord },{ ls_raw-z_coord }|,
                              color       = ls_raw-color_code ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_raw_to_3d_props FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_raw_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_raw_to_3d_props.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_object_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE zcl_3dv_object_mapper=>tt_raw_data(
      ( material_id = 'Cube' x_coord = 1.0 y_coord = 2.0 z_coord = 3.0 color_code = 'Red' )
      ( material_id = 'Sphere' x_coord = 4.0 y_coord = 5.0 z_coord = 6.0 color_code = 'Blue' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_3d_props) = lo_cut->map_raw_to_3d_props( lt_raw_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_3d_props ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_3d_props[ 1 ]-object_name exp = 'Cube' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_3d_props[ 1 ]-position exp = '1.0,2.0,3.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_3d_props[ 2 ]-color exp = 'Blue' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_raw_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_object_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE zcl_3dv_object_mapper=>tt_raw_data( ).

    DATA(lt_3d_props) = lo_cut->map_raw_to_3d_props( lt_raw_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_3d_props ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten für die Anzeige in einem 3D-Viewer (z.B. über `CL_GUI_ECL_3DVIEWER`) vorzubereiten.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Constructor Expression, 3D Viewer

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf dem Status eines 3D-Objekts, welche Aktion ausgeführt werden soll. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `COND` Expression.
hint: Die `COND` Expression ist eine moderne Alternative zu `IF` für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dv_action_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_object_status TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 active   TYPE ty_object_status VALUE 'ACTIVE',
                 inactive TYPE ty_object_status VALUE 'INACTIVE',
                 error    TYPE ty_object_status VALUE 'ERROR',
               END OF gc_status.

    METHODS get_action_for_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE ty_object_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_action_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_action_for_status.
    rv_action = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = gc_status-active   THEN 'Display Details'
      WHEN iv_status = gc_status-inactive THEN 'Activate Object'
      WHEN iv_status = gc_status-error    THEN 'Log Error'
      ELSE 'No Action Defined'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_active_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_inactive_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_active_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_action_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_action) = lo_cut->get_action_for_status( zcl_3dv_action_selector=>gc_status-active ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_action exp = 'Display Details' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_inactive_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_action_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_action) = lo_cut->get_action_for_status( zcl_3dv_action_selector=>gc_status-inactive ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_action exp = 'Activate Object' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_action_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_action) = lo_cut->get_action_for_status( zcl_3dv_action_selector=>gc_status-error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_action exp = 'Log Error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_action_selector( ).

explanation: Die `COND` Expression ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen in einer kompakten und funktionalen Syntax. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, insbesondere bei der Verarbeitung von Statuswerten, die z.B. von einem 3D-Viewer (CL_GUI_ECL_3DVIEWER) zurückgegeben werden.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Constructor Expression, 3D Viewer

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Kette von Konfigurationsaufrufen für ein Kollaborationstool ermöglicht (Method Chaining).

CLASS zcl_clb_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:

CL_CLB_TOOLS) der Fall sein kann.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Collaboration

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und bereiten Sie diese für die Anzeige in einem 3D-Viewer vor, indem Sie moderne Open SQL Syntax verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen und `@DATA()` für die Zielstruktur in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dv_sflights_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_3d,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             distance TYPE s_distance,
             unit     TYPE s_distid,
           END OF ty_flight_3d.
    TYPES tt_flight_3d TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_3d WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_data_for_3d
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_3d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_sflights_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data_for_3d.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, distance, distid AS unit
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
                               ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                 connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                 fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                 distance = ls_sflight-distance,
                                 unit     = ls_sflight-unit ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data_filtered FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_sflights_data( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = lo_cut->get_flight_data_for_3d( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_data ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_data_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_sflights_data( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = lo_cut->get_flight_data_for_3d( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_data ) exp = 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen (`@DATA()`) und Hostvariablen-Markierung (`@`) vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich. Die Daten werden direkt in eine interne Tabelle gelesen und anschließend mit `VALUE` und `FOR` in das gewünschte Format für den 3D-Viewer transformiert, was die Datenbeschaffung und -aufbereitung sehr effizient macht.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHTS, 3D Viewer, Data Transformation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für eine Operation, die mit einem Kollaborationstool interagiert, und protokollieren Sie Fehlerdetails mit String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen ab. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_clb_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_clb_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_error
      IMPORTING
        io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_clb_operation.
    TRY.
        " Simulate an operation with CL_CLB_TOOLS that might fail
        IF iv_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_message.
        ENDIF.
        " Actual CL_CLB_TOOLS call would go here
        " cl_clb_tools=>some_method( iv_data ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        log_error( lx_static_check ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        log_error( lx_root ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_error.
    DATA(lv_error_message) = |Fehler aufgetreten: { io_exception->get_text( ) }\n|
                            & |Klasse: { cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( io_exception ) }\n|
                            & |Stack: { io_exception->get_longtext( ) }|.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a proper log (e.g., SLG1, custom log table)
    WRITE: / lv_error_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_operation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_operation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_clb_operation( 'Valid Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_clb_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_clb_operation( '' ). " Empty data to trigger error
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP verwendet `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen abzufangen. Inline-Deklarationen für Ausnahmen (`DATA(lx_static_check)`) und String-Templates für die Formatierung von Fehlermeldungen verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich. Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Flugsegmenten aus `SFLIGHTS` in ein hierarchisches Format, das für die Visualisierung in einem 3D-Viewer geeignet ist, wobei Sie `GROUP BY` in `FOR` Expressions verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` um Daten zu gruppieren und dann zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dv_flight_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES tt_flight_segment TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             segments TYPE tt_flight_segment,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_segment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_flight_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                  INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
                                  ( carrid   = ls_group_key-carrid,
                                    connid   = ls_group_key-connid,
                                    segments = VALUE #( FOR ls_segment IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                        ( ls_segment ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle von Kollaborationsereignissen basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen, die zur Laufzeit bereitgestellt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für dynamische Tabellen und Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_clb_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_clb_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_clb_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_clb_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " All fields as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Vektor zwischen zwei Punkten im 3D-Raum, die für die Positionierung von Objekten im 3D-Viewer relevant sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie einfache arithmetische Operationen und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dv_vector_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_point,
             x TYPE f,
             y TYPE f,
             z TYPE f,
           END OF ty_point.

    METHODS calculate_vector
      IMPORTING
        is_point1 TYPE ty_point
        is_point2 TYPE ty_point
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_vector) TYPE ty_point.

    METHODS format_vector_string
      IMPORTING
        is_vector TYPE ty_point
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_vector_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_vector_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_vector.
    rs_vector-x = is_point2-x - is_point1-x.
    rs_vector-y = is_point2-y - is_point1-y.
    rs_vector-z = is_point2-z - is_point1-z.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_vector_string.
    rv_vector_str = |Vector: ({ is_vector-x }, { is_vector-y }, { is_vector-z })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie, ob ein gegebener String ein gültiges Hexadezimal-Farbformat (z.B. '#RRGGBB') für die Verwendung im 3D-Viewer darstellt.
hint: Nutzen Sie reguläre Ausdrücke mit `FIND REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dv_color_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_hex_color
      IMPORTING
        iv_color_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_color_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hex_color.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'.
    IF iv_color_string IS NOT INITIAL AND
       cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern( pattern = lv_regex_pattern
                                           ignore_case = abap_false )->match( iv_color_string ) = abap_true.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
