explanation: Die `WITH`-Klausel (Common Table Expression) in Open SQL ermöglicht die Definition von temporären Resultsets, die innerhalb einer einzigen Abfrage mehrfach referenziert werden können. In Kombination mit `UNION ALL` können so komplexe Datenkombinationen und -aggregationen in einer lesbaren und performanten Weise durchgeführt werden. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit für temporäre interne Tabellen und Schleifen in ABAP.
keywords: Open SQL, WITH, UNION ALL, CTE, Database Access, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern, transformieren (MAP) und reduzieren (REDUCE) Sie eine interne Tabelle mit modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` (mit `MAP`) und `REDUCE` für funktionale Operationen auf internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items        TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_of_filtered_values) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    DATA(lt_filtered_items) = FILTER tt_item FROM it_items
                               WHERE value > 5.

    DATA(lt_mapped_items) = VALUE tt_item(
      FOR ls_item IN lt_filtered_items
      ( id = ls_item-id,
        value = ls_item-value * 2,
        text = |Processed: { ls_item-text }|
      )
    ).

    rv_sum_of_filtered_values = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_item IN lt_mapped_items
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie moderne bedingte Ausdrücke (`COND`, `SWITCH`) zur Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen.
hint: COND für IF-ELSE-Logik, SWITCH für CASE-Logik.

CLASS zcl_conditional_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

      IMPORTING
        iv_category TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'A' THEN 'Active'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'I' THEN 'Inactive'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_category_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH string(
      iv_category
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Electronics'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Books'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Clothing'
      ELSE 'Miscellaneous'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie mit Tabellenausdrücken auf Elemente einer internen Tabelle zu und modifizieren Sie diese.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_product_name
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_product
        iv_id       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

      CHANGING
        ct_products TYPE tt_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_id       TYPE i
        iv_new_price TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_product_name.
    TRY.
        rv_name = it_products[ id = iv_id ]-name.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_name = 'Product not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_product_price.
    TRY.
        ct_products[ id = iv_id ]-price = iv_new_price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle error or log
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Inline-Deklarationen für Variablen und Feldsymbole, um den Code kompakter zu gestalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(...)` oder `FIELD-SYMBOLS(...)` direkt an der Verwendungsstelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS loop_and_assign
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_first_char) TYPE c LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_length) = STRLEN( iv_input ).
    DATA(lv_upper_input) = CONV string( to_upper( iv_input ) ).

    rv_output = |Input: { lv_upper_input }, Length: { lv_length }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD loop_and_assign.
    LOOP AT it_strings ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_string>).
      IF <fs_string> IS NOT INITIAL.
        rv_first_char = <fs_string>(1).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_my_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        zcx_my_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_my_error=>default_text
          " You can define custom message IDs in ZCX_MY_ERROR
          " textid = zcx_my_error=>division_by_zero.
          .
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining (Fluent Interface) für eine flüssigere und lesbarere API-Nutzung.
hint: Methoden, die Chaining ermöglichen sollen, müssen `ME` als Rückgabewert vom Typ `REF TO SELF` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_count TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS add_count
      IMPORTING
        iv_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_count.
    me->mv_count = me->mv_count + iv_add.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rs_result = |Value: { me->mv_value }, Count: { me->mv_count }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_builder( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->set_value( 'Test' )->add_count( 5 )->add_count( 3 )->build( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Value: Test, Count: 8' ).

Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Builder-Pattern oder Konfigurations-APIs.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, Builder Pattern, API Design

CLASS zcl_rtti_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie einen HTTP-Statuscode als 'Informational', 'Success', 'Redirection', 'Client Error' oder 'Server Error'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `is_informational`, `is_success`, `is_redirection`, `is_client_error`, `is_server_error` von `cl_rest_status_code`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_status_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_category,
             code     TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_category.

    METHODS get_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_category.
    CASE iv_status_code.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_informational_continue OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_informational_switching_protocols OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_informational_processing.
        rv_category = 'Informational'.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_ok OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_created OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_accepted OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_no_content OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_partial_content.
        rv_category = 'Success'.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_multiple_choices OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_moved_permanently OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_found OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_not_modified OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_use_proxy OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_temporary_redirect OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_redirection_permanent_redirect.
        rv_category = 'Redirection'.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_bad_request OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_unauthorized OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_forbidden OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_method_not_allowed OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_conflict OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_unprocessable_entity.
        rv_category = 'Client Error'.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal_server_error OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_not_implemented OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_bad_gateway OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_service_unavailable OR
           cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_gateway_timeout.
        rv_category = 'Server Error'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_category = 'Unknown'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen internen Fehlercode auf einen passenden HTTP-Statuscode abbildet und dessen Beschreibung zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit einer internen Tabelle zur Abbildung und `cl_rest_status_code=>get_description`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_custom_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_map,
             internal_code TYPE string,
             http_status   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_error_map.
    TYPES tt_error_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error_map WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_info,
             code     TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_info.

    METHODS get_http_status_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_internal_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status_info) TYPE ty_status_info.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_custom_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_http_status_info.
    DATA(lt_error_mapping) = VALUE tt_error_map(
      ( internal_code = 'E001' http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_bad_request )
      ( internal_code = 'E002' http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_unauthorized )
      ( internal_code = 'E003' http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found )
      ( internal_code = 'E004' http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal_server_error )
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_error_mapping INTO DATA(ls_map_entry) WITH KEY internal_code = iv_internal_code.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_status_info-code = ls_map_entry-http_status.
      rs_status_info-category = cl_rest_status_code=>get_description( ls_map_entry-http_status ).
    ELSE.
      rs_status_info-code = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal_server_error.
      rs_status_info-category = cl_rest_status_code=>get_description( cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal_server_error ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, deren Flugnummer mit 'LH' beginnt und die nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen. Verwenden Sie dabei eine funktionale Iteration.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `WHERE` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityto FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
                             WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
                             ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Zusätzlicher Test: Überprüfen, ob die Anzahl der Einträge korrekt ist (abhängig von Testdaten)
    " Hier nur ein Beispiel, genaue Anzahl müsste bekannt sein.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = <expected_count> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu iterieren und zu transformieren. In Kombination mit `WHERE` kann direkt gefiltert werden. `VALUE #(...)` und `CORRESPONDING #(...)` sorgen für eine kompakte Initialisierung und Zuweisung von Strukturen.
keywords: FOR, Internal Table, Table Comprehension, WHERE, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jeden Flug in der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Zusatz in einer `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_count.
    TYPES tt_passenger_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passenger_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_passenger_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_counts.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight_data
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid )
                           ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
                             connid = ls_group-connid,
                             total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_passenger_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_passenger_counts.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->get_passenger_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein.' ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen Sie einen bekannten Flug
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count-total_passengers exp = 100 msg = 'Passagierzahl für LH 0400 nicht korrekt.' ). " Annahme: 100 Passagiere für LH 0400 in Testdaten
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF` und `GROUP BY` innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Expression ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um die Summe der Passagiere innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu berechnen, was eine funktionale Aggregation darstellt.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach allen Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist. Speichern Sie die gefilterten Einträge in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_lh_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die eine Liste von Zahlen filtern, transformieren und aggregieren können, wobei die Methodenaufrufe verkettet werden können (Method Chaining).
hint: Lassen Sie die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chaining_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_initial_numbers TYPE tt_numbers.
    METHODS filter_greater_than IMPORTING iv_threshold TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chaining_example.
    METHODS multiply_by IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chaining_example.
    METHODS get_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
    METHODS get_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_numbers TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chaining_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_numbers = it_initial_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_greater_than.
    mt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN mt_numbers WHERE ( num > iv_threshold ) ( num ) ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_by.
    mt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN mt_numbers ( num * iv_factor ) ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR num IN mt_numbers NEXT sum = sum + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_numbers.
    rt_numbers = mt_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_initial_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_chaining_example=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chaining_example( it_initial_numbers = lt_initial ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_processor->filter_greater_than( 3 )->multiply_by( 2 )->get_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 20 msg = 'Die Summe nach Chaining ist nicht korrekt (erwartet: (4*2) + (5*2) + (6*2) = 8+10+12 = 30).' ).

    DATA(lt_result_numbers) = lo_processor->filter_greater_than( 3 )->multiply_by( 2 )->get_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_expected_numbers) = VALUE zcl_chaining_example=>tt_numbers( ( 8 ) ( 10 ) ( 12 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_numbers exp = lt_expected_numbers msg = 'Die gefilterten und multiplizierten Zahlen sind nicht korrekt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_initial_list.
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_chaining_example=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chaining_example( it_initial_numbers = lt_initial ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_processor->filter_greater_than( 0 )->multiply_by( 10 )->get_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Summe sollte 0 sein für leere Liste.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ist ein Designmuster, bei dem Methoden einer Klasse einen Verweis auf die Instanz selbst (`ME`) zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht, ähnlich einer funktionalen Pipeline. Hier werden moderne Operatoren wie `VALUE` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Methoden verwendet.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, VALUE, REDUCE, ME

hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_data UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_data
                                   WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND fldate > '20230101' )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Filtered flights should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( line_exists( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) ) msg = 'Should contain flights from LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( NOT line_exists( lt_filtered[ fldate <= '20230101' ] ) ) msg = 'Should only contain flights after 20230101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, FILTER, sflights, VALUE

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Einträge und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int`, um einen Index zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_random_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " Handle case where no flights are found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_num_flights
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    " Assert that a flight was returned (assuming sflights is not empty)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_flight-carrid
      msg = 'No flight returned when sflights is expected to have data'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    " Further checks could involve verifying data consistency if needed
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man `cl_abap_random_int` verwendet, um einen zufälligen Index für eine interne Tabelle zu generieren. Dies ermöglicht die Auswahl eines beliebigen Eintrags aus einer Datenmenge, was nützlich für Stichproben oder Testdaten ist. Die Verwendung von `SELECT INTO TABLE @DATA()` und `lines()` sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, SELECT, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst und diese mit `cl_message_helper` behandelt, um die Fehlermeldung zu extrahieren.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahme-Klasse, lösen Sie sie aus und verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper=>get_message_text` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING zcx_custom_error.
    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text
          previous = NEW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero ). " Just for demo, not actual division by zero
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text( io_exception ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_error_message) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( -1 ).
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_custom_error).
        lv_error_message = lo_cut->get_error_message( lx_custom_error ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_error_message
      msg = 'Error message should not be initial'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_error_message
      exp = 'Fehler' " Default text for zcx_custom_error is 'Fehler in ZCX_CUSTOM_ERROR'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_message_helper=>get_message_text` verwendet wird, um die vollständige Fehlermeldung aus einer Ausnahme zu extrahieren, einschließlich der Texte von verketteten Ausnahmen. Dies ist entscheidend für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung und Protokollierung.
keywords: EXCEPTION, CATCH, cl_message_helper, Error Handling, MESSAGE

Instructions: Sammeln Sie mehrere Nachrichten in einem Nachrichtencontainer (`cl_abap_message_manager`) und verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper`, um diese Nachrichten zu formatieren und anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_manager` zum Sammeln und `cl_message_helper=>get_messages_as_string` oder `get_messages_as_table`.

CLASS zcl_message_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS collect_and_display_messages
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_messages_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_display_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_manager) = NEW cl_abap_message_manager( ).

    lo_message_manager->add_message(
      msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      msgty = 'I'
      msgno = '001'
      msgv1 = 'LH'
      msgv2 = '0400'
    ).
    lo_message_manager->add_message(
      msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      msgty = 'W'
      msgno = '002'
      msgv1 = 'FRA'
      msgv2 = 'JFK'
    ).
    lo_message_manager->add_message(
      msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      msgty = 'E'
      msgno = '003'
      msgv1 = '20251224'
    ).

    rv_messages_string = cl_message_helper=>get_messages_as_string(
      io_message_manager = lo_message_manager
      iv_with_message_type = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_collector( ).
    DATA(lv_messages) = lo_cut->collect_and_display_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_messages
      msg = 'Messages string should not be initial'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_messages
      exp = 'I:Flight LH 0400'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_messages
      exp = 'W:Flight from FRA to JFK'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_messages
      exp = 'E:Date 20251224 is invalid'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_details DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS raise_and_get_details
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      EXPORTING ev_msgid TYPE symsgid
                ev_msgno TYPE symsgno
                ev_msgv1 TYPE symsgv
                ev_msgv2 TYPE symsgv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_details IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_and_get_details.
    DATA(lv_msgid) = 'SFLIGHT'.
    DATA(lv_msgno) = '004'.
    DATA(lv_msgv1) = 'Value'.
    DATA(lv_msgv2) = iv_value.

    TRY.
        IF iv_value < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_invalid
            MESSAGE ID lv_msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER lv_msgno
            WITH lv_msgv1 lv_msgv2.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH zcx_data_invalid INTO DATA(lx_data_invalid).
        cl_message_helper=>get_message_details(
          EXPORTING
            io_exception = lx_data_invalid
          IMPORTING
            ev_msgid     = ev_msgid
            ev_msgno     = ev_msgno
            ev_msgv1     = ev_msgv1
            ev_msgv2     = ev_msgv2
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_exception_message
      IMPORTING io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root
      RETURNING VALUE(rb_has_message) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS raise_exception_with_msg
      RAISING zcx_data_invalid.
    METHODS raise_exception_without_msg
      RAISING zcx_no_message.

CLASS zcl_message_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_exception_message.
    rb_has_message = cl_message_helper=>has_message( io_exception ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD raise_exception_with_msg.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_invalid
      MESSAGE ID 'SFLIGHT' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '005'
      WITH 'Test'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD raise_exception_without_msg.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_has_message FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_has_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_check( ).
    DATA(lb_has_message) TYPE abap_bool.

    " Test with exception that has a message
    TRY.
        lo_cut->raise_exception_with_msg( ).
      CATCH zcx_data_invalid INTO DATA(lx_with_msg).
        lb_has_message = lo_cut->check_exception_message( lx_with_msg ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_has_message exp = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test with exception that does not have a message
    TRY.
        lo_cut->raise_exception_without_msg( ).
      CATCH zcx_no_message INTO DATA(lx_without_msg).
        lb_has_message = lo_cut->check_exception_message( lx_without_msg ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_has_message exp = abap_false ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und weisen Sie jeder Gruppe eine zufällige ID zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_group_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             group_id TYPE string,
             flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_with_random_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_group_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_with_random_id.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_random_id_gen) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1000 high = 9999 ).

    rt_flight_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   group_id = |GROUP_{ lo_random_id_gen->get_next( ) }|,
                                   flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_member IN GROUP ls_flight ( flight_member ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_group_id( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_groups) = lo_cut->group_flights_with_random_id( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flight_groups
      msg = 'Flight groups should not be initial' 
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lv_first_group_id) = lt_flight_groups[ 1 ]-group_id.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_first_group_id exp = 'GROUP_' ).

    " Check for uniqueness of group IDs (probabilistic, but good enough for a unit test)
    DATA(lt_group_ids) = VALUE string_table( FOR group_entry IN lt_flight_groups ( group_entry-group_id ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_group_ids ) exp = lines( NEW cl_abap_container_utilities( )->remove_duplicates( lt_group_ids ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `FOR GROUPS`-Syntax in ABAP 7.55, um Daten nach einem Kriterium zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `cl_abap_random_int` verwendet, um eine eindeutige, zufällige ID zu generieren. Dies zeigt eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation und -anreicherung.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, Grouping, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, sflights, ABAP 7.55

CLASS zcl_formatted_msg_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_format
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_formatted_msg_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_format.
    TRY.
        IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_formatted_message
            MESSAGE ID 'SFLIGHT' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '008'
            WITH 'Input value' 'cannot be empty'.
        ENDIF.
        rv_formatted_message = |Input '{ iv_input }' processed successfully.|.
      CATCH zcx_formatted_message INTO DATA(lx_formatted_message).
        DATA(lv_raw_message) = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text( lx_formatted_message ).
        rv_formatted_message = |Error: { lv_raw_message }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige Anzahl von Einträgen (zwischen 5 und 15) für eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Anzahl der Einträge und `FOR` für die Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             id       TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_count) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 5 high = 15 ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_random_count->get_next( ).

    DATA(lo_random_connid) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 100 high = 999 ).
    DATA(lo_random_carrid) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 3 ).

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > lv_count
                               ( id = i,
                                 carrid = SWITCH sflight-carrid(
                                            lo_random_carrid->get_next( )
                                            WHEN 1 THEN 'LH'
                                            WHEN 2 THEN 'AA'
                                            WHEN 3 THEN 'UA'
                                            ELSE 'XX' ),
                                 connid = lo_random_connid->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_data_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_data_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_data_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_generated_flights) = lo_cut->generate_random_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_num_entries) = lines( lt_generated_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_num_entries >= 5 AND lv_num_entries <= 15 )
      msg = 'Number of generated entries should be between 5 and 15'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_generated_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-connid >= 100 AND ls_flight-connid <= 999 )
        msg = 'Connid should be between 100 and 999'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'UA' )
        msg = 'Carrid should be LH, AA or UA'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Generierung von Testdaten. `cl_abap_random_int` wird verwendet, um sowohl die Anzahl der zu generierenden Einträge als auch die Werte für einzelne Felder zufällig zu bestimmen. Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine kompakte und moderne Erstellung der internen Tabelle.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE

hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `LOG` von `CL_ABAP_MATH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_natural_log

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34

        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD calculate_natural_log.

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_log FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_log_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_log( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( '1' ) exp = '0' msg = 'Log von 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( '2.718281828459045' ) exp = '1' msg = 'Log von e' ). " Approx. e
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_log_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_log( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( '0' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR erwartet für Log(0)' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR korrekt abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_natural_log( '-1' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR erwartet für Log(-1)' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR korrekt abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOG`-Methode von `CL_ABAP_MATH` bietet eine robuste Implementierung des natürlichen Logarithmus für `DECFLOAT`-Zahlen und behandelt potenzielle Fehler (z.B. Logarithmus von Null oder negativen Zahlen) durch Auslösen von Ausnahmen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_MATH, LOG, Mathematik, Logarithmus, DECFLOAT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und füllen Sie diese mit initialen Werten unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators. Die Tabelle soll nach Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Flugdatum eindeutig sortiert sein.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )

                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '110.00' currency = 'EUR' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) ).

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für die effiziente Bearbeitung der Tabellenzeilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <field_symbol>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_field_symbol_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_standard.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_field_symbol_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_flight_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_field_symbol_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_standard(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_original_price_lh) = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price.
    DATA(lv_original_price_aa) = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price.

    lo_cut->increase_flight_prices( EXPORTING iv_percentage = 10 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price exp = lv_original_price_lh * 1.1 msg = 'Preis für LH sollte um 10% erhöht sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price exp = lv_original_price_aa * 1.1 msg = 'Preis für AA sollte um 10% erhöht sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen in einer LOOP AT-Anweisung ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung der Tabellenzeilen im Speicher, ohne dass eine Kopie der Zeile erstellt werden muss. Dies ist besonders bei großen Tabellen performanter als die Verwendung eines Work-Bereichs.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Suchen Sie einen spezifischen Flug in einer sortierten Tabelle anhand des Flugdatums und der Flugnummer. Geben Sie den gefundenen Flug zurück oder initialisieren Sie eine leere Struktur, falls nicht gefunden.
hint: Verwenden Sie READ TABLE itab WITH TABLE KEY ....
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS find_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight.
    READ TABLE it_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS test_find_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->find_flight( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                  iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                                  iv_connid  = '0400'
                                                  iv_fldate  = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Korrekter Flug sollte gefunden werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_non_existing_flight.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_destination_and_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
        iv_cityto     TYPE sflight-cityto
        iv_max_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_destination_and_price.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityto = iv_cityto AND price < iv_max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge zu einem bestimmten Zielort in einer sortierten Tabelle. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Der REDUCE-Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine Tabelle zu aggregieren und einen einzelnen Wert zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_destination
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
        iv_cityto  TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_destination.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( 0 ) )
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( cityto = iv_cityto )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Flugdaten von Flügen enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Wert liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei Feldsymbole in einer FOR-Expression für die Iteration und Datenextraktion.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ... IN itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) und den VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_field_symbol_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_standard
        iv_min_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_field_symbol_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
                          WHERE <fs_flight>-price > iv_min_price
                          ( connid = <fs_flight>-connid, fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer und einem bestimmten Datum in einer sortierten Tabelle existiert. Verwenden Sie LINE_EXISTS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rb_exists = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die alle Felder einer beliebigen Strukturzeile einer internen Tabelle ausliest und deren Werte als String in einem bestimmten Format zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für den generischen Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line> und innerhalb der Schleife DO ... TIMES. ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_field_symbol_generic_print DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_row_as_string
      IMPORTING
        is_row        TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_row_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_table_content_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_field_symbol_generic_print IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_row_as_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_component_value TYPE string.
    DATA lv_field_count TYPE i.

    DESCRIBE FIELD is_row COMPONENTS lv_field_count.

    DO lv_field_count TIMES.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE is_row TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_component_value = <fs_component>.
        rv_row_string = |{ rv_row_string }{ COND #( WHEN sy-index > 1 THEN ', ' ) }{ lv_component_value }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_table_content_as_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_line_string TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      lv_line_string = get_table_row_as_string( <fs_line> ).
      rv_content_string = |{ rv_content_string }{ COND #( WHEN sy-tabix > 1 THEN |
| ) }{ lv_line_string }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch setzt. Der Feldname und der neue Wert werden als Strings übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol> und eine Zuweisung zum Feldsymbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_set DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data           TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_set IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
          rb_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rb_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu einem bestimmten Zielort in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus FOR-Expression und Feldsymbolen.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ... IN itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) und den MAX-Operator oder eine REDUCE-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_field_symbol_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_highest_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_standard
        iv_cityto  TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_field_symbol_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    rs_flight = REDUCE #( INIT max_price_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( )
                               FOR flight IN it_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
                               WHERE <fs_flight>-cityto = iv_cityto
                               NEXT max_price_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > max_price_flight-price THEN <fs_flight>
                                                               ELSE max_price_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_highest_price_flight) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_highest_price_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Bei einem Flug sollte dieser zurückgegeben werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet den REDUCE-Operator in Kombination mit einer FOR-Expression und Feldsymbolen, um den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu einem bestimmten Zielort zu finden. Die Zuweisung an ein Feldsymbol (<fs_flight>) innerhalb der FOR-Schleife ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf die Tabellenzeile, was effizienter ist als das Kopieren in einen Work-Bereich. Der COND-Operator wird verwendet, um die Logik für die Auswahl des maximalen Preises kompakt zu halten.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, COND

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges in einer sortierten Tabelle. Verwenden Sie den MODIFY-Operator mit einem Tabellenschlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ... oder MODIFY itab FROM wa INDEX ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-price,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA ls_flight_to_modify TYPE ty_sflight.

    " Zuerst die Zeile lesen, um sie zu modifizieren
    READ TABLE ct_flights INTO ls_flight_to_modify
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight_to_modify-price = iv_new_price.
      MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_to_modify.
      rb_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird die Zeile mit READ TABLE gelesen, dann modifiziert und schließlich mit MODIFY TABLE zurückgeschrieben. Bei SORTED TABLES wird die interne Verwaltung der Sortierung und Eindeutigkeit automatisch beibehalten.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten eines generischen Typs akzeptiert und für jedes Objekt eine bestimmte Methode dynamisch aufruft. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für den Zugriff auf die Objekte und den dynamischen Methodenaufruf.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_object> und CALL METHOD (<fs_object>)->(method_name).
solution:
CLASS zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_printable.

    METHODS call_method_on_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_objects    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_printable WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_printable.
  METHODS print_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_test_object DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_printable.
    DATA mv_id TYPE i.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_test_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_printable~print_info.
    rv_info = |ID: { mv_id }, Name: { mv_name }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_on_objects.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO if_printable.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_method> TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_objects ASSIGNING <fs_object>.
      IF <fs_object> IS BOUND.
        TRY.
            CALL METHOD (<fs_object>)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING result = lv_result.
            APPEND lv_result TO rt_results.
          CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
            APPEND |Error calling method '{ iv_method_name }' on object.| TO rt_results.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        APPEND 'Unbound object reference.' TO rt_results.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_obj1) = NEW lcl_test_object( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Object A' ).
    DATA(lo_obj2) = NEW lcl_test_object( iv_id = 2 iv_name = 'Object B' ).

    DATA lt_objects TYPE zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_call=>STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_printable WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND lo_obj1 TO lt_objects.
    APPEND lo_obj2 TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->call_method_on_objects(
      it_objects = lt_objects
      iv_method_name = 'IF_PRINTABLE~PRINT_INFO'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Ergebnisse zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'ID: 1, Name: Object A' msg = 'Ergebnis für Objekt A sollte korrekt sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'ID: 2, Name: Object B' msg = 'Ergebnis für Objekt B sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_obj1) = NEW lcl_test_object( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Object A' ).

    DATA lt_objects TYPE zcl_field_symbol_dynamic_call=>STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_printable WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND lo_obj1 TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->call_method_on_objects(
      it_objects = lt_objects
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es sollte 1 Ergebnis zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error calling method' act = lt_results[ 1 ] msg = 'Fehlermeldung erwartet.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mittels Feldsymbolen. Durch CALL METHOD (<fs_object>)->(method_name) kann der Name der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit als String übergeben werden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature der Objektorientierung in ABAP, das für Frameworks, Plugins oder generische Event-Handler nützlich ist. Die Verwendung eines Interfaces (if_printable) stellt sicher, dass alle Objekte die aufgerufene Methode implementieren, was die Typsicherheit erhöht.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, CALL METHOD, Generische Programmierung

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die Flugdaten enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei den VALUE-Operator für die Initialisierung der Zeile.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,

      carrid = iv_carrid

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Daten konsistent sind und verwenden Sie moderne Syntax.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

      RAISING

CLASS zcl_db_insert_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_single_flight.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      mandt  = sy-mandt
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      price  = iv_price
      currency = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'BOEING747'
      seatsmax = 300
      seatsocc = 150

    INSERT sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen des Flugdatensatzes'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere neue Flugdatensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein. Generieren Sie die Daten dabei mit dem `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu füllen, und `INSERT ... FROM TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_multiple_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_multiple_flights.
    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_count
      ( mandt = sy-mandt
        carrid = |XX{ i MOD 5 }|
        connid = |{ 9000 + i }|
        fldate = sy-datum + i
        price = |{ 100.00 + i * 10 }|
        currency = 'USD'
        planetype = 'AIRBUS A380'
        seatsmax = 500
        seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_new_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen mehrerer Flugdatensätze'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_multiple( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 3.
    DATA(lv_carrid_prefix) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lv_connid_start) = 9000.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->insert_multiple_flights( lv_count ).

        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_inserted_count)
          WHERE carrid LIKE @( lv_carrid_prefix && '%' ) AND connid BETWEEN @lv_connid_start AND @( lv_connid_start + lv_count - 1 ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted_count exp = lv_count ).

      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
      FINALLY.
        DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid LIKE @( lv_carrid_prefix && '%' ) AND connid BETWEEN @lv_connid_start AND @( lv_connid_start + lv_count - 1 ).
        COMMIT WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle mit generierten Flugdaten zu füllen, was eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art der Dateninitialisierung darstellt. Anschließend werden diese Daten effizient mit `INSERT ... FROM TABLE` in die Datenbank eingefügt. `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` ist hier eine nützliche Ergänzung, um Fehler bei doppelten Schlüsseln zu vermeiden, falls die Testdaten nicht vollständig eindeutig sind.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, Database, SFLIGHTS, Multiple Records, ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen mithilfe eines expliziten Cursors. Schließen Sie den Cursor nach der Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Verarbeiten Sie die gefetchten Daten mit einem `FOR`-Loop.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_fetch_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_flights_with_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_fetch_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_flights_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_flight_data.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_max_rows.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Process the fetched package using modern ABAP
      LOOP AT lt_package ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        APPEND CORRESPONDING #( <fs_flight> ) TO rt_all_flights.
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fetch_cursor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_cursor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_fetch_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_count.

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->fetch_flights_with_cursor( iv_max_rows = 50 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` für die paketweise Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen. Obwohl direkte `SELECT`-Anweisungen oft bevorzugt werden, ist der explizite Cursor für bestimmte Szenarien (z.B. sehr große Datenmengen, dynamische SQL mit komplexen Bedingungen) weiterhin relevant. Die Verarbeitung des gefetchten Pakets innerhalb des `DO`-Loops nutzt moderne Field-Symbols und `CORRESPONDING` für eine effiziente Datenübernahme.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor mit einer dynamisch erzeugten `WHERE`-Klausel für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Fetchen Sie die Daten und schließen Sie den Cursor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `(lv_where_clause)` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_dynamic_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_dynamic_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA: ls_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && | AND CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ELSE.
        lv_where_clause = |CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_where_clause IS INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = '1 = 1'. " Always true if no conditions
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight WHERE (lv_where_clause).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors mit dynamischer WHERE-Klausel'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_flight_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_key TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, aber nur, wenn bestimmte Bedingungen erfüllt sind. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_insert_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_conditional
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_conditional.
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Initial Item' active = abap_true )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF VALUE tt_items(
      FOR ls_item IN it_source_items
      WHERE ( active = abap_true AND id > 10 )
      ( ls_item )
    ) INTO TABLE lt_target.

    rt_target_items = lt_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen 'Upsert'-Vorgang auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` durch: Fügen Sie neue Datensätze ein oder aktualisieren Sie bestehende, falls sie bereits existieren. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` und `MODIFY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... FROM TABLE ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` gefolgt von `MODIFY ... FROM TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_upsert_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_upsert,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_upsert.
    TYPES tt_flight_upsert TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_upsert WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS upsert_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_upsert
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_upsert_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_db TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare data for SFLIGHT table structure
    lt_sflight_db = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights (
      mandt = sy-mandt
      carrid = ls_flight-carrid
      connid = ls_flight-connid
      fldate = ls_flight-fldate
      price = ls_flight-price
      currency = ls_flight-currency
      planetype = 'A320'
      seatsmax = 180
      seatsocc = 100
    ) ).

    " Attempt to insert new records, ignoring duplicates
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_db ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    " Update existing records (those that were not inserted due to duplicate keys)
    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_db.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Upsert von Flugdatensätzen'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upsert_new_and_update FOR TESTING.
