CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upsert_new_and_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_upsert_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'ZZ'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '1111'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum + 3.

    " Initial insert for one record
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_upsert_data) = VALUE zcl_db_upsert_sflight=>tt_flight_upsert(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) " Update existing
      ( carrid = 'QQ' connid = '2222' fldate = sy-datum + 4 price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " Insert new
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->upsert_flights( it_flights = lt_upsert_data ).

        SELECT SINGLE price, currency FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_check_updated) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check_updated-price exp = '150.00' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check_updated-currency exp = 'USD' ).

        SELECT SINGLE price, currency FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_check_new) WHERE carrid = 'QQ' AND connid = '2222' AND fldate = sy-datum + 4.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check_new-price exp = '200.00' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check_new-currency exp = 'EUR' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
      FINALLY.
        DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
        DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'QQ' AND connid = '2222' AND fldate = sy-datum + 4.
        COMMIT WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Der `VALUE`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um die Eingabedaten in die Struktur der Datenbanktabelle zu transformieren, was eine moderne und effiziente Art der Datenzuweisung ist.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugpreise aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie einen Cursor verwenden und die gefetchten Daten mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator verarbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Aggregieren Sie die Daten im `DO`-Loop mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_prices_with_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_prices_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_flight_price.
    DATA: lv_current_total TYPE sflight-price.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_total = REDUCE #( INIT sum = lv_current_total
                                   FOR ls_price IN lt_package
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price ).

      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_total_price = lv_current_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die paketweise Datenverarbeitung mittels Cursor mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator zur Aggregation von Werten. Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (hier die Summe der Preise). Dies ist eine sehr elegante und effiziente Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, insbesondere wenn Daten in Chunks verarbeitet werden müssen.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             key   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simple_item.
    TYPES tt_simple_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_at_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_key    TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_value  TYPE string
        iv_index  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_simple_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_insert_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_at_index.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_simple_items(
      ( key = 'A' value = 'First' )
      ( key = 'C' value = 'Third' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE ty_simple_item(
      key = iv_key
      value = iv_value
    ) INTO lt_items INDEX iv_index.

    rt_items = lt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_archived_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE sflight-fldate

        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_archived_flights.
    " Fiktive Tabelle SFLIGHTS_ARCHIVE wird hier angenommen.
    " Für den Test fügen wir Daten direkt in SFLIGHTS ein und löschen sie wieder.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde SFLIGHTS_ARCHIVE existieren.

    " Beispiel: Füge einige Daten in SFLIGHTS ein, die als 'archiviert' gelten könnten
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AR' connid = '0001' fldate = '20240101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AR' connid = '0002' fldate = '20240601' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AR' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Der eigentliche INSERT ... SELECT Vorgang
    INSERT sflight FROM
      ( SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE fldate < @iv_cut_off_date AND carrid = 'AR' ).

    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND sy-subrc <> 4. " 4 means some duplicates, which is fine for this example
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen von archivierten Flügen'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Aufräumen der temporären Daten
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AR'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_to_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_temp,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_temp.
    TYPES tt_flight_temp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_temp WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_and_insert_to_itab
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_temp_flights) TYPE tt_flight_temp
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_to_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_and_insert_to_itab.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_flight_temp.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 50.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT LINES OF lt_package INTO TABLE rt_temp_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_cond_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_new,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_new.
    TYPES tt_flight_new TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_new WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_candidate_flights TYPE tt_flight_new
        iv_min_price         TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_cond_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_conditionally.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_candidate_flights
      WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = ls_flight-price
        currency = ls_flight-currency
        planetype = 'A321'
        seatsmax = 200
        seatsocc = 120 )
    ).

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_insert ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND sy-subrc <> 4.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim bedingten Einfügen von Flugdatensätzen'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid LIKE @( lv_carrid_prefix && '%' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted exp = 2 ). " Only 2 flights should be inserted

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, um Flugdaten zu lesen. Wenn während des Fetchens ein Fehler auftritt, schließen Sie den Cursor sofort und behandeln Sie die Ausnahme.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH` in einem `TRY`-Block und `CLOSE CURSOR` im `FINALLY`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_simple.
    TYPES tt_flight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_with_error_handling
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_simple
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_simple.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors'.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_flight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.

          " Simulate an error after fetching some data
          IF lines( rt_flights ) > 5.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Simulierter Fehler beim Fetchen'.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Cursor-Vorgang: { lx_sql->get_text( ) }|.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fetch_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->fetch_with_error_handling( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Erwartete Ausnahme wurde nicht ausgelöst.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_sql->get_text( ) exp = 'Fehler beim Cursor-Vorgang' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei Cursor-Operationen. Der gesamte Cursor-Vorgang ist in einem `TRY`-`CATCH`-`FINALLY`-Block gekapselt. Der `FINALLY`-Block stellt sicher, dass `CLOSE CURSOR` immer aufgerufen wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. Dies ist entscheidend, um Datenbankressourcen freizugeben und Deadlocks zu vermeiden. Die Simulation eines Fehlers demonstriert, wie die Ausnahmebehandlung greift.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, Exception Handling, TRY-CATCH-FINALLY, Database

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, um Flugdaten zu lesen. Fügen Sie die gefetchten Daten in eine interne Tabelle ein und schließen Sie den Cursor. Verwenden Sie dabei `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung.

CLASS zcl_cursor_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_flight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_and_map_with_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE tt_flight_reduced
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_and_map_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Use CORRESPONDING to map fields to the target internal table
      APPEND LINES OF CORRESPONDING #( lt_package ) TO rt_reduced_flights.

      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_complex_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_transformed_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      ( mandt = sy-mandt
        carrid = COND #( WHEN strlen( ls_raw-carrier_code ) > 2 THEN ls_raw-carrier_code(2) ELSE ls_raw-carrier_code ) " Truncate if too long
        connid = COND #( WHEN ls_raw-flight_num IS NUMERIC THEN ls_raw-flight_num ELSE '0000' ) " Ensure numeric
        fldate = COND #( WHEN ls_raw-departure_date IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_raw-departure_date ELSE sy-datum ) " Default date
        price = COND #( WHEN ls_raw-base_price IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_raw-base_price IS NUMERIC THEN ls_raw-base_price ELSE '0.00' ) " Default price
        currency = 'USD'
        planetype = 'UNKNOWN'
        seatsmax = 0
        seatsocc = 0 )
    ).

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_insert ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND sy-subrc <> 4.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen transformierter Flugdatensätze'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, um Flugdaten zu lesen. Fügen Sie die gefetchten Daten in eine interne Tabelle ein und schließen Sie den Cursor. Verwenden Sie dabei den `MAP`-Operator für die Zuweisung und Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Verwenden Sie `MAP` für die Transformation der gefetchten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_map_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_mapped,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             departure_date TYPE string,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_mapped.
    TYPES tt_flight_mapped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_mapped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_and_map_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_mapped
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_map_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_and_map_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Use MAP to transform and append data
      APPEND LINES OF VALUE tt_flight_mapped(
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_package
        ( flight_id = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
          departure_date = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|
          adjusted_price = ls_sflight-price * iv_price_factor )
      ) TO rt_mapped_flights.

      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lt_summaries_to_insert) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_source_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( mandt = sy-mandt
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = 'GRP'
        fldate = sy-datum
        price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 FOR <member> IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + <member>-price )
        currency = 'AGG'
        planetype = 'SUMMARY'
        seatsmax = 0
        seatsocc = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) )
    ).

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_summaries_to_insert ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND sy-subrc <> 4.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen von Flugzusammenfassungen'.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bs_period_toolset_basics DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_period_info,

           END OF ty_s_year_range.

    METHODS get_period_for_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date           TYPE d
        iv_fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant DEFAULT 'K4'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_period_info) TYPE ty_s_period_info.

    METHODS get_period_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_fisc_yr        TYPE gjahr
        iv_fisc_period    TYPE peraf
        iv_fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant DEFAULT 'K4'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_period_dates) TYPE ty_s_period_dates.

    METHODS get_fiscal_year_range
      IMPORTING

        iv_fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant DEFAULT 'K4'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_year_range) TYPE ty_s_year_range.

    METHODS get_all_periods_for_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_fisc_yr        TYPE gjahr
        iv_fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant DEFAULT 'K4'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE ty_t_period_info.

    METHODS add_periods
      IMPORTING
        iv_date           TYPE d
        iv_periods        TYPE i
        iv_fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant DEFAULT 'K4'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_date) TYPE d.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bs_period_toolset_basics IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_period_for_date.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic for demonstration
    DATA(lv_year) = iv_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).

    rs_period_info-fisc_yr = lv_year.
    rs_period_info-fisc_period = lv_month.

    " Calculate start date of the month
    rs_period_info-period_start_date = |{ lv_year }{ lv_month }01|.
    " Calculate end date of the month
    DATA(lv_next_month_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = rs_period_info-period_start_date iv_months = 1 ).
    rs_period_info-period_end_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>subtract_days( iv_date = lv_next_month_date iv_days = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_period_dates.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic
    rs_period_dates-period_start_date = |{ iv_fisc_yr }{ iv_fisc_period }01|.
    DATA(lv_next_month_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = rs_period_dates-period_start_date iv_months = 1 ).
    rs_period_dates-period_end_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>subtract_days( iv_date = lv_next_month_date iv_days = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_fiscal_year_range.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic
    rs_year_range-year_start_date = |{ iv_fisc_yr }0101|.
    rs_year_range-year_end_date = |{ iv_fisc_yr }1231|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_periods_for_year.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic
    LOOP AT sy-tab_month INTO DATA(lv_month_num) FROM 1 TO 12.
      DATA(ls_period) = VALUE ty_s_period_info(
        fisc_yr = iv_fisc_yr
        fisc_period = |{ lv_month_num ALPHA = OUT }|
      ).
      DATA(ls_dates) = get_period_dates( iv_fisc_yr = iv_fisc_yr iv_fisc_period = ls_period-fisc_period ).
      ls_period-period_start_date = ls_dates-period_start_date.
      ls_period-period_end_date = ls_dates-period_end_date.
      APPEND ls_period TO rt_periods.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_periods.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic: adds months
    rv_new_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = iv_date iv_months = iv_periods ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Geschäftsjahresvariante für einen gegebenen Buchungskreis (z.B. '1000'). Da dies oft über Customizing erfolgt, simulieren Sie eine einfache Zuordnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Mapping-Tabelle und den `READ TABLE` mit `VALUE`-Operator oder eine `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_per_007_solution DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_fisc_variant_map,
             bukrs TYPE bukrs,
             fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant,
           END OF ty_s_fisc_variant_map.
    TYPES: ty_t_fisc_variant_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_fisc_variant_map WITH UNIQUE KEY bukrs.

    METHODS get_fisc_yr_variant
      IMPORTING
        iv_bukrs TYPE bukrs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fisc_yr_variant) TYPE fisc_yr_variant
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_per_007_solution IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fisc_yr_variant.
    CONSTANTS: lc_default_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant VALUE 'K4'.

    DATA(lt_mapping) = VALUE ty_t_fisc_variant_map(
      ( bukrs = '1000' fisc_yr_variant = 'K4' )
      ( bukrs = '2000' fisc_yr_variant = 'V3' )
      ( bukrs = '3000' fisc_yr_variant = 'V6' )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_fisc_yr_variant = lt_mapping[ bukrs = iv_bukrs ]-fisc_yr_variant.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Fallback to default or raise error
        rv_fisc_yr_variant = lc_default_variant.
        " Or raise cx_sy_read_error.
        " RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING

        iv_fisc_yr_variant TYPE fisc_yr_variant DEFAULT 'K4'
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_bs_period_toolset_basics IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_period_for_date.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic for demonstration
    DATA(lv_year) = iv_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).

    rs_period_info-fisc_yr = lv_year.
    rs_period_info-fisc_period = lv_month.

    " Calculate start date of the month
    rs_period_info-period_start_date = |{ lv_year }{ lv_month }01|.
    " Calculate end date of the month
    DATA(lv_next_month_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = rs_period_info-period_start_date iv_months = 1 ).
    rs_period_info-period_end_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>subtract_days( iv_date = lv_next_month_date iv_days = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_period_dates.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic
    rs_period_dates-period_start_date = |{ iv_fisc_yr }{ iv_fisc_period }01|.
    DATA(lv_next_month_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = rs_period_dates-period_start_date iv_months = 1 ).
    rs_period_dates-period_end_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>subtract_days( iv_date = lv_next_month_date iv_days = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_fiscal_year_range.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic
    rs_year_range-year_start_date = |{ iv_fisc_yr }0101|.
    rs_year_range-year_end_date = |{ iv_fisc_yr }1231|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_periods_for_year.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic
    LOOP AT sy-tab_month INTO DATA(lv_month_num) FROM 1 TO 12.
      DATA(ls_period) = VALUE ty_s_period_info(
        fisc_yr = iv_fisc_yr
        fisc_period = |{ lv_month_num ALPHA = OUT }|
      ).
      DATA(ls_dates) = get_period_dates( iv_fisc_yr = iv_fisc_yr iv_fisc_period = ls_period-fisc_period ).
      ls_period-period_start_date = ls_dates-period_start_date.
      ls_period-period_end_date = ls_dates-period_end_date.
      APPEND ls_period TO rt_periods.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_periods.
    " Simplified K4 (calendar year) logic: adds months
    rv_new_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = iv_date iv_months = iv_periods ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie einen einzelnen Flug aus `sflights` und verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck in der `SELECT`-Liste, um einen Status basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit einem `CASE`-Ausdruck für die Statusermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occup_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_occup_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_status) TYPE ty_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occup_status.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate,
      CASE
        WHEN seatsocc = 0 THEN 'Empty'
        WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Full'
      END AS occup_status
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight_status = ls_flight_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Komponentennamen und deren Typen einer gegebenen Struktur aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_name TYPE string,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info,
           tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR component IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
                             LET comp_descr = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( component-type ) IN
                             ( name      = component-name
                               type_name = comp_descr->get_relative_name( )
                               length    = comp_descr->length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Tabellentypnamen und fügen Sie Daten hinzu. Verwenden Sie den Typ 'SFLIGHT_TAB' (Tabelle von SFLIGHT).

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

      " Example: Add one line to SFLIGHT_TAB
      DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
      ls_sflight-carrid   = 'AA'.
      ls_sflight-connid   = '0017'.
      ls_sflight-fldate   = sy-datum.
      ls_sflight-price    = '100.00'.
      ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.

      APPEND ls_sflight TO <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_field_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen GUI-Timer, dessen Intervall sich nach jeder Auslösung dynamisch ändert (z.B. verkürzt).
hint: Ändern Sie das `interval`-Attribut des Timers im Ereignishandler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dyn_interval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_tick IMPORTING VALUE(iv_current_interval) TYPE i.
    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 5.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_current_interval TYPE i.
    DATA mv_tick_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS mc_max_ticks TYPE i VALUE 3.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dyn_interval IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mv_current_interval = iv_initial_interval.
    mo_timer->interval = mv_current_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_tick_count = mv_tick_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT timer_tick EXPORTING iv_current_interval = mv_current_interval.

    IF mv_tick_count < mc_max_ticks.
      mv_current_interval = mv_current_interval - 1. " Decrease interval
      IF mv_current_interval < 1. mv_current_interval = 1. ENDIF.
      mo_timer->interval = mv_current_interval.
      mo_timer->run( ). " Restart timer with new interval
    ELSE.
      mo_timer->free( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_external_stop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_external_stop IMPLEMENTATION.

    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).

    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.

      CLEAR mo_timer.
      RAISE EVENT timer_stopped.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " This event should ideally not fire if stop_timer is called quickly.
    " For demonstration, we just ensure it doesn't cause issues.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->run( ). " Keep running if not stopped externally
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Methoden und Attribute einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_members DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_member_info,
             name TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string, " Method or Attribute
           END OF ty_member_info,
           tt_member_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_member_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_class_members
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_members) TYPE tt_member_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_members IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_members.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

    rt_members = VALUE #( BASE rt_members
                          FOR method IN lo_class_descr->get_methods( )
                          ( name = method-name kind = 'METHOD' )
                          FOR attribute IN lo_class_descr->get_attributes( )
                          ( name = attribute-name kind = 'ATTRIBUTE' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_class_members FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_members( ).
    DATA(lt_members) = lo_cut->get_class_members( 'ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_MEMBERS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_members ).

    READ TABLE lt_members WITH KEY name = 'GET_CLASS_MEMBERS' kind = 'METHOD' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    READ TABLE lt_members WITH KEY name = 'MO_TIMER' kind = 'ATTRIBUTE' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    " This class does not have mo_timer, so it should fail.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( sy-subrc ).

    READ TABLE lt_members WITH KEY name = 'MO_TIMER' kind = 'ATTRIBUTE' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    " Test for a known attribute in a different class (e.g., cl_gui_timer)
    DATA(lt_timer_members) = lo_cut->get_class_members( 'CL_GUI_TIMER' ).
    READ TABLE lt_timer_members WITH KEY name = 'INTERVAL' kind = 'ATTRIBUTE' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_status_msg IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen GUI-Timer, der eine lange laufende Hintergrundaufgabe (simuliert) überwacht und eine Meldung anzeigt, wenn diese abgeschlossen ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und eine Statusvariable, die von der Hintergrundaufgabe gesetzt wird.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS task_completed.
    METHODS start_monitoring
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_task_finished TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS simulate_background_task.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_monitoring.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_check_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).

    " Start simulated background task (in a real scenario, this would be a separate process/thread)
    simulate_background_task( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    IF mv_task_finished = abap_true.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>set_status_bar_text( text = 'Hintergrundaufgabe abgeschlossen!' type = 'S' ).
      RAISE EVENT task_completed.
      mo_timer->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_timer.
    ELSE.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>set_status_bar_text( text = 'Hintergrundaufgabe läuft...' type = 'I' ).
      mo_timer->run( ). " Continue monitoring
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_background_task.
    " In a real scenario, this would be a separate process or a long-running function module.
    " For simulation, we just set the flag after a delay.
    WAIT UP TO 3 SECONDS.
    mv_task_finished = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_monitor( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_task_completed FOR lo_cut.

    lo_cut->start_monitoring( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_cut->mo_timer ).

    " Simulate the background task finishing and timer ticks
    lo_cut->simulate_background_task( ). " This will set mv_task_finished = abap_true

    " Simulate timer ticks until it detects completion
    DO 5 TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->mo_timer IS BOUND.
        CALL METHOD lo_cut->handle_timer_event.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_task_completed exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->mo_timer ).

    mv_task_completed = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne die Fibonacci-Folge bis zu einem Wert, der einen gegebenen Maximalwert nicht überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Sequenz zu generieren, und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fibonacci_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_fibonacci_sequence
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fibonacci) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_next_fibonacci
      IMPORTING
        iv_prev1 TYPE i
        iv_prev2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fibonacci_sequence.
    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.

    IF iv_max_value < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_max_value >= 0.
      APPEND lv_a TO rt_fibonacci.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_max_value >= 1.
      APPEND lv_b TO rt_fibonacci.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE calculate_next_fibonacci( iv_prev1 = lv_a iv_prev2 = lv_b ) <= iv_max_value.
      DATA(lv_next) = calculate_next_fibonacci( iv_prev1 = lv_a iv_prev2 = lv_b ).
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_fibonacci.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_next_fibonacci.
    rv_next = iv_prev1 + iv_prev2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `calculate_next_fibonacci` ist in der `PRIVATE SECTION` gekapselt, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit erhöht. `VALUE` wird für die Initialisierung der erwarteten Tabelle im Unit-Test verwendet.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Satz, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen, bis eine maximale Anzahl von Wörtern erreicht ist oder der Satz vollständig verarbeitet wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die iterative Verarbeitung des Strings und `FIND` mit `OFFSET` und `LENGTH` oder `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_prefix_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_prefixed_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence   TYPE string
        iv_prefix     TYPE string
        iv_max_words  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_offset   TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_word     TYPE string
        ev_word_len TYPE i
        ev_next_offset TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_prefix_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_prefixed_words.
    DATA(lv_current_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_word_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_sentence_len) = strlen( iv_sentence ).

    WHILE lv_current_offset < lv_sentence_len AND lv_word_count < iv_max_words.
      DATA(lv_word) = ''.
      DATA(lv_word_len) = 0.
      DATA(lv_next_offset) = 0.

      get_next_word(
        EXPORTING
          iv_sentence    = iv_sentence
          iv_offset      = lv_current_offset
        IMPORTING
          ev_word        = lv_word
          ev_word_len    = lv_word_len
          ev_next_offset = lv_next_offset
      ).

      IF lv_word IS INITIAL. " No more words found
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_word CP iv_prefix && '*'. " Check if word starts with prefix
        APPEND lv_word TO rt_words.
        lv_word_count = lv_word_count + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_offset = lv_next_offset.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_word.
    DATA(lv_start) = iv_offset.
    " Skip leading spaces
    WHILE lv_start < strlen( iv_sentence ) AND iv_sentence+lv_start(1) = ' '.
      lv_start = lv_start + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_start >= strlen( iv_sentence ).
      ev_word = ''.
      ev_word_len = 0.
      ev_next_offset = strlen( iv_sentence ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_end) = lv_start.
    " Find end of word (space or end of string)
    WHILE lv_end < strlen( iv_sentence ) AND iv_sentence+lv_end(1) <> ' '.
      lv_end = lv_end + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    ev_word = iv_sentence+lv_start(lv_end - lv_start).
    ev_word_len = lv_end - lv_start.
    ev_next_offset = lv_end.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_words_prefix FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_words_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_words_max_limit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_words_empty_sentence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_words_prefix.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_prefix_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_prefixed_words( iv_sentence = 'Das ist ein Test Satz mit vielen tollen Wörtern.' iv_prefix = 'T' ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table ( ( 'Test' ) ( 'tollen' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_words_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_prefix_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_prefixed_words( iv_sentence = 'Hallo Welt' iv_prefix = 'X' ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table ( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_words_max_limit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_prefix_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_prefixed_words( iv_sentence = 'Apfel Banane Ananas Birne Avocado' iv_prefix = 'A' iv_max_words = 2 ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table ( ( 'Apfel' ) ( 'Ananas' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_words_empty_sentence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_prefix_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_prefixed_words( iv_sentence = '' iv_prefix = 'A' ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table ( ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `extract_prefixed_words` verwendet eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um den Eingabestring Wort für Wort zu verarbeiten. Die Hilfsmethode `get_next_word` (privat) isoliert die Logik zum Extrahieren einzelner Wörter. Dies demonstriert die iterative String-Verarbeitung mit `WHILE` und die Kapselung von Hilfslogik in der `PRIVATE SECTION`.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Operation mit einer maximalen Anzahl von Wiederholungen versucht, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder die Wiederholungen aufgebraucht sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Zähler und einer Bedingung für den Erfolg.

CLASS zcl_retry_mechanism DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_with_retry
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_operation
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_op_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA mv_attempt_count TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_retry_mechanism IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_with_retry.
    DATA(lv_retries) = 0.
    mv_attempt_count = 0.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_retries < iv_max_retries AND rv_success = abap_false.
      mv_attempt_count = mv_attempt_count + 1.
      rv_success = simulate_operation( ).
      IF rv_success = abap_false.
        lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
        " Simulate a delay or log error here
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_operation.
    " Simulate an operation that might fail
    " For demonstration, it succeeds on the 3rd attempt
    IF mv_attempt_count = 3.
      rv_op_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_op_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_retry_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_retry_failure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_retry_zero_retries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_retry_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_mechanism( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_with_retry( iv_max_retries = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Operation should succeed within 3 retries' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_retry_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_mechanism( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_with_retry( iv_max_retries = 2 ). " Only 2 retries, but needs 3 to succeed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Operation should fail after 2 retries' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_retry_zero_retries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_mechanism( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_with_retry( iv_max_retries = 0 ). " Needs 3 to succeed, 0 retries means 1 attempt
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Operation should fail with 0 retries' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt einen generischen Wiederholungsmechanismus unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Die `simulate_operation`-Methode, die in der `PRIVATE SECTION` gekapselt ist, simuliert eine fehleranfällige Operation. Die `WHILE`-Schleife wiederholt die Operation, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder die maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht ist.
keywords: WHILE, PRIVATE SECTION, Retry, Conditional Logic, ABAP_BOOL

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) dynamisch basierend auf einer Liste von Ausschlusskriterien, bis die Tabelle eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl von Einträgen erreicht hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die iterative Filterung und `DELETE` mit `WHERE` oder `FILTER` für die Tabellenmanipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_until_size
      IMPORTING
        it_exclude_keys TYPE tt_sflight_key
        iv_min_size     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_initial_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_initial) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_until_size.
    rt_sflights = get_initial_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_exclude_idx) = 0.
    DATA(lv_exclude_count) = lines( it_exclude_keys ).

    WHILE lines( rt_sflights ) > iv_min_size AND lv_exclude_idx < lv_exclude_count.
      DATA(ls_exclude_key) = it_exclude_keys[ lv_exclude_idx + 1 ]. " +1 for 1-based index

      " Modern way to filter and assign
      rt_sflights = FILTER #( rt_sflights EXCEPT IN ( ls_exclude_key ) WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid ).

      lv_exclude_idx = lv_exclude_idx + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_initial_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_sflights_initial UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_to_min_size FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_exclusion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_all_excluded FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_to_min_size.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_exclude_keys) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_filter=>tt_sflight_key (
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0064' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0550' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_until_size( it_exclude_keys = lt_exclude_keys iv_min_size = 5 ).
    " Assert that the size is at least iv_min_size, or all exclusions were applied
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_result ) >= 5 OR lines( lt_result ) = 0 ) ).
    " Further specific checks could be added if initial data is fixed
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_exclusion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_exclude_keys) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_filter=>tt_sflight_key ( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_until_size( it_exclude_keys = lt_exclude_keys iv_min_size = 10 ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = lo_cut->get_initial_sflights( ). " Access private method for comparison
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_initial ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_all_excluded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_exclude_keys) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_filter=>tt_sflight_key (
      FOR ls_sflight IN lo_cut->get_initial_sflights( ) ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_until_size( it_exclude_keys = lt_exclude_keys iv_min_size = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Filterung einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife. In jeder Iteration wird ein Ausschlusskriterium angewendet, bis die Tabelle eine bestimmte Mindestgröße erreicht oder alle Ausschlusskriterien verarbeitet wurden. Die `FILTER`-Operator ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature für die Tabellenmanipulation. Die Methode `get_initial_sflights` ist privat gekapselt.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Arbeitstagen nach einem Startdatum liegt, wobei Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) übersprungen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um Tage zu inkrementieren, und prüfen Sie den Wochentag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_day_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_after_working_days
      IMPORTING
        id_start_date TYPE d
        iv_working_days TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rd_target_date) TYPE d.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_weekend
      IMPORTING
        id_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_weekend) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_day_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_after_working_days.
    rd_target_date = id_start_date.
    DATA(lv_days_added) = 0.

    WHILE lv_days_added < iv_working_days.
      rd_target_date = rd_target_date + 1. " Increment day
      IF is_weekend( rd_target_date ) = abap_false.
        lv_days_added = lv_days_added + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_weekend.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( id_date ).
    IF lv_weekday = 6 OR lv_weekday = 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      rv_is_weekend = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_weekend = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Zustandsmaschine für einen Bestellprozess (z.B. Erstellt -> Genehmigt -> Versandt -> Abgeschlossen). Die Zustandsübergänge sollen durch eine `WHILE`-Schleife gesteuert werden, bis der Endzustand erreicht ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Zustandsübergänge zu simulieren, und eine private Methode, um den nächsten Zustand zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_state_machine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_state,
             state_id   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_order_state.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_states,
                 created   TYPE ty_order_state VALUE 'CREATED',
                 approved  TYPE ty_order_state VALUE 'APPROVED',
                 shipped   TYPE ty_order_state VALUE 'SHIPPED',
                 completed TYPE ty_order_state VALUE 'COMPLETED',
               END OF gc_states.

    METHODS process_order
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_state TYPE ty_order_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_final_state) TYPE ty_order_state.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_state TYPE ty_order_state.
    METHODS get_next_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_next_state) TYPE ty_order_state.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_state_machine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_order.
    mv_current_state = iv_start_state.

    WHILE mv_current_state-state_id <> gc_states-completed-state_id.
      mv_current_state = get_next_state( ).
      " Simulate some processing for each state
      " cl_demo_output=>display( |Current state: { mv_current_state-description }| ).
    ENDWHILE.

    rs_final_state = mv_current_state.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_state.
    CASE mv_current_state-state_id.
      WHEN gc_states-created-state_id.
        rs_next_state = gc_states-approved.
      WHEN gc_states-approved-state_id.
        rs_next_state = gc_states-shipped.
      WHEN gc_states-shipped-state_id.
        rs_next_state = gc_states-completed.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Should not happen if states are well-defined
        rs_next_state = mv_current_state.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine dynamische Suche in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) durchführt, indem sie eine Liste von Suchkriterien iterativ anwendet, bis ein einzelner Treffer gefunden wird oder alle Kriterien angewendet wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die iterative Anwendung der Kriterien und `REDUCE` mit `COND` für die dynamische Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_search_criteria,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_search_criteria,
           tt_search_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_search_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dynamic_search_sflight
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_search_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_flight) TYPE sflight.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_search_sflight.
    DATA(lt_current_flights) = get_all_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_criteria_idx) = 0.
    DATA(lv_criteria_count) = lines( it_criteria ).

    WHILE lines( lt_current_flights ) > 1 AND lv_criteria_idx < lv_criteria_count.
      DATA(ls_criteria) = it_criteria[ lv_criteria_idx + 1 ].

      " Dynamically filter using REDUCE and COND
      lt_current_flights = REDUCE #( INIT result = lt_current_flights
                                     FOR ls_flight IN lt_current_flights
                                     WHERE ( COND #( WHEN ls_criteria-field_name = 'CARRID' AND ls_flight-carrid = ls_criteria-field_value THEN abap_true
                                                     WHEN ls_criteria-field_name = 'CONNID' AND ls_flight-connid = ls_criteria-field_value THEN abap_true
                                                     WHEN ls_criteria-field_name = 'FLDATE' AND ls_flight-fldate = ls_criteria-field_value THEN abap_true
                                                     ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true )
                                     FOR ls_filtered IN result ( ls_filtered ) ).

      lv_criteria_idx = lv_criteria_idx + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lines( lt_current_flights ) = 1.
      rs_found_flight = lt_current_flights[ 1 ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_all_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Diese Klasse führt eine dynamische Suche in der `sflights`-Tabelle durch. Eine `WHILE`-Schleife wendet iterativ Suchkriterien an, bis nur noch ein Treffer übrig ist oder alle Kriterien verbraucht sind. Die Filterung innerhalb der Schleife nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `COND` für eine moderne und flexible dynamische Filterlogik. Die Methode `get_all_sflights` ist privat gekapselt.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Wenn eine Gruppe eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen überschreitet, verarbeiten Sie diese Gruppe und entfernen Sie sie aus der weiteren Betrachtung, bis alle Gruppen verarbeitet wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die iterative Gruppenverarbeitung und `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_group_key,
           tt_flight_group_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_group_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_groups) TYPE tt_flight_group_key.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_initial_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_groups.
    get_initial_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_remaining_flights) = mt_all_sflights.

    WHILE lines( lt_remaining_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_group_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_remaining_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING AS GROUP_KEY.
        DATA(lt_group_members) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY ( FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight ( member ) ).
        IF lines( lt_group_members ) >= iv_min_group_size.
          " Process this group (e.g., add to result, log, etc.)
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group_key( carrid = GROUP_KEY-carrid connid = GROUP_KEY-connid ) TO rt_processed_groups.

          " Remove processed flights from lt_remaining_flights
          lt_remaining_flights = FILTER #( lt_remaining_flights EXCEPT IN ( GROUP_KEY ) WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid ).
          lv_group_found = abap_true.
          EXIT. " Exit LOOP AT GROUP BY to re-evaluate lt_remaining_flights
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_group_found = abap_false.
        " No more groups meet the criteria, or no groups left
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_initial_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_all_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_groups_large_enough FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_groups_too_small FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_groups_empty_initial FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_groups_large_enough.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flight_groups( iv_min_group_size = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_processed ) > 0 ).
    " Further assertions could check specific group keys if test data is controlled
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_groups_too_small.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flight_groups( iv_min_group_size = 100 ). " Unlikely to find groups this large
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_processed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_groups_empty_initial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_processor( ).
    " Manually clear internal table for this test case
    CLEAR lo_cut->mt_all_sflights.
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flight_groups( iv_min_group_size = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_processed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Innerhalb der Schleife wird `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` verwendet, um Flüge zu gruppieren. Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von eindeutigen IDs, bis eine bestimmte Anzahl erreicht ist. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Generierung zu steuern, und stellen Sie sicher, dass die IDs eindeutig sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und eine private Methode zur ID-Generierung. Prüfen Sie die Eindeutigkeit mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_id_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_ids
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_new_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_id) TYPE string.
    DATA mv_id_counter TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_ids.
    mv_id_counter = 0.
    DATA(lv_generated_count) = 0.

    WHILE lv_generated_count < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_new_id) = get_new_id( ).
      IF NOT line_exists( rt_unique_ids[ table_line = lv_new_id ] ).
        APPEND lv_new_id TO rt_unique_ids.
        lv_generated_count = lv_generated_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_new_id.
    mv_id_counter = mv_id_counter + 1.
    rv_new_id = |ID_{ mv_id_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch die Attribute einer Klasse mit RTTI. Iterieren Sie durch die Attribute einer Klasse und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus, bis ein Attribut mit einem bestimmten Präfix gefunden wird oder alle Attribute geprüft wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` für die Iteration durch die Attribute und `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_attribute_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_prefix     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_attribute) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_attribute_descr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_attribute_by_prefix.
    DATA(lt_attributes) = get_class_attributes( io_object ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    DATA(lv_attribute_count) = lines( lt_attributes ).

    WHILE lv_index < lv_attribute_count.
      DATA(ls_attribute) = lt_attributes[ lv_index + 1 ].
      IF ls_attribute-name CP iv_prefix && '*'.
        rv_found_attribute = ls_attribute-name.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    rt_attributes = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen aus einem String, bis keine weiteren Leerzeichen mehr entfernt werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und den `CONDENSE` Befehl oder String-Funktionen wie `FIND` und `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_trimmer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string_while
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS remove_leading_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS remove_trailing_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_trimmer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string_while.
    DATA(lv_current_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_previous_string) = ''.

    WHILE lv_current_string <> lv_previous_string.
      lv_previous_string = lv_current_string.
      lv_current_string = remove_leading_spaces( lv_current_string ).
      lv_current_string = remove_trailing_spaces( lv_current_string ).
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_trimmed_string = lv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_leading_spaces.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    WHILE lv_offset < strlen( iv_string ) AND iv_string+lv_offset(1) = ' '.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_result = iv_string+lv_offset.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_trailing_spaces.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_string ).
    WHILE lv_length > 0 AND iv_string+lv_length-1(1) = ' '.
      lv_length = lv_length - 1.
    ENDWHWHILE.
    rv_result = iv_string(lv_length).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ, bis das Ergebnis einen bestimmten Maximalwert überschreitet. Geben Sie die letzte Fakultät zurück, die den Maximalwert nicht überschritten hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die iterative Berechnung und eine private Methode für die Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_factorial_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial_until_max
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_last_factorial) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factorial_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial_until_max.
    DATA(lv_n) = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_factorial) = 1.
    DATA(lv_previous_factorial) = 1.

    IF iv_max_value < 1.
      rv_last_factorial = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_current_factorial <= iv_max_value.
      lv_previous_factorial = lv_current_factorial.
      lv_n = lv_n + 1.
      TRY.
          lv_current_factorial = multiply_safely( iv_num1 = lv_current_factorial iv_num2 = lv_n ).
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
          " Overflow occurred, previous factorial is the last valid one
          rv_last_factorial = lv_previous_factorial.
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_last_factorial = lv_previous_factorial.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_safely.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_first_greater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS find_first_number_greater_than
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_number) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " No private methods needed for this simple example, but section is included as per requirement.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_first_greater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_number_greater_than.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_table_lines) = lines( it_numbers ).

    rv_found_number = 0. " Default to 0 if not found

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_table_lines.
      DATA(lv_current_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_number > iv_threshold.
        rv_found_number = lv_current_number.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key,
           tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression mit VALUE und COND für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status,
           tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                  connid = flight-connid
                                  price = flight-price
                                  status = COND string( WHEN flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 'Teuer' ELSE 'Günstig' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 )
                                      msg = 'Result table should not be null' ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      IF ls_first_flight-price > 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-status exp = 'Teuer' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-status exp = 'Günstig' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus FOR-Expression und COND-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung innerhalb von Schleifen oder Konstruktorausdrücken. Dies verbessert die Klarheit des Codes erheblich im Vergleich zu IF-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus SFLIGHT eine berechnete 'Reisezeit' (angenommen als CONNID / 10) und den Flugpreis enthält. Verwenden Sie eine lokale Variable innerhalb der FOR-Expression für die Berechnung.

CLASS zcl_for_let_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             travel_time TYPE i,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_details RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_let_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rt_flight_details = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                 LET lv_travel_time = flight-connid DIV 10 IN
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   connid = flight-connid
                                   travel_time = lv_travel_time
                                   price = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_let_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 )
                                      msg = 'Result table should not be null' ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].

    ENDIF.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag von einer Währung in eine andere, unter Berücksichtigung eines bestimmten Datums. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine vereinfachte Logik für den Wechselkurs verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT CURRENCY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_data,
             amount     TYPE bapi_curr,
             currency_in  TYPE waers,
             currency_out TYPE waers,
             date       TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_currency_data.

    METHODS convert_currency_amount
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_currency_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_amount) TYPE bapi_curr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_currency_amount.
    DATA(lv_factor) TYPE f. " Conversion factor
    DATA(lv_rate)   TYPE f. " Exchange rate

    " In a real scenario, you would fetch exchange rates from TCURR or a similar table.
    " For this example, we'll use a simplified logic or mock data.
    " Let's assume 1 EUR = 1.1 USD for simplicity.
    IF is_data-currency_in = 'EUR' AND is_data-currency_out = 'USD'.
      lv_rate = '1.1'.
    ELSEIF is_data-currency_in = 'USD' AND is_data-currency_out = 'EUR'.
      lv_rate = '0.909'. " Approx 1/1.1
    ELSEIF is_data-currency_in = is_data-currency_out.
      rv_converted_amount = is_data-amount.
      RETURN.
    ELSE.
      " Handle other currencies or error
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message. " Or a custom exception
    ENDIF.

    CONVERT CURRENCY is_data-amount
      FROM is_data-currency_in
      TO is_data-currency_out
      DATE is_data-date
      INTO rv_converted_amount
      RATE lv_rate
      FACTOR lv_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Menge von einer Mengeneinheit in eine andere. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine vereinfachte Logik für die Umrechnung verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT UNIT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unit_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unit_data,
             quantity_in  TYPE menge_d,
             unit_in      TYPE meins,
             unit_out     TYPE meins,
           END OF ty_unit_data.

    METHODS convert_quantity_unit
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_unit_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_quantity) TYPE menge_d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unit_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_quantity_unit.
    " In a real scenario, you would fetch conversion factors from T006 or a similar table.
    " For this example, we'll use a simplified logic or mock data.
    " Let's assume 1 KG = 1000 G
    IF is_data-unit_in = 'KG' AND is_data-unit_out = 'G'.
      rv_converted_quantity = is_data-quantity_in * 1000.
      RETURN.
    ELSEIF is_data-unit_in = 'G' AND is_data-unit_out = 'KG'.
      rv_converted_quantity = is_data-quantity_in / 1000.
      RETURN.
    ELSEIF is_data-unit_in = is_data-unit_out.
      rv_converted_quantity = is_data-quantity_in.
      RETURN.
    ELSE.
      " The CONVERT UNIT statement would typically look like this:
      " CONVERT QUANTITY is_data-quantity_in
      "   UNIT is_data-unit_in
      "   TO UNIT is_data-unit_out
      "   INTO rv_converted_quantity.
      " This relies on customizing in T006 and related tables.
      " For a simple example, direct multiplication is used if not relying on T006 setup.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             date TYPE sy-datum,

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Flugdatum, Abflugzeit). Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge, die an einem bestimmten Datum nach einer bestimmten Uhrzeit starten, indem Sie die Abflugzeit in einen Zeitstempel konvertieren und `REDUCE` verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONVERT` und einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_after_time
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_date    TYPE sy-datum
        iv_time    TYPE sy-uzeit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_after_time.
    DATA(lv_threshold_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
    CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_threshold_timestamp.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                             LET lv_flight_timestamp TYPE timestampl = '' IN
                               ( CONVERT DATE <fs_flight>-fldate TIME <fs_flight>-fltime INTO TIME STAMP lv_flight_timestamp.
                                 IF lv_flight_timestamp > lv_threshold_timestamp
                                   AND <fs_flight>-fldate = iv_date. " Only count for the specified date
                                   count = count + 1.
                                 ENDIF ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( fldate = '20251124' fltime = '120000' )

Innerhalb der `REDUCE`-Schleife wird die `CONVERT` Anweisung verwendet, um Datum und Uhrzeit in einen Zeitstempel umzuwandeln, was eine einfache Vergleichslogik ermöglicht.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag basierend auf einem Konvertierungstyp (z.B. 'CURRENCY', 'UNIT', 'TIMESTAMP'). Verwenden Sie hierfür die `SWITCH`-Expression.
