solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_conversion_type TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_conversion_type,
                 currency TYPE ty_conversion_type VALUE 'CURRENCY',
                 unit     TYPE ty_conversion_type VALUE 'UNIT',
                 timestamp TYPE ty_conversion_type VALUE 'TIMESTAMP',
               END OF gc_conversion_type.

    METHODS convert_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_type      TYPE ty_conversion_type
        iv_amount    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 OPTIONAL
        iv_currency_in TYPE waers OPTIONAL
        iv_currency_out TYPE waers OPTIONAL
        iv_quantity  TYPE menge_d OPTIONAL
        iv_unit_in   TYPE meins OPTIONAL
        iv_unit_out  TYPE meins OPTIONAL
        iv_date      TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
        iv_time      TYPE sy-uzeit OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_by_type.
    rv_result_string = SWITCH #( iv_type
      WHEN gc_conversion_type-currency THEN
        REDUCE string( INIT res = ''
                        LET lv_converted_amount TYPE bapi_curr = ''
                            lv_rate TYPE f = '1.1' " Simplified rate
                            lv_factor TYPE f = 0 IN
                          ( CONVERT CURRENCY iv_amount
                            FROM iv_currency_in
                            TO iv_currency_out
                            DATE sy-datum
                            INTO lv_converted_amount
                            RATE lv_rate
                            FACTOR lv_factor.
                            res = |{ lv_converted_amount } { iv_currency_out }| ) )
      WHEN gc_conversion_type-unit THEN
        REDUCE string( INIT res = ''
                        LET lv_converted_quantity TYPE menge_d = '' IN
                          ( IF iv_unit_in = 'KG' AND iv_unit_out = 'G'.
                              lv_converted_quantity = iv_quantity * 1000.
                            ELSEIF iv_unit_in = 'G' AND iv_unit_out = 'KG'.
                              lv_converted_quantity = iv_quantity / 1000.
                            ELSE.
                              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message.
                            ENDIF.
                            res = |{ lv_converted_quantity } { iv_unit_out }| ) )
      WHEN gc_conversion_type-timestamp THEN
        REDUCE string( INIT res = ''
                        LET lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl = '' IN
                          ( CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_timestamp.
                            res = |{ lv_timestamp TIMESTAMP = ISO }| ) )
      ELSE
        'Unsupported Conversion Type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und konvertieren Sie das Flugdatum und die Abflugzeit direkt in einen Zeitstempel während des `SELECT`-Statements.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... AS ...` und `CONVERT` in einem `SELECT`-Statement (falls möglich, sonst nach dem SELECT).
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_convert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_timestamp,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_flight_timestamp.
    TYPES: tt_flight_timestamp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_timestamp WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_timestamp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_convert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_timestamp.
    " Direct CONVERT in SELECT is not supported. Perform conversion after SELECT.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                             LET lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl = '' IN
                               ( CONVERT DATE <fs_sflight>-fldate TIME <fs_sflight>-fltime INTO TIME STAMP lv_timestamp.
                                 carrid    = <fs_sflight>-carrid,
                                 connid    = <fs_sflight>-connid,
                                 timestamp = lv_timestamp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine generische Konvertierungslogik kapselt. Die Klasse soll eine Methode `convert_value` haben, die einen Wert und einen Zieltyp akzeptiert und den konvertierten Wert zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um den Zieltyp zu bestimmen und die entsprechende `CONVERT`-Anweisung dynamisch aufzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`) und `CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value    TYPE any
        iv_target_type TYPE string " e.g., 'TIMESTAMPL', 'BAPI_CURR', 'MENGE_D'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE string " Return as string for generic display.
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_dst_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_value.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_time TYPE sy-uzeit,
          lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl,
          lv_amount TYPE bapi_curr,
          lv_currency_in TYPE waers VALUE 'EUR',
          lv_currency_out TYPE waers VALUE 'USD',
          lv_quantity TYPE menge_d,
          lv_unit_in TYPE meins VALUE 'KG',
          lv_unit_out TYPE meins VALUE 'G'.

    CASE iv_target_type.
      WHEN 'TIMESTAMPL'.
        " Assuming iv_value is a string 'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS'
        IF iv_value IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_date = iv_value(8).
          lv_time = iv_value+8(6).
          CONVERT DATE lv_date TIME lv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_timestamp.
          rv_converted_value = |{ lv_timestamp TIMESTAMP = ISO }|.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'BAPI_CURR'.
        " Simplified currency conversion
        TRY.
            lv_amount = iv_value.
            DATA(lv_rate) TYPE f = '1.1'.
            DATA(lv_factor) TYPE f = 0.
            CONVERT CURRENCY lv_amount
              FROM lv_currency_in
              TO lv_currency_out
              DATE sy-datum
              INTO lv_amount
              RATE lv_rate
              FACTOR lv_factor.
            rv_converted_value = |{ lv_amount } { lv_currency_out }|.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            rv_converted_value = 'Conversion Error'.
        ENDTRY.
      WHEN 'MENGE_D'.
        " Simplified unit conversion
        TRY.
            lv_quantity = iv_value.
            IF lv_unit_in = 'KG' AND lv_unit_out = 'G'.
              lv_quantity = lv_quantity * 1000.
            ELSEIF lv_unit_in = 'G' AND lv_unit_out = 'KG'.
              lv_quantity = lv_quantity / 1000.
            ENDIF.
            rv_converted_value = |{ lv_quantity } { lv_unit_out }|.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            rv_converted_value = 'Conversion Error'.
        ENDTRY.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_converted_value = 'Unsupported Target Type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einen Zeitstempel und anschließend in eine lokale Zeitzone. Verwenden Sie hierfür die `CONVERT` Anweisung mit `TIME ZONE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONVERT TIME STAMP ... INTO DATE ... TIME ... TIME ZONE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dtc_timezone DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_local_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_date      TYPE sy-datum
        iv_time      TYPE sy-uzeit
        iv_timezone  TYPE timezone
      EXPORTING
        ev_local_date TYPE sy-datum
        ev_local_time TYPE sy-uzeit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dtc_timezone IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_local_timezone.
    DATA(lv_utc_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
    CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_utc_timestamp.

    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_utc_timestamp
      INTO DATE ev_local_date
      TIME ev_local_time
      TIME ZONE iv_timezone.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_local_timezone.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dtc_timezone( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_date) = '20251124'.
    DATA(lv_utc_time) = '100000'. " 10:00 AM UTC
    DATA(lv_timezone) = 'CET'.   " Central European Time (UTC+1)

    DATA(lv_local_date) TYPE sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_local_time) TYPE sy-uzeit.

    lo_cut->convert_to_local_timezone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date      = lv_utc_date
        iv_time      = lv_utc_time
        iv_timezone  = lv_timezone
      IMPORTING
        ev_local_date = lv_local_date
        ev_local_time = lv_local_time
    ).

    " Expected result for 10:00 AM UTC in CET (UTC+1) is 11:00 AM
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_local_date
      exp = '20251124'
      msg = 'Local date should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_local_time
      exp = '110000'
      msg = 'Local time should be 11:00:00'
    ).

    " Test with a different timezone (e.g., EST, UTC-5)
    lv_timezone = 'EST'.
    lo_cut->convert_to_local_timezone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date      = lv_utc_date
        iv_time      = lv_utc_time
        iv_timezone  = lv_timezone
      IMPORTING
        ev_local_date = lv_local_date
        ev_local_time = lv_local_time
    ).
    " Expected result for 10:00 AM UTC in EST (UTC-5) is 05:00 AM
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_local_date
      exp = '20251124'
      msg = 'Local date for EST should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_local_time
      exp = '050000'
      msg = 'Local time for EST should be 05:00:00'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung eines Zeitstempels in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit unter Berücksichtigung einer spezifischen Zeitzone. Die `CONVERT TIME STAMP ... INTO DATE ... TIME ... TIME ZONE ...` Anweisung ist hierfür das Standardwerkzeug und unerlässlich für die korrekte Handhabung von Datums- und Zeitangaben in globalen Anwendungen.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Währungsumrechnung durch, bei der die Quell- und Zielwährung sowie der Betrag zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden. Nutzen Sie `CONVERT CURRENCY` und behandeln Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT CURRENCY` und Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY ... CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_currency_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dynamic_currency_conversion
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_str    TYPE string
        iv_currency_in   TYPE waers
        iv_currency_out  TYPE waers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_currency_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_currency_conversion.
    DATA: lv_amount TYPE bapi_curr,
          lv_converted_amount TYPE bapi_curr,
          lv_rate TYPE f = '1.1', " Simplified rate
          lv_factor TYPE f = 0.

    TRY.
        lv_amount = iv_amount_str.

        CONVERT CURRENCY lv_amount
          FROM iv_currency_in
          TO iv_currency_out
          DATE sy-datum
          INTO lv_converted_amount
          RATE lv_rate
          FACTOR lv_factor.

        rv_result_str = |{ lv_converted_amount } { iv_currency_out }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_result_str = 'Error: Invalid amount format or conversion issue'.
      CATCH cx_abap_message.
        rv_result_str = 'Error: Currency conversion failed (e.g., unsupported currencies)'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Flügen, deren Abflugzeit nach einer bestimmten Uhrzeit liegt, und konvertieren Sie dabei das Flugdatum und die Abflugzeit in einen Zeitstempel. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `CONVERT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die `CONVERT` beinhaltet.

CLASS zcl_filter_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_after_time
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_date        TYPE sy-datum
        iv_time_threshold TYPE sy-uzeit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_after_time.
    DATA(lv_threshold_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
    CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time_threshold INTO TIME STAMP lv_threshold_timestamp.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( fldate = iv_date AND
                                            ( REDUCE timestampl( INIT ts = ''
                                                                 LET lv_fldate = fldate
                                                                     lv_fltime = fltime IN
                                                                   ( CONVERT DATE lv_fldate TIME lv_fltime INTO TIME STAMP ts.
                                                                     RESULT = ts ) ) > lv_threshold_timestamp ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_convert( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_convert=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' fltime = '090000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251124' fltime = '103000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251124' fltime = '110000' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251125' fltime = '100000' ) " Different date
    ).

    DATA(lv_date_filter) = '20251124'.
    DATA(lv_time_threshold) = '100000'. " 10:00 AM

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_after_time(
      it_all_flights    = lt_all_flights
      iv_date           = lv_date_filter
      iv_time_threshold = lv_time_threshold
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should find 2 flights after 10:00 AM on 20251124'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = '0401'
      msg = 'First filtered flight should be 0401'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = '0402'
      msg = 'Second filtered flight should be 0402'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FILTER`-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) in Kombination mit der `CONVERT`-Anweisung, um interne Tabellen effizient zu filtern. Die `REDUCE`-Expression wird innerhalb der `WHERE`-Bedingung verwendet, um die Abflugzeit in einen Zeitstempel zu konvertieren und so einen direkten Vergleich mit dem Schwellenwert-Zeitstempel zu ermöglichen. Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Methode zur Datenmanipulation.
keywords: CONVERT, FILTER, Internal Tables, TIMESTAMP, Functional Programming, WHERE

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Fangen Sie mögliche Datenbankfehler mit moderner Ausnahmebehandlung ab, anstatt `sy-subrc` zu prüfen. Die Methode soll `abap_true` zurückgeben, wenn die Aktualisierung erfolgreich war, und `abap_false`, wenn kein Eintrag gefunden wurde. Bei einem Datenbankfehler soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db` um Datenbankfehler abzufangen und `sy-dbcnt` für die Anzahl der betroffenen Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid.
    ls_sflight-connid = iv_connid.
    ls_sflight-fldate = iv_fldate.
    ls_sflight-price  = iv_price.

    TRY.
        UPDATE sflight SET price = ls_sflight-price WHERE carrid = ls_sflight-carrid AND connid = ls_sflight-connid AND fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.
        IF sy-dbcnt = 0. " Check if any row was updated
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ELSE.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_db_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_no_record FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA: go_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_db_update_sflight.
  DATA: gs_test_flight TYPE sflight.

  METHOD setup.
    go_cut = NEW zcl_db_update_sflight( ).
    gs_test_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    gs_test_flight-connid = '0400'.
    gs_test_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    gs_test_flight-price  = '100.00'.
    INSERT sflight FROM gs_test_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      UPDATE sflight SET price = '100.00' WHERE carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid AND connid = gs_test_flight-connid AND fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid AND connid = gs_test_flight-connid AND fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '200.00'.
    DATA(lv_success) = go_cut->update_flight(
        iv_carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid
        iv_connid = gs_test_flight-connid
        iv_fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate
        iv_price  = lv_new_price
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    SELECT SINGLE price INTO DATA(lv_actual_price) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid AND connid = gs_test_flight-connid AND fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_new_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_no_record.
    DATA(lv_success) = go_cut->update_flight(
        iv_carrid = 'XX' " Non-existent carrier
        iv_connid = '0001'
        iv_fldate = sy-datum
        iv_price  = '500.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für Datenbankoperationen ist der modernen ABAP-Standard, da sie eine robustere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht als die Prüfung von `sy-subrc`. Spezifische Ausnahmen wie `cx_sy_open_sql_db` können gezielt abgefangen und behandelt werden, was zu klarerem und wartbarerem Code führt. `sy-dbcnt` wird hier verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob eine Zeile aktualisiert wurde, was eine Geschäftslogikprüfung und keine Fehlerbehandlung ist.
keywords: sy-subrc, TRY...CATCH, UPDATE, COMMIT WORK, ROLLBACK WORK, Exception Handling, Database Operations

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, ohne `sy-subrc` nach einem `READ TABLE` zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE i,
             val TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_line_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_line_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( it_data[ key = iv_key ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_line_exists_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_true.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_it_line_exists=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 val = 'Test1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 2 val = 'Test2' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_line_exists( it_data = lt_data iv_key = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_exists_false.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_it_line_exists=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 val = 'Test1' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_line_exists( it_data = lt_data iv_key = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne auf `READ TABLE` und die anschließende `sy-subrc`-Prüfung angewiesen zu sein. In Kombination mit dem `COND`-Ausdruck wird der Code noch kompakter und lesbarer.
keywords: sy-subrc, READ TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, COND

CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
        WHEN iv_status = 'A' THEN 'Active'
        WHEN iv_status = 'I' THEN 'Inactive'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder einer Quelltabelle enthält und diese transformiert, ohne eine explizite `LOOP AT` Schleife zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck zur Tabellenkomprehension.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_processed,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_processed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( 
        FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
        ( 
            flight_key      = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
            formatted_price = |{ ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }|
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_raw TYPE zcl_it_for_expression=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251225' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_raw.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-flight_key exp = 'LH-0400-24.11.2025' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-formatted_price exp = '100,00 EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-flight_key exp = 'AA-0001-25.12.2025' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-formatted_price exp = '250.50 USD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP AT`-Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen, was den Code deutlich kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. In Kombination mit String-Templates können Daten direkt während der Transformation formatiert werden.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Table Comprehension, VALUE, String Templates

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, ohne eine explizite `LOOP AT` Schleife zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
        NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen wie Summen, Zählungen oder die Ermittlung von Min/Max-Werten. Er ersetzt eine `LOOP AT`-Schleife mit einer expliziten Akkumulator-Variablen und macht den Code funktionaler und kompakter. Die `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine direkte Filterung der zu aggregierenden Daten.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle nach einem bestimmten Kriterium und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen, ohne eine explizite `LOOP AT` Schleife zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_all TYPE zcl_it_filter_expression=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_all.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251225' ) TO lt_all.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_all.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_all iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie den Status eines Enterprise Search (ESH) Caches mit der Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Ausnahmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK=>S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` und `TRY...CATCH cx_esh_ca_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_esh_cache_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_cache_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_esh_cache_status.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_is_active) = cl_esh_ca_check=>s_esh_eng_cache( iv_cache_id = iv_cache_id ).
        IF lv_is_active = abap_true.
          rv_status_message = |Cache '{ iv_cache_id }' ist aktiv.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_status_message = |Cache '{ iv_cache_id }' ist inaktiv.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        rv_status_message = |Fehler beim Prüfen des Caches '{ iv_cache_id }': { lx_esh_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        rv_status_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler beim Prüfen des Caches '{ iv_cache_id }': { lx_general_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_active_cache FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_inactive_cache FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_active_cache.
    " This test assumes a mock or a known active cache. For a real unit test,
    " CL_ESH_CA_CHECK would need to be mocked. Here, we simulate a positive outcome.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->check_esh_cache_status( 'KNOWN_ACTIVE_CACHE' ).
    " Since we cannot mock CL_ESH_CA_CHECK directly in a simple unit test,
    " we assert based on the expected behavior if it were active.
    " In a real scenario, this would require a test double for CL_ESH_CA_CHECK.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = |Cache 'KNOWN_ACTIVE_CACHE' ist inaktiv.| ). " Default behavior if not mocked
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_inactive_cache.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->check_esh_cache_status( 'NON_EXISTENT_CACHE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = |Cache 'NON_EXISTENT_CACHE' ist inaktiv.| ). " Default behavior if not mocked
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    " Simulating an error from CL_ESH_CA_CHECK is difficult without mocking.
    " This test primarily verifies the error handling path is present.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->check_esh_cache_status( 'INVALID_CACHE_ID_TO_TRIGGER_ERROR' ).
    " We expect a generic 'inaktiv' or an error message if the system throws one.
    " For a robust test, mocking CL_ESH_CA_CHECK to throw CX_ESH_CA_ERROR is necessary.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler' act = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Interaktion mit Systemklassen wie `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` erfolgt in modernem ABAP über funktionale Methodenaufrufe und eine umfassende Ausnahmebehandlung mittels `TRY...CATCH`. Dies stellt sicher, dass der Code robust auf unerwartete Systemzustände oder Fehler reagiert. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und String-Templates verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit.
keywords: cl_esh_ca_check, S_ESH_ENG_CACHE, Cache check, Object Orientation, Exception Handling, TRY...CATCH, System Interaction

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von funktionalen Methodenaufrufen, um eine komplexe Transformation von Daten in einem einzigen Ausdruck durchzuführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Aufrufe zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE string.
    METHODS add_prefix  IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_suffix  IMPORTING iv_suffix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS to_upper    RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result  RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_value = |{ iv_prefix }{ mv_value }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_suffix.
    mv_value = |{ mv_value }{ iv_suffix }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_value = to_upper( mv_value ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 'world' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->add_prefix( 'hello ' )->add_suffix( '!' )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLO WORLD!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies führt zu einem sehr flüssigen, lesbaren und funktionalen Programmierstil, der komplexe Operationen prägnant darstellt.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, ME

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle nach einem Kriterium und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen, ohne explizite `LOOP AT GROUP` oder `AT NEW/END` zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR GROUP`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             price  TYPE sbook-loccuram,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_bookings TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sbook-loccuram,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_bookings_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_flight_booking
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_bookings_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_booking IN it_bookings BY ls_booking-carrid
        ( 
            carrid = ls_booking-carrid,
            total_bookings = GROUP SIZE,
            total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sbook-loccuram = 0
                                    FOR member IN GROUP ls_booking
                                    NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) 
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_bookings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_bookings_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_bookings.
    DATA: lt_bookings TYPE zcl_it_for_group=>tt_flight_booking.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' bookid = '0001' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' bookid = '0002' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' bookid = '0003' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' bookid = '0004' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_bookings.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_bookings_by_carrier( lt_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_bookings exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price exp = '300.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_bookings exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_price exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_bookings_empty.
    DATA: lt_bookings TYPE zcl_it_for_group=>tt_flight_booking.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_bookings_by_carrier( lt_bookings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF`-Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Er ersetzt die älteren `LOOP AT GROUP` oder `AT NEW/END`-Konstrukte durch eine deklarative Syntax, die die Gruppierung und die Verarbeitung der Gruppenmitglieder in einem einzigen Ausdruck ermöglicht. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können komplexe Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchgeführt werden.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, REDUCE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit und rufen Sie eine Methode basierend auf dem ermittelten Typ auf, ohne `sy-subrc` für die Typprüfung zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CAST` und `IS INSTANCE OF` für die Typprüfung und `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error` für dynamische Aufrufe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_message_provider.
    METHODS process_object
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_message_provider.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_msg) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_type_a DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_message_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_type_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_msg = 'Message from Type A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_type_b DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_message_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_type_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_msg = 'Message from Type B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_object.
    TRY.
        IF io_object IS INSTANCE OF if_message_provider.
          DATA(lo_message_provider) = CAST if_message_provider( io_object ).
          rv_message = lo_message_provider->get_message( ).
        ELSE.
          rv_message = 'Object does not implement IF_MESSAGE_PROVIDER'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_message = |Dynamic call error: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        rv_message = |Unexpected error: { lx_general_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_type_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_type_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unsupported_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_type_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_object_a) = NEW lcl_type_a( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->process_object( lo_object_a ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Message from Type A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_type_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_object_b) = NEW lcl_type_b( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->process_object( lo_object_b ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Message from Type B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unsupported_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lo_object_unsupported) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ). " Itself, does not implement the interface
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->process_object( lo_object_unsupported ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Object does not implement IF_MESSAGE_PROVIDER' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Entwicklung nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `IS INSTANCE OF` und `CAST` für die dynamische Typprüfung und -behandlung von Objekten. Dies ist wesentlich sicherer und objektorientierter als ältere Methoden, die auf `sy-subrc` nach einem `CALL METHOD` oder ähnlichem angewiesen waren. Die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` fängt Fehler bei dynamischen Aufrufen robust ab.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CAST, IS INSTANCE OF, TRY...CATCH, Object Orientation, sy-subrc

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer übergebenen Strukturdefinition.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_component,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr,
           END OF ty_s_component.
    TYPES: ty_t_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE ty_t_components
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_abap_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type
      ) TO lt_abap_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_abap_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'TEXT' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_kind( )

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data1,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data1.
    TYPES: ty_t_data1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data2,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_data2.
    TYPES: ty_t_data2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_structures
      IMPORTING
        it_table1     TYPE ANY TABLE
        it_table2     TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_structures.
    DATA: lt_dummy1 TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_dummy2 TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE DATA lt_dummy1 LIKE it_table1.
    CREATE DATA lt_dummy2 LIKE it_table2.

    DATA(lo_table_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_dummy1->* ) ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr1->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components1) = lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_dummy2->* ) ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr2->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components2) = lo_struct_descr2->get_components( ).

    IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
      rv_equal = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_equal = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) WITH KEY name = ls_comp1-name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_comp1-type->get_type_kind( ) <> ls_comp2-type->get_type_kind( ).
        rv_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem bestimmten Feldnamen und Wert filtert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_by_field
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_field_name   TYPE fieldname
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_by_field.
    DATA: lr_line TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Describe the source table
    CREATE DATA lr_line LIKE LINE OF it_source_table.
    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).

    " Create a new table with the same type as the source table
    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_filtered> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_table->* TO <lt_filtered>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <lv_field> = iv_filter_value.
          APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_filtered>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (gebuchte Sitze / maximale Sitze) pro Monat für alle Flüge aus `sflights`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_occupancy_month,
             year_month TYPE c LENGTH 6,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_occupancy_month.
    TYPES: ty_t_occupancy_month TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_occupancy_month WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_avg_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE ty_t_occupancy_month.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_avg_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                             GROUP BY ( year_month = substring( val = ls_flight-fldate off = 0 len = 6 ) )
                             ( year_month = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-year_month
                               avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat16(
                                 INIT sum_booked = 0.0d sum_capacity = 0.0d
                                 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                 NEXT
                                   sum_booked   = sum_booked + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
                                   sum_capacity = sum_capacity + <fs_flight>-seatsmax
                                 FINALLY
                                   IF sum_capacity > 0 THEN sum_booked / sum_capacity ELSE 0 ENDIF
                               )
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Identifizieren Sie Tage mit einer überdurchschnittlich hohen Anzahl an Flugstornierungen (angenommen, es gibt ein Feld `cancelled_flights` in `sflights` oder eine Ableitung davon).
hint: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt und filtern Sie dann. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_high_cancellations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cancelled_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_cancellation_days
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE ty_t_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_cancellation_days) TYPE ty_t_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_high_cancellations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_cancellation_days.
    IF it_flight_data IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_cancellations) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_data IN it_flight_data
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_data-cancelled_flights
    ).

    DATA(lv_average_cancellations) = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN lines( it_flight_data ) > 0 THEN lv_total_cancellations / lines( it_flight_data )
      ELSE 0
    ).

    rt_high_cancellation_days = FILTER #( it_flight_data USING KEY primary_key
                                          WHERE cancelled_flights > lv_average_cancellations ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in der Struktur einer internen Tabelle existiert.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field_a TYPE i,
             field_b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS field_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists.
    DATA: lt_data_dummy TYPE ty_t_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data_dummy.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_data_dummy ) ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).
        rv_exists = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle in eine andere interne Tabelle mit derselben Struktur kopiert, aber nur ausgewählte Felder befüllt.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Feldnamen zu identifizieren, und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_copy_selected_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_source.
    TYPES: ty_t_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_target,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_target.
    TYPES: ty_t_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_fields_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_copy_selected_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_fields_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Describe the source table to get its type
    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).

    " Create a new table of the same type as the source table
    CREATE DATA rt_target_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_target> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_target_table->* TO <lt_target>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_source_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_target_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_source_field> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_target_field> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA <ls_target_line> LIKE LINE OF it_source_table.

      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <lv_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_target_line> TO <lv_target_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_target_field> = <lv_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_target_line> TO <lt_target>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Top 3 Fluggesellschaften basierend auf der Gesamtzahl der Passagiere in einem bestimmten Monat aus `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF`, `SORT` und `UP TO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_top_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_passengers,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_passengers.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_carriers_by_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year_month TYPE c LENGTH 6
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_carriers) TYPE ty_t_carrier_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_top_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_carriers_by_month.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE substring( val = fldate off = 0 len = 6 ) = @iv_year_month.

    DATA(lt_monthly_passengers) = VALUE ty_t_carrier_passengers(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid,
        total_passengers = SUM( ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
    ).

    SORT lt_monthly_passengers BY total_passengers DESCENDING.

    rt_top_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_monthly_passengers UP TO 3 ROWS ( ls_entry ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Anzahl der Flüge pro Tag für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Schleife und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_cumulative_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_daily_flights,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             daily_count TYPE i,
             cumulative_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_daily_flights.
    TYPES: ty_t_daily_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_daily_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cumulative_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cumulative_flights) TYPE ty_t_daily_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_cumulative_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT fldate, COUNT(*) AS daily_count
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      GROUP BY fldate
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_daily_counts).

    rt_cumulative_flights = REDUCE ty_t_daily_flights(
      INIT cumulative_sum = 0
      FOR ls_daily IN lt_daily_counts
      NEXT
        cumulative_sum = cumulative_sum + ls_daily-daily_count
        APPEND VALUE #( fldate = ls_daily-fldate
                        daily_count = ls_daily-daily_count
                        cumulative_count = cumulative_sum ) TO rt_cumulative_flights
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_cumulative_flights_single_day FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cumulative_flights_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_flights.
    " Assuming sflights has data for 'AA'
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_cumulative_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_cumulative) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_cumulative ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lines( lt_cumulative ) exp = 0 ).

    " Check if cumulative sum is increasing
    DATA(lv_prev_cumulative) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_cumulative INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-cumulative_count >= lv_prev_cumulative ).
      lv_prev_cumulative = ls_entry-cumulative_count.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cumulative_flights_single_day.
    " Insert dummy data for a single day for a new carrier
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20240201' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 ) INTO TABLE sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20240201' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) INTO TABLE sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_cumulative_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_cumulative) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_cumulative ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_cumulative[ 1 ]-daily_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_cumulative[ 1 ]-cumulative_count exp = 2 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'. "Clean up dummy data

CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_prices.
    DATA(lt_sflight_to_update) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_adj IN it_price_adjustments
      WHERE ( ls_adj-price IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( carrid   = ls_adj-carrid
        connid   = ls_adj-connid
        fldate   = ls_adj-fldate
        price    = ls_adj-price
        currency = ls_adj-currency )
    ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_to_update.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle mit aggregierten Werten zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_reduce_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_plane_seats,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_plane_seats.
    TYPES tt_plane_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_plane_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupied_seats_by_plane
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_plane_seats) TYPE tt_plane_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_reduce_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupied_seats_by_plane.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_plane_seats = REDUCE tt_plane_seats(
      INIT lv_result = VALUE tt_plane_seats( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET ls_existing = lv_result[ planetype = ls_flight-planetype DEFAULT sy-initial ] IN
      IF ls_existing IS INITIAL.
        lv_result = VALUE #( lv_result ( planetype = ls_flight-planetype total_occupied_seats = ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
      ELSE.
        lv_result = VALUE #( lv_result ( planetype = ls_flight-planetype total_occupied_seats = ls_existing-total_occupied_seats + ls_flight-seatsocc ) USING KEY primary_key ).
      ENDIF.
      FINALLY
        result = lv_result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Datenbindung für ein `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE` Objekt. Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Preis) und verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR`-Loop, um die durchschnittlichen Preise pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` oder `SUM` innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE tt_carrier_avg_price(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        avg_price = REDUCE s_price(
          INIT sum_price = 0.0
               count = 0
          FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_group_flight-price
               count = count + 1
          FINALLY sum_price / count
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currency,
           END OF ty_flight_price_update.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_update_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_with_corresponding.
    DATA lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Daten aus der Eingabetabelle in die SFLIGHT-Struktur mappen
    lt_sflight_data = CORRESPONDING #( it_price_updates MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate price = price currency = currency ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_data.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_update_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_error_handling.
    DATA(ls_sflight_update) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid  = iv_carrid
      connid  = iv_connid
      fldate  = iv_fldate
      price   = iv_new_price
      currency = 'EUR'
    ).

    TRY.
        UPDATE sflight FROM ls_sflight_update.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Aktualisierung von Flugdaten mit der sofortigen Visualisierung in einem Chart. Aktualisieren Sie die belegten Sitze für einen Flug und bereiten Sie dann die Daten für die `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE` auf, um die Auslastung pro Flugzeugtyp anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Features für beide Schritte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE` für die Datenbankaktualisierung und anschließend `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` für die Chart-Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_and_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_plane_occupancy,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
             total_seats_max TYPE i,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_plane_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_plane_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_plane_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_and_get_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
        iv_new_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy_data) TYPE tt_plane_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_and_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_and_get_occupancy.
    " 1. Update der Flugdaten
    DATA(ls_sflight_update) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid  = iv_carrid
      connid  = iv_connid
      fldate  = iv_fldate
      seatsocc = iv_new_seatsocc
    ).
    UPDATE sflight FROM ls_sflight_update.

    " 2. Daten für Chart aufbereiten
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_occupancy_data = VALUE tt_plane_occupancy(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-planetype
      ( planetype = ls_flight-planetype
        total_seats_occupied = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum_occ = 0
          FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_group_flight-seatsocc
        )
        total_seats_max = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum_max = 0
          FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum_max = sum_max + ls_group_flight-seatsmax
        )
        occupancy_rate = COND #( WHEN total_seats_max > 0 THEN ( total_seats_occupied * 100 ) / total_seats_max ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price_with_case
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
        iv_price_increase TYPE s_price
        iv_max_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_with_case.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      price = CASE WHEN price < @iv_max_price THEN price + @iv_price_increase ELSE price END
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      AND connid = @iv_connid
      AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator, um dynamisch eine Farbe basierend auf der Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) zuzuweisen. Diese Farbe könnte dann in einem `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE` zur visuellen Hervorhebung verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator, um basierend auf einer Bedingung einen Wert zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_color_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             occupancy_color TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_color_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_color_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_color_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_colors_by_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_color_data) TYPE tt_flight_color_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_colors_by_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_color_data = VALUE tt_flight_color_data(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_occupancy_rate = COND p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
                                WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_flight-seatsmax
                                ELSE 0 )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        occupancy_color = SWITCH string(
          WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 80 THEN 'RED'
          WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 50 THEN 'YELLOW'
          ELSE 'GREEN' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      LET lv_occupancy_rate = COND p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
                                WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_flight-seatsmax
                                ELSE 0 )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        occupancy_status = COND string(
          WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 90 THEN 'Voll'
          WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 60 THEN 'Mittel'
          WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > 0 THEN 'Leer'
          ELSE 'Nicht verfügbar' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings in ein XSTRING und dekomprimiere sie zurück in eine interne Tabelle. Verwende dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Konvertiere die interne Tabelle zuerst in einen einzelnen String (z.B. mit `REDUCE` oder `CONCATENATE LINES OF`) und dann in ein XSTRING, oder nutze `cl_abap_conv_codepage` für die Umwandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_line,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_line,
           ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE ty_string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_table) TYPE ty_string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN it_original_table
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line>-text ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line>-text ) ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_text_converter(
      codepage = `UTF-8`
      endian    = `L` ).

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_conv->convert( lv_concatenated_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_binary( lv_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_binary( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = lo_conv->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).

    SPLIT lv_decompressed_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE DATA(lt_lines).

    rt_decompressed_table = VALUE #( FOR <line_str> IN lt_lines (
      text = <line_str> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen und speichere sie als BLOB in einer temporären Datenbanktabelle. Lese die Daten zurück und dekomprimiere sie.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_serialize` zur Serialisierung der Tabelle in ein XSTRING und `cl_abap_gzip=>compress_binary`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_db_storage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS save_and_load_compressed
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_sflight_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_db_table TYPE tabname VALUE 'ZTEMP_GZIP_DATA'.
    METHODS create_temp_db_table.
    METHODS delete_temp_db_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_db_storage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_and_load_compressed.
    DATA(lv_serialized_xstring) = cl_abap_serialize=>serialize( it_data ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_binary( lv_serialized_xstring ).

    create_temp_db_table( ).

    INSERT INTO (gc_db_table) VALUES ( @(lv_compressed_xstring) ).

    DATA(lv_read_compressed_xstring) = VALUE xstring( ).
    SELECT SINGLE field1 FROM (gc_db_table) INTO @lv_read_compressed_xstring.

    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_binary( lv_read_compressed_xstring ).
    cl_abap_serialize=>deserialize( EXPORTING i_xstream = lv_decompressed_xstring IMPORTING e_data = rt_data ).

    delete_temp_db_table( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_temp_db_table.
    TRY.
        DELETE FROM (gc_db_table).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        " Table does not exist, create it
        DATA(lv_ddl) = |CREATE TABLE { gc_db_table } ( field1 VARBINARY(MAX) )|.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_ddl }
        ENDEXEC.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_temp_db_table.
    EXEC SQL.
      DROP TABLE { gc_db_table }
    ENDEXEC.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_db_storage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_db_storage.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_db_storage( ).
    DATA(lt_original_sflights) = VALUE zcl_gzip_db_storage=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' ) ).

    DATA(lt_loaded_sflights) = lo_cut->save_and_load_compressed( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_loaded_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Anzahl der Einträge sollte übereinstimmen.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_original_sflights INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_loaded_sflights INTO DATA(ls_loaded) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_loaded-carrid exp = ls_orig-carrid msg = |CARRIER { sy-tabix } sollte übereinstimmen.| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_loaded-connid exp = ls_orig-connid msg = |CONNECTION { sy-tabix } sollte übereinstimmen.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von GZIP zur Speicherung strukturierter Daten in einer Datenbank. Die interne Tabelle wird mit `cl_abap_serialize` in ein XSTRING umgewandelt, komprimiert und dann in einer temporären DB-Tabelle abgelegt. Die Verwendung von dynamischem SQL und Inline-Deklarationen ist modern. Beachten Sie, dass die temporäre Tabelle nur für Demonstrationszwecke erstellt wird.

Instructions: Generiere eine große Textmenge, komprimiere sie mit GZIP und berechne die Kompressionsrate, um die Effizienz zu demonstrieren.
hint: Vergleiche die Länge des Original-XSTRINGs mit der Länge des komprimierten XSTRINGs. Nutze `cl_abap_conv_codepage` zur Umwandlung von String zu XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_ratio DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_compression_ratio
      IMPORTING
        iv_text_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ratio) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_ratio IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_compression_ratio.
    DATA(lv_large_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_text_length / 100
      NEXT s = s && `Dies ist ein wiederholter Textblock zur Erzeugung einer großen Datenmenge. ` ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_text_converter(
      codepage = `UTF-8`
      endian    = `L` ).

    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = lo_conv->convert( lv_large_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_binary( lv_original_xstring ).

    IF xstrlen( lv_original_xstring ) > 0.
      rv_ratio = xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ) / xstrlen( lv_original_xstring ).
    ELSE.
      rv_ratio = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_compression_ratio( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_ratio msg = 'Kompressionsrate sollte berechnet werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_ratio > 0 AND lv_ratio < 1.0 msg = 'Kompressionsrate sollte zwischen 0 und 1 liegen (Kompression erfolgreich).' ).

Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur String-Generierung und `cl_abap_conv_codepage` zur Umwandlung in XSTRING sind moderne Ansätze. Eine Rate unter 1 zeigt eine erfolgreiche Datenreduktion an.
