Instructions: Komprimiere eine interne Tabelle von Strings und speichere sie in einem `string` Feld einer Datenbanktabelle (Base64-kodiert). Lese sie zurück und dekomprimiere sie.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_conv_x2x_base64` zur Kodierung/Dekodierung des XSTRINGs in/aus einem String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_base64_db_storage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_line,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_line,
           ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS save_and_load_base64_compressed
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_data_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_db_table TYPE tabname VALUE 'ZTEMP_GZIP_B64_DATA'.
    METHODS create_temp_db_table.
    METHODS delete_temp_db_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_base64_db_storage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_and_load_base64_compressed.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN it_data
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line>-content ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line>-content ) ).

    DATA(lo_conv_text_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_text_converter(
      codepage = `UTF-8`
      endian    = `L` ).

    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = lo_conv_text_xstring->convert( lv_concatenated_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_binary( lv_original_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_base64_string) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_base64=>xstring_to_string( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    create_temp_db_table( ).

    INSERT INTO (gc_db_table) VALUES ( @(lv_base64_string) ).

    DATA(lv_read_base64_string) = VALUE string( ).
    SELECT SINGLE field1 FROM (gc_db_table) INTO @lv_read_base64_string.

    DATA(lv_read_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_base64=>string_to_xstring( lv_read_base64_string ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_binary( lv_read_compressed_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = lo_conv_text_xstring->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).

    SPLIT lv_decompressed_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE DATA(lt_lines).

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR <line_str> IN lt_lines (
      content = <line_str> ) ).

    delete_temp_db_table( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_temp_db_table.
    TRY.
        DELETE FROM (gc_db_table).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        DATA(lv_ddl) = |CREATE TABLE { gc_db_table } ( field1 VARCHAR(MAX) )|.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_ddl }
        ENDEXEC.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_temp_db_table.
    EXEC SQL.
      DROP TABLE { gc_db_table }
    ENDEXEC.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_base64_db_storage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_base64_db_storage.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_base64_db_storage( ).
    DATA(lt_original_data) = VALUE zcl_gzip_base64_db_storage=>ty_data_table(
      ( content = `Erste Zeile mit Daten.` )
      ( content = `Zweite Zeile, etwas länger.` )
      ( content = `Dritte Zeile, um die Kompression zu testen.` ) ).

    DATA(lt_loaded_data) = lo_cut->save_and_load_base64_compressed( lt_original_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_loaded_data ) exp = lines( lt_original_data ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte übereinstimmen.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_original_data INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_loaded_data INTO DATA(ls_loaded) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_loaded-content exp = ls_orig-content msg = |Inhalt der Zeile { sy-tabix } sollte übereinstimmen.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert GZIP-Kompression mit Base64-Kodierung, um binäre Daten (XSTRING) in einem String-Feld einer Datenbanktabelle speichern zu können. `cl_abap_conv_x2x_base64` wird für die Umwandlung verwendet. Dies ist nützlich, wenn keine BLOB-Felder direkt verfügbar sind oder die Daten in einem Textformat transportiert werden müssen.
keywords: GZIP, Base64, XSTRING, String, Datenbank, Kompression, Dekompression, cl_abap_conv_x2x_base64

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe der Preise und `LINES` für die Anzahl der Flüge, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
      ).
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle mit den Feldern CARRIER, CONNECTION und FLIGHT_COUNT zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_count_per_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_count_per_conn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( VALUE #( carrid = flight-carrid
                                            connid = flight-connid
                                            flight_count = lines( GROUP flight ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 0 ).

    " Example: Check a specific entry if known
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_lh_0400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected flight count for LH 0400' act = ls_count_lh_0400-flight_count exp = 1 ). " Adjust expected count based on SFLIGHTS data

Es ersetzt komplexe LOOP-Konstrukte mit AT NEW/ENDAT und ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Programmierung, die zu kürzerem und besser lesbarem Code führt. `lines( GROUP flight )` zählt die Elemente in jeder Gruppe.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die prozentuale Auslastung (belegte Sitze / maximale Sitze * 100) für jeden Flug in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `DIVIDE` Operator und berücksichtigen Sie die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_rates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy_rates) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_rates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy_rates = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  LET lv_occupancy = COND p(
                                                       WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                       THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                                                       ELSE 0
                                                     )
                                  IN ( carrid       = flight-carrid,
                                       connid       = flight-connid,
                                       fldate       = flight-fldate,
                                       occupancy_rate = lv_occupancy ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_rates.

CLASS zcl_avg_occupancy_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_occupancy,
             carrid              TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_carrier_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_rates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_occupancy) TYPE tt_carrier_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_occupancy_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_rates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                    GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                    LET lv_total_occ = REDUCE i(
                                                         INIT sum_occ = 0
                                                         FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                         NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + member-seatsocc
                                                       )
                                        lv_total_max = REDUCE i(
                                                         INIT sum_max = 0
                                                         FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                         NEXT sum_max = sum_max + member-seatsmax
                                                       )
                                    IN ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                         average_occupancy_rate = COND p(
                                                                    WHEN lv_total_max > 0
                                                                    THEN ( lv_total_occ / lv_total_max ) * 100
                                                                    ELSE 0
                                                                  ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_large_flight_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid                 TYPE s_carr_id,
             percentage_large_flights TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,

  METHOD get_large_flight_percentages.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_percentages = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                               GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                               LET lv_total_flights = lines( GROUP flight )
                                   lv_large_flights = REDUCE i(
                                                        INIT count = 0
                                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                        WHERE ( member-seatsmax > 200 )
                                                        NEXT count = count + 1
                                                      )
                               IN ( carrid                 = flight-carrid,
                                    percentage_large_flights = COND p(
                                                                 WHEN lv_total_flights > 0
                                                                 THEN ( lv_large_flights / lv_total_flights ) * 100
                                                                 ELSE 0
                                                               ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge, die sowohl eine Auslastungsrate von über 70% als auch einen Preis von über 300 haben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_flight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_complex_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             matching_flights_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_complex_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_complex_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_complex_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_complex_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_complex_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_flight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                           ( VALUE #( carrid = flight-carrid
                                      matching_flights_count = REDUCE i(
                                                                 INIT count = 0
                                                                 FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                 LET lv_occupancy_rate = COND p(
                                                                                             WHEN member-seatsmax > 0
                                                                                             THEN ( member-seatsocc / member-seatsmax ) * 100
                                                                                             ELSE 0
                                                                                           )
                                                                 WHERE ( lv_occupancy_rate > 70 AND member-price > 300 )
                                                                 NEXT count = count + 1
                                                               ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_revenue_per_seat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_revenue_per_seat,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid          TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate          TYPE s_date,

             revenue_per_occ_seat TYPE p LENGTH 7 DECIMALS 2,

CLASS zcl_revenue_per_seat IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_revenue_data = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               LET lv_rev_per_max = COND p(
                                                      WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                      THEN flight-price / flight-seatsmax

                                    connid             = flight-connid,
                                    fldate             = flight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_with_error
      IMPORTING iv_raise_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING   cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_error.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid
            FROM sflight.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DO 2 TIMES. " Fetch a few rows
            FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
            IF sy-subrc <> 0.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
          ENDDO.

          IF iv_raise_error = abap_true.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_message.
          ENDIF.

        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle specific error
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING previous = lx_error. " Re-raise or handle
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->process_flights_with_error( iv_raise_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_method_act(
        i_object = lo_cut
        i_method_name = 'PROCESS_FLIGHTS_WITH_ERROR'
        i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_RAISE_ERROR' value = abap_true ) )
      )
      exp_exception_type = 'CX_STATIC_CHECK'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die robuste Handhabung von Datenbank-Cursorn. Der `FINALLY`-Block stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch bei Exceptions ordnungsgemäß geschlossen wird, was Ressourcenlecks verhindert. `DATA(...)` und `VALUE #()` sind moderne Syntax.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_sql_statement = lv_sql_statement && | WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR lv_sql_statement.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DO.
            FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
            IF sy-subrc <> 0.

            APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.

        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie den Unterschied zwischen `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` und `OPEN CURSOR WITHOUT HOLD` und wie `CLOSE CURSOR` in beiden Fällen verwendet wird.
hint: Ein Cursor mit `WITH HOLD` bleibt über einen COMMIT/ROLLBACK hinaus offen, `WITHOUT HOLD` wird implizit geschlossen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_hold_option DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_with_hold
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    METHODS process_without_hold
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_hold_option IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_hold.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    COMMIT WORK. " This would NOT close a cursor opened WITH HOLD

    IF sy-subrc = 0. " Try to fetch again after COMMIT
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights. " This fetch might succeed if more rows exist
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_without_hold.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    OPEN CURSOR WITHOUT HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    COMMIT WORK. " This WOULD close a cursor opened WITHOUT HOLD

    IF sy-subrc = 0. " Try to fetch again after COMMIT - this will likely fail
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Explicit CLOSE CURSOR is still good practice, even if implicitly closed
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_hold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_without_hold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_hold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_hold_option( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->process_with_hold( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    " Assert that at least one row was fetched, indicating cursor was open after commit
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equal( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_without_hold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_hold_option( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->process_without_hold( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    " Assert that only one row was fetched, as cursor should be closed after commit
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` und `WITHOUT HOLD`. `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor über Transaktionsgrenzen (COMMIT WORK) hinweg offen, während `WITHOUT HOLD` ihn implizit schließt. `CLOSE CURSOR` ist in beiden Fällen wichtig für die explizite Ressourcenfreigabe.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD, OPEN CURSOR WITHOUT HOLD, COMMIT WORK, Database Access, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_cursor_large_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_large_data_cursor
      IMPORTING iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_large_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_large_data_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    DATA: lv_counter TYPE i.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        " Simulate complex processing or external call after each row/small batch
        " This is where explicit cursor control can be more flexible than PACKAGE SIZE
        " if the 'package' logic is not purely about fetching.
        IF ls_sflight-price > 1000. " Example condition
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_processed_data.
        ENDIF.

        lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
        IF lv_counter >= iv_max_rows.
          EXIT. " Stop after processing a certain number of rows
        ENDIF.

      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

PACKAGE SIZE` ist oft einfacher, aber weniger flexibel in solchen Nischenfällen.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_basic_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

    " Define a bold style
    DATA(lo_style_bold) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_bold->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Sheet 1: Flight Data
    DATA(lo_sheet_flights) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).

    " Add some flight data (using modern ABAP for data retrieval)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: Carrier Data
    DATA(lo_sheet_carriers) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Carrier' ).
    lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Carrier Name' ).
    lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).
    lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).

    " Add some carrier data
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      UP TO 2 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carriers).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_carrier-carrid ).
      lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_carrier-carrname ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->build( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_advanced_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS create_formatted_xlsx
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_advanced_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdetails' ).

    " Prepare some data using modern ABAP SELECT
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_data).

    " Headers
    DATA(lt_headers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Carrier ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ( 'Currency' ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(lv_header).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = sy-tabix ip_value = lv_header ).
      DATA(lo_style_header) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
      lo_style_header->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = sy-tabix ip_style = lo_style_header ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Data rows
    LOOP AT lt_flights_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_flight-currency ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Conditional Formatting: Highlight prices > 1000 in red
    DATA(lo_style_red) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_red->set_font_color( cl_xlsx_document=>c_color_red ).

    lo_sheet->set_conditional_formatting(
      ip_range = 'D2:D' && ( lines( lt_flights_data ) + 1 )
      ip_type = cl_xlsx_document=>c_cf_type_cell_value
      ip_operator = cl_xlsx_document=>c_cf_operator_greater_than
      ip_formula1 = '1000'
      ip_style = lo_style_red
    ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->build( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine vorhandene XLSX-Datei (als XSTRING) ein und extrahieren Sie die Daten aus einem bestimmten Arbeitsblatt in eine interne Tabelle. Nehmen Sie an, die erste Zeile enthält die Kopfzeilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_xstring`, `get_sheet_by_name` und `get_cell_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_read_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_read_data.
    TYPES tt_read_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_read_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_xlsx_data
      IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring
                iv_sheet_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_read_data
      RAISING   cx_xlsx_document.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS create_dummy_xlsx_xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD create_dummy_xlsx_xstring.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'TestSheet' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Header1' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Header2' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Header3' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Value1A' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Value1B' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Value1C' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Value2A' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Value2B' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Value2C' ).
    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->build( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_xlsx_data.
    DATA: lo_xlsx TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document.
    DATA: lo_sheet TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet.
    DATA: ls_row TYPE ty_read_data.
    DATA: lv_row_idx TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_col_idx TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lo_xlsx = cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_xstring( iv_xstring ).
        lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_by_name( iv_sheet_name ).

        IF lo_sheet IS BOUND.
          " Assuming first row is header, start from second row
          DO.
            lv_row_idx = sy-index + 1. " Start from row 2
            IF lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = 1 ) IS INITIAL.
              EXIT. " No more data rows
            ENDIF.

            ls_row-col1 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = 1 ).
            ls_row-col2 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = 2 ).
            ls_row-col3 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = 3 ).
            APPEND ls_row TO rt_data.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xlsx_document INTO DATA(lx_xlsx).
        MESSAGE lx_xlsx->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_xlsx_document EXPORTING previous = lx_xlsx.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_read_data( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_xstring) = lo_cut->create_dummy_xlsx_xstring( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten enthält. Die Spaltenbreiten sollen automatisch an den Inhalt angepasst werden. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_autofit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_autofit_xlsx
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_autofit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_autofit_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdetails Autofit' ).

    " Prepare data with joins for more varied content
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_info).

    " Headers
    DATA(lt_headers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Carrier ID' ) ( 'Carrier Name' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'City From' ) ( 'City To' ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(lv_header).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = sy-tabix ip_value = lv_header ).
      DATA(lo_style_header) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
      lo_style_header->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = sy-tabix ip_style = lo_style_header ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Data rows
    LOOP AT lt_flight_info INTO DATA(ls_info).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_info-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_info-carrname ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_info-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_info-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_info-cityfrom ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 6 ip_value = ls_info-cityto ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Autofit columns
    DO lines( lt_headers ) TIMES.
      lo_sheet->set_column_autofit( ip_column = sy-index ).
    ENDDO.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->build( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle. Wenn eine Zahl ungültig ist (z.B. Division durch Null), fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und sammeln Sie die Fehlermeldungen.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
             divisor TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_with_errors
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      EXPORTING
        ev_sum  TYPE i
        et_errors TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_with_errors.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lt_current_errors) = VALUE string_table( ).

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      TRY.
          lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + ( ls_data-value / ls_data-divisor ).
        CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
          APPEND lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) TO lt_current_errors.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
          APPEND lx_other->get_text( ) TO lt_current_errors.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    ev_sum = lv_current_sum.
    et_errors = lt_current_errors.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` und versuchen Sie, ein Feld in ein ungültiges Format zu konvertieren. Fangen Sie die Konvertierungsausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie die Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um die Daten zu iterieren, und `TRY...CATCH` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_with_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      EXPORTING
        et_processed_flights TYPE tt_flight_info
        et_errors TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_with_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    et_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                    LET lv_price_str = '' IN
                                    ( TRY.
                                          lv_price_str = |{ ls_flight-price }|. " Example: Convert numeric to string
                                          " To simulate a conversion error, one might try to assign a non-numeric string to a numeric field
                                          " DATA(lv_num) = CAST i( 'ABC' ). This would raise CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER
                                          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                          connid = ls_flight-connid
                                          fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                          price_str = lv_price_str
                                      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
                                          APPEND |Error processing flight { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }| TO et_errors.
                                          CONTINUE. " Skip this entry
                                      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
                                          APPEND |Generic error processing flight { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| TO et_errors.
                                          CONTINUE.
                                      ENDTRY ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf ein `cl_gui_control` (z.B. `cl_gui_textedit`) in einem `cl_gui_docking_container` platziert. Fangen Sie dabei mögliche Ausnahmen ab, die beim Setzen des Parent-Containers auftreten können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET_PARENT` der Control-Klasse und umschließen Sie den Aufruf mit `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL` oder `CX_GUI_EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_control_placement DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS place_control_in_docking
      IMPORTING
        io_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control
        io_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   cx_gui_exception cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_control_placement IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD place_control_in_docking.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        IF io_control IS NOT BOUND OR io_docking_container IS NOT BOUND.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        ENDIF.
        CALL METHOD io_control->set_parent
          EXPORTING
            parent = io_docking_container.
        rv_success = abap_true.
    CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial INTO DATA(lx_initial).
        " Handle initial reference error
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_initial.
    CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        " Handle GUI specific exceptions
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_gui.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    DATA(lv_concatenated) = ``.
    TRY.
        LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).

        ENDLOOP.
        rv_result = lv_concatenated.
    CATCH cx_sy_strg_too_long INTO DATA(lx_too_long).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_too_long.
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen Methodenaufruf durch. Fangen Sie dabei mögliche Ausnahmen ab, falls die Methode nicht existiert oder Parameter ungültig sind.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

    METHODS _dummy_method.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_call_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_dyn_call_error.
    CATCH cx_sy_create_object INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        " Handle case where class does not exist
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _dummy_method.
    " This method exists to be called dynamically.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes
      RAISING   cx_sy_classdescr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_attributes_descr) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

        rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR ls_attr_descr IN lt_attributes_descr
                                   ( name = ls_attr_descr-name
                                     type = ls_attr_descr-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) ).
    CATCH cx_sy_classdescr_error INTO DATA(lx_classdescr_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_classdescr_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einem Kriterium. Fangen Sie dabei eine Ausnahme ab, falls das Filterkriterium ungültig ist (z.B. leere Fluggesellschaft).

CLASS zcl_filter_with_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING   cx_sy_invalid_parameter.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    TRY.
        IF iv_carrid IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_invalid_parameter EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_invalid_parameter=>default.
        ENDIF.
        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    CATCH cx_sy_invalid_parameter INTO DATA(lx_invalid_param).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_invalid_param.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Interaktion mit einem `cl_gui_textedit` Control, das in einem `cl_gui_docking_container` platziert ist. Fangen Sie dabei eine Ausnahme ab, falls das Control nicht initialisiert ist, bevor Sie versuchen, Text zu setzen.

CLASS zcl_textedit_interaction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_text_in_editor
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
        iv_text     TYPE string

      RAISING   cx_sy_ref_is_initial cx_gui_exception.

CLASS zcl_textedit_interaction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_text_in_editor.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        IF io_textedit IS NOT BOUND.

        ENDIF.
        CALL METHOD io_textedit->set_text_as_stream
          EXPORTING
            text = iv_text.
        rv_success = abap_true.
    CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial INTO DATA(lx_initial).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_initial.
    CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen durchführt. Fangen Sie dabei eine Ausnahme ab, die an einer beliebigen Stelle in der Kette auftreten kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke oder eine zentrale Fehlerbehandlung für eine Kette von Aufrufen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_chain_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_chain_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain_try DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING   zcx_chain_error.
    METHODS method_b
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING   zcx_chain_error.
    METHODS method_c
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING   zcx_chain_error.
    METHODS execute_chain
      IMPORTING iv_start_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   zcx_chain_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain_try IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    IF iv_value = 1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_chain_error EXPORTING textid = VALUE scx_t100( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'Method A failed' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    IF iv_value = 2.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_chain_error EXPORTING textid = VALUE scx_t100( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'Method B failed' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_c.
    IF iv_value = 3.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_chain_error EXPORTING textid = VALUE scx_t100( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'Method C failed' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_chain.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        me->method_a( iv_value ).
        me->method_b( iv_value ).
        me->method_c( iv_value ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
    CATCH zcx_chain_error INTO DATA(lx_chain_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_chain_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_chain_success.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = lo_cut->execute_chain( 2 ) exp_type = 'ZCX_CHAIN_ERROR' ).

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (vom Typ String) in ein XSTRING-Format mittels ZIP-Komprimierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` zum Komprimieren von Binärdaten. Die interne Tabelle muss zuerst in ein XSTRING konvertiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_compress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_string_table.
    DATA(lv_string_data) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR <line> IN it_data NEXT s = s && <line> && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( )->ucl1( lv_string_data ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      i_name    = 'table_data.txt'
      i_content = lv_xstring_data
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compress_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_table.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Line 1 of test data' TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND 'Line 2 with more content' TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND 'Line 3' TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_table( ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_cut->compress_string_table( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_compressed_xstring
      msg = 'Compressed XSTRING should not be initial'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_ABAP_ZIP` ermöglicht die Komprimierung von Daten im Speicher. Hier wird eine interne Tabelle zuerst in einen String und dann in ein XSTRING konvertiert, um als Datei in einem ZIP-Archiv abgelegt zu werden. `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_conv_ce` sind moderne Wege, um Daten zu verarbeiten und zu konvertieren.
keywords: ZIP, XSTRING, Komprimierung, Interne Tabelle, REDUCE, CL_ABAP_CONV_CE

Instructions: Dekomprimiere ein ZIP-komprimiertes XSTRING, das eine Textdatei enthält, zurück in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` zum Laden und Extrahieren von Daten aus einem XSTRING. Achten Sie auf die korrekte Konvertierung von XSTRING zu String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_to_string_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_to_string_table.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_xstring_content) = lo_zip->get( 'table_data.txt' ).
    DATA(lv_string_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( )->create_from_ucs2( lv_xstring_content )->get_string( ).

    SPLIT lv_string_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_data.
    DELETE rt_data WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. " Remove potential empty last line
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_decompress_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decompress_table.
    DATA lt_original_data TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Line 1 of test data' TO lt_original_data.
    APPEND 'Line 2 with more content' TO lt_original_data.
    APPEND 'Line 3' TO lt_original_data.

    " First, compress the data (using the previous example's logic)
    DATA(lo_compress) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_table( ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_compress->compress_string_table( lt_original_data ).

    " Now, decompress it
    DATA(lo_decompress) = NEW zcl_zip_decompress_table( ).
    DATA(lt_decompressed_data) = lo_decompress->decompress_to_string_table( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_decompressed_data )
      exp = lines( lt_original_data )
      msg = 'Number of lines should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_decompressed_data[ 1 ]
      exp = lt_original_data[ 1 ]
      msg = 'First line should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_decompressed_data[ 2 ]
      exp = lt_original_data[ 2 ]
      msg = 'Second line should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_ABAP_ZIP` wird verwendet, um ein ZIP-Archiv aus einem XSTRING zu laden und den Inhalt einer spezifischen Datei zu extrahieren. Die Konvertierung von XSTRING zu String erfolgt über `CL_ABAP_CONV_CE`. `SPLIT` wird verwendet, um den String wieder in eine interne Tabelle zu zerlegen.
keywords: ZIP, XSTRING, Dekomprimierung, Interne Tabelle, CL_ABAP_CONV_CE, SPLIT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv im Speicher, das mehrere Textdateien mit unterschiedlichen Inhalten enthält. Die Dateinamen und Inhalte sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `ADD` von `CL_ABAP_ZIP` in einer Schleife, um mehrere Dateien hinzuzufügen, und anschließend `SAVE`, um das Archiv zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_content.
    TYPES: tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_from_files
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( )->ucl1( ls_file-content ).
      lo_zip->add(
        i_name    = ls_file-name

CLASS zcl_tstmp_to_local DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_dt) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_datetime(
      EXPORTING
        i_tstmp = iv_tstmp
        i_tzone = sy-zonlo " Current user's time zone
      IMPORTING
        e_date  = lv_date

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_tstmp_to_local_dt FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_tstmp_to_local_dt.
    " Example UTC timestamp (26.10.2023 14:30:00 UTC)
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231026143000.0000000'.

    " Assuming SY-ZONLO is 'CET' (+1 hour, +2 hours during DST)
    " For testing, we need to know the expected local time.
    " Let's assume CET (UTC+1) without DST for simplicity in test.
    " If SY-ZONLO is 'CET', then 14:30 UTC is 15:30 CET.
    " If DST is active, it would be 16:30 CET.
    " To make the test robust, we can mock SY-ZONLO or use a fixed time zone.
    " For this example, let's assume a fixed offset for simplicity.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_to_local( ).
    DATA(lv_local_dt_string) = lo_cut->convert_tstmp_to_local_dt( lv_utc_tstmp ).

    " This assertion is highly dependent on the system's time zone and DST settings.
    " A more robust test would involve setting a specific time zone for the test.
    " For demonstration, let's assume a simple +1 hour offset for local time.
    " Expected format: 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS'
    " If SY-ZONLO is 'CET' and no DST, expected: '26.10.2023 15:30:00'
    " If SY-ZONLO is 'CET' and DST, expected: '26.10.2023 16:30:00'

    " Let's assert based on a known fixed offset for the test.
    " For example, if we know the system is UTC+1 and no DST:
    DATA(lv_expected_date) TYPE d VALUE '20231026'.
    DATA(lv_expected_time) TYPE t VALUE '153000'.
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = |{ lv_expected_date DATE = USER } { lv_expected_time TIME = USER }|.

    " This test might fail if the actual system's SY-ZONLO or DST differs.
    " A better approach for unit tests is to pass the time zone to the method.
    " For this example, we'll keep it simple and acknowledge the dependency.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_local_dt_string
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'Local date/time string mismatch (check system time zone/DST)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die formatierte Ausgabe verwendet.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag/Sonntag).
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER` (falls verfügbar) zur Datumsarithmetik und Wochentagsbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d,
          lv_weekday      TYPE i.

    lv_current_date = iv_date_from.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday(
        EXPORTING
          i_date    = lv_current_date
        IMPORTING
          e_weekday = lv_weekday
      ).

      " 1 = Monday, ..., 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7.
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_workdays_between FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workdays_between.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_workdays( ).

    " Test case 1: Monday to Friday (5 workdays)
    DATA(lv_workdays1) = lo_cut->get_workdays_between(
                               iv_date_from = '20231120' " Monday
                               iv_date_to   = '20231124' " Friday
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays1 exp = 5 msg = 'Test Case 1 Failed' ).

    " Test case 2: Monday to Sunday (5 workdays)
    DATA(lv_workdays2) = lo_cut->get_workdays_between(
                               iv_date_from = '20231120' " Monday
                               iv_date_to   = '20231126' " Sunday
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays2 exp = 5 msg = 'Test Case 2 Failed' ).

    " Test case 3: Saturday to Sunday (0 workdays)
    DATA(lv_workdays3) = lo_cut->get_workdays_between(
                               iv_date_from = '20231125' " Saturday
                               iv_date_to   = '20231126' " Sunday
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays3 exp = 0 msg = 'Test Case 3 Failed' ).

    " Test case 4: Single workday
    DATA(lv_workdays4) = lo_cut->get_workdays_between(
                               iv_date_from = '20231120' " Monday

Instructions: Berechne den SHA256-Hash der serialisierten Daten einer internen Tabelle, um deren Integrität zu überprüfen.
hint: Serialisiere die Tabelle zuerst in ein XSTRING-Format, z.B. mit `cl_abap_json_serializer`, und hashe dann die Binärdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_integrity_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_table_hash
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_integrity_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_table_hash.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_json_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lo_serializer->serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data_ref = REF #( it_data )
          RECEIVING
            json     = lv_json_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      if_abap_message_digest=>algorithm_sha256
    ).
    lo_hasher->update_xstring( lv_json_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_hasher->get_hash_as_xstring( ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( )->convert( lv_hash_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_hash FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_hash.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_integrity_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) TYPE zcl_table_integrity_hasher=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251125' ) TO lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_cut->calculate_table_hash( lt_sflight_data ).

    " To get the expected hash, you would typically serialize the same data
    " and hash it outside ABAP or in a separate trusted environment.
    " For this test, we'll use a pre-calculated hash for the specific data above.
    " The JSON representation of the table is:
    " [{"CARRID":"AA","CONNID":"0017","FLDATE":"20251124"},{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"0400","FLDATE":"20251125"}]
    " SHA256 hash of this JSON string (UTF-8 encoded)
    DATA(lv_json_string_for_hash) = `[{"CARRID":"AA","CONNID":"0017","FLDATE":"20251124"},{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"0400","FLDATE":"20251125"}]`.
    DATA(lv_xstring_for_hash) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_host( )->convert( lv_json_string_for_hash ).
    DATA(lo_hasher_exp) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( if_abap_message_digest=>algorithm_sha256 ).
    lo_hasher_exp->update_xstring( lv_xstring_for_hash ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_calc) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( )->convert( lo_hasher_exp->get_hash_as_xstring( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hash
      exp = lv_expected_hash_calc
      msg = 'Hash of serialized table should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Integritätsprüfung von strukturierten Daten. Die interne Tabelle wird mittels `cl_abap_json_serializer` in ein JSON-XSTRING serialisiert. Anschließend wird der SHA256-Hash dieses XSTRINGs berechnet. Dies ist nützlich, um sicherzustellen, dass Daten während der Übertragung oder Speicherung nicht manipuliert wurden.
keywords: Hash, Internal Table, Serialization, JSON, SHA256, cl_abap_message_digest, cl_abap_json_serializer, Data Integrity

Instructions: Überprüfe die Integrität einer Datei, indem du ihren Hash mit einem erwarteten Hash vergleichst. (Simuliert mit einem String als Dateiinhalt).

CLASS zcl_file_integrity_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_file_integrity
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content_string TYPE string
        iv_expected_hash_hex   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid)     TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_integrity_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_file_integrity.
    DATA(lv_file_content_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_by_host( )->convert( iv_file_content_string ).

    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      if_abap_message_digest=>algorithm_sha256
    ).
    lo_hasher->update_xstring( lv_file_content_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_xstring) = lo_hasher->get_hash_as_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( )->convert( lv_actual_hash_xstring ).

    rv_is_valid = COND #( WHEN lv_actual_hash_hex = iv_expected_hash_hex THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_hmac_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Formatiere eine sehr große Zahl (z.B. Millionen, Milliarden) mit einer geeigneten Skalierung (z.B. '1.2M' für 1.200.000).
hint: Kombiniere `format_number` von `/ui2/cl_number` mit eigener Logik zur Skalierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_large_number_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_large_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE p DECIMALS 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_large_number_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_large_number.
    DATA(lo_number_util) = NEW /ui2/cl_number( ).
    DATA(lv_abs_number) TYPE p DECIMALS 0.
    lv_abs_number = ABS( iv_number ).

    IF lv_abs_number >= 1000000000. " Billions
      DATA(lv_scaled_number_b) TYPE p DECIMALS 1.
      lv_scaled_number_b = lv_abs_number / 1000000000.
      rv_formatted_string = lo_number_util->format_number( i_value = lv_scaled_number_b i_decimals = 1 ) && 'B'.
    ELSEIF lv_abs_number >= 1000000. " Millions
      DATA(lv_scaled_number_m) TYPE p DECIMALS 1.
      lv_scaled_number_m = lv_abs_number / 1000000.
      rv_formatted_string = lo_number_util->format_number( i_value = lv_scaled_number_m i_decimals = 1 ) && 'M'.
    ELSEIF lv_abs_number >= 1000. " Thousands
      DATA(lv_scaled_number_k) TYPE p DECIMALS 1.
      lv_scaled_number_k = lv_abs_number / 1000.
      rv_formatted_string = lo_number_util->format_number( i_value = lv_scaled_number_k i_decimals = 1 ) && 'K'.
    ELSE.
      rv_formatted_string = lo_number_util->format_number( i_value = iv_number i_decimals = 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number < 0 AND lv_abs_number >= 1000.
      rv_formatted_string = '-' && rv_formatted_string.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Hash eines Strings unter Verwendung verschiedener Algorithmen (z.B. MD5, SHA1, SHA256).
hint: Die Methode `create` von `cl_abap_message_digest` erlaubt die Angabe des Algorithmus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_algo_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_hash_result,
             algorithm TYPE string,
             hash_hex  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_hash_result.
    TYPES: tt_hash_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_hash_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hashes
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hash_results) TYPE tt_hash_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_algo_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hashes.
    DATA: lt_algorithms TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string VALUE
      VALUE #(
        ( if_abap_message_digest=>algorithm_md5 )
        ( if_abap_message_digest=>algorithm_sha1 )
        ( if_abap_message_digest=>algorithm_sha256 )
      ).

    LOOP AT lt_algorithms INTO DATA(lv_algorithm).
      DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( lv_algorithm ).
      lo_hasher->update_char( iv_input_string ).
      DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_hasher->get_hash_as_xstring( ).
      DATA(lv_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( )->convert( lv_hash_xstring ).

      APPEND VALUE #( algorithm = lv_algorithm hash_hex = lv_hash_hex ) TO rt_hash_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (Feld `PRICE`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis (`PRICE`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Verwenden Sie `DECFLOAT` für präzise Ergebnisse.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für Summe und Zähler, und verwenden Sie `DECFLOAT` für die Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
           count_flights = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price,
           count_flights = count_flights + 1
    ).

    IF ls_result-count_flights > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_dynamic_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_oo_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_string_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_strings) TYPE ty_string_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_flight_data_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).

    rt_flight_strings = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN FILTER ty_flight_data_tt( lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) )
      ( |Flug { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die noch freie Plätze haben (`seatsocc < seatsmax`), und berechnen Sie für jeden dieser Flüge den Prozentsatz der freien Plätze. Fügen Sie die Flugdetails zusammen mit dem berechneten Prozentsatz einer neuen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `VALUE` mit einer Berechnung im Zielstruktur-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ma_filter_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_free_seats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats_perc TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_free_seats.
    TYPES ty_flight_free_seats_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_free_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_free_seats_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ma_filter_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsocc < seatsmax )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        free_seats_perc = COND p( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) * 100 ) / flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ma_filter_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ free_seats_perc > 0 ] ) )
      msg = 'Should contain flights with free seats'
    ).
    IF line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' ] ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' ]-free_seats_perc
        exp = '10.00'
        msg = 'Incorrect free seats percentage for LH 0400'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator wählt relevante Flüge aus. Anschließend wird der `VALUE`-Operator verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren. Innerhalb des Konstruktors wird für jede gefilterte Zeile der Prozentsatz der freien Plätze berechnet und zusammen mit den anderen Feldern der neuen Zeile zugewiesen, was einem `APPEND` der berechneten Daten entspricht. Die `COND`-Expression sorgt für eine sichere Division durch Null.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, APPEND, Math, Internal Tables, COND, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge, die von 'BERLIN' abfliegen, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` nach einer `FILTER`-Operation.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fp_reduce_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fp_reduce_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT cityfrom, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      msg = 'Total occupied seats should be non-negative'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

CLASS zcl_it_filter_group_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_key TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_it_filter_group_key IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ einer internen Tabelle und den Typ ihrer Zeilenstruktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` sowie `get_table_line_type`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
        id   TYPE i,
        name TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_data,
      ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_and_line_type
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE ty_t_data
      EXPORTING
        eo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
        eo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_and_line_type.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    eo_table_descr ?= lo_table_descr.

    DATA(lo_line_descr) = eo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    eo_line_descr ?= lo_line_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_type.
    DATA(lt_test_table) TYPE zcl_rtti_table_type=>ty_t_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_type( ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA(lo_line_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lo_cut->get_table_and_line_type(
      EXPORTING
        it_table       = lt_test_table
      IMPORTING
        eo_table_descr = lo_table_descr
        eo_line_descr  = lo_line_descr
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_table_descr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_table_descr->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_table_descr->table_kind exp = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_line_descr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 1 ]-name exp = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 2 ]-name exp = 'NAME' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie RTTI verwendet wird, um detaillierte Informationen über interne Tabellen und deren Zeilenstrukturen zu erhalten. `cl_abap_tabledescr` bietet Methoden, um den Tabellentyp (Standard, Sorted, Hashed) und den Typ der Zeile zu bestimmen. Dies ist entscheidend für die dynamische Verarbeitung von Tabellen, deren Struktur zur Entwicklungszeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, get_table_line_type, Interne Tabelle, Struktur

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein Datenobjekt vom Typ `string` und weisen Sie ihm einen Wert zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p_string` und `create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_string.
    DATA(lo_string_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p_string( ).
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_string_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_string> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_string>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_string> = iv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_string_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_string_creation.
    DATA(lv_test_value) = 'Dynamisch erzeugt'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_data( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_string( lv_test_value ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_string> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_string>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_string> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_string> exp = lv_test_value ).

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_string> ).
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_descr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_elem_descr->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene RTTI-Anwendung: die dynamische Erzeugung von Datenobjekten. Mit `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p_string()` wird ein Typdeskriptor für den Typ `string` abgerufen. Dieser Deskriptor wird dann verwendet, um mit `CREATE DATA` ein Datenreferenzobjekt zu instanziieren. Dies ist fundamental für generische Frameworks oder wenn die Datenstruktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamische Programmierung, CREATE DATA, cl_abap_elemdescr, Datenreferenz

" Abstract Base Class

    " To properly test MESSAGE, one would need to use test doubles or check sy-msgid/sy-msgty

    DATA(lv_msg) TYPE string.
    TRY.
