explanation: Abstrakte Klassen und Methoden sind ein Eckpfeiler der objektorientierten Programmierung. Sie ermöglichen es, eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle und teilweise Implementierung in einer Basisklasse zu definieren, während die spezifischen Details den Unterklassen überlassen werden. Dies fördert Polymorphie und eine saubere Architektur, da die Basisklasse nicht instanziiert werden kann und die Implementierung der abstrakten Methoden in den Unterklassen erzwungen wird.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Polymorphie mit RTTI. Obwohl die Liste Referenzen auf die abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_shape_abstract` enthält, kann mit `cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object()` der *konkrete* Typ jedes Objekts zur Laufzeit ermittelt werden. Dies ist nützlich, wenn man mit polymorphen Objekten arbeitet, aber dennoch spezifische Aktionen basierend auf ihrem tatsächlichen Typ ausführen muss, ohne explizite `CAST`-Operationen oder `CASE TYPE OF` verwenden zu müssen. Die `LET`-Expression in der `VALUE`-Anweisung verbessert die Lesbarkeit.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Zeilenstruktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_component,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_component,
           ty_t_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE ty_t_components
        iv_num_rows   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components_descr TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component_descr  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ls_component_descr-name = ls_component-name.
      CASE ls_component-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component_descr-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component_descr-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p_int4( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle other types or raise error
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component_descr TO lt_components_descr.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components_descr ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
      DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp> TYPE any.
          LOOP AT lt_components_descr INTO ls_component_descr.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component_descr-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              CASE ls_component_descr-type->type_kind.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
                  <fs_comp> = |Value { sy-index } for { ls_component_descr-name }|.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int4.
                  <fs_comp> = sy-index.
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table=>ty_t_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'ID' type = 'INT' ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'DESCRIPTION' type = 'STRING' ) TO lt_components.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_components = lt_components iv_num_rows = 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_id> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_id>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_desc> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DESCRIPTION' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_desc>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_desc> exp = 'Value 1 for DESCRIPTION' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur. Mittels `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` wird ein Strukturdeskriptor aus einer Liste von Komponenten erstellt, und dann mit `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` ein Tabellendeskriptor. Diese Deskriptoren werden verwendet, um mit `CREATE DATA` die Tabelle zu instanziieren. Die Befüllung erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über Feldsymbole. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene RTTI-Anwendung für hochflexible Datenverarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_object_of_type.
    DATA(lo_obj_descr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).

      rv_is_of_type = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine abstrakte Strategieklasse `zcl_sort_strategy_abstract` mit einer abstrakten Methode `sort_data`. Erstellen Sie konkrete Strategien `zcl_bubble_sort` und `zcl_quick_sort` und verwenden Sie diese in einer Kontextklasse `zcl_sorter`.
hint: Das Strategy Pattern verwendet eine abstrakte Basisklasse oder ein Interface, um austauschbare Algorithmen zu definieren.
solution:
TYPES: ty_t_int_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

" Abstract Strategy
CLASS zcl_sort_strategy_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_data ABSTRACT CHANGING ct_data TYPE ty_t_int_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_strategy_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

" Concrete Strategy: Bubble Sort
CLASS zcl_bubble_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_sort_strategy_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bubble_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_data.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE i.
    DO lines( ct_data ) - 1 TIMES.
      DO lines( ct_data ) - sy-index TIMES.
        IF ct_data[ sy-index ] > ct_data[ sy-index + 1 ].
          lv_temp = ct_data[ sy-index ].
          ct_data[ sy-index ] = ct_data[ sy-index + 1 ].
          ct_data[ sy-index + 1 ] = lv_temp.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Concrete Strategy: Quick Sort (simplified for demo)
CLASS zcl_quick_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_sort_strategy_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quick_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_data.
    " In a real scenario, this would be a full Quick Sort implementation.
    " For demo, we'll use ABAP's built-in sort.
    SORT ct_data ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Context Class
CLASS zcl_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: 
      constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_sort_strategy_abstract,
      execute_sort CHANGING ct_data TYPE ty_t_int_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_sort_strategy_abstract.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD execute_sort.
    mo_strategy->sort_data( CHANGING ct_data = ct_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bubble_sort FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_quick_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bubble_sort.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_t_int_table( ( 5 ) ( 2 ) ( 8 ) ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE ty_t_int_table( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ( 8 ) ).

    DATA(lo_bubble_sort) = NEW zcl_bubble_sort( ).
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_sorter( lo_bubble_sort ).
    lo_sorter->execute_sort( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_quick_sort.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_t_int_table( ( 5 ) ( 2 ) ( 8 ) ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE ty_t_int_table( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ( 8 ) ).

    DATA(lo_quick_sort) = NEW zcl_quick_sort( ).
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_sorter( lo_quick_sort ).
    lo_sorter->execute_sort( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategy Pattern definiert eine Familie von Algorithmen, kapselt jeden einzelnen und macht sie austauschbar. Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_sort_strategy_abstract` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle für die Sortieralgorithmen. Konkrete Unterklassen implementieren spezifische Sortierstrategien. Die Kontextklasse `zcl_sorter` verwendet eine Referenz auf die abstrakte Strategie, um den Algorithmus zur Laufzeit auszuwählen. Dies ermöglicht es, das Verhalten eines Objekts dynamisch zu ändern.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, Design Pattern, Strategy Pattern, Objektorientierung, Polymorphie

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SORTED TABLE` mit einem `UNIQUE KEY` und fügen Sie Daten hinzu. Versuchen Sie, einen doppelten Eintrag hinzuzufügen, um den Fehler zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Zeilenstruktur und `DATA` mit `TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_unique_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_t_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS demonstrate_unique_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_unique_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights.
    rt_result = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD demonstrate_unique_key.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_sorted.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.

    APPEND 'Erster Eintrag AA 0017 20250101 hinzugefügt.' TO rt_log.
    APPEND 'Zweiter Eintrag LH 0400 20250101 hinzugefügt.' TO rt_log.

    TRY.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
        <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
        <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
        <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
        APPEND 'Fehler: Doppelter Eintrag AA 0017 20250101 erfolgreich hinzugefügt (sollte nicht passieren).' TO rt_log.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        APPEND 'Erfolg: Doppelter Eintrag AA 0017 20250101 wurde abgelehnt (CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY).' TO rt_log.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_unique_key( ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_cut->demonstrate_unique_key( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lt_log
      exp = 'Erfolg: Doppelter Eintrag AA 0017 20250101 wurde abgelehnt (CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge basierend auf den Schlüsselfeldern existieren können. Versucht man, einen doppelten Eintrag hinzuzufügen, wird die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY` ausgelöst. Dies ist effizient für Datenkonsistenz und schnellen Zugriff.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, TYPES, Internal Tables, Exception Handling

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SORTED TABLE` mit einem `NON-UNIQUE KEY` und fügen Sie Daten hinzu, die doppelte Schlüsselwerte enthalten.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_product,
             product_id   TYPE string,

    <fs_product>-price = '1200.00'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_products ASSIGNING <fs_product>.
    <fs_product>-product_id = 'P002'.
    <fs_product>-product_name = 'Mouse'.
    <fs_product>-price = '25.50'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_products ASSIGNING <fs_product>.
    <fs_product>-product_id = 'P001'. "Duplicate key value for product_id

    DATA(lt_products) = lo_cut->demonstrate_non_unique_key( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist nützlich, wenn man schnelle Zugriffe über einen Schlüssel benötigt, aber Duplikate zulässig sind, z.B. für Gruppierungen oder wenn der Schlüssel nur ein Teil der Identität ist.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_local_struct( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

CLASS zcl_types_range_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_r_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        ir_carrids TYPE ty_r_carrid
      RETURNING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_filtered.

CLASS zcl_types_range_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @ir_carrids
      INTO TABLE @rt_filtered_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD demonstrate_range_usage.
    DATA(lr_carrids) = VALUE ty_r_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'JL' high = 'UA' )

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->demonstrate_range_usage( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

                 ( <fs_flight>-carrid GE 'JL' AND <fs_flight>-carrid LE 'UA' ) )
        msg = |Flight { <fs_flight>-carrid } is not in expected range.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_types_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine `SORTED TABLE` und demonstrieren Sie, wie die Sortierung für effiziente Verarbeitung genutzt werden kann (z.B. Gruppierung von Elementen mit gleichem Schlüssel).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` oder manuelle Gruppierung, da die Tabelle bereits sortiert ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_order_item,
             order_id TYPE i,
             item_id  TYPE i,
             amount   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_order_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_order_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_s_order_item WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY order_id.

    METHODS get_order_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE ty_t_order_items.

    METHODS calculate_total_per_order
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_totals) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF
                           BEGIN OF HIERARCHY_LEVEL 0,
                             order_id TYPE i,
                             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
                           END OF HIERARCHY_LEVEL 0
                           WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_items.
    rt_items = VALUE #(
      ( order_id = 1 item_id = 10 amount = '100.00' )
      ( order_id = 1 item_id = 20 amount = '50.00' )
      ( order_id = 2 item_id = 30 amount = '200.00' )
      ( order_id = 3 item_id = 40 amount = '75.00' )
      ( order_id = 2 item_id = 50 amount = '120.00' )
      ( order_id = 1 item_id = 60 amount = '30.00' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_per_order.
    DATA(lt_order_items) = get_order_items( ).

    LOOP AT lt_order_items INTO DATA(ls_item) GROUP BY ls_item-order_id.
      DATA(ls_total) = VALUE ty_s_order_total(
        order_id = ls_item-order_id
        total_amount = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <fs_group_item> IN GROUP ls_item
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_item>-amount
        )
      ).
      APPEND ls_total TO rt_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_totals FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_totals.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->calculate_total_per_order( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY order_id = 1 INTO DATA(ls_total_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_total_1-total_amount exp = '180.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY order_id = 2 INTO DATA(ls_total_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_total_2-total_amount exp = '320.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_totals WITH KEY order_id = 3 INTO DATA(ls_total_3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_total_3-total_amount exp = '75.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren. Bei einer `SORTED TABLE` ist dies besonders performant, da die Daten bereits nach dem Gruppierungsschlüssel sortiert sind. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können Aggregationen innerhalb der Gruppen kompakt durchgeführt werden.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Typ für eine Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie diesen, um eine Tabelle per Referenz zu übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: ty_t_ref TYPE REF TO data.` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_table_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             key   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_t_data_ref TYPE REF TO ty_t_data.

    METHODS modify_table_by_ref
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref TYPE ty_t_data_ref.

    METHODS get_initial_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_table) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_table_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_table_by_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ty_t_data.
    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      APPEND VALUE ty_s_data( key = 3 value = 'Modified' ) TO <lt_table>.
      SORT <lt_table> BY key ASCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_initial_table.
    rt_table = VALUE #(
      ( key = 1 value = 'Original 1' )
      ( key = 2 value = 'Original 2' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_my_table) = lo_cut->get_initial_table( ).

    DATA(lr_table_ref) TYPE REF TO zcl_types_table_ref=>ty_t_data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_my_table INTO lr_table_ref.

    lo_cut->modify_table_by_ref( ir_table_ref = lr_table_ref ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_my_table ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_my_table[ 3 ]-value exp = 'Modified' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_my_table[ 1 ]-key exp = 1 ). "Check sort order
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Übergeben von internen Tabellen per Referenz (`TYPE REF TO data` oder spezifischer `TYPE REF TO ty_t_data`) ist effizient, da keine Kopie der Tabelle erstellt wird. Dies ist besonders vorteilhaft bei großen Tabellen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff und die Modifikation der referenzierten Tabelle. `SORT` ist hier eine klassische Operation, die die Sortierung einer Tabelle nach einem Schlüssel demonstriert.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flights.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = get_all_flights( ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Zeilentyp und den Tabellentyp (Standard, Sorted, Hashed) einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_table_info,
             row_type_name TYPE string,
             table_kind    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_table_info.

    METHODS get_table_details
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_table_info) TYPE ty_table_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_details.
    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ) ).

    rs_table_info-row_type_name = lo_tabledescr->get_persistent_type( )->get_name( ).

    CASE lo_tabledescr->get_table_kind( ).
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std.
        rs_table_info-table_kind = 'STANDARD'.
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted.
        rs_table_info-table_kind = 'SORTED'.
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed.
        rs_table_info-table_kind = 'HASHED'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_table_info-table_kind = 'UNKNOWN'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Methoden einer Klasse zur Laufzeit, inklusive ihrer Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und die Methode `GET_METHODS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter.
    TYPES: tt_parameters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name       TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameters,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods.
    DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
      IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_classdescr=>visibility_public.
        DATA(ls_method_info) TYPE ty_method_info.
        ls_method_info-name = ls_method-name.

        LOOP AT ls_method-parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
          DATA(lv_param_kind) TYPE string.
          CASE ls_param-kind.
            WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>parameterkind_importing THEN lv_param_kind = 'IMPORTING'.
            WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>parameterkind_exporting THEN lv_param_kind = 'EXPORTING'.
            WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>parameterkind_changing  THEN lv_param_kind = 'CHANGING'.
            WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>parameterkind_returning THEN lv_param_kind = 'RETURNING'.
            WHEN OTHERS THEN lv_param_kind = 'UNKNOWN'.
          ENDCASE.

          APPEND VALUE ty_parameter(
            name = ls_param-name
            type = ls_param-type->get_name( )
            kind = lv_param_kind
          ) TO ls_method_info-parameters.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND ls_method_info TO rt_methods.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String-Parameter haben und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR=>GET_CLASS_NAME`, `CREATE OBJECT` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT' ##NO_TEXT.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    DATA lv_result TYPE string.
    DATA lr_result TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_result INTO lr_result.

    CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING RESULTS
        VALUE(result) = lr_result.

    rv_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Länge, die Kurzbeschreibung und den Datentyp eines Data Elements zur Laufzeit.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR` und seine Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_data_element_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_element_info,
             name        TYPE string,
             length      TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             type_kind   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_element_info.

    METHODS get_element_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_element_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_element_info) TYPE ty_element_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_data_element_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_details.
    DATA(lo_elemdescr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_data_element_name ) ).

    rs_element_info-name = lo_elemdescr->get_name( ).
    rs_element_info-length = lo_elemdescr->length.
    rs_element_info-description = lo_elemdescr->get_ddic_field_label( ).

    CASE lo_elemdescr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char THEN rs_element_info-type_kind = 'Character'.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num  THEN rs_element_info-type_kind = 'Numeric'.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int  THEN rs_element_info-type_kind = 'Integer'.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date THEN rs_element_info-type_kind = 'Date'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN rs_element_info-type_kind = 'Other'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und die Methode `GET_INTERFACES`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_loggable PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_my_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_loggable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_loggable~log_message.
    " Implementierung hier (z.B. WRITE iv_message).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_interfaces( ) INTO DATA(ls_interface).
      IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
        rb_implements = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rb_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs entgegennimmt und den Inhalt einer bestimmten Spalte (Name als String) in einer neuen internen Tabelle sammelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_column_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_column
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any table
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        et_target_table TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_column_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_row> TYPE any,
                   <fs_column_value> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_target_row> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_row_type) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_tabledescr->get_persistent_type( ) ).

    " Create dynamic target table with the type of the column
    DATA(lo_column_type) = lo_row_type->get_component_type( iv_column_name ).
    DATA(lo_target_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_column_type
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA et_target_table TYPE HANDLE lo_target_table_type.
    ASSIGN et_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_row> TO <fs_column_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Component '{ iv_column_name }' not found in structure.|.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE DATA <fs_target_row> TYPE HANDLE lo_column_type.
      ASSIGN <fs_target_row>->* TO <fs_target_row>.
      <fs_target_row> = <fs_column_value>.
      INSERT <fs_target_row> INTO TABLE <fs_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      DATA(ls_attribute_info) = VALUE ty_attribute_info(
        name = ls_attribute-name
        type = ls_attribute-type_descr->get_absolute_name( )
      ).
      APPEND ls_attribute_info TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Methoden einer beliebigen Klasse, deren Parameter und deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string, "Importing, Exporting, Changing, Returning
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameter_info,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_class_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method).
      DATA(lt_parameters_info) = VALUE tt_parameter_info(
        FOR ls_param IN ls_method-parameters
        ( name = ls_param-name
          kind = SWITCH string( ls_param-kind
                   WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>importing THEN 'IMPORTING'
                   WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>exporting THEN 'EXPORTING'
                   WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>changing  THEN 'CHANGING'
                   WHEN cl_abap_parmdescr=>returning THEN 'RETURNING'
                   ELSE 'UNKNOWN' )
          type = ls_param-type_descr->get_absolute_name( ) )
      ).
      DATA(ls_method_info) = VALUE ty_method_info(
        name = ls_method-name
        parameters = lt_parameters_info
      ).
      APPEND ls_method_info TO rt_methods.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden dynamisch auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit Typangabe und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_static_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL "For simple string parameter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error,
        cx_sy_descr_error.

    METHODS call_instance_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL "For simple string parameter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error,
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_static_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameters_table.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE cl_abap_parmdescr.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    lt_parameters = lo_class_descr->get_method_parameters( iv_method_name ).

    " Prepare parameters dynamically
    DATA lt_param_tab TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      READ TABLE lt_parameters INTO ls_parameter INDEX 1. "Assume first parameter is the one to set
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmdescr=>importing.
        DATA(ls_param_bind) = VALUE abap_parmbind( name = ls_parameter-name kind = abap_parmbind_kind=>importing value = REF #( iv_param_value ) ).
        APPEND ls_param_bind TO lt_param_tab.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Call static method dynamically
    CALL METHOD (iv_class_name)=>(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_param_tab
      RECEIVING
        VALUE(result) = rv_result. "Assuming a returning parameter of type string
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_instance_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameters_table.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE cl_abap_parmdescr.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    lt_parameters = lo_class_descr->get_method_parameters( iv_method_name ).

    " Create object dynamically
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    " Prepare parameters dynamically
    DATA lt_param_tab TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      READ TABLE lt_parameters INTO ls_parameter INDEX 1. "Assume first parameter is the one to set
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmdescr=>importing.
        DATA(ls_param_bind) = VALUE abap_parmbind( name = ls_parameter-name kind = abap_parmbind_kind=>importing value = REF #( iv_param_value ) ).
        APPEND ls_param_bind TO lt_param_tab.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Call instance method dynamically
    CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_param_tab
      RECEIVING
        VALUE(result) = rv_result. "Assuming a returning parameter of type string
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur und deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name` oder `describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
             decimals TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_component_info) = VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_absolute_name( )
        length = ls_component-type_descr->length
        decimals = ls_component-type_descr->decimals
      ).
      APPEND ls_component_info TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in eine CSV-formatierte XSTRING-Repräsentation, die UTF-8-kodiert ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities` für die String-zu-XSTRING-Konvertierung mit String-Templates und `REDUCE` für die CSV-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_csv_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error,
        cx_sy_buffer_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " Get header row dynamically using RTTI (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_header) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_comp-name ELSE s && ',' && ls_comp-name ) ).

    lv_csv_string = lv_header && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR comp_name IN lt_components
        LET lv_value = |
          { SWITCH string(
              comp_name-type_descr->type_kind
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char THEN |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string ESCAPE JSON }
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num THEN |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string }
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed THEN |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string }
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat THEN |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string }
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date THEN |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string }
              WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time THEN |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string }
              ELSE |
                { REF #( ls_sflight )->*( comp_name-name ) AS string }
            ) }
        |
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_value ELSE s && ',' && lv_value ) ).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string && lv_row && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>string_to_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_string   = lv_csv_string
        im_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        ex_xstring  = rx_csv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Strukturdefinition und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
        it_data_values TYPE string_table "Simple string values for demo
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_table        TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line         TYPE REF TO data.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).

    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    CREATE DATA lr_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_comp_count) = lines( lt_components ).

    LOOP AT it_data_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix MOD lv_comp_count.
      IF lv_index = 0. lv_index = lv_comp_count. ENDIF.

      DATA(ls_component) = lt_components[ lv_index ].
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Simple assignment, more complex type handling would be needed for real scenarios
        <fs_component> = lv_value.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_index = lv_comp_count. "After filling all components for a line
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        CLEAR <fs_line>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rr_dynamic_table = lr_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status,

             in_progress TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
             completed   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
             cancelled   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'X',

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Namen einer Enumeration und einen Wert als String akzeptiert und prüft, ob dieser Wert in der Enumeration existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR=>GET_BY_NAME` und `GET_ENUM_VALUE_NAME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_dynamic_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM status_code,
             success TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'S',
             error   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'E',
             warning TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'W',
           END OF ENUM status_code.

    METHODS is_enum_value_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_enum_name TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_dynamic_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_enum_value_valid.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_enum_descr) = cl_abap_enumdescr=>get_by_name( iv_enum_name ).
        " This method throws an exception if the value does not exist
        lo_enum_descr->get_enum_value_name( iv_value ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_enum_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von Flügen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält. Jeder Flug soll als `<Flight>`-Element mit Attributen für `Carrid` und `Connid` sowie Kind-Elementen für `Fldate` und `Price` dargestellt werden. Beschränken Sie die Ausgabe auf die ersten 3 Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UP TO ... ROWS` und eine Schleife (`LOOP AT`) zur Iteration über die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflights_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_xml.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrid' value = <fs_flight>-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connid' value = <fs_flight>-connid ).

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Fldate' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( <fs_flight>-fldate ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Fldate

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( <fs_flight>-price ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Price

      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_xml_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sxml_writer_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_sflights_xml( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flights>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight Carrid="' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Fldate>' ).
    DATA(lv_count) = count( val = lv_xml regex = '<Flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count >= 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration von Datenbankabfragen mit der XML-Generierung. Die `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` Syntax ist modern und effizient. Die Schleife über die interne Tabelle und das sequentielle Schreiben der XML-Elemente und Attribute ist eine typische Vorgehensweise.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie Flüge basierend auf ihrem Preis in 'Budget', 'Standard', 'Premium' oder 'Luxury' unter Verwendung eines `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )` für eine kompakte und lesbare Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                                      ( carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                        connid   = <fs_flight>-connid
                                        fldate   = <fs_flight>-fldate
                                        price    = <fs_flight>-price
                                        currency = <fs_flight>-currency
                                        category = SWITCH #( <fs_flight>-price
                                                             WHEN < 100 THEN 'Budget'
                                                             WHEN < 500 THEN 'Standard'
                                                             WHEN < 1000 THEN 'Premium'
                                                             ELSE 'Luxury' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_categorization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorization.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`, wobei Sie nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Status berücksichtigen. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung für die bedingte Aggregation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `CASE`-Anweisung, um die Aggregation bedingt durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_capacity WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_status   TYPE sflight-status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_capacity) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rt_carrier_capacity = REDUCE tt_carrier_capacity(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( status = iv_status )
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT result = COND tt_carrier_capacity(
        WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL THEN
          VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid total_capacity = <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) )
        ELSE
          VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid total_capacity = result[ lv_index ]-total_capacity + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100. ls_sflight-status = 'B'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0402'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 120. ls_sflight-status = 'B'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 200. ls_sflight-status = 'B'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0002'. ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 80.  ls_sflight-status = 'R'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_status = 'B' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_capacity exp = 220 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_capacity exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In diesem Beispiel wird sie verwendet, um die Gesamtkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen, wobei nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Status berücksichtigt werden. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine bedingte Aktualisierung der Aggregationsergebnisse, was den Code sehr funktional und ausdrucksstark macht.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filter_type TYPE string " 'SHORT', 'LONG', 'INTERNATIONAL'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_criteria.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( SWITCH #( iv_filter_type
                                                      WHEN 'SHORT' THEN distance < 500
                                                      WHEN 'LONG' THEN distance >= 2000
                                                      WHEN 'INTERNATIONAL' THEN countryfr <> countryto
                                                      ELSE abap_true ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Aktion basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung ausführt, um verschiedene Verhaltensweisen zu kapseln.

CLASS zcl_action_dispatcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dispatch_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_action_type TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dispatch_action.
    CASE iv_action_type.
      WHEN 'ADD'.
        rv_result = |Result: { iv_value + 10 }|.
      WHEN 'SUBTRACT'.
        rv_result = |Result: { iv_value - 5 }|.
      WHEN 'MULTIPLY'.
        rv_result = |Result: { iv_value * 2 }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'Unbekannte Aktion'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung, um verschiedene Berechnungen basierend auf einem Operationstyp durchzuführen und das Ergebnis zurückzugeben.
hint: Eine klassische `CASE`-Anweisung ist hier die beste Wahl, um verschiedene Rechenwege zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE i
        iv_operand2 TYPE i
        iv_operation TYPE string " 'ADD', 'SUB', 'MUL', 'DIV'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    CASE iv_operation.
      WHEN 'ADD'.
        rv_result = iv_operand1 + iv_operand2.
      WHEN 'SUB'.
        rv_result = iv_operand1 - iv_operand2.
      WHEN 'MUL'.
        rv_result = iv_operand1 * iv_operand2.
      WHEN 'DIV'.
        IF iv_operand2 = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arith_errors.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = iv_operand1 / iv_operand2.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default or error handling
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die korrekte Pluralform eines Wortes basierend auf einer Zahl und einer Ländereinstellung unter Verwendung von `cl_i18n_utils`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_plural_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_plural_form
      IMPORTING
        iv_count  TYPE i
        iv_word   TYPE string
        iv_locale TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_plural_word) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_plural_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_plural_form.
    " This is a simplified example. Real pluralization often requires more complex rules
    " or external resources. cl_i18n_utils provides a basic mechanism.
    IF iv_count = 1.
      rv_plural_word = iv_word.
    ELSE.
      " For demonstration, we'll just append 's' for English or 'e' for German if not 1
      " A real implementation would use cl_i18n_utils=>format_plural if available and configured
      " or a more sophisticated pluralization logic.
      CASE iv_locale.
        WHEN 'en_US'.
          rv_plural_word = |{ iv_word }s|.
        WHEN 'de_DE'.
          " Simplified: assuming 'Buch' -> 'Bücher', 'Auto' -> 'Autos'
          IF iv_word = 'Buch'.
            rv_plural_word = 'Bücher'.
          ELSEIF iv_word = 'Auto'.
            rv_plural_word = 'Autos'.
          ELSE.
            rv_plural_word = |{ iv_word }e|.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          rv_plural_word = iv_word.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDIF.

    " Actual cl_i18n_utils=>format_plural usage (requires specific setup/configuration not easily demoable here)
    " rv_plural_word = cl_i18n_utils=>format_plural(
    "   count  = iv_count
    "   word   = iv_word
    "   locale = iv_locale
    " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, deren maximale Kapazität über einem in `cl_mmpur_constants` definierten Schwellenwert liegt. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit den Feldern `carrid`, `connid`, `fldate`, `price` und `currency`. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` und greifen Sie auf eine Konstante von `cl_mmpur_constants` zu. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine simulierte Konstante verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    " Simulierte Konstante aus cl_mmpur_constants für das Beispiel
    CONSTANTS lc_min_capacity TYPE s_max_seats VALUE 100.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier AND seatsmax > lc_min_capacity )
                                   ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                                     connid   = flight-connid,
                                     fldate   = flight-fldate,
                                     price    = flight-price,
                                     currency = flight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_detail.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE type( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

Instructions: Zeigen Sie, wie man Ereignisse von Schaltflächen einer `cl_gui_toolbar` Instanz behandelt. Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für einen 'Speichern'-Button. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine vereinfachte Darstellung des Event-Handlings verwendet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_button_id) TYPE string.

    METHODS register_handler
      IMPORTING
        io_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.

    DATA mv_last_clicked_button TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_handler.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR io_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_last_clicked_button = fcode.
    RAISE EVENT button_clicked EXPORTING e_button_id = fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_handler_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler_registration.
    " In a real scenario, cl_gui_toolbar would be created on a screen.
    " For unit testing, we can only verify the handler registration syntax.
    " A full functional test would require a GUI environment.
    DATA lo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_toolbar_event_handler( ).

    " This call itself tests the syntax of SET HANDLER
    lo_handler->register_handler( lo_toolbar ).

    " To actually test the event, one would need to trigger it, which is not
    " directly possible in a pure unit test without a GUI.
    " We can assert that the handler object exists.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_handler ).

    " Clean up (important for GUI objects)
    FREE OBJECT lo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung eines Event-Handlers für das `BUTTON_CLICK`-Ereignis der `cl_gui_toolbar`. Die `SET HANDLER`-Anweisung registriert eine Methode als Reaktion auf ein Ereignis. Dies ist der Standardweg, um auf Benutzerinteraktionen in ABAP-GUI-Programmen zu reagieren. Obwohl ein vollständiger Test ohne GUI schwierig ist, zeigt der Unit Test die korrekte Syntax für die Registrierung des Handlers.
keywords: cl_gui_toolbar, GUI, Events, SET HANDLER, BUTTON_CLICK

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie die moderne `GROUP BY` Syntax in Open SQL und den `FOR` Ausdruck für die interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ...` und `FOR GROUPS ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_result).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_db_result
                                 ( carrid = row-carrid, flight_count = row-flight_count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouping_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Assert for a specific carrier, e.g., 'AA'
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Klausel in Open SQL ermöglicht es, Aggregationen direkt in der Datenbank durchzuführen, was die Performance verbessert und den Code vereinfacht. In Kombination mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und dem `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Ausdruck für die interne Tabelle wird der Code sehr prägnant und effizient. Dies ist der moderne Weg, um Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, Open SQL, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Teilstrings in einem Text durch einen anderen Teilstring. Verwenden Sie die moderne `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... IN ... WITH ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        iv_old_string TYPE string
        iv_new_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring.
    rv_result_text = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_string IN rv_result_text WITH iv_new_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_all FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replace FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring(
      iv_text       = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP'
      iv_old_string = 'Hello'
      iv_new_string = 'Hi'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring(
      iv_text       = 'ABAP'
      iv_old_string = 'Java'
      iv_new_string = 'Python'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring(
      iv_text       = 'ABAP'
      iv_old_string = 'A'
      iv_new_string = ''
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'BAP' ).

explanation: Die Anweisung `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem String zu ersetzen. Sie ist leistungsfähiger und lesbarer als ältere Ansätze mit `DO`-Schleifen und `FIND`/`REPLACE` in Kombination.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, String

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Interfaces und Polymorphie, indem Sie eine Methode implementieren, die verschiedene Objekte verarbeitet, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren. Verwenden Sie eine Liste von Objekten.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und implementieren Sie es in mehreren Klassen. Verwenden Sie dann eine Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processable.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processor_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor A processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor B handled: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_processable TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_processable WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS handle_processors
      IMPORTING
        it_processors TYPE tt_processable
        iv_data       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_processors.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR processor IN it_processors
                          ( processor->process_data( iv_input = iv_data ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA: lt_processors TYPE zcl_polymorphic_handler=>tt_processable,
          lo_processor_a TYPE REF TO zif_processable,
          lo_processor_b TYPE REF TO zif_processable.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_processor_a TYPE zcl_processor_a.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_processor_b TYPE zcl_processor_b.

    APPEND lo_processor_a TO lt_processors.
    APPEND lo_processor_b TO lt_processors.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_polymorphic_handler( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_handler->handle_processors( it_processors = lt_processors iv_data = 'Testdata' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Processor A processed: Testdata' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Processor B handled: Testdata' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Polymorphie und die Verwendung von Interfaces. Durch die Definition eines gemeinsamen Interfaces (`zif_processable`) können verschiedene Klassen (`zcl_processor_a`, `zcl_processor_b`) unterschiedliche Implementierungen derselben Methode bereitstellen. Eine verarbeitende Klasse (`zcl_polymorphic_handler`) kann dann eine Liste von Interface-Referenzen verarbeiten, ohne die konkreten Implementierungen zu kennen. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen wird hier genutzt, um die Verarbeitung der Liste kompakt zu gestalten.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interfaces, Polymorphism, FOR, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine RANGE-Tabelle für Flugnummern (CARRID) der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'AA' und 'LH' enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und die Struktur `RANGES OF ...`.
solution:

ENDCLASS.

    rt_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'NE' low = 'AA' )
                        ( sign = 'I' option = 'NE' low = 'LH' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten, um nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaften 'LH' und 'UA' anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für die Selektion.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit einer RANGE-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflight_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflight_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    lt_carrid_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
                                ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) ).

    rt_filtered_sflight = FILTER #( it_sflight WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filter_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_sflight_by_carrid( lt_sflight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen, einschließlich RANGE-Tabellen, zu filtern.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, Internal Tables, Selection, IN

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft ('SQ') in einer RANGE-Tabelle enthalten ist, die 'LH' und 'AA' ausschließt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `IN` Bedingung mit einer RANGE-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_carrid_allowed
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_allowed) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_carrid_allowed.
    DATA: lt_excluded_carrids TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    lt_excluded_carrids = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'NE' low = 'LH' )
                                   ( sign = 'I' option = 'NE' low = 'AA' ) ).

    IF iv_carrid IN lt_excluded_carrids.
      rv_is_allowed = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_allowed = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_carrid_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrid_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_line_exists( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_carrid_allowed( 'SQ' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_carrid_allowed( 'LH' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_carrid_allowed( 'AA' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `IN` Bedingung mit einer RANGE-Tabelle ist eine effiziente Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein Wert in einem definierten Bereich oder einer Liste von Werten liegt.
keywords: RANGES, IN, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für Flugnummern (CONNID), die alle Verbindungen von '0001' bis '0100' (inklusive) und zusätzlich die Verbindung '9999' enthält, aber '0050' ausschließt.
