Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und deren Verbindungen (als geschachtelte Tabelle). Erstellen Sie eine flache Tabelle, die jede Verbindung als separate Zeile mit der zugehörigen Fluggesellschaft enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie geschachtelte `FOR` Ausdrücke mit `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... FOR ... IN ... )`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_connection,
           tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_connections,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections TYPE tt_connections,
           END OF ty_carr_connections,
           tt_carr_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flat_connection,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flat_connection,
           tt_flat_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flat_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_nested_for_flatten DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flatten_connections
      IMPORTING
        it_carr_conn TYPE tt_carr_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flat_conn) TYPE tt_flat_connection.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for_flatten IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flatten_connections.
    rt_flat_conn = VALUE #( FOR <carr_conn> IN it_carr_conn
                            FOR <connection> IN <carr_conn>-connections
                              ( carrid = <carr_conn>-carrid
                                connid = <connection>-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_flatten_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flatten_connections.
    DATA: lt_carr_conn TYPE tt_carr_connections.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_conn ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carr_conn>).
    <fs_carr_conn>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_connection( connid = '0400' ) TO <fs_carr_conn>-connections.
    APPEND VALUE ty_connection( connid = '0401' ) TO <fs_carr_conn>-connections.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_conn ASSIGNING <fs_carr_conn>.
    <fs_carr_conn>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_connection( connid = '0017' ) TO <fs_carr_conn>-connections.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_for_flatten( ).
    DATA(lt_flat) = lo_cut->flatten_connections( lt_carr_conn ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flat ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Geschachtelte `FOR` Ausdrücke in `VALUE #( ... )` sind ideal, um hierarchische Datenstrukturen zu transformieren oder zu 'flatten', ohne explizite Schleifen zu verwenden.
keywords: NESTING, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Flattening

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer Fluggesellschaft, wobei die Passagierzahlen pro Flug in einer geschachtelten Tabelle vorliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `REDUCE` Ausdrücke.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_carr_flights,
           tt_carr_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_total_pass,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carr_total_pass,
           tt_carr_total_pass TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_total_pass WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_total_pass) TYPE tt_carr_total_pass.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rt_carr_total_pass = VALUE #( FOR <carr_flight> IN it_carr_flights
                                  ( carrid = <carr_flight>-carrid
                                    total_passengers = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc( INIT sum = 0
                                                                                FOR <flight> IN <carr_flight>-flights
                                                                                NEXT sum = sum + <flight>-passengers ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carr_flights>).
    <fs_carr_flights>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0400' passengers = 100 ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0401' passengers = 50 ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_flights ASSIGNING <fs_carr_flights>.
    <fs_carr_flights>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0017' passengers = 200 ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_total_pass) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_carr_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_total_pass ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_pass[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_pass[ 1 ]-total_passengers exp = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_pass[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_pass[ 2 ]-total_passengers exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Durch die Verschachtelung in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck kann eine Multi-Level-Aggregation elegant und funktional ausgedrückt werden.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine Liste von Flügen enthalten. Behalten Sie nur Fluggesellschaften, die mindestens einen Flug mit mehr als 150 Passagieren haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer geschachtelten `LINE_EXISTS` Bedingung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_carr_flights,
           tt_carr_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_carr_by_high_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_carr) TYPE tt_carr_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_carr_by_high_passengers.
    rt_filtered_carr = FILTER #( it_carr_flights WHERE LINE_EXISTS( flights[ passengers > 150 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filter_high_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_high_passengers.
    DATA: lt_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carr_flights>).
    <fs_carr_flights>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0400' passengers = 100 ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0401' passengers = 160 ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights. " LH has one high passenger flight

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_flights ASSIGNING <fs_carr_flights>.
    <fs_carr_flights>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0017' passengers = 120 ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights. " AA has no high passenger flight

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_carr_by_high_passengers( lt_carr_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` mit `LINE_EXISTS` und einer Bedingung auf eine geschachtelte Tabelle ermöglicht das Filtern von übergeordneten Einträgen basierend auf Eigenschaften ihrer Untereinträge.
keywords: NESTING, FILTER, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus SFLIGHT alle zugehörigen Verbindungen (CONNID) als Untertabelle enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die Daten zu gruppieren und dann die geschachtelte Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connid_only,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_connid_only,
           tt_connid_only TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connid_only WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_conn_nested,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections TYPE tt_connid_only,
           END OF ty_carr_conn_nested,
           tt_carr_conn_nested TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_conn_nested WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_nested_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_nested_connections
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_conn) TYPE tt_carr_conn_nested.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_connections.
    rt_nested_conn = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN it_sflight GROUP BY <flight>-carrid INTO DATA(carr_group)
                                ( carrid = carr_group-key
                                  connections = VALUE #( FOR <grouped_flight> IN carr_group
                                                          ( connid = <grouped_flight>-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_nested_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lt_nested) = lo_cut->create_nested_connections( lt_sflight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nested ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_nested[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Grouping order might vary, but content should be correct
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nested[ 1 ]-connections ) exp = 1 ).

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine geschachtelte Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle so, dass nur Fluggesellschaften übrig bleiben, die Flüge haben, deren Flugnummer (CONNID) in einer bestimmten RANGE-Tabelle liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf der äußeren Tabelle und `LINE_EXISTS` mit der RANGE-Tabelle auf der inneren Tabelle.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data,

CLASS zcl_range_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_nested_by_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_carr) TYPE tt_carr_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_nested_by_range.
    DATA: lt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    lt_connid_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0400' )
                               ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0017' ) ).

    rt_filtered_carr = FILTER #( it_carr_flights WHERE LINE_EXISTS( flights[ connid IN lt_connid_range ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_by_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_month TYPE sy-datum+4(2)
        iv_year  TYPE sy-datum+0(4)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_date_range.
    DATA: lv_first_day TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_last_day  TYPE sy-datum,
          lt_fldate_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-fldate.

    CONCATENATE iv_year iv_month '01' INTO lv_first_day.
    CALL FUNCTION 'LAST_DAY_OF_MONTHS'
      EXPORTING
        i_day   = lv_first_day
      IMPORTING
        e_date  = lv_last_day.

    lt_fldate_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = lv_first_day high = lv_last_day ) ).

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE rt_sflight WHERE fldate IN lt_fldate_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine geschachtelte Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft einen String enthält, der alle Flugnummern (CONNID) dieser Gesellschaft, durch Komma getrennt, auflistet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `STRING_AGG` (oder String Templates) in einem geschachtelten `FOR` Ausdruck.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_carr_flights,
           tt_carr_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_conn_string,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_string TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carr_conn_string,
           tt_carr_conn_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_conn_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_nested_string_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_connids_to_string
      IMPORTING
        it_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_conn_string) TYPE tt_carr_conn_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_string_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_connids_to_string.
    rt_carr_conn_string = VALUE #( FOR <carr_flight> IN it_carr_flights
                                   ( carrid = <carr_flight>-carrid
                                     connid_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                                                    FOR <flight> IN <carr_flight>-flights
                                                                    NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <flight>-connid
                                                                                         ELSE |{ s },{ <flight>-connid }| ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_aggregate_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_connids.
    DATA: lt_carr_flights TYPE tt_carr_flights.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carr_flights>).
    <fs_carr_flights>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0400' ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0401' ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_carr_flights ASSIGNING <fs_carr_flights>.
    <fs_carr_flights>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data( connid = '0017' ) TO <fs_carr_flights>-flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_string_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_connids_to_string( lt_carr_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid_string exp = '0400,0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid_string exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE` mit String Templates innerhalb eines geschachtelten `FOR`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine effiziente Aggregation von String-Werten aus geschachtelten Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, FOR, String Processing, String Templates, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische RANGE-Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Werten. Anschließend filtern Sie eine geschachtelte Tabelle, wobei die innere Tabelle basierend auf dieser dynamischen RANGE-Tabelle gefiltert wird, und nur die äußeren Einträge behalten werden, die mindestens einen passenden inneren Eintrag haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` für die RANGE-Erstellung, `FILTER` für die äußere Tabelle und `LINE_EXISTS` mit der RANGE für die innere Tabelle.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group,
             group_id TYPE i,
             items TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_group,
           tt_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_groups_by_dynamic_range
      IMPORTING
        it_groups TYPE tt_groups
        it_filter_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_groups) TYPE tt_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_groups_by_dynamic_range.
    DATA: lt_dynamic_range TYPE RANGE OF string.

    lt_dynamic_range = VALUE #( FOR <value> IN it_filter_values
                                ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = <value> ) ).

    rt_filtered_groups = FILTER #( it_groups WHERE LINE_EXISTS( items[ value IN lt_dynamic_range ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_range_nested_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_range_nested_filter.
    DATA: lt_groups TYPE tt_groups,
          lt_filter_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_groups ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
    <fs_group>-group_id = 1.
    APPEND VALUE ty_item( id = 101 value = 'Apple' ) TO <fs_group>-items.
    APPEND VALUE ty_item( id = 102 value = 'Banana' ) TO <fs_group>-items.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_groups ASSIGNING <fs_group>.
    <fs_group>-group_id = 2.
    APPEND VALUE ty_item( id = 201 value = 'Orange' ) TO <fs_group>-items.
    APPEND VALUE ty_item( id = 202 value = 'Grape' ) TO <fs_group>-items.

    APPEND 'Apple' TO lt_filter_values.
    APPEND 'Grape' TO lt_filter_values.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range_nested_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_groups_by_dynamic_range( it_groups = lt_groups it_filter_values = lt_filter_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-group_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-group_id exp = 2 ).

    CLEAR lt_filter_values.
    APPEND 'Banana' TO lt_filter_values.
    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_groups_by_dynamic_range( it_groups = lt_groups it_filter_values = lt_filter_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-group_id exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination aus dynamischer RANGE-Erstellung mittels `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und dem Filtern geschachtelter Tabellen mit `FILTER` und `LINE_EXISTS`. Dies ermöglicht hochflexible und deklarative Datenmanipulationen.
keywords: RANGES, NESTING, VALUE, FOR, FILTER, LINE_EXISTS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie SFLIGHT-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugnummer (CONNID). Für jede Gruppe sollen die Passagierzahlen (SEATSOCC) in einer geschachtelten Tabelle gesammelt werden. Anschließend filtern Sie die Gruppen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an Passagieren in ihrer geschachtelten Tabelle erreichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` für die Gruppierung und `FILTER` mit `REDUCE` für die Filterung der aggregierten Passagierzahlen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_count, seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc, END OF ty_passenger_count, tt_passenger_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_count WITH EMPTY KEY. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, passengers TYPE tt_passenger_count, END OF ty_flight_group, tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_nested_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS group_and_filter_sflight IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight iv_min_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_nested_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD group_and_filter_sflight. DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_groups( FOR GROUPS OF IN it_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = -carrid connid = -connid ) INTO DATA(flight_group) ( carrid = flight_group-key-carrid connid = flight_group-key-connid passengers = VALUE #( FOR IN flight_group ( seatsocc = -seatsocc ) ) ) ). rt_filtered_groups = FILTER #( lt_grouped_flights WHERE REDUCE sflight-seatsocc( INIT sum = 0 FOR

IN passengers NEXT sum = sum +

-seatsocc ) >= iv_min_passengers ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_and_filter FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_group_and_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 80.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_group_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->group_and_filter_sflight( it_sflight = lt_sflight_data iv_min_passengers = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten. Für jede Zeile soll ein neues Feld 'STATUS' hinzugefügt werden, das 'HIGH' ist, wenn die Passagierzahl (SEATSOCC) in einem bestimmten Bereich liegt (z.B. > 100), ansonsten 'LOW'. Der Bereich soll dynamisch über eine RANGE-Tabelle definiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und einer RANGE-Tabelle.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_status,
           tt_sflight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_range_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sflight_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_status) TYPE tt_sflight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflight_with_status.
    DATA: lt_high_passenger_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-seatsocc.

    lt_high_passenger_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'GT' low = iv_min_passengers ) ).

    rt_sflight_status = VALUE #( FOR <flight> IN it_sflight
                                 ( <flight> EXCEPT status
                                   status = COND string( WHEN <flight>-seatsocc IN lt_high_passenger_range THEN 'HIGH'
                                                        ELSE 'LOW' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthält und nur die Felder 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' berücksichtigt.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Simulate data for sflight table
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) 
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) 
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' ) ).

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   connid = flight-connid
                                   fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten effizient, bevor die neuen Zeilen konstruiert werden. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtanzahl der freien Sitze (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'UA' (United Airlines) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE`-Operator, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Simulate data for sflight table
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 100 )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 ) ).

    rv_free_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                              NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats( 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 130
      msg = 'Die Gesamtanzahl der freien Sitze für UA sollte 130 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die gefilterte Tabelle (`FOR flight IN ... WHERE`). In jedem Schritt wird die `NEXT`-Anweisung ausgeführt, um den Wert der Aggregationsvariable zu aktualisieren. Dies ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, FOR

Instructions: Implementiere eine Funktion, die einen gegebenen String um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen zirkulär nach links verschiebt. Beispiel: 'ABCDE' um 2 nach links wird zu 'CDEAB'.
hint: Nutze die `SHIFT ... CIRCULAR LEFT BY ... PLACES`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_shifter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_circular_left
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_places       TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_shifted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_shifter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_circular_left.
    rv_shifted_string = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT rv_shifted_string CIRCULAR LEFT BY iv_places PLACES.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shift_circular_left FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_circular_left.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_shifter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input_string = 'ABCDE' iv_places = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'CDEAB'
      msg = 'Zirkuläre Verschiebung um 2 nach links sollte korrekt sein.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->shift_circular_left( iv_input_string = 'XYZ' iv_places = 1 ).

explanation: Die `SHIFT ... CIRCULAR`-Anweisung ist eine spezialisierte und effiziente Methode, um Zeichenketten zu rotieren. Sie ist besonders nützlich, wenn man eine feste Anzahl von Zeichen vom Anfang zum Ende (oder umgekehrt) verschieben muss, ohne den String zu kürzen oder zu erweitern. Dies ist eine moderne und direkte Art, diese Operation durchzuführen.
keywords: SHIFT, CIRCULAR, String Processing

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Strings, die Materialnummern enthalten können, welche mit führenden Nullen aufgefüllt sind. Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, in der alle führenden Nullen entfernt wurden.
hint: Kombiniere den `FOR`-Operator mit `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_material_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_material_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS clean_material_numbers
      IMPORTING it_raw_materials TYPE tt_material_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_cleaned_materials) TYPE tt_material_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_material_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_material_numbers.
    rt_cleaned_materials = VALUE #( FOR material IN it_raw_materials
                                    LET lv_cleaned_material = material IN
                                    ( SHIFT lv_cleaned_material LEFT DELETING LEADING '0' )
                                    ( lv_cleaned_material ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_material_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_material_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_material_cleaner( ).
    DATA lt_raw_data TYPE zcl_material_cleaner=>tt_material_numbers.
    lt_raw_data = VALUE #( ( '000123' ) ( '456' ) ( '007890' ) ( '0' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->clean_material_numbers( lt_raw_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '123'
      msg = 'Führende Nullen sollten entfernt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = '456'
      msg = 'Keine Änderung bei fehlenden Nullen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = '7890'
      msg = 'Führende Nullen sollten entfernt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[4] exp = ''
      msg = 'Einzelne Null sollte zu leerem String werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hier wird der `FOR`-Operator verwendet, um über die Eingabetabelle zu iterieren. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `LET` genutzt, um eine lokale Variable `lv_cleaned_material` zu deklarieren und zu initialisieren. Die `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'`-Anweisung entfernt dann direkt die führenden Nullen aus dieser Variablen, bevor sie der Ergebnistabelle hinzugefügt wird. Dies ist eine funktionale und effiziente Art der Datenbereinigung.
keywords: FOR, SHIFT, LET, Internal Tables, String Processing, Data Cleaning

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und deren Namen. Füge eine Spalte hinzu, die 'Major Carrier' anzeigt, wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' oder 'UA' ist, ansonsten 'Other Carrier'.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und dem `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_carrier_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_categorized_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_carriers.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    " Simulate data for scarr table
    lt_scarr = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' ) 
                        ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) 
                        ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' ) 
                        ( carrid = 'BA' carrname = 'British Airways' ) ).

    rt_categorized_carriers = VALUE #( FOR carrier IN lt_scarr
                                       ( carrid   = carrier-carrid,
                                         carrname = carrier-carrname,
                                         category = COND string( WHEN carrier-carrid = 'LH' OR carrier-carrid = 'UA' THEN 'Major Carrier'
                                                                ELSE 'Other Carrier' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_categorized_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_categorized_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_carrier_categorizer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_categorized_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-category exp = 'Major Carrier'
      msg = 'LH sollte als Major Carrier kategorisiert werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-category exp = 'Other Carrier'
      msg = 'AA sollte als Other Carrier kategorisiert werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-category exp = 'Major Carrier'
      msg = 'UA sollte als Major Carrier kategorisiert werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE` kann man so neue interne Tabellen mit berechneten Feldern erstellen, ohne explizite `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Strukturen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Gruppiere die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Gib das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator mit der `GROUP BY`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Simulate data for sflight table
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250104' )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250105' ) ).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Gruppen (Fluggesellschaften) gefunden werden.' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 3
      msg = 'LH sollte 3 Flüge haben.' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 1
      msg = 'AA sollte 1 Flug haben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY`-Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion ab ABAP 7.50, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie ermöglicht es, Gruppen zu bilden und Aggregationsfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` direkt im `VALUE`-Operator zu nutzen, was den Code für Gruppierungsaufgaben extrem vereinfacht und lesbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechne für jeden Flug in der Tabelle SFLIGHT die Flugdauer in Minuten, basierend auf der geplanten Abflug- und Ankunftszeit. Füge diese Dauer einer neuen internen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator mit `LET` für Zwischenberechnungen und die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für Zeitstempelberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             duration_minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_durations
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_durations) TYPE tt_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_durations.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Simulate data for sflight table
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' deptime = '100000' arrtime = '123000' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' deptime = '080000' arrtime = '090000' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' deptime = '140000' arrtime = '180000' ) ).

    rt_flight_durations = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                   LET lv_dep_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = flight-fldate iv_time = flight-deptime )
                                       lv_arr_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = flight-fldate iv_time = flight-arrtime )
                                       lv_diff_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_tstmp( iv_tstmp1 = lv_arr_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_dep_tstmp ) IN
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fldate = flight-fldate,
                                     duration_minutes = lv_diff_seconds / 60 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_durations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_durations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_duration( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_durations( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-duration_minutes exp = 150
      msg = 'Flug LH 0400 sollte 150 Minuten dauern.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-duration_minutes exp = 60
      msg = 'Flug AA 0017 sollte 60 Minuten dauern.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-duration_minutes exp = 240
      msg = 'Flug LH 0401 sollte 240 Minuten dauern.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Ausdruck innerhalb eines `FOR`-Operators ermöglicht die Deklaration lokaler Hilfsvariablen, die nur innerhalb des Ausdrucks gültig sind. Dies ist ideal für Zwischenberechnungen wie die Umwandlung von Datum und Uhrzeit in Zeitstempel und deren Subtraktion, um die Flugdauer zu ermitteln. Der Code bleibt so kompakt und die Logik ist direkt im `VALUE`-Operator enthalten.
keywords: FOR, LET, VALUE, Internal Tables, Date/Time, CL_ABAP_TSTMP

Instructions: Formatiere eine Liste von numerischen Strings so, dass jeder String rechtsbündig in einem Feld von 10 Zeichen steht und mit Leerzeichen aufgefüllt wird.
hint: Nutze `SHIFT RIGHT BY ... PLACES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numeric_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_right_aligned
      IMPORTING it_input_strings TYPE tt_numeric_strings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE tt_numeric_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_right_aligned.
    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE #( FOR input_string IN it_input_strings
                                    LET lv_formatted = input_string IN
                                    ( SHIFT lv_formatted RIGHT BY 10 - strlen( lv_formatted ) PLACES )
                                    ( lv_formatted ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_right_aligned FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_right_aligned.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_formatter( ).
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_string_formatter=>tt_numeric_strings.
    lt_input = VALUE #( ( '123' ) ( '1234567890' ) ( '5' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->format_right_aligned( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '       123'
      msg = 'String sollte rechtsbündig mit Leerzeichen aufgefüllt sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = '1234567890'
      msg = 'String sollte unverändert bleiben, wenn er die Länge erreicht.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = '         5'
      msg = 'Einzelne Ziffer sollte korrekt formatiert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SHIFT RIGHT BY ... PLACES`-Anweisung verschiebt den Inhalt eines Strings nach rechts und füllt die entstehenden Leerstellen am Anfang mit Leerzeichen auf. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `LET` kann dies elegant für die Formatierung von Listen von Strings verwendet werden, um eine einheitliche rechtsbündige Ausrichtung zu erzielen.
keywords: SHIFT, FOR, String Formatting, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Dateinamen (Strings), die alle eine feste Länge von 12 Zeichen haben. Entferne die letzten 4 Zeichen (angenommen, es ist die Erweiterung '.txt') und fülle den Rest des Namens mit Leerzeichen auf, um die ursprüngliche Länge beizubehalten.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator und `SHIFT LEFT BY ... PLACES` mit `FILLING SPACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filename_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_filenames TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_extension_and_shift
      IMPORTING it_raw_filenames TYPE tt_filenames
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_filenames) TYPE tt_filenames.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filename_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_extension_and_shift.
    rt_processed_filenames = VALUE #( FOR filename IN it_raw_filenames
                                      LET lv_temp_filename = filename IN
                                      ( SHIFT lv_temp_filename LEFT BY 8 PLACES FILLING SPACE )
                                      ( lv_temp_filename ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_extension FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_extension.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filename_processor( ).
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_filename_processor=>tt_filenames.
    lt_input = VALUE #( ( 'REPORT01.TXT' ) ( 'IMAGE001.JPG' ) ( 'DATAFILE.TXT' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_extension_and_shift( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'REPORT01    '
      msg = 'Erweiterung .TXT sollte entfernt und mit Leerzeichen aufgefüllt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'IMAGE001    '
      msg = 'Auch bei .JPG sollte die Verschiebung erfolgen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'DATAFILE    '
      msg = 'Weiteres Beispiel sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt `FOR` und `LET` zur Iteration und temporären Variablenzuweisung. `SHIFT LEFT BY 8 PLACES FILLING SPACE` verschiebt den String um 8 Zeichen nach links und füllt die letzten 4 Zeichen mit Leerzeichen auf. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um feste String-Formate zu manipulieren, wenn die Länge bekannt ist und eine Auffüllung erforderlich ist.
keywords: SHIFT, FOR, String Processing, Internal Tables, FILLING SPACE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge anzuzeigen, die eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität von über 200 Plätzen haben und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist.
hint: Nutze den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Simulate data for sflight table
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 250 )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 300 )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 180 )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' seatsmax = 220 )
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' seatsmax = 280 ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_large_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_large_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_large_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge gefunden werden, die LH sind und > 200 Sitze haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Der erste gefilterte Flug sollte 0400 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-connid exp = '0402'
      msg = 'Der zweite gefilterte Flug sollte 0402 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die den angegebenen Kriterien entsprechen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als eine explizite Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Entferne alle Leerzeichen am Ende eines Strings und verschiebe den verbleibenden Inhalt nach links, um den String zu kürzen.

  METHOD get_even_sq_connids.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie ein gegebenes XML-Dokument auf das Vorhandensein eines `<Signature>`-Elements, das auf eine digitale Signatur hindeutet. Dies ist eine konzeptionelle Demonstration der Nutzung von `cl_secxml_helper` für Sicherheitsprüfungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_secxml_helper` (konzeptionell) und `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secxml_check_signature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_for_signature_element IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_has_signature) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secxml_check_signature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_signature_element.
    " Konzeptionelle Nutzung von cl_secxml_helper für Sicherheitsprüfungen.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde cl_secxml_helper spezifische Methoden zur Signaturprüfung bereitstellen.
    " Hier simulieren wir eine solche Prüfung durch XML-Parsing.
    DATA(lo_sec_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ). " Instanziierung zur Demonstration

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Signature' ).
        IF lo_node_list IS NOT INITIAL AND lo_node_list->get_length( ) > 0.
          rv_has_signature = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_has_signature = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung bei ungültigem XML
        MESSAGE lx_parse_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_has_signature = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_for_signature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_for_signature.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_secxml_check_signature( ).

    " Testfall 1: XML mit Signatur-Element
    DATA(lv_xml_with_signature) = |<Root><Data>Some data</Data><Signature><SignedInfo/></Signature></Root>|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_for_signature_element( lv_xml_with_signature ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Should detect signature' ).

    " Testfall 2: XML ohne Signatur-Element
    DATA(lv_xml_without_signature) = |<Root><Data>Some data</Data></Root>|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_for_signature_element( lv_xml_without_signature ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Should not detect signature' ).

    " Testfall 3: Ungültiges XML
    DATA(lv_invalid_xml) = |<Root><Data>Some data</Data>|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_for_signature_element( lv_invalid_xml ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Should handle invalid XML' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert konzeptionell die Nutzung von `cl_secxml_helper` in Verbindung mit `cl_xml_document` zur Überprüfung von XML-Dokumenten auf sicherheitsrelevante Elemente. Die Instanziierung von `cl_secxml_helper` zeigt die beabsichtigte Verwendung, während die eigentliche Logik zur Elementprüfung mit `cl_xml_document` implementiert ist, da die spezifischen Methoden von `cl_secxml_helper` nicht öffentlich dokumentiert sind. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` und `TRY...CATCH` ist modern.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle URI-Attribute aus `<SignatureReference>`-Elementen in einem XML-Dokument, um potenzielle externe Referenzen in einem Sicherheitskontext zu identifizieren. Nutzen Sie `cl_secxml_helper` (konzeptionell) und moderne ABAP-XML-Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_secxml_helper` (konzeptionell), `cl_xml_document` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secxml_extract_uris DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_signature_uris IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_uris) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secxml_extract_uris IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_signature_uris.
    " Konzeptionelle Nutzung von cl_secxml_helper zur Analyse von Sicherheitsreferenzen.
    DATA(lo_sec_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ). " Instanziierung zur Demonstration

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'SignatureReference' ).

        IF lo_node_list IS NOT INITIAL.
          rt_uris = VALUE string_table( FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= lo_node_list->get_length( )
                                        LET lo_node = lo_node_list->get_item( i ) IN
                                        ( lo_node->get_attribute( 'URI' ) ) ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        MESSAGE lx_parse_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein XML-Dokument ein bestimmtes Attribut in einem sicherheitsrelevanten Element (z.B. `Algorithm` in `<EncryptionMethod>`) enthält. Nutzen Sie `cl_secxml_helper` (konzeptionell) und moderne ABAP-XML-Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_secxml_helper` (konzeptionell), `cl_xml_document` und `COND` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secxml_check_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_encryption_algorithm IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string iv_algorithm TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_present) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secxml_check_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_encryption_algorithm.
    " Konzeptionelle Nutzung von cl_secxml_helper zur Validierung von Sicherheitsattributen.
    DATA(lo_sec_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ). " Instanziierung zur Demonstration

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'EncryptionMethod' ).

        rv_is_present = abap_false.
        IF lo_node_list IS NOT INITIAL.
          LOOP AT lo_node_list->get_list( ) INTO DATA(lo_node).
            IF lo_node->get_attribute( 'Algorithm' ) = iv_algorithm.
              rv_is_present = abap_true.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        MESSAGE lx_parse_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_is_present = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_algorithm FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_algorithm.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_secxml_check_attribute( ).

    DATA(lv_xml) = |<Root>
  <EncryptedData>
    <EncryptionMethod Algorithm="AES256"/>
  </EncryptedData>
  <EncryptedData>
    <EncryptionMethod Algorithm="RSA15"/>
  </EncryptedData>
</Root>|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_encryption_algorithm( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_algorithm = 'AES256' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Should find AES256' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_encryption_algorithm( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_algorithm = 'RSA15' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Should find RSA15' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_encryption_algorithm( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_algorithm = 'DES' ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Should not find DES' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_no_method) = |<Root><EncryptedData/></Root>|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_encryption_algorithm( iv_xml_string = lv_xml_no_method iv_algorithm = 'AES256' ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Should not find algorithm in empty EncryptionMethod' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Überprüfung eines spezifischen Attributwerts in einem XML-Element, das für Sicherheitszwecke relevant ist. Die Verwendung von `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen und einer `LOOP` über die gefundenen Knoten ist eine gängige Methode. Die Instanziierung von `cl_secxml_helper` dient der Kontextualisierung der Aufgabe als Sicherheitsprüfung. Die moderne Syntax mit `DATA(...)` und `TRY...CATCH` wird verwendet.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie einen GOS-Objektschlüssel basierend auf einer Flugnummer aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Wenn die Flugnummer nicht gefunden wird, verwenden Sie einen Standardwert. Nutzen Sie eine `VALUE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung oder `COND` um den Objektschlüssel zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_object_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_gos_object_key
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_key) TYPE gos_objid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_object_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_gos_object_key.
    DATA(lv_default_key) = 'DEFAULT_FLIGHT_KEY'.
    DATA(lv_found_key) = ''.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_found_key = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ ls_sflight-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_object_key = VALUE gos_objid(
                          COND #( WHEN lv_found_key IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_found_key ELSE lv_default_key )
                        ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_visibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_allowed_users TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-uname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_gos_visible
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_user TYPE sy-uname
        it_allowed_users TYPE tt_allowed_users
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_visible) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS set_gos_visibility
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_user TYPE sy-uname
        it_allowed_users TYPE tt_allowed_users
        io_gos_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_gos_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_visibility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_gos_visible.
    DATA(lt_filtered_users) = FILTER tt_allowed_users( it_allowed_users WHERE table_line = iv_current_user ).
    IF lines( lt_filtered_users ) > 0.
      rv_is_visible = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_visible = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_gos_visibility.
    IF io_gos_container IS INITIAL.
      rv_message = 'GOS Container not initialized.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF is_gos_visible( iv_current_user = iv_current_user it_allowed_users = it_allowed_users ) = abap_true.
      " io_gos_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
      rv_message = |GOS Container would be visible for user '{ iv_current_user }'.|.
    ELSE.
      " io_gos_container->set_visible( abap_false ).
      rv_message = |GOS Container would be hidden for user '{ iv_current_user }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Kontextmenü-Einträgen für den GOS-Container. Fügen Sie einen speziellen Eintrag nur hinzu, wenn der Benutzer eine bestimmte Berechtigung hat. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für den Aufbau der Menütabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und einer `IF`-Bedingung innerhalb des `NEXT` Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_menu_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_menu_item,
             function TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_menu_item,
           tt_menu_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_menu_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_context_menu
      IMPORTING
        iv_has_special_auth TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_menu_items) TYPE tt_menu_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_menu_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_context_menu.
    rt_menu_items = REDUCE tt_menu_items(
                                INIT menu_items = VALUE tt_menu_items(
                                  ( function = 'SHOW_ATTACHMENTS' text = 'Anlagen anzeigen' )
                                  ( function = 'CREATE_NOTE' text = 'Notiz erstellen' )
                                )
                                FOR lv_dummy = 1 THEN 1 WHILE lv_dummy = 1 " Loop once for conditional add
                                  NEXT menu_items = COND #( 
                                                        WHEN iv_has_special_auth = abap_true
                                                        THEN VALUE tt_menu_items( BASE menu_items ( function = 'SPECIAL_ACTION' text = 'Spezialaktion' ) )
                                                        ELSE menu_items
                                                      )
                              ).
    " In a real GOS scenario, you would then pass this table to a method like:
    " lo_gos_container->set_context_menu( it_menu_items = rt_menu_items ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Check that SPECIAL_ACTION is not present

CLASS zcl_gos_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_gos_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_gos_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        " Simulate an error by passing an invalid container name or other parameters
        " In a real scenario, the error might come from invalid screen elements etc.
        DATA(lo_gos_container) = NEW cl_gui_gos_container(
                                     i_repid = sy-repid
                                     i_dynnr = sy-dynnr
                                     i_container_name = iv_container_name
                                     i_object_type = 'BUS1001'
                                     i_object_key = '0000000001'
                                   ).
        rv_message = 'GOS Container successfully created.'.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        " Check if the exception is specifically about the container name
        IF lx_create_error->get_text( ) CS 'Container'. " Simplified check
          rv_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des GOS-Containers: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Allgemeiner Fehler beim Erstellen: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_gos_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_gos_container.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_gos_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = sy-dynnr.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'GOS_DYNAMIC_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS1001'.
    DATA(lv_object_key) = '0000000001'.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_gos_container TYPE (iv_class_name)
          EXPORTING
            i_repid = lv_repid
            i_dynnr = lv_dynnr
            i_container_name = lv_container_name
            i_object_type = lv_object_type
            i_object_key = lv_object_key.

        IF ro_gos_container IS BOUND.
          " Object created successfully
        ELSE.
          " This branch might be reached if CREATE OBJECT doesn't raise an exception
          " but fails to assign for other reasons (e.g., class not compatible)
          CLEAR ro_gos_container.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        " Handle creation error, e.g., class not found or constructor error
        CLEAR ro_gos_container.
        " In a real app, you'd log this or raise a custom exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie `SFLIGHTS`-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe, ob Flüge für die GOS-Verarbeitung relevant sind (z.B. wenn mindestens ein Flug nicht storniert ist). Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und prüfen Sie innerhalb der Gruppe mit `IF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cancelled TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             has_active_flights TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_grouped_result,
           tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_gos_relevant_airlines
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_gos_relevant_airlines.
    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = it_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_temp_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_has_active) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        IF ls_grouped_flight-cancelled = abap_false.
          lv_has_active = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        has_active_flights = lv_has_active
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie einen GOS Container für einen Flugdatensatz aus `sflights`. Aktualisieren Sie anschließend einen Status in der benutzerdefinierten Tabelle `ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS` auf 'GOS_INIT', um anzuzeigen, dass GOS-Dienste für diesen Datensatz vorbereitet wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen und den `VALUE`-Operator für die Struktur des `ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS`-Eintrags. Die GOS-Initialisierung wird hier simuliert, da `cl_gui_gos_container` ein UI-Element ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_example_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS update_gos_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_a_table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_example_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_gos_status.
    " Simulate GOS container initialization (cl_gui_gos_container is a UI element)
    " In a real scenario, this would involve screen logic.
    " For demonstration, we assume GOS setup is successful.
    DATA(lv_gos_initialized) = abap_true.

    IF lv_gos_initialized = abap_true.
      " Assume ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS is a custom transparent table
      " with fields CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE (keys) and GOS_STATUS.
      " In a real system, this table would need to be created.
      UPDATE zflight_gos_status SET gos_status = 'GOS_INIT'
        WHERE carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
          AND connid = is_flight_key-connid
          AND fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " If update fails (record not found), try to insert
        INSERT zflight_gos_status FROM @( VALUE #( 
          carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
          connid = is_flight_key-connid
          fldate = is_flight_key-fldate
          gos_status = 'GOS_INIT'
        ) ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_a_table_line
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Flight GOS status record could not be created or updated'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    DATA: ms_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key.

    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_update_gos_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_gos_status_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    ms_flight_key = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251124' ).
    " Ensure the custom table ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS exists in the test environment.
    " For a real test, you might need to create a test double or mock the DB.
    " Here, we assume it exists.
    DELETE FROM zflight_gos_status WHERE carrid = ms_flight_key-carrid
                                    AND connid = ms_flight_key-connid
                                    AND fldate = ms_flight_key-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM zflight_gos_status WHERE carrid = ms_flight_key-carrid
                                    AND connid = ms_flight_key-connid
                                    AND fldate = ms_flight_key-fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_gos_status.
    " First, insert a record to test the UPDATE path
    INSERT zflight_gos_status FROM @( VALUE #( 
      carrid = ms_flight_key-carrid
      connid = ms_flight_key-connid
      fldate = ms_flight_key-fldate
      gos_status = 'OLD_STATUS'
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_example_001( ).
    lo_cut->update_gos_status( is_flight_key = ms_flight_key ).

    " Verify the update
    SELECT SINGLE gos_status FROM zflight_gos_status INTO @DATA(lv_status)
      WHERE carrid = ms_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = ms_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = ms_flight_key-fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'GOS_INIT'
      msg = 'GOS_STATUS should be updated to GOS_INIT'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_gos_status_insert.
    " Test the INSERT path (no prior record)

hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal, um eine Liste von Notizen zu einem einzigen String zu aggregieren. String-Templates verbessern die Lesbarkeit der Verkettung.

CLASS zcl_gos_example_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_notes_summary.
    " Simulate retrieving GOS notes.
    " In a real scenario, you would use CL_GOS_MANAGER or CL_GOS_SRV_NOTE.
    " For this example, we'll provide dummy notes.
    DATA(lt_notes) = VALUE tt_gos_notes(
      ( text = 'Erste Notiz zum Flug.' )
      ( text = 'Zweite Notiz mit wichtigen Details.' )
      ( text = 'Dritte Notiz.' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_notes_summary) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <note> IN lt_notes
      NEXT s = |
{ s }{ <note>-text }|
    ).

    " Remove leading newline if present
    IF lv_notes_summary IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_notes_summary(1) = |
|.
      lv_notes_summary = lv_notes_summary+1.
    ENDIF.

    " Assume ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS has a field GOS_NOTES_SUMMARY (type STRING)
    UPDATE zflight_gos_status SET gos_notes_summary = @lv_notes_summary
      WHERE carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT zflight_gos_status FROM @( VALUE #( 
        carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
        connid = is_flight_key-connid
        fldate = is_flight_key-fldate
        gos_notes_summary = lv_notes_summary
      ) ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_a_table_line
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Flight GOS status record could not be created or updated'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Nutzen Sie hierfür den `CASE TYPE OF`-Ausdruck.
hint: Der `CASE TYPE OF`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die typsichere Behandlung von Objekten zur Laufzeit. Die GOS-Objekterstellung wird hier abstrahiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_example_005 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS update_status_by_gos_type
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        iv_gos_type   TYPE string " 'NOTE' or 'ATTACHMENT'
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_a_table_line
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

CLASS zcl_gos_example_005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_by_gos_type.
    DATA: lo_gos_service TYPE REF TO object,
          lv_new_status  TYPE string.

    " Simulate dynamic GOS service creation
    CASE iv_gos_type.
      WHEN 'NOTE'.
        " In a real scenario: lo_gos_service = NEW cl_gos_srv_note( ).
        CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_service TYPE cl_gos_srv_note.
        lv_new_status = 'NOTE_CREATED'.
      WHEN 'ATTACHMENT'.
        " In a real scenario: lo_gos_service = NEW cl_gos_srv_attachment( ).
        CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_service TYPE cl_gos_srv_attachment.
        lv_new_status = 'ATT_CREATED'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Unsupported GOS type provided'.
    ENDCASE.

    " Use CASE TYPE OF to demonstrate type-specific logic (here, just for status)
    CASE TYPE OF lo_gos_service.
      WHEN TYPE cl_gos_srv_note.
        lv_new_status = lv_new_status && '_VIA_NOTE_SERVICE'.
      WHEN TYPE cl_gos_srv_attachment.
        lv_new_status = lv_new_status && '_VIA_ATT_SERVICE'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_new_status = 'UNKNOWN_GOS_SERVICE'.
    ENDCASE.

    " Assume ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS has a field GOS_STATUS (type CHAR 10)
    UPDATE zflight_gos_status SET gos_status = @lv_new_status
      WHERE carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT zflight_gos_status FROM @( VALUE #( 
        carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
        connid = is_flight_key-connid
        fldate = is_flight_key-fldate
        gos_status = lv_new_status
      ) ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_a_table_line
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Flight GOS status record could not be created or updated'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_example_006 IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_gos_example_008 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_note_subject.
    " Simulate retrieving attributes for a GOS note.
    " In a real scenario, you would use GOS APIs to get attributes.
    DATA(lt_note_attributes) = VALUE tt_gos_attributes(
      ( name = 'CREATED_BY' value = 'USER123' )
      ( name = 'SUBJECT' value = 'Wichtige Flugdetails' )
      ( name = 'CATEGORY' value = 'INFO' )
    ).

    " Functionally extract the 'SUBJECT' attribute
    DATA(lv_note_subject) = VALUE string(
      FOR <attr> IN lt_note_attributes WHERE ( name = 'SUBJECT' )
      ( <attr>-value )
    ).

    " Assume ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS has a field GOS_LAST_NOTE_SUBJECT (type STRING)
    UPDATE zflight_gos_status SET gos_last_note_subject = @lv_note_subject
      WHERE carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT zflight_gos_status FROM @( VALUE #( 
        carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
        connid = is_flight_key-connid
        fldate = is_flight_key-fldate
        gos_last_note_subject = lv_note_subject
      ) ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_a_table_line

solution:

CLASS zcl_gos_example_009 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_after_gos_delete.
    " Simulate deletion of a GOS object.
    " In a real scenario, you would use CL_GOS_MANAGER->DELETE_OBJECT or similar.
    " For this example, we just assume deletion was successful.
    DATA(lv_gos_deleted) = abap_true.

    IF lv_gos_deleted = abap_true.
      " Assume ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS has a field GOS_STATUS (type CHAR 10)
      UPDATE zflight_gos_status SET gos_status = 'GOS_CLEANED'
        WHERE carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
          AND connid = is_flight_key-connid
          AND fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " If update fails (record not found), try to insert
        INSERT zflight_gos_status FROM @( VALUE #( 
          carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
          connid = is_flight_key-connid
          fldate = is_flight_key-fldate
          gos_status = 'GOS_CLEANED'
        ) ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_a_table_line
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Flight GOS status record could not be created or updated'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
