        AND action = 'UPDATED'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc
      msg = 'Log entry should be found'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_log-change_date
      exp = sy-datum
      msg = 'Log entry date should be current date'
    ).

    " Verify status update
    SELECT SINGLE gos_last_change_date FROM zflight_gos_status INTO @DATA(lv_last_change_date)
      WHERE carrid = ms_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = ms_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = ms_flight_key-fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_last_change_date
      exp = sy-datum
      msg = 'GOS_LAST_CHANGE_DATE should be updated to current date'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Protokollierung von GOS-Änderungen in einer separaten Datenbanktabelle (`ZFLIGHT_GOS_LOG`) mittels `INSERT` und die anschließende Aktualisierung eines Zeitstempels (`GOS_LAST_CHANGE_DATE`) in der Hauptstatus-Tabelle `ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS` mittels `UPDATE`. Die Verwendung von `sy-datum` und `sy-uzeit` für aktuelle Zeitstempel ist Standard. Der `VALUE`-Operator wird für die kompakte Erstellung der Log-Struktur verwendet. Die GOS-Änderung wird hier simuliert.
keywords: cl_gui_gos_container, UPDATE, INSERT, sy-datum, Logging, ZFLIGHT_GOS_STATUS, ZFLIGHT_GOS_LOG

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine CDS View, die Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT filtert und aggregiert, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Monat anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP SQL Syntax, um diese View abzufragen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine CDS View mit Aggregationsfunktionen und `GROUP BY`. Fragen Sie die View mit `SELECT FROM @cds_view` ab.

@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZCDS_FLIGHT_AGGR'
@AbapCatalog.compiler.compareWithVersion: '750'
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Flight Aggregation'
define view ZCDS_FLIGHT_AGGR as select from sflight {
  key carrid,
  key substring( fldate, 1, 6 ) as flight_month,
  count( * ) as number_of_flights
} group by carrid, substring( fldate, 1, 6 );

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_month    TYPE char6,
             number_of_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cds_flight_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT FROM zcds_flight_aggr
      FIELDS carrid, flight_month, number_of_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT und filtern Sie diese nach Flügen, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen, unter Verwendung einer modernen Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_to_ny RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_to_ny.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_ny_flights) = lo_filter->get_flights_to_ny( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT contains at least one flight to NEW YORK for a meaningful test
    IF lines( lt_ny_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_ny_flights msg = 'Filtered table should not be empty' ).
      LOOP AT lt_ny_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'Cityto is not NEW YORK' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      " If no data for 'NEW YORK' exists, assert it's empty.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_ny_flights msg = 'Filtered table should be empty if no flights to NY' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen ist eine prägnante und performante Möglichkeit, Einträge basierend auf Bedingungen zu selektieren. In Kombination mit `SELECT INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` wird der Code sehr lesbar und modern.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, SELECT, SFLIGHT, Data Declaration

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `LOOP AT ... INTO ... SUM` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lv_total_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.

    SELECT price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE p DECIMALS 2( 0 ) )
                                  FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
      lv_count = lines( lt_flights ).
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_calculator->get_average_price( 'LH' ).

    " This test assumes 'LH' has flights in SFLIGHT with prices.
    " For a robust test, ensure test data exists or mock the SELECT.
    IF lv_avg_price > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = 0 msg = 'Average price should not be zero' ).
      " Further assertions could check a specific expected average if test data is controlled.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = 0 msg = 'Average price should be zero if no flights found' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist eine leistungsstarke funktionale Methode, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Schleife mit Akkumulation durchgeführt wird. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` Anweisungen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory-Pattern, um verschiedene Flugzeugtypen (Passagier, Fracht) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zu erzeugen. Nutzen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse und eine Factory-Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie die zuvor erstellte abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_aircraft` und erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen der konkreten Unterklassen zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_aircraft_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aircraft_data,
             type        TYPE string,
             max_speed   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aircraft_data.

    CLASS-METHODS create_aircraft
      IMPORTING
        is_aircraft_data TYPE ty_aircraft_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_aircraft) TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_aircraft
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aircraft_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_aircraft.
    CASE is_aircraft_data-type.
      WHEN 'PASSENGER'.
        ro_aircraft = NEW zcl_passenger_aircraft( is_aircraft_data-max_speed ).
      WHEN 'CARGO'.
        ro_aircraft = NEW zcl_cargo_aircraft( is_aircraft_data-max_speed ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Flugzeugtyp: { is_aircraft_data-type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_pattern FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_invalid_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_pattern.
    DATA: ls_passenger_data TYPE zcl_aircraft_factory=>ty_aircraft_data,
          ls_cargo_data     TYPE zcl_aircraft_factory=>ty_aircraft_data.

    ls_passenger_data-type = 'PASSENGER'.
    ls_passenger_data-max_speed = 950.
    DATA(lo_passenger) = zcl_aircraft_factory=>create_aircraft( ls_passenger_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_passenger->get_type( ) exp = 'Passagierflugzeug' msg = 'Factory created wrong passenger type' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_passenger->get_max_speed( ) exp = 950 msg = 'Factory created passenger with wrong speed' ).

    ls_cargo_data-type = 'CARGO'.
    ls_cargo_data-max_speed = 850.
    DATA(lo_cargo) = zcl_aircraft_factory=>create_aircraft( ls_cargo_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cargo->get_type( ) exp = 'Frachtflugzeug' msg = 'Factory created wrong cargo type' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cargo->get_max_speed( ) exp = 850 msg = 'Factory created cargo with wrong speed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_invalid_type.
    DATA ls_invalid_data TYPE zcl_aircraft_factory=>ty_aircraft_data.
    ls_invalid_data-type = 'GLIDER'.
    ls_invalid_data-max_speed = 100.

    TRY.
        zcl_aircraft_factory=>create_aircraft( ls_invalid_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid aircraft type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for invalid aircraft type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Pattern kapselt die Objekterzeugung und ermöglicht es, die konkrete Klasse zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes, da die Client-Klasse nicht direkt von den konkreten Implementierungen abhängt. `CLASS-METHODS` und `NEW` sind hierbei zentrale Elemente.
keywords: Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Polymorphism, NEW

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einer Eingabe, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck für eine prägnante Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_flight_status TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_flight_status,
                 on_time   TYPE ty_flight_status VALUE 'A',
                 delayed   TYPE ty_flight_status VALUE 'B',
                 cancelled TYPE ty_flight_status VALUE 'C',
               END OF gc_flight_status.

    METHODS get_status_text IMPORTING iv_status TYPE ty_flight_status
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_status
      WHEN gc_flight_status-on_time    THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN gc_flight_status-delayed    THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN gc_flight_status-cancelled THEN 'Abgesagt'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status_texts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status_texts.
    DATA(lo_status_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_checker->get_status_text( zcl_flight_status=>gc_flight_status-on_time ) exp = 'Pünktlich' msg = 'Status On Time incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_checker->get_status_text( zcl_flight_status=>gc_flight_status-delayed ) exp = 'Verspätet' msg = 'Status Delayed incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_checker->get_status_text( zcl_flight_status=>gc_flight_status-cancelled ) exp = 'Abgesagt' msg = 'Status Cancelled incorrect' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Nutzen Sie Field-Symbols oder Data References.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field-symbol>` oder `GET REFERENCE OF ... INTO data_reference`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_field_value IMPORTING is_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info
                                      iv_field_name  TYPE string
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight_info TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_read.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_dynamic_read=>ty_flight_info.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
    ls_flight-cityto = 'NEW YORK'.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_reader->get_field_value( is_flight_info = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Dynamic read of CARRID incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_cityto) = lo_reader->get_field_value( is_flight_info = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CITYTO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'Dynamic read of CITYTO incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_field_not_found.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_dynamic_read=>ty_flight_info.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_field) = lo_reader->get_field_value( is_flight_info = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_invalid_field exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' msg = 'Dynamic read of non-existent field incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Field-Symbols (`<fs>`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` sind mächtige Werkzeuge für die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen den Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur oder Tabelle, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck für interne Tabellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit dem `GROUP` Schlüsselwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             number_of_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                       number_of_flights = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_itab_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_grouper->get_flights_by_carrier( ).

    " This test assumes SFLIGHT has data. For a robust test, ensure test data exists.
    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'Grouped table should not be empty' ).
      " Example: Check if 'LH' has at least one flight
      READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-number_of_flights exp = 0 msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'Grouped table should be empty if no flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Er ersetzt die Notwendigkeit manueller Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und führt zu deutlich lesbarerem Code.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit den Typ eines beliebigen Objekts und geben Sie dessen Klassennamen zurück. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` oder `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_class_name IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_class_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_name.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        rv_class_name = lo_class_descr->get_name( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_class_name = 'Kein Objekt oder Fehler beim Cast'.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_type_error.
        rv_class_name = 'Dynamischer Typfehler'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_class_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rtti_null_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_class_name.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ). " Using itself as a test object
    DATA(lv_class_name) = lo_analyzer->get_class_name( lo_test_object ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_class_name exp = 'ZCL_RTTI_ANALYZER' msg = 'RTTI class name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rtti_null_object.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA lo_null_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = lo_analyzer->get_class_name( lo_null_object ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_class_name exp = 'Kein Objekt oder Fehler beim Cast' msg = 'RTTI for null object incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Informationen über Datentypen und Objekte zur Laufzeit zu erhalten. Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` sind die zentralen Werkzeuge dafür und bieten eine robuste Möglichkeit, dynamische Typanalysen durchzuführen.
keywords: RTTI, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme und werfen Sie diese, wenn ein ungültiger Fluggesellschaftscode übergeben wird. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und behandeln Sie sie.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` und `TRY ... CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL.

    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                             RAISING zcx_invalid_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_carrier.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM scarr INTO @DATA(lv_carrid_db) WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_invalid_carrier( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_carrier FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_carrier.
    METHODS test_invalid_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_carrier.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    lo_validator->validate_carrier( 'LH' ). " Assuming LH is a valid carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Valid carrier did not raise exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_carrier.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_validator->validate_carrier( 'XX' ). " Assuming XX is an invalid carrier
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid carrier' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_carrier INTO DATA(lx_invalid_carrier).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_invalid_carrier->mv_carrid exp = 'XX' msg = 'Caught exception with wrong carrier ID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught custom exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Benutzerdefinierte Ausnahmen, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erben, ermöglichen eine typsichere und strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung. Das `RAISING` Schlüsselwort in der Methodendefinition und die `TRY ... CATCH` Blöcke sind der moderne Weg, um Fehler zu signalisieren und darauf zu reagieren, was die Robustheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: Exceptions, Error Handling, CX_STATIC_CHECK, RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Städtenamen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die mit 'S' beginnen, zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Nutzen Sie funktionale Operatoren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` mit String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_cities_starting_with_s RETURNING VALUE(rv_cities) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_cities_starting_with_s.
    DATA lt_all_cities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_cityname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT DISTINCT cityfrom AS cityname FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_cityfrom).
    SELECT DISTINCT cityto AS cityname FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_cityto).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_cityfrom TO lt_all_cities.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_cityto TO lt_all_cities.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_cities.

    DATA(lt_filtered_cities) = FILTER #( lt_all_cities WHERE table_line CS 'S*' ).

    IF lt_filtered_cities IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_cities = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``
        FOR city IN lt_filtered_cities
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE |{ s }, { city }| ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_cities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_cities.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_functional_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->concatenate_cities_starting_with_s( ).

    " This test assumes SFLIGHT contains cities starting with 'S' (e.g., 'SAN FRANCISCO', 'SYDNEY').
    " Adjust expected value based on actual SFLIGHT data or mock it.
    IF lv_result IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Result string should not be empty' ).
      " Example check: if 'STUTTGART' is expected
      " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'STUTTGART' in_string = lv_result msg = 'Result should contain STUTTGART' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Result string should be empty if no matching cities' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Programmieransätze in ABAP. `FILTER` selektiert die relevanten Daten, und `REDUCE` aggregiert sie prägnant zu einem einzigen Ergebnisstring. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: Functional Programming, FILTER, REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE` zur Bestimmung der 'Temperatur' von Daten (heiß, warm, kalt) basierend auf einem fiktiven Zugriffsdatum. Da `CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE` eine interne Klasse ist, wird hier ein Konzept demonstriert, das die Logik nachbildet.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die Logik für die Datenalterung implementiert. Nutzen Sie Datumsberechnungen und `COND` für die Statusbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_concept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_temperature,
             access_date TYPE sy-datum,
             temperature TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_temperature.

    METHODS get_data_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_access_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_temperature) TYPE ty_data_temperature.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_hot_threshold  TYPE i VALUE 30,  " Data accessed within 30 days is 'HOT'
               gc_warm_threshold TYPE i VALUE 180. " Data accessed within 180 days is 'WARM'
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_concept IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_temperature.
    DATA(lv_days_since_access) = sy-datum - iv_access_date.

    rs_temperature-access_date = iv_access_date.
    rs_temperature-temperature = COND string(
      WHEN lv_days_since_access <= gc_hot_threshold  THEN 'HOT'
      WHEN lv_days_since_access <= gc_warm_threshold THEN 'WARM'
      ELSE 'COLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_temperature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_temperature.
    DATA(lo_aging_concept) = NEW zcl_data_aging_concept( ).
    DATA ls_result TYPE zcl_data_aging_concept=>ty_data_temperature.

    " Test HOT data (accessed today)
    ls_result = lo_aging_concept->get_data_temperature( sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-temperature exp = 'HOT' msg = 'Today should be HOT' ).

    " Test HOT data (accessed 15 days ago)
    ls_result = lo_aging_concept->get_data_temperature( sy-datum - 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-temperature exp = 'HOT' msg = '15 days ago should be HOT' ).

    " Test WARM data (accessed 60 days ago)
    ls_result = lo_aging_concept->get_data_temperature( sy-datum - 60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-temperature exp = 'WARM' msg = '60 days ago should be WARM' ).

    " Test COLD data (accessed 200 days ago)
    ls_result = lo_aging_concept->get_data_temperature( sy-datum - 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-temperature exp = 'COLD' msg = '200 days ago should be COLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE` eine interne Klasse ist, die nicht direkt verwendet werden kann, demonstriert dieses Beispiel das Konzept der Datenalterung. Die Verwendung von `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das den Code für solche Logiken sehr prägnant macht. Die Datumsarithmetik ist ebenfalls ein modernes und effizientes Mittel zur Berechnung von Zeitspannen.
keywords: Data Aging, COND, Date, Time, SY-DATUM, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag hinzu. Nutzen Sie die moderne `VALUE` Operator Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND VALUE #( ... ) TO itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_value_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA'
                    connid = '0001'
                    fldate = sy-datum ) TO rt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL'
                    connid = '0002'
                    fldate = sy-datum ) TO rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flight.
    DATA(lo_adder) = NEW zcl_itab_value_append( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_adder->add_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights added' ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight carrier incorrect' ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO ls_flight INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'DL' msg = 'Second flight carrier incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `APPEND` ist die moderne und bevorzugte Methode, um Zeilen zu internen Tabellen hinzuzufügen. Er ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung der Zeile und ist wesentlich prägnanter und lesbarer als die alte `CLEAR` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Syntax.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, APPEND, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) mit den Werten 'LH' und 'UA' unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` zur kompakten Initialisierung der Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_carrid_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE ty_range_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrid IN 'LH', 'UA' ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->create_carrid_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_range )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Einträge in der Range-Tabelle sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Der erste Eintrag sollte LH sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_range[ 2 ]-low
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Der zweite Eintrag sollte UA sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck ermöglicht die kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle, hier einer Range-Tabelle, ohne explizite `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, RANGES, Internal Tables, Dynamic

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in einer zuvor definierten Range-Tabelle liegt, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck mit der `IN` Operator für die Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_range
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_range.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_range( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_filter_with_range=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_filter_with_range=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_range(
      it_sflights     = lt_sflights
      it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten drei gefilterte Einträge sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] )
      msg = 'Flug LH 0400 sollte enthalten sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ] )
      msg = 'Flug UA 0010 sollte enthalten sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      cond = line_exists( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' ] )
      msg = 'Flug AA 0020 sollte NICHT enthalten sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen, einschließlich Range-Tabellen, zu filtern.
keywords: FILTER, RANGES, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_count_flights
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_carrid_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` für eine dynamisch erstellte Range von Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... WHERE field IN @range_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_range
      IMPORTING it_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_range.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_with_range( ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_select_with_range=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_range( lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSE IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_lh_count > 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für LH gefunden werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_aa_count > 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für AA gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `@` vor der Range-Tabelle im `WHERE`-Teil einer `SELECT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die direkte Übergabe von internen Range-Tabellen an die Datenbank, was zu effizienteren Abfragen führt. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights` ist ebenfalls eine moderne und prägnante Syntax.
keywords: SELECT, IN, RANGES, Database Access, sflights

CLASS zcl_line_exists_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    IF line_exists( it_data[ key_field = iv_key ] ).

Instructions: Konkatenieren Sie alle Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: `REDUCE` kann eine Schleifenlogik kompakt ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_carrids
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carrids.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-carrid ELSE s && ',' && ls_flight-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'LH,UA,AA'
      msg = 'Die Fluggesellschaften sollten korrekt konkateniert sein.'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carrids( lt_empty_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_empty_result
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leeren String ergeben.'

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität haben. Fügen Sie ein Feld hinzu, das 'Groß' oder 'Klein' basierend auf der Kapazität anzeigt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... WHERE` mit `COND` im `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_where_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity_info,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             capacity_cat TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_capacity_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_capacity_info
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_capacity_info) TYPE tt_flight_capacity_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_where_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_capacity_info.
    rt_capacity_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( seatsmax >= iv_min_seats )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          capacity_cat = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax >= 200 THEN 'Groß' ELSE 'Klein' ) 
        ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über `sflights` und weisen Sie jedem Flug eine 'Service-Klasse' zu basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft: 'Business' für 'LH', 'Economy' für 'UA', und 'Other' für alle anderen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck für mehrfache Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_service_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_service_class,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             service_cls TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_service_class.
    TYPES: tt_flight_service_class TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_service_class WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_service_class
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_service_classes) TYPE tt_flight_service_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_service_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_service_class.
    rt_flight_service_classes = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          service_cls = SWITCH string(
            ls_flight-carrid
            WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Business'
            WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Economy'
            ELSE 'Other' 
          ) 
        ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei bestimmte Felder umbenannt oder ignoriert werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` für flexible Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE string,
             field_c TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             new_field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b     TYPE string,
             ignored_fld TYPE i,
             extra_fld   TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source MAPPING new_field_a = field_a EXCEPT ignored_fld 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_mapping( ).

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_source_data(
      field_a = 'SourceA'
      field_b = 'SourceB Value'
      field_c = 123
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-new_field_a
      exp = 'SourceA'
      msg = 'Feld A sollte korrekt umbenannt und zugewiesen werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field_b
      exp = 'SourceB Value'
      msg = 'Feld B sollte direkt zugewiesen werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_target-ignored_fld
      msg = 'Feld ignored_fld sollte initial sein (EXCEPT).' 
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_target-extra_fld
      msg = 'Feld extra_fld sollte initial sein (nicht in Quelle).' 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` bietet eine flexible und deklarative Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu kopieren. Man kann Felder umbenennen (`MAPPING`) und bestimmte Felder von der Zuweisung ausschließen (`EXCEPT`), was den Code sehr wartbar macht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Structures, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur Zeilen hinzugefügt werden, die noch nicht in der Zieltabelle existieren (basierend auf einem Schlüssel).
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ...` mit einem geeigneten Tabellentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_lines_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS merge_unique_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_data
      CHANGING
        ct_target TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_lines_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_unique_data.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source INTO TABLE ct_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_merge_unique FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_unique.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_lines_unique( ).

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_unique=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Initial 1' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Initial 2' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_unique=>tt_data(
      ( id = 2 value = 'New 2' ) "Duplikat
      ( id = 3 value = 'New 3' ) "Neu
      ( id = 4 value = 'New 4' ) "Neu
    ).

    lo_cut->merge_unique_data( it_source = lt_source CHANGING ct_target = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_target )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Es sollten 4 eindeutige Einträge in der Zieltabelle sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ id = 1 ]-value
      exp = 'Initial 1'
      msg = 'Eintrag 1 sollte unverändert sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ id = 2 ]-value
      exp = 'Initial 2'
      msg = 'Eintrag 2 sollte nicht überschrieben werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ id = 3 ]-value
      exp = 'New 3'
      msg = 'Eintrag 3 sollte hinzugefügt werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ...` ist eine effiziente Methode, um Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle einzufügen. Bei Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel werden Duplikate automatisch ignoriert, was eine einfache Möglichkeit zur Zusammenführung von Daten bietet.
keywords: INSERT LINES, Internal Tables, Unique Key, Merge

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle doppelten Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, basierend auf allen Feldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ...` nach dem Sortieren der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    SORT ct_data BY field1 field2.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_data COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 'Val1' )
      ( field1 = 'B' field2 = 'Val2' )
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 'Val1' ) "Duplikat
      ( field1 = 'C' field2 = 'Val3' )
      ( field1 = 'B' field2 = 'Val2' ) "Duplikat
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 'ValX' ) "Kein Duplikat
    ).

    lo_cut->remove_duplicates( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Es sollten 4 eindeutige Einträge übrig bleiben.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_data[ field1 = 'A' field2 = 'Val1' ] )
      msg = 'Eintrag A/Val1 sollte existieren.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_data[ field1 = 'B' field2 = 'Val2' ] )
      msg = 'Eintrag B/Val2 sollte existieren.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_data[ field1 = 'C' field2 = 'Val3' ] )
      msg = 'Eintrag C/Val3 sollte existieren.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_data[ field1 = 'A' field2 = 'ValX' ] )
      msg = 'Eintrag A/ValX sollte existieren.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ...` ist die Standardmethode zum Entfernen von Duplikaten aus internen Tabellen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate entfernt. `COMPARING ALL FIELDS` stellt sicher, dass alle Felder für den Vergleich herangezogen werden.
keywords: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, Duplicates, Sort

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle transformieren und dabei nur bestimmte Felder übernehmen und neue Felder hinzufügen, die aus den Originaldaten abgeleitet sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
             status  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             item_id     TYPE i,
             item_name   TYPE string,
             calculated_val TYPE decfloat16,
             is_active   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_target = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
        ( CORRESPONDING ty_target_line( 
            ls_source MAPPING item_id = id item_name = name 
            EXCEPT value status 
          )
          calculated_val = ls_source-value * 100
          is_active = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_source-status = 'A' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) 
        ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_transform_table( ).

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_transform_table=>tt_source(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item One' value = '10.5' status = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item Two' value = '20.0' status = 'I' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item Three' value = '5.25' status = 'A' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_target )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 transformierte Einträge sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Item ID 1 sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name
      exp = 'Item One'
      msg = 'Item Name 1 sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-calculated_val
      exp = '1050.00'
      msg = 'Calculated Value 1 sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-is_active
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Is Active 1 sollte true sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 2 ]-is_active
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Is Active 2 sollte false sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `VALUE #( FOR ... )` mit `CORRESPONDING` und `COND`, um eine interne Tabelle in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck zu transformieren. `CORRESPONDING` wird verwendet, um Felder mit gleichem Namen oder explizit gemappte Felder zu kopieren, während `EXCEPT` unerwünschte Felder ausschließt. Neue Felder können direkt mit abgeleiteten Werten befüllt werden.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, COND, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle, die alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'LH' und 'UA' ausschließt, unter Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` mit `sign = 'E'` und `option = 'EQ'` für den Ausschluss.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE ddsh_sign,
             option TYPE ddsh_option,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_exclude_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE ty_range_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_exclude_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrid IN 'LH', 'UA' ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = carrid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_exclude_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_exclude_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_exclude( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->create_exclude_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_range )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Einträge in der Range-Tabelle sein.'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_range[ 1 ]-sign
      exp = 'E'
      msg = 'Der Sign sollte E sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_range[ 1 ]-option
      exp = 'EQ'
      msg = 'Die Option sollte EQ sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Der Low-Wert sollte LH sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Range-Tabellen mit `VALUE` und `FOR` ist auch für Ausschlusskriterien sehr nützlich. Durch die Verwendung von `sign = 'E'` (Exclude) und `option = 'EQ'` (Equal) können spezifische Werte von einer Selektion ausgeschlossen werden, was oft in `WHERE`-Klauseln von `SELECT`-Anweisungen oder `FILTER`-Ausdrücken verwendet wird.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, RANGES, Exclude, Internal Tables

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Ampelfarben und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um eine entsprechende Nachricht zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ENUM` zur Definition und `CASE TYPE OF` zur Verarbeitung der Enumerationswerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_color,
             red   VALUE IS INITIAL,
             yellow VALUE IS INITIAL,
             green VALUE IS INITIAL,
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_color.

    METHODS get_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_color TYPE traffic_light_color
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message.
    CASE iv_color.
      WHEN traffic_light_color-red.
        rv_message = 'Stop!'.
      WHEN traffic_light_color-yellow.
        rv_message = 'Prepare to stop/go.'.
      WHEN traffic_light_color-green.
        rv_message = 'Go!'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unknown color.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_red FOR TESTING. METHODS test_green FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_red.
    DATA(lo_traffic_light) = NEW zcl_traffic_light( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_traffic_light->get_message( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_color-red ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Stop!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_green.
    DATA(lo_traffic_light) = NEW zcl_traffic_light( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_traffic_light->get_message( zcl_traffic_light=>traffic_light_color-green ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Go!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Definition und Verwendung einer Enumeration (`TYPES ENUM`) in ABAP 7.50+. Enumerationen verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Typsicherheit des Codes, indem sie eine feste Menge benannter Konstanten bereitstellen. Die Verarbeitung erfolgt elegant mittels `CASE TYPE OF`.
keywords: ENUMERATION, TYPES ENUM, CASE TYPE OF, Typsicherheit

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle möglichen Werte einer Enumeration dynamisch und geben Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_ENUM_UTILITIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_reflection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM weekday,
             monday,
             tuesday,
             wednesday,
             thursday,
             friday,
             saturday,
             sunday,
           END OF ENUM weekday.

    METHODS get_all_weekdays
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_weekdays) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_reflection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_weekdays.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_ENUM_REFLECTION=>WEEKDAY' ).
    DATA(lo_enum_type_descr) = CAST cl_abap_enum_type_descr( lo_type_descr ).

    LOOP AT lo_enum_type_descr->get_literals( ) INTO DATA(ls_literal).
      APPEND ls_literal-name TO rt_weekdays.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Flugstatus (z.B. 'Gebucht', 'Storniert', 'Abgeflogen') und verwenden Sie diese, um Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` zu filtern. Da `SFLIGHTS` keinen Status hat, simulieren wir dies durch eine zusätzliche Spalte in einer lokalen Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücke für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM flight_status,
             booked   VALUE IS INITIAL,
             cancelled VALUE IS INITIAL,
             departed VALUE IS INITIAL,
           END OF ENUM flight_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE flight_status,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_status.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_with_status_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_with_status_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_status.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_with_status_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        status = COND flight_status(
          WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum THEN flight_status-departed
          WHEN ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum THEN flight_status-booked "Simplified logic
          ELSE flight_status-booked
        )
      )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE status = iv_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filter_departed FOR TESTING. METHODS test_filter_booked FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_departed.
    DATA(lo_flight_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_departed_flights) = lo_flight_filter->get_flights_by_status( zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status-departed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_departed_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_departed_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status-departed ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_booked.
    DATA(lo_flight_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_booked_flights) = lo_flight_filter->get_flights_by_status( zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status-booked ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_booked_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_booked_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = zcl_flight_filter=>flight_status-booked ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration von Enumerationen in die moderne Tabellenverarbeitung. Mit `VALUE` und `FOR` wird eine neue interne Tabelle mit simulierten Flugstatus basierend auf der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle erstellt. Anschließend wird `FILTER` verwendet, um die Tabelle effizient nach dem Enumerationswert zu filtern. Dies ist eine sehr lesbare und performante Art der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, sflights

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie die Klasse `CL_GUI_ECL_VIEWERBOX` und bereiten Sie sie konzeptionell für die Anzeige vor, indem Sie einen Dummy-Container als Parent verwenden. Der Fokus liegt auf der korrekten Instanziierung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` und verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle mit transformierten Daten zu füllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             formatted_date TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: ty_flight_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_flights) TYPE ty_flight_info_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights_raw UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_formatted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
                                    ( carrier_id    = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                      connection_id = ls_sflight-connid,
                                      flight_date   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                      formatted_date = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|
                                    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_for_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_expression.
    DATA(lo_itab_for) = NEW zcl_itab_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_formatted_flights) = lo_itab_for->get_formatted_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_formatted_flights ) exp = 10 ).
    LOOP AT lt_formatted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight_info-formatted_date ).
      " Check if the date format is plausible (e.g., contains dots or slashes)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight_info-formatted_date CS '.' OR ls_flight_info-formatted_date CS '/' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE #(...)` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.40+, um interne Tabellen zu initialisieren und gleichzeitig Daten zu transformieren. Er ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Programmierung, die die Lesbarkeit des Codes verbessert und Schleifenkonstrukte reduziert. Hier wird zusätzlich ein String-Template zur Datumsformatierung verwendet.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, sflights, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen, um die Vererbung und das Überschreiben zu kontrollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` in der Definition der Klasse und/oder Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_final DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_final IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_info.
    rv_info = 'This is a final class. It cannot be inherited.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example of a class with a final method (cannot be inherited due to final class above)
" CLASS zcl_sub_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_final.
" ENDCLASS.
" This would lead to a syntax error: 'Class ZCL_SUB_CLASS cannot inherit from final class ZCL_BASE_FINAL.'

CLASS zcl_method_final DEFINITION PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_more_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_final IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    rv_data = 'This method is final and cannot be redefined.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_more_data.
    rv_data = 'This method can be redefined.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_final_sub DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_method_final CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " METHODS get_data REDEFINITION. " This would cause a syntax error: 'Method GET_DATA is final and cannot be redefined.'
    METHODS get_more_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_final_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_more_data.
    rv_data = 'Redefined method in subclass.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_final_class FOR TESTING. METHODS test_final_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_class.
    DATA(lo_final_class) = NEW zcl_base_final( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_final_class->get_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'This is a final class. It cannot be inherited.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_final_method.
    DATA(lo_sub_class) = NEW zcl_method_final_sub( ).
    DATA(lv_data_final) = lo_sub_class->get_data( ).
    DATA(lv_data_redefined) = lo_sub_class->get_more_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_data_final exp = 'This method is final and cannot be redefined.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_data_redefined exp = 'Redefined method in subclass.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` in ABAP 7.50+ ermöglicht eine präzise Kontrolle über die Vererbungshierarchie. Eine `FINAL` Klasse kann nicht beerbt werden, was die Stabilität und Kapselung erhöht. Eine `FINAL` Methode kann in Unterklassen nicht überschrieben werden, was sicherstellt, dass die Implementierung in der Basisklasse unverändert bleibt. Dies ist wichtig für das Design robuster und wartbarer objektorientierter Architekturen.
keywords: FINAL, Object Orientation, Inheritance, Redefinition, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `INIT`-Parameter für die Summe und den Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR n IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + n
    ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lines( it_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_average_positive FOR TESTING. METHODS test_average_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_positive.
    DATA(lo_reduce_average) = NEW zcl_reduce_average( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_reduce_average->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 20.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_empty.
    DATA(lo_reduce_average) = NEW zcl_reduce_average( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_reduce_average->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck in ABAP 7.40+ ist ideal, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Zahlen zu berechnen. In Kombination mit `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Berechnung des Durchschnitts, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Math, Average, ABAP 7.40
