Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für verschiedene Mitarbeiterrollen und initialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit diesen Konstanten unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONSTANTS` für die Definition und `VALUE #()` für die Initialisierung der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_roles DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_role,
             role_id   TYPE string,
             role_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee_role.
    TYPES tt_employee_roles TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_role WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS: gc_role_admin    TYPE string VALUE 'ADMIN',
               gc_role_manager  TYPE string VALUE 'MANAGER',
               gc_role_employee TYPE string VALUE 'EMPLOYEE'.

    METHODS get_all_roles
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_roles) TYPE tt_employee_roles.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_roles IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_roles.
    rt_roles = VALUE #( ( role_id = gc_role_admin    role_name = 'Administrator' )
                        ( role_id = gc_role_manager  role_name = 'Manager' )
                        ( role_id = gc_role_employee role_name = 'Mitarbeiter' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_roles FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_roles.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_roles( ).
    DATA(lt_roles) = lo_cut->get_all_roles( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 roles' act = lines( lt_roles ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_roles WITH KEY role_id = zcl_employee_roles=>gc_role_admin INTO DATA(ls_admin_role).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Admin role name mismatch' act = ls_admin_role-role_name exp = 'Administrator' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Verwendung von `CONSTANTS` zur Definition von festen Werten und des `VALUE #()`-Operators zur kompakten Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes, da die Daten direkt bei der Deklaration zugewiesen werden können.
keywords: CONSTANTS, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Initialization

Instructions: Konstruieren Sie eine OData-Abfrage-URL für Mitarbeiterdaten dynamisch unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie Backticks (`) für String-Templates und `&&` für die Verkettung von Ausdrücken innerhalb des Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_url_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_employee_query_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_top         TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_skip        TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_employee_query_url.
    DATA(lv_base_url) = '/sap/opu/odata/sap/ODATA_HCMFAB_REUSE/Employees'.
    DATA(lv_filter) = COND string( WHEN iv_employee_id IS NOT INITIAL THEN |$filter=employee_id eq '{ iv_employee_id }'| ELSE '' ).
    DATA(lv_query_params) = |$top={ iv_top }&$skip={ iv_skip }|.

    rv_url = |{ lv_base_url }{ COND string( WHEN lv_filter IS NOT INITIAL THEN |?{ lv_filter }&{ lv_query_params }| ELSE |?{ lv_query_params }| ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_url_no_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_build_url_with_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_url_no_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_url_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = lo_cut->build_employee_query_url( iv_top = 5 iv_skip = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'URL without filter mismatch' act = lv_url exp = '/sap/opu/odata/sap/ODATA_HCMFAB_REUSE/Employees?$top=5&$skip=10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_build_url_with_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_url_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = lo_cut->build_employee_query_url( iv_employee_id = '00000001' iv_top = 1 iv_skip = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'URL with filter mismatch' act = lv_url exp = '/sap/opu/odata/sap/ODATA_HCMFAB_REUSE/Employees?$filter=employee_id eq ''00000001''&$top=1&$skip=0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen eine intuitive und lesbare Art der String-Konkatenation. Hier werden sie verwendet, um eine komplexe OData-URL dynamisch zusammenzusetzen, inklusive optionaler Filterparameter. Der `COND`-Operator wird genutzt, um bedingte Teile der URL elegant einzufügen.
keywords: String Templates, OData, URL, COND

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Mitarbeiterobjekten, um nur aktive Mitarbeiter einer bestimmten Abteilung zu erhalten, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `WHERE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` um die Filterung direkt bei der Zuweisung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             department  TYPE string,
             is_active   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_active_employees
      IMPORTING
        it_all_employees TYPE tt_employees
        iv_department    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_employees) TYPE tt_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_active_employees.
    rt_filtered_employees = VALUE #( FOR ls_employee IN it_all_employees
                                     WHERE ( department = iv_department AND is_active = abap_true )
                                     ( ls_employee ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_employees FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_employees.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_filter=>tt_employees(
      ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'HR' is_active = abap_true )
      ( employee_id = '002' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Meier' department = 'IT' is_active = abap_true )
      ( employee_id = '003' first_name = 'Julia' last_name = 'Wagner' department = 'HR' is_active = abap_false )
      ( employee_id = '004' first_name = 'Tom' last_name = 'Müller' department = 'IT' is_active = abap_true )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_active_employees( it_all_employees = lt_all_employees iv_department = 'IT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 active IT employees' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_employee).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered employee ID mismatch' act = ls_employee-employee_id exp = '002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingung zu schreiben, wird die Filterlogik direkt in den Zuweisungsausdruck integriert, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Gehälter aller Mitarbeiter in einer Liste unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Initialisieren Sie einen Akkumulator und addieren Sie in jedem Schritt das Gehalt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_salary_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             salary      TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_salary
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employees
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_salary) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_salary_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_salary.
    rv_total_salary = REDUCE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT lv_sum = 0
      FOR ls_employee IN it_employees
      NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_employee-salary
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_salary FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_salary_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_salary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_salary_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_salary_calc=>tt_employees(
      ( employee_id = '001' salary = '5000.00' )
      ( employee_id = '002' salary = '7500.50' )
      ( employee_id = '003' salary = '3000.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_salary( lt_employees ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total salary mismatch' act = lv_total exp = '15500.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_salary_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_salary_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_salary_calc=>tt_employees(
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_salary( lt_employees ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total salary for empty table should be 0' act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das es erlaubt, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Gehälter aller Mitarbeiter in einer sehr prägnanten und effizienten Weise zu berechnen, ohne eine explizite Schleife.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Mitarbeiterobjekten nach mehreren Kriterien (z.B. Abteilung und Mindestgehalt) unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung, die auf jedes Element der Quelltabelle angewendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             department  TYPE string,
             salary      TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_department_and_salary
      IMPORTING
        it_all_employees TYPE tt_employees
        iv_department    TYPE string
        iv_min_salary    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_employees) TYPE tt_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_department_and_salary.
    rt_filtered_employees = FILTER #( it_all_employees
                                      WHERE department = iv_department
                                      AND   salary >= iv_min_salary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_complex_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_complex_filter=>tt_employees(
      ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'HR' salary = '6000.00' )
      ( employee_id = '002' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Meier' department = 'IT' salary = '7500.50' )
      ( employee_id = '003' first_name = 'Julia' last_name = 'Wagner' department = 'HR' salary = '4000.00' )
      ( employee_id = '004' first_name = 'Tom' last_name = 'Müller' department = 'IT' salary = '8000.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_department_and_salary( it_all_employees = lt_all_employees
                                                                 iv_department    = 'IT'
                                                                 iv_min_salary    = '7000.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 IT employees with salary >= 7000' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_employee).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered employee ID mismatch' act = ls_employee-employee_id exp = '002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_complex_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_complex_filter=>tt_employees(
      ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'HR' salary = '6000.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_department_and_salary( it_all_employees = lt_all_employees
                                                                 iv_department    = 'IT'
                                                                 iv_min_salary    = '7000.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected no matches' act = lt_filtered IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Elemente enthält, die die angegebene Bedingung erfüllen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Code-Klarheit.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering, Functional Programming

Instructions: Mappen Sie Daten von einer generischen OData-Antwortstruktur auf eine spezifische Mitarbeiterstruktur unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #()` mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel, um Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zuzuordnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_odata_response_item,
             person_id   TYPE string,
             first       TYPE string,
             last        TYPE string,
             email_addr  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_odata_response_item.
    TYPES tt_odata_response_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_odata_response_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             email       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee_data.
    TYPES tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_odata_to_employee
      IMPORTING
        it_odata_items TYPE tt_odata_response_items
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_employee_data) TYPE tt_employee_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_odata_to_employee.
    rt_employee_data = CORRESPONDING #( it_odata_items MAPPING employee_id = person_id
                                                          first_name  = first
                                                          last_name   = last
                                                          email       = email_addr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_odata_items) = VALUE zcl_odata_mapper=>tt_odata_response_items(
      ( person_id = '00000001' first = 'Max' last = 'Mustermann' email_addr = 'max.m@example.com' )
      ( person_id = '00000002' first = 'Erika' last = 'Musterfrau' email_addr = 'erika.m@example.com' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_employee_data) = lo_cut->map_odata_to_employee( lt_odata_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 mapped employees' act = lines( lt_employee_data ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_employee_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_employee).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Employee ID mismatch' act = ls_employee-employee_id exp = '00000001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First name mismatch' act = ls_employee-first_name exp = 'Max' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist ein sehr effizientes und modernes Mittel, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (potenziell) unterschiedlichen Feldnamen zu kopieren. Die `MAPPING`-Klausel erlaubt die explizite Zuordnung von Feldern, die nicht namensgleich sind, was den Code deutlich kürzer und wartbarer macht als manuelle Zuweisungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Mapping, Structures, Internal Tables, OData

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Mitarbeiterdatensatz aus der Datenbank (simuliert mit `sflights`) unter Verwendung von `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration und `UP TO 1 ROWS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` oder `SELECT ... UP TO 1 ROWS INTO @DATA(...)` für einzelne Datensätze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_db_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_db,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             price      TYPE s_price,
             currency   TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax   TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_employee_db.

    METHODS get_employee_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_employee_data) TYPE ty_employee_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_db_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_data.
    " Using sflights as a stand-in for an employee table
    " Mapping CARRIER_ID to CARRID and EMPLOYEE_ID to CONNID for demonstration
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_employee_data = ls_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_existing_employee FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_employee FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_employee.
    " Ensure test data exists in sflights
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251124' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 150 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_db_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_employee) = lo_cut->get_employee_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Employee data should not be initial' act = ls_employee IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' act = ls_employee-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection ID mismatch' act = ls_employee-connid exp = '0017' ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_employee.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_db_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_employee) = lo_cut->get_employee_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existing employee data should be initial' act = ls_employee IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SELECT ... INTO @DATA(...)` und `UP TO 1 ROWS` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, einen einzelnen Datensatz aus der Datenbank zu lesen. `DATA()` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Zielstruktur, und `UP TO 1 ROWS` optimiert die Datenbankabfrage, indem nur ein Datensatz gelesen wird, was performanter ist als `SELECT SINGLE` in bestimmten Szenarien.
keywords: SELECT, DATA, UP TO 1 ROWS, Database Access, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Mitarbeiterobjekt und setzen Sie dessen Eigenschaften in einer flüssigen (fluent) Weise unter Verwendung des `NEW`-Operators und Method Chaining.
hint: Definieren Sie Setter-Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: employee_id TYPE string READ-ONLY,
          first_name  TYPE string READ-ONLY,
          last_name   TYPE string READ-ONLY,
          email       TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string.

    METHODS set_first_name
      IMPORTING iv_first_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_employee.

    METHODS set_last_name
      IMPORTING iv_last_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_employee.

    METHODS set_email
      IMPORTING iv_email TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_employee.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->employee_id = iv_employee_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_first_name.
    me->first_name = iv_first_name.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_last_name.
    me->last_name = iv_last_name.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_email.
    me->email = iv_email.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_employee_fluent
      IMPORTING iv_employee_id TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_employee) TYPE REF TO zcl_employee.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_employee_fluent.
    ro_employee = NEW zcl_employee( iv_employee_id = iv_employee_id )
                      ->set_first_name( 'John' )
                      ->set_last_name( 'Doe' )
                      ->set_email( 'john.doe@example.com' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_creation.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_employee_builder( ).
    DATA(lo_employee) = lo_builder->create_employee_fluent( 'EMP001' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Employee object should not be initial' act = lo_employee IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Employee ID mismatch' act = lo_employee->employee_id exp = 'EMP001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First name mismatch' act = lo_employee->first_name exp = 'John' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Email mismatch' act = lo_employee->email exp = 'john.doe@example.com' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator in Kombination mit Method Chaining ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und lesbare Art der Objektinstanziierung und Eigenschaftenzuweisung. Indem Setter-Methoden eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben, können mehrere Methodenaufrufe hintereinander gekettet werden, was zu einem flüssigeren und kompakteren Code führt.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Zugriffsebene eines Mitarbeiters basierend auf seiner Rolle unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_access_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_employee_role TYPE string.
    TYPES ty_access_level TYPE string.

    CONSTANTS: gc_role_admin    TYPE ty_employee_role VALUE 'ADMIN',
               gc_role_manager  TYPE ty_employee_role VALUE 'MANAGER',
               gc_role_employee TYPE ty_employee_role VALUE 'EMPLOYEE',
               gc_role_guest    TYPE ty_employee_role VALUE 'GUEST'.

    CONSTANTS: gc_access_full   TYPE ty_access_level VALUE 'FULL',
               gc_access_medium TYPE ty_access_level VALUE 'MEDIUM',
               gc_access_limited TYPE ty_access_level VALUE 'LIMITED',
               gc_access_none   TYPE ty_access_level VALUE 'NONE'.

    METHODS get_access_level
      IMPORTING iv_employee_role TYPE ty_employee_role
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_access_level) TYPE ty_access_level.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_access_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_access_level.
    rv_access_level = SWITCH ty_access_level(
      iv_employee_role
      WHEN gc_role_admin    THEN gc_access_full
      WHEN gc_role_manager  THEN gc_access_medium
      WHEN gc_role_employee THEN gc_access_limited
      ELSE                       gc_access_none
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die E-Mail-Adressen von Mitarbeitern enthält, deren Nachname mit 'M' beginnt, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit `COND` und `CONTAINS`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und der String-Funktion `CONTAINS` für eine präzise Filterung und Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_email_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             email       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_emails TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_emails_by_lastname_prefix
      IMPORTING
        it_all_employees TYPE tt_employees
        iv_prefix        TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_emails.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_email_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_emails_by_lastname_prefix.
    rt_emails = VALUE #( FOR ls_employee IN it_all_employees
                         WHERE ( CONTAINS( val = ls_employee-last_name sub = iv_prefix ) )
                         ( ls_employee-email ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_emails FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_emails_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_emails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_employee_email_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_all_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_email_extractor=>tt_employees(
      ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'Max' last_name = 'Mustermann' email = 'max.m@example.com' )
      ( employee_id = '002' first_name = 'Erika' last_name = 'Musterfrau' email = 'erika.m@example.com' )
      ( employee_id = '003' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' email = 'anna.s@example.com' )
      ( employee_id = '004' first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Meier' email = 'peter.m@example.com' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_emails) = lo_cut->get_emails_by_lastname_prefix( it_all_employees = lt_all_employees iv_prefix = 'M' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 emails' act = lines( lt_emails ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First email mismatch' act = lt_emails[1] exp = 'max.m@example.com' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_emails_no_match.

    DATA(lt_all_employees) = VALUE zcl_employee_email_extractor=>tt_employees(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu durchlaufen, zu filtern und gleichzeitig zu transformieren. Die `WHERE`-Klausel in Kombination mit der String-Funktion `CONTAINS` ermöglicht eine effiziente Filterung basierend auf einem Teilstring. Die direkte Zuweisung des E-Mail-Feldes `( ls_employee-email )` in der Zieltabellenkonstruktion macht den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, String Functions, CONTAINS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, um eine 'Employee Function' auszuführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Namen oder `cl_abap_classdescr` für RTTI.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_employee_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_employee_function
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_employee_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_employee_function.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lo_object) = lo_class_descr->create_object( ).

        DATA(lo_method_descr) = CAST cl_abap_methdescr( lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ) ).

        DATA(lt_parameters) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
          ( name = 'IV_EMPLOYEE_ID' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_importing value = REF #( iv_employee_id ) )
        ).

        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING   rv_result = rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_class_not_found cx_sy_struct_creation.
        rv_result = |Error: Dynamic call failed for { iv_class_name }->{ iv_method_name }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Mitarbeitern nach ihrer Abteilung und zählen Sie die Mitarbeiter pro Abteilung unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... INTO ...` um die Gruppierung durchzuführen und den `COUNT`-Operator für die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             department  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_department_count,
             department TYPE string,
             employee_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_department_count.
    TYPES tt_department_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_department_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_employees_by_department
      IMPORTING
        it_all_employees TYPE tt_employees
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_department_counts) TYPE tt_department_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_employees_by_department.
    rt_department_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_employee IN it_all_employees
                                    GROUP BY ls_employee-department
                                    ASCENDING
                                    INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
                                    ( department = ls_group_key-department
                                      employee_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ...` Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter eines Mitarbeiters in Jahren basierend auf seinem Geburtsdatum unter Verwendung moderner Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik mit `CONV` und `sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_age_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        id_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_age_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(ld_today) = sy-datum.

    rv_age = ld_today(4) - id_birth_date(4).

    IF ld_today(5) < id_birth_date(5).
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Attribute einer Mitarbeiterstruktur (oder einer beliebigen Struktur) und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` für die Beschreibung von Strukturen und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_info,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             salary      TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             hire_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_employee_info.

        ir_data TYPE REF TO data

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ) ).
    rt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, die Metadaten von Datentypen zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. Hier wird `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref()` verwendet, um eine Typbeschreibung für eine beliebige Datenreferenz zu erhalten, und dann `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components()`, um die einzelnen Komponenten einer Struktur zu ermitteln. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API durch und geben Sie den HTTP-Statuscode sowie den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und die Methoden `send` und `receive`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
        status_code TYPE i,
        response_body TYPE string,
      END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_http_client        = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found   = 1
        plugin_not_active    = 2
        internal_error       = 3
        OTHERS               = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_get_invalid_url FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_example( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1'. " Public test API
    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_data( lv_url ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'HTTP Status Code should be 200 for success'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_response-response_body IS INITIAL
      msg = 'Response body should not be initial' " Check for non-empty body
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_invalid_url.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_example( ).

solution:

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url         = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_http_client = lo_http_client

    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.

    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( iv_json_payload ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS

    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request unter Verwendung einer im Transaktionscode SM59 definierten HTTP-Destination durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_destination`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_dest_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_dest_response,
        status_code TYPE i,
        response_body TYPE string,
      END OF ty_dest_response.

    METHODS get_data_by_destination
      IMPORTING
        iv_destination TYPE string " Name der SM59 HTTP-Destination
        iv_path        TYPE string OPTIONAL " Pfad relativ zur Destination
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_dest_response
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error.

CLASS zcl_http_dest_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_by_destination.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_destination(
      EXPORTING
        i_destination        = iv_destination
      IMPORTING
        e_http_client        = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found   = 1
        plugin_not_active    = 2
        internal_error       = 3
        OTHERS               = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_path IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_http_client->request->set_request_uri( iv_path ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dest_success.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_dest_example( ).

    DATA(lv_path) = '/todos/1'.

CLASS zcl_profile_params_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_profile_params_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multiple_param_values.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>tt_parameter_name.

      i_parameter_names = lt_parameters

                                  value = ls_raw-parameter_value
                                ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>set_request_timeout` um ein Timeout zu setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `lo_http_client->set_request_timeout( iv_timeout_seconds )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_timeout_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_timeout_response,
        status_code TYPE i,
        response_body TYPE string,
        timeout_occurred TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_timeout_response.

    METHODS get_data_with_timeout
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_timeout_seconds TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_timeout_response
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_timeout_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_with_timeout.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url         = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_http_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS        = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->set_request_timeout( iv_timeout_seconds ).

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        rs_response-timeout_occurred = abap_false.

      CATCH cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_io_error).
        IF lx_io_error->reason = if_http_client=>co_timeout.
          rs_response-timeout_occurred = abap_true.
          rs_response-response_body = 'Request timed out'.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_io_error.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timeout_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_timeout_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timeout_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_timeout_example( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1'.
    DATA(lv_timeout) = 10. " 10 Sekunden, sollte ausreichen

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_data_with_timeout(
      iv_url           = lv_url
      iv_timeout_seconds = lv_timeout
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'HTTP Status Code should be 200'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = ls_response-timeout_occurred
      msg = 'Timeout should not have occurred'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timeout_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_timeout_example( ).
    " Eine URL, die absichtlich langsam antwortet oder ein sehr kurzes Timeout
    " HINWEIS: Eine echte Test-URL für ein Timeout ist schwer zu finden. Hier wird ein sehr kurzes Timeout verwendet.
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1'.
    DATA(lv_timeout) = 1. " 1 Sekunde, könnte zu Timeout führen, abhängig von Netzwerk/Server

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_data_with_timeout(
      iv_url           = lv_url
      iv_timeout_seconds = lv_timeout
    ).

    " Der Test kann je nach Netzwerkbedingungen fehlschlagen, wenn der Request doch schnell genug ist.
    " Idealerweise würde man einen Mock-Server oder eine bekannte langsame API verwenden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ls_response-timeout_occurred
      msg = 'Timeout should have occurred (may vary based on network)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Setzen eines Timeouts für HTTP-Requests ist entscheidend, um zu verhindern, dass Anwendungen bei langsamen oder nicht reagierenden externen Diensten hängen bleiben. `set_request_timeout` ermöglicht die Konfiguration dieser Wartezeit. Die Fehlerbehandlung fängt `cx_http_io_error` ab und prüft auf den spezifischen Timeout-Grund.
keywords: cl_http_client, Timeout, HTTP Request, Error Handling, cx_http_io_error

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>set_cookie` und `cl_http_client=>get_cookies` zur Cookie-Verwaltung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `lo_http_client->request->set_cookie` und `lo_http_client->response->get_cookies`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_cookie_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_cookie,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_cookie,
      tt_cookies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cookie WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_cookie_response,
        status_code TYPE i,
        response_body TYPE string,
        sent_cookie_value TYPE string,
        received_cookies TYPE tt_cookies,
      END OF ty_cookie_response.

    METHODS get_data_with_cookies
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_cookie_name TYPE string
        iv_cookie_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_cookie_response
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_cookie_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_with_cookies.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url         = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_http_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS        = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_cookie(
      name  = iv_cookie_name
      value = iv_cookie_value
    ).
    rs_response-sent_cookie_value = iv_cookie_value.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_io_error.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    DATA(lt_raw_cookies) = lo_http_client->response->get_cookies( ).
    rs_response-received_cookies = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_cookies (
                                              name = ls_raw-name
                                              value = ls_raw-value
                                            ) ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    " This part would typically be in a PBO of a screen or a report.
    " For demonstration, we assume a container exists (e.g., 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' on a screen).
    " In a real application, robust error handling for container creation is crucial.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'. " Placeholder for a screen element
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle exception, e.g., if container not found in non-GUI context
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Display data in ALV
    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Doppelklick-Event-Handler für ein ALV Grid, das `SFLIGHTS`-Daten anzeigt. Bei Doppelklick soll eine Meldung mit der Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer erscheinen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Event-Handler-Klasse und registrieren Sie diese mit `SET HANDLER` für das `double_click`-Ereignis von `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column
        es_row_no.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights.

    " Register event handler
    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
      EXPORTING
        i_ready_for_input = 0.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    " In a real scenario, you'd get the actual data from the internal table
    " passed to the ALV, using e_row-index. For simplicity, we'll just show a dummy message.
    MESSAGE |Doppelklick auf Zeile { e_row } (Spalte: { e_column })| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_fieldcat_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_fcat IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_fieldcat_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_with_fcat.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_fcat      TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Build field catalog dynamically using VALUE operator
    lt_fcat = VALUE #( ( fieldname = 'CARRID'  seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
                       ( fieldname = 'CONNID'  seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
                       ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'  seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
                       ( fieldname = 'PRICE'   seltext_l = 'Preis' )
                       ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
                       ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' no_out = abap_true ) " Hide column
                       ( fieldname = 'SEATSMAX' seltext_l = 'Max. Sitze' )
                       ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' seltext_l = 'Belegte Sitze' )
                     ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        is_layout        = VALUE #( cwidth_opt = abap_true )
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
      EXPORTING
        i_ready_for_input = 0.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_data IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_sflights).

    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
      EXPORTING
        i_ready_for_input = 0.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_filter_data( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'. " Example airline

    " Ensure some test data exists for 'LH' in SFLIGHTS or mock it.
    " For this example, we assume 'LH' exists.
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflights( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_sflights )
      msg = 'Should retrieve filtered flight data for LH'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_sflight-carrid
        exp = lv_carrid
        msg = 'All entries should match the filtered airline'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Anstatt eine Schleife mit `IF` zu verwenden, erstellt `FILTER` eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Elemente enthält, die der Bedingung entsprechen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `SFLIGHTS`-Daten und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet') basierend auf einem Schwellenwert anzeigt. Zeigen Sie diese Daten im ALV an.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die berechnete Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights_status) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
    METHODS display_sflights_status IMPORTING it_sflights_status TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_with_status.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights )
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    " Add a calculated column 'status' using FOR and COND
    rt_sflights_status = VALUE tt_sflight_status(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        price    = ls_flight-price,
        currency = ls_flight-currency,
        status   = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc < ls_flight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Pünktlich'
                                 WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc >= ls_flight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
                                 ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_status.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_CALCULATED_COLUMN=>TY_SFLIGHT_STATUS' " Use the local type
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflights_status.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
      EXPORTING
        i_ready_for_input = 0.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculated_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculated_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_calculated_column( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_status) = lo_cut->get_sflights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_sflights_status )
      msg = 'Should retrieve flight data with status'
    ).

    " Find an entry and check its status
    READ TABLE lt_sflights_status INTO DATA(ls_flight_status) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_flight_status-status
        msg = 'Status should be calculated'
      ).
      " More specific checks would require knowing the exact data in SFLIGHTS
      " and the logic of the COND expression.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer berechneten Spalte in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Ausdruck. Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht die Transformation von Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, während `COND` eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung bietet. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und ausdrucksstarkes Muster in ABAP, um Daten effizient zu verarbeiten und für die Anzeige im ALV vorzubereiten.

CLASS zcl_appointment_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                             iv_description TYPE string

CLASS zcl_appointment_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_new_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    lo_appointment->set_subject( iv_subject ).
    lo_appointment->set_description( iv_description ).
    lo_appointment->set_date_from( iv_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_time_from( iv_time_from ).
    lo_appointment->set_date_to( iv_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_time_to( iv_time_to ).

    lo_appointment->create_appointment( ).
    lo_appointment->save_appointment( ).

    rv_guid = lo_appointment->get_guid( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details eines bestehenden Termins anhand seiner GUID aus und geben Sie Betreff und Beschreibung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `cl_appointment=>get_instance` und anschließend `read_appointment`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_details,
             subject     TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             date_from   TYPE d,
             time_from   TYPE t,
             date_to     TYPE d,
             time_to     TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_details.

    METHODS read_appointment_details IMPORTING iv_guid TYPE szz_guid
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rs_details) TYPE ty_appointment_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_appointment_details.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>get_instance( iv_guid ).

    IF lo_appointment IS BOUND.
      lo_appointment->read_appointment( ).
      rs_details-subject     = lo_appointment->get_subject( ).
      rs_details-description = lo_appointment->get_description( ).
      rs_details-date_from   = lo_appointment->get_date_from( ).
      rs_details-time_from   = lo_appointment->get_time_from( ).
      rs_details-date_to     = lo_appointment->get_date_to( ).
      rs_details-time_to     = lo_appointment->get_time_to( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_appointment FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_appointment.
    " First, create an appointment to read
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_appointment_create( ).
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Termin zum Lesen'.
    DATA(lv_description) = 'Beschreibung des Termins zum Lesen'.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time_from) = '110000'.
    DATA(lv_time_to) = '120000'.
    DATA(lv_guid) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      iv_subject     = lv_subject
      iv_description = lv_description
      iv_date        = lv_date
      iv_time_from   = lv_time_from
      iv_time_to     = lv_time_to
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_guid msg = 'GUID should not be initial' ).

    " Now, read the appointment
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_appointment_read( ).
    DATA(ls_details) = lo_reader->read_appointment_details( lv_guid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-subject exp = lv_subject msg = 'Subject should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-description exp = lv_description msg = 'Description should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-date_from exp = lv_date msg = 'Date should match' ).

    " Clean up
    DATA(lo_appointment_cleanup) = cl_appointment=>get_instance( lv_guid ).
    IF lo_appointment_cleanup IS BOUND.
      lo_appointment_cleanup->delete_appointment( ).
      lo_appointment_cleanup->save_appointment( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die statische Methode `cl_appointment=>get_instance( iv_guid )` wird verwendet, um eine Referenz auf einen bestehenden Termin zu erhalten. Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Betreff und die Beschreibung eines bestehenden Termins anhand seiner GUID.

solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_appointment_details IMPORTING iv_guid TYPE szz_guid
                                               iv_new_subject TYPE string
                                               iv_new_description TYPE string
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_appointment_details.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>get_instance( iv_guid ).

    IF lo_appointment IS BOUND.
      lo_appointment->read_appointment( ).
      lo_appointment->set_subject( iv_new_subject ).
      lo_appointment->set_description( iv_new_description ).
      lo_appointment->save_appointment( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_appointment.
    " First, create an appointment to update
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_appointment_create( ).
    DATA(lv_subject_orig) = 'Original Betreff'.
    DATA(lv_description_orig) = 'Original Beschreibung'.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time_from) = '130000'.
    DATA(lv_time_to) = '140000'.
    DATA(lv_guid) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      iv_subject     = lv_subject_orig
      iv_description = lv_description_orig
      iv_date        = lv_date
      iv_time_from   = lv_time_from
      iv_time_to     = lv_time_to
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_guid msg = 'GUID should not be initial' ).

    " Now, update the appointment
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_appointment_update( ).
    DATA(lv_subject_new) = 'Neuer Betreff'.
    DATA(lv_description_new) = 'Neue Beschreibung'.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_appointment_details(
      iv_guid            = lv_guid
      iv_new_subject     = lv_subject_new
      iv_new_description = lv_description_new
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    " Verify the update by reading the appointment again
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_appointment_read( ).

CLASS zcl_appointment_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_found_appointment,
             guid    TYPE szz_guid,
             subject TYPE string,
           END OF ty_found_appointment.
    TYPES: tt_found_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_found_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_appointments_in_range IMPORTING iv_date_from TYPE d
                                                 iv_date_to TYPE d
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_found_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_appointments_in_range.
    DATA(lt_guids) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_in_period(
      i_date_from = iv_date_from
      i_date_to   = iv_date_to
    ).

    " Use FOR expression to iterate and retrieve details for each GUID
    rt_appointments = VALUE tt_found_appointments(
      FOR lv_guid IN lt_guids
      LET lo_appointment = cl_appointment=>get_instance( lv_guid ) IN
        ( guid    = lv_guid,
          subject = COND string( WHEN lo_appointment IS BOUND THEN lo_appointment->get_subject( ) ELSE 'N/A' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_appointments.
    " First, create some appointments for testing the search
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_appointment_create( ).
    DATA(lv_date_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_date_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lv_guid1) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      iv_subject     = 'Termin Heute'
      iv_description = 'Beschreibung Heute'
      iv_date        = lv_date_today
      iv_time_from   = '090000'
      iv_time_to     = '100000'
    ).
    DATA(lv_guid2) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      iv_subject     = 'Termin Morgen'
      iv_description = 'Beschreibung Morgen'
      iv_date        = lv_date_tomorrow
      iv_time_from   = '110000'
      iv_time_to     = '120000'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_guid1 msg = 'GUID1 should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_guid2 msg = 'GUID2 should not be initial' ).

    " Now, search for appointments
    DATA(lo_searcher) = NEW zcl_appointment_search( ).
    DATA(lt_found_appointments) = lo_searcher->find_appointments_in_range(
      iv_date_from = lv_date_today
      iv_date_to   = lv_date_tomorrow
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_found_appointments )
      msg = 'Should find at least two appointments'
    ).

    " Check if the created appointments are found
    DATA(lv_found_guid1) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_guid2) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_found_appointments INTO DATA(ls_found).
      IF ls_found-guid = lv_guid1.
        lv_found_guid1 = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-subject exp = 'Termin Heute' msg = 'Subject for GUID1 mismatch' ).
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_found-guid = lv_guid2.
        lv_found_guid2 = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-subject exp = 'Termin Morgen' msg = 'Subject for GUID2 mismatch' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found_guid1 exp = abap_true msg = 'GUID1 should be found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found_guid2 exp = abap_true msg = 'GUID2 should be found' ).

    " Clean up
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_appointment_delete( ).
    lo_deleter->delete_existing_appointment( lv_guid1 ).
    lo_deleter->delete_existing_appointment( lv_guid2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verarbeitung der zurückgegebenen GUIDs erfolgt mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit einem `LET`-Ausdruck und `COND`. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation der Liste von GUIDs in eine Tabelle mit detaillierten Termininformationen. `LET` wird verwendet, um eine temporäre Variable (`lo_appointment`) innerhalb des Ausdrucks zu definieren, was den Code lesbarer macht. `COND` sorgt für eine sichere Abfrage des Betreffs, falls ein Termin nicht gefunden wird. Dies sind fortgeschrittene und sehr effiziente ABAP-Features für die Datenverarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_sflights_to_appointments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_appointments_for_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_guids) TYPE szz_guid_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_to_appointments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointments_for_flights.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    " Select future flights and create appointments using FOR expression
    rt_guids = VALUE szz_guid_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime FROM sflights WHERE fldate >= @lv_current_date )
      LET lo_appointment = NEW cl_appointment(
                                subject     = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }|,
                                description = |Abflug am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } um { ls_flight-fltime TIME = USER } Uhr|,
                                date_from   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                time_from   = ls_flight-fltime,
                                date_to     = ls_flight-fldate,
                                time_to     = ls_flight-fltime + 3600 " Example: 1 hour duration
                              ) IN
        ( lo_appointment->create_appointment( ),
          lo_appointment->save_appointment( ),
          lo_appointment->get_guid( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_daily_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_appointment,
             guid      TYPE szz_guid,
             subject   TYPE string,
             time_from TYPE t,
             time_to   TYPE t,
           END OF ty_daily_appointment.
    TYPES: tt_daily_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_todays_appointments RETURNING VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_daily_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_daily_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_todays_appointments.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_guids) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_in_period(
      i_date_from = lv_today
      i_date_to   = lv_today
    ).

    " Retrieve details and sort by time_from using FOR expression with SORTED BY
    rt_appointments = VALUE tt_daily_appointments(
      FOR lv_guid IN lt_guids
      LET lo_appointment = cl_appointment=>get_instance( lv_guid ) IN
        ( guid      = lv_guid,
          subject   = COND string( WHEN lo_appointment IS BOUND THEN lo_appointment->get_subject( ) ELSE 'N/A' ),
          time_from = COND t( WHEN lo_appointment IS BOUND THEN lo_appointment->get_time_from( ) ELSE '000000' ),
          time_to   = COND t( WHEN lo_appointment IS BOUND THEN lo_appointment->get_time_to( ) ELSE '000000' ) )
      ORDER BY time_from ASCENDING
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_appointment.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_todays_appointments_grouped RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_appointments) TYPE tt_grouped_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_todays_appointments_grouped.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_guids) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_in_period(
      i_date_from = lv_today
      i_date_to   = lv_today
    ).

    " Retrieve details and group by subject using FOR expression with GROUP BY
    rt_grouped_appointments = VALUE tt_grouped_appointments(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_guids GROUP BY (
        subject = COND string( WHEN cl_appointment=>get_instance( ls_group ) IS BOUND THEN cl_appointment=>get_instance( ls_group )->get_subject( ) ELSE 'Unbekannt' )
      ) INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( subject = group_key-subject,
        guids   = VALUE szz_guid_tab( FOR lv_guid IN GROUP ls_group ( lv_guid ) ),
        count   = lines( GROUP ls_group ) )
      ORDER BY subject ASCENDING
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle SFLIGHT) für eine sehr große Liste von Flugverbindungen, die zuvor aus einer anderen Tabelle ermittelt wurden. Demonstrieren Sie die Notwendigkeit der Sortierung und Duplikatsentfernung der Driving Table.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `SORTED TABLE` als Driving Table, um Sortierung und Duplikatsentfernung zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_large_driving DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_driving_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_driving_key.
    TYPES tt_driving_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_driving_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_large_driving IMPORTING it_driving_keys TYPE tt_driving_key
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_large_driving IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_large_driving.
    " it_driving_keys ist bereits sortiert und eindeutig aufgrund ihres Typs.
    " Wäre es eine Standardtabelle, bräuchten wir:
    " SORT it_driving_keys BY carrid connid.
    " DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM it_driving_keys COMPARING carrid connid.

    IF it_driving_keys IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_driving_keys
        WHERE carrid = @it_driving_keys-carrid
          AND connid = @it_driving_keys-connid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_large_driving_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_driving_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_large_driving_table.
    DATA: lt_driving_keys TYPE zcl_fae_large_driving=>tt_driving_key.
    " Populate with some test data, potentially with duplicates for demonstration
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) INTO TABLE lt_driving_keys.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_driving_keys.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) INTO TABLE lt_driving_keys. " Duplicate wird ignoriert durch UNIQUE KEY
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ) INTO TABLE lt_driving_keys.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_large_driving( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_large_driving( lt_driving_keys ).

CLASS zcl_fae_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING AS GROUP
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_count(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = GROUP-carrid count = lines( GROUP ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_join_local DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_currency,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             currtext TYPE scurx-ltext,
           END OF ty_sflight_currency.
    TYPES tt_sflight_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_currency IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights_curr) TYPE tt_sflight_currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_join_local IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_currency.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_currencies TYPE SORTED TABLE OF scurx WITH UNIQUE KEY waers.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Collect unique currencies from flights
      DATA(lt_unique_currencies) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-curr(
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights GROUP BY ( curr = ls_flight-curr ) ASCENDING AS GROUP
        ( GROUP-curr )
      ).

      " Read currency texts for unique currencies
      SELECT waers, ltext
        FROM scurx
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_unique_currencies
        WHERE waers = @lt_unique_currencies-table_line
        INTO TABLE @lt_currencies.
    ENDIF.

    " Combine flights with currency texts
    rt_flights_curr = VALUE tt_sflight_currency(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      LET ls_currency = lt_currencies[ KEY waers COMPONENTS waers = ls_flight-curr ] IN
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        price    = ls_flight-price,
        currency = ls_flight-curr,
        currtext = ls_currency-ltext OPTIONAL )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_top_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
                                   iv_top_n    TYPE i DEFAULT 3
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_top_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_top_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING AS GROUP
      FOR ls_sorted_flight IN SORTED lt_all_flights BY price DESCENDING
      WHERE ( ls_sorted_flight-carrid = GROUP-carrid )
      " Take only the top N flights per group
      UNTIL sy-tabix > iv_top_n
      ( ls_sorted_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
