Instructions: Verwenden Sie Konstanten, um die erlaubten Werte für einen Methodenparameter zu definieren und diese in der Methode zu validieren.
hint: Definieren Sie Konstanten für die erlaubten Werte und prüfen Sie den Parameter gegen diese Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_param_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      status_new      TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
      status_in_process TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
      status_completed  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C'.

    METHODS set_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RAISING
        cx_abap_unit_assert. " Using for simplicity, normally a custom exception

    METHODS get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE c LENGTH 1.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_param_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_status.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN status_new OR status_in_process OR status_completed.
        mv_status = iv_status.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_unit_assert
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Invalid status provided'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_status_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_status_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_status_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_param_constants( ).
    lo_cut->set_status( zcl_method_param_constants=>status_new ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = zcl_method_param_constants=>status_new msg = 'Status should be set to NEW' ).

    lo_cut->set_status( zcl_method_param_constants=>status_completed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = zcl_method_param_constants=>status_completed msg = 'Status should be set to COMPLETED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_status_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_param_constants( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_status( 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for invalid status' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_unit_assert.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught exception for invalid status' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Konstanten zur Definition erlaubter Werte für Methodenparameter verbessert die Typsicherheit und Lesbarkeit des Codes. Anstatt 'Magic Characters' direkt im Code zu verwenden, wird auf benannte Konstanten verwiesen, was die Wartung vereinfacht und Fehler reduziert. Die Validierung gegen diese Konstanten stellt sicher, dass nur gültige Werte übergeben werden.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Method Parameters, Validation, Object Orientation, Readability

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine Zielstruktur mit Werten aus einer Quellstruktur, wobei die nicht in der Quelle vorhandenen Felder der Zielstruktur ihre ursprünglichen Werte behalten sollen. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( target_structure ) source_structure )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE i,
        descr TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data.

    METHODS update_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_data
        is_base   TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_updated) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_data.
    " is_base provides the initial state, is_source provides updates
    rs_updated = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( is_base ) is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_with_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_with_base.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_base( ).
    DATA(ls_base) = VALUE zcl_corr_base=>ty_data( id = 1 name = 'Old Name' value = 100 descr = 'Old Description' ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_base=>ty_data( id = 1 name = 'New Name' value = 200 ). " descr is missing

    DATA(ls_updated) = lo_cut->update_data( is_source = ls_source is_base = ls_base ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-id exp = 1 msg = 'ID should be from source' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-name exp = 'New Name' msg = 'Name should be updated from source' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-value exp = 200 msg = 'Value should be updated from source' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-descr exp = 'Old Description' msg = 'Description should be retained from base' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `BASE` Klausel des `CORRESPONDING` Operators (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, eine Zielstruktur oder -tabelle mit einem initialen Zustand zu versehen, bevor die Felder aus der Quellstruktur zugewiesen werden. Dies ist ideal für Update-Szenarien, bei denen nur bestimmte Felder aktualisiert werden sollen, während andere ihre bestehenden Werte behalten.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, BASE, Data Transfer, Update, Merge, Structure

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für Fehlermeldungen oder Statuscodes in einer Klasse, um eine zentrale Verwaltung und einfache Referenzierung zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Struktur von Konstanten für verwandte Meldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_error_codes,
        invalid_input TYPE string VALUE 'E001',
        data_not_found TYPE string VALUE 'E002',
        permission_denied TYPE string VALUE 'E003',
      END OF gc_error_codes,
      BEGIN OF gc_error_messages,
        invalid_input_msg TYPE string VALUE 'Ungültige Eingabe festgestellt.',
        data_not_found_msg TYPE string VALUE 'Angefragte Daten nicht gefunden.',
        permission_denied_msg TYPE string VALUE 'Keine Berechtigung für diese Aktion.',
      END OF gc_error_messages.

    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_code TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    CASE iv_error_code.
      WHEN gc_error_codes-invalid_input.
        rv_message = gc_error_messages-invalid_input_msg.
      WHEN gc_error_codes-data_not_found.
        rv_message = gc_error_messages-data_not_found_msg.
      WHEN gc_error_codes-permission_denied.
        rv_message = gc_error_messages-permission_denied_msg.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Fehlercode.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_constants( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_error_message( zcl_error_constants=>gc_error_codes-invalid_input ) exp = zcl_error_constants=>gc_error_messages-invalid_input_msg msg = 'Invalid input message expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_error_message( zcl_error_constants=>gc_error_codes-data_not_found ) exp = zcl_error_constants=>gc_error_messages-data_not_found_msg msg = 'Data not found message expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_error_message( 'UNKNOWN' ) exp = 'Unbekannter Fehlercode.' msg = 'Unknown error message expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die zentrale Definition von Fehlermeldungen und Statuscodes als Konstanten in einer Klasse verbessert die Konsistenz und Wartbarkeit der Fehlerbehandlung. Anstatt Meldungstexte oder Codes direkt im Code zu wiederholen, wird auf die Konstanten verwiesen, was Tippfehler reduziert und die Aktualisierung erleichtert.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Error Handling, Messages, Status Codes, Centralization

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere durch, wobei Sie sowohl Feldnamen umbenennen als auch bestimmte Felder ausschließen und dabei Konstanten für die Steuerung der Transformation verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` und nutzen Sie Konstanten für Feldnamen oder Ausschlüsse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
        seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date  TYPE s_date,
        ticket_price TYPE s_price,
        available_seats TYPE s_seatsmax, " New field, not in source
      END OF ty_target_line,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS:
      c_source_carrid TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID',
      c_target_airline_id TYPE string VALUE 'AIRLINE_ID',
      c_exclude_seatsocc TYPE string VALUE 'SEATSOCC'.

    METHODS transform_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflight_data.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                           flight_number = connid
                                           ticket_price = price
                                   EXCEPT seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_complex=>ty_source_table(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_sflight_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'AA' msg = 'Airline ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-flight_number exp = '0017' msg = 'Flight Number should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-flight_date exp = '20250101' msg = 'Flight Date should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-ticket_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Ticket Price should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-available_seats msg = 'Available Seats should be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-flight_date msg = 'Flight Date should be mapped (same name)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit des `CORRESPONDING` Operators in Kombination mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` für komplexe Datentransformationen zwischen internen Tabellen. Obwohl die Konstanten hier nicht direkt in der `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung verwendet werden können (da `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` Literal-Feldnamen erwarten), zeigen sie, wie solche Werte zentral definiert und im Kontext der Transformation dokumentiert werden können. Die Transformation ist kompakt und effizient.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, EXCEPT, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, SFLIGHT, Constants

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` und übertragen Sie diese in eine Ziel-interne Tabelle, wobei nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` übernommen werden sollen. Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date TYPE s_date,
        additional_field TYPE string, " This field will not be mapped by SELECT
      END OF ty_sflight_target,
      ty_sflight_target_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_target_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 2 ROWS.

    LOOP AT rt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-additional_field = 'Processed'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_sflight ) msg = 'Should retrieve some data' ).
    IF lines( lt_sflight ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrid should be AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-connid msg = 'Connid should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-flight_date msg = 'Flight date should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-additional_field exp = 'Processed' msg = 'Additional field should be set' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Anweisung ist eine moderne Möglichkeit, Daten aus der Datenbank in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen automatisch zugewiesen werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Zielstruktur nicht alle Felder der Datenbanktabelle benötigt oder zusätzliche Felder enthält, die nicht von der Datenbank befüllt werden sollen. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist ab ABAP 7.40 erforderlich.
keywords: SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Tables, Database Access, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere durch, wobei Sie sowohl Feldnamen umbenennen als auch bestimmte Felder ausschließen und dabei Konstanten für die Steuerung der Transformation verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` und nutzen Sie Konstanten für Feldnamen oder Ausschlüsse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_complex_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
        seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date  TYPE s_date,
        ticket_price TYPE s_price,
        available_seats TYPE s_seatsmax, " New field, not in source
      END OF ty_target_line,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS:
      c_map_carrid_to_airline_id TYPE string VALUE 'AIRLINE_ID = CARRID',
      c_map_connid_to_flight_number TYPE string VALUE 'FLIGHT_NUMBER = CONNID',
      c_map_price_to_ticket_price TYPE string VALUE 'TICKET_PRICE = PRICE',
      c_exclude_seatsocc TYPE string VALUE 'SEATSOCC'.

    METHODS transform_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_complex_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflight_data.
    " Note: MAPPING and EXCEPT clauses require literal field names, not variables/constants directly.
    " This example demonstrates how constants can document the intended mapping/exclusion.
    " For dynamic mapping, RTTI or dynamic programming would be needed.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                           flight_number = connid
                                           ticket_price = price
                                   EXCEPT seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_complex_mapping_with_constants.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_complex_constants( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_complex_constants=>ty_source_table(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_sflight_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'AA' msg = 'Airline ID should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-flight_number exp = '0017' msg = 'Flight Number should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-flight_date exp = '20250101' msg = 'Flight Date should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-ticket_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Ticket Price should be mapped' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-available_seats msg = 'Available Seats should be initial' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Konstanten verwendet werden können, um die Absicht hinter komplexen `CORRESPONDING` Operationen zu dokumentieren, selbst wenn die `MAPPING`- und `EXCEPT`-Klauseln selbst Literal-Feldnamen erfordern. Die Konstanten dienen hier als 'Named Constants' für die Feldnamen, die in der Transformation verwendet werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert. Die Transformation selbst nutzt die modernen `CORRESPONDING` Features für effiziente Datenzuweisung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache XLSX-Datei mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_XLSX_DOCUMENT` zum Erstellen des Dokuments und `ADD_SHEET` sowie `SET_CELL` zum Befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflight_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_xlsx
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflight_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflight  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_row      TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col      TYPE i VALUE 1.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
    lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHT Data' ).

    " Write Header
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col   ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col+1 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col+2 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Read Data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Write Data
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col   ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col+1 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col+2 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_create_xlsx FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_sflight_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->create_sflight_xlsx( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_xstring msg = 'XLSX-Daten sollten nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( xstrlen( lv_xstring ) > 0 )
                                     msg = 'XLSX-Daten sollten eine Größe > 0 haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei mit zwei Blättern: eines für SFLIGHT-Daten und eines für SCARR-Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_SHEET` mehrmals, um separate Worksheets zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_sheet_xlsx
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet_sf TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_sheet_sc TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflight  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_scarr    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr,
          lv_row      TYPE i,
          lv_col      TYPE i.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.

    " Sheet 1: SFLIGHT
    lo_sheet_sf = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    lv_row = 1. lv_col = 1.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, deren Spaltenüberschriften dynamisch aus den Feldnamen einer internen Tabelle generiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) um Feldnamen zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_header_xlsx
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_header_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx       TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet      TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflight    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lv_row        TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col        TYPE i VALUE 1.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
    lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Dynamic Header' ).

    " Get field names using RTTI
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Write Header
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    lv_col = 1. " Reset column for data

    " Read Data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Write Data
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        DATA(lv_value) = CAST cl_abap_datadescr( ls_component-type )->get_value_as_string( REF #( ls_sflight ) ).
        lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
      lv_col = 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird (dynamische Tabelle).
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) mit `CL_XLSX_DOCUMENT` und dynamischem Datenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table_xlsx
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx         TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet        TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          dref_table      TYPE REF TO data,
          lv_row          TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col          TYPE i VALUE 1.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
    lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Dynamic Table' ).

    " Get structure description for SFLIGHT
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA dref_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN dref_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill dynamic table with data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Write Header
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    lv_col = 1.

    " Write Data from dynamic table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <lv_field_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
      lv_col = 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie den Speicherverbrauch von zwei internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Zeilentypen (z.B. flache vs. tiefe Struktur).
hint: Erstellen Sie zwei Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen und messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch beider.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flat_line,
         field1 TYPE string,
         field2 TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flat_line.
TYPES: tt_flat_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flat_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_deep_sub_line,
         sub_field1 TYPE string,
         sub_field2 TYPE i,
       END OF ty_deep_sub_line.
TYPES: tt_deep_sub_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_deep_sub_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_deep_line,
         main_field TYPE string,
         sub_table  TYPE tt_deep_sub_table,
       END OF ty_deep_line.
TYPES: tt_deep_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_deep_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_table_memory
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_comparison) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_memory.
    DATA: lt_flat TYPE tt_flat_table,
          lt_deep TYPE tt_deep_table.

    " Fill flat table
    lt_flat = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 100
                         ( field1 = |Flat { i }| field2 = i ) ).

    " Fill deep table
    lt_deep = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 100
                         ( main_field = |Deep { i }|
                           sub_table = VALUE #( FOR j = 1 UNTIL j > 5
                                                  ( sub_field1 = |Sub { i }-{ j }| sub_field2 = j ) ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_flat_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_flat ).
    DATA(lv_deep_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_deep ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_result,
             flat_table_memory TYPE i,
             deep_table_memory TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_result.
    DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_memory_result( flat_table_memory = lv_flat_memory
                                              deep_table_memory = lv_deep_memory ).
    CREATE DATA rs_memory_comparison LIKE ls_result.
    ASSIGN ls_result TO CAST ty_memory_result( rs_memory_comparison )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_memory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_memory.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_table_compare( ).
    DATA(dref_result) = lo_cut->compare_table_memory( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_result> TYPE zcl_mem_table_compare=>ty_memory_result.
    ASSIGN dref_result->* TO <ls_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-flat_table_memory > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicherverbrauch flacher Tabelle sollte > 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-deep_table_memory > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicherverbrauch tiefer Tabelle sollte > 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-deep_table_memory > <ls_result>-flat_table_memory )
                                     msg = 'Tiefe Tabelle sollte mehr Speicher verbrauchen als flache Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht den Speicherverbrauch von flachen und tiefen internen Tabellen. Es zeigt, dass tiefe Strukturen aufgrund der zusätzlichen Referenzen und der verschachtelten Daten in der Regel mehr Speicher benötigen. `VALUE` und `FOR` werden für die moderne Initialisierung der Tabellen verwendet.
keywords: Memory, Internal Table, Deep Structure, Flat Structure, Comparison, CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES, VALUE, FOR

CLASS zcl_xlsx_conditional_format IMPLEMENTATION.

    lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col+2 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_sheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col   ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).

Instructions: Messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle vor und nach dem Löschen von Duplikaten mit `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle mit Duplikaten, messen Sie, löschen Sie Duplikate, messen Sie erneut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_deduplicate_memory_diff
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_diff) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_deduplicate_memory_diff.
    DATA: lt_sflight_with_dups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_sflight_deduped   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Fill table with duplicates (e.g., by selecting same data multiple times)
    DO 5 TIMES.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_with_dups UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_memory_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_sflight_with_dups ).

    " Copy and deduplicate
    lt_sflight_deduped = lt_sflight_with_dups.
    SORT lt_sflight_deduped BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_sflight_deduped COMPARING carrid connid.

    DATA(lv_memory_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_sflight_deduped ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_result,
             memory_before TYPE i,
             memory_after  TYPE i,
             memory_diff   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_result.
    DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_memory_result( memory_before = lv_memory_before
                                              memory_after  = lv_memory_after
                                              memory_diff   = lv_memory_before - lv_memory_after ).
    CREATE DATA rs_memory_diff LIKE ls_result.
    ASSIGN ls_result TO CAST ty_memory_result( rs_memory_diff )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deduplicate_memory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deduplicate_memory.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_deduplicate( ).
    DATA(dref_result) = lo_cut->get_deduplicate_memory_diff( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_result> TYPE zcl_mem_deduplicate=>ty_memory_result.
    ASSIGN dref_result->* TO <ls_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-memory_before > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicher vor Deduplizierung sollte > 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-memory_after > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicher nach Deduplizierung sollte > 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-memory_diff > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicherunterschied sollte > 0 sein (Duplikate wurden entfernt)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Effizienz der Datenbereinigung in Bezug auf den Speicherverbrauch. Durch das Entfernen von Duplikaten mit `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` kann der Speicherbedarf einer internen Tabelle erheblich reduziert werden, was mit `CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES` messbar ist.
keywords: Memory, Deduplicate, Internal Table, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES

Instructions: Messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch einer Hash-Tabelle im Vergleich zu einer Standardtabelle mit denselben Daten.
hint: Erstellen Sie beide Tabellentypen, befüllen Sie sie mit identischen Daten und vergleichen Sie den Speicherverbrauch.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
         key_field TYPE string,
         value_field TYPE string,
       END OF ty_data.
TYPES: tt_standard_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: tt_hash_table     TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_table_type_memory
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_comparison) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_type_memory.
    DATA: lt_standard TYPE tt_standard_table,
          lt_hashed   TYPE tt_hash_table.

    " Fill both tables with data
    DO 1000 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_key) = |KEY_{ sy-index }|.
      DATA(lv_value) = |VALUE_{ sy-index }_long_text_to_fill_memory|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( key_field = lv_key value_field = lv_value ) TO lt_standard.
      INSERT VALUE ty_data( key_field = lv_key value_field = lv_value ) INTO TABLE lt_hashed.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_standard_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_standard ).
    DATA(lv_hashed_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lt_hashed ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_result,
             standard_table_memory TYPE i,
             hashed_table_memory   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_result.
    DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_memory_result( standard_table_memory = lv_standard_memory
                                              hashed_table_memory   = lv_hashed_memory ).
    CREATE DATA rs_memory_comparison LIKE ls_result.
    ASSIGN ls_result TO CAST ty_memory_result( rs_memory_comparison )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_type_memory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_type_memory.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_table_types( ).
    DATA(dref_result) = lo_cut->compare_table_type_memory( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_result> TYPE zcl_mem_table_types=>ty_memory_result.
    ASSIGN dref_result->* TO <ls_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-standard_table_memory > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicher Standardtabelle sollte > 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <ls_result>-hashed_table_memory > 0 )
                                     msg = 'Speicher Hash-Tabelle sollte > 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht den Speicherverbrauch verschiedener interner Tabellentypen. Hash-Tabellen haben oft einen höheren Overhead pro Eintrag aufgrund der Hash-Struktur, können aber bei großen Datenmengen und häufigen Zugriffen über den Schlüssel performanter sein. `CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES` hilft, diese Unterschiede zu quantifizieren.
keywords: Memory, Internal Table, Hash Table, Standard Table, Comparison, CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die sich basierend auf dem angemeldeten Benutzer unterschiedlich verhält. Für Benutzer 'DEVELOPER' soll eine spezielle Nachricht ausgegeben werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name( )` mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung oder `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctx_dynamic_user_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_user_specific_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctx_dynamic_user_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_user_specific_message.
    DATA(lv_user) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name( ).

    CASE lv_user.
      WHEN 'DEVELOPER'. " Beispielbenutzer
        rv_message = 'Willkommen, Entwickler! Spezielle Funktionen sind aktiv.'.
      WHEN sy-uname. " Aktueller Benutzer, falls nicht 'DEVELOPER'
        rv_message = |Hallo { lv_user }, normale Funktionen sind aktiv.|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Benutzer, eingeschränkte Funktionen.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_user_specific_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_user_specific_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctx_dynamic_user_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_user_specific_message( ).

    IF sy-uname = 'DEVELOPER'. " Annahme: Testbenutzer ist 'DEVELOPER'
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Willkommen, Entwickler! Spezielle Funktionen sind aktiv.' msg = 'Nachricht für DEVELOPER stimmt nicht' ).
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_expected_message) = |Hallo { sy-uname }, normale Funktionen sind aktiv.|.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = lv_expected_message msg = 'Nachricht für normalen Benutzer stimmt nicht' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name()` mit modernen Kontrollstrukturen wie `CASE` oder `IF` ermöglicht die Implementierung von rollen- oder benutzerspezifischen Logiken. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in der Anwendungsentwicklung. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische Nachrichtengenerierung verwendet, was den Code lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Erfassen Sie relevante Kontextinformationen (Benutzer, System, Programm, Transaktion, Modus) und serialisieren Sie diese in einen JSON-String für Logging-Zwecke.

CLASS zcl_log_context_as_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_context_log,
             timestamp    TYPE timestampl,
             user_name    TYPE sy-uname,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_log_context_as_json IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_context_data) = VALUE ty_context_log(
      timestamp    = cl_abap_context_info=>get_timestamp( )

      system_id    = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_id( )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_context_as_json( ).

Dies ist ideal für zentralisiertes Logging oder Monitoring. Die Verwendung von `COND string(...)` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature (ab 7.50), das bedingte Zuweisungen in einer kompakten Form ermöglicht.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in JSON, wobei ein Feld explizit ignoriert werden soll (z.B. ein internes Feld, das nicht im JSON erscheinen soll).
hint: Die Klasse `/ui2/cl_abap2json` bietet keine direkte Option zum Ignorieren von Feldern. Eine moderne Lösung ist, eine Hilfsstruktur zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Felder enthält, oder eine Transformation zu verwenden. Hier wird eine Hilfsstruktur verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_ignore_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_full_data,
             id          TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             _internal_field TYPE string, " Dieses Feld soll ignoriert werden
           END OF ty_full_data,
           BEGIN OF ty_public_data,
             id          TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_public_data.

    METHODS serialize_public_data
      IMPORTING
        is_full_data TYPE ty_full_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_ignore_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_public_data.
    DATA(ls_public_data) = CORRESPONDING ty_public_data( is_full_data ).
    rv_json = /ui2/cl_abap2json=>serialize( ls_public_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialize_public_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_public_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_ignore_field( ).
    DATA(ls_full_data) = VALUE zcl_json_ignore_field=>ty_full_data(
      id = 'ITEM001'
      name = 'Test Item'
      _internal_field = 'Secret Value'
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_public_data( ls_full_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = '{"ID":"ITEM001","NAME":"Test Item"}' msg = 'JSON sollte internes Feld ignorieren' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ( lv_json CS '_INTERNAL_FIELD' ) msg = 'Internes Feld sollte nicht im JSON sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da `/ui2/cl_abap2json` alle Felder einer übergebenen Struktur serialisiert, ist der moderne Ansatz zum Ignorieren bestimmter Felder die Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` (ab 7.40) oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` in Kombination mit einer Hilfsstruktur. `CORRESPONDING` ist hier die präferierte, kompakte Syntax, um nur die relevanten Felder in eine neue Struktur zu kopieren, die dann serialisiert wird. Dies gewährleistet, dass nur die gewünschten Daten im JSON-Output erscheinen.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, Field Ignore, CORRESPONDING, /ui2/cl_abap2json, Structure Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen ALV-Bericht mit `cl_gui_alv_grid`, der Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung und die Initialisierung des Feldkatalogs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data)` und `VALUE #()` für den Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_simple_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    " Datenbeschaffung mit moderner SELECT-Syntax
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Container und ALV-Grid instanziieren
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Muss in einem Dynpro existieren

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Feldkatalog mit VALUE #() erstellen
    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
    ).

    " ALV anzeigen
    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_sflights FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_sflights.
    " Da ALV-Anzeige UI-abhängig ist, kann die direkte Anzeige nicht getestet werden.
    " Hier wird nur die Instanziierung und Datenbeschaffung simuliert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_simple_report( ).
    " Ein echter Unit-Test würde hier Mocking für UI-Objekte verwenden.
    " Für diese Demo prüfen wir nur, ob die Methode ohne Dump läuft.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflights( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method should run without dump' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_gui_alv_grid` für die Anzeige von Daten. Die Datenbeschaffung erfolgt mit der modernen `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data)`-Syntax, die eine Inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle ermöglicht. Der Feldkatalog wird effizient mit einem `VALUE #()`-Konstruktor erstellt, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Obwohl die UI-Interaktion nicht direkt im Unit-Test geprüft werden kann, zeigt die Lösung moderne Praktiken für die Datenvorbereitung und ALV-Initialisierung.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `PRICE` und `CURRENCY` von `SFLIGHTS`-Einträgen für eine bestimmte `CARRID` und `CONNID` unter Verwendung der modernen `UPDATE`-Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen und `CONDENSE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE dbtab SET field = @( ... ) WHERE ...` und `CONDENSE` für String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
        iv_new_curr  TYPE s_currkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = iv_carrid.
    DATA(lv_connid) = iv_connid.

    " Sicherstellen, dass die Werte keine führenden/nachfolgenden Leerzeichen haben
    CONDENSE lv_carrid.
    CONDENSE lv_connid.

    UPDATE sflights SET
      price    = @iv_new_price,
      currency = @iv_new_curr
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid
      AND connid = @lv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_no_change FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup. " Setup method to prepare test data
    METHODS teardown. " Teardown method to clean up test data

    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
          mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0400',
          mv_fldate TYPE s_date    VALUE '20251224'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Insert a test record if it doesn't exist
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      UPDATE sflights SET price = 100, currency = 'EUR' WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Clean up test record
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 250.00.
    DATA(lv_new_curr) = 'USD'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_new_price = lv_new_price iv_new_curr = lv_new_curr ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    " Verify the update
    SELECT SINGLE price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check)
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid
      AND connid = @mv_connid
      AND fldate = @mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check-price    exp = lv_new_price msg = 'Price should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check-currency exp = lv_new_curr  msg = 'Currency should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_no_change.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 100.00. " Original price
    DATA(lv_new_curr) = 'EUR'.   " Original currency

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_price = lv_new_price iv_new_curr = lv_new_curr ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Update should not find any record' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne `UPDATE`-Syntax, bei der Hostvariablen direkt mit `@` referenziert werden können, ohne dass `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` erforderlich ist. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine ALV-Anzeige mit `cl_gui_alv_grid` und fangen Sie das `DATA_CHANGED`-Ereignis ab. Filtern Sie die geänderten Zeilen, um nur solche zu verarbeiten, bei denen der `PRICE` geändert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für Ereignisse und `FILTER #()` für die effiziente Verarbeitung der geänderten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_data_changed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_editable_sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_old_values
        e_full_data_changed
        e_by_user.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_changed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_editable_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF mt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' edit = abap_false )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer'       edit = abap_false )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum'        edit = abap_false )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis'            edit = abap_true )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung'        edit = abap_false )
    ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights.

    " Ereignishandler registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR mo_alv_grid.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    IF e_by_user = abap_true.
      " Geänderte Zeilen filtern, bei denen der Preis geändert wurde
      DATA(lt_changed_prices) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM e_full_data_changed
        WHERE ( table_line-price <> e_old_values[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate ]-price ).

      IF lt_changed_prices IS NOT INITIAL.
        MESSAGE |{ lines( lt_changed_prices ) } Zeile(n) mit geändertem Preis erkannt.| TYPE 'S'.
        " Hier könnte die Logik zur Datenbank-UPDATE oder weiteren Verarbeitung erfolgen
        " Beispiel: UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_changed_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen ALV-Bericht, dessen Spalten dynamisch basierend auf einer Konfiguration definiert werden. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `SWITCH` für die dynamische Feldkatalog-Erstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle für die Konfiguration und `SWITCH #()` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_field,
             fieldname TYPE fieldname,
             visible   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_config_field,
           ty_config_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_config TYPE ty_config_fields.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Dynamischer Feldkatalog mit SWITCH und LINE_EXISTS
    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR ls_sflight_comp IN CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ) )->get_components( )
      LET lv_fieldname = ls_sflight_comp-name IN
      ( fieldname = lv_fieldname
        tech_fieldname = lv_fieldname
        outputlen = SWITCH #( lv_fieldname
                               WHEN 'CARRID' THEN 4
                               WHEN 'CONNID' THEN 4
                               WHEN 'FLDATE' THEN 10
                               WHEN 'PRICE' THEN 16
                               WHEN 'CURRENCY' THEN 5
                               ELSE 10 )
        no_out = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_config[ fieldname = lv_fieldname ] ) AND it_config[ fieldname = lv_fieldname ]-visible = abap_false THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein Feldkatalog für `cl_gui_alv_grid` dynamisch zur Laufzeit erstellt werden kann. Es verwendet `cl_abap_structdescr` und `get_components` zur Reflexion der Struktur `SFLIGHTS`. Die moderne `FOR`-Expression wird verwendet, um den Feldkatalog zu füllen. Innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife kommen `SWITCH #()` zum Einsatz, um die `outputlen` basierend auf dem Feldnamen zu setzen, und `COND #()` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` (ab ABAP 7.50) zur bedingten Ausblendung von Spalten basierend auf der übergebenen Konfiguration. Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die `PRICE` für jede `CARRID` aus `SFLIGHTS` und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem ALV-Bericht an. Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #()` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife über die gruppierten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg,
           ty_sflight_aggs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    SELECT carrid price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Aggregation mit REDUCE
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE ty_sflight_aggs(
      INIT lt_result = VALUE ty_sflight_aggs( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      LET lv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                             INIT sum = 0
                             FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                             NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_flight-price ) IN
      ( APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_agg(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          total_price = lv_total_price
          flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) ) TO lt_result )
    ).

    IF lt_aggregated_data IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine aggregierten Daten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'      seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' seltext_l = 'Gesamtpreis' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_COUNT' seltext_l = 'Anzahl Flüge' )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_REDUCE_AGG=>TY_SFLIGHT_AGG'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_aggregated_data.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_agg( ).
    " Da die Methode UI-abhängig ist, testen wir hier nur die Aggregationslogik separat.
    " Simulation der Rohdaten
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY (

CLASS zcl_alv_cond_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_cond_formatted_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price DEFAULT 500.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cond_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_cond_formatted_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Layout-Tabelle für Zeilenfarben
    DATA(lt_layout_colors) = VALUE lvc_t_srow(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( fieldname = '' " Leerer Feldname für Zeilenfarbe
        color = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 3 " Rot
                        ELSE 0 ) ) ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_layout) = VALUE lvc_s_layo(
      ctabs_fname = 'LINE_COLORS' " Name der Spalte in der Ausgabetabelle, die die Zeilenfarben enthält
    ).

    " Hinzufügen der Layout-Farben zur Ausgabetabelle (falls nicht direkt in der Struktur)
    " Für diese Demo wird eine separate Tabelle verwendet und über ctabs_fname referenziert.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man die Farbe direkt in die Ausgabetabelle aufnehmen.
    " Hier wird es vereinfacht, indem wir die Layout-Tabelle direkt übergeben.
    " Dies ist eine Vereinfachung für den Unit-Test, da ctabs_fname eine Spalte in der Ausgabetabelle erwartet.
    " Ein realistischeres Szenario würde eine erweiterte Struktur für lt_sflights benötigen.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_layout        = ls_layout
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights.

    " Manuelle Zuweisung der Zeilenfarben (Workaround für ctabs_fname im Unit-Test-Kontext)
    " In einem echten Programm würde man die Farbe direkt in die Ausgabetabelle aufnehmen
    " oder eine separate Tabelle für die Farben übergeben und diese im ALV-Layout referenzieren.
    " Für den Unit-Test ist dies schwierig zu prüfen, daher nur die Logik.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        butn_type = 0
        text  = |Mein Custom Button|

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung von `SFLIGHTS`-Datensätzen durch und sammeln Sie alle Fehler, die während des `UPDATE`-Vorgangs auftreten, in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `FOR` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... ACCEPTING CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und `TRY...CATCH` um `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` abzufangen. Sammeln Sie Fehler mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_mass_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_update_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             success TYPE abap_bool,
             error_msg TYPE string,
           END OF ty_update_result,
           ty_update_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_update_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE ty_update_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_mass_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_sflights.
    DATA: lt_successful_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lt_failed_updates   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update).
      TRY.
          UPDATE sflights SET
            price    = @ls_update-price,
            currency = @ls_update-currency
            WHERE carrid = @ls_update-carrid
            AND connid = @ls_update-connid
            AND fldate = @ls_update-fldate.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND ls_update TO lt_successful_updates.
            APPEND VALUE ty_update_result( carrid = ls_update-carrid connid = ls_update-connid fldate = ls_update-fldate success = abap_true ) TO rt_results.
          ELSE.
            APPEND ls_update TO lt_failed_updates.
            APPEND VALUE ty_update_result( carrid = ls_update-carrid connid = ls_update-connid fldate = ls_update-fldate success = abap_false error_msg = 'Record not found or no change' ) TO rt_results.
          ENDIF.

        CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
          APPEND ls_update TO lt_failed_updates.
          APPEND VALUE ty_update_result( carrid = ls_update-carrid connid = ls_update-connid fldate = ls_update-fldate success = abap_false error_msg = lx_sql_error->get_text( ) ) TO rt_results.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: mv_carrid1 TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid1 connid = mv_connid1 fldate = mv_fldate1 price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = mv_carrid2 connid = mv_connid2 fldate = mv_fldate2 price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = mv_carrid1 AND connid = mv_connid1 AND fldate = mv_fldate1.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = mv_carrid2 AND connid = mv_connid2 AND fldate = mv_fldate2.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_update_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_mass_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights (
      ( carrid = mv_carrid1 connid = mv_connid1 fldate = mv_fldate1 price = 150 currency = 'GBP' ) " Existing record, should update
      ( carrid = mv_carrid2 connid = mv_connid2 fldate = mv_fldate2 price = 250 currency = 'CAD' ) " Existing record, should update
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250101' price = 500 currency = 'JPY' ) " Non-existing record, should fail to update
    ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->mass_update_sflights( it_updates = lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should process all 3 updates' ).

    " Check first update
    DATA(ls_result1) = lt_results[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_result1-success msg = 'First update should be successful' ).

    " Check second update
    DATA(ls_result2) = lt_results[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_result2-success msg = 'Second update should be successful' ).

    " Check third update (non-existing record)
    DATA(ls_result3) = lt_results[ 3 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ls_result3-success msg = 'Third update should fail' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_result3-error_msg msg = 'Error message should be present for failed update' ).

    " Verify actual database changes
    SELECT SINGLE price, currency FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check1) WHERE carrid = mv_carrid1 AND connid = mv_connid1 AND fldate = mv_fldate1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check1-price exp = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check1-currency exp = 'GBP' ).

    SELECT SINGLE price, currency FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check2) WHERE carrid = mv_carrid2 AND connid = mv_connid2 AND fldate = mv_fldate2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check2-price exp = 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check2-currency exp = 'CAD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine robuste Massenaktualisierung von Datenbankdatensätzen mit `UPDATE` und integrierter Fehlerbehandlung. Jede `UPDATE`-Operation wird in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block gekapselt, um `cx_sy_sql_error` abzufangen, falls Datenbankfehler auftreten. Das Ergebnis jeder Aktualisierung (Erfolg oder Fehler mit Meldung) wird in einer strukturierten internen Tabelle gesammelt. Dies ist entscheidend für die Nachverfolgung und Berichterstattung über den Erfolg von Massenoperationen. `COMMIT WORK` stellt sicher, dass die Änderungen dauerhaft in der Datenbank gespeichert werden.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine hierarchische ALV-Liste an, die Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` darstellt. Nutzen Sie moderne interne Tabellenoperationen zur Vorbereitung der Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_alv_grid` mit `i_structure_name` für die Kopfzeile und `i_structure_name_alv` für die Positionen. Bereiten Sie die Daten mit `FOR` und `VALUE` vor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_hierarchical DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             key_h TYPE lvc_value,
           END OF ty_header,
           ty_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key_h TYPE lvc_value,
             key_i TYPE lvc_value,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_hierarchical_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_hierarchical IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_hierarchical_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Kopfdaten vorbereiten mit FOR GROUPS OF
    DATA(lt_headers) = REDUCE ty_headers(
      INIT lt_h = VALUE ty_headers( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      LET lv_carrname = VALUE scarr-carrname( SELECT SINGLE carrname FROM scarr WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
          lv_key_h = |{ ls_flight-carrid }| IN
      ( APPEND VALUE ty_header(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          carrname = lv_carrname
          num_flights = lines( GROUP ls_flight )
          key_h = lv_key_h ) TO lt_h )
    ).

    " Positionsdaten vorbereiten mit FOR
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE ty_items(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      LET lv_key_h = |{ ls_flight-carrid }|
          lv_key_i = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }| IN
      ( key_h = lv_key_h
        key_i = lv_key_i
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = ls_flight-price
        currency = ls_flight-currency ) ).

    IF lt_headers IS INITIAL OR lt_items IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine hierarchischen Daten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Layout für hierarchisches ALV
    DATA(ls_layout) = VALUE lvc_s_layo(
      fcat_x = abap_true " Feldkatalog wird explizit übergeben
      s_aufl = 'X' " Hierarchische Anzeige
      s_aufl_alv = 'X' " Hierarchische Anzeige
      header_fieldname = 'KEY_H'
      item_fieldname = 'KEY_H'
      item_num_fieldname = 'KEY_I'
    ).

    " Feldkatalog für Kopfzeilen
    DATA(lt_fieldcat_h) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'     seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRNAME'   seltext_l = 'Name' )
      ( fieldname = 'NUM_FLIGHTS' seltext_l = 'Anzahl Flüge' )
    ).

    " Feldkatalog für Positionszeilen
    DATA(lt_fieldcat_i) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_HIERARCHICAL=>TY_HEADER'
        i_structure_name_alv = 'ZCL_ALV_HIERARCHICAL=>TY_ITEM'
        is_layout        = ls_layout
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat_h
        it_fieldcatalog_alv = lt_fieldcat_i
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_headers
        it_outtab_alv    = lt_items.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten filtern mit FILTER #()
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
      WHERE price > 300
      AND ( currency = 'EUR' OR currency = 'USD' ) ).

    IF lt_filtered_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine gefilterten Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_filtered_sflights.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_add_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             sflights,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext,
           ty_sflights_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_with_status.

CLASS zcl_alv_add_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_status.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights_raw IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Neue Spalte 'STATUS' hinzufügen und füllen mit FOR und COND
    DATA(lt_sflights_with_status) = VALUE ty_sflights_ext(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( sflights = ls_flight
        status = COND string(
          WHEN ls_flight-price > 500 THEN 'Expensive'
          ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).

    IF lt_sflights_with_status IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Daten mit Status gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
      ( fieldname = 'STATUS'   seltext_l = 'Status' )
    ).

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_ADD_COLUMN=>TY_SFLIGHT_EXT'
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights_with_status.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_search_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_search
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_term TYPE string OPTIONAL.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_search_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_search.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF mt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   seltext_l = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   seltext_l = 'Flugdatum' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    seltext_l = 'Preis' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' seltext_l = 'Währung' )
    ).

    IF iv_search_term IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_filtered_data) = FILTER #( mt_sflights
        WHERE carrid CP iv_search_term OR
              connid CP iv_search_term ).
      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
          it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_filtered_data.
    ELSE.
      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
          it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = mt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'.

      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(

      ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   seltext_l = 'Flugnummer' )

hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_BUTTON`, definieren Sie ein Event-Handler-Interface und registrieren Sie den Handler mit `SET HANDLER`.

INTERFACE lif_button_handler.

CLASS zcl_gui_button_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_button_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_parent_container
        text   = 'Click Me!'.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button.
    ro_button = mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_click_count = mv_click_count + 1.
*   In a real application, you would update a field on the screen
*   or trigger further logic here.
*   For unit testing, we just increment a counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_button_click_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_click_handling.
    " Mock a container for testing purposes
    DATA(lo_mock_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'MOCK_CONTAINER' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_button_handler( lo_mock_container ).

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_button->raise_event_click.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Event should be raised without error' act = abap_true exp = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    " We cannot directly access mv_click_count from outside the class in a unit test
    " without adding a getter, which would be for testing purposes only.
    " The primary test here is that the event handling mechanism is correctly set up
    " and doesn't cause runtime errors when the event is triggered.

    " Clean up mock container
    CALL METHOD lo_mock_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
