Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tt` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck über die Tabelle und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE sflights_tt
                iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT s = s + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflights_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected total seats for LH is 150' act = lv_result exp = 150 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected total seats for AA is 200' act = lv_result exp = 200 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected total seats for non-existent carrier is 0' act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Klausel können komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, gut lesbaren Anweisung ausgedrückt werden, was die Funktionalität und Effizienz erhöht.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Status ('Overbooked' oder 'Available') basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitzplätze und der maximalen Kapazität zu, unter Verwendung des `COND` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING iv_seats_occupied TYPE s_seatsocc
                iv_capacity       TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_seats_occupied > iv_capacity THEN 'Overbooked'
      ELSE 'Available'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 100 iv_capacity = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected Available for full flight' act = lv_result exp = 'Available' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 101 iv_capacity = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected Overbooked for overbooked flight' act = lv_result exp = 'Overbooked' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occupied = 50 iv_capacity = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected Available for partially filled flight' act = lv_result exp = 'Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator bietet eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Möglichkeit, Werte basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu einfachen `IF`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes, insbesondere bei kurzen, bedingten Zuweisungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Data Assignment

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Flugstruktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und geben Sie dessen Wert als String zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING is_flight_data TYPE sflight
                iv_field_name  TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur vorhanden.|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_field_value = <fs_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planes = 300 seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 150
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected CARRID value' act = lv_result exp = 'LH' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'PRICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected PRICE value' act = lv_result exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_field_value_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planes = 300 seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 150
    ).

    " Expecting an exception for an invalid field name
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_assign_error ).
    lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'INVALID_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programmierung. Die moderne Verwendung beinhaltet die explizite Fehlerbehandlung mit Exceptions (`RAISING cx_sy_assign_error`), was zu robusterem Code führt.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, sflight, Exceptions

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein einfaches Interface für eine Flugaktion und implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` zur Definition und `INTERFACES` zur Implementierung in der Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_action.
  METHODS execute_action
    IMPORTING iv_flight_id TYPE s_conn_id
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_book_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_action.

    METHODS zif_flight_action~execute_action
      REDEFINITION.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_booked_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_book_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_action~execute_action.
    " Simulate booking a flight
    IF NOT line_exists( mv_booked_flights[ table_line = iv_flight_id ] ).
      APPEND iv_flight_id TO mv_booked_flights.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_booking FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_booking.
    DATA: lo_book_flight TYPE REF TO zcl_book_flight,
          li_flight_action TYPE REF TO zif_flight_action.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_book_flight.
    li_flight_action ?= lo_book_flight.

    DATA(lv_success) = li_flight_action->execute_action( '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First booking should be successful' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    lv_success = li_flight_action->execute_action( '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second booking of same flight should fail' act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).

    lv_success = li_flight_action->execute_action( '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Booking new flight should be successful' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces (`INTERFACE`) definieren Verträge für Klassen, die sie implementieren (`INTERFACES`). Dies fördert Polymorphie und lose Kopplung, was zu flexibleren und wartbareren objektorientierten Designs führt. Die Implementierung der Interface-Methode erfolgt mit `REDEFINITION`.
keywords: INTERFACES, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, ABAP Objects

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights_tt`), um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') zu erhalten, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE sflights_tt
                iv_carrier     TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflights_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 flights for LH' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered carrier should be LH' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 flight for AA' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected 0 flights for non-existent carrier' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `DELETE ... WHERE` und führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code, der die Absicht klarer ausdrückt.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tt` unter Verwendung eines `FOR` Ausdrucks und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die Summe und zählen Sie die Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE sflights_tt
                iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT s = s + flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i(
      INIT c = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT c = c + 1
    ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_price( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflights_tt(

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected average price for non-existent carrier is 0' act = lv_result exp = '0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` Operatoren, um sowohl die Summe als auch die Anzahl der Elemente in einer internen Tabelle zu ermitteln, die einer bestimmten Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, die den Code prägnanter macht.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
           tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count(
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    " Assuming 'LH' exists and has flights
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE zcl_group_flights=>ty_carrier_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH carrier should be in result' act = xsdbool( sy-subrc = 0 ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH flight count should be greater than 0' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und vereinfacht Aggregationen und Gruppierungslogik erheblich. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Grouping, Internal Tables, sflights, DATA

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes einer Struktur zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type
      IMPORTING is_data       TYPE any
                iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_data_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_data_descr.

        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_type_name = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ).
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur vorhanden.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected type for CARRID is S_CARR_ID' act = lv_result exp = 'S_CARR_ID' ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Mit Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` kann man die Struktur und die Typen von Komponenten einer Datenstruktur ermitteln. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Frameworks und dynamische Anwendungen.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, Dynamic Programming, Exceptions

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Knotens.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML-Strings und navigieren Sie mit `get_element_by_tag_name` und `get_text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_get_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_get_value.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_xml_node     TYPE REF TO if_xml_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        lo_xml_node = lo_xml_document->get_element_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).
        IF lo_xml_node IS BOUND.
          rv_value = lo_xml_node->get_text( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        rv_value = |Error: { lx_xml_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methoden `create_element`, `create_text_node` und `append_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sflight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_flight_node  TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_field_node   TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_text_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_flight_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_root_node->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      lo_field_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'CarrierID' ).
      lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_field_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_field_node ).

      lo_field_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'ConnectionID' ).
      lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( |{ ls_sflight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ).
      lo_field_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_field_node ).

      lo_field_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'FlightDate' ).
      lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).
      lo_field_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_field_node ).

      lo_field_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( |{ ls_sflight-price }| ).
      lo_field_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_field_node ).

      lo_field_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Currency' ).
      lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( ls_sflight-currency ).
      lo_field_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_field_node ).

    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251225' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die interne Tabelle und String-Templates mit Formatierungsoptionen (`ALPHA = OUT`, `DATE = ISO`) sind moderne ABAP-Features ab 7.40/7.50, die den Code lesbarer und kompakter machen.
keywords: XML, Creation, cl_xml_document, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, String Templates

Instructions: Lesen Sie XML-Attribute und -Knotenwerte aus einem komplexeren XML-Dokument, das mehrere Ebenen und Attribute enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` für Listen von Elementen und `get_attribute` für Attribute.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_advanced_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id       TYPE string,
             name     TYPE string,
             category TYPE string,
             price    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_products
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_advanced_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_products.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lt_product_nodes TYPE if_xml_node=>tt_nodes,
          lo_product_node  TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          ls_product       TYPE ty_product.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        lt_product_nodes = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Product' ).

        LOOP AT lt_product_nodes INTO lo_product_node.
          CLEAR ls_product.
          ls_product-id = lo_product_node->get_attribute( 'id' ).
          ls_product-name = lo_product_node->get_element_by_tag_name( 'Name' )->get_text( ).
          ls_product-category = lo_product_node->get_element_by_tag_name( 'Category' )->get_text( ).
          ls_product-price = lo_product_node->get_element_by_tag_name( 'Price' )->get_text( ).
          APPEND ls_product TO rt_products.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = lx_xml_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        " Handle cases where get_element_by_tag_name returns initial reference (node not found)
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = 'XML node not found or invalid structure'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_parse_multiple_products FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_invalid_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_missing_node FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_multiple_products.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Catalog>
  <Product id="P001">
    <Name>Laptop</Name>
    <Category>Electronics</Category>
    <Price>1200.00</Price>
  </Product>
  <Product id="P002">
    <Name>Mouse</Name>
    <Category>Electronics</Category>
    <Price>25.50</Price>
  </Product>
</Catalog>`.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_xml_advanced_parser( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = lo_parser->parse_products( lv_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_products ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_products INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_product1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_product1-id exp = 'P001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_product1-name exp = 'Laptop' ).

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Daten in ein XML-Format unter Verwendung von Transformationen (Simple Transformations).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit einer Simple Transformation (ST) und `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des Ergebnisses.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_st_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material,
             matnr TYPE matnr,
             maktx TYPE maktx,
             meins TYPE meins,
           END OF ty_material.
    TYPES tt_materials TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_materials_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_materials TYPE tt_materials
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_st_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_materials_to_xml.
    DATA: lv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Define a simple transformation (ST) programmatically or use an existing one
    " For this example, we assume a simple transformation 'Z_MATERIAL_TO_XML' exists
    " which transforms a table of TY_MATERIAL into a basic XML structure.
    " Example ST (Z_MATERIAL_TO_XML):
    " <?sap.transform simple?>
    " <tt:transform xmlns:tt="http://www.sap.com/transformation-templates">
    "   <tt:root name="MATERIALS" type="tt:ref"/>
    "   <tt:template>
    "     <Materials>
    "       <tt:loop ref=".MATERIALS">
    "         <Material>
    "           <MATNR><tt:value ref="MATNR"/></MATNR>
    "           <MAKTX><tt:value ref="MAKTX"/></MAKTX>
    "           <MEINS><tt:value ref="MEINS"/></MEINS>
    "         </Material>
    "       </tt:loop>
    "     </Materials>
    "   </tt:template>
    " </tt:transform>

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION z_material_to_xml
          SOURCE materials = it_materials
          RESULT XML lv_xml_xstring.

        rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xml_xstring ).

      CATCH cx_st_error INTO DATA(lx_st_error).
        rv_xml_string = |Error during ST: { lx_st_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie ein XML-Dokument in eine interne Tabelle unter Verwendung von Transformationen (Simple Transformations).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit einer Simple Transformation (ST) und `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des Ergebnisses.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_st_deserializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material,
             matnr TYPE matnr,
             maktx TYPE maktx,
             meins TYPE meins,
           END OF ty_material.
    TYPES tt_materials TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_xml_to_materials
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_materials) TYPE tt_materials.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_st_deserializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_xml_to_materials.
    DATA: lv_xml_xstring TYPE xstring.

    lv_xml_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ).

    " Define a simple transformation (ST) programmatically or use an existing one
    " For this example, we assume a simple transformation 'Z_XML_TO_MATERIAL' exists
    " which transforms a basic XML structure into a table of TY_MATERIAL.
    " Example ST (Z_XML_TO_MATERIAL):
    " <?sap.transform simple?>
    " <tt:transform xmlns:tt="http://www.sap.com/transformation-templates">
    "   <tt:root name="MATERIALS" type="tt:ref"/>
    "   <tt:template>
    "     <Materials>
    "       <tt:loop ref=".MATERIALS">
    "         <Material>
    "           <MATNR><tt:value ref="MATNR"/></MATNR>
    "           <MAKTX><tt:value ref="MAKTX"/></MAktX>
    "           <MEINS><tt:value ref="MEINS"/></MEINS>
    "         </Material>
    "       </tt:loop>
    "     </Materials>
    "   </tt:template>
    " </tt:transform>

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION z_xml_to_material
          SOURCE XML lv_xml_xstring
          RESULT materials = rt_materials.

      CATCH cx_st_error INTO DATA(lx_st_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = lx_st_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Balkendiagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` zur Visualisierung von Flugpreisen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win`, setzen Sie Daten mit `set_data_from_internal_table` und rufen Sie `draw_chart` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_bar_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_chart.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_sflights         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_chart_data       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_chart_data.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating chart engine' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      " Prepare chart data
      ls_chart_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar.
      ls_chart_data-title = 'Flugpreise (SFLIGHT)' .
      ls_chart_data-x_axis_title = 'Fluggesellschaft / Verbindung'.
      ls_chart_data-y_axis_title = 'Preis'.

      " Set data from internal table
      lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_chart_data = ls_chart_data
          i_table      = lt_sflights
          i_x_axis_field = 'CARRID'
          i_y_axis_field = 'PRICE'
          i_series_field = 'CONNID' " Optional: for multiple series per X-axis item
      ).

      lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_chart.
    " In a real GUI test, you would need a screen and a custom container.
    " For a unit test, we can only assert the creation and method calls.
    " We cannot actually render the GUI chart in a headless unit test.

    DATA: lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_mock_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    " In a real scenario, these would be created by the framework.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_container EXPORTING container_name = 'TEST_CONTAINER'.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_chart EXPORTING parent = lo_mock_container.

    DATA(lo_chart_displayer) = NEW zcl_chart_bar_sflight( ).

    " We can't directly assert the chart rendering, but we can check if
    " the methods were called without exceptions.
    " The following call should not raise any exceptions if the code is correct.
    lo_chart_displayer->display_sflight_chart( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).

    " More advanced mocking frameworks could verify method calls on lo_mock_chart.
    " For simplicity, we just ensure no dump occurs.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_mock_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_mock_chart ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chart_pie_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_chart_pie_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_pie_chart.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_sflights         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_carrier_counts   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF struct_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_chart_data       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_chart_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_carrier_count.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Aggregate data using modern ABAP features (GROUP BY, REDUCE)
      lt_carrier_counts = VALUE #(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
        ( VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) )
      ).

      CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy_subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating chart engine' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      ls_chart_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_pie.
      ls_chart_data-title = 'Verteilung der Fluggesellschaften' .
      ls_chart_data-legend_position = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_legend_pos_right.

      lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_chart_data = ls_chart_data
          i_table      = lt_carrier_counts
          i_x_axis_field = 'CARRID' " Categories for pie slices
          i_y_axis_field = 'COUNT'  " Values for pie slices
      ).

      lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein gestapeltes Balkendiagramm, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum darzustellen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_stacked_sflight_chart.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_sflights         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_aggregated_data  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF struct_agg_flight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_chart_data       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_chart_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_agg_flight,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_agg_flight.

    SELECT carrid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Aggregate data for stacked bar chart: count flights per date and carrier
      lt_aggregated_data = VALUE #(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate, carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
        ( VALUE #( fldate = ls_flight-fldate carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) )
      ).

      CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating chart engine' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      ls_chart_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_stacked_bar.
      ls_chart_data-title = 'Anzahl Flüge pro Datum und Fluggesellschaft' .
      ls_chart_data-x_axis_title = 'Flugdatum'.
      ls_chart_data-y_axis_title = 'Anzahl Flüge'.
      ls_chart_data-legend_position = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_legend_pos_right.

      lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_chart_data = ls_chart_data
          i_table      = lt_aggregated_data
          i_x_axis_field = 'FLDATE'
          i_y_axis_field = 'COUNT'
          i_series_field = 'CARRID' " Each CARRID will be a stack segment
      ).

      lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit Namespaces und Attributen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_element_ns` und `set_attribute_ns` für Namespaces.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_namespaced_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_namespaced_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_item_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node.

    CONSTANTS: lc_ns_uri TYPE string VALUE 'http://www.example.com/data',
               lc_ns_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'ex'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Data' namespace_uri = lc_ns_uri prefix = lc_ns_prefix ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    lo_root_node->set_attribute_ns( name = 'version' value = '1.0' namespace_uri = '' prefix = '' ).

    lo_item_node = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Item' namespace_uri = lc_ns_uri prefix = lc_ns_prefix ).
    lo_root_node->append_child( lo_item_node ).
    lo_item_node->set_attribute_ns( name = 'id' value = '123' namespace_uri = '' prefix = '' ).

    DATA(lo_value_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( name = 'Value' namespace_uri = lc_ns_uri prefix = lc_ns_prefix ).
    lo_item_node->append_child( lo_value_node ).
    DATA(lo_text_node) = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( 'Sample Value' ).
    lo_value_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).

    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem XML-Dokument nach Elementen mittels XPath-Ausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie `select_nodes` mit einem XPath-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_nodes_by_xpath
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_node_texts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_nodes_by_xpath.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lt_nodes        TYPE if_xml_node=>tt_nodes,
          lo_node         TYPE REF TO if_xml_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        lt_nodes = lo_xml_document->select_nodes( iv_xpath ).

        LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO lo_node.
          APPEND lo_node->get_text( ) TO rt_node_texts.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |XML Parse Error: { lx_xml_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_xml_xpath_error INTO DATA(lx_xpath_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |XPath Error: { lx_xpath_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_xpath_simple FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xpath_simple.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Root><Item><Value>A</Value></Item><Item><Value>B</Value></Item></Root>`.
    DATA(lo_searcher) = NEW zcl_xml_xpath_search( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_searcher->find_nodes_by_xpath( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_xpath = '//Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[2] exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_xpath_attribute.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Root><Item id="1"><Value>X</Value></Item><Item id="2"><Value>Y</Value></Item></Root>`.
    DATA(lo_searcher) = NEW zcl_xml_xpath_search( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_searcher->find_nodes_by_xpath( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_xpath = '//Item[@id="1"]/Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[1] exp = 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_xpath_nonexistent.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Root><Item><Value>A</Value></Item></Root>`.
    DATA(lo_searcher) = NEW zcl_xml_xpath_search( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_searcher->find_nodes_by_xpath( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_xpath = '//NonExistent' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_results ).

  METHOD test_xpath_error.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Root><Item><Value>A</Value></Item></Root>`.
    DATA(lo_searcher) = NEW zcl_xml_xpath_search( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = `lo_searcher->find_nodes_by_xpath( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_xpath = '//Value[' )` EXCEPTIONS cx_abap_message_digest ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Verarbeitung von XML-Nachrichten aus externen Systemen. Die Fehlerbehandlung für XPath-Fehler ist hier ebenfalls integriert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kombinationsdiagramm (z.B. Balken und Linie), um Flugpreise und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft darzustellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_data_from_internal_table` mit mehreren `i_y_axis_field` Einträgen und `set_series_type`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_combo_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_combo_sflight_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_combo_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_combo_sflight_chart.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_sflights         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_agg_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF struct_agg_combo WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_chart_data       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_chart_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_agg_combo,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF struct_agg_combo.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Aggregate data: average price and count per carrier
      lt_agg_data = VALUE #(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
        ( VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                   avg_price = REDUCE #( INIT p = 0.0 FOR <fs> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT p = p + <fs>-price ) / GROUP SIZE
                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) )
      ).

      CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy_subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating chart engine' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      ls_chart_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar.
      ls_chart_data-title = 'Flugpreise und Fluganzahl pro Fluggesellschaft' .
      ls_chart_data-x_axis_title = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
      ls_chart_data-y_axis_title = 'Preis / Anzahl'.
      ls_chart_data-legend_position = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_legend_pos_right.

      lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_chart_data = ls_chart_data
          i_table      = lt_agg_data
          i_x_axis_field = 'CARRID'
          i_y_axis_field = 'AVG_PRICE'
          i_series_field = '' " No series field for primary data
      ).

      " Add second series for flight count as a line
      lo_chart_engine->add_series_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_table      = lt_agg_data
          i_x_axis_field = 'CARRID'
          i_y_axis_field = 'FLIGHT_COUNT'
          i_series_name = 'Anzahl Flüge'
          i_series_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_line
          i_y_axis_id = '2' " Use a secondary Y-axis if needed
      ).

      lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie ein XML-Dokument gegen ein DTD (Document Type Definition).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methode `validate_dtd`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_dtd_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_xml_with_dtd
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_dtd_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_dtd_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_xml_with_dtd.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        lo_xml_document->validate_dtd( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_dtd_string ) ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_parse_error).
        " XML itself is not well-formed
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_xml_dtd_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_dtd_error).
        " XML is not valid against DTD
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm mit zwei Y-Achsen, um Flugpreise und die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze gleichzeitig darzustellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_series_from_internal_table` und weisen Sie `i_y_axis_id` zu, um eine zweite Y-Achse zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dual_axis_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dual_axis_sflight_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dual_axis_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dual_axis_sflight_chart.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_sflights         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_chart_data       TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_chart_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = iv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error creating chart engine' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      ls_chart_data-chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_line.
      ls_chart_data-title = 'Flugpreise und Sitzplätze pro Flug' .
      ls_chart_data-x_axis_title = 'Flugverbindung'.
      ls_chart_data-y_axis_title = 'Preis'.
      ls_chart_data-legend_position = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_legend_pos_right.

      " Primary series (Price) on Y-axis 1
      lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_chart_data = ls_chart_data
          i_table      = lt_sflights
          i_x_axis_field = 'CONNID'
          i_y_axis_field = 'PRICE'
          i_series_field = 'CARRID'
          i_y_axis_id = '1'
      ).

      " Secondary series (SeatsMax) on Y-axis 2
      lo_chart_engine->add_series_from_internal_table(
        EXPORTING
          i_table      = lt_sflights
          i_x_axis_field = 'CONNID'
          i_y_axis_field = 'SEATSMAX'
          i_series_name = 'Verfügbare Sitze'
          i_series_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_line
          i_y_axis_id = '2'
      ).

      " Configure secondary Y-axis
      lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( i_axis_id = '2' i_title = 'Anzahl Sitze' ).
      lo_chart_engine->set_axis_visible( i_axis_id = '2' i_visible = abap_true ).

      lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` um ein XML-Dokument zu modifizieren, indem Sie einen Knoten hinzufügen und einen anderen aktualisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `create_element`, `append_child`, `get_element_by_tag_name` und `set_text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_xml_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_xml_document.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_root_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_item_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_new_item_node TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lo_text_node    TYPE REF TO if_xml_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        lo_root_node = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).

        " Update an existing node
        lo_item_node = lo_xml_document->get_element_by_tag_name( 'Item' ).
        IF lo_item_node IS BOUND.
          DATA(lo_value_node) = lo_item_node->get_element_by_tag_name( 'Value' ).
          IF lo_value_node IS BOUND.
            lo_value_node->set_text( 'Updated Value' ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        " Add a new node
        lo_new_item_node = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'NewItem' ).
        lo_root_node->append_child( lo_new_item_node ).
        lo_text_node = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( 'Newly Added' ).
        lo_new_item_node->append_child( lo_text_node ).

        rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( ) ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |XML Parse Error: { lx_xml_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_empty_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_xml.
    DATA(lv_original_xml) = `<Root><Item><Value>Original Value</Value></Item></Root>`.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_xml_modifier( ).
    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_modifier->modify_xml_document( lv_original_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Value>Updated Value</Value>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<NewItem>Newly Added</NewItem>' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_empty_xml.
    DATA(lv_original_xml) = `<Root/>`.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_xml_modifier( ).
    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_modifier->modify_xml_document( lv_original_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Root><NewItem>Newly Added</NewItem></Root>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Value>' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Modifikation eines bestehenden XML-Dokuments. Es zeigt, wie man einen vorhandenen Knoten findet und dessen Textinhalt aktualisiert (`set_text`) und wie man einen neuen Knoten erstellt (`create_element`) und ihn an das Dokument anhängt (`append_child`). Dies ist eine grundlegende Operation für die dynamische Manipulation von XML-Daten.
keywords: XML, Modification, Add Node, Update Node, cl_xml_document, set_text, append_child

hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_string,
             carrid TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_string.
    TYPES: tt_flight_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrids_as_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_flight_string.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_as_string.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid = CONV string( ls_sflight-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Betrag (Dezimalzahl) in einen String, der Tausender-Trennzeichen und ein Währungssymbol enthält, basierend auf einer gegebenen Währung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_currency_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        iv_currency TYPE c LENGTH 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_amount) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_currency_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_currency.
    DATA: lv_formatted_num TYPE string.

    " CONV to string with formatting options (e.g., using a formatted type)
    " For more complex formatting, CL_ABAP_FORMAT is often used.
    " Here, we simulate a simple format for demonstration.
    lv_formatted_num = CONV string( iv_amount ).

    " A more robust solution would involve CL_ABAP_FORMAT or WRITE TO ... CURRENCY
    " For modern ABAP, string templates are preferred for concatenation.
    rv_formatted_amount = |{ iv_currency } { lv_formatted_num STYLE = CL_ABAP_FORMAT=>STYLE_FINANCIAL }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_currency_format FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_currency_format( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_currency( iv_amount = '12345.67' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    " Note: The exact output of STYLE_FINANCIAL depends on user settings/locale.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = '12.345,67' ). " Assuming German locale for example
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`).
hint: Bestimmen Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen und verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für einen Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_carrier) TYPE ty_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_carrier.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE tt_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_carriers.

    IF lt_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_carriers ).
      DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
                                                    min  = 1
                                                    max  = lv_lines ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_carriers INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_carrier.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_random_carrier-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_random_carrier-carrname ).

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Einträge in einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Zufallszahlen und sortieren Sie die Tabelle danach. Oder verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife, um Elemente zu tauschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname   TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_shuffled.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_shuffled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_carriers.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_carriers.

    IF lt_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_carriers ).
      DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
                                                    min  = 1
                                                    max  = lv_lines * 1000 ). " Larger range for better distribution

      rt_shuffled_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrier IN lt_carriers
                                      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
                                        carrid     = ls_carrier-carrid
                                        carrname   = ls_carrier-carrname ) ).
      SORT rt_shuffled_carriers BY random_key.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_uniqueness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_1) = lo_cut->shuffle_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_2) = lo_cut->shuffle_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_shuffled_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_shuffled_2 ).

    " It's highly improbable that two random shuffles are identical for a non-trivial table
    " We compare the first few entries to check for difference
    IF lines( lt_shuffled_1 ) > 1 AND lines( lt_shuffled_2 ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled_1[1]-carrid exp = lt_shuffled_2[1]-carrid
                                            msg = 'First elements should differ after shuffle' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine gängige Methode zum Mischen einer Tabelle ist das Hinzufügen einer temporären Spalte mit Zufallszahlen und anschließendes Sortieren nach dieser Spalte. Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` ermöglicht dies in einer modernen, funktionalen Weise.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, Shuffle, Sort, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, nachdem Sie die Preise in einen Dezimaltyp konvertiert haben, um Rundungsfehler zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `CONV` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + CONV p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2( ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Assert that the total price is a positive value (assuming LH has flights)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_total_price > 0 ) ).

    " For a more precise test, you would need to know the exact sum for 'LH'
    " Example: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '12345.67' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. In Kombination mit `FILTER` zur Vorfilterung der Daten und `CONV` zur sicheren Typkonvertierung der Preise in einen Dezimaltyp (`p`) innerhalb der Schleife, entsteht ein sehr ausdrucksstarker und fehlerresistenter Code. Dies ist ein Musterbeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP 7.50+.

CLASS zcl_random_alphanum_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_alphanum_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_id.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )

      rv_random_id = rv_random_id && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb der letzten 365 Tage und konvertieren Sie es in ein lesbares String-Format (z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD').
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Tage, `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()` für das aktuelle Datum und String-Templates mit `CONV` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_date_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_date_string.
    DATA(lv_today) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
                                                  min  = 0
                                                  max  = 364 ). " 0 to 364 days ago
    DATA(lv_days_ago) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    DATA(lv_random_date) = lv_today - lv_days_ago.

    rv_date_string = |{ CONV string( lv_random_date+0(4) ) }-{ CONV string( lv_random_date+4(2) ) }-{ CONV string( lv_random_date+6(2) ) }|.
    " Alternatively, using CL_ABAP_FORMAT for locale-specific date formatting
    " rv_date_string = cl_abap_format=>date_alpha( lv_random_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_random_date_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_date_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_date_str) = lo_cut->generate_random_date_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_date_str ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match( act = lv_date_str exp = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' ).

    DATA(lv_today) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
    DATA(lv_date_from_string) = CONV d( lv_date_str ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_date_from_string LE lv_today ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( lv_date_from_string GE ( lv_today - 364 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung einer Zufallszahl (`CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`) mit Datumsberechnungen und String-Templates für die Formatierung. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()` ist der moderne Weg, um das aktuelle Systemdatum zu erhalten. `CONV` wird hier verwendet, um die einzelnen Teile des Datums in Strings umzuwandeln, bevor sie im String-Template zusammengefügt werden.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und wählen Sie für jede Gruppe einen zufälligen Flug aus. Geben Sie die Flugnummer und den Preis des zufällig ausgewählten Fluges aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_random_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_random_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_random_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_random_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE tt_random_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lt_group_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key ( <fs_flight> ) ).
      DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_group_flights ).

      IF lv_lines > 0.
        DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
                                                      min  = 1
                                                      max  = lv_lines ).
        DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

        READ TABLE lt_group_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).

        APPEND VALUE ty_random_flight_info(
          carrid   = ls_random_flight-carrid
          connid   = ls_random_flight-connid
          price    = ls_random_flight-price
          currency = ls_random_flight-curr
        ) TO rt_random_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_flight_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_per_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_random_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_random_flights ).

    " Check if each carrier has exactly one random flight selected
    DATA(lt_distinct_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid(
                                   FOR ls_flight IN lt_random_flights ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
    SORT lt_distinct_carriers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_distinct_carriers.

    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid(
                               FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid FROM sflight AS s GROUP BY carrid ) ( ls_sflight-carrid ) ).
    SORT lt_all_carriers ASCENDING.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_distinct_carriers ) exp = lines( lt_all_carriers ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_random_flights INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_random_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_random_flight-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.40+) zur Gruppierung von Daten mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` zur Auswahl eines zufälligen Elements innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Erstellung der Gruppentabelle ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature. Dies zeigt, wie komplexe Datenmanipulationen in modernem ABAP elegant gelöst werden können.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, Grouping, SFLIGHTS, VALUE

CLASS zcl_gui_file_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_file_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_desktop_file.
    DATA(lv_desktop_path) = cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory( ).
    DATA(lv_full_path) = lv_desktop_path && '\' && iv_filename.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING

      CHANGING
        data_tab                = rt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error         = 1
        file_read_error         = 2
        no_batch                = 3
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 4
        invalid_type            = 5
        no_authority            = 6
        unknown_error           = 7
        bad_data_format         = 8
        header_not_allowed      = 9
        separator_not_allowed   = 10
        empty_filename          = 11
        invalid_table_width     = 12
        read_error              = 13
        others                  = 14
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CASE sy-subrc.
        WHEN 1. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'File open error'.
        WHEN 2. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'File read error'.
        WHEN OTHERS. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Unknown GUI upload error'.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_gui_file_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_file_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_file_on_desktop.
    DATA(lv_desktop_path) = cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory( ).
    DATA(lv_full_path) = lv_desktop_path && '\' && iv_filename.
