Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Carrier und ermitteln Sie für jeden Carrier die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_summary.
    TYPES tt_sflight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_sflight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_grouped_flight-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_summary(
          carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
          flight_count = lv_count
          avg_price   = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ) )
        TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `SFLIGHTS` einen neuen Preis berechnet, indem ein Rabatt angewendet wird, aber nur, wenn der Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Andernfalls bleibt der Preis unverändert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` für die bedingte Preisberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_cond_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_discounted_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             original_price TYPE sflight-price,
             discounted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_discounted_flight.
    TYPES tt_discounted_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_discounted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_discounted_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_discount_threshold TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_rate      TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 " e.g., 0.10 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE tt_discounted_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_cond_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                     ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                       connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                       original_price = ls_sflight-price,
                                       discounted_price = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > iv_discount_threshold
                                                                  THEN ls_sflight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate )
                                                                  ELSE ls_sflight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_discounted_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_cond_price( ).
    DATA(lt_discounted) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_prices( iv_discount_threshold = 500 iv_discount_rate = '0.10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_discounted ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_discounted ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_discounted INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-original_price > 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-discounted_price exp = ls_flight-original_price * '0.90' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-discounted_price exp = ls_flight-original_price ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_map_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
             age_years  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             full_name TYPE string,
             age       TYPE i,
             status    TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_with_transformation
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_map_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_transformation.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source MAPPING
        full_name = first_name && ' ' && last_name
        age       = age_years
      EXCEPT
        first_name
        last_name
        age_years
    ).
    IF rs_target-age >= 18.
      rs_target-status = 'Adult'.
    ELSE.
      rs_target-status = 'Minor'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Wert dem Initialwert seines Typs entspricht, ohne den Typ explizit zu kennen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_is_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_value_initial
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_initial) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_is_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_initial.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).
    DATA(lv_initial_value) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_initial_value( p_type = lo_typedescr ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_initial> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    ASSIGN lv_initial_value TO <fs_initial>.

    IF <fs_data> = <fs_initial>.
      rv_is_initial = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_initial = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Maximalwert für einen numerischen Typ, der als generischer Parameter übergeben wird, und geben Sie ihn als den korrekten numerischen Typ zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value` und dynamische Typisierung mit `CAST` oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_generic_num_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_numeric_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_max_value) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_generic_num_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_numeric_value.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).
    DATA(lv_max_string) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( p_type = lo_typedescr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_max_value TYPE HANDLE lo_typedescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_max_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN rr_max_value->* TO <fs_max_value>.

    TRY.
        <fs_max_value> = lv_max_string.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Handle non-numeric types if necessary, or raise an error
        " For this example, we assume numeric types are passed.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermittle die Anzahl der einzigartigen Abflugorte (`cityfrom`) in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutze eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und anschließend den `COUNT`-Operator auf die resultierende Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_distinct_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_distinct_cities_from
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_distinct_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_cities_from.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT distinct_cities = 0
      FOR GROUPS OF city IN lt_sflights BY city~cityfrom
      WHERE city~cityfrom IS NOT INITIAL
      DO
        distinct_cities = distinct_cities + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle, wie oft ein bestimmtes Zeichen (z.B. 'a') in einem gegebenen String vorkommt.
hint: Verwende `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... IN ... RESULTS ...` und zähle die Einträge im Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_char_in_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_char_in_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_char.
    DATA lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_char IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_matches.

    rv_count = lines( lt_matches ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der 'aktiven' Termine (simuliert als interne Tabelle) innerhalb eines bestimmten Datumsbereichs. Ein Termin ist aktiv, wenn sein Startdatum im Bereich liegt.
hint: Verwende `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle und anschließend den `COUNT`-Operator.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
         id        TYPE i,
         description TYPE string,
         start_date  TYPE d,
         end_date    TYPE d,
       END OF ty_appointment.
TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_count_active_appts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_active_appointments
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_start_date   TYPE d
        iv_end_date     TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_active_appts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_active_appointments.
    rv_count = COUNT(
      FILTER tt_appointments
        FROM it_appointments
        WHERE start_date >= iv_start_date AND start_date <= iv_end_date
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwende den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Tabelle zu durchlaufen und einen Zähler zu inkrementieren, wenn die Bedingung erfüllt ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_sflights_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_sflights_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_connid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE flight-connid = iv_connid
      DO
        count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_count_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_sum_seats_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sum_seats_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE flight-carrid = iv_carrier
      DO
        total_seats = total_seats + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_group_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache HTTP DELETE-Anfrage an eine Ressource und überprüfen Sie den Statuscode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` und die Methode `DELETE`. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_resource.
    DATA(lv_url) = |https://api.example.com/resources/{ iv_resource_id }|.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( lv_url ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Z.B. Loggen des Fehlers und Rückgabe eines generischen Fehlercodes
        rv_status_code = 500.
      FINALLY.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_delete_basic( ).
    " HINWEIS: Für echte Unit-Tests müsste CL_HTTP_CLIENT gemockt werden,
    " um externe Abhängigkeiten zu vermeiden und spezifische Statuscodes zu simulieren.
    " Hier wird ein erwarteter Erfolgscode angenommen.
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->delete_resource( '123' ).
    " Da wir keine echte API aufrufen, können wir hier nur den Standard-Fehlerfall abfangen
    " oder einen simulierten Erfolgswert annehmen.
    " Für diesen Demonstrationszweck nehmen wir an, dass ein erfolgreicher Aufruf 204 zurückgeben würde.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_status = 204 OR lv_status = 500 ) " 204 No Content (typical for DELETE) or 500 if dummy call fails
      msg = 'Expected status 204 (No Content) or 500 (simulated error)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_delete_basic( ).
    " Simulieren eines Fehlers, z.B. durch eine ungültige URL oder Netzwerkprobleme.
    " In einem echten Test würde man hier einen Mock verwenden, der einen Fehler wirft.
    " Da dies nicht möglich ist, wird der erwartete Fehlercode 500 geprüft.
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->delete_resource( 'invalid_id_to_trigger_error' ). " Dummy-ID, die keinen echten Aufruf auslöst
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 500
      msg = 'Expected status 500 for simulated error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für eine DELETE-Anfrage. Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `DATA(...) = NEW ...` für die Objekterzeugung und String-Templates (`|...|`) für die URL-Konstruktion. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` fängt potenzielle HTTP-Ausnahmen ab und erhöht die Robustheit.
keywords: CL_HTTP_CLIENT, DELETE, HTTP, REST, Status Code, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Senden Sie eine HTTP DELETE-Anfrage, die zusätzliche Query-Parameter enthält, um die Löschoperation zu spezifizieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_query_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_filtered_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string
        iv_filter_key  TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_filter_val  TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_query_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_filtered_resource.
    DATA(lv_base_url) = |https://api.example.com/resources/{ iv_resource_id }|.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( lv_base_url ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).

    IF iv_filter_key IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_filter_val IS NOT INITIAL.
      lo_http_client->request->set_query_parameter(
        EXPORTING
          name  = iv_filter_key
          value = iv_filter_val
      ).
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rv_status_code = 500.
      FINALLY.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_custom_header IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_url) = |https://api.example.com/secure-resources/{ iv_resource_id }|.

        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

        rv_status_code = 500.
      FINALLY.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine HTTP DELETE-Anfrage und verarbeiten Sie den JSON-Antwortkörper, der eine Bestätigungsnachricht enthalten könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF_HTTP_RESPONSE~GET_CDATA` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für JSON-Parsing.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_resp_body DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_confirmation,
             message TYPE string,
             status  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_confirmation.

    METHODS delete_and_get_confirmation
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_confirmation) TYPE ty_confirmation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_resp_body IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_get_confirmation.
    DATA(lv_url) = |https://api.example.com/confirm-delete/{ iv_resource_id }|.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( lv_url ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Accept' value = 'application/json' ).

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          " Parse JSON response
          CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_response_body RESULT rs_confirmation.
        ELSE.
          rs_confirmation-message = |Error: { lv_response_body }|.
          rs_confirmation-status = |{ lv_status_code }|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_confirmation-message = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
        rs_confirmation-status = '500'.
      FINALLY.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_with_confirmation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_with_confirmation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_delete_resp_body( ).
    " HINWEIS: Hier müsste der HTTP-Client gemockt werden, um einen JSON-Response-Body zu simulieren.
    " Für diesen Demonstrationszweck wird ein Dummy-Aufruf gemacht.
    DATA(ls_confirmation) = lo_cut->delete_and_get_confirmation( '112' ).
    " Erwartet wird entweder eine geparste Nachricht oder eine Fehlermeldung

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine DELETE-Anfrage und behandeln Sie verschiedene HTTP-Statuscodes (z.B. 204 No Content, 404 Not Found, 403 Forbidden) mit spezifischen Aktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` für den Statuscode und `IF_HTTP_RESPONSE~GET_STATUS_CODE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_status_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_delete_result,
             success TYPE abap_bool,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_delete_result.

    METHODS delete_resource_with_status_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_delete_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_status_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_resource_with_status_handling.
    DATA(lv_url) = |https://api.example.com/status-aware-resources/{ iv_resource_id }|.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( lv_url ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).

        CASE lv_status_code.
          WHEN 200 OR 204. " OK or No Content
            rs_result-success = abap_true.
            rs_result-message = |Ressource '{ iv_resource_id }' erfolgreich gelöscht.|.
          WHEN 403. " Forbidden
            rs_result-success = abap_false.
            rs_result-message = |Keine Berechtigung zum Löschen der Ressource '{ iv_resource_id }'.|. 
          WHEN 404. " Not Found
            rs_result-success = abap_false.
            rs_result-message = |Ressource '{ iv_resource_id }' nicht gefunden.|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rs_result-success = abap_false.
            rs_result-message = |Unerwarteter Fehler ({ lv_status_code }): { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_result-success = abap_false.
        rs_result-message = |Netzwerk- oder Kommunikationsfehler: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      FINALLY.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine DELETE-Anfrage asynchron aus und verarbeiten Sie das Ergebnis in einem Callback.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT=>CREATE_BY_DESTINATION` mit `i_asynchronous = ABAP_TRUE` und implementieren Sie `IF_HTTP_CLIENT_ASYNC_CALLBACK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_async DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_client_async_callback.

    METHODS delete_resource_async
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS get_last_status_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA gv_last_status_code TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_async IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_resource_async.
    DATA(lv_url) = |https://api.example.com/async-resources/{ iv_resource_id }|.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
                               i_url = lv_url
                               i_asynchronous = abap_true
                               i_callback_object = me ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        gv_last_status_code = 500.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_http_client_async_callback~handle_event.
    DATA(lo_client) = io_client.
    TRY.
        lo_client->receive( ).
        gv_last_status_code = lo_client->response->get_status_code( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        gv_last_status_code = 500.
      FINALLY.
        lo_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_status_code.
    rv_status_code = gv_last_status_code.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_async FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_async.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_delete_async( ).
    lo_cut->delete_resource_async( 'async_1' ).

    " In einem echten asynchronen Szenario müsste man hier warten oder
    " einen Mechanismus implementieren, um auf das Ergebnis zu warten.
    " Für den Unit-Test simulieren wir eine kurze Wartezeit.
    WAIT UP TO '0.1' SECONDS.

    DATA(lv_status) = zcl_http_delete_async=>get_last_status_code( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_status = 204 OR lv_status = 500 OR lv_status = 0 ) " 0 if callback not yet processed
      msg = 'Expected status 204, 500 or 0 for async DELETE'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die asynchrone Ausführung einer DELETE-Anfrage. Durch Setzen von `i_asynchronous = abap_true` und Übergabe eines Callback-Objekts (das `IF_HTTP_CLIENT_ASYNC_CALLBACK` implementiert) wird die Anfrage im Hintergrund verarbeitet. Das Ergebnis wird in der `handle_event`-Methode des Callback-Objekts empfangen, was die Hauptanwendung nicht blockiert. Dies ist ideal für langlaufende oder nicht-kritische HTTP-Aufrufe.
keywords: CL_HTTP_CLIENT, DELETE, Asynchronous, Callback, IF_HTTP_CLIENT_ASYNC_CALLBACK

Instructions: Führen Sie eine DELETE-Anfrage mit einem Timeout durch, um zu verhindern, dass die Anfrage unbegrenzt blockiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF_HTTP_CLIENT~SET_TIMEOUT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_delete_timeout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_resource_with_timeout
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string
        iv_timeout_sec TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_delete_timeout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_resource_with_timeout.
    DATA(lv_url) = |https://api.example.com/slow-delete/{ iv_resource_id }|.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( lv_url ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_delete ).
    lo_http_client->set_timeout( iv_timeout_sec ).

    TRY.
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        " CX_HTTP_TIMEOUT ist eine Unterklasse von CX_HTTP_IO_ERROR
        IF lx_http_error IS INSTANCE OF cx_http_timeout.
          rv_status_code = 408. " Request Timeout
        ELSE.
          rv_status_code = 500.
        ENDIF.
      FINALLY.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      act = ( lv_status = 204 OR lv_status = 500 )
      msg = 'Expected status 204 or 500 for DELETE within timeout'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_timeout_exceeded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_delete_timeout( ).
    " Simulieren eines Timeouts durch sehr kurze Timeout-Zeit
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->delete_resource_with_timeout(

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

      msg = 'Expected status 408 or 500 for DELETE timeout'

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein Timeout für eine HTTP DELETE-Anfrage setzt. Die Methode `set_timeout` verhindert, dass die Anwendung unbegrenzt auf eine Antwort wartet, was die Stabilität und Reaktionsfähigkeit verbessert. Die spezifische Ausnahme `CX_HTTP_TIMEOUT` kann abgefangen werden, um auf einen Timeout-Fehler zu reagieren, was eine präzisere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: CL_HTTP_CLIENT, DELETE, Timeout, CX_HTTP_TIMEOUT, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere aus einer Tabelle von Flügen berechnet. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `INIT` Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             payments TYPE sflight-payments, " Assuming payments represents passenger count for simplicity
           END OF ty_flight_booking,
           tt_flight_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_flight_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings
      NEXT total = total + ls_booking-payments
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_bookings TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flight_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251124' payments = 100 ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251124' payments = 50 ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20251124' payments = 75 ) TO lt_bookings.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_passengers( lt_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die alle Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Datum aus der Datenbank abruft. Verwenden Sie modernen ABAP SQL mit Inline-Deklarationen und `@` für Hostvariablen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `@` für Hostvariablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251124' planetype = 'A380' ) ).

ENDSELECT` Schleifen. Dies vereinfacht den Datenzugriff erheblich und ist effizient für die Bereitstellung von Daten für UI5-Anwendungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die nacheinander aufgerufen werden können, um eine Zeichenkette zu verarbeiten (z.B. trimmen, in Großbuchstaben umwandeln). Nutzen Sie funktionale Methoden und Method Chaining.
hint: Methoden, die `VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor` zurückgeben, ermöglichen Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim_string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS to_upper_case RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '^\s+|\s+$' IN mv_current_string WITH ''.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper_case.
    TRANSLATE mv_current_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lv_processed_string) = NEW zcl_string_processor( iv_initial_string = '  hello world  ' )->trim_string( )->to_upper_case( )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_processed_string,
      exp = 'HELLO WORLD'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, ähnlich einer Fluent API, was in modernen Anwendungen, die komplexe Datenverarbeitungsschritte durchführen, sehr geschätzt wird.
keywords: METHOD_CHAINING, FUNCTIONAL_METHODS, OBJECT_ORIENTATION, STRING_PROCESSING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum gruppiert und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights,
           tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_date.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid fldate = ls_group-fldate ) 
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        fldate = ls_group-fldate
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20251124' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '402' fldate = '20251125' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier_date( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251124' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20251124' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251125' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Operator ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist ideal für die Erstellung von aggregierten Ansichten oder Berichten, die oft in UI5-Anwendungen benötigt werden, um Daten zusammenzufassen.
keywords: GROUP_BY, INTERNAL_TABLES, AGGREGATION, FOR_GROUPS_OF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode zur dynamischen Ermittlung von Attributen eines Objekts basierend auf einem Feldnamen bereitstellt. Dies kann für generische UI-Elemente nützlich sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    METHODS get_attribute_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse und Manipulation von Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Frameworks oder UI-Komponenten, die Datenfelder basierend auf Metadaten anzeigen oder verarbeiten müssen, ohne den Feldnamen zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen. Die Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist hier eine moderne und effiziente Art, auf dynamische Felder zuzugreifen.
keywords: RTTI, DYNAMIC_PROGRAMMING, FIELD_SYMBOLS, REF_TO_DATA, CX_SY_DYN_SRC_ERROR

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und geben Sie den Index jeder Zeile zusammen mit dem Inhalt aus, ohne sy-tabix zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die FOR-Schleife mit INDEX INTO in Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_index_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_table IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_index_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_row IN it_data INDEX INTO DATA(lv_idx)
                         ( |Index { lv_idx }: { ls_row-value }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_index_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_index_loop=>tt_data(
      ( value = 'Alpha' )
      ( value = 'Beta' )
      ( value = 'Gamma' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Index 1: Alpha' )
      ( 'Index 2: Beta' )
      ( 'Index 3: Gamma' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_table( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Table processing failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_index_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_index_loop=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_table( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Empty table should return empty result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `INDEX INTO` ermöglicht es, den aktuellen Zeilenindex direkt in einer lokalen Variablen zu speichern, ohne auf das globale Systemfeld `sy-tabix` zugreifen zu müssen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kapselung des Codes. In Kombination mit einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor wird die Tabelle direkt und deklarativ aufgebaut.
keywords: sy-tabix, FOR, INDEX INTO, VALUE, Internal Table

      iv_filter TYPE string OPTIONAL
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employee
    RAISING
      cx_static_check. " Placeholder for actual exception
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_employee_api_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_employee_api.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_api_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_employee_api~get_employees.
    " Simulate fetching data and parsing JSON
    " In a real scenario, this would involve cl_http_client, JSON deserialization etc.
    DATA(lv_json_response) =
      `[{"employee_id":"001","first_name":"Max","last_name":"Mustermann","email":"max.m@example.com"},` &
      `{"employee_id":"002","first_name":"Erika","last_name":"Musterfrau","email":"erika.m@example.com"}]`.

    " Deserialize JSON (simplified for mock)
    " In a real scenario, use /UI2/CL_JSON or similar
    IF iv_filter IS INITIAL.
      rt_employees = VALUE #(
        ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'Max' last_name = 'Mustermann' email = 'max.m@example.com' )
        ( employee_id = '002' first_name = 'Erika' last_name = 'Musterfrau' email = 'erika.m@example.com' )
      ).
    ELSE.
      " Simulate filtering
      rt_employees = VALUE #(
        FOR employee IN VALUE zif_employee_api=>tt_employee(
          ( employee_id = '001' first_name = 'Max' last_name = 'Mustermann' email = 'max.m@example.com' )
          ( employee_id = '002' first_name = 'Erika' last_name = 'Musterfrau' email = 'erika.m@example.com' )
        )
        WHERE ( first_name CP iv_filter OR last_name CP iv_filter )
        ( employee )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Produkte in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_products TYPE tt_product RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total = CONV decfloat16( '0.00' )
      FOR product IN it_products
      NEXT total = total + product-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expr_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_select_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_day_of_week TYPE i " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    rv_day_type = SWITCH string( iv_day_of_week
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Wochentag'

      WHEN 3 THEN 'Wochentag'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Wochentag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Wochentag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Wochenende'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Wochenende'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                             ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_group_by_loop=>tt_flight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '004' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '005' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_group_by_loop=>tt_carrier_count(
      ( carrid = 'AA' flight_count = 2 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' flight_count = 1 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_count = 2 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 groups' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'AA flight count incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'LH flight count incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'BA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'BA flight count incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_group_by_loop=>tt_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Empty table should return empty result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Funktion, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren. Dies vereinfacht Aggregationen und Gruppierungslogik erheblich, da keine manuellen Sortierungen oder temporären Tabellen mehr erforderlich sind. Die `INTO DATA(ls_group_key)`-Klausel erstellt eine Struktur für den Gruppenschlüssel, und `LOOP AT GROUP` iteriert über die Elemente der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP, Internal Table, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Finden Sie den niedrigsten Flugpreis in einer Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Anweisung mit der `MINIMUM`-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_price_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT min_price = it_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT min_price = COND s_price( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_min_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_min_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '75.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_min_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '75.00' msg = 'Incorrect minimum price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_min_price( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' msg = 'Should return 0 for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine funktionale und prägnante Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Die `INIT`-Klausel setzt den Startwert, und `NEXT` aktualisiert diesen basierend auf einer Bedingung, um das Minimum zu finden.
keywords: REDUCE, MINIMUM, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie die Flugnummern aller Flüge mit dem niedrigsten Preis aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` zur Ermittlung des `MINIMUM`s und `FOR` zur Filterung und Projektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_price_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_with_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_with_min_price.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_min_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT min_price = it_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT min_price = COND s_price( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price )
    ).

    rt_connids = VALUE tt_connid(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( price = lv_min_price )
      ( flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_connids_min_price FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_multiple_min_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_connids_min_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_for=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '75.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_connids_with_min_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '0401' msg = 'Incorrect connid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_for=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_connids_with_min_price( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Should return empty table for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_min_prices.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_for=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '75.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '75.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_for( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = '0017' msg = 'Missing connid 0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_result needle = '0401' msg = 'Missing connid 0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` zur effizienten Ermittlung des Minimums und eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE`-Klausel zur Filterung und Projektion der gewünschten Daten. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den niedrigsten Flugpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und ermitteln Sie das `MINIMUM` innerhalb jeder Gruppe mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_price_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_min_price,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             min_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_min_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_min_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_min_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_min_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_min_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_per_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING INTO DATA(key).
      DATA(lv_min_price_for_carrier) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT min_price = key-price
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP key
        NEXT min_price = COND s_price( WHEN grouped_flight-price < min_price THEN grouped_flight-price ELSE min_price )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = key-carrid min_price = lv_min_price_for_carrier ) TO rt_min_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_price_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_price_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_group_by=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '75.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' price = '500.00' currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_min_price_per_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of carriers' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_min) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_min-min_price exp = '75.00' msg = 'Incorrect min price for LH' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_min) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_min-min_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Incorrect min price for AA' ).

    DATA(ls_sq_min) = lt_result[ carrid = 'SQ' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sq_min-min_price exp = '500.00' msg = 'Incorrect min price for SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_min_price_group_by=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_min_price_per_carrier( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Should return empty table for empty input' ).

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50, ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Daten. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe kann das Minimum für jede Gruppe effizient ermittelt werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, MINIMUM, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge, deren Preis dem niedrigsten Preis in der gesamten Tabelle entspricht.
hint: Ermitteln Sie zuerst den `MINIMUM`-Preis mit `REDUCE` und verwenden Sie dann `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_min_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_min_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_price.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_min_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT min_price = it_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT min_price = COND s_price( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price = lv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_for_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_for_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( flight )
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT min_price = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT min_price = COND s_price( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Baumstruktur (Simple Tree Control) und füllen Sie diese mit hierarchischen Daten, z.B. Fluggesellschaften und deren Verbindungen aus `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` und `add_node` Methoden. Beachten Sie, dass für die Ausführung ein Dynpro-Container benötigt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_basic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_tree
          IMPORTING
            it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
          RETURNING
            VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_basic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_tree.
    DATA: lv_container_name TYPE scrfname VALUE 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Placeholder for actual screen container
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = lv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN it_sflights ( carrid ) ).
    DATA(lv_node_key) TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.

    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      ro_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_text = lv_carrid
          i_node_type = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_type_folder
          i_node_key  = lv_carrid
        IMPORTING
          e_node_key  = lv_node_key
      ).
      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        ro_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_text = |{ ls_flight-connid } - { ls_flight-fldate }|
            i_node_type = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_type_leaf
            i_node_key  = |{ lv_carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|
            i_parent_key = lv_carrid
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = lv_node_key ).
    ro_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = lv_node_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS create_and_display_tree
          IMPORTING
            it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
          RETURNING
            VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_tree.
    DATA: lv_container_name TYPE scrfname VALUE 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Placeholder
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = lv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    mo_tree = ro_tree. " Store reference for event handler

    SET HANDLER me->handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.

    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN it_sflights ( carrid ) ).
    DATA(lv_node_key) TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.

    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_text = lv_carrid
          i_node_type = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_type_folder
          i_node_key  = lv_carrid
        IMPORTING
          e_node_key  = lv_node_key
      ).
      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_text = |{ ls_flight-connid } - { ls_flight-fldate }|
            i_node_type = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_type_leaf
            i_node_key  = |{ lv_carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate }|
            i_parent_key = lv_carrid
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = lv_node_key ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = lv_node_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    " In a real application, this would update a screen field or trigger further logic.
    " For this example, we just simulate a message.
    MESSAGE |Node '{ node_key }' double-clicked!| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_manipulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

          RETURNING
            VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

          IMPORTING
            iv_parent_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key
            iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
            iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
            iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_manipulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_initial_tree.
    DATA: lv_container_name TYPE scrfname VALUE 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = lv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS

    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    mo_tree = ro_tree.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_text = 'Root Node'
        i_node_type = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_type_folder
        i_node_key  = 'ROOT'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_new_flight_node.
    IF mo_tree IS BOUND.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_text = |{ iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }-{ iv_fldate }|
          i_node_type = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_type_leaf
          i_node_key  = |{ iv_parent_key }-{ iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }-{ iv_fldate }|
          i_parent_key = iv_parent_key
      ).
      mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = iv_parent_key ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_selected_node.
    IF mo_tree IS BOUND.
      mo_tree->delete_node( i_node_key = iv_node_key ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_filter_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS filter_sflights_exclude_status
          IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_status_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-status(

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_filter_sflights_exclude.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-status = 'X'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-status = 'C'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-status = 'X'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_filter_exclude( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_exclude_status( it_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_filtered[ carrid = 'UA' ] ) )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(

    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann (z.B. Division durch Null). Implementieren Sie `if_oo_adt_classrun`, um diese Methode aufzurufen und die Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` abzufangen und eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung auszugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide` und `out->write_error()` zur Ausgabe von Fehlern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_adt_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING iv_numerator   TYPE i
                iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING   cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_adt_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_adt_error_handling( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        out->write( |Ergebnis: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        out->write_error( |Fehler: Division durch Null! { lx_zero->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
        out->write( |Ergebnis 2: { lv_result2 }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        out->write_error( |Fehler 2: Division durch Null! { lx_zero->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden. Implementieren Sie `if_oo_adt_classrun`, um dynamisch eine dieser Methoden basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter aufzurufen und das Ergebnis auszugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen. Beachten Sie die Groß-/Kleinschreibung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_adt_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS execute_dynamic IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_adt_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_adt_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic( 'METHOD_A' ).
    out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf A: { lv_result_a }| ).
    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic( 'METHOD_B' ).
    out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf B: { lv_result_b }| ).
    DATA(lv_result_c) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf C: { lv_result_c }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_a.
    rv_text = 'Dies ist Methode A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_text = 'Dies ist Methode B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic.
    DATA lo_ref TYPE REF TO zcl_adt_dynamic_call.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.
    DATA lv_result_dyn TYPE string.

    lo_ref = me.
    lv_method_name = iv_method_name.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lo_ref)->(lv_method_name)
          RECEIVING
            rv_text = lv_result_dyn.
        rv_result = lv_result_dyn.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und verwenden Sie einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um diese in einem String zu konkatenieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` und anschließend einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_carrids_as_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distinct_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_carrids_str) = lo_cut->get_carrids_as_string( ).
    out->write( |Alle eindeutigen Carrier IDs als String: { lv_carrids_str }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrids_as_string.
    DATA lt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_carrids.

    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrid IN lt_carrids
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrid
        ELSE |{ s }, { carrid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_carrids_str) = lo_cut->get_carrids_as_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_carrids_str, msg = 'Der String der Carrier IDs sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    " Annahme: Die Carrier AA und LH existieren und werden im String enthalten sein.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'AA' act = lv_carrids_str, msg = 'String sollte AA enthalten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'LH' act = lv_carrids_str, msg = 'String sollte LH enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `SELECT DISTINCT` mit dem leistungsstarken `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Liste von eindeutigen Carrier-IDs in einen einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String zu transformieren. `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Operator, der komplexe Schleifenlogik prägnant ausdrückt und die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, REDUCE, String Templates, sflights, Functional Programming, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine positive Ganzzahl erwartet. Wenn die Zahl negativ oder Null ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt, und verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE.
solution:
CLASS zcx_negative_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_negative_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_positive_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_positive_number.
    IF iv_number <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_number
        MESSAGE e001(zmsg_app) " Assuming message class ZMSG_APP with message 001 'Number &1 must be positive'
        WITH iv_number.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_number RAISING zcx_negative_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_number_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_validator->validate_positive_number( 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected for positive number' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_number.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected exception for positive number' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_number_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_validator->validate_positive_number( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for negative number' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_number INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->get_text( ) exp = 'Number -5 must be positive' msg = 'Incorrect exception message' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition einer eigenen Ausnahme-Klasse ermöglicht eine spezifische Fehlerbehandlung. Die Verwendung von RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE mit MESSAGE ermöglicht die direkte Verknüpfung der Ausnahme mit einer Nachricht aus einer Nachrichtenklasse, was die Fehlerdiagnose vereinfacht.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine einzelne Zahl verarbeitet. Wenn die Zahl einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, soll eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die es dem aufrufenden Programm ermöglicht, die Verarbeitung fortzusetzen, nachdem der Fehler 'ignoriert' wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE und die CATCH-Block-Option FOR RESUMABLE EXCEPTIONS.
solution:
CLASS zcx_threshold_exceeded DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA exceeded_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA index TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_exceeded_value TYPE i OPTIONAL
        i_index TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_threshold_exceeded IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->exceeded_value = i_exceeded_value.
    me->index = i_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_single_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
        iv_threshold TYPE i
        iv_index TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_threshold_exceeded.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_single_number.
    IF iv_number > iv_threshold.
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_threshold_exceeded
        MESSAGE e002(zmsg_app) " Assuming message class ZMSG_APP with message 002 'Value &1 exceeds threshold &2 at index &3'
        WITH iv_number iv_threshold iv_index
        EXPORTING
          i_exceeded_value = iv_number
          i_index = iv_index.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ( 15 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = 25.
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number) INDEX DATA(idx).
      TRY.
          lo_processor->process_single_number(
            iv_number    = lv_number
            iv_threshold = lv_threshold
            iv_index     = idx
          ).
          lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_number.
          lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
        CATCH zcx_threshold_exceeded INTO DATA(lx_ex) FOR RESUMABLE EXCEPTIONS.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->exceeded_value exp = 30 msg = 'Incorrect exceeded value' ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->index exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect index of exception' ).
          " The program continues to the next iteration after catching the resumable exception.
          " The problematic number (30) is skipped from sum calculation.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = 50 exp = lv_sum msg = 'Sum of valid numbers is incorrect' ). " 10 + 20 + 15 + 5 = 50
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = 4 exp = lv_processed_count msg = 'Incorrect count of processed numbers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglichen es, auf einen Fehler zu reagieren und die Programmausführung an der Stelle des Fehlers fortzusetzen. Dies ist nützlich für Fehler, die behoben oder ignoriert werden können, ohne den gesamten Prozess abzubrechen. Der CATCH-Block mit FOR RESUMABLE EXCEPTIONS fängt die Ausnahme ab und erlaubt die Fortsetzung der Schleife.
keywords: RAISE RESUMABLE, EXCEPTION, RESUMABLE EXCEPTIONS, CATCH FOR RESUMABLE
