Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die versucht, eine Division durch Null durchzuführen. Verwenden Sie einen funktionalen Ansatz mit TRY...CATCH, um die Ausnahme abzufangen und einen Standardwert zurückzugeben, falls ein Fehler auftritt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den TRY-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem CATCH-Block, um einen Wert zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_with_default.
    rv_result = TRY.
                  DATA(lv_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
                  " If no exception, return lv_result
                  lv_result.
                CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
                  " If exception, return default value
                  0.
                ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_functional_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->divide_with_default( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 msg = 'Division should be successful' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_functional_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->divide_with_default( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Division by zero should return default' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der TRY-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen direkt in Ausdrücken abzufangen und einen alternativen Wert zurückzugeben. Dies führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code, insbesondere wenn ein Standardwert im Fehlerfall gewünscht ist.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, FUNCTIONAL, EXCEPTION, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Führen Sie eine binäre Suche auf einer sortierten internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) durch, um zu prüfen, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag existiert, und geben Sie den Eintrag zurück, falls vorhanden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Ausdruck LINE_EXISTS mit BINARY SEARCH.

CLASS zcl_flight_searcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS find_flight_binary_search
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_searcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_binary_search.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate fetching data into a sorted table
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] BINARY SEARCH ).
      rs_flight = lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] BINARY SEARCH.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie eine Sequenz von Bytes innerhalb eines XSTRINGs durch eine andere Sequenz.
hint: Verwenden Sie die REPLACE SECTION-Anweisung für XSTRINGs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_byte_sequence
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_offset TYPE i
        iv_length TYPE i
        iv_replacement_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_byte_sequence.
    rv_modified_xstring = iv_original_xstring.
    REPLACE SECTION iv_offset LENGTH iv_length OF rv_modified_xstring WITH iv_replacement_xstring.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_byte_sequence FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_at_start FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_at_end FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_byte_sequence.
    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_xstring_manipulator( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = '00112233445566778899AABBCCDD'X.
    DATA(lv_replacement) = 'EEFF'X.
    DATA(lv_expected) = '0011EEFF445566778899AABBCCDD'X.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_manipulator->replace_byte_sequence(
      iv_original_xstring = lv_original
      iv_offset           = 2 " Start at 3rd byte (0-indexed)
      iv_length           = 2 " Replace 2 bytes
      iv_replacement_xstring = lv_replacement
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Byte sequence replacement failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_at_start.
    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_xstring_manipulator( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = '00112233'X.
    DATA(lv_replacement) = 'AABB'X.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'AABB2233'X.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_manipulator->replace_byte_sequence(
      iv_original_xstring = lv_original
      iv_offset           = 0
      iv_length           = 2
      iv_replacement_xstring = lv_replacement
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Byte sequence replacement at start failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_at_end.
    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_xstring_manipulator( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = '00112233'X.
    DATA(lv_replacement) = 'CCDD'X.
    DATA(lv_expected) = '0011CCDD'X.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_manipulator->replace_byte_sequence(
      iv_original_xstring = lv_original
      iv_offset           = 2
      iv_length           = 2
      iv_replacement_xstring = lv_replacement
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Byte sequence replacement at end failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die REPLACE SECTION-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke und direkte Methode zur Manipulation von XSTRINGs. Sie ermöglicht das Ersetzen von Byte-Sequenzen an einer bestimmten Position und Länge, was für die Bearbeitung binärer Daten unerlässlich ist.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, REPLACE SECTION, BYTE MANIPULATION

Instructions: Suchen Sie eine bestimmte Byte-Sequenz innerhalb eines XSTRINGs und geben Sie den Offset zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die FIND-Anweisung für XSTRINGs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_byte_sequence
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_search_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_offset) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_byte_sequence.
    FIND iv_search_xstring IN SECTION OFFSET 0 OF iv_xstring MATCH OFFSET rv_offset.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_offset = -1. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RAISE SHORTDUMP` in einem Szenario, in dem ein nicht behebbarer kritischer Fehler auftritt, der einen sofortigen Programmabbruch erfordert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE SHORTDUMP` mit einer Begründung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_critical_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_critical_step
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_critical_step.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      " Simulate a critical, unrecoverable error condition
      RAISE SHORTDUMP WITH 'Critical input value 0 detected. Program cannot continue.'.
    ELSE.
      " Normal processing
      WRITE: / 'Processing input:', iv_input.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `RAISE SHORTDUMP` (ab ABAP 7.50) ist für Situationen gedacht, in denen ein Programm aufgrund eines schwerwiegenden, nicht behebbaren Fehlers nicht sinnvoll fortgesetzt werden kann. Es erzeugt einen sofortigen Laufzeitfehler (Shortdump) und sollte nur in Ausnahmefällen verwendet werden, wenn keine andere Fehlerbehandlung möglich ist.
keywords: RAISE SHORTDUMP, EXCEPTION, CRITICAL ERROR, SHORTDUMP

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Preis eines Fluges aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer mittels Tabellenausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck `itab[ key_field = value ]-result_field` und fangen Sie `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        rv_price = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_price = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus `sflights` enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( 
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_for( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( iv_min_price = 500 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_expensive ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE #, WHERE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Constructor Injection, um eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Logger) in eine Klasse zu übergeben.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    METHODS zif_logger~log_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einem echten System würde hier auf die Konsole oder ein Log geschrieben.
    " Für dieses Beispiel wird die Nachricht ignoriert.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
    METHODS perform_action.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    " Mock logger for testing
    CLASS lcl_mock_logger DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_console_logger.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
        METHODS zif_logger~log_message REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
        mv_last_message = iv_message.
      ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Struktur zur Laufzeit und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_line,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_line.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Define the structure of the dynamic table line
    lo_line_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data( VALUE ty_dynamic_line( ) ).

    " Create a table type based on the line structure
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
        p_line_type = lo_line_descr
        p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
        p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    " Create the dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " Assign to a field symbol to work with it
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill the dynamic table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.

    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    <fs_line>-field1 = 'Dynamic Value 1'.
    <fs_line>-field2 = 100.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

    <fs_line>-field1 = 'Dynamic Value 2'.
    <fs_line>-field2 = 200.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <ls_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field1> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Dynamic Value 1' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field2> TYPE i.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Anwendungen, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` sind hierfür zentrale Werkzeuge.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators und der neuen mathematischen Funktionen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Zählvariable und der Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
             count TYPE i = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price,
             count = count + 1 
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_avg_price ).
    " A more robust test would insert specific test data into SFLIGHT or mock the SELECT.
    " For simplicity, we just check if the result is not empty.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination des `REDUCE`-Operators mit mehreren `INIT`-Variablen ermöglicht die gleichzeitige Aggregation von Summen und Zählern in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Durchschnittswerte zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, SFLIGHT, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_http_hello_world DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

CLASS zcl_http_hello_world IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.

    lo_request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    lo_server->set_request( lo_request ).
    lo_server->set_response( lo_response ).

    lo_handler->if_http_extension~handle_request( lo_server ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_response->get_cdata( )
      exp = 'Hello, World!'
      msg = 'Response body should be "Hello, World!"'
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der eine POST-Anfrage mit einem JSON-Body empfängt, diesen parst und eine Bestätigungsnachricht mit einem Wert aus dem JSON zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `server->request->get_cdata()` für den Request-Body und `cl_abap_conv_json=>json_to_data()` zum Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_request_body) = server->request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            message TYPE string,
          END OF ls_data.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_conv_json=>json_to_data( EXPORTING json = lv_request_body IMPORTING data = ls_data ).
        server->response->set_cdata( |Received message: '{ ls_data-message }'| ).
        server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        server->response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
        server->response->set_cdata( |JSON parsing error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der je nach HTTP-Methode (GET oder POST) unterschiedliche Antworten liefert. Für GET "This is a GET request.", für POST "This is a POST request.".
hint: Verwenden Sie `server->request->get_method()` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_method_dispatch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_method_dispatch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_method) = server->request->get_method( ).
    DATA(lv_response_text) = ''.

    CASE lv_method.
      WHEN if_http_request=>co_method_get.
        lv_response_text = 'This is a GET request.'.
      WHEN if_http_request=>co_method_post.
        lv_response_text = 'This is a POST request.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        server->response->set_status( code = 405 reason = 'Method Not Allowed' ).
        lv_response_text = |Method '{ lv_method }' not supported.|.
    ENDCASE.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( lv_response_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_cookies IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_session_id) = server->request->get_cookie_value( 'SESSION_ID' ).

      " Set a new session ID if not present
      lv_session_id = cl_uuid_factory=>create_uuid_x16_static( )->if_uuid_x16~create_uuid_c32( ).

    ELSE.
      server->response->set_cdata( |Existing session. Session ID: { lv_session_id }| ).
    ENDIF.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    lo_handler->if_http_extension~handle_request( lo_server ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_cdata( ) exp = 'Existing session. Session ID: 1234567890ABCDEF1234567890ABCDEF' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den Umgang mit HTTP-Cookies. Es demonstriert, wie man ein neues Cookie in der Antwort setzt (`set_cookie`) und wie man den Wert eines vorhandenen Cookies aus der Anfrage ausliest (`get_cookie_value`). Die Verwendung von `cl_uuid_factory` zur Generierung einer eindeutigen Session-ID ist ein modernes Muster.
keywords: HTTP, Cookies, Session Management, if_http_request, if_http_response, cl_uuid_factory

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Service, der einen URL-Pfadparameter (z.B. `/users/{id}`) ausliest und eine Antwort basierend auf diesem Parameter generiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `server->request->get_url_parameter()` für Pfadparameter. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine ICF-Konfiguration erfordert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_url_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_url_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    " In ICF, the URL parameter 'id' would be configured as a placeholder in the service path, e.g., /sap/bc/http/sap/z_my_service/users/{id}
    DATA(lv_user_id) = server->request->get_url_parameter( 'id' ).

    IF lv_user_id IS NOT INITIAL.
      server->response->set_cdata( |User ID from URL: { lv_user_id }| ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ELSE.
      server->response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
      server->response->set_cdata( 'User ID parameter missing in URL path.' ).
    ENDIF.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_url_param FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_without_url_param FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_url_param.
    DATA(lo_server) = NEW cl_http_server( ).
    DATA(lo_request) = NEW cl_http_request( ).
    DATA(lo_response) = NEW cl_http_response( ).

    lo_request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    " Simulate URL parameter 'id' being set by ICF runtime
    lo_request->set_url_parameter( name = 'id' value = '123' ).
    lo_server->set_request( lo_request ).
    lo_server->set_response( lo_response ).

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_http_url_param( ).
    lo_handler->if_http_extension~handle_request( lo_server ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_cdata( ) exp = 'User ID from URL: 123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_status_code( ) exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_without_url_param.
    DATA(lo_server) = NEW cl_http_server( ).
    DATA(lo_request) = NEW cl_http_request( ).
    DATA(lo_response) = NEW cl_http_response( ).

    lo_request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    " No URL parameter set
    lo_server->set_request( lo_request ).
    lo_server->set_response( lo_response ).

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_http_url_param( ).
    lo_handler->if_http_extension~handle_request( lo_server ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_status_code( ) exp = 400 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lo_response->get_cdata( ) exp = 'User ID parameter missing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man URL-Pfadparameter ausliest, die in der ICF-Konfiguration als Platzhalter definiert sind (z.B. `/users/{id}`). Die Methode `server->request->get_url_parameter()` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf diese Werte. Dies ist grundlegend für die Implementierung von RESTful APIs mit dynamischen Ressourcenpfaden.
keywords: HTTP, URL Parameters, Path Parameters, REST, if_http_request, ICF

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Status-Code (0, 1, 2) einen entsprechenden Text ('Offen', 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen') zu. Wenn der Code unbekannt ist, soll 'Unbekannt' zugewiesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND #(` Ausdrucksform für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_status_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_status_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 0 THEN 'Offen'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                       ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_codes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_codes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_status_assign( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 0 )
      exp = 'Offen' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 1 )
      exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 2 )
      exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 99 )
      exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND #(` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten, ähnlich einem Ternary-Operator oder Switch-Statement in anderen Sprachen. Er vermeidet lange `IF-ELSEIF-ENDIF`-Blöcke.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Flugdatum nach dem 01.01.2025 liegt. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Feldern `carrid`, `connid`, `fldate` und `price`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Tabellen-Comprehension mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #(`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lv_date_threshold) = '20250101'.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND
                fldate > lv_date_threshold AND
                cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) 
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
          price  = ls_flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'No flights found, check SFLIGHTS data or filter conditions.'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_warning ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-fldate > '20250101' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellen-Comprehensions mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` ermöglichen das Filtern und Transformieren von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ... ENDLOOP`-Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der freien Sitze (seatsmax - seatsocc) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um die Summe zu aggregieren, und filtern Sie die Einträge mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_seats = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
        NEXT total_seats = total_seats + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_seats) = 0.

    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_expected_seats = lv_expected_seats + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_seats
      exp = lv_expected_seats
      msg = 'Total free seats calculation is incorrect.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats( 'XX' )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Should return 0 for non-existent carrier.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` können Filterbedingungen direkt in den Aggregationsprozess integriert werden, was zu sehr prägnantem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hierarchie von Klassen (z.B. `Shape`, `Circle`, `Rectangle`). Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von `Shape`-Objekten entgegennimmt und für jedes Objekt eine typspezifische Aktion ausführt (z.B. die Fläche berechnet), indem `CASE TYPE OF` verwendet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` um den tatsächlichen Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen und typspezifische Methoden aufzurufen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    " Default implementation or error
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    " Default implementation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'. " Pi
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width  = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Rectangle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE tt_shapes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      DATA(lv_result) = SWITCH string(
        TYPE OF lo_shape
        WHEN TYPE zcl_circle THEN |Circle: { lo_shape->get_type( ) } Area: { lo_shape->get_area( ) }|
        WHEN TYPE zcl_rectangle THEN |Rectangle: { lo_shape->get_type( ) } Area: { lo_shape->get_area( ) }|
        ELSE |Unknown Shape: { lo_shape->get_type( ) }|
      ).
      APPEND lv_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shape_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shape_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_shapes)    = zcl_shape_processor=>tt_shapes(
      ( NEW zcl_circle( 5 ) )
      ( NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = 4 iv_width = 6 ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results )
      exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lt_results[ 1 ]
      needle   = 'Circle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lt_results[ 1 ]
      needle   = 'Area: 78.53975' ). 

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lt_results[ 2 ]
      needle   = 'Rectangle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lt_results[ 2 ]
      needle   = 'Area: 24' ). 
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CASE TYPE OF` Ausdruck (hier in Kombination mit `SWITCH`) ermöglicht die typsichere Verarbeitung von Objekten in einer Polymorphie-Hierarchie. Dies ist eine elegante Methode, um typspezifisches Verhalten zu implementieren, ohne auf RTTI-Methoden wie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, SWITCH, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Lesen Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` die Flugdaten. Fügen Sie ein neues Feld `flight_status` hinzu, das 'On Time' ist, wenn `seatsocc` kleiner als `seatsmax` ist, und 'Full' wenn `seatsocc` gleich `seatsmax` ist. Wenn `seatsocc` größer als `seatsmax` ist (was ein Fehler wäre), soll 'Overbooked' angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE WHEN` Ausdruck direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_sql_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate       TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc     TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax     TYPE s_seatsmax,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_sql_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid,
           connid,
           fldate,
           seatsocc,
           seatsmax,
           CASE
             WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax THEN 'On Time'
             WHEN seatsocc = seatsmax THEN 'Full'
             ELSE 'Overbooked'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_sql_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'No flights found, check SFLIGHTS data.'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_warning ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_on_time) = lt_flights[ 1 ]. 
      IF ls_on_time-seatsocc < ls_on_time-seatsmax.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_on_time-flight_status
          exp = 'On Time'
          msg = 'Incorrect status for On Time flight.' ).
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_flight-flight_status = 'On Time' OR
                  ls_flight-flight_status = 'Full' OR
                  ls_flight-flight_status = 'Overbooked' )
          msg = 'Invalid flight status found.' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE WHEN` direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die bedingte Datenmanipulation auf Datenbankebene. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing in ABAP und kann die Performance verbessern, da die Logik direkt im SQL-Statement ausgeführt wird.
keywords: SELECT, CASE WHEN, SQL, Database Access, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und verschiedene Ausnahmen (z.B. `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`, `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW`) mit spezifischen `WHEN`-Blöcken abfängt und entsprechende Fehlermeldungen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit mehreren `WHEN`-Klauseln, um verschiedene Ausnahmetypen zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_division.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division successful: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero_divide).
        rv_result = |Fehler: Division durch Null! ({ lx_zero_divide->get_text( ) })|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow INTO DATA(lx_overflow).
        rv_result = |Fehler: Arithmetischer Überlauf! ({ lx_overflow->get_text( ) })|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Allgemeiner Fehler: ({ lx_root->get_text( ) })|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_normal_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overflow FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_result
      needle   = 'Division durch Null!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_normal_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Division successful: 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    " Max int value is 2,147,483,647. Multiplying by a large number can cause overflow.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 2147483647 iv_denominator = -1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_result
      needle   = 'Division successful: -2147483647' ).
    " For a true overflow test, we'd need to force a scenario that exceeds the type's capacity
    " which is harder with simple division. This example focuses on the CATCH WHEN structure.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur mit mehreren `WHEN`-Klauseln ermöglicht eine granulare Fehlerbehandlung. Spezifische Ausnahmen können abgefangen und unterschiedlich behandelt werden, während eine generische `CATCH cx_root` oder `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback dient. Dies führt zu robusterem und wartbarerem Code.
keywords: TRY CATCH, WHEN, Exception Handling, Error Handling, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Base64-kodiertes PNG-Bild in das JPEG-Format unter Verwendung von `CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER`. Geben Sie das Ergebnis ebenfalls Base64-kodiert zurück.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER`, setzen Sie die Eingabedaten und -formate und rufen Sie die Konvertierungsmethode auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_converter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_png_to_jpeg
      IMPORTING
        iv_base64_png TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_base64_jpeg) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_igs_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_converter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_png_to_jpeg.
    DATA: lv_xstring_png TYPE xstring,
          lv_xstring_jpeg TYPE xstring.

    " Convert Base64 string to XSTRING
    CALL FUNCTION 'SSFC_BASE64_DECODE'
      EXPORTING
        bindata = iv_base64_png
      IMPORTING
        xdata   = lv_xstring_png.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).

    lo_converter->input_format  = cl_igs_image_converter=>c_image_format_png.
    lo_converter->output_format = cl_igs_image_converter=>c_image_format_jpeg.
    lo_converter->input_data    = lv_xstring_png.

    lo_converter->execute( ).

    lv_xstring_jpeg = lo_converter->output_data.

    " Convert XSTRING to Base64 string
    CALL FUNCTION 'SSFC_BASE64_ENCODE'
      EXPORTING
        xdata   = lv_xstring_jpeg
      IMPORTING
        bindata = rv_base64_jpeg.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_png_to_jpeg_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, ein ungültiges Bildformat mit `CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER` zu konvertieren und fangen Sie die spezifische Ausnahme `CX_IGS_ERROR` ab. Geben Sie eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_igs_error` um Fehler der Bildkonvertierung abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_base64_data TYPE string
        iv_input_format TYPE string
        iv_output_format TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_xstring_data TYPE xstring.

    CALL FUNCTION 'SSFC_BASE64_DECODE'
      EXPORTING
        bindata = iv_base64_data
      IMPORTING
        xdata   = lv_xstring_data.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).
        lo_converter->input_format  = iv_input_format.
        lo_converter->output_format = iv_output_format.
        lo_converter->input_data    = lv_xstring_data.

        lo_converter->execute( ).

        rv_result = 'Image conversion successful.'.

      CATCH cx_igs_error INTO DATA(lx_igs_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler bei der Bildkonvertierung: { lx_igs_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (`carrid`, `connid`, `cityfrom`, `cityto`). Initialisieren Sie diese Tabelle mit einigen Werten und fügen Sie bedingt einen Eintrag hinzu, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist (z.B. wenn der Abflugort 'NEW YORK' ist).

CLASS zcl_table_value_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_connection.

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_value_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_conditionally.
    rt_connections = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '9000' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'SAN FRANCISCO' )
      FOR cond = 1 THEN 1 WHEN iv_add_ny_flight = abap_true

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft, basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen. Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN` oder `COND #(` um verschiedene Methodenaufrufe zu steuern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und `CASE WHEN` zur Steuerung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_dynamic_action.
  METHODS action_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  METHODS action_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~action_a.
    rv_result = 'Action A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~action_b.
    rv_result = 'Action B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_action.
    DATA(lo_me) = me.
    DATA(lv_method_name_uc) = to_upper( iv_method_name ).

    rv_output = COND string(
      WHEN lv_method_name_uc = 'ACTION_A' THEN lo_me->zif_dynamic_action~action_a( )
      WHEN lv_method_name_uc = 'ACTION_B' THEN lo_me->zif_dynamic_action~action_b( )
      ELSE 'Unknown action'
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugverbindung (`connid`). Für jede Gruppe sollen die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) ermittelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight_line-carrid connid = ls_flight_line-connid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid          = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid          = ls_group_key-connid
        num_flights     = GROUP SIZE
        total_seats_occ = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_summary )
      msg = 'No flight summaries found, check SFLIGHTS data.'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>severity_warning ).

    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
      " Find a specific group to assert, e.g., LH 0400
      DATA(ls_lh_0400_summary) = VALUE #( lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] OPTIONAL ).
      IF ls_lh_0400_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ls_lh_0400_summary-num_flights > 0
          msg = 'Number of flights for LH 0400 should be greater than 0.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ls_lh_0400_summary-total_seats_occ >= 0
          msg = 'Total seats occupied for LH 0400 should be non-negative.' ).
      ENDIF.

      " Check if all entries have valid data
      LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-carrid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-connid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_entry-num_flights > 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_entry-total_seats_occ >= 0 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife können komplexe Aggregationen sehr effizient und deklarativ durchgeführt werden, was den Code deutlich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach bestimmten Fluggesellschaften, die in einem Range definiert sind. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator, um den Range zu initialisieren, und eine `FOR`-Schleife, um die Ergebnisse zu sammeln. Wenn eine Fluggesellschaft nicht in den definierten Kriterien ist, aber eine spezielle Behandlung benötigt, nutzen Sie `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Range-Initialisierung und `FOR` mit `IN` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    " Define a range for airlines using VALUE operator
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid
      ( ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'LH' )
        ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'UA' ) ).

    " Filter using FOR loop and collect results
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid IN lr_carrid )
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                            price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    " Example of WHEN OTHERS usage (not directly in filter, but for processing)
    LOOP AT rt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      CASE <fs_flight>-carrid.
        WHEN 'LH'.
          " Special processing for Lufthansa
        WHEN 'UA'.
          " Special processing for United Airlines
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default processing for other filtered airlines (if any, though filter limits this)
          " This demonstrates WHEN OTHERS in a general processing context.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    " Setup test data (if sflight is empty)
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'UA' OR carrid = 'AA'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Initialisierung von Ranges mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und die Filterung einer internen Tabelle mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und der `WHERE`-Klausel. Die `WHEN OTHERS`-Klausel wird innerhalb einer `CASE`-Anweisung verwendet, um eine Standardbehandlung für nicht explizit genannte Fluggesellschaften zu zeigen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaften und Preisen. Die Fluggesellschaften sollen aus einem Range stammen, der dynamisch erstellt wird. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für eine prägnante Filterung.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und eine Range-Tabelle in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ',
               lc_option_gt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'GT'.

    " Define a range for airlines
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid
      ( ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'AA' )
        ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'DL' ) ).

    " Define a range for prices
    DATA(lr_price) = VALUE ranges of sflight-price
      ( ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_gt low = iv_min_price ) ).

    " Filter using the FILTER operator
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid IN lr_carrid AND price IN lr_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für verschiedene Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator und eine `CASE`-Anweisung mit `WHEN OTHERS`, um einen Standardwert für unbekannte Fluggesellschaften zu handhaben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `CASE WHEN OTHERS` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Simulate constants for specific processing
    CONSTANTS: lc_carrid_lh TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'LH',
               lc_carrid_ua TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'UA'.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price +
                                 CASE ls_sflight-carrid
                                   WHEN lc_carrid_lh THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.9' " 10% discount for LH
                                   WHEN lc_carrid_ua THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.95' " 5% discount for UA
                                   WHEN OTHERS THEN ls_sflight-price " No discount for others
                                 END ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und dies mit moderner Exception-Behandlung abfängt. Fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen ab und verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` sowie `cx_root` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING   cx_static_check. " Declare specific exceptions if re-raising

    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING
        io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arithmetic_error).
        " Specific handling for arithmetic errors (e.g., division by zero)
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_static_check=>default_text
            previous = lx_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " WHEN OTHERS equivalent for exceptions
        " Generic handling for any other unexpected exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_static_check=>default_text
            previous = lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = io_exception->get_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_divide_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_divide_other_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_when_others( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_when_others( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_static_check not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_ex->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->previous->get_class_name( ) exp = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Division by zero' act = lo_cut->get_error_message( lx_ex->previous ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_other_error.
    " Simulate another error, e.g., overflow (though division by zero is more common)
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_when_others( ).
    TRY.
        " This specific case might not trigger a different CX_ROOT easily without mocking
        " For demonstration, assume a generic error could occur.
        " Here, we'll just re-raise a generic CX_ROOT to test the WHEN OTHERS branch.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        TRY.
            lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 1 ). " This call won't actually trigger the WHEN OTHERS in real scenario
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_static_check not raised' ).
          CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_ex).
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_ex->previous ).
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_ex->previous->get_class_name( ) exp = 'CX_ROOT' ).
        ENDTRY.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Exception-Behandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Fehlerbehandlungslogik. Das Abfangen spezifischer Ausnahmen (z.B. `cx_sy_arithmetic_error`) und die Verwendung von `CATCH cx_root` (entspricht `WHEN OTHERS`) für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler macht den Code robust und wartbar.
keywords: TRY CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, Exceptions, Error Handling

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften, die in einem dynamisch erstellten Range definiert sind. Verwenden Sie die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax mit `IN @(range_table)`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... IN @(range_table)` für die Datenbankabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_in_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_in_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrids.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    " Dynamically build a range table from input table
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid
      ( FOR carrid_val IN it_carrids
        ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = carrid_val ) ).

    " Select data using the range table
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @lr_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` für eine präzise Feldzuordnung. Simulieren Sie die Verwendung von Ranges, um bestimmte Felder basierend auf Kriterien zu behandeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_mapping_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE string,
             field_c TYPE string,
             field_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             target_a TYPE string,
             target_b TYPE string,
             target_c TYPE string,
             target_e TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_mapping_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    " Simulate a range for fields to be excluded from default mapping
    DATA(lr_excluded_fields) = VALUE ranges of string
      ( ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'FIELD_C' ) ).

    " Use CORRESPONDING with MAPPING and EXCEPT
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING target_a = field_a
                                                 target_b = field_b
                                 EXCEPT field_c ). " Exclude field_c from default mapping

    " Manual mapping for excluded field, potentially based on range logic
    IF 'FIELD_C' NOT IN lr_excluded_fields. " This condition would always be true here, but demonstrates the concept
      rs_target-target_c = is_source-field_c.
    ELSE.
      rs_target-target_c = 'Excluded Value'.
    ENDIF.

    " Another field not in source, but can be set
    rs_target-target_e = 'Default E'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_mapping_except( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_mapping_except=>ty_source_data(
      field_a = 'Value A'
      field_b = 'Value B'
      field_c = 'Value C'
      field_d = 'Value D' ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_a exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_b exp = 'Value B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_c exp = 'Excluded Value' ). " Due to explicit exclusion and manual setting
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_e exp = 'Default E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten filtert. Der Filter soll über einen Range im Konstruktor der Klasse übergeben werden. Instanziieren Sie die Klasse mit dem `NEW`-Operator und einem dynamisch erstellten Range.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        ir_carrid_filter TYPE ranges of sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mr_carrid_filter TYPE ranges of sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mr_carrid_filter = ir_carrid_filter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid IN mr_carrid_filter ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Nutzen Sie `WHEN OTHERS` in einer `CASE`-Anweisung innerhalb der Schleife, um spezielle Behandlungen für bestimmte Gruppen zu zeigen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `CASE WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             special_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                        FOR GROUP ls_flight OF lt_sflights
                                        NEXT count = count + 1 ).

      DATA(lv_special_info) = CASE lv_carrid
                                WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa Group'
                                WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Star Alliance Member'
                                WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Other Airline'
                              END.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid      = lv_carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        special_info = lv_special_info
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt auf einen Flugpreis. Wenn der Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, wenden Sie einen höheren Rabatt an. Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für den Standardrabatt. Nutzen Sie Konstanten für die Schwellenwerte und Rabattsätze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` für die bedingte Rabattberechnung und Konstanten für Schwellenwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_cond_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_cond_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    CONSTANTS: lc_high_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price VALUE 500,
               lc_high_discount_rate   TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.15', " 15%
               lc_standard_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.05'. " 5%

    DATA(lv_discount_rate) = COND p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2(
      WHEN iv_original_price > lc_high_price_threshold THEN lc_high_discount_rate
      WHEN OTHERS THEN lc_standard_discount_rate
    ).

    rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( 1 - lv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein Feld einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) leer ist. Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und eine `CASE WHEN OTHERS`-Struktur, um verschiedene Feldtypen zu behandeln oder einen Standardfall zu definieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_elemdescr`) und `CASE WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_empty DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS is_field_empty
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_empty) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_empty IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_field_empty.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_elem_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr,
          lv_field_value  TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        DATA(ls_component) = lr_struct_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
        lr_elem_descr ?= ls_component-type.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE lr_elem_descr->type_kind.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
              lv_field_value = <fs_field>.
              IF lv_field_value IS INITIAL.
                rv_is_empty = abap_true.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_numc.
              lv_field_value = <fs_field>.
              IF lv_field_value IS INITIAL.
                rv_is_empty = abap_true.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
                 cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR
                 cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR
                 cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
              IF <fs_field> IS INITIAL.
                rv_is_empty = abap_true.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat OR
                 cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float OR
                 cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
              IF <fs_field> IS INITIAL.
                rv_is_empty = abap_true.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN OTHERS. " Handle other types generically or with a default assumption
              " For simplicity, convert to string and check initial for other types
              lv_field_value = <fs_field>.
              IF lv_field_value IS INITIAL.
                rv_is_empty = abap_true.
              ENDIF.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error cx_sy_assign_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Handle errors during RTTI or dynamic access
        rv_is_empty = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein Flugdatum in der aktuellen Woche, im aktuellen Monat oder im aktuellen Jahr liegt. Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für den Fall, dass es außerhalb dieser Zeiträume liegt. Nutzen Sie moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` und Datumsfunktionen wie `cl_abap_tstmp=>get_current_date_time` und `cl_abap_date_helper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_cond_period DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_period) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_cond_period IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_period.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_current_week_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_week_start( lv_current_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_week_end) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_week_end( lv_current_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_month_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_month_start( lv_current_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_month_end) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_month_end( lv_current_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_year_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_year_start( lv_current_date ).
    DATA(lv_current_year_end) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_year_end( lv_current_date ).

    rv_period = COND string(
      WHEN iv_fldate BETWEEN lv_current_week_start AND lv_current_week_end THEN 'Aktuelle Woche'
      WHEN iv_fldate BETWEEN lv_current_month_start AND lv_current_month_end THEN 'Aktueller Monat'
      WHEN iv_fldate BETWEEN lv_current_year_start AND lv_current_year_end THEN 'Aktuelles Jahr'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Anderer Zeitraum'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_current_week.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_cond_period( ).
    DATA(lv_date_in_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_month_start( sy-datum ) + 10.
    DATA(lv_period) = lo_cut->get_date_period( lv_date_in_month ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Aktuelle Woche' OR lv_period = 'Aktueller Monat' ). " Could be current week too
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_current_year.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_cond_period( ).
    DATA(lv_date_in_year) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_year_start( sy-datum ) + 60.
    DATA(lv_period) = lo_cut->get_date_period( lv_date_in_year ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Aktuelle Woche' OR lv_period = 'Aktueller Monat' OR lv_period = 'Aktuelles Jahr' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_cond_period( ).
    DATA(lv_date_other) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_period) = lo_cut->get_date_period( lv_date_other ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Anderer Zeitraum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression in Kombination mit den modernen Datumsfunktionen der Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Bestimmung von Zeiträumen. Die `WHEN OTHERS`-Klausel stellt sicher, dass alle nicht explizit definierten Zeiträume einen Standardwert erhalten, was die Robustheit des Codes erhöht.
