Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaften, die in einem Range definiert sind, und nach einem Mindestpreis. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und eine `CASE`-Anweisung mit `WHEN OTHERS` innerhalb der Filterbedingung, um eine spezielle Preislogik für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften zu berücksichtigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer komplexen `WHERE`-Bedingung, die `CASE WHEN OTHERS` enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_case_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_complex
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_case_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_complex.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    " Define a range for airlines
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid
      ( ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'LH' )
        ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'UA' ) ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid IN lr_carrid AND
                                 price >= CASE carrid
                                            WHEN 'LH' THEN iv_min_price * '0.8' " Lower min price for LH
                                            WHEN 'UA' THEN iv_min_price * '0.9'
                                            WHEN OTHERS THEN iv_min_price " Standard min price for others
                                          END ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_complex FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_complex_no_match FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_complex.
    " Setup test data
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = 120 ) ).

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_case_range( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_complex( iv_min_price = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " LH price 120 >= 150 * 0.8 (120)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ). " UA price 150 >= 150 * 0.9 (135)

  METHOD test_filter_complex_no_match.
    " Setup test data

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_case_range( ).

Dies ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und leistungsstarke Filterung von internen Tabellen, bei der die Filterkriterien dynamisch basierend auf den Daten selbst angepasst werden können. `WHEN OTHERS` sorgt für eine robuste Standardbehandlung.
keywords: FILTER, RANGES, CASE, WHEN OTHERS, Internal Tables, Filtering, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Status enthält und den Preis basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft anpasst. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `COND` und `WHEN OTHERS` für die Preislogik.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_status TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                      LET lv_flight_status = COND string(
                                        WHEN ls_sflight-fldate > sy-datum THEN 'Geplant'
                                        WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                                        WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt'
                                      ) IN
                                      WHERE ( lv_flight_status = iv_target_status )
                                      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                        adjusted_price = COND sflight-price(
                                          WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' THEN ls_sflight-price * '1.1' " 10% Aufschlag
                                          WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA' THEN ls_sflight-price * '1.05' " 5% Aufschlag
                                          WHEN OTHERS THEN ls_sflight-price " Kein Aufschlag
                                        ),
                                        status = lv_flight_status ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights_planned FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_flights_completed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights_planned.
    " Setup test data
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = 300 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( 'Geplant' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-adjusted_price exp = 110 ). " 100 * 1.1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ]-adjusted_price exp = 210 ). " 200 * 1.05
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-adjusted_price exp = 300 ). " 300 * 1.0

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE fldate = sy-datum + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_flights_completed.
    " Setup test data
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum - 1 price = 100 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( 'Abgeschlossen' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-adjusted_price exp = 110 ).

    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE fldate = sy-datum - 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_flights_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( 'Nicht Existenter Status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Durch die Verwendung von `LET` für lokale Variablen und `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS` innerhalb der Transformation kann komplexe Logik zur Filterung und Datenanpassung sehr kompakt und lesbar ausgedrückt werden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, WHEN OTHERS, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaften, die in einem Range definiert sind. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Range mit Konstanten für `SIGN` und `OPTION` initialisiert wird, die den Werten aus `if_fsbp_const_range` entsprechen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `VALUE` für die Range-Initialisierung mit expliziten Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_const_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_const_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I', " Include
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ', " Equals
               lc_option_bt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT'. " Between

    " Define a range for airlines using VALUE operator and constants
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE ranges of sflight-carrid
      ( ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'LH' )
        ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'UA' )
        ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_bt low = 'AA' high = 'DL' ) ).

    " Filter using the FILTER operator
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid IN lr_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus der Tabelle `SCARR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um die Liste zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_join_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_join_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_list.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR wa IN lt_scarr
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN wa-carrname
        ELSE s && ', ' && wa-carrname
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_carrier_list exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_carrier_list exp = 'United Airlines' ).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` durch, um Flugnummern mit den entsprechenden Fluggesellschaftsnamen zu erhalten. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Tabellenexpression mit `FOR` und `IN` für den Join und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           FOR carrier IN lt_scarr WHERE carrier~carrid = flight~carrid
                           ( carrid   = flight~carrid,
                             carrname = carrier~carrname,
                             connid   = flight~connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_inner_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_result>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_result>-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenexpressions mit verschachtelten `FOR`-Schleifen und `WHERE`-Bedingungen sind die moderne Art, Joins auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Dies ist oft performanter und lesbarer als klassische `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... READ TABLE` Konstrukte.
keywords: JOIN, Internal Tables, FOR, Table Expressions, SFLIGHTS, SCARR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen SQL-Befehl, der eine Tabelle und eine Liste von Feldern basierend auf Eingabeparametern verknüpft.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates, um den SQL-String zusammenzusetzen. Achten Sie auf korrekte Syntax und Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_dynamic_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_select_statement
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        it_fields     TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sql_statement) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_dynamic_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_select_statement.
    DATA(lv_field_list) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR field IN it_fields
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field
        ELSE s && ', ' && field
      )
    ).

    rv_sql_statement = |SELECT { lv_field_list } FROM { iv_table_name } INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result).|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_dynamic_sql FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sql.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_dynamic_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Left Outer Join zwischen `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` durch, um alle Flüge mit ihren Fluggesellschaftsnamen zu erhalten. Wenn keine Fluggesellschaft gefunden wird, soll der Name leer bleiben.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Tabellenexpression mit `FOR` und `IN` für den Join und `OPTIONAL` für den Left Outer Join.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_opt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_opt_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           LET carrier = lt_scarr[ OPTIONAL KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = flight~carrid ] IN
                           ( carrid   = flight~carrid,
                             carrname = carrier-carrname,
                             connid   = flight~connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_opt_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Check if there are entries with carrier name and potentially some without (if data allows)
    DATA(lv_has_lufthansa) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_empty_carrier) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
      IF <fs_result>-carrname = 'Lufthansa'.
        lv_has_lufthansa = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF <fs_result>-carrname IS INITIAL AND <fs_result>-carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_has_empty_carrier = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_lufthansa ).
    " Depending on SFLIGHTS/SCARR data, lv_has_empty_carrier might be true or false.
    " For a robust test, one might need to mock data or ensure a specific scenario.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Left Outer Join auf internen Tabellen wird elegant mit `FOR` und der `OPTIONAL KEY` Syntax in einer `LET`-Expression realisiert. Dies vermeidet explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen und macht den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker.
keywords: JOIN, Internal Tables, FOR, Table Expressions, OPTIONAL KEY, SFLIGHTS, SCARR

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und geben Sie das Ergebnis als String im Format 'CARRID: Count, ...' zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einer Tabellenexpression und `REDUCE` zur Formatierung des Ausgabe-Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_counts_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_grouped_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    rv_counts_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR group_item IN lt_grouped_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ group_item-carrid }: { group_item-count }|
        ELSE s && ', ' && |{ group_item-carrid }: { group_item-count }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         count  TYPE i,
       END OF ty_grouped_flight.
TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen URL-String aus Basispfad und Query-Parametern. Die Parameter sollen nur hinzugefügt werden, wenn sie nicht leer sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `COND` für die bedingte Hinzufügung von Query-Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_build_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url TYPE string
        iv_param1_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_param1_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_param2_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_param2_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_build_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_url.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = ``.

    IF iv_param1_name IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_param1_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_query_string = |{ iv_param1_name }={ iv_param1_value }|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_param2_name IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_param2_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_query_string = COND string(
        WHEN lv_query_string IS INITIAL THEN |{ iv_param2_name }={ iv_param2_value }|
        ELSE lv_query_string && '&' && |{ iv_param2_name }={ iv_param2_value }|
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_full_url = COND string(
      WHEN lv_query_string IS INITIAL THEN iv_base_url
      ELSE |{ iv_base_url }?{ lv_query_string }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Join über drei Tabellen (`SFLIGHTS`, `SCARR`, `SPFLI`) durch, um Flugdetails inklusive Fluggesellschaftsnamen und Abflug-/Ankunftsstädten zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Schleifen in einer Tabellenexpression, um den Multi-Join zu realisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_multi_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_full_flight_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_multi_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_full_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           FOR carrier IN lt_scarr WHERE carrier~carrid = flight~carrid
                           FOR connection IN lt_spfli WHERE connection~carrid = flight~carrid
                                                          AND connection~connid = flight~connid
                           ( carrid   = flight~carrid,
                             carrname = carrier~carrname,
                             connid   = flight~connid,
                             fldate   = flight~fldate,
                             cityfrom = connection~cityfrom,
                             cityto   = connection~cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_full_flight_details( ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_result>-cityfrom ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_result>-cityto ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_debug_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_debug_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_var_name TYPE string
        iv_var_value TYPE string
        iv_max_len   TYPE i DEFAULT 50
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_debug_msg) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_debug_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_debug_message.
    DATA(lv_display_value) = COND string(
      WHEN strlen( iv_var_value ) > iv_max_len
      THEN substring( val = iv_var_value off = 0 len = iv_max_len - 3 ) && '...'
      ELSE iv_var_value
    ).
    rv_debug_msg = |DEBUG: { iv_var_name } = '{ lv_display_value }'|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filtered_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_str_json_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_as_json
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_json_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_as_json.
    DATA(lv_flights_json_array) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{{"carrid":"{ flight-carrid }","connid":"{ flight-connid }","fldate":"{ flight-fldate }"}}|
        ELSE s && ',' && |{{"carrid":"{ flight-carrid }","connid":"{ flight-connid }","fldate":"{ flight-fldate }"}}|
      )
    ).
    rv_json_string = |[{ lv_flights_json_array }]|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Fehlermeldungen aus einer internen Tabelle von Fehlern, wobei jede Meldung mit einem Präfix versehen und durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt ist.

CLASS zcl_str_error_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_error_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_error_list
      IMPORTING
        it_errors TYPE tt_error_messages
        iv_prefix TYPE string DEFAULT 'ERROR: '
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_error_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_error_list.
    rv_formatted_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR error_msg IN it_errors
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ iv_prefix }{ error_msg }|
        ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && |{ iv_prefix }{ error_msg }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_project DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_project IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fra_jfk_connections.
    DATA lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_connections = VALUE #( FOR connection IN lt_spfli
                               WHERE connection-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
                                 AND connection-cityto   = 'NEW YORK'
                               ( carrid   = connection-carrid,
                                 connid   = connection-connid,
                                 cityfrom = connection-cityfrom,
                                 cityto   = connection-cityto ) ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.

    ELSE IF iv_status = 'O'.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert zu, basierend auf dem Preis eines Fluges: 'Günstig' (< 100), 'Normal' (100-500), 'Teuer' (> 500).

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price < 100 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN iv_price >= 100 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN 'Normal'
      WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Teuer'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `REDUCE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_test_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_test_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_test_flight-price = '200.00'. APPEND ls_test_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_test_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_test_flight-price = '150.00'. APPEND ls_test_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_test_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_test_flight-price = '300.00'. APPEND ls_test_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ) exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ) exp = '200.00' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Aggregationslogik angewendet wird. Sie ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `INTO GROUP` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(flight_group).
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ts_flight_count(
        carrid = flight_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_group_by_basic=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0012' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-flight_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und effizienter macht als manuelle Schleifen und Hilfstabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Filtern Sie dabei nur Gruppen, die mehr als einen Flug enthalten, und speichern Sie nur die Gruppenschlüssel (ohne die einzelnen Flüge).
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY ... WHERE` und `WITHOUT MEMBERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_grouped_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_grouped_key.
    TYPES tt_grouped_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_grouped_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_groups
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_keys) TYPE tt_grouped_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_groups.
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
         INTO DATA(flight_group)
         WHERE ( GROUP SIZE > 1 )
         WITHOUT MEMBERS.
      APPEND VALUE ts_grouped_key( carrid = flight_group-carrid fldate = flight_group-fldate ) TO rt_filtered_keys.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_group_by_filter=>tt_flight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data. "Group LH-20250101 (size 2)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data. "Group AA-20250101 (size 1)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0012' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_test_data. "Group AA-20250102 (size 2)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_groups( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250101'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Sammeln Sie alle Flugverbindungen (`connid`) jeder Gruppe in einer separaten internen Tabelle innerhalb der Ergebnisstruktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY COMPONENTS` und eine innere Schleife `LOOP AT GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_grouped_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ts_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_connections
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_connections.
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
         INTO DATA(flight_group).

      DATA(ls_grouped_flight) = VALUE ts_grouped_flights(
        carrid = flight_group-carrid
        fldate = flight_group-fldate
      ).

      LOOP AT GROUP flight_group INTO DATA(ls_member).
        APPEND ls_member-connid TO ls_grouped_flight-connections.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_grouped_flight TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_grouped_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_connections.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_group_by_components=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_components( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_connections( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result_lh-connections ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-connections[ 1 ] exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-connections[ 2 ] exp = '0401' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_aa_01) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result_aa_01-connections ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa_01-connections[ 1 ] exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Durch die Verwendung einer internen Schleife `LOOP AT GROUP` können die einzelnen Elemente einer Gruppe verarbeitet werden. Die Gruppenschlüssel werden explizit in der `GROUP BY`-Klausel definiert. Dies ist eine flexible Methode, um Aggregationen oder Transformationen auf Gruppenebene durchzuführen.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`) aller Flüge, die in einer internen Tabelle enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` innerhalb der `GROUP BY`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem lokalen Akkumulator, um die Summe pro Gruppe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ts_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_capacity) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(flight_group).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight_group
                                        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax ).
      APPEND VALUE ts_carrier_capacity( carrid = flight_group-carrid total_capacity = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_carrier_capacity.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Laden Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`. Gruppieren Sie diese Daten nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugverbindung (`connid`). Ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` um Daten zu laden und dann `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit mehreren Gruppierungsschlüsseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ts_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_grouped_sflight_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_seatsmax TYPE i,
           END OF ts_grouped_sflight_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_sflight_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_grouped_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_grouped_sflight_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for demo purposes

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
         INTO DATA(flight_group).

      DATA(lv_max_seats) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP flight_group INTO DATA(ls_member).
        IF ls_member-seatsmax > lv_max_seats.
          lv_max_seats = ls_member-seatsmax.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ts_grouped_sflight_result(
        carrid = flight_group-carrid
        connid = flight_group-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        max_seatsmax = lv_max_seats
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    " Für die tatsächliche Anzeige ist ein Dynpro (z.B. 1000) mit einem Custom Control

    " Erstellen eines Haupt-Custom-Containers, der auf einem Dynpro platziert wird
    DATA(lo_main_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = 'MAIN_CONTAINER' " Dieser Name muss auf einem Dynpro existieren

    mo_container2 = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Hier könnten weitere Controls in mo_container1 und mo_container2 platziert werden.

    " DATA(lo_text_edit1) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = mo_container1 ).
    " DATA(lo_text_edit2) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = mo_container2 ).

    out->write( 'Splitter-Container-Objekte erfolgreich instanziiert.' ).

CLASS zcl_splitter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_splitter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_main_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = 'MAIN_CONTAINER'
      parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen
    ).

    " Haupt-Splitter: 1 Zeile, 2 Spalten (vertikale Teilung)
    mo_main_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_main_custom_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2

    DATA(lo_left_pane) = mo_main_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_container_right = mo_main_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    mo_nested_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(

    mo_container_top_left    = mo_nested_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_container_bottom_left = mo_nested_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

CLASS zcl_splitter_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_splitter_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.

      parent  = lo_main_custom_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    " Event-Handler registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_dragging FOR mo_splitter.

    out->write( 'Splitter-Container mit Event-Handler instanziiert.' ).
    out->write( 'Ziehen Sie die Trennlinie auf dem Dynpro, um das Protokoll zu sehen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_dragging.
    " Protokollierung der Größenänderung
    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write_text(

      && |Prozent Zeile { percent_row }%, Prozent Spalte { percent_column }%|

CLASS zcl_splitter_controls IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_main_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(

    ).

      parent  = lo_main_custom_container
      rows    = 1

    ).

    DATA(lo_left_pane)  = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_pane) = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " TextEdit im linken Bereich
    mo_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_left_pane
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_fixed_position
    ).
    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist ein Text im linken Bereich.' ).

    " ALV Grid im rechten Bereich
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = lo_right_pane

             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ts_alv_data.
    DATA: lt_alv_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_alv_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'Wert A' field2 = 100 ) TO lt_alv_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'Wert B' field2 = 200 ) TO lt_alv_data.

    DATA(lo_alv_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( lt_alv_data ).
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = lo_alv_table_descr->get_relative_name( )
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_alv_data
    ).

    out->write( 'Splitter-Container mit TextEdit und ALV Grid instanziiert.' ).
    out->write( 'Für die Anzeige ist ein Dynpro mit einem Custom Control namens MAIN_CONTAINER erforderlich.' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestsitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`) überschreiten, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_filtered_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seatsmax TYPE i,
           END OF ts_filtered_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_filtered_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_filtered_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_grouped_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_min_seats   TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_filtered_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_data FROM it_flight_data
                                 WHERE seatsmax > iv_min_seats.

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(flight_group).

      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight_group
                                        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax ).

      APPEND VALUE ts_filtered_grouped_result(
        carrid = flight_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_seatsmax = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_group_by.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_filter_group_by=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 80 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_grouped_flights( it_flight_data = lt_test_data iv_min_seats = 90 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-total_seatsmax exp = 250 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-total_seatsmax exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination des `FILTER`-Operators mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine effiziente Vorfilterung von Daten, bevor die Gruppierung erfolgt. Dies verbessert die Performance und Lesbarkeit des Codes, da nur relevante Daten gruppiert werden.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`) aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und eine manuelle Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und zählen Sie die Elemente sowie die Summe manuell, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_avg_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_capacity TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ts_carrier_avg_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_avg_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_capacity_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_avg_capacity) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_capacity_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(flight_group).
      DATA(lv_sum_seats) = 0.
      DATA(lv_count_flights) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP flight_group INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_sum_seats = lv_sum_seats + ls_member-seatsmax.
        lv_count_flights = lv_count_flights + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      DATA(lv_average) = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_count_flights > 0 THEN lv_sum_seats / lv_count_flights ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE ts_carrier_avg_capacity(
        carrid = flight_group-carrid
        average_capacity = lv_average
      ) TO rt_carrier_avg_capacity.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_average_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_average_capacity.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_group_by_average=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' seatsmax = 50 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0012' seatsmax = 75 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_average( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_capacity_by_carrier( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-average_capacity exp = '125.0' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-average_capacity exp = '108.3333333333333' ). " (200+50+75)/3
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `REDUCE` für Aggregationen bevorzugt wird, zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` auch komplexere Aggregationen wie den Durchschnitt manuell berechnen kann. Die Verwendung von `COND` für die Division durch Null ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Average, Aggregation, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container und implementieren Sie die Möglichkeit, die Trennlinie programmatisch zu verschieben, z.B. auf eine feste Position von 50% nach einem Button-Klick.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `set_column_width` oder `set_row_height` in Reaktion auf ein Ereignis (z.B. von einem Button).
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_programmatic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_button TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_programmatic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_main_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = 'MAIN_CONTAINER'
      parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen
    ).

    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_main_custom_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    DATA(lo_left_pane)  = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_right_pane) = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    " Button im rechten Bereich platzieren
    mo_button = NEW cl_gui_button(
      parent = lo_right_pane
      text   = 'Splitter auf 50% setzen'
    ).

    " Event-Handler für Button-Klick registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR me->mo_button.

    out->write( 'Splitter-Container mit Button instanziiert.' ).
    out->write( 'Klicken Sie auf den Button auf dem Dynpro, um den Splitter zu verschieben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    " Splitter-Position programmatisch auf 50% setzen
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 1 width = 50 percent = abap_true ).
    mo_splitter->set_column_width( id = 2 width = 50 percent = abap_true ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write_text( 'Splitter-Position auf 50% gesetzt.' )->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Down-Cast einer generischen Objektreferenz (Typ `object`) auf eine spezifischere Klasse oder ein Interface durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` für den Down-Cast. Beachten Sie, dass ein Down-Cast fehlschlagen kann, wenn das Objekt nicht vom Zieltyp ist.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_generic_shape TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_shape) = CONV zif_shape( io_generic_shape ). " Down-cast to interface
        rv_area = lo_shape->get_area( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Object is not a ZIF_SHAPE compatible type'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_cast FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_cast FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_cast.
    DATA(lo_circle_obj) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '10' ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_circle_obj ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_area exp = '314.159' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_cast.
    DATA(lo_dummy_obj) = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ). " A random object not implementing zif_shape
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance(
        class_name = 'CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR'
        method_name = 'PROCESS_SHAPE'
        object_instance = lo_processor
        parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IO_GENERIC_SHAPE' value = lo_dummy_obj ) ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV` Operator kann für sichere Down-Casts von Objektreferenzen verwendet werden. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder `CAST` und ermöglicht die Typumwandlung direkt in Ausdrücken. Fehler bei inkompatiblen Typen werden als `CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR` behandelt.
keywords: CONV, Object Orientation, Down-Cast, Interface, TRY-CATCH, CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine Struktur mit Standardwerten, wobei einige Felder explizit konvertiert werden müssen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` in Kombination mit `CONV` für die Feldinitialisierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id       TYPE string,
             name     TYPE string,
             price    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity TYPE i,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_product.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_default_product
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_product) TYPE ty_product.
    METHODS create_product_from_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_id       TYPE string
        iv_name     TYPE string
        iv_price    TYPE string
        iv_quantity TYPE string
        iv_active   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_product) TYPE ty_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_default_product.
    rs_product = VALUE #(
      id        = 'PROD001'
      name      = 'Default Product'
      price     = CONV p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2( '99.99' ) " CONV for price string to packed
      quantity  = 10
      is_active = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_product_from_data.
    TRY.
        rs_product = VALUE #(

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND CONV string( <fs_column_value> ) TO rt_values.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Column '{ iv_column_name }' not found in internal table.|.
      ENDIF.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines beliebigen Feldes einer beliebigen Datenreferenz setzt, deren Name dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN (name) TO FIELD-SYMBOL` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf das Feld und `DATA(lr_data) = REF #(ir_data)` für die Dereferenzierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error,
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>. " Dereference the data reference
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid data reference'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_target>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_target> = iv_value. " Direct assignment, implicit conversion
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Value '{ iv_value }' could not be converted for field '{ iv_field_name }'.|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in data object.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Attribute einer Klasse zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info,
           tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_instance_type( ).

        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          DATA(ls_attr_info) = VALUE ty_attribute_info(
            name = ls_component-name
            type = ls_component-type_descr_ref->get_ddic_type_name( )
          ).
          APPEND ls_attr_info TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Class '{ iv_class_name }' not found or cannot be described.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Error during RTTI processing (e.g., no instance type found).'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_int_to_padded_str IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie dynamisch den Wert einer Spalte in einer internen Tabelle, deren Name und der neue Wert zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` für die Modifikation.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_column_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_id         TYPE i
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error,
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_column_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE ty_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE ct_data WITH KEY id = iv_id ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
              EXPORTING
                text = |Value '{ iv_new_value }' could not be converted for field '{ iv_column_name }'.|.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Column '{ iv_column_name }' not found in table row.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Row with ID '{ iv_id }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Inhalt eines beliebigen Datenobjekts (Referenz) in einen String konvertiert, indem sie dynamisch auf seine Komponenten zugreift.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` in einer Schleife über die Komponenten, die Sie über RTTI erhalten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_value,
           tt_component_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_data_object
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_serialized_data) TYPE tt_component_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error,
        cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_data_object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_structdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid data reference'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
        lo_structdescr ?= lo_typedescr.

        LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND VALUE ty_component_value(
              name = ls_component-name
              value = CONV string( <fs_component> )
            ) TO rt_serialized_data.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_error.
        " Handle cases where it's not a structure (e.g., elementary type)
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_value(
          name = 'VALUE'
          value = CONV string( <fs_data> )
        ) TO rt_serialized_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Error accessing data components'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und nach 'JFK' fliegen, und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered,
           tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights msg = 'Filtered flights should not be empty' ).

    " Check if all filtered flights match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'City from mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'City to mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt eine `LOOP AT` mit `IF` zu verwenden, ermöglicht `FILTER` eine deklarative und prägnante Syntax zur Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY primary_key` ist hier optional, aber gute Praxis, wenn ein Primärschlüssel definiert ist.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid seatsocc seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has some flights in sflights with available seats.
    " A more precise test would involve mocking sflights or knowing exact test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_total_capacity >= 0 ) msg = 'Total capacity should be non-negative' ).

    " Example with known data (if sflights is consistent)
    " DATA(lv_expected_capacity) = 12345. " Replace with actual expected value
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_capacity exp = lv_expected_capacity msg = 'Total capacity mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) zur Aggregation von Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Es berechnet die Summe der verfügbaren Sitze (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. `REDUCE` bietet eine funktionale und kompakte Möglichkeit, Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren zu ersetzen, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation, Math, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` als Eingabe nimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Flugnummern und die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             avail_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                          ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
                            avail_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF lt_test_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 100. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50.
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_test_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. ls_sflight-seatsmax = 200. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 180.
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_test_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_for_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( it_sflights = lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of summary entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First entry connid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-avail_seats exp = 50 msg = 'First entry avail_seats mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_summary INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'Second entry connid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-avail_seats exp = 20 msg = 'Second entry avail_seats mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Tabellenkonstruktion und Transformation mit dem `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` (ab ABAP 7.40). Es ermöglicht die Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem über eine vorhandene Tabelle iteriert und die Daten in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung transformiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... APPEND`-Konstrukten.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, Transformation, Modern ABAP

CLASS zcl_bal_table_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        i_msgty = ls_message-msgty

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ausliest, dessen Feldname als String übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_by_data()` und `cl_abap_datadescr=>get_by_data()` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value IMPORTING is_data     TYPE any
                                      iv_field_name TYPE string
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden oder nicht zugreifbar'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Wert1',
             field2 TYPE i VALUE 123,
           END OF ty_test_data.

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_test_data( field1 = 'Testwert' field2 = 456 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_read_field( ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Testwert' msg = 'Value for FIELD1 mismatch' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '456' msg = 'Value for FIELD2 mismatch' ).

    DATA(lv_value_invalid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'INVALID_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_invalid exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden oder nicht zugreifbar' msg = 'Invalid field handling mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert dynamische Programmierung unter Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zur Laufzeit. Es ermöglicht das Auslesen eines Feldwertes aus einer beliebigen Struktur, dessen Name als String übergeben wird. Obwohl RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` für komplexere Szenarien nützlich sind, ist `ASSIGN COMPONENT` die direkteste Methode für diesen Anwendungsfall. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight_line-carrid
                                                            connid = ls_flight_line-connid
                                                            group_size = GROUP SIZE )
                                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    connid = ls_group_key-connid
                                    flight_count = ls_group_key-group_size ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
