  METHOD test_get_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_grouped_flights msg = 'Grouped flights should not be empty' ).

    " Example: Check if a specific group exists and has a count > 0
    READ TABLE lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_group-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'Flight count for LH 0400 should be greater than 0' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Group for LH 0400 not found' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien und das Aggregieren von Informationen für jede Gruppe, wie hier die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und macht den Code sehr ausdrucksstark.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Flugdaten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur und die moderne `SELECT SINGLE` Syntax.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.

        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-table_line
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    SELECT
      FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT( * ) > 10
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS und fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Fluges basierend auf dem Datum anzeigt (z.B. 'Vergangen', 'Heute', 'Zukünftig').

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT
      FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate,
             CASE
               WHEN fldate < @lv_today THEN 'Vergangen'
               WHEN fldate = @lv_today THEN 'Heute'
               ELSE 'Zukünftig'
             END AS status
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie zwei `SELECT`-Statements aus, die unterschiedliche Daten aus SFLIGHTS abrufen, und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse in einer einzigen internen Tabelle mit `UNION ALL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             info   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flight_info.
    SELECT
      FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, 'Preisinformation' AS info
      WHERE price > 500
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      FROM sflights
      FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, 'Sitzplatzinformation' AS info
      WHERE seatsocc < seatsmax
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_combiner) = NEW zcl_sflights_union( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_combiner->get_combined_flight_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Combined info should be found' act = lt_combined ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one price info' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_combined[ info = 'Preisinformation' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one seat info' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_combined[ info = 'Sitzplatzinformation' ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Statements zu einer einzigen Ergebnismenge zu kombinieren. Dies ist nützlich, wenn Sie Daten aus derselben oder verschiedenen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Kriterien abrufen und in einer einheitlichen Struktur zusammenführen möchten. `UNION ALL` behält Duplikate bei, während `UNION` Duplikate entfernt.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, SFLIGHTS, Database Access, Data Combination

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Anhang, der den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) als CSV-Datei enthält.
hint: Wandeln Sie die interne Tabelle in einen String um und fügen Sie diesen als Anhang hinzu. Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_solix` für Binärdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_with_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_sflight_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE string
        iv_body      TYPE string
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_with_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_sflight_attachment.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Create email body
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    " Convert internal table to CSV string
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string( INIT s = lv_csv_header FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                        NEXT s = s && |{ flight-carrid };{ flight-connid };{ flight-fldate };{ flight-price };{ flight-currency }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).

    " Create attachment
    DATA(lv_attachment_xstring) = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_solix( lv_csv_data ).
    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_utilities=>solix_to_soli( lv_attachment_xstring ) " SOLIX to SOLI for attachment
      i_length  = xstrlen( lv_attachment_xstring )
      i_subject = 'sflights_data.csv'
    ).
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment = lo_attachment
      i_attachment_size = xstrlen( lv_attachment_xstring )
      i_attachment_type = 'CSV'
      i_attachment_filename = 'sflights_data.csv'
    ).

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen zwei Mengenfeldern in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Differenzen zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id       TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             sold     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_remaining
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_remaining) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_remaining.
    rv_total_remaining = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                                   FOR item IN it_items
                                   NEXT total = total + ( item-quantity - item-sold ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_remaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_remaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_reduce_subtract=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 quantity = 100 sold = 30 )
      ( id = 2 quantity = 50  sold = 20 )
      ( id = 3 quantity = 200 sold = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_remaining( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 150 ). " 70 + 30 + 50 = 150
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird für jedes Element die Differenz `item-quantity - item-sold` berechnet und zur Gesamtsumme addiert, was die explizite Verwendung von `SUBTRACT` in einer Schleife überflüssig macht.
keywords: REDUCE, INTERNAL_TABLES, MATH, AGGREGATION

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach einem bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode und berechnen Sie die verbleibenden Sitze, indem Sie die belegten Sitze von der maximalen Kapazität subtrahieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
             booked_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_sflight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_remaining_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights  TYPE tt_sflight_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_remaining_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rv_remaining_seats = REDUCE i( INIT total_remaining = 0
                                   FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                   NEXT total_remaining = total_remaining + ( flight-max_seats - flight-booked_seats ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remaining_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remaining_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_subtract=>tt_sflight_capacity(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' max_seats = 100 booked_seats = 30 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230101' max_seats = 150 booked_seats = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' max_seats = 200 booked_seats = 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_remaining_lh) = lo_cut->get_remaining_seats_for_carrier(
      iv_carrid  = 'LH'
      it_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_lh exp = 170 ). " (100-30) + (150-50) = 70 + 100 = 170

    DATA(lv_remaining_aa) = lo_cut->get_remaining_seats_for_carrier(
      iv_carrid  = 'AA'
      it_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_aa exp = 100 ). " (200-100) = 100

    DATA(lv_remaining_ua) = lo_cut->get_remaining_seats_for_carrier(
      iv_carrid  = 'UA'
      it_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_ua exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die leistungsstarken funktionalen Operatoren `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mit `FILTER` nach dem Fluggesellschaftscode gefiltert. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Differenz zwischen maximalen und belegten Sitzen für jeden gefilterten Flug zu summieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Art der Datenverarbeitung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, INTERNAL_TABLES, MATH, SFLIGHTS, GROUPING

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf dem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.

solution:
CLASS zcl_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
        iv_current_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.

      iv_date1 = iv_current_date
      iv_date2 = iv_birth_date
    ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_age.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_age_calculator( ).

    " Test case 1: Birthday passed
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( iv_birth_date = '19900101' iv_current_date = '20230615' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 33 ).

    " Test case 2: Birthday not yet passed in current year
    lv_age = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( iv_birth_date = '19901231' iv_current_date = '20230615' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 32 ).

    " Test case 3: Same day

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 33 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `cl_abap_date_helper=>diff_years` ist die moderne und korrekte Art, Altersberechnungen in ABAP durchzuführen. Sie berücksichtigt Schaltjahre und den genauen Tag des Jahres, um das Alter präzise zu bestimmen, was bei manuellen `SUBTRACT`-Operationen auf Datumsfeldern oft zu Fehlern führt.
keywords: DATE, AGE, DIFFERENCE, CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER, MATH

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem PDF-Anhang, der aus einem XSTRING generiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_utilities=>xstring_to_soli` für den PDF-Inhalt und setzen Sie den Anhangstyp auf 'PDF'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_pdf_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_pdf_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE string
        iv_body      TYPE string
        iv_pdf_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_pdf_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_pdf_email.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli( iv_body )

    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_utilities=>xstring_to_soli( iv_pdf_xstring )

      i_attachment = lo_attachment

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

keywords: EMAIL, PDF, ATTACHMENT, XSTRING, BCS, COMMUNICATION

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den absoluten Unterschied zwischen zwei Zahlen mit dem `COND` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator, um den größeren Wert zu ermitteln und dann den kleineren zu subtrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abs_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_absolute_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_abs_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_absolute_difference.
    rv_abs_diff = COND #( WHEN iv_num1 >= iv_num2 THEN iv_num1 - iv_num2
                          ELSE iv_num2 - iv_num1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_absolute_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_absolute_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abs_difference( ).

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->get_absolute_difference( iv_num1 = 10 iv_num2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 5 ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->get_absolute_difference( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 5 ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->get_absolute_difference( iv_num1 = 7 iv_num2 = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 0 ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->get_absolute_difference( iv_num1 = -5 iv_num2 = -10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Implementierung von bedingter Logik. Anstatt einer traditionellen `IF`-Anweisung wird hier in einer Zeile der absolute Unterschied berechnet, indem der kleinere Wert vom größeren subtrahiert wird. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu `IF...ENDIF` Blöcken.
keywords: COND, MATH, SUBTRACT, CONDITIONAL_LOGIC

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, und subtrahieren Sie einen festen Rabattbetrag.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in Kombination, um die Flüge zu selektieren, die Preise zu summieren und den Rabatt abzuziehen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_price
        iv_min_date   TYPE d
        iv_discount   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lt_relevant_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate >= iv_min_date ).

    DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR flight IN lt_relevant_flights
                                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

    rv_total_price = lv_sum_prices - iv_discount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_discounted_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_price_calc=>tt_sflight_price(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230105' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230110' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price(
      it_flights  = lt_flights
      iv_min_date = '20230105'
      iv_discount = '25.00'
    ).
    " Flights from 20230105 and 20230110 are relevant: 150.00 + 200.00 = 350.00
    " Discount: 350.00 - 25.00 = 325.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '325.00' ).

    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price(
      it_flights  = lt_flights
      iv_min_date = '20230115'
      iv_discount = '10.00'
    ).
    " No flights relevant: 0.00 - 10.00 = -10.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '-10.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine komplexe Aggregation und anschließende Subtraktion. Zuerst werden Flüge nach einem Datum gefiltert, dann deren Preise summiert und schließlich ein Rabatt abgezogen. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der den Code sehr prägnant und lesbar macht, indem er die Datenverarbeitung in einer Kette von Ausdrücken darstellt.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, INTERNAL_TABLES, MATH, SFLIGHTS, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String-Wert in einen Integer-Wert und umgekehrt. Demonstrieren Sie die direkte Typkonvertierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CONV`-Operator für die Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_int IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_int) TYPE i.
    METHODS convert_int_to_string IMPORTING iv_int TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int.
    rv_int = CONV i( iv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD convert_int_to_string.
    rv_string = CONV string( iv_int ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_001( ).
    DATA(lv_string_input) = '456'.
    DATA(lv_int_output) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_int( lv_string_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_int_output exp = 456 msg = 'String to Int conversion failed' ).

    DATA(lv_int_input) = 789.
    DATA(lv_string_output) = lo_cut->convert_int_to_string( lv_int_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_output exp = '789' msg = 'Int to String conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und direkte Typkonvertierung. Er ist besonders nützlich in Ausdrücken und bei der Initialisierung von Variablen, da er den Code lesbarer macht als ältere `MOVE`- oder `CAST`-Anweisungen.
keywords: CONV, Type Conversion, Integer, String

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer Spalte vom Typ `string` und füllen Sie diese mit Werten aus einer anderen internen Tabelle, deren Spalte vom Typ `i` ist, unter Verwendung von `CONV` und `VALUE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` und `CONV` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck zur effizienten Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_002 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_int,
             num TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_int.
    TYPES: ty_t_int TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_int WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_string,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_string.
    TYPES: ty_t_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_int_to_string IMPORTING it_int_data TYPE ty_t_int RETURNING VALUE(rt_string_data) TYPE ty_t_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_002 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_int_to_string.
    rt_string_data = VALUE ty_t_string( FOR <fs> IN it_int_data ( text = CONV string( <fs>-num ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_002( ).
    DATA(lt_int_input) = VALUE zcl_conv_002=>ty_t_int( ( num = 1 ) ( num = 2 ) ( num = 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_string_output) = lo_cut->convert_table_int_to_string( lt_int_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_string_output ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_string_output[1]-text exp = '1' msg = 'First element conversion failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_string_output[3]-text exp = '3' msg = 'Third element conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE`-Operator und `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative und effiziente Befüllung interner Tabellen. `CONV` wird hier direkt im `FOR`-Ausdruck verwendet, um die Typkonvertierung für jede Zeile durchzuführen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: CONV, VALUE, Internal Tables, FOR, Data Conversion

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum vom internen ABAP-Format (YYYYMMDD) in ein externes Format (DD.MM.YYYY) und umgekehrt, unter Verwendung von `CONV` und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONV` mit `d` und `string` Typen und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_003 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_date_to_external IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d RETURNING VALUE(rv_date_ext) TYPE string.
    METHODS parse_date_from_external IMPORTING iv_date_ext TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_date_int) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_to_external.
    rv_date_ext = CONV string( |{ iv_date+6(2) }.{ iv_date+4(2) }.{ iv_date+0(4) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD parse_date_from_external.
    rv_date_int = CONV d( |{ iv_date_ext+6(4) }{ iv_date_ext+3(2) }{ iv_date_ext+0(2) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_003( ).
    DATA(lv_internal_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_external_date) = lo_cut->format_date_to_external( lv_internal_date ).

    DATA(lv_expected_external) = |{ lv_internal_date+6(2) }.{ lv_internal_date+4(2) }.{ lv_internal_date+0(4) }|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_external_date exp = lv_expected_external msg = 'Date to external format failed' ).

    DATA(lv_parsed_date) = lo_cut->parse_date_from_external( lv_external_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_parsed_date exp = lv_internal_date msg = 'External to date format failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine flexible Möglichkeit zur Formatierung von Strings. In Kombination mit dem `CONV`-Operator können Datums- und Zeitwerte einfach zwischen internen und externen Darstellungen umgewandelt werden, ohne auf komplexe Funktionsbausteine zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: CONV, Date, String Templates, Data Conversion

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Integer-Werten in einer internen Tabelle, die ursprünglich als Strings gespeichert waren, und geben Sie das Ergebnis als String zurück. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONV` im `NEXT`-Ausdruck und im `THEN`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_004 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_string_numbers IMPORTING it_strings TYPE ty_t_strings RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_004 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_string_numbers.
    rv_sum_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR <fs> IN it_strings
      NEXT s = s + CONV i( <fs> )
      THEN CONV string( s )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_conv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_conv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_004( ).
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE zcl_conv_004=>ty_t_strings( ( '10' ) ( '20' ) ( '30' ) ( '5' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum_result) = lo_cut->sum_string_numbers( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_result exp = '65' msg = 'REDUCE with CONV failed' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_strings) = VALUE zcl_conv_004=>ty_t_strings( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_empty) = lo_cut->sum_string_numbers( lt_empty_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_empty exp = '0' msg = 'REDUCE with empty table failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um String-Werte zuerst mit `CONV i(...)` in Integer zu konvertieren, zu summieren und das Endergebnis dann wieder mit `CONV string(...)` als String zurückzugeben. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Transformationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung.
keywords: CONV, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Data Conversion

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag von einer Währung in eine andere (vereinfacht, nur Multiplikation), wobei der ursprüngliche Betrag und der Umrechnungskurs als Strings vorliegen. Das Ergebnis soll als `decfloat34` berechnet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` für Dezimalzahlen (`decfloat34`) vor der Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_005 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_currency IMPORTING iv_amount_str TYPE string
                                     iv_exchange_rate_str TYPE string
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_amount_converted) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_currency.
    DATA(lv_amount_dec) = CONV decfloat34( iv_amount_str ).
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate_dec) = CONV decfloat34( iv_exchange_rate_str ).
    rv_amount_converted = lv_amount_dec * lv_exchange_rate_dec.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_005( ).
    DATA(lv_amount_eur) = '100.50'.
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate) = '1.18'.
    DATA(lv_amount_usd) = lo_cut->convert_currency( iv_amount_str = lv_amount_eur iv_exchange_rate_str = lv_exchange_rate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_amount_usd exp = '118.59' msg = 'Currency conversion failed' ).

    DATA(lv_amount_zero) = lo_cut->convert_currency( iv_amount_str = '0.00' iv_exchange_rate_str = '1.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_amount_zero exp = '0.00' msg = 'Zero amount conversion failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator ist ideal, um String-Repräsentationen von Zahlen in präzise numerische Typen wie `decfloat34` zu konvertieren, bevor mathematische Operationen durchgeführt werden. Dies vermeidet Rundungsfehler, die bei der Verwendung von `float` auftreten können, und ist für Finanzberechnungen unerlässlich.
keywords: CONV, Currency, Math, Data Conversion, DECFLOAT34

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit Komma als Trennzeichen und Header-Zeile in eine interne Tabelle mit einer vordefinierten Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv=>create` und die Methode `parse`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string IMPORTING iv_csv_data TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE ty_t_data
      RAISING cx_icf_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = cl_icf_csv=>create( iv_separator = ',' iv_has_header = abap_true ).
    lo_csv_parser->parse( EXPORTING iv_data = iv_csv_data IMPORTING et_data = rt_parsed_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_simple_csv FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_empty_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_simple_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_001( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_input) = 'Header1,Header2\nValue1,Value2\nValue3,Value4'.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String, der eine Spalte mit Zahlen als Strings enthält. Konvertieren Sie diese Spalte in Integer-Werte und generieren Sie dann einen neuen CSV-String mit den konvertierten Werten. Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` zum Parsen und Rendern und `CONV` mit `FOR` zur Konvertierung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_icf_csv` zum Parsen, `FOR` mit `CONV` zur Konvertierung und `cl_icf_csv` zum Rendern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_raw,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_raw.
    TYPES: ty_t_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_processed,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_processed.
    TYPES: ty_t_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_csv_with_conversion IMPORTING iv_csv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING cx_icf_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_csv_with_conversion.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE ty_t_raw( ).
    DATA(lt_processed_data) = VALUE ty_t_processed( ).

    " 1. Parse CSV
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = cl_icf_csv=>create( iv_separator = ',' iv_has_header = abap_true ).
    lo_csv_parser->parse( EXPORTING iv_data = iv_csv_input IMPORTING et_data = lt_raw_data ).

    " 2. Convert data types using FOR and CONV
    lt_processed_data = VALUE ty_t_processed( FOR <fs> IN lt_raw_data ( name = <fs>-name value = CONV i( <fs>-value ) ) ).

    " 3. Render new CSV
    DATA(lo_csv_renderer) = cl_icf_csv=>create( iv_separator = ';' iv_has_header = abap_true ).
    lo_csv_renderer->render( EXPORTING it_data = lt_processed_data IMPORTING ev_data = rv_csv_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mix_001( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_input) = 'Name,Value\nItemA,100\nItemB,200\nItemC,300'.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv_output exp = lv_expected_output msg = 'End-to-end CSV processing failed' ).

        " Verify intermediate data (optional, but good for complex tests)
        DATA(lo_csv_parser_verify) = cl_icf_csv=>create( iv_separator = ';' iv_has_header = abap_true ).
        DATA(lt_verified_data) = VALUE zcl_mix_001=>ty_t_processed( ).
        lo_csv_parser_verify->parse( EXPORTING iv_data = lv_csv_output IMPORTING et_data = lt_verified_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_verified_data[1]-value exp = 100 msg = 'Verified value 1 incorrect' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_verified_data[3]-name exp = 'ItemC' msg = 'Verified name 3 incorrect' ).
      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies zeigt die nahtlose Integration moderner ABAP-Sprachkonstrukte für effiziente Datenpipelines.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Wert dynamisch von einem Typ in einen anderen, basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bekannten Zieltyp. Nutzen Sie `CONV` in Kombination mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `CONV` mit einem dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_006 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic IMPORTING iv_source_value TYPE string
                                    iv_target_type_name TYPE string
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE string
      RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_006 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_target_value_i TYPE i,
          lv_target_value_f TYPE f,
          lv_target_value_d TYPE d,
          lv_target_value_t TYPE t,
          lv_target_value_s TYPE string.

    CASE iv_target_type_name.
      WHEN 'I'.
        lv_target_value_i = CONV i( iv_source_value ).
        rv_converted_value = CONV string( lv_target_value_i ).
      WHEN 'F'.
        lv_target_value_f = CONV f( iv_source_value ).
        rv_converted_value = CONV string( lv_target_value_f ).
      WHEN 'D'.
        lv_target_value_d = CONV d( iv_source_value ).
        rv_converted_value = CONV string( lv_target_value_d ).
      WHEN 'T'.
        lv_target_value_t = CONV t( iv_source_value ).
        rv_converted_value = CONV string( lv_target_value_t ).
      WHEN 'STRING'.
        rv_converted_value = iv_source_value.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>invalid_type.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '12345' msg = 'Dynamic conversion to INT failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_conversion_float.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '1.2345000000000000E+02' msg = 'Dynamic conversion to FLOAT failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `CONV` in einem dynamischen Kontext verwendet werden kann, um Werte basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Zieltyp zu konvertieren. Obwohl ABAP keine direkte dynamische Typkonvertierung mit `CONV` über eine Variable für den Zieltyp bietet, kann dies durch eine `CASE`-Anweisung in Kombination mit `CONV` für jeden bekannten Typ simuliert werden. Dies ist nützlich in Szenarien, wo die Zielstruktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten.
keywords: CONV, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Data Conversion, CASE

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_hold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_hold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_flight_cursor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.
    FETCH NEXT CURSOR mv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 2.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung bei `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` durch Überprüfung von `sy-subrc` und die Verwendung von `MESSAGE`.
hint: Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und reagieren Sie entsprechend, z.B. mit einer Fehlermeldung oder einem Abbruch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_error_handling
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING   cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 10.
      IF sy-subrc = 4. " No more data
        EXIT.
      ELSEIF sy-subrc <> 0. " Other error
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = 'Fehler beim Lesen der Flugdaten.'
            severity = if_abap_message_digest=>error.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 Zufalls-Float-Werten, die jeweils zwischen 0 und 1 liegen, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `cl_abap_random_float`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_random_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_float_table
      IMPORTING iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_random_floats) TYPE tt_random_floats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_float_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    rt_random_floats = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                                 ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_generate_random_float_table.

    DATA(lt_floats) = lo_cut->generate_random_float_table( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_floats ) exp = 5 ).
    LOOP AT lt_floats INTO DATA(lv_float).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_float >= 0 AND lv_float < 1 )
                                         msg = 'Generated float not in range [0, 1)' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_empty_floats) = lo_cut->generate_random_float_table( 0 ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die `OPEN CURSOR` verwendet, um Daten aus `sflights` zu lesen und diese Daten dann mit `REDUCE` zu aggregieren (z.B. die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR` zum Lesen der Datenpakete und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation der gefetchten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, price
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 1000.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      rt_carrier_prices = REDUCE tt_carrier_price(
        INIT result = rt_carrier_prices
        FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_package
        LET existing_entry = result[ KEY carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid DEFAULT VALUE ]
        IN
          COND tt_carrier_price(
            WHEN existing_entry IS INITIAL THEN VALUE #( ( <fs_flight>-carrid, <fs_flight>-price ) )
            ELSE VALUE #( ( existing_entry-carrid, existing_entry-total_price + <fs_flight>-price ) )
          )
      ).
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_total_price_by_carrier FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' price = '100.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251124' price = '200.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251124' price = '150.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251124' price = '50.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND ( connid = '0400' OR connid = '0401' ).
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND ( connid = '0001' OR connid = '0002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_prices) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( ).

    DATA(lv_lh_price) = lt_carrier_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price.
    DATA(lv_aa_price) = lt_carrier_prices[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_price.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lh_price exp = '250.00' ). " 100 + 150
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_aa_price exp = '250.00' ). " 200 + 50
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die effiziente Datenbeschaffung mittels `OPEN CURSOR` mit der leistungsstarken Aggregationsfunktion `REDUCE`. `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle zu durchlaufen und dabei einen einzelnen Wert (oder eine neue Tabelle) zu konstruieren, indem Elemente basierend auf einer Logik zusammengeführt werden. Hier wird die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft berechnet, während die Daten paketweise verarbeitet werden.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` in einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften akzeptiert und für jede Fluggesellschaft die zugehörigen Flüge abruft. Demonstrieren Sie die Wiederverwendung des Cursors.
hint: Öffnen Sie den Cursor einmal und verwenden Sie `SET PARAMETER` oder eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel, um die Filterkriterien für jede Fluggesellschaft anzupassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_reuse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_reuse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
       WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.

    LOOP AT it_carrids INTO lv_carrid.
      " Set the parameter for the current carrier
      SET PARAMETER ID 'CAR' FIELD lv_carrid. " This is a conceptual example, SET PARAMETER ID is for dynpro/memory ID
      " For actual cursor parameter change, you'd need to close and re-open or use dynamic SQL.
      " A more realistic approach for dynamic WHERE with OPEN CURSOR is to build the WHERE clause string.
      " However, for simplicity and demonstrating 'reuse' of the cursor *conceptually* with different parameters,
      " we'll simulate it by re-opening the cursor with a new parameter.
      " In a real scenario, for different WHERE clauses, you'd typically close and re-open the cursor.
      " Or, if the WHERE clause is simple, use a single SELECT with IN operator.

      " Re-opening the cursor for each carrier is the practical way to change WHERE clause with OPEN CURSOR.
      " The 'reuse' here refers to the pattern of using OPEN/FETCH/CLOSE in a loop.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
      OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
          FROM sflight
         WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.

      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 500.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
        CLEAR lt_package.
      ENDDO.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' price = '100.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251124' price = '200.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251124' price = '150.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251124' price = '300.00' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND ( connid = '0400' OR connid = '0401' ).
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0001'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND connid = '0001'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_reuse( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_open_cursor_reuse=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_flights ) exp = 3 ). " 2 for LH, 1 for AA

    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aa_flights ) exp = 1 ).

explanation: Während `OPEN CURSOR` selbst nicht direkt 'wiederverwendet' werden kann, um eine neue `WHERE`-Klausel zu setzen, ohne ihn zu schließen und neu zu öffnen, demonstriert dieses Beispiel das Muster, wie man Cursor-Operationen in einer Schleife für verschiedene Parameter ausführt. Für jede Fluggesellschaft wird der Cursor neu geöffnet, um die spezifischen Daten abzurufen. Dies ist effizienter als mehrere `SELECT`-Anweisungen, wenn die Datenmenge pro Parameter groß ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugpreisen akzeptiert und diese Preise um einen zufälligen Prozentsatz (z.B. -10% bis +10%) anpasst. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` zum Iterieren und Anpassen der Preise, `cl_abap_random_float` für den Prozentsatz und `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_price_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_prices_randomly
      IMPORTING it_original_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_adjusted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_price_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices_randomly.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_adjusted_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_price IN it_original_prices
                                  LET lv_adjustment_factor = lo_random->get_next_in_range( ip_low = -0.10 ip_high = 0.10 )
                                      lv_adjusted_price = ls_price-price * ( 1 + lv_adjustment_factor )
                                  IN
                                    ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_price EXCEPT price ) WITH price = lv_adjusted_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adjust_prices_randomly FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjust_prices_randomly.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_price_adjust( ).
    DATA(lt_original_prices) = VALUE zcl_random_price_adjust=>tt_flight_price(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_adjusted_prices) = lo_cut->adjust_prices_randomly( lt_original_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_adjusted_prices ) exp = 2 ).

    LOOP AT lt_adjusted_prices INTO DATA(ls_adjusted_price).
      DATA(ls_original_price) = lt_original_prices[ carrid = ls_adjusted_price-carrid AND connid = ls_adjusted_price-connid ].
      DATA(lv_original_val) = ls_original_price-price.
      DATA(lv_adjusted_val) = ls_adjusted_price-price.

      " Check if adjusted price is within -10% to +10% of original
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_adjusted_val >= lv_original_val * 0.90 AND lv_adjusted_val <= lv_original_val * 1.10 )
                                         msg = |Adjusted price { lv_adjusted_val } for { ls_adjusted_price-carrid } { ls_adjusted_price-connid } not in expected range. Original: { lv_original_val }| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_adjusted_val exp = lv_original_val
                                              msg = 'Price should have been adjusted randomly' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_utf16 IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen sehr langen String in kleineren Blöcken, um Speicher zu schonen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `write` in einer Schleife mit `substring` und `get_buffer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_chunked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_chunked
      IMPORTING
        iv_long_string TYPE string
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_chunked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_chunked.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = iv_encoding ).
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_length) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_remaining_length) TYPE i.

    lv_remaining_length = strlen( iv_long_string ).

    WHILE lv_remaining_length > 0.
      lv_length = MIN( iv_chunk_size, lv_remaining_length ).
      lo_conv_out->write( substring( val = iv_long_string off = lv_offset len = lv_length ) ).
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_length.
      lv_remaining_length = lv_remaining_length - lv_length.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chunked_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chunked_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_chunked( ).
    DATA(lv_long_string) = 'A' && REPEAT( val = 'B' occ = 999 ) && 'C' && REPEAT( val = 'D' occ = 500 ). "1502 chars
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Calculate expected xstring directly for comparison
    DATA(lo_conv_full) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv_full->write( lv_long_string ).
    lv_expected_xstring = lo_conv_full->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_string_chunked(
                                 iv_long_string = lv_long_string
                                 iv_chunk_size = 500 "Smaller chunk size for testing
                                 iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                               ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_xstring
      exp = lv_expected_xstring
      msg = 'Chunked conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Verarbeitung sehr großer Strings kann es sinnvoll sein, diese in kleineren Blöcken zu konvertieren, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_abap_conv_obj` in einer Schleife verwendet werden kann, um Daten schrittweise zu verarbeiten.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_obj, Large Data, Chunking, Performance, Memory Optimization

Instructions: Summieren Sie alle Werte einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit einer einzigen Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_table_column.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN it_data NEXT s = s + <fs>-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie eine laufende Summe für eine interne Tabelle und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und einer lokalen Variablen für die Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_running_total DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_input,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_input,
           ty_t_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_output,
             amount TYPE i,
             running_total TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_output,
           ty_t_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_running_total
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE ty_t_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE ty_t_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_running_total IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_running_total.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN it_input
                         ( amount = <fs>-amount
                           running_total = ( lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + <fs>-amount ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_running_total( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_running_total=>ty_t_input(
      ( amount = 10 )
      ( amount = 5 )
      ( amount = 15 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_math_running_total=>ty_t_output(
      ( amount = 10 running_total = 10 )
      ( amount = 5 running_total = 15 )
      ( amount = 15 running_total = 30 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_running_total( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Running total failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_running_total( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_running_total=>ty_t_input( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_running_total( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Running total for empty table failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Ergebnis einer komplexen arithmetischen Formel, die mehrere Additionen und andere Operationen enthält, unter Verwendung von `LET`-Ausdrücken zur Zwischenspeicherung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LET` für lokale Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_let_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_complex_formula
      IMPORTING
        iv_a TYPE i
        iv_b TYPE i
        iv_c TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_let_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_complex_formula.
    " Formula: (A + B) * C + (A - B)
    rv_result = LET
                  lv_sum = iv_a + iv_b
                  lv_diff = iv_a - iv_b
                IN
                  lv_sum * iv_c + lv_diff.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_complex_formula.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_let_expression( ).
    " Test case: A=5, B=3, C=2
    " (5 + 3) * 2 + (5 - 3)
    " 8 * 2 + 2
    " 16 + 2 = 18
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_complex_formula( iv_a = 5 iv_b = 3 iv_c = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 18 msg = 'Complex formula calculation failed' ).

    " Test case: A=10, B=2, C=3
    " (10 + 2) * 3 + (10 - 2)
    " 12 * 3 + 8
    " 36 + 8 = 44

  ENDMETHOD.

        VALUE(rv_decoded_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_html_decode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decode_html_entities.
    " cl_abap_conv_obj is for codepage conversion, not HTML entity decoding.
    " For HTML entity decoding, cl_abap_html_utilities is more appropriate.
    " However, if the goal is to demonstrate cl_abap_conv_obj, we can simulate
    " a scenario where a string needs to be converted after some 'decoding' step.
    " For this example, we'll use cl_abap_html_utilities as it's the correct tool.
    " If cl_abap_conv_obj must be used, the problem statement needs adjustment.

    " Assuming the user wants to see a modern way to handle HTML entities,
    " cl_abap_html_utilities is the standard.
    rv_decoded_string = cl_abap_html_utilities=>decode_html( iv_html_string ).

    " If a conversion with cl_abap_conv_obj is still desired, it would be a separate step.
    " E.g., if the decoded string then needs to be converted to a specific codepage.
    " For simplicity and correctness of HTML decoding, we stick to cl_abap_html_utilities.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_html_decode FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_html_decode( ).
    DATA(lv_html_input) = 'Hello & World! <tag> €'.
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Hello & World! <tag> €'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->decode_html_entities( lv_html_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: Obwohl `cl_abap_conv_obj` für Codepage-Konvertierungen zuständig ist, ist die Dekodierung von HTML-Entitäten eine andere Aufgabe. Hierfür ist die Klasse `cl_abap_html_utilities` mit ihrer Methode `decode_html` das korrekte und moderne Werkzeug. Sie wandelt HTML-Entitäten wie `&` oder `<` in ihre entsprechenden Zeichen um.

Instructions: Addieren Sie einen konstanten Wert zu allen Elementen einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und dem `+` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_add_constant DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_constant_to_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_constant TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_add_constant IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_constant_to_column.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN it_data
                         ( id = <fs>-id
                           value = <fs>-value + iv_constant ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_constant.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_add_constant( ).

      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
      ( id = 3 value = 30 )

    DATA(lv_constant) = 5.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_math_add_constant=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 15 )
      ( id = 2 value = 25 )

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_constant_to_column( it_data = lt_input iv_constant = lv_constant ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_add_constant( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_constant_to_column( it_data = lt_input iv_constant = lv_constant ).

explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` bietet eine prägnante Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, indem Operationen auf die Elemente einer Quelltabelle angewendet werden. Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit gleichen Namen übernommen werden sollen. Verwenden Sie die `sflights` Tabelle als Quelle und eine passende Zielstruktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_sflights.
    rt_reduced_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( <fs_sflight> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_fields.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price  = '100.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
    ls_sflight-price  = '250.50'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_reduced) = lo_cut->get_reduced_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_reduced ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 2 ]-price  exp = '250.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht das Füllen einer internen Tabelle mit Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle, wobei nur gleichnamige Felder kopiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode im Vergleich zu expliziten `LOOP` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der `sflights` Tabelle für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                               FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-price  = '100.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-price  = '200.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-price  = '150.00'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art, Schleifen für Summierungen oder andere Reduktionen zu ersetzen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Handle error if type does not exist

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein übergebenes Datenobjekt vom Typ `sflight` ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_relative_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_sflight_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_sflight) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_sflight_type.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        IF lo_type_descr->get_relative_name( ) = '\TYPE=SFLIGHT'.
          rv_is_sflight = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_sflight = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        rv_is_sflight = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_not_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_sflight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_sflight INTO DATA(lr_sflight).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_type( ).
    DATA(lv_is_sflight) = lo_cut->is_sflight_type( lr_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_sflight exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_not_sflight.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_string INTO DATA(lr_string).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_type( ).
    DATA(lv_is_sflight) = lo_cut->is_sflight_type( lr_string ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Typüberprüfung mit `cl_abap_typedescr` ist ein weiteres mächtiges RTTI-Feature. Die `IF` Anweisung wird hier verwendet, um das Ergebnis der Typüberprüfung zu verarbeiten.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, IF, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in der `sflights` Tabelle, der einem bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode und einer Flugnummer entspricht. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Initialwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Suche und einen `DEFAULT` Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_find_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_find_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( it_sflights[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ] DEFAULT VALUE sflight( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_find_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-fldate exp = '20251201' ).

  METHOD test_find_non_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251201'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_find_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit dem Tabellenindex-Operator `[]` und dem `DEFAULT` Zusatz ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und sichere Suche nach Einträgen in internen Tabellen. Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights) in ein JSON-Format. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung.
hint: Nutzen Sie /UI2/CL_JSON=>SERIALIZE und den VALUE-Operator für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
                            FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflights pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Error during serialization' act = lv_json regex = 'CX_SY_JSON_SERIALIZATION_ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_json msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'carrid' ) msg = 'JSON should contain carrid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'connid' ) msg = 'JSON should contain connid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die einfache Serialisierung einer internen Tabelle in JSON unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators für die Datenbeschaffung und der Klasse /UI2/CL_JSON. Der Code ist kompakt und nutzt moderne ABAP-Features für die Datenmanipulation und JSON-Konvertierung.
keywords: JSON, /UI2/CL_JSON, SERIALIZE, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der Flugdaten enthält, in eine ABAP-Struktur. Der JSON-String repräsentiert ein einzelnes Flugsegment.
hint: Nutzen Sie /UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE und die CORRESPONDING-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS deserialize_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_sflight.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                   CHANGING  data = rs_sflight ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deserialize_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{ "carrid": "LH", "connid": "0400", "fldate": "2025-11-24", "price": "123.45", "currency": "EUR" }`.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = lo_cut->deserialize_sflight( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Connid mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-fldate exp = '20251124' msg = 'Fldate mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = '123.45' msg = 'Price mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-currency exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Currency mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = `{ "carrid": "LH", "connid": "0400", "fldate": "2025-11-24", "price": "123.45", "currency": "EUR" `.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        type = 'CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR'
        act  = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance(
          NEW zcl_json_deserialize_sflight( )->deserialize_sflight( lv_invalid_json )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Deserialisierung eines JSON-Strings in eine vordefinierte ABAP-Struktur. Die Klasse /UI2/CL_JSON übernimmt die Konvertierung, und eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR ist integriert, um ungültige JSON-Eingaben abzufangen.
