Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches SAP GUI-Fenster mit einem Splitter-Container, der den Bildschirm vertikal in zwei Bereiche teilt. Zeigen Sie in jedem Bereich einen einfachen Text an.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER und CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT oder CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_split_screen
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_split_screen.
    DATA: lo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
          lo_container1 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_container2 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_textedit1  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
          lo_textedit2  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = iv_parent_container
        rows    = 1
        columns = 2. " Two columns for vertical split

    lo_container1 = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    lo_container2 = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_textedit1
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container1.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_textedit2
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container2.

    lo_textedit1->set_text_as_stream( 'Inhalt des linken Bereichs' ).
    lo_textedit2->set_text_as_stream( 'Inhalt des rechten Bereichs' ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER verwendet. Im linken Bereich soll ein CL_SALV_TABLE mit Flugdaten (sflights) angezeigt werden. Im rechten Bereich soll bei Auswahl einer Zeile im ALV die Detailinformation der Zeile als JSON-String dargestellt werden. Die Klasse soll die Logik für die ALV-Anzeige und die JSON-Serialisierung kapseln.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_SALV_TABLE, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT und /UI2/CL_JSON. Implementieren Sie ein Event-Handler-Methode für das ALV-Ereignis LINK_CLICK oder DOUBLE_CLICK, um die ausgewählte Zeile zu serialisieren und anzuzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_alv_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS display_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_splitter     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
          mo_alv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          mo_json_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          mo_alv          TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          mo_json_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
          mt_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS handle_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING
        row.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_alv_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = iv_parent_container
        rows    = 1
        columns = 2.

    mo_alv_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_json_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_json_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_json_container.

    mt_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
                            FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_data.
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = mo_alv_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table = mt_sflights
        ).

        SET HANDLER handle_link_click FOR mo_alv->get_event_manager( ).

        mo_alv->display( ).
        CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_link_click.
    DATA: ls_selected_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA(lv_json_string) TYPE string.

    READ TABLE mt_sflights INDEX row INTO ls_selected_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          lv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_selected_sflight pretty_print = abap_true ).
          mo_json_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_json_string ).
          CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
        CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          mo_json_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
          CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_handle_link_click FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_link_click.
    DATA(lo_mock_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( EXPORTING container_name = 'MOCK_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_splitter_alv_json( lo_mock_container ).

    lo_cut->mt_sflights = VALUE zcl_splitter_alv_json=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251125' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    lo_cut->handle_link_click( row = 1 ).

    DATA(lv_expected_json) = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      data = VALUE zcl_splitter_alv_json=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      pretty_print = abap_true
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_expected_json IS NOT INITIAL ) msg = 'Expected JSON should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_expected_json CS 'LH' ) msg = 'Expected JSON should contain LH' ).

    FREE lo_mock_container.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel kombiniert CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER mit CL_SALV_TABLE und /UI2/CL_JSON. Es zeigt, wie man Flugdaten in einem ALV anzeigt und bei Auswahl einer Zeile die Details als JSON im zweiten Bereich darstellt. Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Serialisieren Sie das Ergebnis in JSON.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation und /UI2/CL_JSON für die Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_serialize
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_serialize.
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = VALUE zcl_json_serialize_sflight=>tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
                            FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_sflight_agg(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_agg( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights_raw
      GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid INTO GROUP g
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid IN
      ( result = VALUE tt_sflight_agg(
          BASE result
          ( carrid = lv_carrid num_flights = lines( g ) )
        )
      )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_aggregated_data pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_json msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'carrid' ) msg = 'JSON should contain carrid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'num_flights' ) msg = 'JSON should contain num_flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Flugdaten enthält. Filtern Sie anschließend diese Liste, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') zu erhalten. Serialisieren Sie das gefilterte Ergebnis erneut in JSON.
hint: Nutzen Sie /UI2/CL_JSON für Deserialisierung und Serialisierung, und den FILTER-Operator für die Datenfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_serialize
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_input TYPE string
        iv_carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_parse_error
        cx_sy_json_serialization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_serialize.
    DATA: lt_sflights_all TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_sflights_filtered TYPE tt_sflight.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_input
                                   CHANGING  data = lt_sflights_all ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_parse_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    lt_sflights_filtered = FILTER #( lt_sflights_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    TRY.
        rv_json_output = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflights_filtered pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_serialize_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_serialization_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_serialize_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

      { "carrid": "AA", "connid": "0001", "fldate": "2025-11-25", "price": "200.00", "currency": "USD" },

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( count( val = lv_filtered_json regex = 'carrid' ) = 2 ) msg = 'Should have 2 LH entries' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine JSON-Struktur basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Werten. Serialisieren Sie diese dynamische Struktur in einen JSON-String.
hint: Nutzen Sie /UI2/CL_JSON und dynamische Datenobjekte (CREATE DATA, ASSIGN COMPONENT) oder eine Hash-Map-ähnliche Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_value,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_value.
    TYPES tt_field_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_serialize_json
      IMPORTING
        it_field_values TYPE tt_field_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_serialization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_serialize_json.
    DATA: lo_data TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_field_values INTO DATA(ls_field_value).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_value-field_name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_struct>.

    LOOP AT it_field_values INTO ls_field_value.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_value-field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = ls_field_value-field_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = <fs_struct> pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_serialization_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

      ( field_name = 'Age' field_value = '30' )
      ( field_name = 'City' field_value = 'Berlin' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->create_and_serialize_json( lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'Name' ) msg = 'JSON should contain Name' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'Max Mustermann' ) msg = 'JSON should contain value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'Age' ) msg = 'JSON should contain Age' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS '30' ) msg = 'JSON should contain value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'City' ) msg = 'JSON should contain City' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'Berlin' ) msg = 'JSON should contain value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_json_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_creation( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine einfache REST-Anfrage (POST) an einen externen Dienst simuliert. Der Request-Body soll ein JSON-String sein, der mit /UI2/CL_JSON aus einer ABAP-Struktur generiert wird. Die Antwort des Dienstes (angenommen als JSON) soll deserialisiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_HTTP_CLIENT für die HTTP-Kommunikation und /UI2/CL_JSON für die JSON-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_json_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_request_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             status  TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS send_json_request
      IMPORTING
        is_request_data TYPE ty_request_data
        iv_url          TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response_data) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_content_type TYPE string VALUE 'application/json'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_json_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_json_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_request_json TYPE string,
          lv_response_json TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_request_json = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = is_request_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_serialize_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_serialize_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD cl_http_client=>create_by_url
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = gc_content_type ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_request_json ).

    CALL METHOD lo_http_client->send
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD lo_http_client->receive
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_response_json = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_response_json
                                   CHANGING  data = rs_response_data ).
    CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_parse_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_json_request_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_request_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_json_client( ).
    DATA(ls_request) = VALUE zcl_rest_json_client=>ty_request_data( id = '123' name = 'Test Item' ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_url) = 'http://localhost:8080/api/test'.

    DATA(lv_expected_request_json) = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_request ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_expected_request_json CS 'Test Item' ) msg = 'Request JSON should be correct' ).

    DATA(lv_mock_response_json) = `{ "status": "success", "message": "Item created" }`.
    DATA(ls_expected_response) = VALUE zcl_rest_json_client=>ty_response_data( status = 'success' message = 'Item created' ).
    DATA(ls_actual_response) = VALUE zcl_rest_json_client=>ty_response_data( ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_mock_response_json CHANGING data = ls_actual_response ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_response-status exp = ls_expected_response-status msg = 'Response status mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_response-message exp = ls_expected_response-message msg = 'Response message mismatch' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true msg = 'JSON conversion logic tested' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container. Im oberen Bereich soll ein CL_SALV_TABLE mit Fluggesellschaften (SCARR) angezeigt werden (Master-ALV). Im unteren Bereich soll ein weiteres CL_SALV_TABLE die Flüge (SFLIGHT) der im Master-ALV ausgewählten Fluggesellschaft anzeigen (Detail-ALV).
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei CL_SALV_TABLE Instanzen und CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER. Implementieren Sie das LINK_CLICK-Ereignis des Master-ALV, um das Detail-ALV zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_master_detail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS display_master_detail.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_splitter      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
          mo_master_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          mo_detail_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          mo_master_alv    TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          mo_detail_alv    TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          mt_scarr         TYPE tt_scarr,
          mt_sflight_all   TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS handle_master_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING
        row.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_master_detail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = iv_parent_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1. " Two rows for horizontal split

    mo_master_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_detail_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

    mt_scarr = VALUE tt_scarr(
      FOR ls_scarr IN ( SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid carrname = ls_scarr-carrname )
    ).

    mt_sflight_all = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
                            FROM sflight UP TO 20 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_master_detail.
    DATA: lt_empty_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = mo_master_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_master_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table = mt_scarr
        ).
        SET HANDLER handle_master_link_click FOR mo_master_alv->get_event_manager( ).
        mo_master_alv->display( ).

        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = mo_detail_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_detail_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_empty_sflight
        ).
        mo_detail_alv->display( ).

        CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_master_link_click.
    DATA: ls_selected_scarr TYPE ty_scarr,
          lt_filtered_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    READ TABLE mt_scarr INDEX row INTO ls_selected_scarr.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lt_filtered_sflight = FILTER #( mt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = ls_selected_scarr-carrid ).

      mo_detail_alv->set_data_ref( CHANGING r_data = lt_filtered_sflight ).
      mo_detail_alv->refresh( ).
      CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights). Fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'status' hinzu, die basierend auf dem Preis des Fluges ('High-Price' > 500, sonst 'Standard') gesetzt wird. Serialisieren Sie diese erweiterte Tabelle in JSON.
hint: Nutzen Sie den COND-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung und /UI2/CL_JSON für die Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_cond_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_serialize
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_cond_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_serialize.
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = VALUE zcl_json_serialize_sflight=>tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
                            FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_extended) = VALUE tt_sflight_ext(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( ls_raw WITH
        status = COND string( WHEN ls_raw-price > 500 THEN 'High-Price' ELSE 'Standard' )
      )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflights_extended pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_serialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_and_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_and_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_cond_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->process_and_serialize( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Error during serialization' act = lv_json regex = 'CX_SY_JSON_SERIALIZATION_ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_json msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'status' ) msg = 'JSON should contain status field' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_json CS 'High-Price' OR lv_json CS 'Standard' ) msg = 'JSON should contain correct status values' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung des COND-Operators, um basierend auf einer Bedingung dynamisch Werte zuzuweisen und eine interne Tabelle zu erweitern. Die erweiterte Tabelle wird dann in JSON serialisiert. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, bedingte Logik in ABAP auszudrücken.
keywords: JSON, /UI2/CL_JSON, COND, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Flugdaten enthält. Prüfen Sie anschließend mit LINE_EXISTS, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in der Liste vorhanden ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie /UI2/CL_JSON für die Deserialisierung und den LINE_EXISTS-Operator für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_input TYPE string
        iv_carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid     TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_input
                                   CHANGING  data = lt_sflights ).
    CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_parse_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists_true FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_json_parse_error.
    METHODS test_flight_exists_false FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `[
      { "carrid": "LH", "connid": "0400", "fldate": "2025-11-24", "price": "100.00", "currency": "EUR" },
      { "carrid": "AA", "connid": "0001", "fldate": "2025-11-25", "price": "200.00", "currency": "USD" }
    ]`.
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_json_input = lv_json_input iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exists msg = 'Flight LH 0400 should exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_exists_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `[
      { "carrid": "LH", "connid": "0400", "fldate": "2025-11-24", "price": "100.00", "currency": "EUR" }
    ]`.
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_json_input = lv_json_input iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( cond = lv_exists msg = 'Flight UA 0001 should not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von der Tabelle `sflights` für die Fluggesellschaften 'LH' und 'AA' mittels `UNION ALL`. Die Ausgabe soll die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION ALL` Operator in Open SQL, um die Ergebnisse zweier `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu verknüpfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).

    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für LH und AA in sflights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte LH Flüge enthalten' act = lv_count_lh exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte AA Flüge enthalten' act = lv_count_aa exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` ist eine moderne Open SQL-Funktion (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40), die es erlaubt, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu kombinieren. Im Gegensatz zu `UNION` werden Duplikate nicht entfernt, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen verbessern kann, wenn Duplikate akzeptabel sind oder nicht erwartet werden. Die Syntax ist kompakt und gut lesbar.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, SELECT, sflights, Datenbankzugriff

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von der Tabelle `sflights` für die Fluggesellschaften 'LH' und 'AA' mittels `UNION`, um sicherzustellen, dass alle zurückgegebenen Zeilen eindeutig sind. Die Ausgabe soll die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION` Operator in Open SQL, der automatisch Duplikate entfernt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_union_distinct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_distinct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_unique_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).

    " Überprüfen auf Duplikate (einfache Methode für den Test)
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lt_flights.
    SORT lt_unique_flights BY carrid connid fldate.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft für 'LH' und 'AA' separat und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse in einer einzigen internen Tabelle. Die Ausgabe soll die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und die Anzahl der Flüge (`total_flights`) enthalten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_counts.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' GROUP BY carrid
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' GROUP BY carrid
    INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregated_union.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge zurückgegeben werden' act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH-Flüge sollten gezählt werden' act = lv_lh_count exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'AA-Flüge sollten gezählt werden' act = lv_aa_count exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um komplexe Berichte oder Übersichten aus verschiedenen Teilmengen von Daten in einem einzigen Datenbankzugriff zu erstellen, was die Effizienz gegenüber mehreren separaten `SELECT`-Anweisungen und anschließender ABAP-Verarbeitung erheblich steigert.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).

    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_union_order.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_order( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_ordered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).

    " Überprüfen der Sortierung
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id VALUE ' '.
    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE s_date VALUE '00000000'.

      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der einen JSON-Payload aus einer POST-Anfrage liest, den Wert des Feldes 'input_value' extrahiert und diesen in einer JSON-Antwort unter dem Feld 'received_value' zurückgibt. Bei ungültigem JSON soll eine 400 Bad Request-Antwort mit einer Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `co_request->get_cdata()` zum Lesen des Request-Bodys und `/UI2/CL_JSON=>deserialize` zur JSON-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_request_body) = co_request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA(lo_response) = co_request->get_response( ).
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            input_value TYPE string,
          END OF ls_data.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_request_body CHANGING data = ls_data ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |{{ "received_value": "{ ls_data-input_value }" }}| ).
        lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json=>cx_json_parse_error.
        lo_response->set_cdata( |{{ "error": "Invalid JSON format" }}| ).
        lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_request_uri) = co_request->get_request_uri( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der den HTTP-Methode (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) der Anfrage erkennt und eine entsprechende Antwort zurückgibt, die die erkannte Methode angibt. Für nicht unterstützte Methoden soll ein 405 Method Not Allowed-Status zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `co_request->get_method()` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung für die Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_method_router DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_method_router IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_method) = co_request->get_method( ).
    DATA(lo_response) = co_request->get_response( ).

    CASE lv_method.
      WHEN if_http_request=>co_request_method_get.
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Method: GET| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      WHEN if_http_request=>co_request_method_post.
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Method: POST| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      WHEN if_http_request=>co_request_method_put.
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Method: PUT| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      WHEN if_http_request=>co_request_method_delete.
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Method: DELETE| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Method { lv_method } not allowed.| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 405 reason = 'Method Not Allowed' ).
        lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Allow' value = 'GET, POST, PUT, DELETE' ).
    ENDCASE.

    lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine einfache Authentifizierung mittels Basic Authentication durchführt. Wenn der Benutzername 'admin' und das Passwort 'password' sind, soll eine 200 OK-Antwort zurückgegeben werden. Andernfalls eine 401 Unauthorized-Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64` und `co_request->get_header_field( 'Authorization' )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_response) = co_request->get_response( ).
    DATA(lv_auth_header) = co_request->get_header_field( 'Authorization' ).
    DATA(lv_username) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_password) TYPE string.

    IF lv_auth_header IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_auth_header CS 'Basic '.
      DATA(lv_base64_encoded) = lv_auth_header+6.
      DATA(lv_decoded) = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( lv_base64_encoded ).
      SPLIT lv_decoded AT ':' INTO lv_username lv_password.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_username = 'admin' AND lv_password = 'password'.
      lo_response->set_cdata( 'Authentication successful!' ).
      lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ELSE.
      lo_response->set_cdata( 'Authentication failed.' ).
      lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'WWW-Authenticate' value = 'Basic realm="ABAP Secure Area"' ).
      lo_response->set_status( code = 401 reason = 'Unauthorized' ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Statuscode ist 200' act = lo_response->get_status( )-code exp = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Statuscode ist 401' act = lo_response->get_status( )-code exp = 401 ).

explanation: Die Implementierung von Basic Authentication in einem ABAP HTTP-Handler ist ein gängiges Szenario für die Absicherung von Services. Der `Authorization`-Header wird ausgelesen, der Base64-kodierte Teil mittels `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64` dekodiert und die Anmeldeinformationen extrahiert. Bei fehlgeschlagener Authentifizierung wird der Status 401 Unauthorized zurückgegeben und der `WWW-Authenticate`-Header gesetzt, was eine moderne und standardkonforme Vorgehensweise darstellt.

CLASS zcl_range_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_carrid_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_carrid_range.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_key(
      FOR sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( connid > '0001' )
      ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
    ).

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #(
      FOR sflight_key IN lt_sflights
      ( sign   = 'I'
        option = 'EQ'
        low    = sflight_key-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = sflight-carrid
        connid = sflight-connid
        fldate = sflight-fldate )
    ).

    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_sflights_by_carrid( lt_test_range ).

    " Assert that all filtered entries have CARRID 'LH' or 'AA'
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that no other CARRID exists in the filtered table
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count_lh_aa) WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = lv_count_lh_aa ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die Integration mit Range-Tabellen (`IN it_carrid_range`) ist besonders mächtig und reduziert den Boilerplate-Code erheblich.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Data Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Dialogbox mit `cl_gui_dialogbox_container` und betten Sie ein `cl_gui_textedit` Control ein. Zeigen Sie, wie die Dialogbox initialisiert und angezeigt wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einem Statuscode eine formatierte Statusmeldung zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie String Templates in Kombination mit `COND` und `SWITCH`.
hint: `COND` und `SWITCH` können direkt innerhalb von String Templates verwendet werden, um dynamische Inhalte zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 success TYPE ty_status_code VALUE 'S',
                 warning TYPE ty_status_code VALUE 'W',
                 error   TYPE ty_status_code VALUE 'E',
                 info    TYPE ty_status_code VALUE 'I',
               END OF gc_status.

    METHODS format_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE ty_status_code
        iv_message     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_status_message.
    rv_formatted_message = |Status: { iv_status_code } - { 
      COND string(
        WHEN iv_status_code = gc_status-success THEN 'Erfolgreich'
        WHEN iv_status_code = gc_status-warning THEN 'Warnung'
        WHEN iv_status_code = gc_status-error   THEN 'Fehler'
        ELSE 'Unbekannt'
      )
    }: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_status.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_status_formatter( ).

    DATA(lv_msg_s) = lo_formatter->format_status_message( iv_status_code = zcl_status_formatter=>gc_status-success iv_message = 'Operation completed.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_msg_s exp = 'Status: S - Erfolgreich: Operation completed.' ).

    DATA(lv_msg_e) = lo_formatter->format_status_message( iv_status_code = zcl_status_formatter=>gc_status-error iv_message = 'Data inconsistency.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_msg_e exp = 'Status: E - Fehler: Data inconsistency.' ).

    DATA(lv_msg_u) = lo_formatter->format_status_message( iv_status_code = 'X' iv_message = 'Unknown status.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_msg_u exp = 'Status: X - Unbekannt: Unknown status.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine flexible und lesbare Möglichkeit zur String-Formatierung. Die Einbettung von `COND` (oder `SWITCH`) ermöglicht die direkte Integration von bedingter Logik, was den Code kompakter und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: String Templates, COND, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, String Processing

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle mittels Table Expression zu und prüfen Sie dessen Existenz mit `LINE_EXISTS`. Wenn der Eintrag nicht existiert, fügen Sie ihn hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key_field = value ]` für den Zugriff und `LINE_EXISTS( itab[ key_field = value ] )` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_name TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF NOT LINE_EXISTS( ct_data[ id = iv_id ] ).
      " Entry does not exist, add it
      INSERT VALUE ty_data( id = iv_id name = iv_name ) INTO TABLE ct_data.
    ELSE.
      " Entry exists, update it (example)
      ct_data[ id = iv_id ]-name = iv_name.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_new_entry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existing_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_new_entry.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_table_accessor( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_accessor=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alpha' )
    ).

    lo_accessor->process_data( iv_id = 2 iv_name = 'Beta' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ id = 2 ]-name exp = 'Beta' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_entry.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_table_accessor( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_accessor=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alpha' )
    ).

    lo_accessor->process_data( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Alpha Updated' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ id = 1 ]-name exp = 'Alpha Updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Table Expressions (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` kann die Existenz eines Eintrags effizient geprüft werden, bevor Operationen wie `INSERT` oder `UPDATE` durchgeführt werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: Table Expressions, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    " Get expected sum using traditional SELECT for comparison
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price ).

    " Test for a CARRID that might not exist
    DATA(lv_price_non_existent) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_non_existent exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um interne Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Akkumulationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Math, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse und demonstrieren Sie deren Verwendung mit `NEW` und `THROW` in einer Methode.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` oder `cx_dynamic_check` erbt.
solution:
" Custom Exception Class Definition
CLASS zcx_my_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    INTERFACES if_t100_dyn_msg.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_param1 TYPE string OPTIONAL.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_param1 = iv_param1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example Class using the custom exception
CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_my_custom_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      " Modern way to raise an exception
      THROW zcx_my_custom_error( textid = zcx_my_custom_error=>textid
                                 iv_param1 = |Value { iv_value } is negative| ).
    ENDIF.
    " ... further processing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_raised FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_my_custom_error.
    METHODS test_no_exception_raised FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_raised.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    " Expecting an exception
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'ZCX_MY_CUSTOM_ERROR'
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        OTHERS     = 2
    ).
    lo_demo->process_value( -10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception_raised.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    " No exception expected
    lo_demo->process_value( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_does_not_raise( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `NEW` und `THROW` für Exceptions ist die moderne Art, Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP zu implementieren. Es ist deklarativer und konsistenter mit anderen modernen Programmiersprachen. Eigene Exception-Klassen ermöglichen eine spezifische Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: NEW, THROW, Exceptions, Error Handling, Object Orientation

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei Sie nur übereinstimmende Felder übertragen und dabei die Werte einer Basisstruktur als Ausgangspunkt verwenden. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE`.
hint: `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` ist ideal für das Mergen von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field4 TYPE string, " Field not in source
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
        is_base   TYPE ty_target
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( is_base ) is_source MAPPING field1 = field1 field2 = field2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping_with_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_with_base.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_source( field1 = 'Source Value 1' field2 = 10 field3 = 'Source Value 3' ).
    DATA(ls_base)   = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_target( field1 = 'Base Value 1' field2 = 5 field4 = 'Base Value 4' ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( is_source = ls_source is_base = ls_base ).

    " field1 and field2 should come from source
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Source Value 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 10 ).
    " field4 should come from base as it's not in source
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field4 exp = 'Base Value 4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Mit dem Zusatz `BASE` können Sie eine Basisstruktur oder -tabelle als Ausgangspunkt für die Zieldaten verwenden, bevor die Felder aus der Quellstruktur/Tabelle übertragen werden. Dies ist nützlich für das Mergen von Daten und das Setzen von Default-Werten.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, BASE, Data Manipulation, Structures

Instructions: Lesen Sie den ersten Eintrag einer Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und deklarieren Sie die Zieltabelle inline.
hint: Verwenden Sie `@DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration und `UP TO 1 ROWS` für die Begrenzung der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

      FROM sflight

      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flight_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_flight.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_reader->get_first_flight_data( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_reader->get_first_flight_data( 'ZZ' ). " Assuming 'ZZ' does not exist

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).

explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von Variablen mit `@DATA(...)` direkt in `SELECT`-Anweisungen reduziert den Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit. `UP TO 1 ROWS` ist eine effiziente Methode, um nur den ersten passenden Eintrag zu lesen, was besonders bei der Prüfung auf Existenz oder dem Abrufen eines einzelnen Datensatzes nützlich ist.
keywords: SELECT, DATA, sflights, Data Selection, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Greifen Sie sicher auf eine Methode oder ein Attribut eines Objekts zu, das möglicherweise initial ist, ohne einen Dump zu verursachen. Nutzen Sie Optional Chaining.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Operator `?->` für den sicheren Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_chain_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS run_demo.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_chain_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_demo.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_assert. " Can be initial

    " Without optional chaining, this would dump if lo_object is initial
    " lo_object->assert_true( ... ).

    " With optional chaining, no dump if lo_object is initial
    lo_object?->assert_true( 1 = 1 ). " This call will simply be skipped if lo_object is initial

    " Example with a method returning a value
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_object?->get_message( ). " lv_result will be initial if lo_object is initial

    IF lv_result IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Method call skipped due to initial object reference.' TYPE 'I'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE |Method call executed, result: { lv_result }| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.

    " Now, instantiate the object
    lo_object = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ).
    lv_result = lo_object?->get_message( ). " This will now execute

    IF lv_result IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Method call skipped due to initial object reference (should not happen now).' TYPE 'I'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE |Method call executed, result: { lv_result }| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_optional_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_optional_chaining.
    DATA lo_assert TYPE REF TO cl_abap_unit_assert.
    DATA lv_message TYPE string.

    " Test with initial object
    lv_message = lo_assert?->get_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_message ). " Should be initial, no dump

    " Test with instantiated object
    lo_assert = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ).
    lv_message = lo_assert?->get_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_message ). " Should return a message
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Optional Chaining (`?->`) ist eine sehr nützliche Funktion, um Null-Pointer-Exceptions (Dumps) zu vermeiden, wenn Sie auf Methoden oder Attribute von Objektreferenzen zugreifen, die möglicherweise initial sind. Der Ausdruck wird einfach übersprungen, wenn die Referenz initial ist, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.
keywords: Optional Chaining, Object Orientation, Null Safety, Dumps

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Dialogbox und betten Sie einen `cl_gui_alv_grid` Control ein, um Daten aus der `sflights` Tabelle anzuzeigen.
hint: Der `cl_gui_alv_grid` benötigt einen Container als Parent.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dialog_with_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_sflights_in_dialog.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dialog_with_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_dialog_container
      EXPORTING
        parent  = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        width   = 800
        height  = 600
        caption = 'SFLIGHTS ALV Display'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_dialog_container.

    " Fetch data for ALV
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_in_dialog.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = mt_sflights
      ).
      mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( 0 ). " Read-only

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit zur Datenaggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( FOR sflight IN sflights ( sflight ) ).

    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_grouping FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_grouping.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_grouper->get_flight_summary( ).

    " Verify counts for known airlines (assuming data in sflights)
    DATA(lv_count_lh) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-flight_count exp = lv_count_lh ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_count_aa) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count_aa WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-flight_count exp = lv_count_aa ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Anstatt manuell zu loopen und zu aggregieren, kann die gesamte Logik in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung ausgedrückt werden. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, sflights

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu. Nutzen Sie `COND` mit `SWITCH` für eine kompakte und lesbare Lösung.
hint: `COND` ist ein Ausdruck, der einen Wert zurückgibt, basierend auf einer Reihe von Bedingungen. `SWITCH` ist eine Variante für Gleichheitsprüfungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_day_of_week TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_day,
                 monday    TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '1',
                 tuesday   TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '2',
                 wednesday TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '3',
                 thursday  TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '4',
                 friday    TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '5',
                 saturday  TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '6',
                 sunday    TYPE ty_day_of_week VALUE '7',
               END OF gc_day.

    METHODS get_work_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_day TYPE ty_day_of_week
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_work_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_day = gc_day-saturday OR iv_day = gc_day-sunday THEN 'Wochenende'
      WHEN iv_day = gc_day-monday THEN 'Arbeitsbeginn'
      WHEN iv_day = gc_day-friday THEN 'Wochenende naht'
      ELSE 'Arbeitstag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_assigner->get_work_status( zcl_conditional_assign=>gc_day-wednesday ) exp = 'Arbeitstag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_assigner->get_work_status( zcl_conditional_assign=>gc_day-saturday ) exp = 'Wochenende' ).

explanation: `COND` ist ein bedingter Ausdruck, der einen Wert zurückgibt, basierend auf den erfüllten Bedingungen. Es ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Statements, wenn es um die Zuweisung eines Wertes geht.

CLASS zcl_periods_between DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_info,
             fiscal_year TYPE bsp_fiscal_year,
             fiscal_period TYPE bsp_fiscal_period,
           END OF ty_period_info.
    TYPES tt_period_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_periods_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
        iv_variant    TYPE bsp_fiscal_year_variant
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE tt_period_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_periods_between IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_periods_between.
    DATA(lo_period_api) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_period_objects) = lo_period_api->get_periods_between_dates(
        iv_start_date = iv_start_date
        iv_end_date    = iv_end_date
        iv_variant    = iv_variant
    ).

    rt_periods = VALUE #( FOR lo_period IN lt_period_objects
                              ( fiscal_year   = lo_period->get_fiscal_year( )
                                fiscal_period = lo_period->get_fiscal_period( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie mehrere Buttons in einem Container und versuchen Sie, deren interne Control-IDs über das Control Framework abzurufen. (Hinweis: Die direkte Abfrage der Control-ID ist nicht immer trivial, hier wird die Instanz selbst als Referenz verwendet).
hint: Das Control Framework verwaltet Referenzen. Die `cl_gui_cfw` Klasse hat keine direkte Methode `get_control_id` für beliebige Controls, aber man kann die Referenzen selbst verwalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_get_control_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_button_info,
             id     TYPE string,
             button TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button,
           END OF ty_button_info.
    TYPES tt_button_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_button_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_buttons TYPE tt_button_info.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_buttons
      IMPORTING
        it_button_texts TYPE string_table.
    METHODS get_button_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_button) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_get_control_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_buttons.
    LOOP AT it_button_texts INTO DATA(lv_text).
      DATA(ls_button_info) = VALUE ty_button_info( id = lv_text ). " Use text as ID for simplicity
      CREATE OBJECT ls_button_info-button
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_container.
      ls_button_info-button->set_text( lv_text ).
      INSERT ls_button_info INTO TABLE mt_buttons.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button_by_id.
    READ TABLE mt_buttons INTO DATA(ls_button_info) WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ro_button = ls_button_info-button.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_control_by_id FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_control_by_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_get_control_id( iv_container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' ).
    DATA(lt_texts) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Button 1' ) ( 'Button 2' ) ).
    lo_cut->create_buttons( lt_texts ).

    DATA(lo_button1) = lo_cut->get_button_by_id( 'Button 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_button1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_button1->get_text( ) exp = 'Button 1' ).

    DATA(lo_button_not_found) = lo_cut->get_button_by_id( 'Non Existent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_button_not_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da `cl_gui_cfw` keine generische `get_control_id`-Methode für alle Controls bietet, wird hier eine eigene Verwaltung der Control-Referenzen in einer internen Tabelle demonstriert. Die `id` wird hier als Text des Buttons simuliert. `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` wird für die Erstellung verwendet.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie das Control Framework und die erstellten GUI-Controls ordnungsgemäß aufgeräumt werden, um Speicherlecks zu vermeiden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FREE OBJECT` für Controls und Container, und `cl_gui_cfw=>flush`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_button    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_button
      IMPORTING
        iv_button_text    TYPE string.
    METHODS cleanup_controls.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_button.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
    mo_button->set_text( iv_button_text ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_controls.
    IF mo_button IS BOUND.
      FREE OBJECT mo_button.
      CLEAR mo_button.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      FREE OBJECT mo_container.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Ensure frontend is updated
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_controls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_controls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_cleanup( iv_container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' ).
    lo_cut->create_button( iv_button_text = 'Temporary Button' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_button ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).

    lo_cut->cleanup_controls( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_cut->mo_button ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das ordnungsgemäße Aufräumen von GUI-Controls ist wichtig, um Speicherlecks auf dem Frontend-Server zu vermeiden. `FREE OBJECT` gibt die Ressourcen frei, und `CLEAR` setzt die Referenz auf initial. `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` stellt sicher, dass die Freigabe an das Frontend kommuniziert wird.
keywords: GUI, Control Framework, cl_gui_cfw, FREE OBJECT, Resource Management, SCET

CLASS zcl_ctx_log_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      ( key = 'Systemdatum'   value = |{ lv_date DATE = USER }| )
      ( key = 'Systemzeit'    value = |{ lv_time TIME = USER }| )
      ( key = 'Benutzer'      value = lv_user )

CLASS zcl_http_get_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_get_json IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~decode_json(

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine Test-API (z.B. JSONPlaceholder).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und `cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~encode_json` zum Erstellen des JSON-Payloads.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_new_post,
        title  TYPE string,
        body   TYPE string,
        userid TYPE i,
      END OF ty_new_post,
      BEGIN OF ty_response_post,
        id     TYPE i,
        title  TYPE string,
        body   TYPE string,
        userid TYPE i,
      END OF ty_response_post.

    METHODS create_post
      IMPORTING
        is_new_post TYPE ty_new_post
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_response_post
      RAISING
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_post.
    DATA:
      lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
      lv_json_request TYPE string,
      lv_json_response TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url    = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts'
      IMPORTING
        e_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
      name  = 'Content-Type'
      value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    ).

    cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~encode_json(
      EXPORTING
        data = is_new_post
      RECEIVING
        json = lv_json_request
    ).

    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send( ).
    lo_http_client->receive( ).

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~decode_json(
      EXPORTING
        json = lv_json_response
      CHANGING
        data = rs_response
    ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP GET-Request und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler (z.B. 404 Not Found) mit `TRY...CATCH` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und fangen Sie `cx_http_client_error` ab. Überprüfen Sie den Statuscode der Antwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_non_existent_resource
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_code) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_non_existent_resource.
    DATA:
      lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/nonexistent' " This URL should return 404
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS   = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        rv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        " Handle HTTP client errors (e.g., connection issues)
        MESSAGE lx_http_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error EXPORTING previous = lx_http_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = 0.

    TRY.

    ENDTRY.

      msg = 'Expected HTTP status 404 for non-existent resource'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
