Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und filtern Sie die JSON-Antwort (eine Liste von Objekten) mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um nur bestimmte Elemente zu extrahieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_http_client`, `decode_json` und den `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_for_processing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_todo,
        userid    TYPE i,
        id        TYPE i,
        title     TYPE string,
        completed TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_todo,
      tt_todos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_todo WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_completed_todos
      IMPORTING
        iv_userid TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_completed_todos) TYPE tt_todos
      RAISING   cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_for_processing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_completed_todos.
    DATA:
      lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
      lv_json_data   TYPE string,
      lt_all_todos   TYPE tt_todos.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url    = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos'
      IMPORTING
        e_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send( ).
    lo_http_client->receive( ).

    lv_json_data = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~decode_json(
      EXPORTING
        json = lv_json_data
      CHANGING
        data = lt_all_todos
    ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).

    rt_completed_todos = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_todo IN lt_all_todos
      WHERE ( userid = iv_userid AND completed = abap_true )
      ( ls_todo )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_access_table_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                   WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_dyn_access_table_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    ASSIGN it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid
                                                  connid = iv_connid
                                                  fldate = iv_fldate ] TO <fs_flight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = <fs_flight>-price.
    ELSE.
      rv_price = 0. " Not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein Datenobjekt (Struktur) und greifen Sie anschließend dynamisch auf eines seiner Felder zu, um einen Wert zu setzen oder zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_create_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_struct,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_dynamic_struct.

    METHODS manipulate_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field1_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_dynamic_data.
    DATA:
      lr_data        TYPE REF TO data,
      lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_dynamic_struct> TYPE any,
      <fs_field>          TYPE any.

    " Dynamically create a data object of type ty_dynamic_struct
    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYN_CREATE_ACCESS=>TY_DYNAMIC_STRUCT' )->as_structdescr( ).
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_struct>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Set initial values
      <fs_dynamic_struct>-('FIELD1') = 'Initial Value'.
      <fs_dynamic_struct>-('FIELD2') = 100.

      " Dynamically access and set the specified field
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.

      " Read field1 for verification
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_field1_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur kopiert, wobei die Feldnamen dynamisch übereinstimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA`, `ASSIGN` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit `EXPANDING NESTED TABLES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_generic_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        id     TYPE i,
        name   TYPE string,
        value  TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        name   TYPE string,
        id     TYPE i,
        amount TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS copy_data_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_generic_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_data_dynamically.
    DATA:
      lr_target_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_source> TYPE any,
      <fs_target> TYPE ty_target_data.

    " Assign source to a field symbol for generic access
    ASSIGN is_source TO <fs_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: source not assignable
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create target data object dynamically (or use a fixed type as here)
    CREATE DATA lr_target_data LIKE rs_target.
    ASSIGN lr_target_data->* TO <fs_target>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Use MOVE-CORRESPONDING for dynamic field matching
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING <fs_source> TO <fs_target> EXPANDING NESTED TABLES.
    ENDIF.

    rs_target = <fs_target>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_data_dynamically FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_data_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_generic_copy( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_generic_copy=>ty_source_data(
      id    = 123
      name  = 'Test Item'
      value = '45.67'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->copy_data_dynamically( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 123 msg = 'ID should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Test Item' msg = 'Name should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-amount exp = '45.67' msg = 'Value should be copied to amount' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `ASSIGN` in Verbindung mit `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` für eine generische Datenübertragung zwischen Strukturen verwendet werden kann, selbst wenn die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind, aber logisch übereinstimmen. `EXPANDING NESTED TABLES` ist wichtig für verschachtelte Tabellen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOL, Dynamic Programming, MOVE-CORRESPONDING, Generic

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über alle Komponenten einer Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` für die Metadaten und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_component_details
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_details.
    DATA:
      lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
      ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE any.

    " Get runtime type information for the structure
    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data )->as_structdescr( ).

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->components INTO ls_component.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ ls_component-name }: { <fs_component_value> }| TO rt_details.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_loop_components( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_dyn_loop_components=>ty_flight_info(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_details[ 5 ] needle = 'CURRENCY: EUR' msg = 'CURRENCY detail incorrect' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in Paketen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_basic_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_paged IMPORTING iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 10
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_basic_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_paged.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE ty_t_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_package TO rt_sflights.
      CLEAR lt_sflight_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_cur_for_all_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_for_carriers.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
          WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
          ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_sflights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.

      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` und das explizite Schließen des Cursors.
hint: `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor über `COMMIT WORK` hinweg offen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_with_hold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflights_with_commit IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                         RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_with_hold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights_with_commit.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE ty_t_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE 10.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_package TO rt_sflights.
      COMMIT WORK. 
    ENDIF.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE 10.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflight_package TO rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_with_hold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_hold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cur_with_hold( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->process_sflights_with_commit( 'AA' ).

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflights ).
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
        ASSERT ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` ist entscheidend, wenn ein Cursor über einen `COMMIT WORK` hinweg offen bleiben muss, um die Datenverarbeitung in Transaktionen fortzusetzen. Das explizite `CLOSE CURSOR` ist wichtig, um Datenbankressourcen freizugeben.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, WITH HOLD, COMMIT WORK, CLOSE CURSOR, Transaktion, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Behandeln Sie Fehler beim Öffnen eines Cursors, z.B. wenn die Tabelle nicht existiert (konzeptionell, da Syntaxfehler meist zur Kompilierzeit erkannt werden).
hint: Überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `OPEN CURSOR` oder verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für dynamische SQL-Fehler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_safe IMPORTING iv_table_name TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_t_sflight
                                RAISING   cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_safe.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
            FROM (iv_table_name)
            ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_sflights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_osql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_osql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sflights_safe( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Substrings in einem gegebenen Text durch einen neuen Substring. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne `REPLACE` Syntax.

CLASS zcl_replace_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_text.
    rv_modified_text = iv_original_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_substring IN rv_modified_text WITH iv_new_substring.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_replace_simple FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_original_text = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP' iv_old_substring = 'Hello' iv_new_substring = 'Greetings' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Greetings World, Greetings ABAP' msg = 'Simple replace failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_text( iv_original_text = 'NoMatch' iv_old_substring = 'XYZ' iv_new_substring = 'ABC' ).

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Zahlen in einem gegebenen Text durch einen Platzhalter. Nutzen Sie dafür reguläre Ausdrücke.

solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_placeholder   TYPE string DEFAULT '#' 
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_numbers.
    rv_modified_text = iv_original_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN rv_modified_text WITH iv_placeholder.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_regex FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_regex.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_regex( ).

Instructions: In einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), ersetzen Sie im Feld `CARRID` alle Vorkommen von 'LH' durch den Wert der Konstante `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base`. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR` Operator und `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `REDUCE` und `REPLACE` innerhalb eines String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_in_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             modified TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_carrid_in_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_in_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrid_in_sflights.
    DATA(lv_mmpur_base) = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base.

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                     modified = REDUCE string( INIT s = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                               FOR ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'LH' IN s
                                                                 REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'LH' IN s WITH lv_mmpur_base ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_replace_in_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_in_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_carrid_in_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Table should not be empty' ).

    DATA(lv_mmpur_base) = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result).
      IF ls_result-carrid CP '*LH*'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-modified exp = REPLACE( val = ls_result-carrid old = 'LH' new = lv_mmpur_base ) msg = 'Replacement in CARRID failed' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-modified exp = ls_result-carrid msg = 'No replacement, but modified' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

IN` für die Iteration über interne Tabellen und dem `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation oder Transformation von Werten. Innerhalb von `REDUCE` wird `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` verwendet, um den `CARRID` zu modifizieren. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Programmierparadigma in ABAP 7.50+, das zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und effizienterem Code führt, indem explizite Schleifen vermieden werden.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie einen Substring in einem Text nur dann, wenn der Text eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt (z.B. eine Mindestlänge hat). Nutzen Sie dafür den `COND` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` um die Bedingung zu prüfen und dann `REPLACE` anzuwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_conditionally DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_if_long_enough
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
        iv_min_length    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_conditionally IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_if_long_enough.
    rv_modified_text = COND string(
      WHEN strlen( iv_original_text ) >= iv_min_length
      THEN REPLACE( val = iv_original_text old = iv_old_substring new = iv_new_substring occ = 0 )
      ELSE iv_original_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_cond FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_cond.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_conditionally( ).

    " Testfall: Bedingung erfüllt, Ersetzung findet statt
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->replace_if_long_enough( iv_original_text = 'Short text with old.' iv_old_substring = 'old' iv_new_substring = 'new' iv_min_length = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Short text with new.' msg = 'Conditional replace (true) failed' ).

    " Testfall: Bedingung nicht erfüllt, keine Ersetzung
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->replace_if_long_enough( iv_original_text = 'Short' iv_old_substring = 'old' iv_new_substring = 'new' iv_min_length = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'Short' msg = 'Conditional replace (false) failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator (Conditional Expression) ermöglicht es, Werte basierend auf Bedingungen inline zu bestimmen. In Kombination mit der `REPLACE` Funktion bietet dies eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Möglichkeit, bedingte String-Manipulationen durchzuführen, ohne separate `IF`-Anweisungen verwenden zu müssen. Dies ist ein Merkmal von modernem ABAP 7.40+.
keywords: REPLACE, COND, Conditional Logic, String Processing

CLASS zcl_replace_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen mit `CARRID = 'AA'` und ersetzen Sie in den gefilterten Einträgen den `CONNID` durch einen neuen Wert, der den Wert der Konstante `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base` enthält. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator und `FOR`.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid

Innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife wird `REPLACE` verwendet, um den `CONNID` zu aktualisieren, wobei der neue Wert aus einem String-Template und der Konstante `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base` gebildet wird. Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen am Anfang und Ende eines Strings und ersetzen Sie mehrere aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen im Inneren des Strings durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen. Nutzen Sie dafür reguläre Ausdrücke und die `REPLACE` Funktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` für die Leerzeichen-Normalisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_whitespace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_whitespace
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_normalized_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_whitespace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_whitespace.
    rv_normalized_text = iv_original_text.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    rv_normalized_text = |{ rv_normalized_text ALPHA = OUT }|.
    " Replace multiple spaces with single space
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_normalized_text WITH ' '.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_whitespace( ).

    DATA(lv_test_string1) = '  Hello   World   ABAP  '.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Hello World ABAP' msg = 'Whitespace normalization failed (multiple spaces)' ).

    DATA(lv_test_string2) = 'SingleSpace'.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->normalize_whitespace( lv_test_string2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'SingleSpace' msg = 'Whitespace normalization failed (no spaces)' ).

    DATA(lv_test_string3) = '   Leading and Trailing   '.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->normalize_whitespace( lv_test_string3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 'Leading and Trailing' msg = 'Whitespace normalization failed (leading/trailing)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine effiziente Methode zur Normalisierung von Leerzeichen in einem String. Zuerst werden führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen mit `ALPHA = OUT` in einem String-Template entfernt. Anschließend werden mehrere aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen im Inneren des Strings mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+'` durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen ersetzt. Die Verwendung von regulären Ausdrücken ist hierbei besonders leistungsstark und flexibel, um verschiedene Arten von Whitespace zu handhaben. Dies ist ein modernes und effizientes Vorgehen in ABAP 7.50+.

CLASS zcl_replace_in_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_replace_in_map IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_in_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_in_map( ).
    DATA(lt_test_urls) = VALUE string_table( ( 'https://www.example.com/path' )
                                            ( 'http://example.com/another' )

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_domain_in_urls( lt_test_urls ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `MAP` Operator (seit ABAP 7.55) ist ein sehr mächtiges Werkzeug für die Transformation von internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird `MAP` verwendet, um jede URL in der Eingabetabelle zu durchlaufen und den Domain-Namen 'example.com' durch 'newdomain.com' zu ersetzen, indem die `REPLACE` Funktion direkt auf jedes Element angewendet wird. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Schreibweise für die Transformation von Tabellen, die explizite Schleifen überflüssig macht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String alle Kleinbuchstaben durch ihre entsprechenden Großbuchstaben, aber nur, wenn der String das Wort 'secret' enthält. Nutzen Sie `COND` und `REPLACE` mit `TO UPPER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` um die Bedingung zu prüfen und dann `REPLACE` in Kombination mit `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_case_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_to_upper_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_case_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_to_upper_cond.
    rv_modified_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_original_text CS 'secret'
      THEN REPLACE( val = iv_original_text old = to_lower( iv_original_text ) new = to_upper( iv_original_text ) occ = 0 )
      ELSE iv_original_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Testfall: Enthält 'secret', Umwandlung in Großbuchstaben
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->replace_to_upper_cond( 'This is a secret message.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'THIS IS A SECRET MESSAGE.' msg = 'Case replace (secret) failed' ).

    " Testfall: Enthält nicht 'secret', keine Umwandlung

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `COND` Operator mit der `REPLACE` Funktion und den String-Funktionen `TO_LOWER` und `TO_UPPER`. Es zeigt, wie man bedingt eine String-Transformation durchführt, indem man den gesamten String durch seine Großbuchstabenversion ersetzt, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist. Die Verwendung von `REPLACE` mit `old = to_lower( iv_original_text )` und `new = to_upper( iv_original_text )` ist eine elegante Methode, um die Groß-/Kleinschreibung des gesamten Strings zu ändern. Dies ist ein Merkmal von modernem ABAP 7.50+ für prägnante bedingte Logik und String-Manipulation.
keywords: REPLACE, COND, String Processing, TO_UPPER, TO_LOWER, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem komplexen String, der mehrere durch Kommas getrennte Werte enthält, den Wert 'UNKNOWN' durch den Wert der Konstante `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base`. Nutzen Sie dafür `SPLIT`, `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Splitten Sie den String, iterieren Sie mit `FOR`, ersetzen Sie bedingt mit `REPLACE` und fügen Sie die Teile mit `REDUCE` wieder zusammen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_complex_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_unknown_in_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_csv) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_complex_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_unknown_in_csv.
    DATA(lv_mmpur_base) = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base.
    DATA(lt_parts) TYPE string_table.

    SPLIT iv_csv_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_modified_csv = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_part IN lt_parts
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                   COND string(
                     WHEN to_upper( trim( ls_part ) ) = 'UNKNOWN' THEN lv_mmpur_base
                     ELSE trim( ls_part )
                   )
                 ELSE
                   |{ s },{ COND string(
                               WHEN to_upper( trim( ls_part ) ) = 'UNKNOWN' THEN lv_mmpur_base
                               ELSE trim( ls_part )
                             ) }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_unknown_in_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_unknown_in_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_complex_string( ).

    DATA(lv_test_csv) = 'Value1, UNKNOWN, Value3,UNKNOWN, Value5'.
    DATA(lv_mmpur_base_val) = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base.
    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = |Value1,{ lv_mmpur_base_val },Value3,{ lv_mmpur_base_val },Value5|.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_unknown_in_csv( lv_test_csv ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_csv msg = 'Replace UNKNOWN in CSV failed' ).

    DATA(lv_no_unknown_csv) = 'A,B,C'.
    DATA(lv_result_no_unknown) = lo_cut->replace_unknown_in_csv( lv_no_unknown_csv ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_no_unknown exp = 'A,B,C' msg = 'No UNKNOWN in CSV failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene String-Manipulation, die `SPLIT` zum Zerlegen eines CSV-Strings, `FOR` zur Iteration über die Teile und `REDUCE` zur bedingten Ersetzung und zum Wiederzusammenfügen verwendet. Innerhalb von `REDUCE` wird `COND` genutzt, um 'UNKNOWN' durch den Wert von `cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base` zu ersetzen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Programmierparadigma in ABAP 7.55+, das komplexe String-Verarbeitungsaufgaben in einer sehr kompakten und lesbaren Form löst.
keywords: REPLACE, SPLIT, FOR, REDUCE, String Processing, CSV, Constants, Functional Programming, cl_mmpur_constants

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Flugpreis (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugnummer (CONNID).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `MAX`-Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_price = nmax( max_price, <fs_sflight>-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = '472.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit `nmax` (oder `max` für nicht-numerische Typen) kann der maximale Wert einer Spalte effizient ermittelt werden, ohne explizite Schleifen oder temporäre Variablen.
keywords: REDUCE, MAX, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, MAXIMUM

Instructions: Finden Sie den längsten String in einer Liste von Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator und die Funktion `strlen`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_longest_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_longest_string
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_longest_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_longest_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_longest_string.
    rv_longest_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT longest TYPE string VALUE ''
      FOR  <fs_string> IN it_strings
      NEXT longest = COND string( WHEN strlen( <fs_string> ) > strlen( longest ) THEN <fs_string> ELSE longest ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_longest_string( lt_test_strings ).

Instructions: Finden Sie das späteste Flugdatum (FLDATE) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `MAX`-Aggregation für Datumsfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_latest_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_date,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_date.
    TYPES tt_sflight_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latest_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_latest_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_date.
    DATA lt_sflight_dates TYPE tt_sflight_date.

    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_dates
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_latest_date = REDUCE #( 
      INIT latest_date TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '00000000' 
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight_dates
      NEXT latest_date = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-fldate > latest_date THEN <fs_sflight>-fldate ELSE latest_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `COND`-Expression vergleicht die Datumsfelder direkt, um das späteste Datum zu ermitteln. Ein initialer Wert '00000000' stellt sicher, dass jedes gültige Datum als 'später' erkannt wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine 'Konfiguration' für ein 3D-Objekt in einer flüssigen Schnittstelle (Fluent Interface) aufbaut, die später von einem 3D-Viewer (wie `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer`) verwendet werden könnte. Die Konfiguration soll Parameter wie Farbe, Position und Skalierung setzen können.

CLASS zcl_3d_object_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_properties,
             color    TYPE string,
             pos_x    TYPE f,
             pos_y    TYPE f,
             pos_z    TYPE f,
             scale_x  TYPE f,
             scale_y  TYPE f,
             scale_z  TYPE f,
           END OF ty_3d_properties.

    METHODS set_color
      IMPORTING iv_color TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_3d_object_config.

    METHODS set_position
      IMPORTING
        iv_x TYPE f
        iv_y TYPE f
        iv_z TYPE f
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_3d_object_config.

    METHODS set_scale
      IMPORTING
        iv_x TYPE f
        iv_y TYPE f
        iv_z TYPE f
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_3d_object_config.

    METHODS get_properties
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_properties) TYPE ty_3d_properties.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_properties TYPE ty_3d_properties.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_object_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_color.
    ms_properties-color = iv_color.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_position.
    ms_properties-pos_x = iv_x.
    ms_properties-pos_y = iv_y.
    ms_properties-pos_z = iv_z.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_scale.
    ms_properties-scale_x = iv_x.
    ms_properties-scale_y = iv_y.
    ms_properties-scale_z = iv_z.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_properties.
    rs_properties = ms_properties.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( iv_min_price = '500.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).

CLASS zcl_value_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,

Instructions: Finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) den maximalen Flugpreis (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_max_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_max_price.
    TYPES tt_carrid_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_prices_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_carrid_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_prices_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_max_price_for_carrid) = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
        FOR  <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT max_price = nmax( max_price, <fs_group_member>-price ) ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_max_price(
        carrid    = ls_group_key-carrid
        max_price = lv_max_price_for_carrid
      ) TO rt_max_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_prices_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_prices_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_by_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_max_prices) = lo_cut->get_max_prices_by_carrid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_max_prices ).

    READ TABLE lt_max_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_max).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_max-max_price exp = '472.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_max_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_max).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_max-max_price exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_by_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_max_prices) = lo_cut->get_max_prices_by_carrid( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_max_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um Aggregationen pro Gruppe in internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Es ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und temporären Tabellen durch eine deklarative Syntax.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, MAXIMUM

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Preis unter den Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die ein bestimmtes Mindestdatum überschreiten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit `REDUCE` und `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_filtered
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_filtered.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                          WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate >= iv_min_fldate ).

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR  <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT max_price = nmax( max_price, <fs_flight>-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_max_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered(

      iv_min_fldate = '20240101'

    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination des `FILTER`-Operators zur Selektion relevanter Daten und des `REDUCE`-Operators zur Aggregation (hier: Ermittlung des Maximums) in einer modernen, funktionalen Weise. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, MAX, Combination, SFLIGHTS, MAXIMUM

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch die Methoden eines Objekts zur Laufzeit inspiziert (RTTI) und prüft, ob eine bestimmte Methode existiert. Dies könnte nützlich sein, um die Fähigkeiten eines generischen UI-Elements wie `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` zu überprüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und `GET_METHODS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_method_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_method_exists
      IMPORTING
        io_object    TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_method_exists.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_methods     TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>method_table.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        lt_methods = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method) WHERE name = iv_method_name.
          rv_exists = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_method_not_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_method_check( ).
    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_rtti_method_check( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_method_exists(
      io_object = lo_test_object
      iv_method_name = 'CHECK_METHOD_EXISTS'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_method_check( ).
    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_rtti_method_check( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_method_exists(
      io_object = lo_test_object
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_method_check( ).
    DATA lo_initial_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_method_exists(
      io_object = lo_initial_object
      iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Informationen über Objekte und ihre Komponenten (wie Methoden) zur Laufzeit zu erhalten. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für dynamische Programmierung und kann verwendet werden, um die Fähigkeiten von generischen oder unbekannten Objekten zu überprüfen, bevor man versucht, mit ihnen zu interagieren. Dies ist besonders relevant für komplexe Framework-Objekte wie `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer`, deren Schnittstelle man dynamisch anpassen möchte.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Object Inspection, cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer (conceptual), CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern (CONNID) aus der Tabelle `sflight` enthält, getrennt durch ein Komma.

CLASS zcl_red_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_price = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_distinct_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_carrier_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_red_distinct_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carrier_count.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(distinct_carriers) = REDUCE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
        INIT result = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT result = INSERT flight-carrid INTO TABLE result.

    rv_count = lines( distinct_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) die Summe ihrer Flugpreise (PRICE) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine Hash-Tabelle, um die Summen pro Fluggesellschaft zu akkumulieren. Nutzen Sie `LET` und `OPTIONAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_red_carrid_price_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_price_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_total_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_price_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_carrid_price_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_total_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_prices = REDUCE tt_carrier_price_map(
        INIT map = VALUE tt_carrier_price_map( )
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        LET current_price = map[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-total_price OPTIONAL
        IN
        NEXT map = VALUE tt_carrier_price_map(
            map
            ( carrid = flight-carrid total_price = current_price + flight-price ) ) ).

CLASS zcl_red_nested_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_red_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             sum_price TYPE sflight-price,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_average_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_red_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_average_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_stats) = REDUCE tt_carrier_stats_map(
        INIT map = VALUE tt_carrier_stats_map( )
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        LET current_entry = map[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ] OPTIONAL
        IN
        NEXT map = VALUE tt_carrier_stats_map(
            map
            ( carrid = flight-carrid
              sum_price = current_entry-sum_price + flight-price
              count = current_entry-count + 1 ) ) ).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE tt_carrier_avg_price(
        FOR stat IN lt_stats
        ( carrid = stat-carrid
          average_price = COND #( WHEN stat-count > 0 THEN stat-sum_price / stat-count ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (SUM(SEATSCC + SEATBC + SEATFC)) für alle Flüge in `sflights`. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatscc + ls_sflight-seatbc + ls_sflight-seatfc ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rv_total_seats
        name  = 'Total Seats'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_sort_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( lt_sflights SORTED BY carrid ASCENDING fldate DESCENDING ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_sorted_flights
        name  = 'Sorted Flights'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->sort_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    DATA ls_prev_flight LIKE LINE OF lt_result.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_current_flight).
      IF sy-tabix = 1.
        ls_prev_flight = ls_current_flight.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_current_flight-carrid < ls_prev_flight-carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Sorting by carrid is incorrect' ).
      ELSE IF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_prev_flight-carrid.
        IF ls_current_flight-fldate > ls_prev_flight-fldate.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Sorting by fldate is incorrect for same carrid' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      ls_prev_flight = ls_current_flight.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SORTED BY`-Zusatz im `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine direkte Sortierung beim Erstellen einer neuen internen Tabelle. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um sortierte Daten zu erhalten, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren oder eine separate `SORT`-Anweisung zu verwenden.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_grouped_counts
        name  = 'Flights per Carrier'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen 'Inner Join' zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch, um die Fluggesellschaftsnamen zu den Flügen hinzuzufügen. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und `LET` für den Join.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS join_flights_with_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_flight_with_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_flights_with_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    DATA(lt_scarr_h) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF scarr
                       FROM lt_scarr
                       ( KEY carrid ).

    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              LET ls_scarr = lt_scarr_h[ KEY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] IN
                              ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                carrname = ls_scarr-carrname
                                connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_joined_data
        name  = 'Joined Flights'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_flights_with_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_flights_with_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->join_flights_with_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_joined>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrname should not be initial after join' act = <fs_first_joined>-carrname ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein 'Inner Join' zwischen internen Tabellen kann effizient mit dem `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE` implementiert werden. Durch die Verwendung einer Hashed Table für die Nachschlagetabelle (`lt_scarr_h`) wird die Performance bei großen Datenmengen optimiert. Der `LET`-Ausdruck verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, STANDARD TABLE, HASHED TABLE, Joining, LET, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der Economy-Sitze (`seatscc`) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' in einer Kopie der `sflights`-Tabelle um 10. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatscc  TYPE sflight-seatscc,
             seatbc   TYPE sflight-seatbc,
             seatfc   TYPE sflight-seatfc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_lh_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_lh_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatscc, seatbc, seatfc
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'
                                             THEN VALUE #( ls_flight-carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                           connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                           fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                                           seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc
                                                           seatscc = ls_flight-seatscc + 10
                                                           seatbc = ls_flight-seatbc
                                                           seatfc = ls_flight-seatfc ) 
                                             ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_modified_flights
        name  = 'Modified LH Flights'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_lh_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_lh_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->increase_lh_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    DATA lv_original_seatscc TYPE sflight-seatscc.
    SELECT SINGLE seatscc FROM sflight INTO lv_original_seatscc WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_modified_lh_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Seatscc for LH flight should be increased by 10' act = ls_modified_lh_flight-seatscc exp = lv_original_seatscc + 10 ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH flight 0400 not found in modified table' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip( msg = 'Test data (LH 0400) not found in sflight, skipping specific assertion.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Operator, `VALUE` und dem `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und bedingte Modifikation von Tabellenzeilen beim Erstellen einer neuen Tabelle. Dies ist eine funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, STANDARD TABLE, Data Modification, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf `carrid` und `connid`. Prüfen Sie, ob der Eintrag existiert. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und den direkten Tabellenzeilenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        is_key          TYPE ty_sflight_key
      EXPORTING
        ev_found        TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ] ).
      rs_flight = lt_sflights[ carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid ].
      ev_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      ev_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rs_flight
        name  = 'Flight Details'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = ev_found
        name  = 'Flight Found'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_sflight( ).
    DATA ls_key TYPE zcl_read_sflight=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_key-connid = '0400'.

    DATA lv_found TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( EXPORTING is_key = ls_key IMPORTING ev_found = lv_found ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight should be found' act = lv_found exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should match' act = ls_result-carrid exp = ls_key-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid should match' act = ls_result-connid exp = ls_key-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Cityfrom should not be initial' act = ls_result-cityfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_sflight( ).
    DATA ls_key TYPE zcl_read_sflight=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_key-carrid = 'XX'.
    ls_key-connid = '9999'.

    DATA lv_found TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( EXPORTING is_key = ls_key IMPORTING ev_found = lv_found ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight should not be found' act = lv_found exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result structure should be initial' act = ls_result-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der direkte Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen mit `itab[ key ]` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um einzelne Einträge zu lesen. `LINE_EXISTS` bietet eine typsichere Möglichkeit zu prüfen, ob ein Eintrag existiert, bevor darauf zugegriffen wird, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, TABLE_LINE, STANDARD TABLE, Data Access, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die `sflights`-Tabelle und geben Sie nur jeden zweiten Flug aus, zusammen mit seinem Index. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` und `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_line_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_index,
             index    TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_index.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_index TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_index WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_every_second_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_index.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_line_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_every_second_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0. " Every second flight
        APPEND VALUE #( index = sy-tabix
                        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                        fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) TO rt_processed_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_processed_flights
        name  = 'Every Second Flight with Index'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_every_second_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_every_second_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_line_index( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_every_second_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result count should be roughly half of total' act = ( lines( lt_result ) >= lv_count / 2 - 1 AND lines( lt_result ) <= lv_count / 2 + 1 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_with_index>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Index should be an even number' act = ( <fs_flight_with_index>-index MOD 2 = 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT` und `sy-tabix` ist eine klassische, aber immer noch relevante Methode zur iterativen Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um bedingt auf Zeilen zuzugreifen und deren Index zu nutzen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen. Wenn der `carrid` 'AA' ist, setzen Sie den `connid` auf '0001', ansonsten behalten Sie den ursprünglichen `connid` bei. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator innerhalb von `VALUE #( FOR ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_table_pop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_conditional_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_conditional_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_table_pop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_conditional_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_conditional_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' THEN '0001' ELSE ls_flight-connid ) 
                                        fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_conditional_flights
        name  = 'Conditional Flights'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_conditional_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_conditional_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_table_pop( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->create_conditional_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid for AA flight should be 0001' act = ls_aa_flight-connid exp = '0001' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip( msg = 'No AA flights found in sflight, skipping specific assertion.' ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA lv_original_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
      SELECT SINGLE connid FROM sflight INTO lv_original_connid WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = ls_lh_flight-connid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid for LH flight should be original' act = ls_lh_flight-connid exp = lv_original_connid ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip( msg = 'No LH flights found in sflight, skipping specific assertion.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einem Ausdruck, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `IF`-Anweisungen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist dies ideal für die bedingte Befüllung oder Transformation von internen Tabellen.
keywords: COND, VALUE, FOR, STANDARD TABLE, Conditional Logic, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen. Weisen Sie basierend auf dem `carrid` einen 'Carrier Type' zu: 'European' für 'LH', 'American' für 'AA', ansonsten 'Other'. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator innerhalb von `VALUE #( FOR ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_table_pop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_type,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             carrier_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_type.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_type TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_type WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights_with_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_type) TYPE tt_flight_with_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_table_pop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights_with_type.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights_with_type = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                      connid = ls_flight-connid
                                      carrier_type = SWITCH #( ls_flight-carrid
                                                               WHEN 'LH' THEN 'European'
                                                               WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American'
                                                               ELSE 'Other' ) ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_flights_with_type
        name  = 'Flights with Carrier Type'
    ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die eine bestimmte maximale Belegung überschreiten, und zeigen Sie die Flugnummern an.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_display_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN sflights
        WHERE ( seatsocc > iv_max_occupancy )
        ( ls_flight )
    ).

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( ls_flight-carrid && '-' && ls_flight-connid )
    ).

    cl_demo_output=>display(
      EXPORTING
        data = rt_flight_numbers
        name = 'Flüge mit hoher Belegung'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aller Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis an.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_occupancy) TYPE i.
    METHODS display_total_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupancy.
    rv_total_occupancy = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN sflights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_total_occupancy.
    DATA(lv_total) = calculate_total_occupancy( ).
    cl_demo_output=>display(
      EXPORTING
        data = lv_total
        name = 'Gesamtzahl belegter Sitze'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( msg = 'Total occupancy should be greater than 0' act = lv_total exp = 0 ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie die maximale Belegung eines bestimmten Fluges aus der `sflights`-Tabelle mittels Tabellenausdruck und zeigen Sie diese an.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`[]`) mit `KEY` oder `WHERE` für den direkten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_and_display_max_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_occupancy) TYPE sflight-max_occ.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_display_max_occupancy.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid
                                                      connid = iv_connid
                                                      fldate = iv_fldate ].
        rv_max_occupancy = ls_flight-max_occ.
        cl_demo_output=>display(
          EXPORTING
            data = |Maximale Belegung für Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER }: { rv_max_occupancy }|
            name = 'Flugdetails'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_demo_output=>display(
          EXPORTING
            data = |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|
            name = 'Fehler'
        ).
        rv_max_occupancy = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
