Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierzahlen aller Flüge in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        payments TYPE s_payments,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_payments
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_payments) TYPE s_payments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_payments.
    rv_total_payments = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_payments
                                  FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-payments ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Entwurfsmuster, das die Abhängigkeiten einer Klasse über ihren Konstruktor bereitstellt. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, erleichtert die Testbarkeit (durch das Injizieren von Mock-Objekten wie im Unit Test gezeigt) und erhöht die Flexibilität des Systems, da die Implementierung der Abhängigkeit zur Laufzeit ausgetauscht werden kann. Die Verwendung von Interfaces (`zif_logger`) ist hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Interface, Testability

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Namen eines Typs (z.B. einer Struktur oder Klasse) als String entgegennimmt und eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen und Typen aller Komponenten dieses Typs zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_component_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
      END OF ty_component_info,
      tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_type_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_component_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_components.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).

    IF lo_descr IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_structdescr.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type->get_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Klasse `cl_abap_typedescr` und ihre Unterklassen (`cl_abap_structdescr`) sind zentrale Bestandteile. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Preise. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Operator in einer `FOR` Schleife mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        total_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_carrier_summary,
      tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                           GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid ASCENDING
                           ( carrid      = <fs_flight>-carrid
                             total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                                     FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP <fs_flight>
                                                     NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

AT NEW` Konstrukten erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feld sortiert, dessen Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit dynamischer Feldangabe und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id   TYPE i,
        name TYPE string,
        value TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    SORT ct_data BY (iv_field_name).

    " For more complex dynamic sorting (e.g., multiple fields, ascending/descending per field),
    " you might need to construct a dynamic WHERE clause or use RTTI to build a dynamic sort key.
    " The simple (iv_field_name) syntax is available for single field dynamic sort.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_sort_by_value FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_id.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'C' value = '3.0' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'A' value = '1.0' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'B' value = '2.0' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'ID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_name.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'C' value = '3.0' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'A' value = '1.0' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'B' value = '2.0' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-name exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-name exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-name exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_value.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'C' value = '3.0' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'A' value = '1.0' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'B' value = '2.0' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'VALUE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = '1.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-value exp = '2.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value exp = '3.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_table_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Expected exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Sortierung von internen Tabellen ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Anwendungen. Durch die Angabe des Feldnamens in Klammern (`(iv_field_name)`) im `SORT`-Statement kann das Sortierkriterium zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn der Benutzer die Sortierreihenfolge selbst festlegen kann oder wenn generische Verarbeitungsroutinen benötigt werden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, Internal Tables, Dynamic Sort, Field Symbols

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und stellen Sie diese Daten in einem Balkendiagramm mit `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` dar.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR GROUPS OF`-Ausdruck, um die Flugdaten zu aggregieren, und die Methode `SET_DATA_FROM_INTERNAL_TABLE` der Chart Engine.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count,
      ty_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_counts.

    METHODS display_carrier_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE ty_flight_counts(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE count
      ( carrid = flight-carrid count = count )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_carrier_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_flight_counts( ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
      parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Flights per Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_x_axis_title( 'Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_y_axis_title( 'Number of Flights' ).

    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table,
          ls_chart_data LIKE LINE OF lt_chart_data.

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_flight_count).
      ls_chart_data-x_label = ls_flight_count-carrid.
      ls_chart_data-y_value = ls_flight_count-count.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
      i_data_table = lt_chart_data
      i_x_axis_field = 'X_LABEL'
      i_y_axis_field = 'Y_VALUE'
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das basierend auf einer Bedingung unterschiedliche Datenreihen oder eine unterschiedliche Datenaufbereitung verwendet. Zum Beispiel, wenn die Anzahl der Flüge über einem Schwellenwert liegt, zeigen Sie eine spezielle Markierung an. Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die bedingte Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` bei der Datenaufbereitung, um je nach Bedingung unterschiedliche Werte oder Attribute zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_conditional_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        count  TYPE i,
        is_high_volume TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_flight_status,
      ty_flight_statuses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditional_data
      IMPORTING
        i_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_flight_statuses.

    METHODS display_conditional_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        i_threshold TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_conditional_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = VALUE zcl_chart_flights_by_carrier=>ty_flight_counts(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE count
      ( carrid = flight-carrid count = count )
    ).

    rt_data = VALUE ty_flight_statuses(
      FOR flight_count IN lt_flight_counts
      ( carrid = flight_count-carrid,
        count = flight_count-count,
        is_high_volume = COND abap_bool( WHEN flight_count-count > i_threshold THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_conditional_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_conditional_data( i_threshold = i_threshold ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
      parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( |Carrier Flight Volume (Threshold: { i_threshold })| ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_x_axis_title( 'Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_y_axis_title( 'Number of Flights' ).

    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table,
          ls_chart_data LIKE LINE OF lt_chart_data.

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_flight_status).
      ls_chart_data-x_label = ls_flight_status-carrid.
      ls_chart_data-y_value = ls_flight_status-count.
      IF ls_flight_status-is_high_volume = abap_true.
        " Example: Set a different color or style for high volume carriers
        " Note: CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN has limited direct styling per data point
        " This would typically be handled by adding separate series or custom rendering
        " For simplicity, we just demonstrate the conditional data preparation.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
      i_data_table = lt_chart_data
      i_x_axis_field = 'X_LABEL'
      i_y_axis_field = 'Y_VALUE'
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm mit mehreren Datenreihen. Weisen Sie den Datenreihen basierend auf einem Wert (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) unterschiedliche Farben zu. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die Farbauswahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator, um dynamisch Farben basierend auf einem Kriterium zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_colors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_chart_series_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        passengers TYPE s_seatsocc,
        color TYPE string,
      END OF ty_chart_series_data,
      ty_chart_series_datas TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_colored_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_chart_series_datas.

    METHODS display_multi_series_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_colors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_colored_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights. " Limit for demo

    rt_data = VALUE ty_chart_series_datas(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        passengers = flight-seatsocc,
        color = SWITCH string(
          flight-carrid
          WHEN 'LH' THEN 'BLUE'
          WHEN 'AA' THEN 'RED'
          WHEN 'UA' THEN 'GREEN'
          ELSE 'GREY' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_multi_series_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_colored_flight_data( ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
      parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Flights with Dynamic Colors' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_x_axis_title( 'Flight' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_y_axis_title( 'Passengers' ).

    " Add series dynamically based on carrier and color
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table,
          ls_chart_data LIKE LINE OF lt_chart_data.

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_flight_data).
      ls_chart_data-x_label = |{ ls_flight_data-carrid } { ls_flight_data-connid }|.
      ls_chart_data-y_value = ls_flight_data-passengers.
      " Note: CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN does not directly support setting color per data point
      " via SET_DATA_FROM_INTERNAL_TABLE. Colors are typically set per series.
      " For this example, we demonstrate the data preparation with color info.
      " A real implementation would group by color and add multiple series.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " For CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN, dynamic colors per series would require
    " creating multiple series and setting colors for each.
    " This example focuses on the SWITCH for data preparation.
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
      i_data_table = lt_chart_data
      i_x_axis_field = 'X_LABEL'
      i_y_axis_field = 'Y_VALUE'
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppierung, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        avg_occupancy TYPE f,
      END OF ty_avg_occupancy,
      ty_avg_occupancies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_avg_occupancies.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_data = VALUE ty_avg_occupancies(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        avg_occupancy = REDUCE f(
          INIT sum_occ = 0.0
               count = 0
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + member-seatsocc
               count = count + 1
          FINALLY = COND f( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_occ / count ELSE 0.0 ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_average_occupancy( ).

    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
      parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Average Flight Occupancy per Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_x_axis_title( 'Carrier' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_y_axis_title( 'Average Occupancy' ).

    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table,
          ls_chart_data LIKE LINE OF lt_chart_data.

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_avg_occupancy).
      ls_chart_data-x_label = ls_avg_occupancy-carrid.
      ls_chart_data-y_value = ls_avg_occupancy-avg_occupancy.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_internal_table(
      i_data_table = lt_chart_data
      i_x_axis_field = 'X_LABEL'
      i_y_axis_field = 'Y_VALUE'
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_struct_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
        cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
        currency TYPE s_currkey, "Different field
        date     TYPE s_date,    "Different field
      END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle, wobei Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit gemappt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_itab_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
        from_city  TYPE s_from_cit,
        to_city    TYPE s_to_city,
        amount     TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom   TYPE s_from_cit,
        destination TYPE s_to_city,
        price      TYPE s_price,
        currency   TYPE s_currkey,
      END OF ty_target_line,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_table_with_mapping
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_table_with_mapping.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source
      MAPPING
        carrid     = carrier_id
        connid     = flight_num
        destination = to_city
        price      = amount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transfer_table_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transfer_table_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_itab_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_itab_mapping=>ty_source_table(
      ( carrier_id = 'LH' flight_num = '0400' from_city = 'FRANKFURT' to_city = 'NEW YORK' amount = '1000.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transfer_table_with_mapping( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid      exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-connid      exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-cityfrom    exp = 'FRANKFURT' ). "Automatically corresponding
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-destination exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-price       exp = '1000.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel im `CORRESPONDING` Operator können Sie explizit Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zwischen Quell- und Zielstrukturen/Tabellen zuordnen. Felder, die nicht gemappt werden, aber gleiche Namen haben, werden weiterhin automatisch zugewiesen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Mapping, MAPPING

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine Zieltabelle mit Daten aus einer Quelltabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel, wobei nur übereinstimmende Felder übertragen werden. Neue Einträge sollen hinzugefügt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` und `USING KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_itab_using_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
        cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      ty_flight_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                        WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE ty_flight_table
      CHANGING
        ct_existing_flights TYPE ty_flight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_using_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights.
    ct_existing_flights = CORRESPONDING #( 
      BASE ( ct_existing_flights )
      it_new_flights
      USING KEY primary_key
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_itab_using_key( ).
    DATA(lt_existing_flights) = VALUE zcl_cor_itab_using_key=>ty_flight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' price = '1000.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'CHICAGO'  price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE zcl_cor_itab_using_key=>ty_flight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON'   price = '1200.00' ) "Update existing
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'DENVER'    cityto = 'MIAMI'    price = '300.00'  ) "Add new
    ).

    lo_cut->update_flights( 
      EXPORTING it_new_flights = lt_new_flights
      CHANGING  ct_existing_flights = lt_existing_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ]-cityto exp = 'LONDON' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ]-price exp = '1200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing_flights[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' ]-cityfrom exp = 'DENVER' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CORRESPONDING #` mit `BASE` und `USING KEY` ermöglicht das Aktualisieren und Einfügen von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle. Bestehende Zeilen werden basierend auf dem Schlüssel aktualisiert, neue Zeilen werden hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode für Massenaktualisierungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Key, USING KEY, BASE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse mit einer abstrakten Methode und implementieren Sie diese Methode in einer konkreten Unterklasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Klasse und die Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_animal DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string,
             make_sound ABSTRACT.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_animal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Animal'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dog DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_animal FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: make_sound REDEFINITION,
             get_name REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD make_sound.
    WRITE: / 'Woof!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Dog'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dog_sound FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dog_sound.
    DATA(lo_dog) = NEW zcl_dog( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_dog->get_name( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Dog' ).

    " To test make_sound, we would typically redirect output or check side effects.
    " For simplicity, we just ensure it can be called without dump.
    lo_dog->make_sound( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_dog ). " Ensure object exists after call
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Eine abstrakte Klasse kann nicht direkt instanziiert werden und dient als Blaupause für Unterklassen. Abstrakte Methoden müssen in jeder konkreten Unterklasse implementiert werden, was Polymorphie und eine klare Schnittstelle erzwingt.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Method, Inheritance, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse und eine Factory-Methode, um Instanzen von konkreten Unterklassen zu erzeugen.
hint: Die Factory-Methode sollte eine statische Methode in der abstrakten Klasse sein und die abstrakte Klasse als Rückgabetyp haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
    CLASS METHODS create_shape
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
        iv_param1 TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
        iv_param2 TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_shape) TYPE REF TO zcl_shape.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_shape.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'CIRCLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = iv_param1 ).
      WHEN 'RECTANGLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = iv_param1 iv_width = iv_param2 ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle error or return initial
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width  TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width  = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shape_factory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shape_factory.
    DATA(lo_circle) = zcl_shape=>create_shape( iv_type = 'CIRCLE' iv_param1 = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->calculate_area( ) exp = '314.1592653589793' delta = '0.0000000000001' ).

    DATA(lo_rectangle) = zcl_shape=>create_shape( iv_type = 'RECTANGLE' iv_param1 = '5' iv_param2 = '4' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_rectangle->calculate_area( ) exp = '20' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern, oft in Verbindung mit abstrakten Klassen, ermöglicht die Erzeugung von Objekten, ohne die genaue Klasse im Voraus kennen zu müssen. Die abstrakte Klasse definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle, während die Factory-Methode die Instanziierung der konkreten Unterklassen übernimmt.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Factory Method, Design Pattern, Polymorphism

Instructions: Zeigen Sie den Unterschied zwischen einer abstrakten Klasse und einem Interface, indem Sie eine gemeinsame Funktionalität in der abstrakten Klasse bereitstellen und spezifische Implementierungen in den Unterklassen fordern.
hint: Abstrakte Klassen können Implementierungen enthalten, Interfaces nur Signaturen. Eine Klasse kann nur von einer abstrakten Klasse erben, aber mehrere Interfaces implementieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_log_formatter PUBLIC.
  METHODS format_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_raw_message TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_log_formatter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_log_formatter~format_message.
    rv_formatted_message = |[INFO] { iv_raw_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string.
    METHODS write_log ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_formatted_message TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_formatter TYPE REF TO zif_log_formatter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lv_formatted) = iv_message.
    IF mo_formatter IS BOUND.
      lv_formatted = mo_formatter->format_message( iv_raw_message = iv_message ).
    ENDIF.
    write_log( iv_formatted_message = lv_formatted ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_logger FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_formatter TYPE REF TO zif_log_formatter OPTIONAL.
    METHODS write_log REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_formatter IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_formatter = io_formatter.
    ELSE.
      mo_formatter = NEW zcl_simple_formatter( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD write_log.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a file.
    " For demo, we just output to console.
    WRITE: / iv_formatted_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_file_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_logger.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_simple_formatter( ).
    DATA(lo_file_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( io_formatter = lo_formatter ).

    " We can't directly assert console output, so we check if the method executes.
    lo_file_logger->log_message( 'Test message for file logger' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_file_logger ). " Ensure object exists after call
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Abstrakte Klassen können sowohl implementierte Methoden als auch abstrakte Methoden enthalten, was die Wiederverwendung von Code in Unterklassen ermöglicht. Interfaces definieren hingegen nur eine Schnittstelle (Methodensignaturen) ohne Implementierung. Eine Klasse kann nur von einer abstrakten Klasse erben, aber mehrere Interfaces implementieren, was Flexibilität in der Design-Architektur bietet.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Interface, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Design Pattern

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern mit einer abstrakten Klasse, die einen Algorithmus-Skelett definiert und Unterklassen die Implementierung bestimmter Schritte überlässt.
hint: Die Template-Methode ist konkret und ruft abstrakte 'Hook'-Methoden auf, die in Unterklassen implementiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_data ABSTRACT.
    METHODS format_data ABSTRACT.
    METHODS output_report ABSTRACT.
    DATA mt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    " Template Method: Defines the algorithm skeleton
    fetch_data( ).
    format_data( ).
    output_report( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS output_report REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_data.
    " Simulate fetching sales data
    APPEND 'Sales Data Line 1: Product A, 100 EUR' TO mt_data.
    APPEND 'Sales Data Line 2: Product B, 250 EUR' TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_data.
    " Simulate formatting data
    LOOP AT mt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Strategieklasse für die Datenübertragung und verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` in den konkreten Strategien, um Daten dynamisch zu mappen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Strategie und `CORRESPONDING` für die Datenübertragung. Nutzen Sie `MAPPING` für spezifische Feldzuordnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_transfer_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        id         TYPE i,
        name       TYPE string,
        value_old  TYPE decfloat16,
        description TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        item_id    TYPE i,
        item_name  TYPE string,
        new_value  TYPE decfloat16,
        comment    TYPE string,
        status     TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_data,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_data ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_data_transfer_strategy FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transfer_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    " Simple corresponding: id -> item_id, name -> item_name
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING item_id = id item_name = name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mapped_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_data_transfer_strategy FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transfer_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mapped_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    " More complex mapping: id -> item_id, name -> item_name, value_old -> new_value, description -> comment
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source
      MAPPING
        item_id   = id
        item_name = name
        new_value = value_old
        comment   = description
      EXCEPT
        status " Exclude status from automatic mapping if it existed in source
    ).
    " Set default status for all entries
    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simple_transfer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mapped_transfer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_transfer.
    DATA(lo_strategy) = CAST zcl_data_transfer_strategy( NEW zcl_simple_transfer( ) ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_data_transfer_strategy=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value_old = '100.50' description = 'First item' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_strategy->transfer_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id   exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-new_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-comment ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mapped_transfer.
    DATA(lo_strategy) = CAST zcl_data_transfer_strategy( NEW zcl_mapped_transfer( ) ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_data_transfer_strategy=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value_old = '200.75' description = 'Second item' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_strategy->transfer_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id   exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-new_value exp = '200.75' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-comment   exp = 'Second item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-status    exp = 'PROCESSED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Strategy Pattern mit abstrakten Klassen und dem `CORRESPONDING` Operator. Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_data_transfer_strategy` definiert die Schnittstelle für verschiedene Datenübertragungsstrategien. Konkrete Strategien (z.B. `zcl_simple_transfer`, `zcl_mapped_transfer`) implementieren die `transfer_data`-Methode und nutzen dabei den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` für flexible und moderne Datenzuweisungen. Dies ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit zwischen verschiedenen Übertragungslogiken zu wechseln.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CORRESPONDING, Strategy Pattern, Dynamic Data, MAPPING, EXCEPT, Object Orientation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (occupancy) für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT seatsocc, carrid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE i = 0
                                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).

    rv_avg_occupancy = lv_total_occupancy / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in der `sflights`-Tabelle existiert und geben Sie dessen Index zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = LINE_INDEX( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_exists = abap_false.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_line_exists( ).

      EXPORTING

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) den Abflugort 'FRANKFURT' durch 'FRA' für alle Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `INTO` und `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_replace_in_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_cityfrom_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_replace_in_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_cityfrom_in_table.
    rt_modified_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                    ( ls_flight WITH cityfrom = REPLACE( val = ls_flight-cityfrom old = 'FRANKFURT' new = 'FRA' occ = 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_cityfrom FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_cityfrom.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_replace_in_field( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_tab_replace_in_field=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_cityfrom_in_table( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code verwendet den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und dem `WITH` Zusatz, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, in der das Feld `cityfrom` jedes Eintrags mit dem `REPLACE` Operator modifiziert wird. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und effiziente Art, Tabelleninhalte zu transformieren.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FOR, VALUE, REPLACE, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight`, die einen bestimmten Flugzeugtyp haben und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `WHERE` und `INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_connections
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connections.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, planetype FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype ) ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_connections.
    " Setup test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0001'.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' planetype = 'BOEING 747' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_filtered_connections( 'BOEING 747' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[ 1 ] exp = '0001' ).

    lt_connids = lo_cut->get_filtered_connections( 'AIRBUS A380' ). " Non-existent planetype
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_connids ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #` kann eine neue Tabelle direkt aus den gefilterten und gemappten Elementen erstellt werden, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Mapping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Wert ermöglicht (z.B. Wert setzen, addieren, multiplizieren).
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden die Instanz der Klasse selbst zurück (`ME->`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ). " (5+3)*2 = 16
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden können. Dies wird durch das Zurückgeben der aktuellen Objektinstanz (`ME->`) in den Methoden erreicht.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    " Setup test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' price = 100 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' price = 200 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0003' price = 500 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 300 ).

    lv_total = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'YY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 500 ).

    lv_total = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'ZZ' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen und führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_planetype.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, planetype FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rv_planetype = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-planetype.

             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_airlines) = lo_cut->get_sorted_airlines( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_airlines ). " Initial check
    IF lines( lt_airlines ) > 0.
      " Check if it's sorted by the key (carrid)
      DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE scarr-carrid.
      LOOP AT lt_airlines INTO DATA(ls_airline).
        IF lv_prev_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
            act = ( ls_airline-carrid > lv_prev_carrid )
            msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly'
          ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_prev_carrid = ls_airline-carrid.
      ENDLOOP.
      " Check for uniqueness (implicit with UNIQUE KEY)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lines( lt_airlines )
        exp = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR wa IN lt_airlines GROUP BY wa-carrid ( count = count + 1 ) )
        msg = 'Duplicate entries found in unique key sorted table'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und einem Abflugort (`cityfrom`).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SORTED TABLE` mit dem `FILTER`-Operator und mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_sorted_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Create a sorted table from the standard table
    DATA(lt_sorted_sflights) = VALUE ty_sflights_sorted_tt(
      FOR wa IN lt_sflights (
        carrid   = wa-carrid
        connid   = wa-connid
        fldate   = wa-fldate
        cityfrom = wa-cityfrom
        cityto   = wa-cityto
      )
    ).

    " Filter the sorted table
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sorted_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sorted_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_cityfrom) = 'FRANKFURT'.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
      iv_carrid   = lv_carrid
      iv_cityfrom = lv_cityfrom
    ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid   exp = lv_carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = lv_cityfrom ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that if there are entries, the table is still sorted
    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 1.
      DATA lv_prev_key TYPE zcl_filter_sorted_sflights=>ty_sflights_sorted_tt-key.
      LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO ls_flight.
        IF sy-tabix > 1.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
            act = ( ls_flight-carrid > lv_prev_key-carrid OR
                    ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_key-carrid AND ls_flight-connid > lv_prev_key-connid ) OR
                    ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_key-carrid AND ls_flight-connid = lv_prev_key-connid AND ls_flight-fldate > lv_prev_key-fldate )
                  )
            msg = 'Filtered sorted table is not sorted correctly'
          ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_prev_key-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
        lv_prev_key-connid = ls_flight-connid.
        lv_prev_key-fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator funktioniert effizient mit `SORTED TABLE`s, da die interne Sortierung für die Filterung genutzt werden kann. Die Kombination ermöglicht eine performante und lesbare Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FILTER, SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, Multiple Conditions, ABAP 7.40

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und eines bestimmten Abflugortes (`cityfrom`) aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_pass) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, cityfrom, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_pass = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie effizient, ob ein bestimmter Flug (`carrid`, `connid`, `fldate`) in einer sortierten Tabelle von Flügen existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit der `KEY`-Option für sortierte Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_sflights_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sorted_flights TYPE ty_sflights_sorted_tt.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    mt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR wa IN lt_sflights (
        carrid = wa-carrid
        connid = wa-connid
        fldate = wa-fldate

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tt
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_table_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_filter.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Dynamic WHERE condition in FILTER is available from ABAP 7.50
    " The field name must be a component of the table line type.
    TRY.
        rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE ( iv_field_name ) = iv_value ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_access INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        " Handle error if field name is invalid
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_access
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel und demonstrieren Sie, wie Duplikate beim Einfügen behandelt werden (z.B. mit `TRY...CATCH` oder `CORRESPONDING`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` und versuchen Sie, Duplikate einzufügen, um die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_sorted_data_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data
                              WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_data
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING   cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.

    METHODS get_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_sorted_data_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE ty_sorted_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_data.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_data INTO TABLE mt_data.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    rt_data = mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_data EXPECTING CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_data_no_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_duplicates( ).
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_sorted_table_duplicates=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-text = 'First entry'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->add_data( ls_data ) ).

    ls_data-id = 2.
    ls_data-text = 'Second entry'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->add_data( ls_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_data() ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_duplicates( ).
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_sorted_table_duplicates=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-text = 'First entry'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->add_data( ls_data ) ).

    " Attempt to add duplicate
    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-text = 'Duplicate entry'.
    lo_cut->add_data( ls_data ). " This should raise CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_data_no_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_duplicates( ).
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_sorted_table_duplicates=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-text = 'First entry'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->add_data( ls_data ) ).

    " Attempt to add duplicate, but catch the exception internally
    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-text = 'Duplicate entry'.
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_true.
    TRY.
        lv_success = lo_cut->add_data( ls_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        lv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_data() ) exp = 1 ). " Still only one entry
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei `SORTED TABLE`s mit `UNIQUE KEY` wird beim Versuch, einen Eintrag mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel einzufügen, die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY` ausgelöst. Dies ermöglicht eine explizite Fehlerbehandlung für Duplikate.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, Duplicates, Exception Handling, CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Abflugort (`cityfrom`) und filtern Sie dann die Gruppen, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `FILTER` für die Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             cityfrom    TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             flights     TYPE ty_sflights_tt,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES ty_grouped_flights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_grouped_flights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_groups.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA lt_temp_grouped TYPE ty_grouped_flights_tt.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-cityfrom
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA ls_grouped_entry TYPE ty_grouped_flights.
      ls_grouped_entry-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_grouped_entry-cityfrom = ls_group_key-cityfrom.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        APPEND CORRESPONDING #( ls_group_member ) TO ls_grouped_entry-flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      ls_grouped_entry-flight_count = lines( ls_grouped_entry-flights ).
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO lt_temp_grouped.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Now filter the grouped table
    rt_grouped_flights = FILTER #( lt_temp_grouped WHERE flight_count > iv_min_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_by( ).
    DATA(lv_min_flights) = 2. " Filter groups with more than 2 flights

    DATA(lt_filtered_groups) = lo_cut->get_filtered_groups( iv_min_flights = lv_min_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_groups INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_group-flight_count > lv_min_flights )
        msg = 'Group should have more flights than minimum'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that if there are entries, the grouping is correct (e.g., all flights in a group have the same carrid/cityfrom)
    IF lines( lt_filtered_groups ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_filtered_groups INTO ls_group.
        DATA(lv_first_carrid) = ls_group-flights[ 1 ]-carrid.
        DATA(lv_first_cityfrom) = ls_group-flights[ 1 ]-cityfrom.
        LOOP AT ls_group-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid   exp = lv_first_carrid ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = lv_first_cityfrom ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.50+) mit dem `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Datenaggregation und anschließende Filterung der resultierenden Gruppen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, komplexe Gruppierungs- und Filteranforderungen zu lösen.
keywords: GROUP BY, FILTER, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flügen und aktualisieren Sie effizient einen Eintrag basierend auf dem Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `INDEX` oder `KEY` für sortierte Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_new_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING   cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_sflights_sorted_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR wa IN lt_sflights ( carrid = wa-carrid connid = wa-connid fldate = wa-fldate price = wa-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA ls_flight_to_update TYPE ty_sflight.
    ls_flight_to_update = is_flight_key.
    ls_flight_to_update-price = iv_new_price.

    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM ls_flight_to_update.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight.
    rs_flight = mt_flights[ KEY primary_key
                            carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                            connid = is_flight_key-connid
                            fldate = is_flight_key-fldate ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_update_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.

    DATA ls_test_key TYPE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>ty_sflight.
    DATA lv_new_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE '123.45'.

    " Get an existing flight to update
    TRY.
        ls_test_key = lo_cut->get_flight( VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " If no such flight exists, insert one for testing
        ls_test_key-carrid = 'LH'.
        ls_test_key-connid = '0400'.
        ls_test_key-fldate = sy-datum.
        ls_test_key-price = '100.00'.

    ENDTRY.

      act = lo_cut->update_flight_price( is_flight_key = ls_test_key iv_new_price = lv_new_price )
      msg = 'Update of existing flight should be successful'

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight( ls_test_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = lv_new_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflight`) nach Flügen, deren Abflugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, und verwenden Sie dabei String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer Datumsbedingung und `String Templates` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_info
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_info.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate > sy-datum ).

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_future_flights
      ( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } von { ls_flight-cityfrom } nach { ls_flight-cityto } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_info) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_info( ).

    " Assert that all entries are for future dates
    LOOP AT lt_flight_info INTO DATA(lv_info_string).
      DATA(lv_fldate_str) = substring( val = lv_info_string off = 70 len = 10 ). " Extract date part (adjust offset/len if format changes)
      DATA(lv_fldate) TYPE sy-datum.
      TRY.
          lv_fldate = lv_fldate_str.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.

CLASS zcl_filter_in_itab_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_multiple_cities
      IMPORTING
        it_cities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-cityfrom WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tt.

CLASS zcl_filter_in_itab_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_multiple_cities.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter using an IN condition with an internal table expression
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom IN it_cities ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
