Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flügen und verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SORTED TABLE` mit `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_for_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_sorted_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_flight_count.
    TYPES ty_carrid_flight_count_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_carrid_flight_count_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_sflights_sorted_tt.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_for_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR wa IN lt_sflights ( carrid = wa-carrid connid = wa-connid fldate = wa-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_member IN mt_flights GROUP BY ls_group_member-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group_member-carrid,
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group_member NEXT count = count + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_for_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_counts ). " Initial check

    IF lines( lt_counts ) > 0.
      " Assert that flight counts are positive
      LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_entry).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_count_entry-flight_count > 0 )
          msg = |Flight count for { ls_count_entry-carrid } should be positive|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.

      " Verify a specific count if possible (requires known SFLIGHT data)
      " Example: If 'LH' has 5 flights in the test data
      DATA(lv_expected_lh_count) = 0.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' UP TO 20 ROWS INTO @lv_expected_lh_count.
      READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_count_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_count_entry-flight_count
          exp = lv_expected_lh_count
          msg = 'Flight count for LH is incorrect'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.50+) mit `REDUCE` in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in einer sortierten Tabelle. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, SORTED TABLE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in vollen Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum bis zum heutigen Datum.

CLASS zcl_date_calc_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    rv_age = lv_current_date-jahr - iv_birth_date-jahr.

    IF lv_current_date-monat < iv_birth_date-monat OR
       ( lv_current_date-monat = iv_birth_date-monat AND
         lv_current_date-tag < iv_birth_date-tag ).
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc_age( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = sy-datum-jahr - 1990 - COND i( WHEN sy-datum < 'XXXX0101' THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ). "XXXX is current year
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_age_birthday_passed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc_age( ).

    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->calculate_age( lv_birth_date ).

    DATA(lv_age) = lo_cut->calculate_age( lv_birth_date ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet direkte Datumsarithmetik und bedingte Logik, um das Alter präzise zu berechnen. solution:
CLASS zcl_date_next_prev_workday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_workday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_factory_calendar_id TYPE tcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_workday) TYPE d.

    METHODS get_previous_workday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_factory_calendar_id TYPE tcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_prev_workday) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_next_prev_workday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_workday.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = NEW cl_hrpad_date_computations( ).
    TRY.
        rv_next_workday = lo_date_comp->add_working_days_to_date(
          iv_date   = iv_date
          iv_days   = 1
          iv_factory_calendar_id = iv_factory_calendar_id
        ).
      CATCH cx_hrpad_error.
        rv_next_workday = iv_date.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_previous_workday.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = NEW cl_hrpad_date_computations( ).
    TRY.
        rv_prev_workday = lo_date_comp->subtract_working_days_from_date(
          iv_date   = iv_date
          iv_days   = 1
          iv_factory_calendar_id = iv_factory_calendar_id
        ).
      CATCH cx_hrpad_error.
        rv_prev_workday = iv_date.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.

                                      fldate <= iv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren, Monaten und Tagen basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum bis zu einem Stichtag.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus direkter Datumsarithmetik und Methoden von `CL_HRPAD_DATE_COMPUTATIONS` oder manueller Logik für Monate/Tage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_age_detailed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_age_details,
             years  TYPE i,
             months TYPE i,
             days   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_age_details.

    METHODS calculate_detailed_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
        iv_reference_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_age) TYPE ty_age_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_age_detailed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_detailed_age.
    DATA: lv_years  TYPE i,
          lv_months TYPE i,
          lv_days   TYPE i.

    lv_years = iv_reference_date-jahr - iv_birth_date-jahr.
    lv_months = iv_reference_date-monat - iv_birth_date-monat.
    lv_days = iv_reference_date-tag - iv_birth_date-tag.

    IF lv_days < 0.
      lv_months = lv_months - 1.
      DATA(lv_prev_month_last_day) = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_last_day_of_month( iv_date = iv_reference_date - iv_reference_date-tag ).
      lv_days = lv_days + lv_prev_month_last_day-tag.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_months < 0.
      lv_years = lv_years - 1.
      lv_months = lv_months + 12.
    ENDIF.

    rs_age-years  = lv_years.
    rs_age-months = lv_months.
    rs_age-days   = lv_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Monate zwischen zwei Daten, wobei unvollständige Monate berücksichtigt werden (z.B. 20250115 bis 20250214 sind 0 Monate, 20250115 bis 20250215 sind 1 Monat).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus Datumsarithmetik und bedingter Logik, um die Monatsdifferenz präzise zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_months_between DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_months_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_months) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_months_between IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_months_between.
    IF iv_date_from IS INITIAL OR iv_date_to IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lv_years_diff  TYPE i,
          lv_months_diff TYPE i.

    lv_years_diff = iv_date_to-jahr - iv_date_from-jahr.
    lv_months_diff = iv_date_to-monat - iv_date_from-monat.

    rv_months = ( lv_years_diff * 12 ) + lv_months_diff.

    " Korrektur für unvollständige Monate
    IF iv_date_to-tag < iv_date_from-tag.
      rv_months = rv_months - 1.
    ENDIF.

    " Sicherstellen, dass das Ergebnis nicht negativ ist, wenn iv_date_to vor iv_date_from liegt
    IF iv_date_to < iv_date_from.
      rv_months = rv_months * -1.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Tag, Monat und Jahr aus einem Datumstring im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` mit Klammern `()` im Pattern, um Gruppen zu definieren, und greifen Sie über `GET_SUBMATCH` darauf zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_components,
             year  TYPE string,
             month TYPE string,
             day   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_date_components.
    METHODS extract_date_components IMPORTING iv_date_string TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rs_components) TYPE ty_date_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_components.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
        pattern = `^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$` " Captures year, month, day
        text    = iv_date_string ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_components-year  = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_components-month = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_components-day   = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->extract_date_components( '2023-11-24' ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Passwort mindestens 8 Zeichen lang ist und mindestens einen Großbuchstaben, einen Kleinbuchstaben, eine Ziffer und ein Sonderzeichen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` Instanzen für die einzelnen Kriterien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_password_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_password_strength IMPORTING iv_password TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_strong) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_password_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_password_strength.
    " At least 8 characters long
    IF strlen( iv_password ) < 8.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Contains at least one uppercase letter
    DATA(lo_matcher_upper) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = `[A-Z]` text = iv_password ).
    IF NOT lo_matcher_upper->match( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Contains at least one lowercase letter
    DATA(lo_matcher_lower) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = `[a-z]` text = iv_password ).
    IF NOT lo_matcher_lower->match( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Contains at least one digit
    DATA(lo_matcher_digit) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = `\d` text = iv_password ).
    IF NOT lo_matcher_digit->match( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Contains at least one special character (not alphanumeric)
    DATA(lo_matcher_special) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = `[^a-zA-Z0-9]` text = iv_password ).
    IF NOT lo_matcher_special->match( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_is_strong = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_capital_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reg_capital_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_capitalized_words.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate aller Zahlen in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle von Integern. Verwenden Sie dabei `COMPUTE` innerhalb eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_of_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_of_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_sq = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        sum_sq = sum_sq + ( number ** 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Division und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Filtern Sie die SFLIGHT-Tabelle nach der Fluggesellschaft und verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` um die Summe der Preise und die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln. Anschließend `COMPUTE` für den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct_type(
      INIT sum_price = 0.00 type sflight-price
           count_flights = 0 type i
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
        count_flights = count_flights + 1
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count_flights > 0.
      COMPUTE rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Währungsumrechnung für Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT durch. Gehen Sie davon aus, dass alle Preise in EUR vorliegen und in USD umgerechnet werden sollen (Umrechnungskurs 1 EUR = 1.08 USD). Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Multiplikation und `FOR` für die Transformation der internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit umgerechneten Preisen zu erstellen. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Multiplikation und achten Sie auf die Datentypen für Dezimalzahlen.

CLASS zcl_math_currency_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price_eur TYPE sflight-price,
             price_usd TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_eur_to_usd
      IMPORTING
        it_eur_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_usd_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_currency_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_eur_to_usd.
    CONSTANTS: lc_exchange_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '1.08'.

    rt_usd_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_price IN it_eur_prices
                                ( carrid    = ls_price-carrid
                                  connid    = ls_price-connid
                                  price_eur = ls_price-price_eur
                                  price_usd = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                                INIT lv_usd_price = 0
                                                NEXT lv_usd_price = ls_price-price_eur * lc_exchange_rate
                                              )
                                ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Schreiben von XML mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer`, insbesondere wenn ungültige Zeichen oder eine falsche Elementreihenfolge auftreten könnten. Erzeugen Sie absichtlich einen Fehler und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um Ausnahmen vom Typ `cx_sxml_error` abzufangen. Versuchen Sie, ein Element zu schließen, das nicht geöffnet wurde, um einen Fehler zu provozieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_faulty_xml
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_faulty_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    TRY.
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Root' ).
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Child' ).
        " Absichtlich einen Fehler provozieren: Versuch, ein nicht geöffnetes Element zu schließen
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Schließt 'Child'
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Schließt 'Root'
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Hier sollte ein Fehler auftreten, da kein Element mehr offen ist

        rv_error_message = 'XML generation successful (unexpected)'.

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Rabatt für einen Flugpreis basierend auf bestimmten Bedingungen: Wenn der Preis über 500 EUR liegt, gibt es 10% Rabatt; wenn er über 1000 EUR liegt, 15% Rabatt. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Rabattberechnung und `COND` für die bedingte Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `COND`-Ausdruck, um den Rabattprozentsatz basierend auf dem Preis zu bestimmen, und dann `COMPUTE` für die eigentliche Berechnung des reduzierten Preises.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_discount_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_discount_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_discount_rate) = COND p DECIMALS 2(
      WHEN iv_original_price > 1000 THEN '0.15'
      WHEN iv_original_price > 500  THEN '0.10'
      ELSE '0.00'
    ).

    COMPUTE rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( 1 - lv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Standardabweichung der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die mathematischen Operationen und moderne ABAP-Features für die Aggregation.
hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Durchschnittspreis. Dann verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` um die Summe der quadrierten Abweichungen vom Mittelwert zu berechnen. Anschließend `COMPUTE` für die Wurzel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_std_dev DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_std_deviation
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_std_dev IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_std_deviation.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      rv_std_dev = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_avg_data) = REDUCE struct_type(
      INIT sum_price = 0.00 type sflight-price
           count_flights = 0 type i
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT
        sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
        count_flights = count_flights + 1
    ).

    DATA(lv_average) = COND f(
      WHEN ls_avg_data-count_flights > 0 THEN ls_avg_data-sum_price / ls_avg_data-count_flights
      ELSE 0
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum_sq_diff) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum_sq_diff = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT
        sum_sq_diff = sum_sq_diff + ( ( ls_flight-price - lv_average ) ** 2 )
    ).

    IF ls_avg_data-count_flights > 1.
      COMPUTE rv_std_dev = sqrt( lv_sum_sq_diff / ( ls_avg_data-count_flights - 1 ) ). " Sample standard deviation
    ELSE.
      rv_std_dev = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein generisches XML-Export-Tool, das eine beliebige interne Tabelle in ein sicheres XML-Format umwandeln kann. Die Spaltennamen der internen Tabelle sollen als XML-Elementnamen verwendet werden. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) um die Struktur der Tabelle dynamisch zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components` für RTTI. Iterieren Sie dynamisch über die Komponenten und schreiben Sie diese mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generic_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_table_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data " Beliebige interne Tabelle
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sxml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generic_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_table_to_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ) ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_value> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Data' ).

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Entry' ).
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_writer->open_element( ls_component-name ).
          lo_writer->write_value( <fs_value> ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " /Entry
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_writer->close_element( ). " /Data

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Median der Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Division und moderne ABAP-Features für die Sortierung und den Zugriff auf die Daten.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Preise der Flüge. Wenn die Anzahl ungerade ist, ist der Median der mittlere Wert. Wenn sie gerade ist, ist es der Durchschnitt der beiden mittleren Werte. Nutzen Sie `SORT` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_median_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_median_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_median_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_median_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_median_price.
    DATA: lt_prices TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-price WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_prices WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_prices IS INITIAL.
      rv_median_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_prices ).
    DATA(lv_middle_index) = lv_count DIV 2.

    IF lv_count MOD 2 = 1. " Ungerade Anzahl
      rv_median_price = lt_prices[ lv_middle_index + 1 ].
    ELSE. " Gerade Anzahl
      DATA(lv_price1) = lt_prices[ lv_middle_index ].
      DATA(lv_price2) = lt_prices[ lv_middle_index + 1 ].
      COMPUTE rv_median_price = ( lv_price1 + lv_price2 ) / 2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jeden Flug aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Addition und `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` für die Gruppierung.
hint: Gruppieren Sie die SFLIGHT-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Innerhalb der Gruppe summieren Sie die Passagierzahlen mit `COMPUTE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_total_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_passengers,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_passengers.
    TYPES tt_flight_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_passengers) TYPE tt_flight_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_total_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid connid seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid
      ASCENDING AS GROUP_KEY.

      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT
          sum_seats = sum_seats + ls_grouped_flight-seatsocc
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_passengers(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        total_passengers = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_passengers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode zur Berechnung des Produkts aller numerischen Felder in einer internen Tabelle. Die Methode soll RTTI verwenden, um die numerischen Felder dynamisch zu identifizieren und `COMPUTE` für die Multiplikation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components` für RTTI. Filtern Sie die Komponenten nach numerischen Typen (z.B. `i`, `p`, `f`). Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `COMPUTE` für die Produktberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_generic_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product_of_numerics
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data " Beliebige interne Tabelle
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rf_product) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_generic_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product_of_numerics.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ) ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_value> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    rf_product = 1.0.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA(lv_line_product) = REDUCE f(
        INIT product = 1.0
        FOR ls_component IN lt_components
        WHERE ( ls_component-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
                ls_component-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
                ls_component-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float )
        NEXT
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS NOT INITIAL.
            product = product * <fs_value>.
          ENDIF.
      ).
      COMPUTE rf_product = rf_product * lv_line_product.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer gegebenen Zahl. Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE` für die Multiplikation und einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `REDUCE` für die iterative Berechnung.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Zahlenreihe bis zur gegebenen Zahl und verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` um das Produkt zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow EXPORTING text = 'Factorial not defined for negative numbers'.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 0.
      rv_factorial = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = 1
      FOR n = 1 THEN n + 1 UNTIL n > iv_number
      NEXT
        result = result * n
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbu_update_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle direkten Unterpakete eines gegebenen ABAP-Pakets nach ihrem Ersteller (Owner). Geben Sie eine interne Tabelle mit der Owner-ID und einer Liste der zugehörigen Pakete zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_subpackages` und eine `FOR ... GROUP BY`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_group_by_owner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_group,
             owner    TYPE syuname,
             packages TYPE cl_pak_package_queries=>tt_package_names,
           END OF ty_package_group.
    TYPES tt_package_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_subpackages_by_owner
      IMPORTING
        iv_package TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_package_groups) TYPE tt_package_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_group_by_owner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_subpackages_by_owner.
    DATA: lt_subpackages TYPE cl_pak_package_queries=>tt_package_names.
    DATA: ls_attributes  TYPE cl_pak_package_queries=>ty_package_attributes.

    TRY.
        lt_subpackages = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_subpackages( iv_package ).

        rt_package_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_subpackage IN lt_subpackages
                                     GROUP BY ( owner = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes( ls_subpackage )->owner )
                                     ( owner    = GROUP KEY-owner
                                       packages = VALUE #( FOR sub_pak IN GROUP
                                                           ( sub_pak ) ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_pak_package_not_found.
        " Return empty table
      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        " Return empty table
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den durchschnittlichen `SEATSOCC` (belegte Sitze) und aktualisieren Sie dann alle Flüge dieser Fluggesellschaft in `SFLIGHTS` mit diesem Durchschnittswert für `SEATSOCC`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY` zur Berechnung der Durchschnitte und dann `UPDATE` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbu_avg_seatsocc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_avg_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbu_avg_seatsocc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_avg_seatsocc.
    DATA: lt_avg_seatsocc TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF BEGIN OF STRUCTURE,
                             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
                             avg_occ TYPE s_seatsocc,
                           END OF STRUCTURE WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_occ
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_avg_seatsocc.

    LOOP AT lt_avg_seatsocc INTO DATA(ls_avg).
      UPDATE sflights SET seatsocc = ls_avg-avg_occ
        WHERE carrid = ls_avg-carrid.
      rv_rows_updated = rv_rows_updated + sy-dbcnt.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Pakete, die von einem bestimmten Benutzer erstellt wurden. Geben Sie eine Liste der Paketnamen zurück.
hint: Es gibt keine direkte Methode in `cl_pak_package_queries` dafür. Sie müssen möglicherweise alle Pakete abrufen und dann filtern oder eine andere Quelle nutzen. Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, dass `get_package_attributes` verwendet wird, um den Owner zu überprüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_by_owner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_packages_by_owner
      IMPORTING
        iv_owner TYPE syuname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_packages) TYPE cl_pak_package_queries=>tt_package_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_by_owner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_packages_by_owner.
    " This is a simplified example. In a real scenario, querying TADIR or DD02L might be more efficient.
    " For demonstration, we iterate over a hypothetical list of packages.
    DATA(lt_all_packages) = VALUE cl_pak_package_queries=>tt_package_names(
      ( 'SABAP_DEMOS' )
      ( 'ZLOCAL' )
      ( 'Z_MY_PACKAGE' )
      ( 'Z_OTHER_PACKAGE' )
    ).

    rt_packages = VALUE #( FOR ls_package IN lt_all_packages
                           LET lv_owner = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes( ls_package )->owner IN
                           WHERE ( lv_owner = iv_owner )
                           ( ls_package ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `FLDATE` (Flugdatum) für eine Liste von Flügen in `SFLIGHTS` auf ein neues Datum. Die Liste der zu aktualisierenden Flüge wird als interne Tabelle von Primärschlüsseln bereitgestellt.

CLASS zcl_dbu_update_fldate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
        iv_new_fldate  TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbu_update_fldate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_dates.
    UPDATE sflights SET fldate = iv_new_fldate
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_flight_keys
      WHERE carrid = it_flight_keys-carrid
        AND connid = it_flight_keys-connid
        AND fldate = it_flight_keys-fldate.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_sub_super DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_super_package,
             package     TYPE devclass,
             superpackage TYPE devclass,
           END OF ty_sub_super_package.
    TYPES tt_sub_super_packages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sub_super_package WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sub_and_super_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sub_super_packages) TYPE tt_sub_super_packages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_sub_super IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sub_and_super_packages.
    DATA(lt_subpackages) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_subpackages( iv_package ).

    rt_sub_super_packages = VALUE #( FOR ls_subpackage IN lt_subpackages
                                     LET lv_superpackage = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_superpackage( ls_subpackage ) IN
                                     ( package = ls_subpackage
                                       superpackage = lv_superpackage ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_tstmp_to_local( ).

    " For a robust test, we need to know the system's local timezone offset.

    lo_converter->convert_utc_to_local(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_date exp = '20231124' msg = 'Date mismatch' ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_time.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_time_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_time_string) = '14:35:00'.
    DATA(lv_expected_time) = '143500'.

    DATA(lv_actual_time) = lo_parser->parse_time_string( lv_time_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_time exp = lv_expected_time msg = 'Time parsing mismatch' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_time.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_time_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_time_string) = '25:00:00'. " Invalid hour

    TRY.
        lo_parser->parse_time_string( lv_invalid_time_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_abap_timefm_error for invalid time string' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_timefm_error.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_detailed_diff.
    DATA(lo_differ) = NEW zcl_tstmp_diff_detailed( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = '20231124100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20231125123045.0000000'. " 1 day, 2 hours, 30 minutes, 45 seconds later

    DATA(ls_actual_diff) = lo_differ->get_detailed_diff(
                               iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp1
                               iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp2

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_diff-days    exp = 1 msg = 'Days mismatch' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_diff-seconds exp = 45 msg = 'Seconds mismatch' ).

    " Test with tstmp1 > tstmp2 (negative differences)
    ls_actual_diff = lo_differ->get_detailed_diff(
                         iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp2

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einen String unter Berücksichtigung einer spezifischen Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_timefm=>format_dt_tstmp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dt_tstmp_tz_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_dt_with_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_date     TYPE d
        iv_time     TYPE t
        iv_timezone TYPE timezone
        iv_format   TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dt_tstmp_tz_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_dt_with_timezone.
    DATA(lv_format_mask) = COND string( WHEN iv_format IS INITIAL THEN 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' ELSE iv_format ).

    rv_formatted_string = cl_abap_timefm=>format_dt_tstmp(
      date    = iv_date
      time    = iv_time
      tzone   = iv_timezone
      mask    = lv_format_mask
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_with_timezone FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_with_timezone.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_dt_tstmp_tz_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231124'.
    DATA(lv_time) = '100000'.
    DATA(lv_timezone_cet) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (+1h UTC)
    DATA(lv_timezone_est) = 'EST'. " Eastern Standard Time (-5h UTC)

    " 2023-11-24 10:00:00 in CET is 2023-11-24 09:00:00 UTC
    " So, 2023-11-24 10:00:00 CET formatted
    DATA(lv_formatted_cet) = lo_formatter->format_dt_with_timezone(
                                 iv_date     = lv_date
                                 iv_time     = lv_time
                                 iv_timezone = lv_timezone_cet
                               ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_cet exp = '2023-11-24 10:00:00' msg = 'CET format mismatch' ).

    " 2023-11-24 10:00:00 in EST is 2023-11-24 15:00:00 UTC
    " So, 2023-11-24 10:00:00 EST formatted
    DATA(lv_formatted_est) = lo_formatter->format_dt_with_timezone(
                                 iv_date     = lv_date
                                 iv_time     = lv_time
                                 iv_timezone = lv_timezone_est
                               ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_est exp = '2023-11-24 10:00:00' msg = 'EST format mismatch' ).

    " Test a conversion from one timezone to another implicitly via UTC
    " If we have 2023-11-24 10:00:00 CET, what is it in EST?
    " 10:00 CET -> 09:00 UTC
    " 09:00 UTC -> 04:00 EST (09 - 5)
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>dt_to_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        date  = lv_date
        time  = lv_time
        tzone = lv_timezone_cet
      IMPORTING
        tstmp = lv_utc_tstmp
    ).

    DATA(lv_est_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_est_time) TYPE t.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>tstmp_to_dt(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp = lv_utc_tstmp
        tzone = lv_timezone_est
      IMPORTING
        date  = lv_est_date
        time  = lv_est_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_converted) = lo_formatter->format_dt_with_timezone(
                                       iv_date     = lv_est_date
                                       iv_time     = lv_est_time
                                       iv_timezone = lv_timezone_est
                                     ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_converted exp = '2023-11-24 04:00:00' msg = 'Cross-timezone conversion mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `format_dt_tstmp` der Klasse `cl_abap_timefm` ist entscheidend, wenn Datum und Uhrzeit in einem bestimmten Zeitzonenkontext formatiert werden müssen. Sie ermöglicht die präzise Darstellung von Zeitpunkten, die nicht unbedingt der System- oder Benutzerzeitzone entsprechen, was für internationale Anwendungen oder die Integration mit externen Systemen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: Datum, Uhrzeit, Zeitzone, Formatierung, cl_abap_timefm

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Flugdatum. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_sflight_db)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_sflight = ls_sflight_db.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_read( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-carrid ). " Assuming no data for 20250101, adjust if needed

    " Example for existing data (adjust values if needed for your system)
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS INTO @DATA(ls_test_data).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_result = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( iv_carrid = ls_test_data-carrid iv_connid = ls_test_data-connid iv_fldate = ls_test_data-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = ls_test_data-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-planetype ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)` ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Inline-Deklaration der Zielstruktur. Das `@`-Zeichen vor den Variablen in der `WHERE`-Klausel ist ein Host-Variablen-Marker, der seit ABAP 7.40 SP05 obligatorisch ist und die Unterscheidung zwischen Datenbankfeldern und ABAP-Variablen klarstellt.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF, Inline Deklaration, Host-Variablen-Marker, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus einer bestehenden Tabelle filtern und transformieren. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `APPEND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`-Bedingung und `APPEND VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             value  TYPE i,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_original_item.
    TYPES tt_original_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_item,
             new_id    TYPE i,
             new_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_transformed_item.
    TYPES tt_transformed_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_original TYPE tt_original_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_filter.
    LOOP AT it_original INTO DATA(ls_original) WHERE active = abap_true.
      APPEND VALUE #( new_id = ls_original-id * 10 new_value = ls_original-value + 100 ) TO rt_transformed.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_transform=>tt_original_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 active = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 active = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 value = 30 active = abap_true )
      ( id = 4 value = 40 active = abap_true )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_and_filter( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-new_id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-new_value exp = 110 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-new_id exp = 40 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-new_value exp = 140 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...) WHERE` Syntax in Kombination mit `APPEND VALUE #(...)` ist eine moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten. Die `WHERE`-Klausel direkt in der `LOOP`-Anweisung filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen effizient, und `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die direkte Konstruktion und das Anhängen der transformierten Daten, ohne eine explizite Work Area deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: APPEND, LOOP AT WHERE, VALUE, Interne Tabelle, Transformation, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und fügen Sie das Ergebnis als einzelne Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `APPEND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `APPEND VALUE #(...)` mit einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_sum,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_sum.
    TYPES tt_flight_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_sums) TYPE tt_flight_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR flight IN ( SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid )
      ( flight )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_flight_sums.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-total_seats exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_append_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_raw_data.

  METHOD process_and_append.
    APPEND LINES OF
      VALUE tt_processed_data(
        FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data WHERE status = 'A'
        ( id = ls_raw-id,
          message = COND string(
            WHEN ls_raw-value > 100 THEN |Value { ls_raw-value } is high|
            ELSE |Value { ls_raw-value } is normal|
          )
        )
      )
      TO rt_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Flugzeugtyp und die Anzahl der belegten Sitze für einen bestimmten Flug aus SFLIGHTS. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert für den Flugzeugtyp und 0 für die Sitze zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(...)` und dem `DEFAULT` Zusatz für mehrere Felder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO @DATA(...) DEFAULT ...` für jedes Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_multi_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_details,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_details.

    METHODS get_flight_details_with_defaults
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_details) TYPE ty_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_multi_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details_with_defaults.
    SELECT SINGLE planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO (@rs_details-planetype DEFAULT 'N/A', @rs_details-seatsocc DEFAULT 0)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String von Zahlen auf und berechnen Sie die Summe der Zahlen mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `SPLIT` und konvertieren Sie die String-Teile in Zahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_reduce
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_reduce.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                             FOR <part> IN LINES OF lv_temp_string( SPLIT lv_temp_string AT ',' )
                             NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( <part> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lv_result = lo_cut->split_and_reduce( '5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->split_and_reduce( '' ).

CLASS zcl_gos_query_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_attachments.
    DATA: lt_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_gos_attachment_query=>ty_s_attachment_list.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String per Regex.
hint: Nutzen Sie `split` mit Regex-Objekt oder Workarounds in älteren Versionen, hier modern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    " Modern ABAP doesn't have functional REGEX split built-in simply like other langs yet without classes.
    " Using FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX as a workaround.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^,]+' IN iv_val RESULTS DATA(res_tab).
    rt_res = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_res IN res_tab
      ( substring( val = iv_val off = ls_res-offset len = ls_res-length ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_split FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_regex_split( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->split_regex( 'A, B,C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 1 ] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 2 ] exp = ' B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 3 ] exp = 'C' ).
    
    lt_res = lo_cut->split_regex( 'OnlyOne' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ 1 ] exp = 'OnlyOne' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Direktes Regex-Splitting als funktionaler Ausdruck ist in ABAP nicht so einfach wie in anderen Sprachen. Eine moderne Methode ist die Verwendung von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`, um die gefundenen Substrings zu extrahieren. Dies ist effizienter als manuelle Schleifen und `OFFSET` / `LENGTH` Operationen.
keywords: REGEX, SPLIT, String, FIND ALL OCCURRENCES, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der GOS-Anlagen pro Dokumenttyp für ein Business-Objekt und geben Sie die Ergebnisse als Hash-Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_count,
             doc_type TYPE so_obj_tp,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_count.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_attachment_count WITH UNIQUE KEY doc_type.

    METHODS get_attachment_counts_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_objtp TYPE gos_objtp
        iv_objky TYPE gos_objky
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_attachment_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_counts_by_type.
    DATA: lt_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_gos_attachment_query=>ty_s_attachment_list.

    " Simulated data for demonstration
    IF iv_objtp = 'BUS2000120' AND iv_objky = '0000000001'.
      lt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( doc_id = 'D1' doc_type = 'PDF' )
        ( doc_id = 'D2' doc_type = 'TXT' )
        ( doc_id = 'D3' doc_type = 'PDF' )
        ( doc_id = 'D4' doc_type = 'JPG' )
        ( doc_id = 'D5' doc_type = 'PDF' )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_attachments GROUP BY ( doc_type = ls_group-doc_type ) ASCENDING
      ( doc_type = ls_group-doc_type
        count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group NEXT c = c + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ doc_type = 'PDF' ]-count exp = 3 ).

Hier wird die Anzahl der Anlagen pro Dokumenttyp ermittelt, was eine effiziente Datenanalyse direkt im ABAP-Code erlaubt.

CLASS zcl_flight_index_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_flight_index_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_index.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX DATA(lv_index).
      APPEND |Index: { lv_index }, Carrier: { ls_flight-carrid }| TO rt_output.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur jeden dritten Flug aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einem Index-Zähler und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für den Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_every_nth_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_every_nth_flight IMPORTING iv_n TYPE i DEFAULT 3 RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_every_nth_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_every_nth_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 WHILE idx <= lines( lt_sflights ) WHERE ( idx MOD iv_n = 0 )
      ( lt_sflights[ idx ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise (PRICE) der ersten 5 Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Index-Zähler und einer `WHILE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_first_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_first_n IMPORTING iv_n TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_first_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_first_n.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 WHILE idx <= iv_n AND idx <= lines( lt_sflights )
      NEXT sum = sum + lt_sflights[ idx ]-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT so, dass für jeden zweiten Flug die Währung (CURRENCY) auf 'EUR' gesetzt wird. Nutzen Sie dabei funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einem Index-Zähler und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für den Modulo-Operator, um die Modifikation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_every_nth_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_every_nth_currency IMPORTING iv_n TYPE i DEFAULT 2 RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_every_nth_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_every_nth_currency.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 WHILE idx <= lines( lt_sflights )
      LET ls_flight = lt_sflights[ idx ] IN
      ( COND #( WHEN idx MOD iv_n = 0 THEN ( VALUE sflight( ls_flight EXCEPT currency ) currency = 'EUR' ) ELSE ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Filtern Sie dabei nur Fluggesellschaften, die in einer bestimmten Range liegen (z.B. 'AA' bis 'LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER`-Operator für die initiale Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grouped_flights_in_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_flights_in_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE sflight_carrid_t(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'AA' high = 'LH' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... INDEX idx` mit einer Hilfsfunktion zur Primzahlprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prime_index_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_prime_flight,
             index TYPE i,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_prime_flight.
    TYPES: tt_prime_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_prime_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_prime_index_flights IMPORTING iv_max_index TYPE i DEFAULT 20 RETURNING VALUE(rt_prime_flights) TYPE tt_prime_flight.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS is_prime IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_prime) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prime_index_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_prime_index_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_prime_flights = VALUE tt_prime_flight(
      FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 WHILE idx <= iv_max_index AND idx <= lines( lt_sflights )
      WHERE ( is_prime( idx ) = abap_true )
      ( index = idx, carrid = lt_sflights[ idx ]-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    IF iv_number <= 1.
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number = 2.
      rv_is_prime = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_limit) = sqrt( iv_number ).
    DO lv_limit - 1 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_divisor) = 2 * sy-index + 1.
      IF iv_number MOD lv_divisor = 0.
        rv_is_prime = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_is_prime = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prime_indices.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_prime_index_flights( 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of prime index flights should be 4 (2,3,5,7)' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First prime index should be 2' act = lt_result[1]-index exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last prime index should be 7' act = lt_result[4]-index exp = 7 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_prime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_prime_index_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '1 is not prime' act = lo_cut->is_prime( 1 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '2 is prime' act = lo_cut->is_prime( 2 ) ).

CLASS zcl_transform_filter_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             fldate_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES: tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_transformed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.

CLASS zcl_transform_filter_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_fldate_range) = VALUE sflight_fldate_t(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '19950101' high = '19950131' )
    ).

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE tt_flight_short(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( fldate IN lt_fldate_range )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        fldate_text = |Flug am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaftscodes (CARRID) zurückgibt, die in der SFLIGHT-Tabelle vorkommen und deren erster Eintrag im Index ungerade ist. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax und vermeiden Sie `sy-tabix`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... INDEX idx` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für ungerade Indizes und `DISTINCT` für eindeutige Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odd_index_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_odd_index_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE s_carr_id_t.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odd_index_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_odd_index_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE s_carr_id_t(
      FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 WHILE idx <= lines( lt_sflights ) WHERE ( idx MOD 2 <> 0 )
      ( DISTINCT lt_sflights[ idx ]-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_all_flights_in_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_all_flights_in_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_flights_in_range.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE sflight_carrid_t(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'AA' high = 'ZZ' )

    IF ALL lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_indexed_flights_offset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_indexed_flight,
             sequence_nr TYPE i,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_indexed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_indexed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_indexed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_offset_indexed_flights IMPORTING iv_start_nr TYPE i DEFAULT 100 RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_flights) TYPE tt_indexed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_indexed_flights_offset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_offset_indexed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_indexed_flights = VALUE tt_indexed_flight(
      FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 WHILE idx <= lines( lt_sflights )
      ( sequence_nr = iv_start_nr + idx - 1,
        carrid = lt_sflights[ idx ]-carrid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, aber nur die ersten 100 Datensätze, und verarbeiten Sie diese in Paketen von 20 Zeilen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` mit `PACKAGE SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 20
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_flights_package TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights_package
      PACKAGE SIZE @iv_package_size
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

      " Hier würde die Verarbeitung des Pakets stattfinden
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + lines( lt_flights_package ).
      CLEAR lt_flights_package.
    ENDSELECT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_package( ).
    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_packages( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_max_rows = 50 iv_package_size = 10 ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt mindestens 50 Flüge für LH in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 50 ).

    " Test mit weniger Zeilen als max_rows
    lv_processed = lo_cut->process_flights_in_packages( iv_carrier = 'AA' iv_max_rows = 5 iv_package_size = 2 ).
    " Hier müsste man die tatsächliche Anzahl der AA-Flüge kennen, um zu asserten.
    " Für diesen Test nehmen wir an, es gibt mindestens 5 AA-Flüge.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `UP TO N ROWS` und `PACKAGE SIZE` ist ideal für die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen. `UP TO N ROWS` begrenzt die Gesamtanzahl der abgerufenen Zeilen, während `PACKAGE SIZE` sicherstellt, dass diese Zeilen in handhabbaren Blöcken an den Applikationsserver übertragen und dort verarbeitet werden. Dies reduziert den Speicherverbrauch und verbessert die Performance.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, SELECT, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Access, Performance, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_db_top_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_top_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY flight_count DESC
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_top_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_n_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_top_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_top_carriers) = lo_cut->get_top_n_carriers( 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_top_carriers ) exp = 2 ).
    " Annahme: 'LH' und 'UA' sind die Top-Fluggesellschaften in SFLIGHTS mit den meisten Flügen.
    " Dies kann je nach Datenbestand variieren, daher ist ein direkter Vergleich schwierig ohne Mocking.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Nutzen Sie dafür eine Subquery oder eine CTE (Common Table Expression), um die Top-N-Ergebnisse pro Gruppe zu erzielen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine CTE mit `ROW_NUMBER()` oder eine Subquery mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und anschließender Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_top_n_per_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_top_n_per_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    " Beispiel mit CTE (Common Table Expression) und Window Function ROW_NUMBER()
    " Diese Syntax ist ab ABAP 7.50 verfügbar und sehr leistungsfähig.
    WITH +ranked_flights AS (
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY carrid ORDER BY fldate, deptime ) AS rn
        FROM sflight
    )
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime
      FROM +ranked_flights
      WHERE rn <= @iv_top_n
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      ORDER BY carrid, fldate, deptime.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_top_n_per_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights_per_carrier( 2 ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Anzahl der Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft <= 2 ist
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE zcl_db_top_n_per_group=>tt_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( ls_flight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( ls_group ) <= 2 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Prüfen, ob die Gesamtanzahl der Flüge sinnvoll ist (mindestens 2 pro Carrier, wenn vorhanden)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) >= 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Common Table Expressions (CTEs) in Kombination mit Window Functions wie `ROW_NUMBER()` ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature von Open SQL ab ABAP 7.50. Es ermöglicht komplexe Abfragen wie 'Top N pro Gruppe' direkt auf der Datenbank auszuführen, was die Performance erheblich steigert und die Datenmenge reduziert, die an den Applikationsserver übertragen werden muss. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für moderne, datenbanknahe Logik.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, SELECT, CTE, ROW_NUMBER, Window Function, Database Access, Top N per Group, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_db_recent_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             latest_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_recent_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_days_back TYPE i DEFAULT 30
        iv_top_n     TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_recent_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_recent_carriers.
    DATA(lv_date_limit) = sy-datum - iv_days_back.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, MAX(fldate) AS latest_fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE fldate >= @lv_date_limit
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY flight_count DESC
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_top_recent_carriers( iv_days_back = 365 iv_top_n = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_summary ) <= 3 ).
    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_summary[ 1 ]-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_summary[ 1 ]-latest_fldate >= sy-datum - 365 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Inline-Variablendeklaration und -verwendung (`@lv_date_limit`) macht den Code sehr prägnant und lesbar. Dies ist ein effizienter Weg, um aggregierte Daten mit Top-N-Logik direkt auf der Datenbank zu ermitteln.

CLASS zcl_date_past_present_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_date_status TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: gc_past    TYPE ty_date_status VALUE 'PAST',
               gc_present TYPE ty_date_status VALUE 'PRESENT',
               gc_future  TYPE ty_date_status VALUE 'FUTURE'.

    METHODS get_date_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE ty_date_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_past_present_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_status.
    IF iv_date < sy-datum.
      rv_status = gc_past.
    ELSE IF iv_date = sy-datum.
      rv_status = gc_present.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = gc_future.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_file_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RAISING

CLASS zcl_write_file_cond IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_append) = abap_false.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` einen Status ('Teuer' oder 'Günstig') basierend auf dem Flugpreis enthält. Ein Flug ist 'Teuer', wenn der Preis über 500 liegt, ansonsten 'Günstig'.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator und `ELSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                  price  = ls_flight-price,
                                  status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-price > 500 THEN 'Teuer' ELSE 'Günstig' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_test WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 600 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = 750 )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' price = 500 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-status exp = 'Teuer' msg = 'LH0400 sollte Teuer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-status exp = 'Günstig' msg = 'AA0017 sollte Günstig sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-status exp = 'Teuer' msg = 'UA0001 sollte Teuer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[4]-status exp = 'Günstig' msg = 'DL1234 sollte Günstig sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Dateien und Unterverzeichnisse in einem angegebenen Verzeichnis auf dem Applikationsserver auf. Wenn das Verzeichnis leer ist, geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück. Andernfalls eine Liste der Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_content` und prüfen Sie, ob die Ergebnis-Tabelle `INITIAL` ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_dir_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dir_content_or_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_dirname TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_dir_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dir_content_or_message.
    DATA: lt_content TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_directory_content.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_content(
      EXPORTING
        iv_dirname = iv_dirname
      IMPORTING
        et_content = lt_content
    ).

    IF lt_content IS INITIAL THEN
      rv_output = |Verzeichnis '{ iv_dirname }' ist leer oder existiert nicht.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_output = |Inhalt von '{ iv_dirname }':{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
      LOOP AT lt_content INTO DATA(ls_entry).
        rv_output = rv_output && |  - { ls_entry-name } ({ ls_entry-type }){ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
