Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die als 'Teuer' gelten (Preis > 500). Wenn keine teuren Flüge gefunden werden, soll die Summe 0 sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `COND`-Expression, die `ELSE` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_expensive_flights_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_expensive_flights_sum.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + COND s_price( WHEN ls_flight-price > 500 THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern (FIELD 'CONNID') einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (FIELD 'CARRID') aus 'sflights' durch Komma und Leerzeichen getrennt enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Verkettung und dem `CONDENSE` Statement oder String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_flight_numbers = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ORDER BY connid )

    DATA(lv_expected_numbers) = REDUCE string(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (Schlüssel: 'CARRID') die Summe ihrer Flugpreise (Wert: 'PRICE') aus 'sflights' enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `VALUE #( )` um eine Hash-Tabelle dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_to_hashmap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_price_hmap TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_total_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE ty_carrier_price_hmap.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_hashmap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_total_prices.
    rt_carrier_prices = REDUCE ty_carrier_price_hmap(
      INIT hmap = VALUE ty_carrier_price_hmap( )
      FOR flight IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights )
      LET existing_entry = hmap[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = flight-carrid ]
      IN
        hmap = VALUE ty_carrier_price_hmap(
          hmap
          ( carrid = flight-carrid
            total_price = existing_entry-total_price + flight-price )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carrier_prices_hmap FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_prices_hmap.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_to_hashmap( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_prices) = lo_cut->get_carrier_total_prices( ).

    " Verify for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(lv_expected_lh_price) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_lh_price.

    DATA(ls_lh_entry) = lt_actual_prices[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_entry-total_price
      exp = lv_expected_lh_price
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).

    " Verify for another specific carrier, e.g., 'AA'
    DATA(lv_expected_aa_price) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO lv_expected_aa_price.

    DATA(ls_aa_entry) = lt_actual_prices[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_entry-total_price
      exp = lv_expected_aa_price
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AA sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `VALUE #( )` und dem `LET`-Ausdruck, um eine Hash-Tabelle dynamisch zu befüllen. Für jeden Flug wird geprüft, ob bereits ein Eintrag für die Fluggesellschaft existiert. Wenn ja, wird der Preis addiert; andernfalls wird ein neuer Eintrag erstellt. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art, Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren, ohne explizite LOOP- und MODIFY-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Hash Table, Map, VALUE, LET, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen URL-Parameter 'message' ausliest und diesen Wert als JSON-Antwort im Format `{"status": "success", "received_message": "..."}` zurückgibt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `get_form_field` und `set_cdata` mit JSON-Serialisierung (z.B. `cl_abap_unit_json` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_response DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             status TYPE string,
             received_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS handle_message_request
      IMPORTING
        io_request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        io_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_response IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_message_request.
    DATA(lv_message) = io_request->get_form_field( 'message' ).

    DATA(ls_response_data) = VALUE ty_response_data(
      status = 'success'
      received_message = lv_message
    ).

    DATA(lv_json_string) TYPE string.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = ls_response_data
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        lv_json_string = |{{"status": "error", "message": "JSON serialization failed: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }"}}|
    ENDTRY.

    io_response->set_cdata( lv_json_string ).
    io_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    io_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_method_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_expected_method TYPE string

CLASS zcl_http_method_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_actual_method) = io_request->get_method( ).
    IF lv_actual_method = iv_expected_method.

CLASS zcl_http_uri_path_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_request_uri_path
      IMPORTING
        io_request TYPE REF TO if_http_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_uri_path_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_request_uri_path.
    " get_uri_path is a more direct way if available and suitable
    " Alternatively, parse from ~request_uri
    DATA(lv_full_uri) = io_request->get_header_field( '~request_uri' ).
    DATA(lv_query_string_pos) = find( val = lv_full_uri sub = '?' ).

    IF lv_query_string_pos IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_path = lv_full_uri(lv_query_string_pos).
    ELSE.
      rv_path = lv_full_uri.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine SORTED TABLE und lesen Sie effizient einen Eintrag über den Primärschlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WITH UNIQUE KEY` und `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Populate with some dummy data for demonstration
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = '747' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight-planetype,
      exp = 'A380',
      msg = 'Flight details not found or incorrect'
    ).
    CLEAR ls_flight.
    ls_flight = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_flight-carrid,
      msg = 'Non-existent flight returned data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SORTED TABLE`s sind intern nach dem angegebenen Schlüssel sortiert, was einen sehr effizienten Zugriff über `READ TABLE WITH TABLE KEY` ermöglicht, ähnlich einem binären Suchalgorithmus.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, READ TABLE, Performance, Key

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine SORTED TABLE nach einem Kriterium und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Populate with some dummy data
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '737' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen fehlerhaften JSON-String und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH` für `cx_fdt_json_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS from_json_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_json TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD from_json_safe.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( iv_json ).
        lo_json_reader->deserialize_data( CHANGING c_data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        ev_error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
        CLEAR rs_data. " Ensure return structure is initial on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_from_json_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_from_json_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_from_json_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_error( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = '{"ID":1,"NAME":"Test"}'.
    DATA(lv_error_msg) TYPE string.
    DATA(ls_deserialized_data) = lo_cut->from_json_safe(
      iv_json = lv_json_input,
      EXPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg,
      msg = 'Error message returned for valid JSON'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_deserialized_data-id,
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'Valid JSON deserialization failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_from_json_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_error( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = '{"ID":1,"NAME":"Test"'. " Missing closing brace
    DATA(lv_error_msg) TYPE string.
    DATA(ls_deserialized_data) = lo_cut->from_json_safe(
      iv_json = lv_json_input,
      EXPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg,
      msg = 'No error message returned for invalid JSON'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_deserialized_data-id,
      msg = 'Invalid JSON deserialized data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deserialisierung von JSON-Strings kann fehlschlagen, wenn das Format ungültig ist. Durch die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit `cx_fdt_json_error` kann dies elegant abgefangen und behandelt werden.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Einträge in eine SORTED TABLE ein und demonstrieren Sie die automatische Sortierung und Schlüsselprüfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT` oder `APPEND` mit `SORTED TABLE`s. Beachten Sie, dass `APPEND` bei `SORTED TABLE`s eine Ausnahme auslösen kann, wenn die Sortierreihenfolge verletzt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_new_entry TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_current_data) TYPE tt_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_data = VALUE #(
      ( key_field = 1 value_field = 'First' )
      ( key_field = 3 value_field = 'Third' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_entry.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_new_entry INTO TABLE mt_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
        " Handle duplicate key, e.g., update or ignore
        MODIFY TABLE mt_data FROM is_new_entry.
    ENDTRY.
    rt_current_data = mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_entry_new FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_entry_duplicate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_entry_order FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_entry_new.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(ls_new_entry) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>ty_data( key_field = 2 value_field = 'Second' ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_entry( ls_new_entry ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Incorrect number of entries after adding new'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_check).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_check-key_field,
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Entry not inserted in correct sorted position'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_entry_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(ls_duplicate_entry) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>ty_data( key_field = 1 value_field = 'Updated First' ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_entry( ls_duplicate_entry ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Number of entries changed for duplicate key'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH TABLE KEY key_field = 1 INTO DATA(ls_check).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_check-value_field,
      exp = 'Updated First',
      msg = 'Duplicate key entry not updated'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_entry_order.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(ls_entry_2) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>ty_data( key_field = 2 value_field = 'Second' ).
    lo_cut->add_entry( ls_entry_2 ).
    DATA(ls_entry_0) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>ty_data( key_field = 0 value_field = 'Zero' ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_entry( ls_entry_0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_check).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_check-key_field,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Sorting order incorrect after multiple inserts'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SORTED TABLE`s behalten ihre Sortierreihenfolge automatisch bei. Beim Einfügen neuer Einträge mit `INSERT` wird die korrekte Position gefunden. Bei `UNIQUE KEY` wird eine Ausnahme `cx_sy_table_line_exists` ausgelöst, wenn ein Eintrag mit gleichem Schlüssel bereits existiert, was eine explizite Fehlerbehandlung oder ein `MODIFY` ermöglicht.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, INSERT, UNIQUE KEY, Exception Handling, Performance

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie Daten dynamisch, ohne die genaue Struktur zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen, unter Verwendung von `cl_fdt_json` und RTTI.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines Feldes in einer SORTED TABLE mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen in einem funktionalen Stil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY category.

    METHODS get_total_value
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_value.
    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_item IN it_items NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_reduce=>tt_items(
      ( category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( category = 'C' value = 30 )

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Er iteriert über die Tabelle und wendet eine Akkumulationslogik an, um ein einzelnes Ergebnis zu erzeugen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge in einer SORTED TABLE nach einem Feld und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die moderne Syntax `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_record,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_record.
    TYPES: tt_sales_records TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sales_record WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY region product.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_region_summary,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE i,
             product_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_region_summary.
    TYPES: tt_region_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_region_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_region
      IMPORTING
        it_sales TYPE tt_sales_records
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_region_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_region.
    LOOP AT it_sales INTO DATA(ls_sales_record) GROUP BY ( region = ls_sales_record-region ) ASCENDING.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_region_summary(
        region = ls_sales_record-region
        total_amount = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sales_record NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-amount )
        product_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sales_record NEXT count = count + 1 )
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_sales FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_summarize_sales_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_sales.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_test_sales) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_grouping=>tt_sales_records(
      ( region = 'East' product = 'A' amount = 100 )
      ( region = 'West' product = 'B' amount = 150 )
      ( region = 'East' product = 'C' amount = 200 )
      ( region = 'West' product = 'D' amount = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_test_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_summaries ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Incorrect number of region summaries'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH KEY region = 'East' INTO DATA(ls_east_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_east_summary-total_amount,
      exp = 300,
      msg = 'East region total amount incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_east_summary-product_count,
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'East region product count incorrect'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH KEY region = 'West' INTO DATA(ls_west_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_west_summary-total_amount,
      exp = 200,
      msg = 'West region total amount incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_west_summary-product_count,
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'West region product count incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_sales_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_sales) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_grouping=>tt_sales_records( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->summarize_sales_by_region( lt_empty_sales ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_summaries ),
      msg = 'Summaries for empty table should be empty'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und lesbare Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife können Aggregationen für jede Gruppe effizient berechnet werden. Für `SORTED TABLE`s ist dies besonders effizient, da die Gruppierung die vorhandene Sortierung nutzen kann.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Aggregation, REDUCE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie eine JSON-Konfigurationsdatei, die verschiedene Datentypen und optionale Felder enthält, in eine ABAP-Struktur und behandeln Sie fehlende Felder.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die ABAP-Struktur optionale Felder als initialisierbar definiert und verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_fdt_json_error` bei unerwarteten Formaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_config_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config,
             setting_a TYPE string,
             setting_b TYPE i,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
             optional_setting TYPE string OPTIONAL,
           END OF ty_config.

    METHODS load_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_config TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_config_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_config.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( iv_json_config ).
        lo_json_reader->deserialize_data( CHANGING c_data = rs_config ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        ev_error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
        CLEAR rs_config. " Ensure return structure is initial on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_load_full_config FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_load_partial_config FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_load_invalid_config FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_load_full_config.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_config_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = '{"SETTING_A":"Value1","SETTING_B":10,"IS_ACTIVE":true,"OPTIONAL_SETTING":"Extra"}'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-setting_b exp = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-optional_setting exp = 'Extra' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_config_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = '{"SETTING_A":"Value2","SETTING_B":20,"IS_ACTIVE":false}'.
    DATA(lv_error_msg) TYPE string.
    DATA(ls_config) = lo_cut->load_config(
      iv_json_config = lv_json_input
      EXPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg,
      msg = 'Error message for valid partial config'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-setting_a exp = 'Value2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-setting_b exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-is_active exp = abap_false ).

      act = ls_config-optional_setting,

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_load_invalid_config.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_config_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json_input) = '{"SETTING_A":"Value3","SETTING_B":"invalid"}'. " Invalid type for SETTING_B
    DATA(lv_error_msg) TYPE string.
    DATA(ls_config) = lo_cut->load_config(
      iv_json_config = lv_json_input
      EXPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg,
      msg = 'No error message for invalid config'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_config-setting_a,
      msg = 'Config should be initial on error'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `cl_fdt_json` kann JSON-Konfigurationen in ABAP-Strukturen deserialisieren. Optionale Felder in der JSON-Struktur, die in der ABAP-Struktur als `OPTIONAL` deklariert sind oder einen Initialwert haben, werden korrekt behandelt. Fehlerhafte JSON-Formate oder Typinkonsistenzen führen zu `cx_fdt_json_error`, die abgefangen werden sollte.
keywords: JSON, Deserialization, cl_fdt_json, Configuration, Optional Fields, Error Handling

Instructions: Entfernen Sie doppelte Einträge aus einer SORTED TABLE basierend auf einem Teil des Schlüssels und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken und `DISTINCT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `GROUP BY` und `CORRESPONDING` oder `VALUE` um die gewünschten Felder zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             user_id   TYPE sy-uname,
             action    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY user_id timestamp.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_user_action,
             user_id TYPE sy-uname,
             action  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_unique_user_action.
    TYPES: tt_unique_user_actions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_unique_user_action WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_user_actions
      IMPORTING
        it_log_entries TYPE tt_log_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_actions) TYPE tt_unique_user_actions.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_user_actions.
    rt_unique_actions = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_log_entries GROUP BY ( user_id = ls_group-user_id, action = ls_group-action ) ASCENDING
      ( VALUE ty_unique_user_action( user_id = ls_group-user_id action = ls_group-action ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_actions FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_unique_actions_empty FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_test_logs) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_distinct=>tt_log_entries(
      ( timestamp = '20251124100000.0000000' user_id = 'USERA' action = 'LOGIN' )
      ( timestamp = '20251124100100.0000000' user_id = 'USERB' action = 'LOGOUT' )
      ( timestamp = '20251124100200.0000000' user_id = 'USERA' action = 'LOGIN' ) " Duplicate
      ( timestamp = '20251124100300.0000000' user_id = 'USERC' action = 'LOGIN' )
      ( timestamp = '20251124100400.0000000' user_id = 'USERA' action = 'LOGOUT' ) " Different action for USERA
    ).
    DATA(lt_unique_actions) = lo_cut->get_unique_user_actions( lt_test_logs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_actions ),

    READ TABLE lt_unique_actions WITH KEY user_id = 'USERA' action = 'LOGIN' INTO DATA(ls_ua_login).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(

    READ TABLE lt_unique_actions WITH KEY user_id = 'USERA' action = 'LOGOUT' INTO DATA(ls_ua_logout).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_ua_logout-user_id,

    ).

  METHOD test_get_unique_actions_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_logs) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_distinct=>tt_log_entries( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_actions) = lo_cut->get_unique_user_actions( lt_empty_logs ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

explanation: Durch die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` mit dem `VALUE`-Operator kann man effizient und deklarativ eindeutige Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle extrahieren, basierend auf den Gruppierungskriterien. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` und bietet mehr Flexibilität.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators. Die Tabelle soll drei Einträge enthalten.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( ( field1 = val1 field2 = val2 ... ) ( ... ) )`
solution:

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( connid = flight-connid fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_sorted_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_carrier_name IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrname) TYPE s_carrname.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_carriers TYPE tt_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_carriers = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' carrname = 'Singapore Airlines' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrier_name.
    READ TABLE mt_carriers WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_carrname = ls_carrier-carrname.
    ELSE.
      rv_carrname = 'UNKNOWN'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine `SORTED TABLE` von Währungscodes und deren Beschreibungen. Nutze den `VALUE`-Operator zur Initialisierung. Implementiere eine Methode, die die Beschreibung zu einem gegebenen Währungscode zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( ( key1 = val1 ... ) ( key2 = val2 ... ) )` und den Tabellenindex `[ key = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_sorted_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency,
             waers TYPE waers,
             descr TYPE string,
           END OF ty_currency.
    TYPES tt_currencies TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_currency WITH UNIQUE KEY waers.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_currency_description IMPORTING iv_waers TYPE waers RETURNING VALUE(rv_descr) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_currencies TYPE tt_currencies.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_currencies = VALUE #( 
      ( waers = 'EUR' descr = 'Euro' )
      ( waers = 'USD' descr = 'US Dollar' )
      ( waers = 'GBP' descr = 'British Pound' )
      ( waers = 'JPY' descr = 'Japanese Yen' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_currency_description.
    TRY.
        rv_descr = mt_currencies[ waers = iv_waers ]-descr.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_descr = 'Unbekannte Währung'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Füge neue Einträge hinzu und ändere bestehende Einträge in einem Schritt mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und `BASE`.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( BASE <original_table> ( ... new entry ... ) ( <key_field> = <value> field_to_change = <new_value> ) )`
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_value_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS modify_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_value_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flights.
    DATA(lt_original_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      BASE lt_original_flights
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20251203' price = '300.00' ) " New entry
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' ) " Modify existing
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_modify_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_value_base( ).
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->modify_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_modified_flights )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Flüge vorhanden sein (2 original + 1 neu).'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_modified_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ]-price
      exp = '150.00'
      msg = 'Preis für LH 0400 sollte aktualisiert sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_modified_flights[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20251203' ]-price
      exp = '300.00'
      msg = 'Neuer Flug UA 0050 sollte vorhanden sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator mit der `BASE`-Option ermöglicht die Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, die auf einer bestehenden basiert, wobei gleichzeitig neue Einträge hinzugefügt und bestehende geändert werden können. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode zur Tabellenmanipulation.
keywords: VALUE, BASE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation, Atomic Operations

Instructions: Aggregiere die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einer `SORTED TABLE`. Nutze `COLLECT`.
hint: Deklariere eine `SORTED TABLE` mit dem Aggregationsfeld und dem Schlüssel. `COLLECT` fügt Einträge ein und summiert numerische Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_sorted_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_sum,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             passnum  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_sum.
    TYPES tt_passenger_sums TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_passenger_sum WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_passenger_sums RETURNING VALUE(rt_sums) TYPE tt_passenger_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_sums.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT VALUE ty_passenger_sum( carrid = ls_flight-carrid passnum = ls_flight-seatsocc ) INTO rt_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_passenger_sums FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_passenger_sums.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_sorted_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_sums) = lo_cut->get_passenger_sums( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_sums )
      msg = 'Die Tabelle der Passagiersummen sollte nicht leer sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sums[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA' " Annahme: AA ist die erste Airline in sflights und somit sortiert
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte AA sein (sortiert).'

    " Weitere Assertions könnten spezifische Summen prüfen, wenn Testdaten gemockt wären.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COLLECT`-Anweisung ist besonders effizient, wenn sie auf eine `SORTED TABLE` angewendet wird. Sie fügt nicht nur neue Zeilen ein, sondern summiert auch automatisch numerische Felder für Zeilen mit identischem Schlüssel. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode zur Datenaggregation, die die Sortierung der Tabelle beibehält.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, COLLECT, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Performance, sflights

Instructions: Entferne Duplikate aus einer Liste von Flugnummern, indem du sie in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit eindeutigem Schlüssel einfügst.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    TYPES tt_connids_unique TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_connid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES tt_connids_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_connids IMPORTING it_raw_connids TYPE tt_connids_raw RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_connids) TYPE tt_connids_unique.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connids.
    INSERT LINES OF it_raw_connids INTO TABLE rt_unique_connids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_connids FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_sorted_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_connids) = VALUE zcl_it_sorted_unique=>tt_connids_raw(
      ( '0017' )
      ( '0400' )
      ( '0017' ) " Duplicate
      ( '0050' )
      ( '0400' ) " Duplicate
    ).

    DATA(lt_unique_connids) = lo_cut->get_unique_connids( lt_raw_connids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_connids )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Flugnummern vorhanden sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_unique_connids[ 1 ]
      exp = '0017'
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte 0017 sein (sortiert).'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_unique_connids[ 3 ]
      exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Letzter Eintrag sollte 0400 sein (sortiert).'

Instructions: Erstelle eine `SORTED TABLE` von Fluggesellschaften und deren Namen. Filtere diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaften, deren Name mit 'A' beginnt, und transformiere die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschafts-IDs enthält. Nutze `VALUE`, `FOR` und `FILTER`.

CLASS zcl_it_value_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_carrids RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_value_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carrids.
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' carrname = 'Singapore Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'AZ' carrname = 'Alitalia' )
    ).

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrier IN FILTER tt_carriers( lt_all_carriers WHERE carrname CP 'A*' )
      ( carrier-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_value_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_it_sorted_value_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_sorted_flights.

      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20251203' price = '300.00' ) " New entry
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' ) " Modify existing

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights` und speichere das Ergebnis in einer Struktur. Nutze den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE #( INIT <result_var> FOR ... IN ... NEXT <result_var> = <expression> )`
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).

      act = lv_total_passengers
      msg = 'Die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere sollte nicht 0 sein.'

    " Ein spezifischer Wert kann nur getestet werden, wenn sflights gemockt ist.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob eine Summe gebildet wurde.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und einem Abflugdatum nach dem 01.01.2000. Geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'LH'
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate DEFAULT '20000101'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate )
                            ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                              connid   = flight-connid,
                              fldate   = flight-fldate,
                              price    = flight-price,
                              currency = flight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_fldate = '20000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming no AA flights after 20000101 in standard sflight data

    lt_result = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_fldate = '19900101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `VALUE #(` wird direkt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten und optional transformierten Daten erzeugt, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Preis aus `sflights` enthält, wobei der Preis in Euro umgerechnet wird (angenommen 1 USD = 0.9 EUR, 1 JPY = 0.007 EUR).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... ( VALUE #( ... ) )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_map_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_euro,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_euro.
    TYPES tt_flight_euro TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_euro WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_euro
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_euro.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_map_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_euro.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            LET lv_price_eur = COND #( WHEN flight-currency = 'USD' THEN flight-price * '0.9'
                                                        WHEN flight-currency = 'JPY' THEN flight-price * '0.007'
                                                        ELSE flight-price ) IN
                            ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                              connid = flight-connid,
                              price  = lv_price_eur ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_map_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_euro( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Find a flight with known currency and assert conversion
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_for_map_sflights=>ty_flight_euro( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_flight WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'. " Assuming this flight exists and has a price
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Assuming original price for LH 0400 is 471.00 USD
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '423.90' ). " 471.00 * 0.9
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE #(` und dem `LET` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine elegante Transformation von Tabellendaten. Der `COND` Operator innerhalb von `LET` erlaubt bedingte Zuweisungen, um den Preis basierend auf der Währung umzurechnen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, LET, COND, Internal Tables, Mapping, Transformation

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'LH'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).

CLASS zcl_for_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             count  TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_gui_custom_container_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_custom_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_custom_container_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_custom_container.
    " In einem echten Szenario wäre 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' der Name eines Custom Control Elements auf einem Dynpro.
    " Für dieses Beispiel wird ein Dummy-Name verwendet.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error     = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dynpro_dynpro_link = 5
        OTHERS         = 6.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der einzigartigen Fluggesellschaften in der Tabelle `sflights`, die Flüge mit einer Kapazität von mehr als 200 Passagieren anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_unique_carriers_high_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_unique_carriers_high_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE #( INIT count TYPE i VALUE 0
                         FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                         WHERE ( seatsocc > 200 )
                         BY flight-carrid
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`, die Flüge mit einer maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität von über 300 anbieten. Jede Fluggesellschaft soll nur einmal in der Liste erscheinen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... BY ...` und `REDUCE` mit `STRING_CONCAT_LINES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_capacity_carriers_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_capacity_carriers_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_csv_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( seatsmax > 300 )
      BY flight-carrid
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-carrid
                 ELSE s && ',' && flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH,UA' ). " Example value, adjust based on actual sflight data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... BY ...` und dem `COND` Operator, um eine kommaseparierte Liste von eindeutigen Werten zu erstellen. Die `&&` Operatoren für String-Verkettung und die `COND` Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung sind moderne ABAP-Features, die zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führen.

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Flugpreis in einer Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
      INIT max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_price THEN flight-price ELSE max_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Max price should not be initial' act = lv_max_price ).
    " Further assertions would require knowing test data, e.g., assert_equals( exp = '1234.56' act = lv_max_price ).
    " For simplicity, we just check it's not initial.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren und dabei den maximalen Wert in einer Zeile zu finden, ohne explizite Schleifen oder temporäre Variablen außerhalb der Anweisung. Die `COND`-Expression sorgt für eine kompakte Bedingungsprüfung.
keywords: REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den maximalen Flugpreis und die Anzahl der Flüge enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `MAX` in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_max_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_max_info.
    TYPES tt_carr_max_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_max_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_max_info) TYPE tt_carr_max_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw.

    rt_carr_max_info = VALUE #( "MAXIMUM"
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight_raw GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      (
        carrid    = flight-carrid
        max_price = REDUCE #( 
                      INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                      FOR member IN GROUP flight
                      NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN member-price > max_p THEN member-price ELSE max_p )
                    )
        num_flights = lines( GROUP flight )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_max FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_max( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Max price should not be initial' act = ls_first_entry-max_price ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Number of flights should not be initial' act = ls_first_entry-num_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF`-Anweisung in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird für jede Gruppe der maximale Preis mittels `REDUCE` ermittelt und die Anzahl der Elemente mit `lines()`.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der den höchsten Flugpreis und die zugehörige Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflight`-Tabelle anzeigt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_string.
    DATA: lt_sflight_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price.
    DATA: ls_max_flight     TYPE ty_sflight_price.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_prices.

    IF lt_sflight_prices IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT lt_sflight_prices BY price DESCENDING.
      ls_max_flight = lt_sflight_prices[ 1 ]. "MAXIMUM"
      rv_result_string = |Der höchste Flugpreis ist { ls_max_flight-price } { ls_max_flight-carrid }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_string = |Keine Flugdaten verfügbar.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_template_max( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result string should not be empty' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Should not be default message if data exists' exp = 'Keine Flugdaten verfügbar.' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'String should contain "höchste Flugpreis"' pattern = 'höchste Flugpreis' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine moderne und lesbare Möglichkeit, Strings zu formatieren und Variablen direkt einzubetten. Die Ermittlung des Maximums erfolgt hier durch Sortierung und Zugriff auf den ersten Eintrag, was für kleinere Tabellen effizient ist.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen in einem ALV Grid an, das in einem `cl_gui_custom_container` auf einem Dynpro eingebettet ist. Heben Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis hervor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container`, `cl_salv_table` und moderne ABAP-Syntax zur Ermittlung des Maximums.
solution:
* This example requires a Dynpro (e.g., 100) with a Custom Control element (e.g., 'CONTAINER_01')
* in the Screen Painter.
CLASS zcl_alv_max_highlight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flights_with_max
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynpro_number TYPE sy-dynnr
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_max_highlight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_max.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_table      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lt_sflight        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_max_price      TYPE sflight-price.

    " Get flight data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No flight data available.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Find maximum price using modern ABAP
    lv_max_price = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
      INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_p THEN flight-price ELSE max_p )
    ).

    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen0. " For Dynpro

    " Create ALV instance
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = lo_custom_container
      IMPORTING

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Wert in einer Liste von Zahlen, die durch eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen verarbeitet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methodenketten und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_get_max
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS _filter_positive
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS _double_values
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doubled_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS _get_max_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_get_max.
    rv_max_value = me->_filter_positive( it_numbers )
                     ->_double_values( )
                     ->_get_max_from_table( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _filter_positive.
    rt_filtered_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers WHERE table_line > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _double_values.
    rt_doubled_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN it_numbers ( num * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_max_from_table.
    rv_max = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
      INIT max_val TYPE i VALUE 0
      FOR num IN it_numbers
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN num > max_val THEN num ELSE max_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_max( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY ( ( -5 ) ( 1 ) ( 10 ) ( -2 ) ( 7 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_and_get_max( lt_test_numbers ).

    " Expected: Filtered: (1, 10, 7) -> Doubled: (2, 20, 14) -> Max: 20
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 20 act = lv_result ).

    DATA(lt_empty_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY ( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->process_and_get_max( lt_empty_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 0 act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies führt zu einem sehr flüssigen und funktionalen Programmierstil.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie mit einer `COND`-Expression, ob ein gegebener Wert der maximale Wert in einer kleinen Liste ist, und geben Sie einen entsprechenden Text zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` und eine einfache Maximum-Bestimmung.

CLASS zcl_cond_max_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_if_max
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_max_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_if_max.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY ( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 5 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_list_max) = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
      INIT max_val TYPE i VALUE 0
      FOR num IN lt_numbers
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN num > max_val THEN num ELSE max_val )
    ).

    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value = lv_list_max THEN |Der Wert { iv_value } ist der maximale Wert in der Liste ({ lv_list_max }).|
      ELSE |Der Wert { iv_value } ist NICHT der maximale Wert in der Liste (Max: { lv_list_max }).|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den maximalen Wert eines numerischen Feldes in einer internen Tabelle, deren Struktur zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist, unter Verwendung von RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für RTTI und eine dynamische Schleife mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_max_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE REF TO data " Generic table
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_max_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN it_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lt_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_field_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = iv_field_name.
        lv_field_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_found = abap_false.
      " Field not found or not numeric
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_field> IS NUMERIC.
        IF <lv_field> > rv_max_value. "MAXIMUM"
          rv_max_value = <lv_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`), um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, die den maximalen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben.
hint: Ermitteln Sie zuerst den maximalen Preis und verwenden Sie dann `FILTER`.

CLASS zcl_filter_max_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_max_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_max_price.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lv_max_price   TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_all_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_max_price = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
        INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
        FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
        NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_p THEN flight-price ELSE max_p )
      ).

      rt_max_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE price = lv_max_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_max_three DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_max_three IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_max = COND #( WHEN iv_num1 > iv_num2 AND iv_num1 > iv_num3 THEN iv_num1

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Objekten verwaltet und den 'maximalen' Objektwert basierend auf einem Kriterium zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Definieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Vergleichskriterium.
solution:
CLASS zcl_object_max_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_object,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_object.
    TYPES tt_data_object TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_data_object.

    METHODS get_object_with_max_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_object) TYPE ty_data_object.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_objects TYPE tt_data_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_max_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_objects = it_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_object_with_max_value.
    IF mt_objects IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR rs_max_object.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_max_object = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
      INIT max_obj TYPE ty_data_object VALUE mt_objects[ 1 ]
      FOR current_obj IN mt_objects
      NEXT max_obj = COND #( WHEN current_obj-value > max_obj-value THEN current_obj ELSE max_obj )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_object_max_finder( it_objects = lt_test_objects ).

CLASS zcl_max_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_date,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_date.
    TYPES tt_sflight_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latest_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_date.
    DATA: lt_flight_dates TYPE tt_sflight_date.

    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flight_dates
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_flight_dates IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_latest_date = REDUCE #( "MAXIMUM"
        INIT latest_d TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '00000000'
        FOR flight IN lt_flight_dates
        NEXT latest_d = COND #( WHEN flight-fldate > latest_d THEN flight-fldate ELSE latest_d )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Dynpro mit einem `cl_gui_custom_container`, das eine Liste von 'Top 3' Flügen (nach Preis) anzeigt, die mit modernen ABAP-Features ermittelt wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_custom_container`, `cl_salv_table`, `SORT` und `FOR` mit `UP TO`.
solution:
* This example requires a Dynpro (e.g., 100) with a Custom Control element (e.g., 'CONTAINER_03')
* in the Screen Painter.
CLASS zcl_alv_top_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_top_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynpro_number TYPE sy-dynnr
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_top_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_top_flights.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_table      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lt_sflight        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_top_flights    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Get all flight data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No flight data available.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Determine top 3 flights by price using modern ABAP
    SORT lt_sflight BY price DESCENDING. "MAXIMUM related sorting
    lt_top_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 3 AND i <= lines( lt_sflight ) ( lt_sflight[ i ] ) ).

    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen0.

    " Create ALV instance for top flights
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = lo_custom_container
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table     = lt_top_flights
    ).

    MESSAGE |Anzeige der Top { lines( lt_top_flights ) } Flüge nach Preis.| TYPE 'I'.

    lo_alv_table->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_top_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_top_flights.
    " UI tests are typically not done with ABAP Unit directly.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_top_flights( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_top_flights( iv_dynpro_number = '0100' iv_container_name = 'CONTAINER_03' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method call should not dump' act = '' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Exception caught: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Anzeige einer gefilterten Liste von 'Top N' Elementen in einem ALV Grid, das in einem `cl_gui_custom_container` eingebettet ist. Die 'Top N' Flüge werden durch Sortierung und anschließende Extraktion der ersten N Elemente mittels `VALUE FOR` mit `WHILE`-Bedingung ermittelt, was eine moderne und kompakte Art der Datenmanipulation darstellt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Strukturdefinition und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data_template TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_data_template[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                              p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                              p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                              p_unique     = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    LOOP AT it_data_template INTO DATA(ls_data).
      APPEND ls_data TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_test_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_test_data,
           ty_t_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_template) = VALUE ty_t_test_data(
      ( col1 = 'A' col2 = 1 )
      ( col1 = 'B' col2 = 2 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_template ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_result> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_result> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_result> ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_result> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_relative_name( ) exp = 'TY_S_TEST_DATA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Datentypen und Datenobjekten mittels RTTI (`cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`, `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE`) ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Frameworks. Es erlaubt die Anpassung an unbekannte Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit, was die Flexibilität von Anwendungen erheblich steigert.
keywords: RTTI, DYNAMIC, TABLE, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse anhand ihres Namens und rufen Sie eine Methode auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name` und `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (class_name)` sowie `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE clike
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
          APPEND VALUE abap_parmbind(
            name = 'IV_INPUT'
            kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing
            value = REF #( iv_param_value )
          ) TO lt_parameters.
        ENDIF.

        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS
            rv_result = rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
