Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Feld in einer Struktur existiert und lesen Sie seinen Wert dynamisch aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_field_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lv_field_name_upper) = to_upper( iv_field_name ).

    IF NOT line_exists( lo_struct_descr->components[ name = lv_field_name_upper ] ).
      rv_field_value = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' does not exist.|.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = |Error assigning field '{ iv_field_name }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Zeilenstruktur, die aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen definiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table_from_def DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_field_def,
           ty_t_field_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_field_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table_from_def IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_def-name
        type = lo_type_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
                               p_components = lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                              p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                              p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                              p_unique     = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_from_def FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_from_def.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dyn_table_from_def=>ty_t_field_defs(
      ( name = 'ID' type = 'I' )
      ( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_table_from_def( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_result> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_result> ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_result> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_line_descr->components ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lo_line_descr->components INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-name exp = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-type->name exp = '\TYPE=I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene dynamische Typdefinition mittels RTTI. Durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` kann eine interne Tabelle mit einer vollständig zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur erstellt werden. Dies ist entscheidend für Szenarien, in denen die Datenstruktur nicht im Voraus bekannt ist, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von externen Schnittstellen oder generischen Berichten.
keywords: RTTI, DYNAMIC, TABLE, STRUCTURE, CREATE_BY_DATA, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, die Codepage eines gegebenen `xstring` zu erkennen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>detect`. Beachten Sie, dass die Erkennung nicht immer 100% genau ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_detect_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_codepage) TYPE cpact.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_detect_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD detect_codepage.
    TRY.
        rv_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>detect( iv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_abap_codepage_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., if detection fails or input is too short
        rv_codepage = '0000'. " Default or error codepage
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_detect_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_detect_iso FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_detect_utf8.
    DATA(lo_detector) = NEW zcl_cpg_detect_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = '48656C6C6F20576F726C642120C384C396C39CC39F'. " Hello World! ÄÖÜß in UTF-8
    DATA(lv_detected_codepage) = lo_detector->detect_codepage( lv_utf8_xstring ).
    " UTF-8 codepage is typically 4103
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_detected_codepage
      exp = '4103'
      msg = 'UTF-8 codepage detection failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_detect_iso.
    DATA(lo_detector) = NEW zcl_cpg_detect_codepage( ).
    " Example: ISO-8859-1 (Latin-1) for 'Hello World! ÄÖÜß'
    " Note: Direct conversion to ISO-8859-1 for test purposes.
    DATA(lv_string_iso) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜß'.
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source          = lv_string_iso
        target_codepage = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = lv_iso_xstring
    ).
    DATA(lv_detected_codepage) = lo_detector->detect_codepage( lv_iso_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_detected_codepage
      exp = '1100'
      msg = 'ISO-8859-1 codepage detection failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die statische Methode `detect` der Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` versucht, die Codepage eines `xstring` zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Codierung einer externen Datei oder eines Datenstroms unbekannt ist. Die Genauigkeit kann variieren.
keywords: cl_abap_codepage, detect, Codepage Detection, xstring

    METHODS display_sflights_with_toolbar.

CLASS zcl_cpg_read_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS read_file_with_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path    TYPE string
        iv_codepage     TYPE cpact

      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_cpg_read_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_with_codepage.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring,
          lv_file_length   TYPE i.

    " Simulate reading a file into xstring
    " In a real scenario, use OPEN DATASET ... IN BINARY MODE ... READ DATASET ...
    IF iv_file_path = '/tmp/test_utf8.txt'.
      " Simulate UTF-8 content for 'Test ÄÖÜß'
      lv_xstring_content = '5465737420C384C396C39CC39F'.
      lv_file_length = xstrlen( lv_xstring_content ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'File not found or simulated content missing'.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source          = lv_xstring_content
        source_codepage = iv_codepage
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = rv_file_content
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_sflights_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_sflights_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_all_columns_as_technical( ). " Hide all initially

        LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
          TRY.
              DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( lv_fieldname ).
              lo_column->set_technical( abap_false ). " Show selected columns
            CATCH cx_salv_not_found.
              " Field not found, ignore or log
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_salv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String durch ein Trennzeichen auf und verketten Sie die Teile anschließend mit einem neuen Trennzeichen, wobei leere Teile ignoriert werden sollen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SPLIT` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_reduce
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_delimiter TYPE string
        iv_new_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_reduce.
    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_old_delimiter ) WHERE ( <part> IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <part> ) ).

    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT lv_concatenated_string = ``
      FOR <part> IN lt_parts
      NEXT lv_concatenated_string = COND string(
        WHEN lv_concatenated_string IS INITIAL THEN <part>
        ELSE lv_concatenated_string && iv_new_delimiter && <part>
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die gefilterten Teile mit einem neuen Trennzeichen zu verketten. `COND` sorgt für die korrekte Handhabung des ersten Elements.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie die Dateierweiterung aus einem Dateipfad und prüfen Sie, ob diese Erweiterung einem der MIME-Typen für Bilder (z.B. 'image/jpeg', 'image/png') entspricht, die in `cl_fxs_mime_types` definiert sind. Geben Sie 'true' zurück, wenn es ein Bild ist, sonst 'false'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` oder `SPLIT` um die Erweiterung zu isolieren und vergleichen Sie diese mit den Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_type_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_image_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_image) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_type_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_image_file.
    DATA(lv_extension) = ``.
    FIND REGEX '\.([^\.]+)$' IN iv_file_path SUBMATCHES lv_extension.

    IF lv_extension IS INITIAL.
      rv_is_image = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert extension to common image MIME types for comparison
    DATA(lv_mime_type) = SWITCH string(
      lv_extension
      WHEN 'jpg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_jpeg
      WHEN 'jpeg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_jpeg
      WHEN 'png' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_png
      WHEN 'gif' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_gif
      WHEN 'bmp' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_bmp
      WHEN 'tif' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_tiff
      WHEN 'tiff' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_tiff
      ELSE ''
    ).

    IF lv_mime_type IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_is_image = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_image = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_str_parse_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value.
    TYPES tt_key_value_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_key_value WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_value_map) TYPE tt_key_value_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_parse_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_key_value_string.
    rt_key_value_map = VALUE tt_key_value_map(
      FOR <pair_string> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' ) WHERE ( <pair_string> IS NOT INITIAL )
      LET lv_key_value_pair = VALUE string_table( FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT <pair_string> AT '=' ) ( <part> ) ) IN
      ( key = lv_key_value_pair[ 1 ] value = lv_key_value_pair[ 2 ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in zwei Teile an einem bestimmten Trennzeichen. Wenn das Trennzeichen nicht gefunden wird, soll der gesamte String als erster Teil und der zweite Teil leer sein. Verwenden Sie `COND` für die Zuweisung.

CLASS zcl_str_split_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_split_result,
             part1 TYPE string,
             part2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_split_result.

    METHODS split_with_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_split_result) TYPE ty_split_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_with_cond.
    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_delimiter ) ( <part> ) ).

    rs_split_result = VALUE ty_split_result(
      part1 = lt_parts[ 1 ]
      part2 = COND string(
        WHEN lines( lt_parts ) > 1 THEN lt_parts[ 2 ]
        ELSE ''
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine Liste von Dateipfaden, die durch Semikolons getrennt sind. Für jeden Pfad sollen der Dateiname und die Erweiterung extrahiert und in einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen gespeichert werden. Verwenden Sie `cl_fxs_mime_types` Konstanten, um gängige Bilddateierweiterungen zu identifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT`, `FIND` mit `REGEX` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Dateityp-Erkennung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_path_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             file_name   TYPE string,
             extension   TYPE string,
             is_image    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_file_info.
    TYPES tt_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_file_paths
      IMPORTING
        iv_path_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_info) TYPE tt_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_path_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_file_paths.
    rt_file_info = VALUE tt_file_info(
      FOR <path> IN ( SPLIT iv_path_list AT ';' ) WHERE ( <path> IS NOT INITIAL )
      LET lv_file_name = ``
          lv_extension = ``
          lv_is_image  = abap_false IN
      BLOCK
        FIND REGEX '([^/\\]+)\.([^\.]+)$' IN <path> SUBMATCHES lv_file_name lv_extension.
        IF lv_extension IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_is_image = COND abap_bool(
            WHEN lv_extension = 'jpg'  THEN abap_true
            WHEN lv_extension = 'jpeg' THEN abap_true
            WHEN lv_extension = 'png'  THEN abap_true
            WHEN lv_extension = 'gif'  THEN abap_true
            WHEN lv_extension = 'bmp'  THEN abap_true
            WHEN lv_extension = 'tif'  THEN abap_true
            WHEN lv_extension = 'tiff' THEN abap_true
            ELSE abap_false
          ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDBLOCK
      ( file_name = lv_file_name extension = lv_extension is_image = lv_is_image )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in Wörter auf und zählen Sie die Häufigkeit jedes Wortes. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle von Strukturen mit Wort und Anzahl zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und `GROUP BY` in einem `LOOP` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_word_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_word_count,
             word  TYPE string,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_word_count.
    TYPES tt_word_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_word_counts) TYPE tt_word_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_word_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_words.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( FOR <word> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT ' ' ) WHERE ( <word> IS NOT INITIAL ) ( to_lower( <word> ) ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_words INTO DATA(lv_word) GROUP BY lv_word.
      APPEND VALUE ty_word_count( word = lv_word count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_word_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen String, der eine Liste von MIME-Typen enthält (z.B. 'text/plain;image/jpeg;application/pdf'). Für jeden MIME-Typ soll geprüft werden, ob er ein Text- oder Bildtyp ist, basierend auf den Konstanten in `cl_fxs_mime_types`. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen mit dem MIME-Typ, einem Flag für Text und einem Flag für Bild sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT`, `FOR` und `COND` in Kombination mit den Konstanten von `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_type_info,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             is_text   TYPE abap_bool,
             is_image  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_mime_type_info.
    TYPES tt_mime_type_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mime_type_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_mime_type_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mime_type_info) TYPE tt_mime_type_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_mime_type_list.
    rt_mime_type_info = VALUE tt_mime_type_info(
      FOR <mime_type_str> IN ( SPLIT iv_mime_type_list AT ';' ) WHERE ( <mime_type_str> IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( mime_type = <mime_type_str>,
        is_text   = COND abap_bool(
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_plain_text THEN abap_true
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_html THEN abap_true
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_xml THEN abap_true
          ELSE abap_false
        ),
        is_image  = COND abap_bool(
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_jpeg THEN abap_true
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_png THEN abap_true
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_gif THEN abap_true
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_bmp THEN abap_true
          WHEN <mime_type_str> = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_tiff THEN abap_true
          ELSE abap_false
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) und greifen Sie effizient auf einen Eintrag zu, um die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_itb_hashed_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_hashed_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info.
    DATA(lt_sflights_h) = VALUE ty_sflight_h_table(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    " Efficient access using table expression
    rs_flight = lt_sflights_h[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Economy-Sitzplätze für alle Flüge in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS calculate_total_eco_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_h_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_eco_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seats_eco ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_filename_frontend  TYPE string

        cx_gui_frontend_services.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_text_file.
    DATA: lt_file_content TYPE TABLE OF string.

Instructions: Laden Sie eine CSV-Datei vom Frontend hoch, parsen Sie die Daten (z.B. Flugdaten: CARRIER, CONNID, DATE) und speichern Sie sie in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload` und anschließend `SPLIT` oder String-Funktionen, um die Zeilen zu parsen und mit `VALUE #` die Hash-Tabelle zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_upload_hashed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flight_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS upload_csv_to_hashed_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename_frontend TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_h_table
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_upload_hashed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_csv_to_hashed_table.
    DATA: lt_file_content TYPE TABLE OF string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename              = iv_filename_frontend
        filetype              = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab              = lt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei'.
    ENDIF.

    " Parse CSV content and populate hashed table
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_line IN lt_file_content
      LET components = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_line sep = ',' ) IN
      (
        carrid = components[ 1 ]->*
        connid = components[ 2 ]->*
        fldate = components[ 3 ]->*
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_count_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_h_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_count_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug in einer Hash-Tabelle existiert und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück, unter Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` und einer `COND`-Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LINE_EXISTS` für die Prüfung und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung der Meldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_h_table
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] )
        THEN |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } existiert.|
      ELSE
        THEN |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } existiert NICHT.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle von Flugdaten und transformieren Sie diese in eine neue Hash-Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft enthält, wobei nur Flüge mit mehr als 100 Sitzplätzen berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_transform_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_summary_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS summarize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_h_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_carrier_summary_h_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_transform_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( ls_flight-seats > 100 )
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_summarize_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_summarize_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_transform_group( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_transform_group=>ty_sflight_h_table(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seats = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' seats = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' seats = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' seats = 110 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' seats = 80 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_transform_group( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_transform_group=>ty_sflight_h_table( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_transform_group( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_transform_group=>ty_sflight_h_table(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seats = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' seats = 70 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `WHERE`-Klausel. Sie ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation und Aggregation von Daten aus einer Hash-Tabelle in eine neue Hash-Tabelle, basierend auf komplexen Filter- und Gruppierungskriterien, alles in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, GROUP BY, WHERE, Transformation, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Quadrate der Flugpreise aus der `sflights` Tabelle, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwende `cl_abap_math=>pow` für die Quadrierung.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation, kombiniert mit `cl_abap_math=>pow`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_sum_squared_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_squared_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_squared) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_squared_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_squared_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_math_find_max_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_find_max_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max_value.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input table cannot be empty for max value calculation.'.

    rv_max_value = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT max_val = it_values[ 1 ]
      FOR <value> IN it_values
      NEXT max_val = cl_abap_math=>max( iv_value1 = max_val iv_value2 = <value> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_math_degrees_to_cos DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_degrees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_cosine_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS convert_degrees_and_calculate_cosine
      IMPORTING
        it_degrees TYPE tt_degrees
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cosine_values) TYPE tt_cosine_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_degrees_to_cos IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_degrees_and_calculate_cosine.
    DATA(lv_180) = CONV decfloat34( 180 ).
    rt_cosine_values = VALUE tt_cosine_values(
      FOR <degree> IN it_degrees
      LET lv_radians = cl_abap_math=>divide(
                         iv_value1 = cl_abap_math=>multiply( iv_value1 = <degree> iv_value2 = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) ),
                         iv_value2 = lv_180 )
      IN
      ( cl_abap_math=>cos( iv_value = lv_radians ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt der Flugpreise aus der `sflights` Tabelle, gerundet auf zwei Nachkommastellen.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` für die Daten, `REDUCE` für die Summe und Zählung, und `cl_abap_math=>divide`, `round` für den Durchschnitt und die Rundung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = '0.00'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct_agg(
      INIT sum_price = CONV decfloat34( '0.0' )
           count_flights = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = cl_abap_math=>add( sum_price <fs_flight>-price )
           count_flights = count_flights + 1
    ).

    DATA(lv_raw_average) = cl_abap_math=>divide(
                              iv_value1 = ls_aggregation-sum_price,
                              iv_value2 = CONV decfloat34( ls_aggregation-count_flights ) ).

    rv_average_price = cl_abap_math=>round(
                         iv_value    = lv_raw_average,
                         iv_decimals = 2,
                         iv_mode     = cl_abap_math=>round_half_up ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_agg,
         sum_price     TYPE decfloat34,
         count_flights TYPE i,
       END OF struct_agg.

Instructions: Berechne den kleinsten Wert aus einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit `cl_abap_math=>min` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_find_min_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_decfloat34 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_min_value
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_value) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_find_min_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_min_value.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input table cannot be empty for min value calculation.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_value = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT min_val = it_values[ 1 ]
      FOR <value> IN it_values
      NEXT min_val = cl_abap_math=>min( iv_value1 = min_val iv_value2 = <value> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parse einen XML-String und extrahiere den Wert eines bestimmten Knotens mittels XPATH.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_with_string` gefolgt von `find_node` und `get_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_xml_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node IS BOUND.
      rv_node_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen XML-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und die Methoden `create_empty_document`, `create_element`, `append_child` und `render_2_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flights_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_carrid) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Carrid' ).
      lo_carrid->set_value( ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_carrid ).

      DATA(lo_connid) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Connid' ).
      lo_connid->set_value( ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_connid ).

      DATA(lo_fldate) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Fldate' ).
      lo_fldate->set_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_fldate ).

      DATA(lo_price) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_price->set_value( ls_flight-price ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_flights_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_empty_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_flights_xml.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_xml_generator=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251124'.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251125'.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.

    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_xml_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_generator->generate_flights_xml( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xml msg = `Generated XML should not be empty` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = `<Flights>` act = lv_xml msg = `XML should contain root element` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = `<Carrid>LH</Carrid>` act = lv_xml msg = `XML should contain flight data` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = `<Carrid>AA</Carrid>` act = lv_xml msg = `XML should contain second flight data` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_empty_xml.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_xml_generator=>tt_flights.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_xml_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_generator->generate_flights_xml( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = `<Flights/>` act = lv_xml msg = `Empty table should generate empty Flights tag` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung eines XML-Dokuments aus einer internen Tabelle. Die Verwendung von `cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document` und das sequentielle Hinzufügen von Elementen mit `create_element` und `append_child` ist der Standardweg zur programmatischen XML-Generierung. `render_2_string` konvertiert das Dokument in einen String.
keywords: XML, Generation, cl_xml_document, Internal Table

Instructions: Transformieren Sie einen XML-String mithilfe eines XSLT-Programms.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML und `cl_xslt_processor` zur Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string   TYPE string
        iv_xslt_program TYPE string " Name des XSLT-Programms (z.B. Z_XSLT_TRANSFORM)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_xslt_processor) = NEW cl_xslt_processor( ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_xml_document( lo_xml_document ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_xslt_program( iv_xslt_program ).
    lo_xslt_processor->transform( ).
    rv_transformed_xml = lo_xslt_processor->get_output_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_xml.
    " NOTE: For this test to run, you need an actual XSLT program
    " in your system, e.g., Z_XSLT_IDENTITY that just copies the XML.
    " Or a more complex one for real transformation.
    " For simplicity, we assume an identity transformation XSLT exists.
    " Create a simple XSLT program named Z_XSLT_IDENTITY in SE80:
    " <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    " <xsl:transform version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
    "   <xsl:template match="/">
    "     <xsl:copy-of select="."/>
    "   </xsl:template>
    " </xsl:transform>

    DATA(lv_xml_input) = `<root><data>Hello</data></root>`.
    DATA(lv_xslt_program_name) = `Z_XSLT_IDENTITY`. " Replace with a valid XSLT program name

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_xml_transformer( ).
    DATA(lv_transformed_xml) = lo_transformer->transform_xml(
                                   iv_xml_string   = lv_xml_input
                                   iv_xslt_program = lv_xslt_program_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_transformed_xml msg = `Transformed XML should not be empty` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = `<data>Hello</data>` act = lv_transformed_xml msg = `Transformed XML should contain original data` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Transformation von XML-Dokumenten mittels XSLT ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug. Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration von `cl_xml_document` mit `cl_xslt_processor`. Das Laden des XML-Dokuments und das Setzen des XSLT-Programms sind die Kernschritte, gefolgt von der `transform`-Methode und dem Abrufen des Ergebnisses.
keywords: XML, XSLT, Transformation, cl_xml_document, cl_xslt_processor

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen XML-String mit einem Element, das Attribute enthält, und lesen Sie diese Attribute wieder aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_attribute` und `get_attribute_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_read_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_element_name TYPE string
        iv_attr_name    TYPE string
        iv_attr_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_attr_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_attributes.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Root' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_element) = lo_xml_document->create_element( iv_element_name ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_element ).

    DATA(lo_attribute) = lo_xml_document->create_attribute( iv_attr_name ).
    lo_attribute->set_value( iv_attr_value ).
    lo_element->set_attribute_node( lo_attribute ).

    " Now read it back
    DATA(lv_xml_string) = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( ).
    DATA(lo_read_doc) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( lv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_read_element) = lo_read_doc->find_node( `/Root/` && iv_element_name ).
    IF lo_read_element IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_read_attribute) = lo_read_element->get_attribute_node( iv_attr_name ).
      IF lo_read_attribute IS BOUND.
        rv_attr_value = lo_read_attribute->get_value( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_searcher IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( id = 'APPT_001' date = '20251120' description = 'Meeting A' )
      ( id = 'APPT_002' date = '20251125' description = 'Meeting B' )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit Namespaces und lesen Sie einen Knoten aus einem spezifischen Namespace.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_element_ns` und `find_node` mit dem Namespace-Präfix im XPATH.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_read_ns_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_name TYPE string
        iv_namespace TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_read_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_ns_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Root' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_ns_element) = lo_xml_document->create_element_ns( iv_namespace, iv_node_name ).
    lo_ns_element->set_value( iv_value ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_ns_element ).

    DATA(lv_xml_string) = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( ).

    " Read back with namespace-aware XPATH
    DATA(lo_read_doc) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( lv_xml_string ).
    " Register namespace for XPATH evaluation
    lo_read_doc->set_namespace_for_prefix( iv_namespace = iv_namespace iv_prefix = 'ns' ).
    DATA(lo_read_node) = lo_read_doc->find_node( `/Root/ns:` && iv_node_name ).
    IF lo_read_node IS BOUND.
      rv_read_value = lo_read_node->get_value( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV Grid in einem benutzerdefinierten Container und zeigen Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) an, die mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxen gefiltert wurden (z.B. alle Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table` und `cl_gui_container` zusammen mit `FILTER` für die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_alv_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_alv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_filtered_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.

    " Fetch all flights
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights using modern ABAP FILTER expression
    lt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    " Create ALV instance
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container  = mo_container
            container_name = iv_container_name
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_filtered_sflights
        ).
        mo_alv_table->display( ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Update frontend
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_logic.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_expected_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.

    " Prepare test data
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.

    " Expected filtered data
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_expected_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_expected_flights.

    " Simulate filtering (cannot directly call display_filtered_sflights without GUI context)
    DATA(lt_actual_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_filtered )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_flights )
      msg = 'Number of filtered flights should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_filtered
      exp = lt_expected_flights
      msg = 'Filtered flights content should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch drei `cl_gui_textedit` Instanzen innerhalb eines `cl_gui_container` und befüllen Sie diese mit individuellem Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung und eine `FOR`-Schleife für die dynamische Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_textedit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_textedits
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_textedit_ref,
             ref TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
           END OF ty_textedit_ref.
    DATA mt_textedits TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_textedit_ref.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_textedits.
    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.

    " Dynamically create 3 textedit controls
    DO 3 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) = sy-index.
      DATA(lo_textedit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
        parent = mo_container
        field_name = |TEXTEDIT_{lv_index}|
      ).
      lo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( |Dies ist Text für Textfeld { lv_index }.| ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_textedit_ref( ref = lo_textedit ) TO mt_textedits.
    ENDDO.

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Update frontend
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_layout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

    DATA mo_bottom_right_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_layout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_split_screen.
    " Create parent container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_parent_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.

    " Create splitter container within the parent container
    mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent = mo_parent_container
      rows   = 2
      columns = 2
    ).

    " Get the sub-containers from the splitter
    mo_top_left_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    mo_bottom_right_container = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 2 ).

    " Optionally, place some content in the sub-containers (e.g., a simple textedit)
    DATA(lo_textedit1) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = mo_top_left_container
      field_name = 'TEXT1'
    ).
    lo_textedit1->set_text_as_stream( 'Oben Links' ).

    DATA(lo_textedit2) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = mo_bottom_right_container
      field_name = 'TEXT2'
    ).
    lo_textedit2->set_text_as_stream( 'Unten Rechts' ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Update frontend
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree` an, wobei die Fluggesellschaften als Wurzelknoten und die Flüge als Kindknoten dargestellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` und seine Methoden zum Hinzufügen von Knoten (`add_node`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = iv_container_name.

    " Create simple tree control
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      parent = mo_container
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    " Fetch all flights
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Get unique carriers using REDUCE and FOR
    lt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( flight-carrid ) ).

    " Add carriers as root nodes
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_carrid
        i_relat_node_key = '' " Root node
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrid }|
      ).

      " Add flights as child nodes
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        mo_tree->add_node(

          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_text = |Flug { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = lt_carriers[ 1 ] ). " Expand first carrier

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach dem Jahr des Flugdatums und berechnen Sie für jedes Jahr die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtumsatz, unter Verwendung von `cl_hrpad_date_computations` zur Jahresermittlung und modernen Gruppierungs-Syntaxen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_hrpad_date_computations` zur Extraktion des Jahres und `GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hr_sflight_yearly_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_yearly_stat,
             year      TYPE gdatj,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_revenue TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_yearly_stat.
    TYPES tt_yearly_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_yearly_stat WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_yearly_flight_stats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_yearly_stats) TYPE tt_yearly_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hr_sflight_yearly_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_yearly_flight_stats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = NEW cl_hrpad_date_computations( ).

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_yearly_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                GROUP BY ( year = lo_date_comp->get_year( ls_flight-fldate ) ) " Use date computation for year
                                ASCENDING BY year
                                ( VALUE #( year = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) " Year from group key
                                            num_flights = GROUP SIZE
                                            total_revenue = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                                                      FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                                      NEXT sum = sum + flight_in_group-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights). Transformieren Sie diese in eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) eine Liste ihrer Flüge (CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE) enthält. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ... )`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ts_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_flights,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights       TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ts_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
          RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

        rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
          GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
          ( 
            carrid = ls_flight-carrid
            flights = VALUE #( 
              FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
              ( 
                connid = ls_grouped_flight-connid
                fldate = ls_grouped_flight-fldate
                price  = ls_grouped_flight-price
              )
            )
          )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und dem summierten Preis sein. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer verschachtelten `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_total_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ts_carrier_total_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_total_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_total_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_nested_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
          RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_total_price.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

        rt_carrier_prices = VALUE #( 
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
          GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
          ( 
            carrid = ls_flight-carrid
            total_price = REDUCE #( 
              INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
              FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
              NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_grouped_flight-price
            )
          )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster für die Datenvalidierung. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `ValidationStrategy` mit einer abstrakten Methode `validate`. Erstellen Sie konkrete Strategien wie `MandatoryFieldValidation` und `NumericRangeValidation`. Eine Client-Klasse soll die Strategie dynamisch zur Laufzeit auswählen und anwenden können.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` für die Strategie und eine Referenz auf die abstrakte Klasse in der Client-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_validation_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_error_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = mv_error_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mandatory_validation DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_validation_strategy.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mandatory_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      mv_error_message = 'Feld ist obligatorisch.'.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_range_validation DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_validation_strategy.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_min TYPE i iv_max TYPE i.
    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min TYPE i.
    DATA mv_max TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_range_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min = iv_min.
    mv_max = iv_max.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate.
    DATA: lv_numeric_value TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_numeric_value = iv_value.
        IF lv_numeric_value < mv_min OR lv_numeric_value > mv_max.
          mv_error_message = |Wert muss zwischen { mv_min } und { mv_max } liegen.|.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        mv_error_message = 'Wert ist keine gültige Zahl.'.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_validation_strategy.
    METHODS execute_validation IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_last_error_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_validation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_validation.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_is_valid = mo_strategy->validate( iv_value ).
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      " Set a default error message if no strategy is set
      DATA(lo_default_strategy) = NEW zcl_mandatory_validation( ).
      lo_default_strategy->validate( '' ). " Trigger error message
      rv_message = lo_default_strategy->get_error_message( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_error_message.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_message = mo_strategy->get_error_message( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mandatory_validation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_numeric_range_validation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_strategy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mandatory_validation.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_validation_context( ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( NEW zcl_mandatory_validation( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_context->execute_validation( '' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_context->get_last_error_message( ) exp = 'Feld ist obligatorisch.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_context->execute_validation( 'abc' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_context->get_last_error_message( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_numeric_range_validation.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_validation_context( ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( NEW zcl_numeric_range_validation( iv_min = 10 iv_max = 20 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_context->execute_validation( '15' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_context->get_last_error_message( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_context->execute_validation( '5' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_context->get_last_error_message( ) exp = 'Wert muss zwischen 10 und 20 liegen.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_context->execute_validation( 'abc' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_context->get_last_error_message( ) exp = 'Wert ist keine gültige Zahl.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_strategy.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_validation_context( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_context->execute_validation( 'any' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_context->get_last_error_message( ) exp = 'Feld ist obligatorisch.' ). " Default error from mandatory validation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster ermöglicht es, Algorithmen (hier Validierungslogiken) in separate Klassen zu kapseln und sie austauschbar zu machen. Die abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_validation_strategy` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle, während konkrete Strategien die spezifische Logik implementieren. Die Client-Klasse `zcl_validation_context` verwendet eine Referenz auf die abstrakte Strategie, um die Validierung auszuführen, ohne die konkrete Implementierung zu kennen (Polymorphie).
keywords: Strategy Pattern, ABSTRACT CLASS, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Validation

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge heraus, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') durchgeführt werden UND deren Flugnummern (CONNID) mit '4' beginnen. Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FILTER`-Ausdrücke.
hint: `FILTER` kann auf das Ergebnis eines anderen `FILTER`-Ausdrucks angewendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
          IMPORTING
            iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
            iv_connid_prefix TYPE string
          RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_filtered_flights.
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
          lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        ).

        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
          rt_filtered_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE connid CS iv_connid_prefix
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multi_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
                               iv_carrid = 'LH'
                               iv_connid_prefix = '4' ).

    " Assert that all results match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-connid CS '4' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for a specific expected flight if it exists in sflight
    DATA(lv_expected_connid) = '400'.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_flight WHERE connid = lv_expected_connid.
      lv_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found exp = abap_true msg = |Flight { lv_expected_connid } not found or filtered incorrectly.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FILTER` in einer Kette ermöglicht eine klare und effiziente schrittweise Filterung von internen Tabellen. Jede `FILTER`-Operation erzeugt eine neue gefilterte Tabelle, die als Eingabe für die nächste Filterung dient. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `LOOP`s oder komplexen `WHERE`-Klauseln.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum). Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `COND`-Ausdrücke, um den Status 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet' oder 'Annulliert' zurückzugeben.
hint: `COND` kann als Ausdruck in einem anderen `COND`-Ausdruck verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
          IMPORTING
            iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
            iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
            iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
          RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' AND iv_connid = '400' AND iv_fldate = sy-datum THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN sy-uzeit > '120000' THEN 'Verspätet'
          ELSE 'Pünktlich'
        )
      WHEN iv_carrid = 'AA' AND iv_connid = '123' THEN 'Annulliert'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_cond( ).

    " Test case 1: LH 400, today, after 12:00:00 (simulated delayed)
    DATA(lv_status_delayed) = lo_cut->get_flight_status(
                                 iv_carrid = 'LH'
                                 iv_connid = '400'
                                 iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
    " This test depends on current time, so we check for either 'Verspätet' or 'Pünktlich'
    " For a robust test, we would mock sy-uzeit or test specific time ranges.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_status_delayed = 'Verspätet' OR lv_status_delayed = 'Pünktlich' ) ).

    " Test case 2: AA 123 (cancelled)
    DATA(lv_status_cancelled) = lo_cut->get_flight_status(
                                   iv_carrid = 'AA'
                                   iv_connid = '123'
                                   iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_cancelled exp = 'Annulliert' ).

    " Test case 3: Other flight (on time)
    DATA(lv_status_on_time) = lo_cut->get_flight_status(
                                 iv_carrid = 'UA'
                                 iv_connid = '789'
                                 iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_on_time exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Anstatt mehrerer `IF`-Anweisungen kann die gesamte Logik in einem einzigen Ausdruck gekapselt werden, was die Lesbarkeit verbessert und Boilerplate-Code reduziert. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer verschachtelten Struktur, die Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge enthält. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus `sflights` und nutzen Sie `VALUE #` mit verschachtelten `FOR`-Ausdrücken, um die Daten zu aggregieren und zu transformieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #` mit einer äußeren `FOR GROUPS OF` und einer inneren `FOR`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_data,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ts_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ts_carrier_data.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_nested_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_nested_flight_data
          RETURNING VALUE(rt_nested_data) TYPE tt_carrier_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_nested_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_nested_flight_data.
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

        rt_nested_data = VALUE tt_carrier_data(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
          GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
          ( 
            carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
            flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
              FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight
              ( 
                connid = ls_grouped_flight-connid,
                fldate = ls_grouped_flight-fldate,
                price  = ls_grouped_flight-price
              )
            )
          )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_nested_value_for FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_value_for.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_nested_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    " Check if at least one carrier has flights
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_carrier_data).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( ls_first_carrier_data-flights ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Verify data integrity for a specific carrier/flight if possible
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '400'.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_first_carrier_data WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE ls_first_carrier_data-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_detail) WITH KEY connid = lv_connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = |Flight { lv_connid } for carrier { lv_carrid } not found.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE #` mit verschachtelten `FOR`-Ausdrücken, insbesondere `FOR GROUPS OF`, ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Methode, um komplexe Datenstrukturen (Deep Structures) zu füllen und zu transformieren. Sie ermöglicht die Aggregation und Umstrukturierung von Daten in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Konstrukte.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, GROUP BY, Nesting, Internal Tables, Deep Structure, Functional Programming

hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
    mv_name = 'Kreis'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_name = 'Rechteck'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_area IMPORTING it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_area.
    rv_total_area = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum_area = 0
      FOR lo_shape IN it_shapes
      NEXT sum_area = sum_area + lo_shape->calculate_area( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_area_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_area_calculation.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '4' iv_width = '6' ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_shape_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_area) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_area( lt_shapes ).

    " Expected: Area of Circle (radius 5) = PI * 25 approx 78.5398
    " Area of Rectangle (4x6) = 24
    " Total approx 102.5398
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals( act = lv_total_area exp = '102.5398' tol = '0.0001' ).

    READ TABLE lt_shapes INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lo_circle).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->get_name( ) exp = 'Kreis' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die Summation der Flächen ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode.

Instructions: Lade Daten aus `sflight`, zeige sie in einem ALV an und demonstriere, wie ein einzelner Datensatz in der internen Tabelle geändert und die Änderung im ALV reflektiert wird.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für die Modifikation und `check_changed_data` sowie `refresh_table_display` für den ALV-Refresh.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_modify_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS display_alv.

    METHODS modify_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid    TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights  TYPE ty_sflights.

    METHODS get_current_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_sflights.

    METHODS create_field_catalog
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_modify_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv.
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        is_variant = VALUE #( report = sy-repid )
        i_save     = 'A'
        i_bypassing_buffer = abap_true
      CHANGING
        it_outtab  = mt_sflights
        it_fieldcatalog = create_field_catalog( )
    ).

    " Simulate a modification after display
    modify_flight_price(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid    = 'AA'
        iv_connid    = '0017'
        iv_fldate    = '20250101'
        iv_new_price = '123.45'
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights  = mt_sflights
    ).

    " Refresh ALV to show changes
    mo_alv_grid->check_changed_data( ).
    mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_data.
    rt_sflights = mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_field_catalog.
    rt_fcat = VALUE #(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE' text = 'Price' )
      ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Currency' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
