Instructions: Gegeben sind zwei interne Tabellen mit Materialnummern und Mengen (geplant und tatsächlich). Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, die die Differenz der Mengen für jedes Material enthält.
hint: Nutze `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `LINE_EXISTS` oder `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuordnung und Subtraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_quantity,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_material_quantity.
    TYPES tt_material_quantities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_quantity WITH UNIQUE KEY material.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_difference,
             material TYPE string,
             difference TYPE i,
           END OF ty_material_difference.
    TYPES tt_material_differences TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_difference WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_quantity_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_planned TYPE tt_material_quantities
        it_actual  TYPE tt_material_quantities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_differences) TYPE tt_material_differences.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_quantity_differences.
    rt_differences = VALUE #( FOR ls_planned IN it_planned
                               LET ls_actual = it_actual[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS material = ls_planned-material ]
                               IN ( material = ls_planned-material,
                                    difference = ls_planned-quantity - ls_actual-quantity ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_quantity_differences FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_quantity_differences.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_subtraction( ).

    DATA(lt_planned) = VALUE zcl_table_subtraction=>tt_material_quantities(
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 100 )
      ( material = 'B' quantity = 50 )
      ( material = 'C' quantity = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual) = VALUE zcl_table_subtraction=>tt_material_quantities(
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 90 )
      ( material = 'B' quantity = 60 )
      ( material = 'D' quantity = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_differences) = lo_cut->calculate_quantity_differences( it_planned = lt_planned it_actual = lt_actual ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_differences ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 entries' ).

    DATA(ls_diff_a) = lt_differences[ material = 'A' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff_a-difference exp = 10 msg = 'Difference for A should be 10' ).

    DATA(ls_diff_b) = lt_differences[ material = 'B' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff_b-difference exp = -10 msg = 'Difference for B should be -10' ).

    DATA(ls_diff_c) = lt_differences[ material = 'C' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_diff_c-difference exp = 200 msg = 'Difference for C should be 200 (actual not found)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE`-Konstruktor ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem Elemente aus einer Quelltabelle verarbeitet werden. Die `LET`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um auf entsprechende Einträge in der zweiten Tabelle zuzugreifen und die Subtraktion durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art der Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, LINE_EXISTS, Table Expression

CLASS zcl_min_string_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_min_string_length IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Subtrahiere einen Wert von einem Feld einer Struktur, dessen Name dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwende `REF TO DATA` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS subtract_dynamic_field
      CHANGING
        cs_data     TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <lv_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <lv_field> = <lv_field> - iv_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_data-field1 = 100.
    ls_data-field2 = 50.

    " Test case: Successful subtraction
    DATA(lv_success1) = lo_cut->subtract_dynamic_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                                        IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 80 msg = 'FIELD1 should be 80' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success1 exp = abap_true msg = 'Subtraction should be successful' ).

    " Test case: Non-existent field
    DATA(lv_success2) = lo_cut->subtract_dynamic_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                                        IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_value = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success2 exp = abap_false msg = 'Subtraction should fail for non-existent field' ).

    " Test case: Subtraction leading to overflow (example for error handling)
    ls_data-field3 = -2147483640. " Near min for I type
    DATA(lv_success3) = lo_cut->subtract_dynamic_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data

Der Feldname wird zur Laufzeit übergeben, was flexible Datenmanipulation ermöglicht. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist wichtig, um Laufzeitfehler wie Überläufe abzufangen. CLASS zcl_itab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flights_short = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_full

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (price) aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                   FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price ). " Check if it's not 0
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endpreis eines Fluges unter Berücksichtigung eines Rabatts und einer Mehrwertsteuer. Der Rabatt wird nur angewendet, wenn der Originalpreis über einem Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CALCULATE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_final_price IMPORTING iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
                                            iv_discount_rate  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
                                            iv_vat_rate       TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
                                            iv_discount_threshold TYPE sflight-price
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_price.
    rv_final_price = CALCULATE
                       ( iv_original_price
                         - COND #( WHEN iv_original_price > iv_discount_threshold
                                   THEN iv_original_price * iv_discount_rate / 100
                                   ELSE 0 ) )
                       * ( 1 + iv_vat_rate / 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CALCULATE` Operator ermöglicht die Definition komplexer arithmetischer Ausdrücke in einer einzigen Anweisung, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit von Berechnungen verbessert. Er kann auch mit anderen Ausdrücken wie `COND` kombiniert werden.
keywords: CALCULATE, Math, Expression, COND

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, um den Zielort eines bestimmten Fluges zu ermitteln. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ key = value ]`) und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_city_to IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                    iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
                                    iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_cityto) TYPE s_cityname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_to.
    TRY.
        rv_cityto = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityto.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_cityto = 'NOT FOUND'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_table_expression=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'DALLAS' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_cityto) = lo_cut->get_city_to( it_flights = lt_flights
                                            iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                            iv_connid  = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_table_expression=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_cityto) = lo_cut->get_city_to( it_flights = lt_flights
                                            iv_carrid  = 'AA'
                                            iv_connid  = '0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cityto exp = 'NOT FOUND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke ermöglichen den direkten, schlüsselbasierten Zugriff auf Zeilen interner Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um auf einzelne Einträge zuzugreifen, und ersetzt `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY`. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ebenfalls modern.
keywords: Table Expression, Internal Tables, Exception Handling, READ TABLE

CLASS zcl_corresponding_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.

             field1 TYPE string,
             field_x TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             field_y TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.

                             RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Anwendungsprotokolleinträge, die in den letzten 24 Stunden erstellt wurden und den Nachrichtentyp 'E' (Error) haben. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Filterung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ=>GET_LOGS` und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FILTER` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_read_errors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             log_handle TYPE bal_loghndl,
             msg_type   TYPE bal_msgty,
             msg_text   TYPE bal_msgtxt,
             timestamp  TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_log_entry,
           ty_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_logs_last_24h
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_logs) TYPE ty_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_read_errors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_logs_last_24h.
    DATA(lv_24_hours_ago) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
                              tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utc_from_system_tstmp( )
                              secs  = -86400 " 24 hours in seconds
                            ).

    DATA(lt_all_logs) = cl_bal_logobj=>get_logs( ).

    rt_error_logs = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_log_handle IN lt_all_logs
      LET lo_log = cl_bal_logobj=>get_log_from_handle( ls_log_handle ) IN
      FOR ls_message IN lo_log->get_messages( )
        WHERE ( msgty = 'E' AND timestamp_long >= lv_24_hours_ago )
        ( log_handle = ls_log_handle
          msg_type   = ls_message-msgty
          msg_text   = ls_message-msgtxt
          timestamp  = ls_message-timestamp_long )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_error_logs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_error_logs.
    " Zuerst einen Fehler-Log-Eintrag zum Testen erstellen
    DATA(lo_log_creator) = NEW zcl_log_simple_create( ). " Wiederverwendung des einfachen Log-Erstellers
    DATA(lo_test_log) = cl_bal_logobj=>create_log( ).
    lo_test_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = 'Testfehler'
    ).
    lo_test_log->save_log( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_read_errors( ).
    DATA(lt_error_logs) = lo_cut->get_error_logs_last_24h( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob mindestens ein Fehler-Log gefunden wurde (der gerade erstellte)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_error_logs ).
    " Weitere Überprüfungen könnten den Inhalt prüfen, aber dies reicht für die Existenzprüfung aus.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_logs[ 1 ]-msg_type exp = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Lesen und Filtern von Anwendungsprotokollen. Es verwendet `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ=>GET_LOGS`, um alle Log-Handles zu erhalten, iteriert dann mit `FOR` über diese und ruft `GET_LOG_FROM_HANDLE` auf. Die Nachrichten innerhalb jedes Logs werden mit `FOR` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel gefiltert, um nur Fehlermeldungen der letzten 24 Stunden zu berücksichtigen. `VALUE` wird für die kompakte Konstruktion der Ergebnistabelle verwendet.
keywords: CL_BAL_LOGOBJ, Application Log, Logging, Error, FILTER, FOR, Timestamp

Instructions: Listen Sie alle ABAP-Klassen (Objekttyp 'CLAS') in einem gegebenen Paket auf.

solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_list_classes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lt_package_objects) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_objects(
                                 iv_package = iv_package

                               ).

    rt_class_names = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_object IN lt_package_objects

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_classes_in_package FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_classes_in_package.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_list_classes( ).
    " Angenommen, das Paket $TMP enthält mindestens eine Klasse (z.B. eine lokale Testklasse)
    " oder verwenden Sie ein bekanntes Paket wie 'SABAP_DEMOS', falls verfügbar und stabil.
    " Für einen robusten Test könnten wir zuerst eine Dummy-Klasse in $TMP erstellen.
    " Hier testen wir gegen $TMP und erwarten einige Ergebnisse oder eine leere Tabelle.
    DATA(lt_class_names) = lo_cut->get_classes_in_package( '$TMP' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob das Ergebnis eine Tabelle ist (könnte leer sein oder Einträge enthalten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_class_names ). " Erwartet mindestens diese Testklasse selbst
    " Wenn wir spezifischer sein wollen, könnten wir nach einem bekannten Klassennamen suchen.
    " Zum Beispiel, wenn diese Testklasse ZCL_PAK_LIST_CLASSES ist, könnten wir danach suchen.
    " Vorerst ist die Überprüfung, ob sie nicht leer ist, eine grundlegende Prüfung.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_class_names ) >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man alle Objekte eines bestimmten Typs (hier: Klassen) innerhalb eines ABAP-Pakets abruft. `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES=>GET_PACKAGE_OBJECTS` liefert eine Liste von Objekten, die dann mit `VALUE` in eine einfache String-Tabelle der Klassennamen umgewandelt wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungsprotokolleintrag und fügen Sie diesem benutzerdefinierte Daten (z.B. eine interne Tabelle) hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` und die Methode `ADD_MESSAGE` zusammen mit `SET_DETAIL_DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_custom_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_log_with_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_custom_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_with_data.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_logobj=>create_log( ).
    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = 'Flugdaten protokolliert'
    ).
    " Benutzerdefinierte Daten anhängen
    lo_log->set_detail_data(
      i_data_name = 'SFLIGHT_DATA'
      i_data_ref  = REF #( it_sflight )
    ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_log_with_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_log_with_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_log_custom_data=>ty_sflight_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_custom_data( ).
    lo_cut->create_log_with_data( it_sflight ).

    " Ähnlich wie bei log_001 ist die direkte Überprüfung des Inhalts ohne Rücklesen komplex.
    " Wir überprüfen, dass kein Dump auftritt und gehen von einer erfolgreichen Ausführung aus.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Kein Dump aufgetreten beim Erstellen des Logs mit benutzerdefinierten Daten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man benutzerdefinierte Daten an einen Anwendungsprotokolleintrag anhängt. Nach dem Hinzufügen einer Nachricht wird `SET_DETAIL_DATA` verwendet, um eine Referenz auf die interne Tabelle `it_sflight` unter einem bestimmten Namen zu speichern. Dies ermöglicht die spätere Analyse der protokollierten Daten.
keywords: CL_BAL_LOGOBJ, Application Log, Custom Data, SET_DETAIL_DATA, REF

Instructions: Finden Sie alle ABAP-Pakete, die einen bestimmten Transport Layer (z.B. 'ZDEV') verwenden und deren Namen mit 'Z' beginnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES=>GET_ALL_PACKAGES` und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FILTER` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_find_by_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_packages_by_transport
      IMPORTING
        iv_transport_layer TYPE trkorr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_packages) TYPE devclass_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_find_by_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_packages_by_transport.
    DATA(lt_all_packages) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_packages( ).

    rt_packages = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_package IN lt_all_packages
      LET ls_attributes = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes( ls_package-package_name ) IN
        WHERE ( ls_attributes-transport_layer = iv_transport_layer AND
                ls_package-package_name CP 'Z*' )
        ( ls_package-package_name )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_packages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_find_by_attr( ).
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig, ohne ein Dummy-Paket mit einem spezifischen Transport Layer zu erstellen.
    " Zur Demonstration suchen wir nach einem gängigen Transport Layer wie 'SAP' (falls vorhanden)
    " oder einem benutzerdefinierten, falls das System ihn hat.
    " Für $TMP ist der Transport Layer normalerweise initial.
    " Nehmen wir ein System an, in dem 'ZDEV' ein gültiger Transport Layer ist und einige Z-Pakete existieren.
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man sicherstellen, dass ein solches Paket existiert oder die Abfrage mocken.
    DATA(lt_found_packages) = lo_cut->find_packages_by_transport( 'ZDEV' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob das Ergebnis eine Tabelle ist (könnte leer sein oder Einträge enthalten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_found_packages ) >= 0 ).
    " Wenn ein spezifisches ZDEV-Paket bekannt ist, könnten wir dessen Vorhandensein überprüfen.
    " Z.B. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( iv_value = 'Z_MY_PACKAGE' it_table = lt_found_packages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Finden von Paketen basierend auf ihren Attributen. Es verwendet `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES=>GET_ALL_PACKAGES` und iteriert dann mit `FOR` über alle Pakete. Für jedes Paket werden die Attribute mit `GET_PACKAGE_ATTRIBUTES` abgerufen und dann mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel gefiltert, um Pakete mit einem bestimmten Transport Layer und Namensmuster zu finden. Die `LET` Expression verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES, Package, Transport Layer, FILTER, FOR, LET

solution:
CLASS zcl_log_placeholders DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_log_with_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE string
        iv_param2 TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_log_placeholders IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_with_placeholders.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_logobj=>create_log( ).
    " Angenommen, es gibt eine Nachricht SY/001: '&1 hat &2 ausgeführt.'
    lo_log->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'

CLASS zcl_pic_url_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_picture
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_custom_container=>container_name
        iv_url            TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_picture_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_url_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture.
    TRY.
        " Modern ABAP: Inline declaration for custom container
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
        " Modern ABAP: Inline declaration for picture control
        mo_picture_control = NEW cl_gui_picture( mo_custom_container ).

        " Load picture from URL
        mo_picture_control->load_picture_from_url( iv_url ).

        " Set display mode (optional)
        mo_picture_control->set_display_mode(
          EXPORTING
            display_mode = cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch
        ).

        " Flush GUI to ensure display
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie mehrere `cl_gui_picture`-Instanzen in einem einzigen `cl_gui_custom_container` und zeigen Sie verschiedene Bilder an, indem Sie einen Splitter-Container verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_easy_splitter_container` um den Hauptcontainer in Bereiche zu unterteilen, in denen dann jeweils ein `cl_gui_picture` platziert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_multi_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_picture_data,
             id  TYPE i,
             url TYPE string,
           END OF ty_picture_data.
    TYPES tt_picture_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_picture_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_multiple_pictures
      IMPORTING
        iv_main_container_name TYPE cl_gui_custom_container=>container_name
        it_picture_urls        TYPE tt_picture_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_main_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_splitter       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_easy_splitter_container.
    DATA mt_picture_controls TYPE TABLE OF REF TO cl_gui_picture.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_multi_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_multiple_pictures.
    TRY.
        mo_main_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_main_container_name ).
        mo_splitter = NEW cl_gui_easy_splitter_container(
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_main_container
            orientation = cl_gui_easy_splitter_container=>orientation_vertical
            sash_position = 50
        ).

        DATA(lv_part) = 1.
        LOOP AT it_picture_urls INTO DATA(ls_pic_data).
          DATA(lo_container_part) = COND REF TO cl_gui_container(
            WHEN lv_part = 1 THEN mo_splitter->get_container1( )
            WHEN lv_part = 2 THEN mo_splitter->get_container2( )
            ELSE THROW cx_gui_exception( textid = cx_gui_exception=>internal_error )
          ).

          DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( lo_container_part ).
          lo_picture->load_picture_from_url( ls_pic_data-url ).
          lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).
          APPEND lo_picture TO mt_picture_controls.

          lv_part = lv_part + 1.
          IF lv_part > 2. " Only two parts for easy splitter for this example
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung, wenn das Laden eines Bildes über eine URL fehlschlägt (z.B. ungültige URL oder Netzwerkfehler).
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_gui_exception` und `cx_wdr_http_client_error` (oder ähnliche HTTP-Fehler). Zeigen Sie ein Standard-Fehlerbild an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_picture_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_custom_container=>container_name
        iv_url            TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_picture_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CONSTANTS: gc_error_image_url TYPE string VALUE `https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e0/Question_mark_%28black%29.svg/1200px-Question_mark_%28black%29.svg.png`.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture_with_error_handling.
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
    mo_picture_control = NEW cl_gui_picture( mo_custom_container ).

    TRY.
        mo_picture_control->load_picture_from_url( iv_url ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        " Log the error and display a default error image
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        mo_picture_control->load_picture_from_url( gc_error_image_url ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
      CATCH cx_wdr_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        " Handle HTTP specific errors
        MESSAGE lx_http_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        mo_picture_control->load_picture_from_url( gc_error_image_url ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Catch any other unexpected errors
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        mo_picture_control->load_picture_from_url( gc_error_image_url ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie mehrere Barcodes aus einer internen Tabelle von Daten und speichern Sie diese als XSTRINGs in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_bar_multi_generate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_barcode_input,
             id      TYPE i,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_barcode_input.
    TYPES tt_barcode_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_barcode_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_barcode_output,
             id      TYPE i,
             content TYPE string,
             barcode TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_barcode_output.
    TYPES tt_barcode_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_barcode_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_multiple_barcodes
      IMPORTING
        it_input_data TYPE tt_barcode_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_data) TYPE tt_barcode_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_multi_generate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_multiple_barcodes.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    rt_output_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_input IN it_input_data
                               LET lv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode_to_xstring(
                                                              i_symbology = 'CODE128'
                                                              i_content   = ls_input-content )
                               IN ( id = ls_input-id, content = ls_input-content, barcode = lv_barcode_xstring ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_custom_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bar_custom_params IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        MESSAGE lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        CLEAR rv_barcode_xstring.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        CLEAR rv_barcode_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie Open SQL, um die Flugnummer zu lesen, und `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` zur Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_db_generate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_flight_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_bar_db_generate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_barcode.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    DATA(lv_barcode_content) TYPE string.

    " Modern ABAP: Open SQL with inline declaration
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflights).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_barcode_content = |{ ls_sflights-carrid }-{ ls_sflights-connid }-{ ls_sflights-fldate }|.
    ELSE.
      lv_barcode_content = 'FLIGHT_NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode_to_xstring(
          i_symbology = 'CODE128'
          i_content   = lv_barcode_content
        ).

      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        MESSAGE lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        CLEAR rv_barcode_xstring.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        CLEAR rv_barcode_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_check_support IMPLEMENTATION.

        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_custom_container=>container_name
        iv_mime_path      TYPE string. " E.g., '/SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/MIME_REPOSITORY/SAP_LOGO.GIF'

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_mime_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_mime_picture.
    DATA(lv_picture_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_mime_api) = cl_mime_repository_api=>get_api( ).
        lo_mime_api->get(
          EXPORTING
            i_url     = iv_mime_path
          IMPORTING
            e_content = lv_picture_xstring
        ).

        IF lv_picture_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
          mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
          mo_picture_control = NEW cl_gui_picture( mo_custom_container ).
          mo_picture_control->load_picture_from_data( lv_picture_xstring ).
          cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |Bild aus MIME-Repository '{ iv_mime_path }' konnte nicht geladen werden.| TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_mime_repository_exception INTO DATA(lx_mime_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_mime_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 3 Einträgen aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT. Geben Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und Feld-Symbolen für die dynamische Tabelle und `SELECT` für die Datenbeschaffung.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_lines) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_sflight.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_sflight_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lt_sflight_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE TABLE OF (lt_sflight_type->get_relative_name()).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <fs_table> UP TO 3 ROWS.
      rv_lines = lines( <fs_table> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit funktionalen Methoden, die String-Operationen (Trimmen, Großschreibung, Ersetzen) verkettet ausführen, um einen Eingabestring zu transformieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RETURNING VALUE` für Methoden, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. String Templates für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_transformer.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_transformer.
    METHODS replace_char IMPORTING iv_old TYPE c iv_new TYPE c RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_transformer.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_current_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_current_string = to_upper( mv_current_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_current_string = condense( mv_current_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_char.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old IN mv_current_string WITH iv_new.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_string_transformer( '  hello world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_transformer->trim( )->to_upper( )->replace_char( iv_old = 'O' iv_new = 'X' )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLX WXRLD' msg = 'String Transformation fehlgeschlagen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Method Chaining, eine moderne Technik, die durch `RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_transformer` ermöglicht wird. Jede Methode gibt eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz zurück, wodurch aufeinanderfolgende Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung möglich sind. Dies führt zu flüssigerem und lesbarerem Code.
keywords: FUNCTIONAL METHOD, METHOD CHAINING, STRING PROCESSING, RETURNING VALUE, OBJECT REFERENCE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine statische Fabrikmethode `create_flight_data_processor`, die Instanzen von `zcl_flight_processor_v1` oder `zcl_flight_processor_v2` basierend auf einer Versionsnummer erzeugt. Beide Klassen implementieren das Interface `zif_flight_processor`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR` und `NEW` in der Fabrikmethode. Das Interface definiert eine Methode zur Verarbeitung von Flugdaten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_processor.
  METHODS process_flight_data IMPORTING is_sflight TYPE sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_v1 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_v1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_processor~process_flight_data.
    rv_result = |V1: Flight { is_sflight-carrid } { is_sflight-connid } from { is_sflight-fldate } processed.|.

  METHOD zif_flight_processor~process_flight_data.
    rv_result = |V2: Flight { is_sflight-carrid } { is_sflight-connid } on { is_sflight-fldate } with price { is_sflight-price } processed.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_flight_data_processor
      IMPORTING iv_version TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_processor) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_data_processor.
    CASE iv_version.
      WHEN 1.
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_flight_processor_v1( ).
      WHEN 2.
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_flight_processor_v2( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default or error handling
        ro_processor = NEW zcl_flight_processor_v1( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT empfängt und den Preis aller Flüge in dieser Tabelle um einen gegebenen Prozentsatz erhöht.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Parameter als `CHANGING REF TO data`. Nutzen Sie Feld-Symbole und `FOR` für die Iteration und Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS adjust_prices
      CHANGING cr_sflight_table TYPE REF TO data
      IMPORTING iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_sflight_line>  TYPE sflight.

    ASSIGN cr_sflight_table->* TO <fs_sflight_table>.

    IF <fs_sflight_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <fs_sflight_table> ASSIGNING <fs_sflight_line>.
        <fs_sflight_line>-price = <fs_sflight_line>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_price_adjustment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_adjustment.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '400'. ls_sflight-price = '100.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '010'. ls_sflight-price = '200.00'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = REF TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_adjuster) = NEW zcl_flight_price_adjuster( ).
    lo_adjuster->adjust_prices( CHANGING cr_sflight_table = lr_sflight_table IMPORTING iv_percentage = 10 ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflight INDEX 1 INTO ls_sflight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Preis für ersten Flug falsch angepasst.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflight INDEX 2 INTO ls_sflight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Preis für zweiten Flug falsch angepasst.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode empfängt eine Datenreferenz (`REF TO data`) auf eine interne Tabelle, was eine generische Verarbeitung beliebiger Tabellentypen ermöglicht. Durch die Zuweisung an ein Feld-Symbol (`ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`) kann der Inhalt der Tabelle direkt modifiziert werden, ohne eine Kopie zu erstellen. Dies ist effizient für große Datenmengen und ein modernes Muster für generische Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)` und `RECEIVING`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_farewell RETURNING VALUE(rv_farewell) TYPE string.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_farewell.
    rv_farewell = 'Goodbye from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_instance->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or callable.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT, die ein bestimmtes Datum haben, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und einer Hilfsmethode.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Lambda-Ausdruck oder einer Methode, die den Preis addiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS add_price
      IMPORTING iv_current_sum TYPE sflight-price
                is_sflight     TYPE sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_new_sum) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = VALUE sflight-price( 0 )
                                FOR flight IN it_sflight
                                WHERE ( fldate = iv_fldate )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_price.
    rv_new_sum = iv_current_sum + is_sflight-price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_with_method.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_math_operations` mit einer statischen Methode `calculate_average`, die eine interne Tabelle von Dezimalzahlen empfängt und den Durchschnitt zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und teilen Sie dann durch die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = VALUE decfloat16( 0 )
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + number
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND '10.0' TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND '20.0' TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND '30.0' TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lv_average) = zcl_math_operations=>calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '20.0' msg = 'Durchschnitt falsch berechnet.' ).

    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    lv_average = zcl_math_operations=>calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.0' msg = 'Durchschnitt für leere Tabelle falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode ist als `CLASS-METHOD` deklariert, da sie keine Instanzdaten benötigt.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight,
           tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_key.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_flight(
        carrid = group_key->carrid
        connid = group_key->connid
        flight_count = group_key->* => group_size
      ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die Eigenschaften eines 3D-Objekts (ID, Position, Farbe) in einem JSON-String serialisiert, der von einem 3D-Viewer verarbeitet werden könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_JSON_WRITER` für die JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_object_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_3d_object,
             id    TYPE string,
             x     TYPE i,
             y     TYPE i,
             z     TYPE i,
             color TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_3d_object.

    METHODS serialize_object_to_json
      IMPORTING
        is_object TYPE ty_s_3d_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_object_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_object_to_json.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_abap_json_writer=>create( ).
    lo_writer->begin_object( ).
    lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'id'    value = is_object-id ).
    lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'x'     value = is_object-x ).
    lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'y'     value = is_object-y ).
    lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'z'     value = is_object-z ).
    lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'color' value = is_object-color ).
    lo_writer->end_object( ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen vereinfachten '3D-Befehls'-String (z.B. 'MOVE CUBE ID1 X 10') und extrahieren Sie die Befehlskomponenten in eine strukturierte Form.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen wie `FIND`, `SUBSTRING`, `SPLIT` und `COND`/`SWITCH` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_command_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_3d_command,
             command_type TYPE string, " e.g., MOVE, ROTATE
             object_type  TYPE string, " e.g., CUBE, SPHERE
             object_id    TYPE string,
             parameter    TYPE string, " e.g., X, Y, Z, ANGLE
             value        TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_3d_command.

    METHODS parse_command_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_command_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_command) TYPE ty_s_3d_command
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_command_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_command_string.
    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_command_string AT ' ' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    IF lines( lt_parts ) < 5.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_strg_par_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid command format'.
    ENDIF.

    rs_command = VALUE #( 
      command_type = lt_parts[1]
      object_type  = lt_parts[2]
      object_id    = lt_parts[3]
      parameter    = lt_parts[4]
      value        = CONV i( lt_parts[5] ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_valid_command.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_command_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_command_string) = 'MOVE CUBE ID1 X 10'.
    DATA(ls_parsed_command) = lo_cut->parse_command_string( lv_command_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parsed_command-command_type exp = 'MOVE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parsed_command-object_type exp = 'CUBE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parsed_command-parameter exp = 'X' ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse zur Verwaltung einer Sammlung von 3D-Objekten, die das Hinzufügen, Entfernen und Abrufen von Objekten nach ID ermöglicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Hash-Tabelle (`SORTED TABLE` oder `HASHED TABLE`) für effizienten Zugriff und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_object_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_3d_object,
             id    TYPE string,
             color TYPE string,
             x     TYPE i,
             y     TYPE i,
             z     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_3d_object.
    TYPES: ty_t_3d_objects TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_s_3d_object WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_object
      IMPORTING
        is_object TYPE ty_s_3d_object
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_exists.

    METHODS remove_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.

    METHODS get_object_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_object) TYPE ty_s_3d_object
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.

    METHODS get_all_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_objects) TYPE ty_t_3d_objects.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_objects TYPE ty_t_3d_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_object_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_object.
    INSERT is_object INTO TABLE mt_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_object.
    DELETE TABLE mt_objects WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_object_by_id.
    READ TABLE mt_objects WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_id INTO rs_object.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_objects.
    rt_objects = mt_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der 3D-Objekte pro Typ aus einer Liste von Objekten unter Verwendung eines modernen ABAP-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit einer `GROUP BY`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_object_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_3d_object,
             id   TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " e.g., 'Cube', 'Sphere'
             color TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_3d_object.
    TYPES: ty_t_3d_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_3d_object WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_object_count,
             object_type TYPE string,
             count       TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_object_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_object_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_object_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_objects_by_type
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE ty_t_3d_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_object_counts) TYPE ty_t_object_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_object_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_objects_by_type.
    rt_object_counts = REDUCE ty_t_object_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_t_object_counts( )
      FOR GROUPS OF object IN it_objects GROUP BY object-type INTO GROUP g
      NEXT counts = VALUE ty_t_object_counts(
        BASE counts
        ( object_type = g
          count       = GROUP SIZE ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von 3D-Objekten in einem Binärformat (z.B. als XSTRING) simuliert, das von einem 3D-Viewer geladen werden könnte, und eine Methode zum 'Dekodieren' dieser Daten bereitstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` oder einfache String-Operationen zur Simulation der Binärdatenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_binary_data_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_3d_object_simple,
             id    TYPE string,
             x     TYPE i,
             y     TYPE i,
             z     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_3d_object_simple.
    TYPES: ty_t_3d_object_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_3d_object_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS encode_objects_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE ty_t_3d_object_simple
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_data) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decode_xstring_to_objects
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_objects) TYPE ty_t_3d_object_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_binary_data_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encode_objects_to_xstring.
    DATA(lv_string) = ``.
    LOOP AT it_objects INTO DATA(ls_object).
      lv_string = lv_string && |{ ls_object-id }:{ ls_object-x },{ ls_object-y },{ ls_object-z };|.
    ENDLOOP.
    rx_data = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_string ). " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8 representation)
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decode_xstring_to_objects.
    DATA(lv_string) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccd( ix_data ). " Convert xstring to string
    DATA(lt_object_strings) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT lv_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_object_strings.

    LOOP AT lt_object_strings INTO DATA(lv_object_string) WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
      SPLIT lv_object_string AT ':' INTO TABLE lt_parts.
      IF lines( lt_parts ) = 2.
        DATA(lv_id) = lt_parts[1].
        DATA(lt_coords) = VALUE string_table( ).
        SPLIT lt_parts[2] AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_coords.
        IF lines( lt_coords ) = 3.
          APPEND VALUE ty_s_3d_object_simple(
            id = lv_id
            x = CONV i( lt_coords[1] )
            y = CONV i( lt_coords[2] )
            z = CONV i( lt_coords[3] )
          ) TO rt_objects.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_encode_decode_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_encode_decode_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_binary_data_handler( ).
    DATA(lt_original_objects) = VALUE zcl_3d_binary_data_handler=>ty_t_3d_object_simple(
      ( id = 'ObjA' x = 10 y = 20 z = 30 )
      ( id = 'ObjB' x = 100 y = 200 z = 300 )
    ).

    DATA(lx_encoded_data) = lo_cut->encode_objects_to_xstring( lt_original_objects ).
    DATA(lt_decoded_objects) = lo_cut->decode_xstring_to_objects( lx_encoded_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_decoded_objects ) exp = lines( lt_original_objects ) msg = 'Decoded object count mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decoded_objects[1]-id exp = lt_original_objects[1]-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decoded_objects[1]-x exp = lt_original_objects[1]-x ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decoded_objects[2]-id exp = lt_original_objects[2]-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decoded_objects[2]-z exp = lt_original_objects[2]-z ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert die Verarbeitung von Binärdaten (XSTRING) für 3D-Objekte. Es zeigt, wie man Daten in ein XSTRING kodiert und wieder dekodiert, was für die Übertragung von großen Datenmengen oder die Interaktion mit Systemen, die Binärformate verwenden, relevant sein kann. `CL_ABAP_CONV_CE` wird für die Konvertierung zwischen STRING und XSTRING verwendet.
keywords: XSTRING, Binärdaten, Kodierung, Dekodierung, 3D Viewer, Object Orientation

    DATA(lv_placeholder) = '<OBJECT_ID>'.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das Flugdatum eines bestimmten Eintrags in einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für eine direkte Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS update_flight_date IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                           iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                           iv_new_fldate TYPE s_date
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_date.
    rt_flights = mt_flights. " Copy for modification

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight.
    READ TABLE rt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-fldate = iv_new_fldate.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie zwei sortierte Tabellen von Flugdaten zusammen. Die resultierende Tabelle soll ebenfalls sortiert sein und keine Duplikate (basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF` mit `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS combine_flights IMPORTING it_flights1 TYPE tt_flights_sorted
                                          it_flights2 TYPE tt_flights_sorted
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_flights.
    rt_combined_flights = it_flights1.
    INSERT LINES OF it_flights2 INTO TABLE rt_combined_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS test_combine_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_combine_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights1) = VALUE tt_flights_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250110' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights2) = VALUE tt_flights_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250120' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_flights( it_flights1 = lt_flights1 it_flights2 = lt_flights2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 4 entries' exp = 4 act = lines( lt_combined ) ).
    DATA(ls_first) = lt_combined[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First carrid' exp = 'AA' act = ls_first-carrid ).
    DATA(ls_last) = lt_combined[ 4 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last carrid' exp = 'UA' act = ls_last-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_combine_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lt_flights1) = VALUE tt_flights_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250110' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights2) = VALUE tt_flights_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) " Duplicate key, different date
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250120' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_flights( it_flights1 = lt_flights1 it_flights2 = lt_flights2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 entries (duplicate ignored)' exp = 3 act = lines( lt_combined ) ).
    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_combined[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Original LH flight date should be kept' exp = '20250101' act = ls_lh_flight-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` Anweisung ist eine effiziente Methode, um Einträge aus einer Tabelle in eine andere sortierte Tabelle einzufügen. Bei `UNIQUE KEY` werden Duplikate ignoriert, was die Integrität der sortierten Tabelle bewahrt.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT LINES OF, Combine Tables, Duplicates

CLASS zcl_xco_current_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_compare_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_comparison_result,
             is_before TYPE abap_bool,
             is_after  TYPE abap_bool,
             is_equal  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_date_comparison_result.

    METHODS compare_dates IMPORTING iv_date1 TYPE d
                                    iv_date2 TYPE d
                          RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_date_comparison_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_compare_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_dates.
    DATA(lo_date1) = xco_cp_time=>date( iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lo_date2) = xco_cp_time=>date( iv_date2 ).

    rs_result-is_before = lo_date1->is_before( lo_date2 )->value( ).
    rs_result-is_after  = lo_date1->is_after( lo_date2 )->value( ).
    rs_result-is_equal  = lo_date1->is_equal_to( lo_date2 )->value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_date_is_before.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_compare_dates( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->compare_dates( iv_date1 = '20250101' iv_date2 = '20250102' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '20250101 should be before 20250102' act = ls_result-is_before ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '20250101 should not be equal to 20250102' act = ls_result-is_equal ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_compare_dates( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->compare_dates( iv_date1 = '20250102' iv_date2 = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '20250102 should not be before 20250101' act = ls_result-is_before ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '20250102 should be after 20250101' act = ls_result-is_after ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '20250102 should not be equal to 20250101' act = ls_result-is_equal ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_compare_dates( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '20250101 should not be after 20250101' act = ls_result-is_after ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten unter Berücksichtigung eines Kalenders (z.B. Fabrikkalender).
hint: Nutzen Sie die XCO Time API in Kombination mit einem Fabrikkalender (z.B. `cl_fima_factory_calendar`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d
                                       iv_end_date   TYPE d
                                       iv_factory_calendar_id TYPE tcal_id
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lo_factory_calendar) = cl_fima_factory_calendar=>get_instance( iv_factory_calendar_id ).
    DATA(lo_start_date) = xco_cp_time=>date( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lo_end_date)   = xco_cp_time=>date( iv_end_date ).

    rv_working_days = 0.
    DATA(lo_current_date) = lo_start_date.

    WHILE lo_current_date->is_before( lo_end_date )->value( ) OR lo_current_date->is_equal_to( lo_end_date )->value( ).
      IF lo_factory_calendar->is_workingday( lo_current_date->value( ) ) = abap_true.
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lo_current_date = lo_current_date->add_days( 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_working_days_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_working_days( ).
    " Assuming 'DE' calendar, 20250101 (Wed) to 20250103 (Fri) -> 3 working days
    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250101' iv_end_date = '20250103' iv_factory_calendar_id = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 working days' exp = 3 act = lv_working_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_working_days_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_working_days( ).
    " Assuming 'DE' calendar, 20250103 (Fri) to 20250106 (Mon) -> 2 working days (Fri, Mon)
    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250103' iv_end_date = '20250106' iv_factory_calendar_id = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 working days (Fri, Mon)' exp = 2 act = lv_working_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_working_days_holiday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_working_days( ).
    " Assuming 'DE' calendar, 20251224 (Tue) to 20251226 (Thu). 25th, 26th are holidays.
    " 24th is working day, 25th holiday, 26th holiday. So 1 working day.
    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20251224' iv_end_date = '20251226' iv_factory_calendar_id = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 working day (24.12)' exp = 1 act = lv_working_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_working_days_same_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_working_days( ).
    " Assuming 'DE' calendar, 20250101 (Wed) is a working day.
    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250101' iv_end_date = '20250101' iv_factory_calendar_id = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 working day for same day' exp = 1 act = lv_working_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus einer sortierten Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und das früheste Flugdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für eine effiziente Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             earliest_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    DATA: ls_summary LIKE LINE OF rt_summary.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      CLEAR ls_summary.
      ls_summary-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_summary-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      ls_summary-earliest_date = REDUCE d( INIT min_date = sy-datum FOR <member> IN GROUP WHERE ( <member>-fldate IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT min_date = COND d( WHEN <member>-fldate < min_date THEN <member>-fldate ELSE min_date ) ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

             fldate   TYPE s_date,

    METHODS test_summarize_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250110' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250106' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights( mt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 summary entries' exp = 3 act = lines( lt_summary ) ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA flight count' exp = 2 act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA earliest date' exp = '20250105' act = ls_aa_summary-earliest_date ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight count' exp = 2 act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH earliest date' exp = '20250101' act = ls_lh_summary-earliest_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE tt_flights_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights( lt_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summary should be empty for empty input' act = lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Liste von Ereignissen, die jeweils ein XCO-Datum und eine XCO-Uhrzeit enthalten, und sortieren Sie diese nach Datum und Uhrzeit.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Struktur mit XCO-Datum- und Uhrzeit-Objekten und verwenden Sie eine `SORTED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_sorted_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             event_id TYPE string,
             event_date TYPE REF TO if_xco_cp_time_date,
             event_time TYPE REF TO if_xco_cp_time_time,
           END OF ty_event.
    TYPES tt_events_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_event WITH UNIQUE KEY event_id.
    TYPES tt_events_sorted_by_dt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_event WITH UNIQUE KEY event_date event_time.

    METHODS create_sorted_events IMPORTING it_raw_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_events) TYPE tt_events_sorted_by_dt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_sorted_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sorted_events.
    LOOP AT it_raw_events INTO DATA(ls_raw_event).
      DATA(ls_event) = VALUE ty_event(
        event_id = ls_raw_event-event_id
        event_date = xco_cp_time=>date( ls_raw_event-event_date->value( ) )
        event_time = xco_cp_time=>time( ls_raw_event-event_time->value( ) )
      ).
      INSERT ls_event INTO TABLE rt_sorted_events.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

           END OF ty_event.

  METHOD test_create_sorted_events.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_sorted_events( ).

    DATA(lt_raw_events) = VALUE tt_events_sorted(
      ( event_id = 'E002' event_date = xco_cp_time=>date( '20250101' ) event_time = xco_cp_time=>time( '100000' ) )
      ( event_id = 'E001' event_date = xco_cp_time=>date( '20250101' ) event_time = xco_cp_time=>time( '090000' ) )
      ( event_id = 'E003' event_date = xco_cp_time=>date( '20250102' ) event_time = xco_cp_time=>time( '080000' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_events) = lo_cut->create_sorted_events( lt_raw_events ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 events' exp = 3 act = lines( lt_sorted_events ) ).

    DATA(ls_first_event) = lt_sorted_events[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First event ID' exp = 'E001' act = ls_first_event-event_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First event date' exp = '20250101' act = ls_first_event-event_date->value( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First event time' exp = '090000' act = ls_first_event-event_time->value( ) ).

    DATA(ls_second_event) = lt_sorted_events[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second event ID' exp = 'E002' act = ls_second_event-event_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second event date' exp = '20250101' act = ls_second_event-event_date->value( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second event time' exp = '100000' act = ls_second_event-event_time->value( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Wochentag (z.B. Montag, Dienstag) für ein gegebenes Datum unter Verwendung der XCO Time API.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_day_of_week()` des XCO Date Objekts und die zugehörigen Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_day_of_week DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_of_week_name IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_day_of_week IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_of_week_name.
    DATA(lo_date) = xco_cp_time=>date( iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = lo_date->get_day_of_week( )->value( ).

    CASE lv_day_of_week.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>monday THEN rv_day_name = 'Montag'.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>tuesday THEN rv_day_name = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>wednesday THEN rv_day_name = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>thursday THEN rv_day_name = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>friday THEN rv_day_name = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>saturday THEN rv_day_name = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN if_xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>sunday THEN rv_day_name = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN rv_day_name = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum und einem Referenzdatum unter Verwendung der XCO Time API.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_difference_in_years()` der XCO Date API.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age IMPORTING iv_birth_date TYPE d
                                    iv_reference_date TYPE d
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_age_in_years) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_str_split_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String, der durch Semikolons getrennte Zahlen enthält, und berechnen Sie die Summe dieser Zahlen. Ungültige Einträge sollen ignoriert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SPLIT` und den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numbers_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers_from_string.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR <part> IN CONV string_table( iv_number_string )
                       WHERE ( <part> IS NOT INITIAL )
                       LET lv_number = COND i( WHEN <part> CO '0123456789 ' THEN CONV i( <part> ) ELSE 0 ) IN
                       NEXT sum = sum + lv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String, der durch Kommas oder Semikolons getrennte Werte enthält, in eine interne Tabelle. Normalisieren Sie zuerst die Trennzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` um alle Trennzeichen zu einem einzigen zu vereinheitlichen, bevor Sie `SPLIT` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_multi_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_normalized_string) = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ';' IN lv_normalized_string WITH ','.
    SPLIT lv_normalized_string AT ',' INTO TABLE rt_parts.
    rt_parts = FILTER #( rt_parts USING KEY default WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
