hint: Verwenden Sie zwei Instanzen von `cl_abap_conv_obj`: eine für die Eingabe (UTF-8) und eine für die Ausgabe (ISO-8859-1).
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_charset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_latin1
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_latin1_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_charset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_latin1.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_xstring_latin1) TYPE xstring.

    " 1. Convert input string (UTF-8) to XSTRING (UTF-8)
    DATA(lo_conv_out_utf8) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_out_utf8->write( EXPORTING data = iv_utf8_string IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring_utf8 ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Convert XSTRING (UTF-8) to XSTRING (ISO-8859-1)
    "    This step implicitly handles character replacement if a character is not representable.
    DATA(lo_conv_in_utf8) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lo_conv_out_latin1) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_in_utf8->convert( EXPORTING input = lv_xstring_utf8
                                  RECEIVING buffer = lv_xstring_latin1
                                  CONVERTER = lo_conv_out_latin1 ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 3. Convert XSTRING (ISO-8859-1) to output string (STRING)
    DATA(lo_conv_in_latin1) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_in_latin1->read( EXPORTING input = lv_xstring_latin1
                                 IMPORTING data = rv_latin1_string ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        rv_latin1_string = ''.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Konvertierung zwischen verschiedenen Zeichensätzen erfordert oft einen Zwischenschritt über XSTRING. Zuerst wird der Eingabestring (UTF-8) in ein UTF-8-XSTRING kodiert. Dann wird dieser XSTRING mit der `convert`-Methode von `cl_abap_conv_obj` direkt in ein XSTRING der Zielkodierung (ISO-8859-1) umgewandelt. Instructions: Splitten Sie einen mehrzeiligen String in einzelne Zeilen und verketten Sie nur die Zeilen, die ein bestimmtes Schlüsselwort enthalten, zu einem neuen String, getrennt durch einen Bindestrich.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` mit `AT CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CR_LF` und `REDUCE` mit `String Templates`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_multiline_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_multiline_text TYPE string
        iv_keyword        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_multiline_string.
    DATA(lt_lines) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_multiline_text AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR <line> IN lt_lines
      WHERE ( <line> CP '*' && iv_keyword && '*' )
      NEXT result = COND string(
                      WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <line>
                      ELSE |{ result }-{ <line> }|
                    )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen einzelnen ABAP-Zeichenwert in seine UTF-8-Byte-Repräsentation (XSTRING) und anschließend wieder zurück in einen Zeichenwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` für die Kodierung und Dekodierung des einzelnen Zeichens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_char_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS char_to_utf8_xstring_and_back
      IMPORTING
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_char_back) TYPE c LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_char_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD char_to_utf8_xstring_and_back.
    DATA(lv_string) TYPE string VALUE iv_char.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_string_back) TYPE string.

    " Convert char (as string) to UTF-8 XSTRING
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_string IMPORTING buffer = lv_xstring_utf8 ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Convert UTF-8 XSTRING back to string
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING input = lv_xstring_utf8 IMPORTING data = lv_string_back ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_char_back = lv_string_back.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String, der durch beliebige Whitespace-Zeichen (Leerzeichen, Tabs, Zeilenumbrüche) getrennte Wörter enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von Strings. Leere Einträge sollen ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` mit `AT SPACE` und `RESPECTING BLANKS` in Kombination mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` für andere Whitespace-Zeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_whitespace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_whitespace
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_whitespace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_whitespace.
    DATA(lv_normalized_string) = iv_input_string.
    " Replace tabs and line breaks with single spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab IN lv_normalized_string WITH ' '.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf IN lv_normalized_string WITH ' '.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>new_line IN lv_normalized_string WITH ' '.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_normalized_string WITH ' '.

    " Split by single space, ignoring leading/trailing/multiple spaces
    SPLIT lv_normalized_string AT ' ' INTO TABLE rt_words.

    " Filter out any remaining empty entries (e.g., if input was just spaces)
    rt_words = FILTER #( rt_words USING KEY default WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine einzelne XSTRING-Variable, wobei jede Zeile als UTF-8 kodiert und durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` und den `REDUCE` Operator mit `String Templates` für die Verkettung der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_string_table TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR <line> IN it_string_table
      NEXT result = COND string(
                      WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <line>
                      ELSE |{ result }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <line> }|
                    )
    ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_concatenated_string
                        IMPORTING buffer = rv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        rv_xstring = ''.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING-Variable, die UTF-8-kodierte Daten enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von Strings, wobei jede Zeile durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt ist. Leere Zeilen sollen ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_obj` für die Dekodierung und anschließend `SPLIT` mit `AT CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CR_LF` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_to_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_to_string_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_string_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_to_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_string_table.
    DATA(lv_string) TYPE string.

    " Convert XSTRING (UTF-8) to string
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING input = iv_xstring
                         IMPORTING data = lv_string ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Split string into table and filter empty lines
    DATA(lt_temp_table) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_temp_table.

    rt_string_table = FILTER #( lt_temp_table USING KEY default
                                WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String, der durch ein bestimmtes Zeichen getrennte Werte enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen. Die Struktur soll zwei Felder für den Schlüssel und den Wert enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` in einer `FOR` Schleife mit dem `VALUE` Operator und `SPLIT` für jeden Teil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_to_struct_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value,
           ty_key_value_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS split_to_key_value_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_pair_delimiter TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_kv_delimiter   TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_value_table) TYPE ty_key_value_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_to_struct_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_to_key_value_table.
    DATA(lt_pairs) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_pair_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    rt_key_value_table = VALUE #( FOR <pair_string> IN lt_pairs
                                  LET lv_key   = ''
                                      lv_value = '' IN
                                  ( COND ty_key_value(
                                      WHEN <pair_string> IS NOT INITIAL AND
                                           <pair_string> CP '*' && iv_kv_delimiter && '*'
                                      THEN ( SPLIT <pair_string> AT iv_kv_delimiter INTO lv_key lv_value )
                                           ( key = lv_key value = lv_value )
                                      ELSE ( key = <pair_string> value = '' )
                                    ) )
                                  WHERE ( key IS NOT INITIAL OR value IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen (z.B. Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT) in eine einzelne XSTRING-Variable im CSV-Format, UTF-8-kodiert. Die erste Zeile soll die Spaltenüberschriften enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `String Templates` für die CSV-Formatierung und `cl_abap_conv_obj` für die Kodierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_csv_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_to_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE'.

    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT csv_string = lv_csv_header
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflight_data
      NEXT csv_string = |{ csv_string }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
                       && |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid },{ <fs_sflight>-connid },{ <fs_sflight>-fldate },{ <fs_sflight>-price }|
    ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_csv_data
                        IMPORTING buffer = rv_csv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_cd_sap_ill_state
            cx_abap_conv_init_error
            cx_abap_conv_illegal_input.
        rv_csv_xstring = ''.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA_PROVIDER` und `ZCL_FLIGHT_ANALYSER`. Die `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA_PROVIDER` soll eine private Methode `_get_raw_flight_data` haben, die nur von `ZCL_FLIGHT_ANALYSER` aufgerufen werden darf. Nutzen Sie die `FRIENDS` Ergänzung, um diese kontrollierte Zugriffsberechtigung zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_data_for_analysis
      IMPORTING
        i_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _get_raw_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        i_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.

    FRIENDS zcl_flight_analyser.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data_for_analysis.
    " This method would typically perform some public-facing logic
    " before calling the private method, or simply delegate.
    r_flights = _get_raw_flight_data( i_carrid = i_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_raw_flight_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE r_flights WHERE carrid = i_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyse_flights
      IMPORTING
        i_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_num_flights) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyse_flights.
    DATA(lo_data_provider) = NEW zcl_flight_data_provider( ).
    " Direct access to private method _get_raw_flight_data is possible due to FRIENDS
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_data_provider->_get_raw_flight_data( i_carrid = i_carrid ).
    r_num_flights = lines( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht eine gezielte Kapselung und Kontrolle des Zugriffs, was die Architektur klarer und sicherer macht, ohne auf öffentliche Methoden ausweichen zu müssen, die möglicherweise unerwünschte Seiteneffekte haben könnten.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_DATA_ACCESS` und eine Klasse `ZCL_SECURE_DATA`. `ZCL_SECURE_DATA` hat eine private Methode `get_sensitive_info`. Nur Klassen, die `ZIF_DATA_ACCESS` implementieren, sollen auf diese Methode zugreifen dürfen. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit `FRIENDS`.
hint: Die `FRIENDS` Ergänzung kann auch mit Interfaces verwendet werden, um allen implementierenden Klassen Zugriff zu gewähren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_access PUBLIC.
  METHODS read_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_secure_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_data RETURNING VALUE(r_data) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sensitive_info RETURNING VALUE(r_sensitive_data) TYPE string.

    FRIENDS INTERFACE zif_data_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_data.
    r_data = 'Public Data'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sensitive_info.
    r_sensitive_data = 'Highly Sensitive Information'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_access.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING i_secure_data TYPE REF TO zcl_secure_data.
    METHODS process_sensitive_data RETURNING VALUE(r_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_secure_data TYPE REF TO zcl_secure_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_access~read_data.
    " This method is part of the interface, but for this example,
    " we focus on the direct access from process_sensitive_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mo_secure_data = i_secure_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_sensitive_data.
    " Direct access to private method get_sensitive_info is possible
    " because ZCL_DATA_CONSUMER implements ZIF_DATA_ACCESS, which is a FRIEND.
    r_result = mo_secure_data->get_sensitive_info( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei interne Tabellen vom Typ `sflights`. Füllen Sie die erste Tabelle mit einigen Einträgen. Fügen Sie dann ausgewählte Einträge aus der ersten Tabelle in die zweite Tabelle ein, indem Sie den `FOR` Operator und `INSERT` verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` und einer `WHERE` Bedingung, um die Zeilenkonstruktion für die zweite Tabelle zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        i_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Populate initial table with some dummy data or from DB
    lt_all_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251203' price = '100.00' )
    ).

    " Use FOR to filter and insert into the result table
    r_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price > i_min_price )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_for( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( i_min_price = '200.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain two filtered flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First filtered flight carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Second filtered flight connection ID mismatch' ).

Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` und `INSERT` Schleife zu schreiben, kann man hier direkt angeben, welche Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle unter welchen Bedingungen in die Zieltabelle übernommen werden sollen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, insbesondere bei Filter- und Mapping-Operationen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur, die einige Felder von `sflights` enthält. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle und fügen Sie dann die Daten in eine `sflights`-Tabelle ein, wobei Sie `CORRESPONDING` verwenden, um die Felder automatisch zuzuordnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT CORRESPONDING` um Felder mit gleichen Namen automatisch zwischen verschiedenen Strukturen zuzuordnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             custom_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_custom_flight.
    TYPES tt_custom_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_custom_flights
      IMPORTING
        i_custom_flights TYPE tt_custom_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_sflights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_custom_flights.
    " INSERT CORRESPONDING FROM TABLE is used here.
    " It automatically maps fields with identical names.
    INSERT CORRESPONDING #(
      FROM i_custom_flights
      MAPPING carrid = carrid
              connid = connid
              fldate = fldate
    ) INTO TABLE r_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_corr( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' custom_field = 'Test1' ) TO lt_custom_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' custom_field = 'Test2' ) TO lt_custom_flights.

    DATA(lt_sflights_result) = lo_cut->transfer_custom_flights( lt_custom_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain two flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20251202' msg = 'Flight date mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT CORRESPONDING` Anweisung, insbesondere mit dem Inline-Mapping `#(...)`, ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen, aber teilweise übereinstimmenden Strukturen zu übertragen. Sie erspart das manuelle Zuweisen jedes einzelnen Feldes in einer Schleife und ist besonders nützlich, wenn nur eine Teilmenge der Felder relevant ist oder die Feldnamen übereinstimmen.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus `sflights` und gruppieren Sie diese nach `CARRID`. Fügen Sie die Ergebnisse in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein, die die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator, um die aggregierten Daten in die Zieltabelle einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary
                            WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE sflights_tab.

    " Read some data from sflights (or use dummy data for testing)
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Group by CARRID and insert into the sorted table
    r_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_and_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) msg = 'Summary table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if grouping works for a known carrier (e.g., LH)
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count msg = 'LH flight count should not be zero' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH carrier not found in summary' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und dem `VALUE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Feature in modernem ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu aggregieren und die Ergebnisse direkt in eine neue Tabelle zu überführen. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und temporären Variablen durch eine deklarative, funktionale Syntax, die sowohl effizienter als auch leichter zu verstehen ist. `GROUP SIZE` ist hierbei eine nützliche vordefinierte Aggregationsfunktion.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, INSERT, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, VALUE, Modern ABAP, Sorted Table

Instructions: Fügen Sie Einträge in eine interne Tabelle ein, aber nur, wenn der Eintrag (basierend auf einem Schlüssel) noch nicht existiert. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` zur Überprüfung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `IF NOT LINE_EXISTS(...)` vor dem `INSERT` oder `APPEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_unique_item.
    TYPES tt_unique_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_unique_item
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_unique_item
      IMPORTING
        i_id   TYPE i
        i_name TYPE string
      CHANGING
        c_items TYPE tt_unique_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_item.
    IF NOT line_exists( c_items[ id = i_id ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( id = i_id name = i_name ) INTO TABLE c_items.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_unique_item FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_unique( ).
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_itab_insert_unique=>tt_unique_item.

    lo_cut->add_unique_item( i_id = 1 i_name = 'Item A' CHANGING c_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 1 msg = 'First item should be added' ).

    lo_cut->add_unique_item( i_id = 2 i_name = 'Item B' CHANGING c_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 2 msg = 'Second item should be added' ).

    lo_cut->add_unique_item( i_id = 1 i_name = 'Item A - Duplicate' CHANGING c_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 2 msg = 'Duplicate item should not be added' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ id = 1 ]-name exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Original item name should be retained' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS` bietet eine performante und lesbare Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle anhand ihres Schlüssels zu überprüfen. In Kombination mit `INSERT` oder `APPEND` kann so einfach sichergestellt werden, dass keine Duplikate eingefügt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei Tabellen mit eindeutigen Schlüsseln und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `READ TABLE` Anweisung gefolgt von einer `SY-SUBRC` Prüfung.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, LINE_EXISTS, Duplicates, Unique Key, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die `PRICE` aus `sflights` pro `CARRID` und fügen Sie die Ergebnisse in eine neue interne Tabelle ein, die `CARRID` und die Summe der Preise enthält. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und einen einzelnen Wert oder eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrier_price_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_price_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_price_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_price_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE sflights_tab.

    " Populate initial table with some dummy data or from DB
    lt_sflights = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251203' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251203' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    " Use REDUCE to aggregate prices per carrier and construct the new table
    r_price_summary = REDUCE tt_carrier_price_sum(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_price_sum( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
      IF lv_index IS INITIAL.
        result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = ls_flight-price ) ).
      ELSE.
        result = VALUE #( BASE result ( KEY lv_index carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = result[ lv_index ]-total_price + ls_flight-price ) ).
      ENDIF.
      FINALLY result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_total_prices_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should contain summary for 3 carriers' ).

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_price exp = '550.00' msg = 'LH total price mismatch' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH carrier not found in summary' ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_price exp = '350.00' msg = 'AA total price mismatch' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'AA carrier not found in summary' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature in ABAP 7.55+, das funktionale Programmierungsmuster für die Aggregation und Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen ermöglicht. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen und die Ergebnisse direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle einzufügen. Die `INIT` Klausel initialisiert das Ergebnis, `FOR` iteriert über die Quelltabelle, und die `LET` und `IF`/`ELSE` Konstrukte ermöglichen die bedingte Aktualisierung oder das Einfügen von Zeilen in das akkumulierte Ergebnis. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, INSERT, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Z-Tabelle (z.B. `ZFLIGHT_LOG` mit `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`). Fügen Sie dann mehrere Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle in diese Z-Tabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ZTABLE FROM TABLE itab` für das Massen-Einfügen von Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_log,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_log.
    TYPES tt_flight_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS log_flights
      IMPORTING
        i_flights TYPE tt_flight_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_flights.
    " Assuming ZFLIGHT_LOG is a custom transparent table with fields CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE
    " CREATE TABLE ZFLIGHT_LOG ( CARRID VARCHAR(3), CONNID VARCHAR(4), FLDATE DATE ) in SE11

    INSERT zflight_log FROM TABLE @i_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      r_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      r_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_log_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_from_itab( ).
    DATA lt_flights_to_log TYPE zcl_db_insert_from_itab=>tt_flight_log.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights_to_log.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) TO lt_flights_to_log.

    " Clean up ZFLIGHT_LOG before test to ensure consistent state
    DELETE FROM zflight_log WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->log_flights( i_flights = lt_flights_to_log ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Flights should be logged successfully' ).

    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zflight_log INTO @lv_count WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Two flights should be in the log table' ).

    " Clean up after test
    DELETE FROM zflight_log WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT dbtab FROM TABLE @itab` Syntax ist der Standardweg, um mehrere Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle effizient in eine Datenbanktabelle einzufügen. Die Verwendung des Inline-Deklarationsoperators `@` für die interne Tabelle ist Teil des modernen ABAP-Stils und verbessert die Lesbarkeit. Diese Methode ist performanter als das Einfügen einzelner Zeilen in einer Schleife, da sie die Datenbankzugriffe minimiert.
keywords: Database, INSERT, Z-Table, Internal Tables, Mass Insert, Open SQL, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Fügen Sie direkt Daten aus der `sflights` Tabelle in eine benutzerdefinierte Z-Tabelle (`ZFLIGHT_SUMMARY`) ein, die nur `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` enthält, ohne die Daten zuerst in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `INSERT ... SELECT ...` Anweisung, um Daten direkt von einer Datenbanktabelle in eine andere zu kopieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transfer_sflights_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        i_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_rows_inserted) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_sflights_to_summary.
    " Assuming ZFLIGHT_SUMMARY is a custom transparent table with fields CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE
    " CREATE TABLE ZFLIGHT_SUMMARY ( CARRID VARCHAR(3), CONNID VARCHAR(4), FLDATE DATE ) in SE11

    INSERT zflight_summary FROM
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @i_carrid.

    r_rows_inserted = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_select( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'AA'.

    " Clean up ZFLIGHT_SUMMARY before test to ensure consistent state
    DELETE FROM zflight_summary WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid.

    DATA lv_sflights_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_sflights_count WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid.

    DATA(lv_rows_inserted) = lo_cut->transfer_sflights_to_summary( i_carrid = lv_test_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_inserted exp = lv_sflights_count msg = 'Number of inserted rows should match sflights count' ).

    DATA lv_summary_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zflight_summary INTO @lv_summary_count WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_summary_count exp = lv_sflights_count msg = 'Number of rows in summary table should match sflights count' ).

    " Clean up after test
    DELETE FROM zflight_summary WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... SELECT ...` Anweisung ist die effizienteste Methode, um Daten direkt von einer Datenbanktabelle in eine andere zu kopieren, ohne den Umweg über eine interne Tabelle im Anwendungsserver. Dies minimiert den Datentransfer zwischen Datenbank und Anwendungsserver und ist daher besonders performant bei großen Datenmengen. Die Syntax ist deklarativ und leicht verständlich, was sie zu einer modernen Wahl für solche Szenarien macht.
keywords: Database, INSERT, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, Direct Transfer, Open SQL, Performance, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag an einer bestimmten Position in eine interne Tabelle ein.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_index IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ) TO lt_items.

Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Reihenfolge der Elemente eine Rolle spielt und nicht nur das Anhängen am Ende der Tabelle. Die Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators für die Zeilenkonstruktion ist hierbei der moderne Ansatz.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, Index, Position, VALUE, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Zeilen einer internen Tabelle in eine andere interne Tabelle ein, wobei Sie den `INSERT LINES OF` Operator verwenden.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_itab_insert_lines=>tt_data.
    DATA lt_target TYPE zcl_itab_insert_lines=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( key = 2 value = 'B' ) TO lt_source.

explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF` Anweisung ist die einfachste und effizienteste Methode, um den gesamten Inhalt einer internen Tabelle in eine andere zu kopieren. Sie ist performanter als das Schleifen über die Quelltabelle und das individuelle Einfügen jeder Zeile. Dies ist ein grundlegendes, aber wichtiges Feature für die Manipulation interner Tabellen in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Fügen Sie dann nur die Flüge mit einem `CARRID` von 'LH' in eine neue interne Tabelle ein, indem Sie den `FILTER` Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      IMPORTING
        i_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_lh_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    r_lh_flights = FILTER #( i_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_filter( ).
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_itab_insert_filter=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251203' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( i_all_flights = lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_lh_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain 2 LH flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_lh_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_lh_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Second flight connection ID mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, indem Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen ausgewählt werden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu filtern, da es den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als eine explizite `LOOP` mit `IF` und `APPEND`. Die Angabe des Schlüssels (`USING KEY primary_key`) kann die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, INSERT, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming, Modern ABAP, Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Fügen Sie dann neue Einträge in diese Tabelle ein, aber nur, wenn der `CARRID` und `CONNID` noch nicht existieren. Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder nutzen Sie eine Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_no_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
                          WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        i_new_flights TYPE tt_flight_key
      CHANGING
        c_existing_flights TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_no_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_flights.
    " When inserting into a table with a UNIQUE key, duplicates are automatically rejected.
    " The ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS addition is implicitly handled by the unique key definition.
    " sy-subrc will be 4 for duplicates.
    INSERT LINES OF i_new_flights INTO TABLE c_existing_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_no_dup( ).
    DATA lt_existing_flights TYPE zcl_itab_insert_no_dup=>tt_flight_key.
    DATA lt_new_flights TYPE zcl_itab_insert_no_dup=>tt_flight_key.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_existing_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_new_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_new_flights. " Duplicate
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' ) TO lt_new_flights.

    lo_cut->add_unique_flights( i_new_flights = lt_new_flights CHANGING c_existing_flights = lt_existing_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should contain 3 unique flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' msg = 'Second flight carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Third flight carrier ID mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wenn eine interne Tabelle mit einem `UNIQUE KEY` definiert ist, werden beim Einfügen von Zeilen (mittels `INSERT` oder `APPEND`) Duplikate automatisch abgelehnt. Die `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` Ergänzung ist hier nicht explizit notwendig, da das Verhalten durch den eindeutigen Schlüssel der Tabelle gesteuert wird. `sy-subrc` wird auf 4 gesetzt, wenn Duplikate abgelehnt wurden. Dies ist der sauberste und performanteste Weg, um die Eindeutigkeit von Einträgen in internen Tabellen zu gewährleisten.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, Unique Key, Duplicates, Sorted Table, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und ein ALV-Feldschema zur Anzeige von Daten, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Verwenden Sie die Struktur 'SFLIGHT' als Beispiel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_alv_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE tabname
      EXPORTING
        eo_data_ref       TYPE REF TO data
        et_field_catalog  TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_alv_data.
    DATA:
      lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
      lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
      lo_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_structure_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        " Fill with some dummy data for demonstration
        IF iv_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          DATA(ls_sflight_line) = VALUE ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '1000.00' currency = 'EUR' ).
          APPEND ls_sflight_line TO <fs_table>.
          ls_sflight_line = VALUE ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' ).
          APPEND ls_sflight_line TO <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.

        cl_alv_table_create=>create_fieldcatalog(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = iv_structure_name
          IMPORTING
            et_fieldcatalog  = et_field_catalog
        ).

        eo_data_ref = lo_data.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        " Handle error
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value
            value  = iv_structure_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_alv_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_alv_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_creator( ).
    DATA lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lt_field_catalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    lo_cut->create_dynamic_alv_data(
      EXPORTING
        iv_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        eo_data_ref       = lo_data_ref
        et_field_catalog  = lt_field_catalog
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Data reference should not be initial' act = lo_data_ref IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field catalog should not be initial' act = lt_field_catalog IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field catalog should have entries' exp = 5 act = lines( lt_field_catalog ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic table should have 2 entries' exp = 2 act = lines( <fs_table> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle und eines ALV-Feldschemas zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der anzuzeigenden Daten nicht im Voraus bekannt ist. Die Klasse `cl_abap_structdescr` wird verwendet, um die Struktur zu beschreiben, und `cl_alv_table_create` generiert das Feldschema. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für flexible Berichterstattung.
keywords: cl_alv_table_create, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, ALV

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 10 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und moderne interne Tabellenoperationen (z.B. `FOR`, `FILTER`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_number_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE i_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_number_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).

    DATA(lt_unique_numbers) = VALUE hashed_int_table( ).
    DATA(lv_current_count) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_count < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_random_num INTO TABLE lt_unique_numbers.
          lv_current_count = lv_current_count + 1.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
          " Number already exists, try again
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_random_numbers = VALUE i_table( FOR num IN lt_unique_numbers ( num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_number_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->generate_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ). " Generate 10 unique numbers between 1 and 10

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should generate 10 numbers' exp = 10 act = lines( lt_numbers ) ).

    " Check for uniqueness (by converting to hashed table and checking lines)
    DATA(lt_check_unique) = VALUE hashed_int_table( FOR num IN lt_numbers ( num ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Numbers should be unique' exp = 10 act = lines( lt_check_unique ) ).

    " Check range
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Number should be >= 1' act = lv_num GE 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Number should be <= 10' act = lv_num LE 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_random_int` bietet eine robuste Möglichkeit, Zufallszahlen zu generieren. In Kombination mit einer `HASHED TABLE` und einer `WHILE`-Schleife können effizient eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Zufallszahlen erzeugt werden. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` am Ende ist ein modernes Feature zur Transformation der Hashed Table in eine Standardtabelle.
keywords: cl_abap_random_int, Random Numbers, Internal Tables, FOR, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT`), füllen Sie diese mit zufälligen Daten (z.B. Flugnummern, Preise) und generieren Sie ein ALV-Feldschema.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und `cl_abap_random_int` (sowie `cl_abap_random_char`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_random_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_alv_with_random_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE tabname
        iv_num_entries    TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      EXPORTING
        eo_data_ref       TYPE REF TO data
        et_field_catalog  TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_random_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_alv_with_random_data.
    DATA:
      lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
      lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
      lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
      lo_random_int   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_random_int,
      lo_random_char  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_random_char.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
      <fs_line>  TYPE any,
      <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_structure_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        lo_random_int = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 9999 ).
        lo_random_char = cl_abap_random_char=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( ) ).

        DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
          CREATE DATA <fs_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
          ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.

          LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp_descr).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_descr-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              CASE ls_comp_descr-type_kind.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
                  <fs_comp> = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                  <fs_comp> = lo_random_char->get_next( p_length = ls_comp_descr-length ).
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
                  <fs_comp> = sy-datum - lo_random_int->get_next( ).
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_curr.
                  <fs_comp> = lo_random_int->get_next( ) * 100. " Example: random price
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_cuky.
                  <fs_comp> = 'EUR'. " Default currency
                WHEN OTHERS.
                  " Do nothing or assign default
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDDO.

        cl_alv_table_create=>create_fieldcatalog(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = iv_structure_name
          IMPORTING
            et_fieldcatalog  = et_field_catalog
        ).

        eo_data_ref = lo_data.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value
            value  = iv_structure_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_alv_random_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_alv_random_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_random_data( ).
    DATA lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lt_field_catalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA(lv_num_entries) = 3.

    lo_cut->create_alv_with_random_data(
      EXPORTING
        iv_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        iv_num_entries    = lv_num_entries
      IMPORTING
        eo_data_ref       = lo_data_ref
        et_field_catalog  = lt_field_catalog
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Data reference should not be initial' act = lo_data_ref IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field catalog should not be initial' act = lt_field_catalog IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field catalog should have entries' exp = 5 act = lines( lt_field_catalog ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic table should have correct number of entries' exp = lv_num_entries act = lines( <fs_table> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung mit der Generierung von Zufallsdaten. Es nutzt RTTI, um die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zu identifizieren und füllt diese dann mit zufälligen Werten unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_int` und `cl_abap_random_char`. Dies ist ideal für Testdaten oder flexible Berichte, bei denen die Daten zur Laufzeit generiert werden müssen.
keywords: cl_alv_table_create, cl_abap_random_int, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, ALV, SFLIGHT, RTTI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern, Fluggesellschaften und Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` enthält, für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `WHERE` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_date.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( fldate > iv_date )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        fldate = flight-fldate ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_after_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_after_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data_transformer( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365. " One year ago

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_after_date( lv_test_date ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has data, there should be entries
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find flights after test date' act = lt_flights ).

    " Check if all returned flights are indeed after the test date
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Flight date must be after test date' act = ls_flight-fldate > lv_test_date ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` zu verwenden, kann die neue Tabelle direkt mit den gewünschten Feldern und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung initialisiert werden. Dies verbessert die Code-Qualität und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, SFLIGHT, Table Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_airline.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0. " Calculate manually for test data

    DATA lt_sflight_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_test WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_test INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_expected_price = lv_expected_price + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_airline( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price should match' exp = lv_expected_price act = lv_actual_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife über eine Tabelle zu iterieren und dabei einen Wert schrittweise zu akkumulieren. Dies führt zu sehr prägnantem Code für Summierungen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionsoperationen, die zuvor oft eine explizite `LOOP` und eine Hilfsvariable erforderten.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, SFLIGHT, Aggregation, Table Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Service zur Datenbeschaffung) über den Konstruktor injiziert. Definieren Sie ein Interface für den Service.
hint: Nutzen Sie `IMPORTING` Parameter im `CONSTRUCTOR` und ein Interface für die Abhängigkeit.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider.
  METHODS get_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    APPEND 'Data Line 1' TO rt_data.
    APPEND 'Data Line 2' TO rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.

    METHODS process_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_data) = mo_data_provider->get_data( ).
    rv_result = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN lt_data
      NEXT s = s && line && |
|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    " Mock-Implementierung des Data Providers für den Test
    CLASS lcl_mock_data_provider DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
        APPEND 'Mock Data A' TO rt_data.
        APPEND 'Mock Data B' TO rt_data.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_mock_provider) = NEW lcl_mock_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_data_consumer( io_data_provider = lo_mock_provider ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_consumer->process_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain mock data A' sub = 'Mock Data A' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain mock data B' sub = 'Mock Data B' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'Result should not contain real data' sub = 'Data Line 1' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konstruktor-Injektion ist ein grundlegendes Prinzip der Objektorientierung, das die Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit von Code erheblich verbessert. Indem Abhängigkeiten über den Konstruktor übergeben werden, wird die Klasse von der konkreten Implementierung der Abhängigkeit entkoppelt. Dies ermöglicht es, im Unit-Test Mock-Objekte zu verwenden, ohne den Code der zu testenden Klasse ändern zu müssen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Interfaces, Testability

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn der Flugpreis über 1000 liegt, soll 'Premium' zugewiesen werden, sonst 'Economy'.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count,
      tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_airline
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_airline.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_airline( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should return flight counts' act = lt_flight_counts ).

    " Example: Check count for a specific airline (e.g., 'LH')
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_lh_count) = 0.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_lh_count.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight count should match' exp = lv_expected_lh_count act = ls_lh_count-count ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check that all entries have a count > 0
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Count should be greater than 0' act = ls_count_entry-count > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein sehr effizientes und elegantes Mittel, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Informationen zu verarbeiten. Sie ermöglicht es, über Gruppen von Zeilen zu iterieren, anstatt über einzelne Zeilen, was den Code für Gruppierungsaufgaben erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessern kann.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, SFLIGHT, Aggregation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt, und geben Sie den Rest des Strings zurück, falls ja.
hint: Verwenden Sie `STARTS WITH` und `SUBSTRING` oder `REPLACE` mit `REGEX`.

CLASS zcl_string_prefix_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_string_after_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_string TYPE string
        iv_prefix      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_prefix_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string_after_prefix.
    IF iv_full_string STARTS WITH iv_prefix.
      rv_remaining_string = iv_full_string+sy-fdpos( ). " sy-fdpos holds the length of the prefix
    ELSE.
      rv_remaining_string = iv_full_string. " Or initial, depending on requirement
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_string_after_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_string_after_prefix.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_prefix_checker( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->get_string_after_prefix( iv_full_string = 'HELLO_WORLD' iv_prefix = 'HELLO_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should return WORLD' exp = 'WORLD' act = lv_result1 ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->get_string_after_prefix( iv_full_string = 'ABAP_PROGRAM' iv_prefix = 'JAVA_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should return full string' exp = 'ABAP_PROGRAM' act = lv_result2 ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->get_string_after_prefix( iv_full_string = 'TEST' iv_prefix = 'TEST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should return empty string' exp = '' act = lv_result3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `STARTS WITH`-Operator ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt. In Kombination mit der Offset- und Längenangabe `+sy-fdpos()` kann der verbleibende Teil des Strings einfach extrahiert werden, ohne auf komplexere String-Funktionen zurückgreifen zu müssen. Dies ist sehr performant und lesbar.
keywords: String Processing, STARTS WITH, SUBSTRING, String Operations

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` nach Flügen, die einen bestimmten Mindestpreis und ein bestimmtes Ziel haben, und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_filtered_flight,
      tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_cityto    TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE price >= iv_min_price AND cityto = iv_cityto 
    ) THEN MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    DATA(lv_min_price) = 500.
    DATA(lv_cityto) = 'NEW YORK'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_min_price = lv_min_price iv_cityto = lv_cityto ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has data, check if entries are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should return filtered flights' act = lt_filtered ).

    " Verify that all returned flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_filtered_flight).
      DATA ls_original_flight TYPE sflight.
      READ TABLE sflight INTO ls_original_flight WITH KEY carrid = ls_filtered_flight-carrid connid = ls_filtered_flight-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cityto should match' exp = lv_cityto act = ls_original_flight-cityto ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Price should be >= min_price' act = ls_original_flight-price >= lv_min_price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ermöglicht es, eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die einer bestimmten Bedingung entsprechen. In Kombination mit `THEN MAPPING` können die Felder der resultierenden Tabelle direkt auf die gewünschten Felder der Quelltabelle abgebildet werden, was den Code sehr prägnant und effizient macht.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt. Verwenden Sie ein Interface für die gemeinsamen Methoden der erstellten Objekte.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface und eine statische Factory-Methode mit `CASE` oder `COND`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_price
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_car DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_model TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_model TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_car IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_model = iv_model.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = |Car: { mv_model }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_price.
    rv_price = 50000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bike DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_type TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bike IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_type = iv_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = |Bike: { mv_type }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_price.
    rv_price = 1500.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
        iv_detail       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'CAR'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_car( iv_detail ).
      WHEN 'BIKE'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_bike( iv_detail ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value
            value  = iv_product_type.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_method.
    DATA(lo_car) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( iv_product_type = 'CAR' iv_detail = 'Sedan' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Car object should be created' act = lo_car ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Car name should be correct' exp = 'Car: Sedan' act = lo_car->get_name( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Car price should be correct' exp = 50000 act = lo_car->get_price( ) ).

    DATA(lo_bike) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( iv_product_type = 'BIKE' iv_detail = 'Mountain' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Bike object should be created' act = lo_bike ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bike name should be correct' exp = 'Bike: Mountain' act = lo_bike->get_name( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bike price should be correct' exp = 1500 act = lo_bike->get_price( ) ).

    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( iv_product_type = 'UNKNOWN' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for unknown product type' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught exception for unknown product type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Method-Pattern ist ein Entwurfsmuster, das die Erstellung von Objekten von der aufrufenden Logik entkoppelt. Eine statische Methode (`create_product`) in einer Factory-Klasse ist dafür verantwortlich, die korrekte Instanz einer Klasse zu erstellen, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementiert. Dies fördert die Flexibilität, da neue Produkttypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die Client-Code-Logik ändern zu müssen, und verbessert die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Method, Design Patterns, Interfaces, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV Grid in einem Docking Container. Befüllen Sie es mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Verwenden Sie den `INSERT` Operator, um die gefilterten Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle einzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_docking_container` und `cl_salv_table`. Für die Datenfilterung und das Einfügen in die interne Tabelle verwenden Sie `FOR` und `INSERT` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_alv_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS display_flights.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_alv_table       TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    METHODS create_screen.
    METHODS create_alv_in_docking.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    create_screen( ).
    create_alv_in_docking( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_filtered_flights( ).
    TRY.
        mo_alv_table->set_data_ref( EXPORTING r_data = REF TO lt_flights ).
        mo_alv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'ALV-Fehler' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_screen.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_SET_SELSCREEN_STATUS'
      EXPORTING
        p_status  = 'STANDARD'
        p_program = sy-repid.
    SET SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_in_docking.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = sy-repid
        dynnr     = '0100'
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 500. " Width in pixels

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS       = 1
        ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'ALV-Factory-Fehler' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
    mo_alv_table->set_container( mo_docking_container ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " Modern ABAP: Filter and INSERT into new table
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( seatsocc < seatsmax )
                             ( INSERT flight INTO TABLE rt_sflights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
