CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_alv_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsocc < ls_flight-seatsmax )
                                        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } has invalid seats: { ls_flight-seatsocc }/{ ls_flight-seatsmax }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Daten werden mit einem modernen `SELECT` Statement aus der Datenbank gelesen und anschließend mit dem `VALUE` Operator und `FOR` Schleife gefiltert. Der `INSERT` Operator wird hier implizit innerhalb des `VALUE` Konstrukts verwendet, um die gefilterten Zeilen in die Ergebnistabelle einzufügen. Dies ist eine kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ausgewählte Felder aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine benutzerdefinierte Datenbanktabelle `ZFLIGHT_LOG` (muss existieren und passende Felder haben) einfügt. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung und `INSERT` für die Datenbankoperation.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Struktur, die den Feldern von `ZFLIGHT_LOG` entspricht. Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` zur Zuweisung von `sflight` Daten und `INSERT` für die Datenbank.
solution:
" Voraussetzung: Datenbanktabelle ZFLIGHT_LOG existiert mit Feldern wie CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE, CURRENCY, LOG_DATE, LOG_TIME
" CREATE TABLE ZFLIGHT_LOG ( CARRID S_CARR_ID, CONNID S_CONN_ID, FLDATE S_DATE, PRICE S_PRICE, CURRENCY S_CURRCODE, LOG_DATE DATS, LOG_TIME TIMS )

CLASS zcl_db_insert_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_log,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             log_date TYPE dats,
             log_time TYPE tims,
           END OF ty_flight_log.
    TYPES tt_flight_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS log_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                  iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_flights.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA ls_flight_log TYPE ty_flight_log.
      " Modern ABAP: CORRESPONDING for field assignment
      ls_flight_log = CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight MAPPING carrid = carrid
                                                connid = connid
                                                fldate = fldate
                                                price = price
                                                currency = currency ).
      ls_flight_log-log_date = sy-datum.
      ls_flight_log-log_time = sy-uzeit.

      " Explicit INSERT statement for database
      INSERT INTO zflight_log VALUES @ls_flight_log.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      END IF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Sortieren Sie diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Fügen Sie dann neue Einträge in eine zweite interne Tabelle ein, die eine fortlaufende Nummerierung basierend auf der Position in der sortierten Tabelle enthält. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` mit `sy-tabix`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT` für die interne Tabelle und `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` mit `INSERT` und `sy-tabix` für die Nummerierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_numbered_flight,
             number   TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_numbered_flight.
    TYPES tt_numbered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_numbered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_numbered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbered_flights) TYPE tt_numbered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_numbered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING.

    DATA ls_numbered_flight TYPE ty_numbered_flight.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ls_numbered_flight-number = sy-tabix.
      ls_numbered_flight-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_numbered_flight-connid = ls_flight-connid.
      ls_numbered_flight-fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      " Explicit INSERT statement for internal table
      INSERT ls_numbered_flight INTO TABLE rt_numbered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_numbered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_numbered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_numbered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_number) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_numbered_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_numbered_flight-number exp = lv_expected_number
                                          msg = |Entry { lv_expected_number } has wrong number| ).
      lv_expected_number = lv_expected_number + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Einfügen von Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle mit dem `INSERT` Statement. Nach dem Sortieren der Quelltabelle wird in einer Schleife jeder Eintrag mit einer fortlaufenden Nummer versehen, die durch `sy-tabix` (den aktuellen Zeilenindex) bestimmt wird. Dies ist eine klassische, aber immer noch relevante Methode, um Daten in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge in eine neue Tabelle zu übertragen und dabei Metadaten wie eine Zeilennummer hinzuzufügen.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, SORT, LOOP, sy-tabix

CLASS zcl_gui_event_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) verarbeitet. Für jede Fluggesellschaft soll ein neuer Eintrag in einer Ergebnistabelle erstellt werden, der die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl ihrer Flüge enthält. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit `INSERT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und zu zählen. Innerhalb des `REDUCE` können Sie `INSERT` verwenden, um die Ergebnisse in die Zieltabelle einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight UP TO 20 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Modern ABAP: REDUCE with implicit INSERT
    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = flight-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT result = COND tt_flight_count(
        WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL THEN
          VALUE #( result ( carrid = flight-carrid count = 1 ) )
        ELSE
          VALUE #( result ( INSERT VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = flight-carrid count = result[ lv_index ]-count + 1 ) INTO result INDEX lv_index ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT VALUE ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_count-count > 0 ) msg = 'LH flight count should be greater than 0' ).

    " Verify uniqueness of carrid
    DATA(lv_unique_carrids) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lv_unique_carrids = lv_unique_carrids + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_carrids exp = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Carrids should be unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten zu aggregieren. Für jede Fluggesellschaft wird die Anzahl der Flüge gezählt. Der `INSERT` Operator wird hier innerhalb des `COND` Ausdrucks verwendet, um entweder einen neuen Eintrag in die Ergebnistabelle einzufügen (wenn die Fluggesellschaft noch nicht vorhanden ist) oder einen bestehenden Eintrag zu aktualisieren (indem ein neuer Eintrag an der gleichen Position eingefügt wird, was den alten überschreibt, oder durch direkte Modifikation). Dies demonstriert eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation und -manipulation.

      EXPORTING

    mo_execute_button->set_text( 'Code ausführen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_generate_click.
    DATA(lv_code) = mo_text_editor->get_text_as_stream( ).
    " Example of dynamic code insertion (e.g., adding a timestamp)
    DATA(lv_timestamp_line) = |* Code generated on { sy-datum } at { sy-uzeit }\n|.
    INSERT lv_timestamp_line INTO lv_code AT 0.

    DATA(lv_code) = mo_text_editor->get_text_as_stream( ).

    DATA lt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    SPLIT iv_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_source.

    GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL mv_program_name FROM lt_source.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE 'Dynamischer Code erfolgreich generiert.' TYPE 'S'.
      PERFORM start_of_selection IN PROGRAM (mv_program_name).
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler bei der Codegenerierung.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Tabelle `sflight` einzufügen. Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung, die bei einem doppelten Primärschlüssel (was zu einem Fehler führt) eine entsprechende Meldung ausgibt und den `INSERT` rückgängig macht. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` und `ROLLBACK WORK`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT` für die Datenbankoperation und überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc`. Bei einem Fehler verwenden Sie `ROLLBACK WORK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS insert_flight_with_error_handling IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                                      iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                                      iv_fldate TYPE s_date
                                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_with_error_handling.
    DATA ls_new_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_new_flight-carrid = iv_carrid.
    ls_new_flight-connid = iv_connid.
    ls_new_flight-fldate = iv_fldate.
    ls_new_flight-price = '100.00'.
    ls_new_flight-currency = 'EUR'.
    ls_new_flight-planetype = 'A320'.
    ls_new_flight-seatsmax = 150.
    ls_new_flight-seatsocc = 50.

    " Start a database LUW
    CALL FUNCTION 'DB_COMMIT'. " Implicitly starts a new LUW

    " Explicit INSERT statement for database
    INSERT sflight FROM @ls_new_flight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE 'Flug erfolgreich eingefügt.' TYPE 'S'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DB_COMMIT'. " Commit the changes
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4. " Duplicate primary key
      MESSAGE 'Fehler: Flug existiert bereits (doppelter Primärschlüssel).' TYPE 'E'.
      ROLLBACK WORK. " Rollback the changes
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Einfügen des Fluges.' TYPE 'E'.
      ROLLBACK WORK. " Rollback the changes
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  DATA: mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'XX',
        mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE 'TEST',
        mv_fldate TYPE s_date    VALUE '20251231'.

  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test data does not exist before test
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Clean up test data after test
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_error_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_with_error_handling(
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Insert should be successful' ).
    " Verify insertion
    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_check_carrid)
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'Inserted flight not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate_key.
    " First insert to create the duplicate
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid = mv_carrid.
    ls_flight-connid = mv_connid.
    ls_flight-fldate = mv_fldate.
    INSERT sflight FROM @ls_flight.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_error_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_with_error_handling(
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Insert should fail due to duplicate key' ).
    " Verify no new insertion (only the first one should exist)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count)
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 msg = 'Only one flight should exist after duplicate insert attempt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung des `INSERT` Statements für Datenbanktabellen in Kombination mit einer robusten Fehlerbehandlung. Es wird versucht, einen Flugdatensatz in `sflight` einzufügen. Bei Erfolg wird die Transaktion mit `COMMIT WORK` bestätigt. Tritt jedoch ein Fehler auf, insbesondere ein doppelter Primärschlüssel (`sy-subrc = 4`), wird die Transaktion mit `ROLLBACK WORK` rückgängig gemacht, um die Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten. Dies ist entscheidend für zuverlässige Datenbankoperationen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und darin einen `cl_gui_picture` anzeigt. Die Klasse soll eine Methode haben, die ein Bild dynamisch lädt und anzeigt. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` um die Bilddaten in eine interne Tabelle zu laden, bevor sie an den Picture-Control übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_docking_container`, `cl_gui_picture` und `cl_mime_helper` zum Laden von Bilddaten. Die Bilddaten müssen in eine `STANDARD TABLE OF RAWSTRING` geladen werden, bevor sie mit `INSERT` in den Picture-Control übergeben werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_picture_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS display_picture_in_docking.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_picture           TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.
    METHODS create_screen.
    METHODS create_picture_in_docking.
    METHODS load_and_display_picture.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture_in_docking.
    create_screen( ).
    create_picture_in_docking( ).
    load_and_display_picture( ).
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_screen.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_SET_SELSCREEN_STATUS'
      EXPORTING
        p_status  = 'STANDARD'
        p_program = sy-repid.
    SET SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_picture_in_docking.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = sy-repid
        dynnr     = '0100'
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 600.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_picture
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_and_display_picture.
    DATA lt_picture_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF rawstring.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Example: Load a standard SAP icon (e.g., from MIME repository or a simple XSTRING)
    " For a real scenario, you would fetch from DB, URL, or MIME repository
    " Here, we simulate loading a small XSTRING (e.g., a base64 decoded image)
    " In a real system, you might use cl_mime_helper=>get_mime_object_from_url or similar.
    lv_xstring = '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'. " A tiny 1x1 GIF

    " Convert XSTRING to table of RAWSTRING
    DATA(lv_length) = xstrlen( lv_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_chunk_size) = 1024.

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      DATA(lv_chunk) = lv_xstring+lv_offset(lv_chunk_size).
      " Explicit INSERT statement for internal table
      INSERT lv_chunk INTO TABLE lt_picture_data.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.

    mo_picture->load_picture_from_data( EXPORTING size = lv_length
                                                  data = lt_picture_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_picture_data_insertion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_picture_insert( ).
    " Simulate the logic of load_and_display_picture up to data preparation
    DATA lt_picture_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF rawstring.
    DATA lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    lv_xstring = '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`). Filtern Sie diese Tabelle nach Flügen, die ein bestimmtes Ziel haben, und fügen Sie die gefilterten Einträge in eine neue interne Tabelle ein. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `INSERT`.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dest,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_dest.
    TYPES tt_flight_dest TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_dest WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_to_destination IMPORTING iv_cityto TYPE s_cityname
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_dest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_to_destination.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityto FROM sflight UP TO 20 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " Modern ABAP: FILTER operator with implicit INSERT into new table
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE cityto = iv_cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` liest. Formatieren Sie diese Liste als einen einzigen String, wobei Sie dynamisch Trennzeichen und zusätzliche Informationen einfügen. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` für die String-Manipulation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` für die Fluggesellschaften und `LOOP AT ... INTO ...`. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` für Strings, um die Liste zu formatieren.

CLASS zcl_str_insert_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS format_carrier_list RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_insert_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_carrier_list.
    DATA lt_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_carrids.

    DATA(lv_result_string) = `Verfügbare Fluggesellschaften: `.
    DATA(lv_first_entry) = abap_true.

    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      IF lv_first_entry = abap_false.
        " Explicit INSERT statement for strings to add separator
        INSERT `, ` INTO lv_result_string AT strlen( lv_result_string ).
      ENDIF.
      INSERT lv_carrid INTO lv_result_string AT strlen( lv_result_string ).
      lv_first_entry = abap_false.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_formatted_list = lv_result_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` mit einem `cl_gui_input_field` und einem Button. Wenn der Benutzer Text in das Eingabefeld eingibt und den Button klickt, soll dieser Text in eine interne Log-Tabelle eingefügt werden. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` für die interne Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_input_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS display_input_field.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_input_field       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_input_field.
    DATA mo_button            TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             text      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_log_entries TYPE tt_log_entries.
    METHODS create_screen.
    METHODS create_controls_in_docking.
    METHODS on_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_input_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_input_field.
    create_screen( ).
    create_controls_in_docking( ).
    SET HANDLER on_button_click FOR mo_button.
    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_screen.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_SET_SELSCREEN_STATUS'
      EXPORTING
        p_status  = 'STANDARD'
        p_program = sy-repid.
    SET SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_controls_in_docking.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = sy-repid
        dynnr     = '0100'
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_top
        extension = 150.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_input_field
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container.
    mo_input_field->set_text( 'Geben Sie Text ein' ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container.
    mo_button->set_text( 'Loggen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_button_click.
    DATA(lv_input_text) = mo_input_field->get_text( ).
    DATA(ls_log_entry) = VALUE ty_log_entry(
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( )
      text      = lv_input_text
    ).
    " Explicit INSERT statement for internal table
    INSERT ls_log_entry INTO TABLE mt_log_entries.

    MESSAGE |Text '{ lv_input_text }' geloggt. Aktuelle Einträge: { lines( mt_log_entries ) }| TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 zufälligen Flugbuchungen. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`, um zufällige Werte für die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` zu erzeugen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      generate_random_flights
        IMPORTING
          iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_carrid) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 2 ). " Assuming 2 carriers for simplicity
    DATA(lo_random_connid) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 9999 ).
    DATA(lo_random_day)    = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 365 ).

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                          ( carrid = COND #( WHEN lo_random_carrid->get_next( ) = 1 THEN 'LH' ELSE 'AA' )
                            connid = lo_random_connid->get_next( )
                            fldate = lv_current_date + lo_random_day->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->generate_random_flights( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[1]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[1]-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[1]-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Strategie-Muster für Angriffe in einem einfachen Spiel. Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_ATTACK_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `EXECUTE_ATTACK`. Erstellen Sie zwei konkrete Strategien: `CL_NORMAL_ATTACK` und `CL_CRITICAL_ATTACK`. Die kritische Attacke soll eine zufällige Chance haben, zusätzlichen Schaden zu verursachen, generiert mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `REDEFINITION` und `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT` für die Zufallschance.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_attack_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_attack
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_damage TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_damage) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_attack_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_normal_attack DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_attack_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_normal_attack IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_attack_strategy~execute_attack.
    rv_final_damage = iv_base_damage.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_attack DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_attack_strategy.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_critical_chance TYPE f VALUE '0.3', " 30% chance
      gc_critical_multiplier TYPE f VALUE '1.5'. " 1.5x damage
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_attack IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_attack_strategy~execute_attack.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) ).
    IF lo_random->get_next( ) < gc_critical_chance.
      rv_final_damage = iv_base_damage * gc_critical_multiplier.
    ELSE.
      rv_final_damage = iv_base_damage.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_player DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      set_attack_strategy
        IMPORTING
          io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_attack_strategy,
      perform_attack
        IMPORTING
          iv_base_damage TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_damage) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_attack_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_attack_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_player IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_attack_strategy.
    mo_attack_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_attack.
    IF mo_attack_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_damage = mo_attack_strategy->execute_attack( iv_base_damage ).
    ELSE.
      rv_damage = 0. " No strategy set
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_normal_attack FOR TESTING,
      test_critical_attack_chance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normal_attack.
    DATA(lo_player) = NEW zcl_player( ).
    DATA(lo_normal_strategy) = NEW zcl_normal_attack( ).
    lo_player->set_attack_strategy( lo_normal_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_damage) = lo_player->perform_attack( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_damage exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_critical_attack_chance.
    DATA(lo_player) = NEW zcl_player( ).
    DATA(lo_critical_strategy) = NEW zcl_critical_attack( ).
    lo_player->set_attack_strategy( lo_critical_strategy ).

    DATA(lv_base_damage) TYPE i VALUE 100.
    DATA(lv_critical_damage) TYPE i VALUE 150. " 100 * 1.5

    DATA(lv_normal_hits) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_critical_hits) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DO 100 TIMES. " Run multiple times to test chance
      DATA(lv_damage) = lo_player->perform_attack( lv_base_damage ).
      IF lv_damage = lv_critical_damage.
        lv_critical_hits = lv_critical_hits + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_damage = lv_base_damage.
        lv_normal_hits = lv_normal_hits + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Assert that both types of hits occurred, indicating randomness
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_critical_hits > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_normal_hits > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_normal_hits + lv_critical_hits exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster ermöglicht den Austausch von Algorithmen zur Laufzeit. Die Verwendung einer Schnittstelle (`zif_attack_strategy`) erzwingt die Implementierung der `EXECUTE_ATTACK`-Methode in den konkreten Strategien. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT` wird verwendet, um eine realistische Zufallschance für kritische Treffer zu simulieren.
keywords: INTERFACE, STRATEGY PATTERN, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, RANDOM

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (`SCARR`) aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`, um einen zufälligen Index zu generieren, und `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        carrname TYPE s_carrname,
      END OF ty_carrier,
      ty_carrier_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      get_random_carrier
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_carrier) TYPE ty_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_carrier.
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE ty_carrier_table(
      FOR <fs_scarr> IN ( SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( carrid = <fs_scarr>-carrid, carrname = <fs_scarr>-carrname )
    ).

    IF lt_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_carriers ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_carriers INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_carrier.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_carrier) = lo_cut->get_random_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_carrier-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_carrier-carrname ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.

solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_validation_rule DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

  METHOD is_valid.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_range_rule DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_validation_rule FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING
          iv_min TYPE i
          iv_max TYPE i,
      is_valid REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_min TYPE i.
    DATA mv_max TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_range_rule IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min = iv_min.
    mv_max = iv_max.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD is_valid.
    DATA(lv_numeric_value) TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_numeric_value = iv_value.
        IF lv_numeric_value >= mv_min AND lv_numeric_value <= mv_max.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines bestimmten Jahresbereichs (z.B. 2000 bis 2025).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      generate_random_date
        IMPORTING
          iv_start_year TYPE i DEFAULT 2000
          iv_end_year   TYPE i DEFAULT 2025
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = iv_start_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = iv_end_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = lv_end_date - lv_start_date.

    IF lv_days_diff < 0.
      rv_random_date = lv_start_date.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_days_diff ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = lv_start_date + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_random_date_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->generate_random_date( iv_start_year = 2000 iv_end_year = 2000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_random_date exp = '20000101' ). " Smallest possible date for 2000

    lv_random_date = lo_cut->generate_random_date( iv_start_year = 2020 iv_end_year = 2020 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_random_date >= '20200101' AND lv_random_date <= '20201231' ).

    DATA(lv_random_date_multi) = lo_cut->generate_random_date( iv_start_year = 2000 iv_end_year = 2025 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_random_date_multi >= '20000101' AND lv_random_date_multi <= '20251231' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugbuchungen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`, um eine zufällige Anzahl von Zeilen aus `SFLIGHT` zu wählen, bevor Sie gruppieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression und `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count,
      ty_flight_count_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      get_random_grouped_flights
        IMPORTING
          iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_flight_count_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_rows) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = iv_max_rows ).
    DATA(lv_rows_to_select) = lo_random_rows->get_next( ).

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO lv_rows_to_select ROWS ) ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflight GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
                                  ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid,
                                    flight_count = lines( GROUP <fs_group> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_grouped_flights( 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_grouped_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_grouped_flights ) <= 50 ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_entry-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) mit einer 50/50-Chance unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` mit einem Bereich von 0 bis 1 und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_coin_side TYPE c LENGTH 4.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_heads TYPE ty_coin_side VALUE 'Kopf',
      gc_tails TYPE ty_coin_side VALUE 'Zahl'.

    METHODS:
      flip_coin
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE ty_coin_side.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_result = COND #( WHEN lv_random_value = 0 THEN gc_heads ELSE gc_tails ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_coin_flip_randomness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_coin_flip_randomness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_coin_flip( ).
    DATA(lv_heads_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_tails_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).
      IF lv_result = zcl_coin_flip=>gc_heads.
        lv_heads_count = lv_heads_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_result = zcl_coin_flip=>gc_tails.
        lv_tails_count = lv_tails_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_heads_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_tails_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_heads_count + lv_tails_count exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` zur Simulation eines einfachen Zufallsereignisses wie eines Münzwurfs. Die `COND`-Expression wird verwendet, um das Ergebnis basierend auf der Zufallszahl kompakt zuzuweisen, was eine moderne und lesbare Syntax darstellt.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, COND, MATH, CONDITIONAL LOGIC

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `CL_ABSTRACT_SHAPE` mit einer abstrakten Methode `CALCULATE_AREA`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Unterklassen `CL_CIRCLE` und `CL_RECTANGLE`, die die Flächenberechnung spezifisch implementieren. Demonstrieren Sie die polymorphe Verwendung in einer Liste von Formen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `ABSTRACT METHODS`, `REDEFINITION` und `FOR` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      calculate_area ABSTRACT
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_area) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING
          iv_radius TYPE f,
      calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_radius TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING
          iv_width  TYPE f
          iv_height TYPE f,
      calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_width TYPE f.
    DATA mv_height TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphic_area_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphic_area_calculation.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5.0' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_width = '4.0' iv_height = '6.0' ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lv_total_area) = REDUCE f( INIT sum = 0.0
                                    FOR lo_shape IN lt_shapes
                                    NEXT sum = sum + lo_shape->calculate_area( ) ).

    " Expected: Area of Circle (radius 5) = PI * 25 = 78.5398...
    " Area of Rectangle (4x6) = 24.0
    " Total approx = 102.5398...
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_area exp = '102.5398' delta = '0.0001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht Polymorphie durch eine abstrakte Basisklasse `CL_ABSTRACT_SHAPE` und deren konkrete Implementierungen. Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das eine kompakte und funktionale Art der Aggregation über eine Liste von Objekten ermöglicht, wobei jede Form ihre eigene `CALCULATE_AREA`-Methode polymorph aufruft.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CLASS, POLYMORPHISM, REDUCE, OBJECT ORIENTATION, MATH

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (`SFLIGHT`) und wählen Sie nur die Flüge aus, deren Flugnummer (`CONNID`) eine zufällig generierte Zahl überschreitet. Die zufällige Zahl soll zwischen 1 und 999 liegen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      filter_flights_randomly
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_randomly.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS ) ( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    DATA(lo_random_connid_threshold) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 999 ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = lo_random_connid_threshold->get_next( ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE connid > lv_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_randomly( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights ).
    " Cannot assert exact count due to randomness, but ensure it's not empty

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `CL_ABSTRACT_REPORT` mit einer abstrakten Methode `GENERATE_REPORT_DATA`. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Unterklasse `CL_RANDOM_SALES_REPORT`, die zufällige Verkaufsdaten generiert. Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Erstellung und Ausführung des Berichts, wobei die Anzahl der generierten Datenzeilen zufällig ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `REDEFINITION`, `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`, `CREATE OBJECT TYPE` und `VALUE` mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_report DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_report_line,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_report_line,
      ty_report_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_report_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      generate_report_data ABSTRACT
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_report_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_report IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sales_report DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_report FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      generate_report_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sales_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report_data.
    DATA(lo_random_rows) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 5 max = 20 ).
    DATA(lv_num_rows) = lo_random_rows->get_next( ).

    DATA(lo_random_value) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 100 max = 1000 ).

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lv_num_rows
                       ( id = i,
                         value = lo_random_value->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:

        RETURNING

CLASS zcl_report_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_report_dynamically.
    DATA lo_report TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_report.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_report TYPE (iv_report_class_name).
        rt_result = lo_report->generate_report_data( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Error: Could not create report object of class { iv_report_class_name }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem Text, unabhängig von Groß- und Kleinschreibung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und die Methode `CREATE_FROM_PATTERN` mit der Option `CASE_SENSITIVE = ABAP_FALSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_matches) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_words.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = iv_pattern
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_match( ) TO rt_matches.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_find( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->find_all_words( iv_text = `Hello World, hello ABAP.` iv_pattern = `hello` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = `Hello` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = `hello` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` zur Suche nach allen Vorkommen eines Musters in einem String. Die `CREATE_FROM_PATTERN`-Methode erstellt ein Regex-Objekt, und `CREATE_MATCHER` erstellt einen Matcher für den Text. Die `FIND`-Methode iteriert durch die Matches, und `GET_MATCH` liefert den gefundenen String. `CASE_SENSITIVE = ABAP_FALSE` ermöglicht eine Suche, die Groß- und Kleinschreibung ignoriert.
keywords: REGEX, FIND, CL_ABAP_REGEX, String Processing

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit einem Betreff und einem Textkörper an einen Empfänger.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BCS` und `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS` zum Erstellen und Senden der E-Mail. `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` ist die Basisklasse für BCS-Nachrichten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_simple_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_simple_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient i_express = abap_true ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).

    IF rv_success = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_simple_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_simple_email.
    " ACHTUNG: Dieser Test sendet tatsächlich eine E-Mail.
    " Für echte Unit-Tests sollte der BCS-Aufruf gemockt werden.
    " Hier wird ein Dummy-Empfänger verwendet.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_email( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_simple_email(
      iv_recipient_email = `test@example.com`
      iv_subject         = `Test E-Mail von ABAP`
      iv_body            = `Dies ist ein Test.`
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung der Business Communication Services (BCS) zum Senden einer E-Mail. `CL_BCS=>CREATE_PERSISTENT` initialisiert den Sendeauftrag. `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS=>CREATE_DOCUMENT` erstellt den E-Mail-Inhalt. `CL_CAM_ADDRESS_BCS=>CREATE_INTERNET_ADDRESS` erstellt den Empfänger. `SET_SEND_IMMEDIATELY` sorgt für den sofortigen Versand, und `SEND` führt den Versand aus. Ein `COMMIT WORK` ist notwendig, um den Sendeauftrag in der Datenbank zu persistieren. `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` ist die abstrakte Basisklasse für BCS-Nachrichten.
keywords: BCS, Email, CL_BCS, CL_DOCUMENT_BCS, Communication, CL_BCS_MESSAGE

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Log-Eintrag das Datum, die Uhrzeit und die Nachricht mithilfe von Regex-Gruppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `GET_SUBMATCH` nach einem erfolgreichen `MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             date    TYPE string,
             time    TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

    METHODS extract_log_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_log_data.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+(.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_log_entry-date    = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_log_entry-time    = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_log_entry-message = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_extract_log_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_log_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( `2023-10-26 14:30:00 This is a log message.` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-date    exp = `2023-10-26` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-time    exp = `14:30:00` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-message exp = `This is a log message.` ).

    CLEAR ls_result.
    ls_result = lo_cut->extract_log_data( `Invalid log line` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit Regex-Gruppen spezifische Teile eines Strings extrahiert. Der Pattern `^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+(.*)$` definiert drei Fanggruppen (durch Klammern `()` gekennzeichnet). Nach einem erfolgreichen Match können die Inhalte dieser Gruppen mit `GET_SUBMATCH(index)` abgerufen werden.
keywords: REGEX, Groups, Extract, CL_ABAP_REGEX, String Processing

      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).

    IF rv_success = abap_true.

    ELSE.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks und geben Sie die einzelnen Teile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` in Kombination mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `GET_MATCH_OFFSET`/`GET_MATCH_LENGTH` oder manuelles Splitting.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern( pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      DATA(lv_match_offset) = lo_matcher->get_match_offset( ).
      DATA(lv_match_length) = lo_matcher->get_match_length( ).

      IF lv_match_offset > lv_last_offset.
        APPEND iv_text+lv_last_offset(lv_match_offset - lv_last_offset) TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = lv_match_offset + lv_match_length.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Add remaining part after the last match
    IF lv_last_offset < xstrlen( iv_text ).
      APPEND iv_text+lv_last_offset TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_by_regex FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_split( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_text = `apple, banana;orange` iv_pattern = `[,;]` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = `apple` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = ` banana` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = `orange` ).

    CLEAR lt_result.
    lt_result = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_text = `word1  word2   word3` iv_pattern = `\s+` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = `word1` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = `word2` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = `word3` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert ein Regex-basiertes Splitting eines Strings. Da ABAP keine direkte `SPLIT`-Anweisung mit Regex-Pattern bietet, wird `CL_ABAP_REGEX` verwendet, um die Matches zu finden. Anschließend wird der String manuell in die Teile vor, zwischen und nach den Matches zerlegt. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Art, Strings basierend auf komplexen Mustern zu teilen.
keywords: REGEX, SPLIT, CL_ABAP_REGEX, String Processing

CLASS zcl_bcs_dynamic_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_dynamic_flight_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_carrid          TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid          TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate          TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_bcs_dynamic_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_dynamic_flight_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Flight not found, handle error or return false
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_subject) = |Fluginformationen für Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|.
    DATA(lv_body) = |
      Sehr geehrter Kunde,

      Ihre Fluginformationen:
      Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }
      Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }
      Datum: { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }
      Abflugort: { ls_flight-cityfrom }
      Zielort: { ls_flight-cityto }
      Abflugzeit: { ls_flight-deptime TIME = USER }
      Ankunftszeit: { ls_flight-arrtime TIME = USER }

      Vielen Dank für Ihre Buchung.
    |.

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
      i_subject = lv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient i_express = abap_true ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).

    IF rv_success = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_pdf_attach IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).

CLASS zcl_group_by_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_group_by_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                    count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    METHODS get_total_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflights-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                    FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
                                                    NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_price( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                     total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_carrier_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    METHODS get_average_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflights-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                    FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
                                                    NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
      DATA(lv_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_avg_price( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                         average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 )
                                       ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem dynamischen Gruppierungsschlüssel.

CLASS zcl_group_by_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_group,
             group_key TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_group.
    METHODS get_dynamic_grouping
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID', 'CONNID'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_grouping.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_key> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> GROUP BY ( key = <fs_sflight>-(iv_group_field) )
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      ASSIGN ls_group-key TO <fs_group_key>.
      APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_group(
        group_key = CONV string( <fs_group_key> )
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_data_processing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             process_ok TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_bal_data_processing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      i_object    = 'Z_FLIGHT_PROC'
      i_subobject = 'DAILY_RUN'
    ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-process_ok = abap_true.
        lo_log->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgid = 'S_AUT'
          i_msgno = '006'
          i_msgv1 = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } erfolgreich verarbeitet.|
        ).
      ELSE.
        lo_log->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'S_AUT'
          i_msgno = '007'
          i_msgv1 = |Fehler bei Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }.|
          i_longtext = 'Detaillierter Fehler: Dateninkonsistenz oder Systemfehler.'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_log_handle = lo_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe den frühesten und spätesten Flugtermin.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit `MIN` und `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_min_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dates_range,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             earliest_fldate TYPE s_date,
             latest_fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_dates_range.
    METHODS get_flight_date_ranges RETURNING VALUE(rt_date_ranges) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_dates_range WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_min_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date_ranges.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      DATA(lv_earliest) = REDUCE s_date( INIT min_date = '99991231'
                                         FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
                                         NEXT min_date = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-fldate < min_date THEN <fs_flight>-fldate ELSE min_date ) ).
      DATA(lv_latest) = REDUCE s_date( INIT max_date = '00000000'
                                        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
                                        NEXT max_date = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-fldate > max_date THEN <fs_flight>-fldate ELSE max_date ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_dates_range( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                         earliest_fldate = lv_earliest
                                         latest_fldate = lv_latest ) TO rt_date_ranges.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connid,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_connid,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_distinct_connids,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             distinct_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connid WITH UNIQUE KEY connid,
           END OF ty_grouped_distinct_connids.

CLASS zcl_group_by_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_connids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_distinct_connids(
        carrid = ls_group-carrid
        distinct_connids = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group ( connid = <fs_flight>-connid ) )
      ) TO rt_distinct_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights`, konvertieren Sie diese in ein CSV-Format und versenden Sie sie als Excel-Anhang (XLSX) in einer E-Mail.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` für die Konvertierung des CSV-Strings in XSTRING und `cl_document_bcs=>create_document` mit Typ 'BIN' und dem Dateityp 'XLSX'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_excel_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_sflight_as_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE so_obj_des.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_excel_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_sflight_as_excel.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Daten aus sflights lesen
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Für ein Beispiel begrenzen

    " Daten in CSV-String konvertieren
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = |"Airline","Flight Number","Flight Date","Price","Currency"|.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT s = |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }"{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }"," { <fs_sflight>-connid }"," { <fs_sflight>-fldate }"," { <fs_sflight>-price }"," { <fs_sflight>-currency }"|
    ).

    " CSV-String in XSTRING konvertieren
    DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = lv_csv_data
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).

    " Dokument für Anhang erstellen
    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'BIN' " Binär für Excel
      i_text    = lv_xstring_content
      i_length  = xstrlen( lv_xstring_content )
      i_subject = 'Flugdaten.xlsx'
    ).
    lo_bcs->add_attachment(
      i_document = lo_attachment
      i_attachment_type = 'XLSX' " Dateityp für den Anhang
      i_attachment_size = xstrlen( lv_xstring_content )
      i_attachment_subject = 'Flugdaten.xlsx'
    ).

    " E-Mail Body (optional, hier einfach Text)
    DATA(lo_document_body) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = 'Anbei finden Sie die Flugdaten.'
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document_body ).

    " Empfänger hinzufügen
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " E-Mail senden
    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    COMMIT WORK.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Nachrichtenliste, fügen Sie verschiedene Nachrichtentypen (Info, Warnung, Fehler) hinzu und geben Sie alle gesammelten Nachrichten aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list` und die Methoden `add_message`, `get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_list_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             id      TYPE symsgid,
             number  TYPE symsgno,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS demonstrate_message_handling
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_list_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_message_handling.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    " Nachrichten hinzufügen
    lo_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '001'
      i_msgv1 = 'Info-Nachricht'
    ).
    lo_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'W'
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '002'
      i_msgv1 = 'Warnung'
    ).
    lo_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '003'
      i_msgv1 = 'Fehler'
    ).

    " Nachrichten auslesen und formatieren
    LOOP AT lo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_msg).
      APPEND VALUE ty_message(
        type    = ls_msg-msgty
        id      = ls_msg-msgid
        number  = ls_msg-msgno

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Validierungslogik für `sflights` Daten. Wenn ein Flugpreis negativ ist oder die Währung nicht 'EUR' ist, fügen Sie entsprechende Fehlermeldungen zur Nachrichtenliste hinzu. Geben Sie die gesammelten Fehlermeldungen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cf_reca_message_list` zur Sammlung der Validierungsfehler und `LOOP AT ...` mit `IF` für die Validierungslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_list_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_validation_message,
             type    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_validation_message.
    TYPES tt_validation_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_validation_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_validation_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_list_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_sflights.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight-price < 0.
        lo_message_list->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG' " Beispiel-Nachrichtenklasse
          i_msgno = '001'
          i_msgv1 = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid } hat negativen Preis: { ls_sflight-price }|
        ).
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_sflight-currency <> 'EUR'.
        lo_message_list->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'W'
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '002'
          i_msgv1 = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid } hat unerwartete Währung: { ls_sflight-currency }|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Nachrichten auslesen und formatieren
    rt_messages = VALUE tt_validation_messages(
      FOR ls_msg IN lo_message_list->get_messages( )
      ( type = ls_msg-msgty message = ls_msg-message_text )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und einen Preis über 500 haben. Transformieren Sie die gefilterten Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Preis enthält.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight  TYPE sflight-connid,
             cost    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Für ein Beispiel begrenzen

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight_raw WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND price > 500 ) 
      ( airline = ls_flight-carrid 
        flight  = ls_flight-connid 
        cost    = ls_flight-price ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_for( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt LH Flüge über 500 in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered ) msg = 'Es sollten gefilterte Flüge vorhanden sein' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).

Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu manipulieren, die die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen reduziert.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_airline.
    DATA lt_sflight_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_prices
      WHERE carrid = iv_airline.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_prices 
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_airline( 'AA' ).

    " Erwarteter Wert muss manuell überprüft oder gemockt werden.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob ein Wert zurückgegeben wird.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price_aa msg = 'Gesamtpreis sollte nicht initial sein' ).

    " Beispiel für einen bekannten Wert (falls Testdaten bekannt sind)
    " DATA(lv_expected_price) = 1234.56.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_aa exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen über interne Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert die Akkumulatorvariable (`sum`), und die `NEXT`-Klausel definiert, wie der Akkumulator in jeder Iteration aktualisiert wird. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, sflights, Summe

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene klassenbasierte Ausnahme und demonstrieren Sie deren Auslösung und Behandlung in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING zcx_my_custom_exception.

    METHODS handle_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_custom_exception
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_my_custom_exception=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulation einer erfolgreichen Operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_operation.
    TRY.
        perform_risky_operation( iv_value = iv_input ).
        rv_result = |Operation erfolgreich für Wert { iv_input }|.
      CATCH zcx_my_custom_exception.
        rv_result = |Fehler: Negativer Wert { iv_input } nicht erlaubt.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_optional_return DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_num2    TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_method_optional_return IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    IF iv_num2 IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
    ELSE.
      rv_sum = iv_num1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
