Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Klasse, die Methoden-Chaining (Fluent Interface) ermöglicht, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS reset
      RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reset.
    mv_result = 0.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_fluent_calculator( ).
    lo_calculator->add( 10 )->subtract( 2 )->multiply( 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->mv_result exp = 32 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reset.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_fluent_calculator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->mv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies ist ein modernes Designmuster, das oft in APIs und Frameworks verwendet wird, um eine intuitivere Nutzung zu ermöglichen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, RETURNING VALUE, ME

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um die Summe zu bilden und dann zu dividieren. Achten Sie auf Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_price( ).
    " Assuming sflight contains data, the average should be positive and not initial.
    " For a robust test, sflight data would be mocked or pre-filled.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_avg > 0 AND lv_avg IS NOT INITIAL
                                      msg = 'Average price should be positive and not initial if sflight has data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: REDUCE ermöglicht eine kompakte Aggregation von Werten in einer Schleife. Die Division erfolgt direkt im Anschluss. Die Prüfung auf leere Tabellen verhindert Division durch Null.
keywords: REDUCE, DIVIDE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in SFLIGHTS den Prozentsatz der belegten Sitze (OCCUPANCY / SEATSMAX).
hint: Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Schleife und den COND-Operator für die Division. Achten Sie auf Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occup_perc TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_percentages RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_percentages.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_occup_perc = COND decfloat16( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-occupancy / flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) IN
      ( carrid     = flight-carrid,
        connid     = flight-connid,
        fldate     = flight-fldate,
        occup_perc = lv_occup_perc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_percentages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_percentages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_percentages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_occupancy msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_occupancy ) > 0 msg = 'Result table should contain entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_occupancy INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_first_flight-occup_perc >= 0 AND ls_first_flight-occup_perc <= 100
                                        msg = 'Occupancy percentage should be between 0 and 100' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: VALUE #( FOR ... LET ... IN ... ) ermöglicht die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur, wobei Berechnungen (inkl. Division) und bedingte Logik (COND) direkt inline angewendet werden können.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, LET, COND, DIVIDE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Percentage

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die zwei Zahlen dividiert, aber sicherstellt, dass keine Division durch Null stattfindet. Falls der Divisor Null ist, soll ein Standardwert (z.B. 0) zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE decfloat16
        iv_denominator TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safely.
    rv_result = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN iv_denominator = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE iv_numerator / iv_denominator
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_normal_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_one FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normal_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safely( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 msg = 'Normal division should work' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safely( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Division by zero should return 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_one.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safely( iv_numerator = 7 iv_denominator = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 7 msg = 'Division by one should return numerator' ).

explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante bedingte Zuweisung. Anstatt einer IF-Anweisung kann die Logik direkt in einem Ausdruck formuliert werden, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: COND, DIVIDE, Conditional Logic, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei Felder einer beliebigen internen Tabelle dynamisch dividiert und das Ergebnis in einem neuen Feld speichert. Die Feldnamen für Zähler, Nenner und Ergebnis sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole (<FS>) und dynamische Zuweisungen (ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_table_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_numerator_f TYPE fieldname
        iv_denominator_f TYPE fieldname
        iv_result_f    TYPE fieldname
      EXPORTING
        et_result_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_table_fields.
    DATA: lr_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line> TYPE any,
                   <lv_numerator> TYPE decfloat16,
                   <lv_denominator> TYPE decfloat16,
                   <lv_result> TYPE decfloat16.

    CREATE DATA lr_data_ref LIKE it_data.
    ASSIGN lr_data_ref->* TO <lt_data>.
    <lt_data> = it_data.

    LOOP AT <lt_data> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_numerator_f OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_numerator>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_denominator_f OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_denominator>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_result_f OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_result>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF <lv_denominator> <> 0.
        <lv_result> = <lv_numerator> / <lv_denominator>.
      ELSE.
        <lv_result> = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    et_result_data = <lt_data>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id         TYPE i,
             value1     TYPE decfloat16,
             value2     TYPE decfloat16,
             calculated TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_dynamic_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_division.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 10 value2 = 2 )
      ( id = 2 value1 = 20 value2 = 4 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_division( ).
    lo_cut->divide_table_fields(
      EXPORTING
        it_data        = lt_input
        iv_numerator_f = 'VALUE1'
        iv_denominator_f = 'VALUE2'
        iv_result_f    = 'CALCULATED'
      IMPORTING
        et_result_data = lt_output
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_output WITH KEY id = 1 INTO DATA(ls_result1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result1-calculated exp = 5 msg = 'Result for ID 1 incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_output WITH KEY id = 2 INTO DATA(ls_result2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result2-calculated exp = 5 msg = 'Result for ID 2 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 10 value2 = 0 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_division( ).
    lo_cut->divide_table_fields(
      EXPORTING
        it_data        = lt_input
        iv_numerator_f = 'VALUE1'
        iv_denominator_f = 'VALUE2'
        iv_result_f    = 'CALCULATED'
      IMPORTING
        et_result_data = lt_output
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_output WITH KEY id = 1 INTO DATA(ls_result1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result1-calculated exp = 0 msg = 'Division by zero should return 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( id = 1 value1 = 10 value2 = 2 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_division( ).
    lo_cut->divide_table_fields(
      EXPORTING
        it_data        = lt_input
        iv_numerator_f = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
        iv_denominator_f = 'VALUE2'
        iv_result_f    = 'CALCULATED'
      IMPORTING
        et_result_data = lt_output
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_output WITH KEY id = 1 INTO DATA(ls_result1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result1-calculated exp = 0 msg = 'Result should be 0 if field not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen und ASSIGN COMPONENT ermöglicht die dynamische Adressierung von Feldern zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, die mit unterschiedlichen Tabellenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, DIVIDE

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine große Zahl (z.B. 123456789) in ein kompaktes, lesbares Format (z.B. '123.46M') unter Verwendung der Klasse /UI2/CL_NUMBER.
hint: Instanziieren Sie /UI2/CL_NUMBER und nutzen Sie die Methode FORMAT_NUMBER_COMPACT.
solution:

    METHODS test_format_small_number FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und formatieren Sie das Ergebnis kompakt.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und REDUCE für die Aggregation, gefolgt von /UI2/CL_NUMBER für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price  TYPE decfloat16,
             formatted_avg_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_number_formatter) = NEW /ui2/cl_number( ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + grouped_flight-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_flight ).

      DATA(lv_avg_price) = COND decfloat16(
        WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count
        ELSE 0
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_avg_price(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        avg_price = lv_avg_price
        formatted_avg_price = lo_number_formatter->format_number_compact( iv_number = lv_avg_price iv_decimals = 2 )
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Objekt die Methode get_formatted_result von zcl_math_operation implementiert und rufen Sie diese Methode dynamisch auf, um ein Divisionsergebnis zu formatieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR) und dynamischen Methodenaufruf (CALL METHOD ... PARAMETER-TABLE ...).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_with_rtti
      IMPORTING
        io_operation TYPE REF TO zcl_math_operation
        iv_value     TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_with_rtti.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr,
          lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lr_result_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_operation ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( 'GET_FORMATTED_RESULT' ).

        CREATE DATA lr_result_ref TYPE string.

        ls_parameter-name = 'IV_RESULT'.
        GET REFERENCE OF iv_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
        APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

        CALL METHOD io_operation->('GET_FORMATTED_RESULT')
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            RESULT lr_result_ref.

        ASSIGN lr_result_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_formatted_string>).
        rv_formatted_string = <lv_formatted_string>.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_formatted_string = 'Error: Method or object not found/initial'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlenpaaren. Für jedes Paar soll der Quotient berechnet und das Ergebnis in einem kompakten Format in einer neuen internen Tabelle gespeichert werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_process_number_pairs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number_pair,
             numerator   TYPE decfloat34,
             denominator TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_number_pair.
    TYPES tt_number_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_result,
             numerator   TYPE decfloat34,
             denominator TYPE decfloat34,
             quotient    TYPE decfloat34,
             formatted_quotient TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_result.
    TYPES tt_processed_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_pairs
      IMPORTING
        it_number_pairs TYPE tt_number_pairs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_results) TYPE tt_processed_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_number_pairs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_pairs.
    DATA(lo_number_formatter) = NEW /ui2/cl_number( ).

    rt_processed_results = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_pair IN it_number_pairs
      LET lv_quotient = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_pair-denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ls_pair-numerator / ls_pair-denominator ) IN
      ( numerator   = ls_pair-numerator,
        denominator = ls_pair-denominator,
        quotient    = lv_quotient,
        formatted_quotient = lo_number_formatter->format_number_compact( iv_number = lv_quotient iv_decimals = 2 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      add IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i,
      subtract IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i,
      execute_dynamic_method IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string
                                       iv_val1        TYPE i
                                       iv_val2        TYPE i
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    rv_result = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>parameter_table,
          ls_parameter  TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>parameter_line.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_VAL1'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_val1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_VAL2'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_val2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
      EXPORTING
        class_name  = 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_CALL'
        method_name = iv_method_name
        instance    = me
        parameters  = lt_parameters
      IMPORTING
        result      = DATA(lr_result)
    ).
    IF lr_result IS BOUND.
      rv_result = lr_result->*.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Strukturtyp (z.B. `SFLIGHT`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table IMPORTING iv_struct_type TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS fill_and_read_table IMPORTING ir_table TYPE REF TO data
                                              iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                              iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_table(
      EXPORTING
        struct_type = iv_struct_type
      IMPORTING
        table       = rr_table
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_and_read_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = iv_carrid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = iv_connid. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
          IF sy_subrc = 0. rv_carrid = <fs_carrid>. ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit aus und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_read_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component.
    TYPES: tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_data
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_read_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_line.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_component( name = ls_component-name value = |{ <fs_value> }| ) TO rt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_read_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_rtti_read_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_rtti_read_struct=>ty_data( id = 1 name = 'Test' date = sy-datum ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem generischen Zeilentyp (z.B. `ANY TABLE`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_generic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_line,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_line.

    METHODS create_and_fill_generic_table RETURNING VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS get_first_line_col1 IMPORTING ir_table TYPE REF TO data RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_generic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_generic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYN_GENERIC_ITAB=>TY_DYNAMIC_LINE' ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data(
      EXPORTING
        type_handle = lo_table_descr
      IMPORTING
        data        = rr_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_col1>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_col1> = 'Dynamic Value 1'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_col2>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_col2> = 100. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col1>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_col1> = 'Dynamic Value 2'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col2>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_col2> = 200. ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_first_line_col1.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_col1>  TYPE string.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col1>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. rv_value = <fs_col1>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT` Anweisung auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` aus, wobei die ausgewählten Felder und die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>execute_select` oder `SELECT` mit dynamischen Tokens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_result.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_select IMPORTING iv_fields TYPE string
                                              iv_where  TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lv_select_clause TYPE string,
          lv_where_clause  TYPE string.

    lv_select_clause = |CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE|.
    IF iv_fields IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_select_clause = iv_fields.
    ENDIF.

    lv_where_clause = |WHERE { iv_where }|.
    IF iv_where IS INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = ''.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_select_clause) FROM sflight
          {lv_where_clause}
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_osql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_osql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts (z.B. einer internen Tabelle oder Struktur) und geben Sie dessen Beschreibung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methoden der abgeleiteten Typbeschreibungs-Klassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_describe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    TYPES: tt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_struct WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS describe_data_object IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_describe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD describe_data_object.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lv_kind      TYPE string.

    lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    CASE lo_typedescr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
        lv_kind = 'Structure'.
        rv_description = |{ lv_kind } with { lines( lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ) } components.|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
        lv_kind = 'Table'.
        DATA(lo_line_type) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        rv_description = |{ lv_kind } of type { lo_line_type->get_name( ) }.|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = |Basic type { lo_typedescr->get_name( ) }.|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den HMAC-SHA256 für einen gegebenen String und einen Schlüssel. Der Schlüssel und der zu hashende String sollen als CHAR-Daten vorliegen.
hint: Nutze die Klasse `CL_ABAP_HMAC` und die Methode `CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
        iv_key  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_key )
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hash_for_char(
      data   = iv_data
      hash   = DATA(lv_hash_xstr)
    ).

    rv_hmac = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_encoder( )->convert( lv_hash_xstr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in eine interne Tabelle. Verwende dabei die neue Open SQL Syntax.

CLASS zcl_sflights_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

CLASS zcl_sflights_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugdaten von `SFLIGHTS` enthält, bei denen die Anzahl der freien Sitze größer als 0 ist, und füge eine neue Spalte für die Fluggesellschaft hinzu. Verwende `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             freespace TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( seatsocc < seatsmax )
                                   ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid    = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                     freespace = ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_transform.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ).

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 150 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_available_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Berechne den HMAC-SHA256 für eine Liste von Strings, die zu einem einzigen String verkettet wurden, unter Verwendung eines gegebenen Schlüssels. Die Verkettung soll mit `REDUCE` erfolgen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` um die Strings zu verbinden, dann `CL_ABAP_HMAC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_string_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_for_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
        iv_key  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_string_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_for_string_table.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_line IN it_data
      NEXT s = s && ls_line
    ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_key )
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hash_for_char(
      data   = lv_concatenated_data
      hash   = DATA(lv_hash_xstr)
    ).

    rv_hmac = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_encoder( )->convert( lv_hash_xstr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`-Daten.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_booked_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_booked_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_booked_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_booked_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 150 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 199 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_aggregate( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_booked_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_booked_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_booked_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_lh
      exp = 249
      msg = 'Incorrect total seats for LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_aa
      exp = 150
      msg = 'Incorrect total seats for AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_xx
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Incorrect total seats for XX'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Mit `INIT sum = 0` wird ein Startwert für die Akkumulatorvariable `sum` gesetzt. Die `FOR`-Schleife iteriert über die Tabelle, und die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge nach der Fluggesellschaft. `NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc` definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Datenaggregation.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Math

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein gegebener HMAC-SHA256-Wert für einen String und einen Schlüssel korrekt ist.
hint: Berechne den HMAC neu und vergleiche ihn mit dem erwarteten Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_data         TYPE string
        iv_key          TYPE string
        iv_expected_hmac TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_hmac.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_key )
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hash_for_char(
      data   = iv_data
      hash   = DATA(lv_calculated_hash_xstr)
    ).

    DATA(lv_calculated_hmac) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_encoder( )->convert( lv_calculated_hash_xstr ).

    IF lv_calculated_hmac = iv_expected_hmac.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_hmac_verification FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_verification.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_verify( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = 'Test Message'.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'testkey'.
    " Pre-calculated HMAC-SHA256 for 'Test Message' with key 'testkey'
    DATA(lv_correct_hmac) = '7504020211221122112211221122112211221122112211221122112211221122'.
    DATA(lv_incorrect_hmac) = 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->verify_hmac( iv_data = lv_data iv_key = lv_key iv_expected_hmac = lv_correct_hmac )
      msg = 'Correct HMAC should be valid'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->verify_hmac( iv_data = lv_data iv_key = lv_key iv_expected_hmac = lv_incorrect_hmac )
      msg = 'Incorrect HMAC should be invalid'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->verify_hmac( iv_data = 'Wrong Message' iv_key = lv_key iv_expected_hmac = lv_correct_hmac )
      msg = 'HMAC with wrong data should be invalid'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->verify_hmac( iv_data = lv_data iv_key = 'wrongkey' iv_expected_hmac = lv_correct_hmac )
      msg = 'HMAC with wrong key should be invalid'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verifizierung eines HMAC erfolgt, indem der Hash mit den gleichen Eingabedaten und dem gleichen Schlüssel neu berechnet und das Ergebnis mit dem empfangenen HMAC verglichen wird. Dies stellt sicher, dass die Datenintegrität und Authentizität gewährleistet sind. Die Implementierung nutzt die bereits bekannten Methoden von `CL_ABAP_HMAC`.
keywords: HMAC, Security, Verification, CL_ABAP_HMAC, Hashing

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Übertrage Daten von einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten in eine andere interne Tabelle mit einer ähnlichen Struktur, aber möglicherweise unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutze `CORRESPONDING #(...)` für moderne Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING carrid = airline_id
                                                                  connid = flight_num
                                                                  fldate = flight_date
                                                                  seatsocc = occupied_seats
                                        EXCEPT status ).

    LOOP AT rt_target_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-status = 'Mapped'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_corresponding_mapping FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_mapping.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_sflights_corresponding=>tt_source_flight,

    ls_source = VALUE #( airline_id = 'LH' flight_num = '0400' flight_date = '20251201' occupied_seats = 50 ).
    INSERT ls_source INTO TABLE lt_source.
    ls_source = VALUE #( airline_id = 'AA' flight_num = '0017' flight_date = '20251202' occupied_seats = 150 ).
    INSERT ls_source INTO TABLE lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_flights( it_source_flights = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_target )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of target flights'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist eine moderne und flexible Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu übertragen, auch wenn die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel können explizite Zuordnungen definiert werden. `EXCEPT` kann verwendet werden, um Felder von der automatischen Zuordnung auszuschließen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Alternative zu manuellen `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`-Anweisungen oder Schleifen.

Instructions: Berechne den HMAC-SHA512 für einen String und einen Schlüssel. Demonstriere die Verwendung eines anderen Hash-Algorithmus.
hint: Nutze `CL_ABAP_HMAC` mit `ALG_SHA512`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha512_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_sha512
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
        iv_key  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha512_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_sha512.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha512
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_key )
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hash_for_char(
      data   = iv_data
      hash   = DATA(lv_hash_xstr)
    ).

    rv_hmac = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_encoder( )->convert( lv_hash_xstr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus `SFLIGHTS` und formatiere diese als kommaseparierten String. Verwende `FOR` und String Templates.
hint: Nutze `FOR` und String Templates mit `REDUCE` oder `CONCATENATE LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_string_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_airline_list_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_airline_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_string_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_list_as_string.
    DATA(lt_unique_airlines) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( ls_sflight-carrid )
    ).

    rv_airline_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_airline IN lt_unique_airlines
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_airline ELSE |{ s }, { ls_airline }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um diese zu einem kommaseparierten String zu verbinden. Instructions: Berechne den HMAC für einen String, wobei der Hash-Algorithmus dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird (z.B. SHA256 oder MD5).
hint: Nutze `CL_ABAP_HMAC` und übergebe den Algorithmus als Variable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_hmac_result,
             algorithm TYPE string,
             hmac      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_hmac_result.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE string
        iv_key      TYPE string
        iv_algorithm TYPE string " e.g., 'SHA256', 'MD5'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_hmac_result
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_hmac.
    DATA(lv_alg_constant) = SWITCH string(
      iv_algorithm
      WHEN 'SHA256' THEN cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      WHEN 'MD5'    THEN cl_abap_hmac=>alg_md5
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_hmac_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Unsupported algorithm: { iv_algorithm }|
    ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = lv_alg_constant
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_key )
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_hash_for_char(
      data   = iv_data
      hash   = DATA(lv_hash_xstr)
    ).

    rs_result-algorithm = iv_algorithm.
    rs_result-hmac = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_encoder( )->convert( lv_hash_xstr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_hmac FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unsupported_algorithm FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_hmac.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = 'Dynamic Algorithm Test'.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'dynamic'.

    " Test SHA256
    DATA(ls_result_sha256) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_hmac( iv_data = lv_data iv_key = lv_key iv_algorithm = 'SHA256' ).
    " Expected SHA256 HMAC (placeholder)
    DATA(lv_expected_sha256) = '7504020211221122112211221122112211221122112211221122112211221122'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_sha256-hmac
      exp = lv_expected_sha256
      msg = 'Dynamic HMAC SHA256 failed'
    ).

    " Test MD5
    DATA(ls_result_md5) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_hmac( iv_data = lv_data iv_key = lv_key iv_algorithm = 'MD5' ).
    " Expected MD5 HMAC (placeholder)
    DATA(lv_expected_md5) = '75040202112211221122112211221122'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_md5-hmac
      exp = lv_expected_md5
      msg = 'Dynamic HMAC MD5 failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unsupported_algorithm.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_hmac( iv_data = 'Data' iv_key = 'Key' iv_algorithm = 'UNKNOWN' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for unsupported algorithm' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught unsupported algorithm exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Auswahl des Hash-Algorithmus zur Laufzeit. Mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression wird der passende Algorithmus-Konstante von `CL_ABAP_HMAC` basierend auf einem Eingabestring ausgewählt. Dies ermöglicht flexiblere Implementierungen, bei denen der Algorithmus von Konfigurationen oder Benutzereingaben abhängen kann. Eine Ausnahmebehandlung für nicht unterstützte Algorithmen ist ebenfalls integriert.
keywords: HMAC, Security, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_HMAC, SWITCH, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, wobei für jeden Flug ein Status ('Full', 'Available', 'Empty') basierend auf der Auslastung der Sitze hinzugefügt wird. Nutze `COND` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwende `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( COND string( ... ) ) )`.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    rt_flights_with_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                        connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc,
                                        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax,
                                        status   = COND string(
                                                     WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'Full'
                                                     WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0 THEN 'Empty'
                                                     ELSE 'Available' )

Instructions: SFLIGHT-Daten: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere (PASSENGER_CNT) pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Das Ergebnis soll eine Tabelle mit den Spalten CARRID und TOTAL_PASSENGERS sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie Open SQL mit der `GROUP BY`-Klausel und der Aggregatfunktion `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_agg,
             carrid        type sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers type i,
           END OF ty_passenger_agg.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Freigewicht (MAX_BAGG)-Werte aus einer Liste von Flügen, wobei Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression verwenden.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator iteriert über eine Tabelle und akkumuliert einen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_total_baggage
      IMPORTING is_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_baggage) TYPE sflight-max_bag.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_baggage.
    rv_total_baggage = REDUCE #( INIT baggage_sum = 0 type sflight-max_bag
                                 FOR wa IN is_all_flights
                                 NEXT baggage_sum = baggage_sum + wa-max_bag ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' max_bag = 15 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' max_bag = 25 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total_baggage) = lo_sflight_reduce->calculate_total_baggage( is_all_flights = lt_sflights ).

Es ersetzt auf elegante Weise klassische `LOOP...ENDLOOP`-Statements mit manueller Summenbildung. Der berechnete Gesamtwert könnte als einzelne Kennzahl in einem Dashboard oder als Summe in einem Diagramm von `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` verwendet werden.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine 'fluent interface' für eine Klasse, die die Flugdaten transformiert, um mehrere Operationen wie Filter und Sortierung aneinanderreihen zu können.
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden, die `ME` (das aktuelle Objekt) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING i_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS filter_by_cityfrom
      IMPORTING i_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_sflight.

    METHODS sort_by_connid
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_sflight.

    METHODS get_results
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = i_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_cityfrom.
    mt_sflights = FILTER #( mt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = i_cityfrom ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sort_by_connid.
    SORT mt_sflights BY connid ASCENDING.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_results.
    rt_sflights = mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE zcl_fluent_sflight=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_initial_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0005' cityfrom = 'MUNICH' ) TO lt_initial_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_initial_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sorted) = NEW zcl_fluent_sflight( lt_initial_flights )->filter_by_cityfrom( 'FRANKFURT' )->sort_by_connid( )->get_results( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_sorted ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_sorted[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_sorted[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Ein 'fluent interface' oder Method Chaining (ab 7.50 effektiver durch bessere `ME`-Rückgabe) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile aneinanderzureihen. Jede Methode, die eine Operation ausführt, gibt eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurück, um das Chaining fortzusetzen. Dies fördert den funktionalen Stil und verbessert die Lesbarkeit von Datenverarbeitungspipelines. Solche Pipelines sind ideal, um auf komplexe Weise Daten für eine anspruchsvolle Diagrammdarstellung (z.B. mit `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN`) vorzubereiten.
keywords: Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Method Chaining, Functional Programming, Data Transformation

solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrierid TYPE sflight-carrid,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflight_to_report.
    rs_flight_report = CORRESPONDING #( is_sflight MAPPING carrierid = carrid
                                                    flightno = connid
                                                    source = cityfrom
                                                    destination = cityto
                                                    EXCEPT description ).

ENDCLASS.

Er kann für Felder mit gleichem Namen automatische Zuweisungen vornehmen und ermöglicht explizite `MAPPING`-Regeln sowie `EXCEPT`-Klauseln. Dies ist extrem nützlich, um Quelldaten (z.B. aus der Datenbank) in ein spezifisches Format für die Darstellung in Grafiken oder Berichten zu transformieren, was sehr oft bei der Verwendung von `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` der Fall ist.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie dynamisch die Feldnamen (Komponenten) einer beliebigen Struktur und geben Sie diese in einer Liste zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und die Methode `GET_COMPONENTS`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_structure_component_names
      IMPORTING ir_data         TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_component_names.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_root. "Handle possible exceptions, e.g., if ir_data is not a structure or initial
        " Error handling e.g. LOG_MESSAGE or RAISING EXCEPTION
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vereinigen Sie zwei interne Tabellen von Flugdaten zu einer einzigen Tabelle, wobei Duplikate vermieden werden sollten. Nutzen Sie hierfür die `CORRESPONDING`-Funktion für Tabellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` oder `INSERT LINES OF` mit Tabellenexpressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_merge DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS merge_sflight_tables
      IMPORTING is_table1 TYPE tt_sflight
                is_table2 TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_merged_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_merge IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_sflight_tables.
*   Option 1: Using CORRESPONDING with BASE (simplest for merging structures)
*   Requires compatible types and unique keys for efficient merge
    rt_merged_table = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( is_table1 ) is_table2 ).

*   Option 2: Using INSERT LINES OF (more control, for generic appending)
*   This example focuses on CORRESPONDING with BASE for uniqueness implicitly by UNIQUE KEY
*   INSERT LINES OF is_table2 INTO TABLE rt_merged_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_tables FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_tables.
    DATA: lt_flights1 TYPE zcl_itab_merge=>tt_sflight,
          lt_flights2 TYPE zcl_itab_merge=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_flights1.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' ) TO lt_flights1.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0030' ) TO lt_flights2.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_flights2. "Duplicate

    DATA(lo_merger) = NEW zcl_itab_merge( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_merger->merge_sflight_tables( is_table1 = lt_flights1 is_table2 = lt_flights2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). "LH0010, AA0020, BA0030
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab 7.40) kann auch verwendet werden, um interne Tabellen zu mergen, insbesondere mit der `BASE`-Option für die Initialisierung und Zuweisung. Wenn die Zieltabelle einen `UNIQUE KEY` hat, werden Duplikate automatisch vermieden. Dies ist eine elegante Methode, um Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen für eine konsolidierte Ansicht (z.B. in einem kombinierten Diagramm mit `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN`) zu aggregieren und vorzubereiten.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Merging, Duplicates, Data Aggregation

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf anonymer (Lambda-)Funktionen in Methodendefinitionen für eine kurze, interne Logik. Simulieren Sie die Berechnung einer Flugverspätung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONCATENATED` mit `FOR` oder `REDUCE` als Beispiel für kompakte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lambda_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_total_delay
      IMPORTING is_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_delay_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lambda_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_delay.
    " Simulate anonymous function concept by using a compact expression
    rv_total_delay_minutes = REDUCE #( INIT delay = 0
                                       FOR wa IN is_sflights
                                       LET scheduled_time = CAST tims( wa-deptime ) IN
                                       LET actual_time = CAST tims( wa-actdeptime ) IN
                                       NEXT delay = delay + COND #( WHEN actual_time > scheduled_time
                                                                    THEN ( actual_time - scheduled_time ) / 60 " Convert seconds to minutes
                                                                    ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delay_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_delay FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delay_calculation.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( deptime = '100000' actdeptime = '103000' ) TO lt_flights. "30 min delay
    APPEND VALUE sflight( deptime = '110000' actdeptime = '111000' ) TO lt_flights. "10 min delay

    DATA(lo_lambda) = NEW zcl_lambda_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_total_delay) = lo_lambda->calculate_total_delay( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_delay exp = 40 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_delay.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( deptime = '100000' actdeptime = '100000' ) TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lo_lambda) = NEW zcl_lambda_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_total_delay) = lo_lambda->calculate_total_delay( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_delay exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Während ABAP keine echten Lambda-Funktionen im Sinne vieler anderer Sprachen hat, können ähnliche Konzepte mit modernen Expressions wie `REDUCE`, `COND` und dem `LET`-Ausdruck (ab 7.50) erreicht werden. Dies ermöglicht die Definition kompakter, lokaler Logik, die direkt innerhalb eines Ausdrucks ausgeführt wird, ohne eine separate Methode erstellen zu müssen. Die berechneten Verspätungswerte sind perfekte Datenpunkte für ein Liniendiagramm oder ein Balkendiagramm, welches mit `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` umgesetzt werden könnte.
keywords: Lambda, Functional Programming, REDUCE, COND, LET, Expressions, Delay Calculation

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus einer Liste von Flugdaten alle Flüge heraus, deren Flugnummern in einer vorgegebenen Range-Tabelle liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `WHERE` und der `IN` Bedingung für die Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_for_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_range
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_data
        it_connid_range TYPE tt_connid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_for_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_range.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( connid IN it_connid_range ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_for_where( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_range_for_where=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0005' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0015' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE zcl_range_for_where=>tt_connid_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0010' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '0020' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_range(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      it_connid_range = lt_connid_range
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0005' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `WHERE` ermöglicht eine sehr expressive und performante Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die `IN` Bedingung mit einer Range-Tabelle ist hierbei besonders nützlich für komplexe Selektionskriterien.
keywords: RANGES, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE zcl_range_delete_not_in=>tt_connid_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0010' )
    ).

    lo_cut->delete_flights_not_in_range(
      it_connid_range = lt_connid_range
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0005' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` mit der `NOT IN` Bedingung und einer Range-Tabelle ist eine sehr mächtige und lesbare Methode, um Zeilen zu entfernen, die nicht einem bestimmten Kriterium entsprechen.
keywords: RANGES, DELETE, NOT IN, Internal Tables

Instructions: Löschen Sie aus einer internen Tabelle alle Flüge, für die es in einer anderen Tabelle keine entsprechende Buchung gibt (d.h. Flüge ohne Buchungen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE NOT line_exists(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_no_booking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sbook_data,
             carrid TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_sbook_data.
    TYPES: tt_sbook_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sbook_data
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS delete_flights_without_bookings
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_sbook_data
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_no_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_without_bookings.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE NOT line_exists( it_bookings[ carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_no_booking FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_no_booking( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_delete_no_booking=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) "Has booking
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0005' fldate = '20250102' ) "No booking
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' ) "Has booking
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' ) "No booking
    ).

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B1' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' bookid = 'B2' )
    ).

    lo_cut->delete_flights_without_bookings(
      it_bookings = lt_bookings
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `DELETE ... WHERE NOT line_exists(...)` ist eine moderne Art, Zeilen aus einer Tabelle zu entfernen, die keine Entsprechung in einer anderen Tabelle haben. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die zweite Tabelle einen eindeutigen Schlüssel hat und die Performance durch den direkten Zugriff verbessert wird.
keywords: DELETE, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Joins

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aus einer internen Tabelle alle Flüge, deren Flugnummern in einer bestimmten Range liegen, indem Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den verbleibenden Einträgen erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit der `NOT IN` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_filter_not_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    METHODS filter_out_flights_in_range
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_data
        it_connid_range TYPE tt_connid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_filter_not_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_out_flights_in_range.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN it_connid_range WHERE connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_out_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_out_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_filter_not_in( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_delete_filter_not_in=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0005' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0015' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE zcl_delete_filter_not_in=>tt_connid_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0010' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_out_flights_in_range(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      it_connid_range = lt_connid_range
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0015' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Zeilen enthält. Die `EXCEPT IN` Syntax ist hierbei besonders prägnant für Ausschlusskriterien basierend auf Ranges.
keywords: DELETE, FILTER, RANGES, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Flugnummern, die dynamisch aus einer Datenbanktabelle (sflight) gelesen wird, basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. alle Flugnummern für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_temp)` und dann den `FOR` Operator, um die Range-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_from_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    METHODS get_connid_range_for_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connid_range) TYPE tt_connid_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_from_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_range_for_carrid.
    DATA: lt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT DISTINCT connid
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_connids.

    rt_connid_range = VALUE #( FOR connid IN lt_connids ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_range_from_db FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_range_from_db.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_from_db( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_connid_range_for_carrid( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has at least one flight in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-sign exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-option exp = 'EQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle aus Datenbankdaten erstellt. Die Kombination von `SELECT INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und dem `FOR` Operator ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten zu aggregieren und in die gewünschte Struktur zu transformieren.
keywords: RANGES, SELECT, FOR, Dynamic, Database, sflight

Instructions: Löschen Sie aus einer internen Tabelle alle Flüge, deren Fluggesellschaft in einer Range von ausgeschlossenen Fluggesellschaften liegt, und deren Flugnummern ebenfalls in einer Range von ausgeschlossenen Flugnummern liegen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ... IN ... AND ... IN ...` mit zwei Range-Tabellen.

CLASS zcl_delete_multi_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
    TYPES: tt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_multi_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_exclude_range TYPE tt_carrid_range
        it_connid_exclude_range TYPE tt_connid_range
      CHANGING
        ct_flights              TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_multi_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_multi_range.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_exclude_range AND connid IN it_connid_exclude_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_multi_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_multi_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_multi_range( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_delete_multi_range=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) "Match both ranges
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0005' fldate = '20250102' ) "Match carrid, not connid
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' ) "Match connid, not carrid
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250104' ) "No match

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE zcl_delete_multi_range=>tt_connid_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0003' )
    ).

    lo_cut->delete_flights_by_multi_range(
      it_carrid_exclude_range = lt_carrid_range
