Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise aus einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #()` mit einem `INIT`-Parameter und einer `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' price = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250104' price = 300 )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 860 msg = 'Total price calculation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP`-Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen und macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer. Code Inspector hebt die Vorteile solcher funktionalen Ausdrücke hervor, da sie oft weniger fehleranfällig sind.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Strukturen in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und die Flugnummer (`connid`) enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 90 )
    ).

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE tt_flight_keys(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_transformation.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First transformed carrid incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Third transformed connid incorrect' ).

Anstatt eine `LOOP`-Schleife zu schreiben und manuell Zeilen zu `APPEND`en, kann die Transformation in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung erfolgen. Dies ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP-Stils und wird vom Code Inspector als Best Practice angesehen.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, VALUE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Setter-Methoden, die jeweils `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. Demonstrieren Sie die Erstellung eines Objekts und das Aufrufen mehrerer Methoden in einer einzigen, verketteten Anweisung.
hint: Geben Sie in den Setter-Methoden `ME` zurück, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_param1 IMPORTING iv_param TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_builder.
    METHODS set_param2 IMPORTING iv_param TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_builder.
    METHODS get_combined_params RETURNING VALUE(rv_combined) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    mv_param1 = iv_param.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    mv_param2 = iv_param.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_combined_params.
    rv_combined = |{ mv_param1 } - { mv_param2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_chained_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->set_param1( 'Wert A' )->set_param2( 'Wert B' )->get_combined_params( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Wert A - Wert B' msg = 'Method chaining failed' ).

explanation: Method Chaining, ermöglicht durch das Zurückgeben von `ME` (der Instanz des Objekts) in den Setter-Methoden, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes erheblich. Es erlaubt, mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile auszuführen, was dem Fluent Interface-Designmuster entspricht. Code Inspector bewertet solche Designmuster positiv, da sie zu wartbarerem Code führen.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, NEW

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Status-Text basierend auf einem Status-Code zu. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck, um verschiedene Fälle abzudecken.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH #()` für die bedingte Wertzuweisung.

CLASS zcl_status_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text IMPORTING iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1 RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
      WHEN 'I' THEN 'Inaktiv'
      WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blockiert'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine spezifische Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` basierend auf ihrem Index. Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... REFERENCE INTO` und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Index ungültig ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... REFERENCE INTO DATA()` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_by_index IMPORTING iv_index TYPE i
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_index.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 90 )
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_all_flights INDEX iv_index REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = lr_flight->*.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_index( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Flight at index 2 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_index( 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-carrid msg = 'Result should be initial for invalid index' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight)` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen, insbesondere wenn die Zeile modifiziert werden soll. `REFERENCE INTO` vermeidet das Kopieren der gesamten Zeile und arbeitet direkt mit einem Daten-Referenz. Die Inline-Deklaration des Referenz-Feldsymbols (`DATA(lr_flight)`) ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature. Code Inspector prüft auf effiziente Tabellenzugriffe und bevorzugt `REFERENCE INTO` gegenüber `INTO` bei großen Strukturen.
keywords: READ TABLE, Internal Tables, REFERENCE INTO, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Typ eines beliebigen übergebenen Datenobjekts dynamisch ermittelt und den Namen des Datentyps zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie hierfür RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_type_name.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    rv_type_name = lo_typedescr->get_name( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_integer_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_test_table TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_cut->get_data_type_name( REF #( lt_test_table ) ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ist ein mächtiges Feature in modernem ABAP, um zur Laufzeit Informationen über Datentypen zu erhalten. `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` ist der zentrale Einstiegspunkt. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Frameworks oder Tools, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen. Code Inspector kann RTTI-Verwendungen analysieren, um potenzielle dynamische Programmierfehler zu identifizieren oder um sicherzustellen, dass RTTI korrekt eingesetzt wird.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Information, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Strukturen nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Verwenden Sie hierfür `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `GROUP REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' price = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250104' price = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250105' price = 100 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_key>).
      DATA(ls_grouped_entry) = VALUE ty_grouped_flight(
        carrid       = <fs_group_key>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price  = GROUP REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR member IN GROUP
          NEXT sum = sum + member-price
        )
      ).
      APPEND ls_grouped_entry TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of groups' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'LH flight count incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-total_price exp = 540 msg = 'LH total price incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'AA flight count incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-total_price exp = 300 msg = 'AA total price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die Notwendigkeit, manuelle Sortierungen und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukte zu verwenden, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und lesbarer macht. `GROUP SIZE` und `GROUP REDUCE` sind hierbei besonders nützlich. Code Inspector fördert die Verwendung dieser modernen Gruppierungsfunktionen für effiziente Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, GROUP REDUCE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Nutzen Sie hierfür moderne String-Funktionen.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input.
    " Entfernt führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und ersetzt mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes
    CONDENSE rv_cleaned_string NO-GAPS.
    " Falls CONDENSE nicht alle Fälle abdeckt (z.B. bei Tabs oder anderen Whitespaces), kann Regex helfen
    " rv_cleaned_string = replace( val = rv_cleaned_string regex = '\s+' with = ' ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'Basic cleaning failed' ).

  METHOD test_clean_string_complex.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string( `	  ABAP	  is   Great!   ` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP is Great!' msg = 'Complex cleaning failed' ).

explanation: Die `CONDENSE ... NO-GAPS`-Anweisung ist eine klassische, aber immer noch effiziente Methode in ABAP, um führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen zu entfernen und mehrere Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes zu ersetzen. Für komplexere Whitespace-Bereinigungen (z.B. Tabs) könnte `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' WITH ' '` verwendet werden. Diese String-Operationen sind grundlegend für die Datenbereinigung. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines ABAP-Attributs (`@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName`) für eine CDS-View. Erklären Sie, wie solche Attribute die Metadaten von ABAP-Objekten erweitern und wie ein Tool wie der Code Inspector (theoretisch über `cl_ci_query_attributes`) diese Metadaten auslesen könnte, um Code-Qualität oder Konventionen zu prüfen. (Hinweis: Die Lösung zeigt die Definition, nicht das Auslesen zur Laufzeit, da dies ein Tool-Kontext ist).
hint: Fügen Sie ein Attribut zu einer CDS-View-Definition hinzu. Erläutern Sie die Rolle von `cl_ci_query_attributes` in der Erklärung.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cds_view_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cds_view_exists.
    " Dieser Unit Test kann nicht direkt die Attribute einer CDS-View zur Laufzeit prüfen,
    " da dies ein Metadaten-Aspekt ist, der von Entwicklungstools analysiert wird.
    " Stattdessen prüfen wir, ob die CDS-View im System existiert.
    DATA(lv_view_name) = 'ZCDS_FLIGHT_ATTRIBUTES'.
    DATA(lv_sql_view_name) = 'ZCDS_FLIGHT_SQL'.
    DATA(lv_exists) = abap_false.

    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true FROM dd25l INTO @lv_exists WHERE viewname = @lv_view_name.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true msg = 'CDS View ZCDS_FLIGHT_ATTRIBUTES does not exist' ).

    CLEAR lv_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true FROM dd25l INTO @lv_exists WHERE viewname = @lv_sql_view_name.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true msg = 'SQL View ZCDS_FLIGHT_SQL does not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Diese Attribute sind entscheidend für die Erweiterung der ABAP-Sprache und die Integration mit Entwicklungstools. Ein Tool wie der Code Inspector könnte theoretisch die Klasse `cl_ci_query_attributes` verwenden, um diese Attribute auszulesen und zu prüfen, ob bestimmte Konventionen eingehalten werden (z.B. Namenskonventionen für SQL-Views, Vorhandensein von Test-Attributen). Dies ermöglicht eine statische Code-Analyse, die über die reine Syntaxprüfung hinausgeht und die Einhaltung von Best Practices sicherstellt.
keywords: Attributes, CDS View, Metadaten, Code Inspector, cl_ci_query_attributes, S_CODE_INSPECTOR

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA(lt_unsorted) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 90 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_unsorted iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Sort by CARRID failed (first entry)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Sort by CARRID failed (second entry)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_price.
    DATA(lt_unsorted) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 90 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_unsorted iv_field_name = 'PRICE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-price exp = 90 msg = 'Sort by PRICE failed (first entry)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-price exp = 150 msg = 'Sort by PRICE failed (second entry)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field_name.
    DATA(lt_unsorted) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_unsorted iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for invalid field name' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Sortierung von internen Tabellen mittels `SORT itab BY (field_name)` ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Anwendungen, bei denen die Sortierreihenfolge zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden muss. Es ist eine moderne Alternative zu älteren, oft umständlicheren dynamischen Programmiertechniken. Die Methode `RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val` zeigt die korrekte Ausnahmebehandlung für ungültige Feldnamen. Code Inspector prüft die Verwendung dynamischer Programmierung und empfiehlt, Ausnahmen korrekt zu behandeln.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Exception Handling

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Stunde und Minute aus einem Zeitstring im Format 'HH:MM:SS' und geben Sie diese als String 'Stunde: HH, Minute: MM' zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TIMEFM=>S_CONVERT` und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timefm_extract_hm DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_hour_minute
      IMPORTING
        iv_time_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_timefm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_extract_hm IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_hour_minute.
    DATA(lv_hour)   TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_minute) TYPE string.

    lv_hour = cl_abap_timefm=>s_convert(
      iv_time_string = iv_time_string
      iv_format_mask = 'HH:MM:SS'
      iv_format_mask_out = 'HH'
    ).

    lv_minute = cl_abap_timefm=>s_convert(
      iv_time_string = iv_time_string
      iv_format_mask = 'HH:MM:SS'
      iv_format_mask_out = 'MM'
    ).

    rv_result = |Stunde: { lv_hour }, Minute: { lv_minute }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mapped_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mapped_flight_info.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                               ( flight_id       = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|
                                 formatted_price = |{ ls_flight-price STYLE = RAW } { ls_flight-currency }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus und berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Selektion und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, price
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_avg_prices = REDUCE tt_avg_price_by_carrier(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_avg_price_by_carrier( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      LET lv_sum_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                           INIT s = 0
                           FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                           NEXT s = s + ls_group_flight-price )
          lv_count_flights = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count_flights > 0 THEN lv_sum_price / lv_count_flights ELSE 0 ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_carrier( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es sollte ein Eintrag für AA geben' ).
    DATA(ls_avg_price) = lt_avg_prices[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_avg_price-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_avg_price-average_price > 0 ) msg = 'Durchschnittspreis sollte positiv sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_price_multiple_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_fae_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sflights_fae_reduce=>tt_carrier(
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_carrier( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten Einträge für AA und LH geben' ).
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_avg_price).
      IF ls_avg_price-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_avg_price-average_price > 0 ) msg = 'AA Durchschnittspreis sollte positiv sein' ).
      ELSEIF ls_avg_price-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_avg_price-average_price > 0 ) msg = 'LH Durchschnittspreis sollte positiv sein' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_aa_found AND lv_lh_found ) msg = 'Durchschnittspreise für beide Carrier sollten gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_price_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_fae_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sflights_fae_reduce=>tt_carrier(
      ( carrid = 'XX' ) " Nicht existierender Carrier
    ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_carrier( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_avg_prices msg = 'Es sollten keine Durchschnittspreise gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Datenbeschaffung und dem `REDUCE`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40 SP05) für die Aggregation. `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, komplexe Aggregationen und Gruppierungen direkt in ABAP-Code auszudrücken, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt. Hier wird der Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft berechnet, indem die Flüge gruppiert und dann die Summe und Anzahl der Flüge innerhalb jeder Gruppe ermittelt werden.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Verbindung zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Selektion und den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_group_no_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_fae_group( ).

      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts msg = 'Es sollten gruppierte Flugdaten gefunden werden' ).
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'Fluganzahl sollte positiv sein' ).
      lv_total_flights = lv_total_flights + ls_count-flight_count.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_flights exp = lines( VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_carriers WHERE carrid = lt_carriers-carrid ) msg = 'Gesamtzahl der Flüge sollte übereinstimmen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_fae_group( ).

      ( carrid = 'XX' ) " Nicht existierender Carrier
    ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_carriers ).

Die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe wird mit `lines( GROUP ls_flight )` ermittelt.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Zeitangabe (z.B. '13:00:00') in eine andere Zeitzone (z.B. von UTC nach CET) und geben Sie die formatierte Zeit zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TIMEFM` und `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für Zeitzonenkonvertierungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timefm_timezone_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_time_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_time_utc TYPE t
        iv_target_tzone TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_time_target_tzone) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_timefm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_timezone_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_time_timezone.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum. " Dummy-Datum für die Konvertierung
    DATA(lv_timestamp_utc) TYPE timestampl.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_target) TYPE timestampl.

    " UTC-Zeitstempel erstellen
    cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date   = lv_date
        iv_time   = iv_time_utc
        iv_tzone  = 'UTC'
      IMPORTING
        ev_tstmpl = lv_timestamp_utc
    ).

    " In Zielzeitzone konvertieren
    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_date_time(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmpl = lv_timestamp_utc
        iv_tzone  = iv_target_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_time   = DATA(lv_time_target)
    ).

    " Formatierte Zeit zurückgeben
    rv_time_target_tzone = cl_abap_timefm=>s_convert(
      iv_time        = lv_time_target
      iv_format_mask = 'HH:MM:SS'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_utc_to_cet FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_utc_to_est FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utc_to_cet.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timefm_timezone_convert( ).
    " 13:00:00 UTC sollte 14:00:00 CET sein (im Winter, ohne Sommerzeit)
    " Für den Test nehmen wir an, dass CET = UTC+1 ist.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_time_timezone( iv_time_utc = '130000' iv_target_tzone = 'CET' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '14:00:00' msg = 'UTC 13:00 sollte CET 14:00 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_utc_to_est.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timefm_timezone_convert( ).
    " 13:00:00 UTC sollte 08:00:00 EST sein (UTC-5)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_time_timezone( iv_time_utc = '130000' iv_target_tzone = 'EST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '08:00:00' msg = 'UTC 13:00 sollte EST 08:00 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `CL_ABAP_TIMEFM` mit `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für die Zeitzonenkonvertierung. Zuerst wird ein UTC-Zeitstempel erstellt, dann dieser Zeitstempel in die Zielzeitzone konvertiert, um die entsprechende Zeit zu erhalten. Abschließend wird die Zeit mit `CL_ABAP_TIMEFM` formatiert. Dies ist der empfohlene Weg, um mit Zeitzonen in ABAP umzugehen, da er die Komplexität der Sommerzeit und anderer Zeitzonenregeln berücksichtigt.
keywords: cl_abap_timefm, cl_abap_tstmp, Zeitformat, Zeitzone, UTC, CET, SABP_CONVERT

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_dynamic_curr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_dynamic_curr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_dynamic_currency.
    IF it_criteria IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_criteria
        WHERE carrid   = @it_criteria-carrid

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus und erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge enthält, die in der Zukunft liegen (basierend auf `fldate`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Selektion und anschließend einen `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit `sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_fae_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_future_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die HMAC-Generierung mit robuster Fehlerbehandlung, indem Sie mögliche Ausnahmen abfangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen wie `CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST_ERROR` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_safe.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
                                    algorithm = if_abap_hmac_types=>alg_sha256
                                    key       = iv_key ).
        lo_hmac->calculate_hmac_for_string(
          EXPORTING
            data   = iv_message
          IMPORTING
            hmac   = rv_hmac
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und verarbeiten Sie die Antwort. Fehlerbehandlung soll mit `TRY...CATCH` erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` und fangen Sie Ausnahmen wie `CX_HTTP_CONN_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_url_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_content.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Failed to create HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Failed to send HTTP request'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Failed to receive HTTP response'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        lv_reason = lo_http_client->get_status_text( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          rv_content = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
            EXPORTING
              text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason }|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_conn_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_resp_receive_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |HTTP Communication Error: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_get_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_example( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://www.example.com'.
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_cut->get_url_content( lv_url ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_content msg = 'Content should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Example Domain' act = lv_content msg = 'Content should contain expected text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_example( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://invalid.example.com/nonexistent'.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_url_content( lv_url ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for invalid URL' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für externe HTTP-Anfragen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist entscheidend für robuste Kommunikation, wobei spezifische Ausnahmen für Netzwerk- und Kommunikationsfehler abgefangen werden. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit der Fehlermeldungen.
keywords: HTTP, CL_HTTP_CLIENT, TRY, CATCH, Exception, String Templates, GET Request

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String in eine ABAP-Datenstruktur und behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler während des Parsens.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json.
    DATA: ls_parsed_data TYPE ty_data.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = iv_json_string
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          CHANGING
            data        = ls_parsed_data
        ).
        rs_data = ls_parsed_data.
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |JSON Parsing Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Data Conversion Error: { lx_cast_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle, transformieren Sie die gefilterten Zeilen und aggregieren Sie ein Ergebnis, alles in einem funktionalen Stil.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` (MAP) und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_it_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_it_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price = 0.00 TYPE s_price
      FOR <fs_flight> IN FILTER #( 
                                    it_flights
                                    WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND price > 100
                                  )
      NEXT total_price = total_price + ( <fs_flight>-price * '0.9' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_functional_it_example=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 90  currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_it_example( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 360.00 msg = 'Total price calculation incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarken funktionalen Operatoren `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für interne Tabellen. `FILTER` wählt Zeilen basierend auf Bedingungen aus, während `REDUCE` eine Aggregation über die gefilterten Daten durchführt. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, REDUCE, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Felder einer Struktur zu und ändern Sie deren Werte zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        <fs_field> = iv_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Type mismatch for field '{ iv_field_name }': { lx_cast_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_field_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_set_field_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_set_field_type_mismatch FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_field_success.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 'Test Value' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'Test Value' ).

    lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' iv_value = '123' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_field_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_value = 'Value' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_field_type_mismatch.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value( EXPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' iv_value = 'ABC' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for type mismatch' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturfelder mittels `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, bei denen Feldnamen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke stellen sicher, dass Fehler wie nicht existierende Felder oder Typkonflikte elegant behandelt werden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, TRY, CATCH, RTTI

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle mit der neuen Open SQL Syntax und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die nicht alle Felder der Datenbanktabelle enthält.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_open_sql_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_info.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String unter Verwendung von String-Templates und verketten Sie mehrere Operationen.

CLASS zcl_string_template_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_age  TYPE i

CLASS zcl_string_template_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message.
    rv_message = |Hello, { iv_name }! You are { iv_age } years old.|.
    rv_message = rv_message && | Today is { sy-datum DATE = USER }.|.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie Objekte und interne Tabellen mit Constructor Expressions (`VALUE`, `NEW`) in einem einzigen Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...)` für interne Tabellen und `NEW #(...)` für Objekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_constructor_expr_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.

    METHODS create_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_item) TYPE REF TO zcl_constructor_expr_example.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_constructor_expr_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_items.
    rt_items = VALUE #( 
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item C' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object.
    ro_item = NEW zcl_constructor_expr_example( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_items FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_constructor_expr_example( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_cut->create_items( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 3 ]-name exp = 'Item C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_constructor_expr_example( ).
    DATA(lo_item) = lo_cut->create_object( iv_id = 10 iv_name = 'New Object' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Expressions wie `VALUE #(...)` für interne Tabellen und `NEW #(...)` für Objekte ermöglichen eine kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von Daten und Objekten. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen und verbessert die Code-Flüssigkeit.
keywords: Constructor Expressions, VALUE, NEW, Internal Tables, Object Creation

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` zur Fehlerbehandlung bei einer Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Division durch Null nicht erlaubt: { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Arithmetischer Fehler: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling_example( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling_example( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for division by zero' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `TRY...CATCH`-Konstrukt ist der Standardweg zur Fehlerbehandlung in modernem ABAP. Es ermöglicht das Abfangen spezifischer Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` und die Bereitstellung aussagekräftiger Fehlermeldungen, was die Robustheit der Anwendung erhöht.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception Handling, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Error Handling

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit JSON-Payload durch und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort. Nutzen Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` und `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Setzen Sie den Content-Type auf 'application/json' und verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT->SET_CDATA` für die Payload.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_request_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             status  TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        is_request_data TYPE ty_request_data
        iv_url          TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response_data) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_request_data
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_request
        ).

        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create HTTP client'. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

        lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to send HTTP request'. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to receive HTTP response'. ENDIF.

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        lv_reason = lo_http_client->get_status_text( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          lv_json_response = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
            EXPORTING
              json        = lv_json_response
              pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
            CHANGING
              data        = rs_response_data
          ).
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason }|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_conn_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_resp_receive_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Communication Error: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |JSON Processing Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_post_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_post_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_post_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_post_json_example( ).
    DATA(ls_request) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json_example=>ty_request_data( key = 'test' value = 'data' ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://httpbin.org/post'. " A public endpoint for testing POST requests

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->post_json_data( is_request_data = ls_request iv_url = lv_url ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_response-status exp = 'success' msg = 'Expected success status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_response-message exp = 'Data received' msg = 'Expected success message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_post_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_post_json_example( ).
    DATA(ls_request) = VALUE zcl_http_post_json_example=>ty_request_data( key = 'test' value = 'data' ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://invalid.example.com/post'.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->post_json_data( is_request_data = ls_request iv_url = lv_url ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for invalid URL' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die HTTP-Kommunikation um POST-Requests mit JSON-Payload. Es zeigt die Serialisierung von ABAP-Daten in JSON, das Setzen des Content-Type Headers und die Deserialisierung der JSON-Antwort. Die umfassende `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur fängt sowohl HTTP-Kommunikations- als auch JSON-Verarbeitungsfehler ab.
keywords: HTTP, CL_HTTP_CLIENT, POST Request, JSON, Serialization, Deserialization, TRY, CATCH

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den Conditional Operator (`COND`) um einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zuzuweisen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND #(...)` für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 200 THEN 'OK'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 404 THEN 'Not Found'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 500 THEN 'Internal Server Error'
      ELSE 'Unknown Status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_ok FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_ok.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator_example( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_status_text( 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_text exp = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator_example( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_status_text( 404 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_text exp = 'Not Found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_unknown.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator_example( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_text exp = 'Unknown Status' ).
