explanation: Der Conditional Operator (`COND`) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er ersetzt längere `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF`-Konstrukte und ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen bestimmt werden muss.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Conditional Operator, IF-ELSE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Zeilen einer internen Tabelle und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen mit der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight_line-carrid )
                                                  ASCENDING
                                                  INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.00.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count
                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_summarize_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_group_by_example=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum price = 300 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_summary_lh) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-total_price exp = 500.00 ).

    DATA(ls_summary_aa) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-total_price exp = 500.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_group_by_example=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) msg = 'Summary should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ab ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungslogik erheblich und macht den Code lesbarer und wartbarer, da keine manuellen Schleifen und Hilfstabellen mehr benötigt werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, LOOP AT GROUP, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum für 'morgen' und 'gestern' relativ zum aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden von `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER` oder direkte arithmetische Operationen mit Datumstypen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_relative_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_dates) TYPE REF TO zcl_date_calc_example=>ty_relative_dates.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relative_dates,
             today    TYPE sy-datum,
             yesterday TYPE sy-datum,
             tomorrow TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_relative_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_relative_dates.
    DATA: ls_dates TYPE ty_relative_dates.

    ls_dates-today = sy-datum.
    ls_dates-yesterday = sy-datum - 1.
    ls_dates-tomorrow = sy-datum + 1.

    rs_dates = NEW ty_relative_dates( ls_dates ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_relative_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_relative_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc_example( ).
    DATA(ls_dates) = lo_cut->get_relative_dates( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates->today exp = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates->yesterday exp = sy-datum - 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates->tomorrow exp = sy-datum + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP-Datumstypen unterstützen direkte arithmetische Operationen, um Tage zu addieren oder zu subtrahieren. Dies ist eine einfache und effiziente Methode, um relative Daten zu berechnen, ohne komplexe Funktionsbausteine oder Klassen verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: Date, Time, Arithmetic, SY-DATUM

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Interface mit einer Standardimplementierung für eine Methode und überschreiben Sie diese in einer implementierenden Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES ... DEFAULT METHODS` und `REDEFINITION`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.

  METHODS log_error
    IMPORTING
      iv_error_message TYPE string
    DEFAULT METHODS 'log_message'. " Default implementation
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / 'LOG:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_logger~log_error.
    WRITE: / 'ERROR:', iv_error_message COLOR 6.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Default implementation for log_error is used
    WRITE: / 'Simple Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_simple_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST zif_logger( NEW zcl_console_logger( ) ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for console' ).
    lo_logger->log_error( 'Error message for console' ).
    " Assertions for output are tricky in ABAP Unit, usually done by checking internal state or mock objects.
    " Here, we just ensure no dump occurs and methods are callable.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Console logger methods called' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_simple_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST zif_logger( NEW zcl_simple_logger( ) ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for simple logger' ).
    lo_logger->log_error( 'Error message for simple logger (default)' ).
    " The default implementation of log_error should call log_message.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = '' msg = 'Simple logger methods called' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.55 führte die Möglichkeit ein, Standardimplementierungen für Interface-Methoden zu definieren (`DEFAULT METHODS`). Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen und ermöglicht eine flexiblere Gestaltung von Interfaces, da nicht jede Methode in jeder Klasse explizit implementiert werden muss. Klassen können die Standardimplementierung nutzen oder überschreiben.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Default Methods, ABAP 7.55, Redefinition

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Absolutwert einer Zahl und runden Sie eine Gleitkommazahl auf die nächste ganze Zahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie die eingebauten Funktionen `ABS` und `ROUND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_functions_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_neg TYPE i
        iv_float      TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO zcl_math_functions_example=>ty_math_results.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_math_results,
             abs_value TYPE i,
             rounded_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_math_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_functions_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_values.
    DATA: ls_results TYPE ty_math_results.

    ls_results-abs_value = abs( iv_number_neg ).
    ls_results-rounded_value = round( val = iv_float dec = 0 ).

    rs_results = NEW ty_math_results( ls_results ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_math_calculations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_math_calculations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_functions_example( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_cut->calculate_values( iv_number_neg = -10 iv_float = 15.6 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->abs_value exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->rounded_value exp = 16 ).

    DATA(ls_results2) = lo_cut->calculate_values( iv_number_neg = -5 iv_float = 15.4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results2->abs_value exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results2->rounded_value exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP bietet eine Reihe von eingebauten mathematischen Funktionen wie `ABS` für den Absolutwert und `ROUND` zum Runden. Diese Funktionen sind effizient und direkt im Code verwendbar, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit mathematischer Operationen verbessert.
keywords: Math, ABS, ROUND, Built-in Functions

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den ersten und letzten Tag des aktuellen Monats.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` mit der Periodenart 'M'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_current_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_month_dates,
             begin_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_month_dates.
    METHODS get_current_month_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_dates) TYPE ty_month_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_current_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_month_dates.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(ls_period) = lo_period_tool->get_period_for_date(
        iv_date       = lv_current_date
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_month
    ).
    rs_dates-begin_date = ls_period-begin_date.
    rs_dates-end_date   = ls_period-end_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_current_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_current_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_current_month( ).
    DATA(ls_dates) = lo_cut->get_current_month_dates( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_begin) = sy-datum.
    lv_expected_begin+6(2) = '01'. " Set day to 01

    DATA(lv_expected_end) = sy-datum.
    " Calculate end of month for current date
    DATA(lv_year)  = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = sy-datum+4(2).
    DATA(lv_last_day) = cl_reca_date=>get_last_day_of_month( iv_date = sy-datum ).
    lv_expected_end+6(2) = lv_last_day.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates-begin_date exp = lv_expected_begin msg = 'Startdatum falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates-end_date   exp = lv_expected_end   msg = 'Enddatum falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` bietet eine standardisierte und robuste Methode zur Ermittlung von Periodendaten, was die manuelle Datumsberechnung überflüssig macht. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung ist moderner ABAP-Stil.
keywords: Date/Time, Period, cl_bs_period_toolset_basics, sy-datum

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Startdatum des nächsten Quartals ausgehend vom aktuellen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` und die Methode `get_next_period`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_next_quarter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_quarter_start
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_start_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_next_quarter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_quarter_start.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).

    DATA(ls_current_quarter) = lo_period_tool->get_period_for_date(
        iv_date       = lv_current_date
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_quarter
    ).

    DATA(ls_next_quarter) = lo_period_tool->get_next_period(
        is_period     = ls_current_quarter
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_quarter
    ).
    rv_start_date = ls_next_quarter-begin_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_quarter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_quarter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_next_quarter( ).
    DATA(lv_next_quarter_start) = lo_cut->get_next_quarter_start( ).

    " Example: If sy-datum is 20251124 (Q4), next quarter starts 20260101
    " If sy-datum is 20250115 (Q1), next quarter starts 20250401
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).
    DATA(lv_expected_year) TYPE syear.
    DATA(lv_expected_month) TYPE sy_mon.

    IF lv_current_month BETWEEN '01' AND '03'. " Q1
      lv_expected_year = lv_current_year.
      lv_expected_month = '04'.
    ELSEIF lv_current_month BETWEEN '04' AND '06'. " Q2
      lv_expected_year = lv_current_year.
      lv_expected_month = '07'.
    ELSEIF lv_current_month BETWEEN '07' AND '09'. " Q3
      lv_expected_year = lv_current_year.
      lv_expected_month = '10'.
    ELSE. " Q4
      lv_expected_year = lv_current_year + 1.
      lv_expected_month = '01'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_expected_date) TYPE d.
    lv_expected_date = |{ lv_expected_year }{ lv_expected_month }01|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_next_quarter_start exp = lv_expected_date msg = 'Startdatum des nächsten Quartals falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_in_fiscal_year FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_in_fiscal_year.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_check_date( ).

    " Test date within current fiscal year
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lo_cut->is_date_in_fiscal_year( iv_date = sy-datum iv_fiscal_year = lv_current_year )
        msg = 'Aktuelles Datum sollte im aktuellen Geschäftsjahr liegen'
    ).

    " Test date outside current fiscal year (next year)
    DATA(lv_next_year) = lv_current_year + 1.
    DATA(lv_date_next_year) = |{ lv_next_year }0101|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = lo_cut->is_date_in_fiscal_year( iv_date = lv_date_next_year iv_fiscal_year = lv_current_year )
        msg = 'Datum im nächsten Jahr sollte nicht im aktuellen Geschäftsjahr liegen'
    ).

    " Test date outside current fiscal year (previous year)
    DATA(lv_prev_year) = lv_current_year - 1.
    DATA(lv_date_prev_year) = |{ lv_prev_year }1231|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = lo_cut->is_date_in_fiscal_year( iv_date = lv_date_prev_year iv_fiscal_year = lv_current_year )
        msg = 'Datum im vorherigen Jahr sollte nicht im aktuellen Geschäftsjahr liegen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Monatsperioden zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` und die Methode `get_periods_for_range`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period,
             begin_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_period.
    TYPES: tt_periods TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_monthly_periods_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE tt_periods.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_periods_in_range.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(lt_periods_raw) = lo_period_tool->get_periods_for_range(
        iv_startdate  = iv_start_date
        iv_enddate    = iv_end_date
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_month
    ).
    " Map raw periods to local type using a FOR expression
    rt_periods = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw_period IN lt_periods_raw
                          ( begin_date = ls_raw_period-begin_date
                            end_date   = ls_raw_period-end_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_periods[ 4 ]-begin_date exp = '20260101' msg = 'Vierte Periode Startdatum falsch' ).

CLASS zcl_period_add_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_offset_by_months
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_date TYPE d

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_date) TYPE d.

CLASS zcl_period_add_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_offset_by_months.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(ls_base_period) = lo_period_tool->get_period_for_date(
        iv_date       = iv_base_date
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_month
    ).
    DATA(ls_result_period) = lo_period_tool->add_periods(
        is_period     = ls_base_period
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_month
        iv_number     = iv_offset_months
    ).
    rv_result_date = ls_result_period-begin_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_offset_months.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_add_sub( ).
    DATA(lv_base_date) = '20250615'.

    " Add 3 months
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lo_cut->get_date_offset_by_months( iv_base_date = lv_base_date iv_offset_months = 3 ).

Instructions: Validieren Sie, ob ein ausgewähltes Datum (z.B. aus einem Kalender-UI) in der Zukunft liegt und nicht am Wochenende ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_date` für Wochentagsprüfung und einfache Datumsvergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_date_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_future_weekday
      IMPORTING
        iv_selected_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_date_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_future_weekday.
    " Datum muss in der Zukunft liegen
    IF iv_selected_date <= sy-datum.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Datum darf kein Wochenende sein (Samstag=6, Sonntag=7)
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_reca_date=>get_weekday( iv_date = iv_selected_date ).
    IF lv_weekday = 6 OR lv_weekday = 7.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_is_valid = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_date_validation( ).

    " Test: Datum in der Vergangenheit
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = lo_cut->is_valid_future_weekday( sy-datum - 1 )
        msg = 'Vergangenes Datum sollte ungültig sein'
    ).

    " Test: Aktuelles Datum
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = lo_cut->is_valid_future_weekday( sy-datum )
        msg = 'Aktuelles Datum sollte ungültig sein'
    ).

    " Test: Zukünftiges Wochenende (Beispiel: Nächster Samstag)
    DATA(lv_next_saturday) = sy-datum.
    DO.
      lv_next_saturday = lv_next_saturday + 1.
      IF cl_reca_date=>get_weekday( lv_next_saturday ) = 6.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = lo_cut->is_valid_future_weekday( lv_next_saturday )
        msg = 'Zukünftiger Samstag sollte ungültig sein'
    ).

    " Test: Zukünftiger Wochentag (Beispiel: Nächster Montag)
    DATA(lv_next_monday) = sy-datum.
    DO.
      lv_next_monday = lv_next_monday + 1.
      IF cl_reca_date=>get_weekday( lv_next_monday ) = 1.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lo_cut->is_valid_future_weekday( lv_next_monday )
        msg = 'Zukünftiger Montag sollte gültig sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Validierung von Datumsangaben ist eine häufige Aufgabe in UI-Anwendungen. Die Verwendung von `cl_reca_date` für Wochentagsberechnungen ist effizient. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `IF ... RETURN` und `DATA(...)` verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Date/Time, Validation, Weekend, cl_gui_calendar (related), cl_reca_date

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für einen bestimmten Zeitraum, die in einem Kalender-UI hervorgehoben werden könnten. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Features.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR`-Expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_date.
    TYPES: tt_flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_for_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_period.
    SELECT fldate, carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @iv_start_date AND @iv_end_date
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          ( fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                            carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = '20000101'. " SFLIGHTS has data from 2000
    DATA(lv_end)   = '20000131'.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_period( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'SFLIGHTS sollte Daten enthalten' ). " Should not be initial if SFLIGHTS has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'SFLIGHTS sollte Daten enthalten' ).

    " Check if all dates are within the range
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_flight-fldate GE lv_start AND ls_flight-fldate LE lv_end )
          msg = 'Flugdatum außerhalb des Bereichs'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das die Inline-Deklaration von internen Tabellen ermöglicht. `FOR`-Expressions werden verwendet, um die Daten in den gewünschten Typ zu mappen, was die Code-Kompaktheit und Lesbarkeit erhöht. Dies ist ideal, um Daten für eine Kalenderanzeige vorzubereiten.
keywords: Internal Tables, Date/Time, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, FOR Expression, cl_gui_calendar (related)

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Auswahl eines Datumsbereichs in einem Kalender-UI und geben Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage in diesem Bereich zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` für die Iteration und `cl_reca_date` für die Wochentagsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workday_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_in_range.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(lt_days_in_range) = lo_period_tool->get_periods_for_range(
        iv_startdate  = iv_start_date
        iv_enddate    = iv_end_date
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_day
    ).

    rv_workday_count = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR ls_day IN lt_days_in_range
        LET lv_weekday = cl_reca_date=>get_weekday( ls_day-begin_date ) IN
        WHERE ( lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7 )
        NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_period_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        is_period     = ls_period_input

CLASS zcl_period_group_quarter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_entry,
             entry_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_date_entry.
    TYPES: tt_date_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_quarter_count,
             quarter_id TYPE poper,
             count      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_quarter_count.
    TYPES: tt_quarter_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_quarter_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_dates_by_quarter
      IMPORTING
        it_dates TYPE tt_date_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_quarter_counts) TYPE tt_quarter_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_group_quarter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_dates_by_quarter.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).

    rt_quarter_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_date IN it_dates
                                  GROUP BY ( quarter_id = lo_period_tool->get_period_for_date(
                                                              iv_date = ls_date-entry_date,
                                                              iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_quarter
                                                          )-period_id )
                                  ( quarter_id = quarter_id,
                                    count      = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Daten, um nur jene zu behalten, die im aktuellen Monat liegen.

CLASS zcl_period_filter_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_entry,
             entry_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_date_entry.
    TYPES: tt_date_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dates_current_month
      IMPORTING
        it_all_dates TYPE tt_date_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_dates) TYPE tt_date_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_filter_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dates_current_month.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(ls_current_month_period) = lo_period_tool->get_period_for_date(
        iv_date       = sy-datum
        iv_periodtype = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>gc_periodtype_month
    ).

    rt_filtered_dates = FILTER #( it_all_dates USING KEY primary_key
                                  WHERE entry_date GE ls_current_month_period-begin_date
                                  AND   entry_date LE ls_current_month_period-end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_filter_month( ).
    DATA(lt_test_dates) TYPE zcl_period_filter_month=>tt_date_entries.

    " Dates for current month (assuming 202511xx)
    APPEND VALUE #( entry_date = '20251101' ) TO lt_test_dates.
    APPEND VALUE #( entry_date = '20251115' ) TO lt_test_dates.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Warteschlange von Aufträgen, die als benutzerdefinierter Typ definiert sind, bis die Warteschlange leer ist. Jeder Auftrag hat eine ID und eine Beschreibung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für die Auftragsstruktur und eine `WHILE` Schleife mit `READ TABLE ... INDEX 1` und `DELETE TABLE ... INDEX 1` zur Simulation einer Warteschlange (FIFO).
solution:
CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES: ty_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_orders
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_orders TYPE ty_orders
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_orders) TYPE ty_orders.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_orders.
    DATA: lt_queue TYPE ty_orders.
    lt_queue = it_initial_orders.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_current_order).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_current_order TO rt_processed_orders.
        DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie hierarchische Daten, die in einer geschachtelten Tabelle gespeichert sind, indem Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwenden, um Ebenen rekursiv abzuarbeiten. Die Hierarchie soll eine einfache Eltern-Kind-Beziehung darstellen.
hint: Definieren Sie geschachtelte `TYPES` für die Hierarchieknoten und verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um eine temporäre Liste von zu verarbeitenden Knoten zu verwalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hierarchy_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             id       TYPE i,
             parent_id TYPE i,
             value    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES: ty_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes TYPE ty_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_hierarchy.
    DATA: lt_to_process TYPE ty_nodes,
          lt_processed_nodes TYPE ty_nodes.

    " Start with root nodes (parent_id = 0 or initial)
    lt_to_process = FILTER #( it_all_nodes WHERE parent_id = 0 ).

    WHILE lt_to_process IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_to_process INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_current_node).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_current_node-id TO rt_processed_ids.
        APPEND ls_current_node TO lt_processed_nodes.
        DELETE TABLE lt_to_process INDEX 1.

        " Add children of the current node to the processing list
        DATA(lt_children) = FILTER #( it_all_nodes WHERE parent_id = ls_current_node-id ).
        APPEND LINES OF lt_children TO lt_to_process.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Root node
    ls_node-id = 1.

    " Children of Root

    " Child of Child 1

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die einen simulierten Vorgang bis zu einer maximalen Anzahl von Versuchen wiederholt, bis er erfolgreich ist oder die Versuche aufgebraucht sind. Geben Sie an, ob der Vorgang erfolgreich war.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Zähler und `EXIT` bei Erfolg. Simulieren Sie den Erfolg mit einer Zufallszahl oder einem einfachen Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_retry_mechanism DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_max_retries TYPE i.
    TYPES: ty_delay_ms TYPE i.

    METHODS perform_operation_with_retry
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE ty_max_retries
        iv_success_on_attempt TYPE i " Simulate success on this attempt number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_retry_mechanism IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_retry.
    DATA: lv_attempt TYPE i VALUE 0.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_attempt < iv_max_retries.
      lv_attempt = lv_attempt + 1.
      " Simulate an operation attempt
      IF lv_attempt = iv_success_on_attempt.
        rv_success = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ELSE.
        " Simulate a delay or some error handling
        " cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Operation failed on attempt ' && lv_attempt ). " For testing purposes
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_retry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_retry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_retries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_retry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_mechanism( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_retry( iv_max_retries = 3 iv_success_on_attempt = 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_retry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_retry_mechanism( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_retry( iv_max_retries = 3 iv_success_on_attempt = 4 ) ).

CLASS zcl_range_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_range.
    DATA: lt_current_range TYPE ty_carrid_range,
          ls_range_line    TYPE LINE OF ty_carrid_range.

    lt_current_range = it_carrid_range.
    rv_flight_count = 0.

    WHILE lt_current_range IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_current_range INDEX 1 INTO ls_range_line.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " In a real scenario, you would build a dynamic WHERE clause or use a loop with CHECK
        " For simplicity, we'll simulate processing one range entry at a time.
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid IN @ls_range_line.
        rv_flight_count = rv_flight_count + lv_count.
        DELETE TABLE lt_current_range INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zerlegen Sie einen Eingabestring manuell in Tokens basierend auf einem Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma), bis keine Trennzeichen mehr gefunden werden. Speichern Sie die extrahierten Tokens in einer Tabelle eines benutzerdefinierten Typs, der den Token-Wert und seine Startposition enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `FIND` und `SUBSTRING` oder `SHIFT` zum Extrahieren der Tokens. Definieren Sie einen `TYPES` für die Token-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_tokenizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_token,
             value TYPE string,
             pos   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_token.
    TYPES: ty_tokens TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_token WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS tokenize_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tokens) TYPE ty_tokens.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_tokenizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tokenize_string.
    DATA: lv_remaining_string TYPE string VALUE iv_input_string,
          lv_offset           TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_found_pos        TYPE i.
    DATA: ls_token            TYPE ty_token.

    WHILE lv_remaining_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_delimiter IN lv_remaining_string MATCH OFFSET lv_found_pos.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_token-value = lv_remaining_string(lv_found_pos).
        ls_token-pos = lv_offset.
        APPEND ls_token TO rt_tokens.

        lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_found_pos + STRLEN( iv_delimiter ).
        lv_remaining_string = lv_remaining_string+lv_found_pos+STRLEN( iv_delimiter ).
      ELSE.
        " No more delimiters, the rest is the last token
        ls_token-value = lv_remaining_string.
        ls_token-pos = lv_offset.
        APPEND ls_token TO rt_tokens.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie in der Tabelle `sflights` den nächsten verfügbaren Flug für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein Startdatum, indem Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwenden, die das Datum inkrementiert, bis ein Flug gefunden wird oder ein maximales Suchdatum erreicht ist.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Typ für die Flugdaten und verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `ADD 1 TO lv_date` und `SELECT SINGLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS find_next_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_start_date TYPE sflights-fldate
        iv_max_search_days TYPE i DEFAULT 30
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_next_flight.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE sflights-fldate VALUE iv_start_date,
          lv_days_searched TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lv_days_searched < iv_max_search_days.
      SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_found_flight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
          AND fldate = @lv_current_date.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Flight found
        EXIT.
      ELSE.
        " No flight found for current date, try next day
        lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
        lv_days_searched = lv_days_searched + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stack_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stack_element,
             message   TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_stack_element.
    TYPES: ty_stack TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_stack_element WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_stack
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_stack TYPE ty_stack
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_messages) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stack_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_stack.
    DATA: lt_stack TYPE ty_stack.
    lt_stack = it_initial_stack.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ) INTO DATA(ls_current_element).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_current_element-message TO rt_processed_messages.
        DELETE TABLE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wenden Sie eine Reihe von numerischen Transformationen auf einen Startwert an. Die Transformationen (Operation und Wert) sind in einer Tabelle eines benutzerdefinierten Typs definiert. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Transformationen sequenziell anzuwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie `TYPES` für die Transformation (z.B. `operation` als String, `value` als Integer) und eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Liste der Transformationen abzuarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformation_rule,
             operation TYPE string, " e.g., 'ADD', 'MULTIPLY'
             operand   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_transformation_rule.
    TYPES: ty_transformation_rules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformation_rule WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_transformations
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
        it_rules         TYPE ty_transformation_rules
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_transformations.
    DATA: lv_current_value TYPE i VALUE iv_initial_value,
          lt_rules_to_apply TYPE ty_transformation_rules.

    lt_rules_to_apply = it_rules.

    WHILE lt_rules_to_apply IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_rules_to_apply INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_rule).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE ls_rule-operation.
          WHEN 'ADD'.
            lv_current_value = lv_current_value + ls_rule-operand.
          WHEN 'MULTIPLY'.
            lv_current_value = lv_current_value * ls_rule-operand.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Handle unknown operation or log error
        ENDCASE.
        DELETE TABLE lt_rules_to_apply INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_result = lv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das zeilenweise Lesen einer großen Datei, indem Sie einen String als Datenstrom behandeln und diesen in einer `WHILE`-Schleife verarbeiten, bis das Ende erreicht ist. Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die gelesene Zeile.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit `FIND` und `SUBSTRING` oder `SPLIT` für Zeilenumbrüche (`cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf`). Definieren Sie einen `TYPES` für die Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stream_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_line TYPE string.
    TYPES: ty_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_simulated_stream
      IMPORTING
        iv_stream_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_lines) TYPE ty_lines.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stream_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_simulated_stream.
    DATA: lv_remaining_content TYPE string VALUE iv_stream_content,
          lv_line_feed         TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf,
          lv_found_pos         TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_current_line      TYPE ty_line.

    WHILE lv_remaining_content IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_line_feed IN lv_remaining_content MATCH OFFSET lv_found_pos.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_line = lv_remaining_content(lv_found_pos).
        APPEND lv_current_line TO rt_processed_lines.
        lv_remaining_content = lv_remaining_content+lv_found_pos+STRLEN( lv_line_feed ).
      ELSE.
        " Last line or only one line without a trailing line feed
        lv_current_line = lv_remaining_content.
        APPEND lv_current_line TO rt_processed_lines.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_content.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verfeinern Sie eine Datenmenge aus `sflights` iterativ basierend auf komplexen, dynamisch generierten Kriterien, die in einem benutzerdefinierten Typ definiert sind. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Verfeinerungsschritte durchzuführen.
hint: Definieren Sie `TYPES` für die Kriterien (z.B. `field_name`, `operator`, `value`). Starten Sie mit allen `sflights` Daten und verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Datenmenge mit `FILTER` oder `LOOP AT ... WHERE` zu reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filter_condition,
             field_name TYPE string, " e.g., 'CARRID', 'PRICE'
             operator   TYPE string, " e.g., 'EQ', 'GT', 'LT'
             value      TYPE string, " Value to compare against
           END OF ty_filter_condition.
    TYPES: ty_filter_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filter_condition WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_dynamic_filters
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE ty_sflights_table
        it_conditions      TYPE ty_filter_conditions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_dynamic_filters.
    DATA: lt_current_flights TYPE ty_sflights_table VALUE it_initial_flights,
          lt_conditions_to_apply TYPE ty_filter_conditions.

    lt_conditions_to_apply = it_conditions.

    WHILE lt_conditions_to_apply IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_conditions_to_apply INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_condition).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lt_next_iteration_flights) = VALUE ty_sflights_table( ).
        LOOP AT lt_current_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          DATA(lv_match) = abap_false.
          CASE ls_condition-field_name.
            WHEN 'CARRID'.
              CASE ls_condition-operator.
                WHEN 'EQ'. IF ls_flight-carrid = ls_condition-value. lv_match = abap_true. ENDIF.
                WHEN OTHERS. " Error handling
              ENDCASE.
            WHEN 'PRICE'.
              DATA(lv_price_value) = CONV sflights-price( ls_condition-value ).
              CASE ls_condition-operator.
                WHEN 'GT'. IF ls_flight-price > lv_price_value. lv_match = abap_true. ENDIF.
                WHEN 'LT'. IF ls_flight-price < lv_price_value. lv_match = abap_true. ENDIF.
                WHEN 'EQ'. IF ls_flight-price = lv_price_value. lv_match = abap_true. ENDIF.
                WHEN OTHERS. " Error handling
              ENDCASE.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Error handling for unknown field
          ENDCASE.
          IF lv_match = abap_true.
            APPEND ls_flight TO lt_next_iteration_flights.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        lt_current_flights = lt_next_iteration_flights.
        DELETE TABLE lt_conditions_to_apply INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    rt_filtered_flights = lt_current_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factorial_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factorial_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feldwert filtert. Der Feldname und der Filterwert sollen als Parameter übergeben werden. Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Definition der dynamischen Filterkriterien.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für die Filterkriterien und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in einer `LOOP AT ... WHERE` oder `FILTER` mit dynamischem Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_filter_criteria,
             field_name TYPE string,
             filter_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_filter_criteria.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        is_criteria     TYPE ty_dynamic_filter_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_row>    TYPE any,
                   <lv_field>  TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE it_source_table.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_source>.
    <lt_source> = it_source_table.

    CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE it_source_table.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO rt_filtered_table.

    LOOP AT <lt_source> ASSIGNING <ls_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT is_criteria-field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_row> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <lv_field> = is_criteria-filter_value.
          APPEND <ls_row> TO rt_filtered_table.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen aus einem String iterativ, bis keine Leerzeichen mehr vorhanden sind. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE` und `SHIFT RIGHT DELETING TRAILING SPACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_trimmer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string_iterative
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_trimmer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string_iterative.
    rv_trimmed_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_changed) = abap_true.

    WHILE lv_changed = abap_true.
      lv_changed = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_old_string) = rv_trimmed_string.

      SHIFT rv_trimmed_string LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
      SHIFT rv_trimmed_string RIGHT DELETING TRAILING SPACE.

      IF rv_trimmed_string <> lv_old_string.
        lv_changed = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugdatum (`FLDATE`). Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Gruppierungsstruktur und eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Gruppierung manuell zu verarbeiten, wenn `GROUP BY` nicht direkt anwendbar ist (hier simuliert).
hint: Definieren Sie `TYPES` für die Gruppierungsschlüssel und die aggregierten Daten. Sortieren Sie die Tabelle und verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um über die sortierten Daten zu iterieren und Gruppen zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_key,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_group_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_data,
             key         TYPE ty_flight_group_key,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price  TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_data.
    TYPES: ty_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_manually
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflights_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_manually.
    DATA: lt_sorted_flights TYPE ty_sflights_table,
          ls_current_group  TYPE ty_flight_group_data.

    lt_sorted_flights = it_all_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid fldate.

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_sorted_flights ).
      READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_first_in_group).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_current_group-key-carrid = ls_first_in_group-carrid.
        ls_current_group-key-fldate = ls_first_in_group-fldate.
        ls_current_group-flight_count = 0.
        ls_current_group-total_price = 0.

        DATA(lv_inner_index) = lv_index.
        WHILE lv_inner_index <= lines( lt_sorted_flights ).
          READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights INDEX lv_inner_index INTO DATA(ls_flight_in_group).
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND
             ls_flight_in_group-carrid = ls_current_group-key-carrid AND
             ls_flight_in_group-fldate = ls_current_group-key-fldate.
            ls_current_group-flight_count = ls_current_group-flight_count + 1.
            ls_current_group-total_price = ls_current_group-total_price + ls_flight_in_group-price.
            lv_inner_index = lv_inner_index + 1.
          ELSE.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDWHILE.
        APPEND ls_current_group TO rt_grouped_flights.
        lv_index = lv_inner_index.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine 'Exponential Backoff'-Strategie für Wiederholungsversuche, bei der die Wartezeit zwischen den Versuchen exponentiell ansteigt. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und `WAIT UP TO`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Zähler, um die Anzahl der Versuche zu verfolgen, und berechnen Sie die Wartezeit exponentiell. Verwenden Sie `WAIT UP TO` für die Pause.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exp_backoff_retry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation_with_backoff
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
        iv_initial_delay_ms TYPE i
        iv_success_on_attempt TYPE i " Simulate success on this attempt number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exp_backoff_retry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_backoff.
    DATA: lv_attempt TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_current_delay TYPE i VALUE iv_initial_delay_ms.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_attempt < iv_max_retries.
      lv_attempt = lv_attempt + 1.

      " Simulate operation
      IF lv_attempt = iv_success_on_attempt.
        rv_success = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ELSE.
        " Wait before next retry, if not the last attempt
        IF lv_attempt < iv_max_retries.
          WAIT UP TO ( lv_current_delay / 1000 ) SECONDS.
          lv_current_delay = lv_current_delay * 2. " Exponential increase
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_backoff(

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_backoff_needed.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine 'Exponential Backoff'-Strategie für Wiederholungsversuche, eine gängige Praxis in verteilten Systemen und bei der Interaktion mit externen Diensten. Eine `WHILE`-Schleife steuert die Wiederholungen, und die Wartezeit zwischen den Versuchen wird exponentiell erhöht (`lv_current_delay = lv_current_delay * 2`). `WAIT UP TO ... SECONDS` wird für die Pausen verwendet. Dies ist eine robuste Anwendung von `WHILE` für fehlertolerante Logik.
keywords: WHILE, Exponential Backoff, Retry, Control Flow, WAIT UP TO

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle für einen 'Iterator' und implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle iteriert. Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Definition der Elementstruktur und eine `WHILE`-Schleife in der `GET_NEXT`-Methode des Iterators.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle mit `HAS_NEXT` und `GET_NEXT`. Implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle kapselt. Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Elementstruktur und eine `WHILE`-Schleife in `GET_NEXT` zur Fortschrittsverwaltung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_iterator.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
           key   TYPE string,
           value TYPE string,
         END OF ty_item.
  TYPES: ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS has_next
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_has_next) TYPE abap_bool.

  METHODS get_next
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_next_item) TYPE ty_item
    RAISING
      cx_sy_no_object.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_table_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_iterator.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE zif_iterator=>ty_items.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mt_source_table TYPE zif_iterator=>ty_items.
    DATA: mv_current_index TYPE i VALUE 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_source_table = it_source_table.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_iterator~has_next.
    IF mv_current_index < lines( mt_source_table ).
      rv_has_next = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_has_next = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_iterator~get_next.
    mv_current_index = mv_current_index + 1.
    IF mv_current_index > lines( mt_source_table ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_object.
    ENDIF.
    READ TABLE mt_source_table INDEX mv_current_index INTO rs_next_item.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: ty_item TYPE zif_iterator=>ty_item.
    TYPES: ty_items TYPE zif_iterator=>ty_items.

    METHODS test_iterator_full_cycle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_iterator_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_iterator_beyond_end EXPECTING EXCEPTION cx_sy_no_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_iterator_full_cycle.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE ty_items,
          ls_item TYPE ty_item.

    ls_item-key = 'A'. ls_item-value = 'Value A'. APPEND ls_item TO lt_data.
    ls_item-key = 'B'. ls_item-value = 'Value B'. APPEND ls_item TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_iterator) = NEW zcl_table_iterator( lt_data ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    WHILE lo_iterator->zif_iterator~has_next( ).
      DATA(ls_next) = lo_iterator->zif_iterator~get_next( ).
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      IF lv_count = 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_next-key exp = 'A' ).
      ELSEIF lv_count = 2.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_next-key exp = 'B' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_iterator_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_iterator) = NEW zcl_table_iterator( VALUE ty_items( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_iterator->zif_iterator~has_next( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_iterator_beyond_end.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE ty_items,
          ls_item TYPE ty_item.

    ls_item-key = 'Single'. ls_item-value = 'Item'. APPEND ls_item TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_iterator) = NEW zcl_table_iterator( lt_data ).
    lo_iterator->zif_iterator~get_next( ). " First item
    lo_iterator->zif_iterator~get_next( ). " Beyond end, should raise exception
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung des Iterator-Musters in ABAP. Eine Schnittstelle (`zif_iterator`) definiert die Methoden `has_next` und `get_next`. Eine Klasse (`zcl_table_iterator`) implementiert diese Schnittstelle, um eine interne Tabelle zu durchlaufen. `TYPES` wird in der Schnittstelle verwendet, um die Struktur der zu iterierenden Elemente zu definieren. Die `WHILE`-Schleife im Unit-Test zeigt, wie der Iterator konsumiert wird, indem `has_next` die Schleifenbedingung steuert und `get_next` das nächste Element liefert. Dies fördert die Kapselung und die Trennung von Belangen.
keywords: TYPES, WHILE, Iterator, Object Orientation, Interfaces, Data Structures

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Ziffern in einer positiven Ganzzahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die die Zahl durch 10 teilt, bis sie 0 wird, und zählen Sie dabei die Schritte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_digit_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_digits
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_digit_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_digit_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_digits.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 0.
      rv_digit_count = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_temp_number) = iv_number.
    rv_digit_count = 0.

    WHILE lv_temp_number > 0.
      lv_temp_number = lv_temp_number DIV 10.
      rv_digit_count = rv_digit_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine einfache, aber effektive Anwendung der `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Anzahl der Ziffern in einer positiven Ganzzahl zu zählen. Die Schleife teilt die Zahl wiederholt durch 10, bis sie 0 wird, und inkrementiert dabei einen Zähler. Dies ist eine grundlegende iterative Logik, die in vielen Programmiersprachen verwendet wird. Die Fehlerbehandlung für negative Zahlen ist ebenfalls enthalten.
keywords: WHILE, Conditional Logic, Math, Digit Count, Control Flow

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von drei Zahlen und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf eine ganze Zahl ab. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die Anzahl der Elemente Null ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `DIVIDE` Operator für die Division und eine Konstante für die Anzahl der Elemente. Nutzen Sie `COND` für die Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_num_elements TYPE i VALUE 3.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
        iv_val3 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = iv_val1 + iv_val2 + iv_val3.
    rv_average = COND #( WHEN gc_num_elements > 0 THEN lv_sum DIV gc_num_elements ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_zero_elements FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_positive.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_average_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_calculator->calculate_average( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 20 iv_val3 = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = 20 msg = 'Durchschnitt falsch berechnet' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_zero_elements.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_average_calculator( ).
    " Temporär die Konstante ändern oder einen anderen Testfall erstellen, der dies simuliert
    " Für diesen Testfall nehmen wir an, dass gc_num_elements > 0 ist, da es eine Klassenkonstante ist.
    " Ein realistischerer Test würde eine Methode mit dynamischer Elementanzahl erfordern.
    " Hier wird der Fall gc_num_elements > 0 getestet, da die Konstante 3 ist.
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_calculator->calculate_average( iv_val1 = 0 iv_val2 = 0 iv_val3 = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg exp = 0 msg = 'Durchschnitt bei Nullen falsch berechnet' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `DIVIDE` Operator führt eine Ganzzahldivision durch, was hier für das Abrunden des Durchschnitts passend ist. Die `COND` Expression ist eine moderne Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik kompakt auszudrücken und eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden. `CONSTANTS` wird für die Anzahl der Elemente verwendet.
keywords: DIVIDE, COND, CONSTANTS, Durchschnitt, Ganzzahldivision

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Konstante für eine Fehlermeldung und geben Sie diese aus, wenn eine Division durch Null versucht wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_error_div_by_zero TYPE string VALUE 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt!'.
    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = gc_error_div_by_zero.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den prozentualen Anteil eines Wertes an einem Gesamtbetrag. Das Ergebnis soll als `DECFLOAT34` für hohe Präzision vorliegen. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Gesamtbetrag Null ist, indem Sie 0 zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_percentage_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_hundred_percent TYPE decfloat34 VALUE '100.00'.
    METHODS calculate_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_part_value TYPE decfloat34
        iv_total_value TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_percentage) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_percentage_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_percentage.
    rv_percentage = COND decfloat34(
      WHEN iv_total_value <> 0
      THEN ( iv_part_value / iv_total_value ) * gc_hundred_percent
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass keine Flüge für eine Fluggesellschaft existieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `REDUCE` mit `DIVIDE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung. Eine Konstante für den Initialwert des Durchschnitts kann hilfreich sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_avg.
    TYPES tt_flight_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS gc_initial_avg_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE '0.00'.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_flight_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE tt_flight_avg(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum_price = gc_initial_avg_price
               count = 0
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT
            sum_price = sum_price + member-price
            count = count + 1
          FINALLY
            COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_price / count ELSE gc_initial_avg_price )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_price( ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft ein Durchschnitt berechnet wurde
    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Keine LH Flüge gefunden' act = ls_lh_avg-avg_price ).
    " Da sflight Daten variieren können, ist ein exakter Wert schwer zu testen.
    " Stattdessen prüfen wir, ob die Tabelle nicht leer ist und Werte enthält.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) msg = 'Ergebnistabelle ist leer' ).

    " Um einen spezifischen Wert zu testen, müsste man Testdaten in sflight einfügen oder mocken.
    " Hier ein generischerer Test, der prüft, ob die Logik bei Division durch Null funktioniert.
    DATA(lv_test_sum) = 100.
    DATA(lv_test_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_test_avg) = COND sflight-price( WHEN lv_test_count > 0 THEN lv_test_sum / lv_test_count ELSE zcl_flight_avg_price=>gc_initial_avg_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_test_avg exp = zcl_flight_avg_price=>gc_initial_avg_price msg = 'Division durch Null im REDUCE falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` für Aggregationen. `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, eine Schleife zu durchlaufen und einen einzelnen Wert zu akkumulieren. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb von `FINALLY` stellt sicher, dass eine Division durch Null vermieden wird, falls keine Flüge für eine Fluggesellschaft gefunden werden. Eine Konstante wird für den Initialwert des Durchschnitts verwendet.

CLASS zcl_split_amount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_num_parts TYPE i VALUE 3.

      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_split_amount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_amount_evenly.
    DATA(lv_base_part) = iv_total_amount DIV gc_num_parts.
    DATA(lv_remainder) = iv_total_amount MOD gc_num_parts.

    rt_parts = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO gc_num_parts
                         ( COND #( WHEN i = 1 THEN lv_base_part + lv_remainder ELSE lv_base_part ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_currency_constants PUBLIC.
  CONSTANTS gc_eur TYPE c LENGTH 3 VALUE 'EUR'.
  CONSTANTS gc_usd TYPE c LENGTH 3 VALUE 'USD'.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_currency_constants.
    METHODS convert_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount      TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2
        iv_from_currency TYPE zif_currency_constants=>gc_eur
        iv_to_currency   TYPE zif_currency_constants=>gc_eur
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_amount) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_currency.
    " Vereinfachte Umrechnung für Demo-Zwecke
    " In realen Szenarien würde hier ein Wechselkursdienst verwendet
    IF iv_from_currency = zif_currency_constants=>gc_eur AND iv_to_currency = zif_currency_constants=>gc_usd.
      rv_converted_amount = iv_amount * '1.10'. " Beispielkurs
    ELSE IF iv_from_currency = zif_currency_constants=>gc_usd AND iv_to_currency = zif_currency_constants=>gc_eur.
      rv_converted_amount = iv_amount / '1.10'. " Beispielkurs
    ELSE.
      rv_converted_amount = iv_amount.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Anteil eines Wertes an einem Gesamtbetrag als Bruch (z.B. 1/4). Verwenden Sie `DIVIDE` und geben Sie Zähler und Nenner zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DIVIDE` und `GCD` (Greatest Common Divisor) zur Vereinfachung des Bruchs. Eine Konstante für den Startwert des Zählers/Nenners kann verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fraction_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_initial_numerator TYPE i VALUE 1.
    CONSTANTS gc_initial_denominator TYPE i VALUE 1.
    METHODS get_fraction
      IMPORTING
        iv_part_value TYPE i
        iv_total_value TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_numerator   TYPE i
        ev_denominator TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_gcd
      IMPORTING
        iv_a TYPE i
        iv_b TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_gcd) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fraction_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fraction.
    IF iv_total_value = 0.
      ev_numerator = 0.
      ev_denominator = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_gcd) = get_gcd( iv_a = iv_part_value iv_b = iv_total_value ).

    ev_numerator = iv_part_value DIV lv_gcd.
    ev_denominator = iv_total_value DIV lv_gcd.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_gcd.
    IF iv_b = 0.
      rv_gcd = iv_a.
    ELSE.
      rv_gcd = get_gcd( iv_a = iv_b iv_b = iv_a MOD iv_b ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gleitenden Durchschnitt (Moving Average) einer Liste von Zahlen für ein gegebenes Fenster. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit `DIVIDE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `OFFSET` und `LENGTH` für das Fenster und `REDUCE` für die Summe und Division. Eine Konstante für die Fenstergröße ist hilfreich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_moving_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_window_size TYPE i VALUE 3.
    METHODS calculate_moving_average
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_moving_averages) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_moving_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_moving_average.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_values ).

    IF lv_table_size < gc_window_size.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_moving_averages = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 TO lv_table_size - gc_window_size
                                  ( REDUCE decfloat34(
                                      INIT sum = '0.0'
                                      FOR j = 0 TO gc_window_size - 1
                                      NEXT sum = sum + it_values[ i + j + 1 ]
                                      FINALLY sum / gc_window_size
                                    )
                                  ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHT-Daten. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um über die `SORTED TABLE` zu iterieren und die Zähler zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR flight IN gt_all_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      LET current_count = lines( carrier_group ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( BASE result ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid count = current_count ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_lh_count = ls_count-count.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lh_count > 0 ).

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_aa_count = ls_count-count.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_aa_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten in einer internen Tabelle auf eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und funktionale Weise. Die `GROUP BY` Klausel innerhalb von `REDUCE` ist besonders mächtig, um Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und dann Operationen auf diesen Gruppen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu klassischen `LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP` mit `AT NEW` oder manuellen Hash-Maps.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verwendung von Embedded Managed Language (EML) innerhalb eines RAP-Behavior-Handlers, um Daten in einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `SORTED TABLE` als Datenquelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `MODIFY ENTITIES` Syntax für EML-ähnliche Operationen auf einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_eml_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_eml_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(lt_update_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid price = iv_new_price )
    ).

    " This simulates EML's MODIFY ENTITIES in a simplified way on an internal table.
    " In real EML, it would be: MODIFY ENTITIES OF z_i_my_rap_entity IN LOCAL MODE
    "                                 ENTITY Flight UPDATE FIELDS ( Price ) WITH lt_update_data.
    LOOP AT lt_update_data INTO DATA(ls_update).
      READ TABLE gt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WITH TABLE KEY carrid = ls_update-carrid connid = ls_update-connid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_flight>-price = ls_update-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_updated_flights = gt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_eml_mock( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '123.45'.

    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid.
