EML ermöglicht es, CRUD-Operationen (Create, Read, Update, Delete) auf Entitäten direkt im ABAP-Code auszuführen. Hier wird eine `SORTED TABLE` verwendet, um die Effizienz der Datenaktualisierung zu demonstrieren, indem der direkte Zugriff über den Schlüssel genutzt wird, ähnlich wie EML auf Datenbankebene agiert.
keywords: EML, RAP, SORTED TABLE, Data Manipulation, ABAP 7.55, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der Flugdetails aus einer `SORTED TABLE` von SFLIGHT-Daten enthält, unter Verwendung von String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie Backticks (`) und Platzhalter ({...}) für String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_template_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS format_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } am { is_flight-fldate } mit Flugzeugtyp { is_flight-planetype }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_flight_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_string_template_sflight=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251124' planetype = 'A320'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und sehr lesbare Methode, um Strings in ABAP zu formatieren. Sie ermöglichen das direkte Einbetten von Variablen und Ausdrücken in einen String, was die String-Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE` überflüssig macht und den Code deutlich vereinfacht.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, ABAP 7.40, Readability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue `SORTED TABLE` mit Flugdaten, indem Sie eine Schleife über eine bestehende Tabelle laufen und nur Flüge mit einem bestimmten Flugzeugtyp hinzufügen. Nutzen Sie hierfür die `FOR` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flights_by_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_planetype.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR ls_flight IN gt_all_sflights WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_planetype FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_planetype.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_planetype) = 'A320'.
    DATA(lt_a320_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_planetype( lv_planetype ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_a320_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_a320_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-planetype exp = lv_planetype ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_non_existent_planetype) = 'XYZ'.
    DATA(lt_xyz_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_planetype( lv_non_existent_planetype ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_xyz_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um interne Tabellen auf funktionale Weise zu verarbeiten und neue Tabellen zu konstruieren. In diesem Beispiel wird sie verwendet, um eine `SORTED TABLE` basierend auf einem Filterkriterium zu füllen. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu einer expliziten `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND` Schleife.
keywords: FOR Expression, Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einem Statuscode. Nutzen Sie hierfür die `COND` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` mit verschiedenen `WHEN` Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'A' THEN 'Abgesagt'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'D' THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 'O' THEN 'Pünktlich'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'O' ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'D' ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'A' ) exp = 'Abgesagt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_text( 'X' ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, bedingte Zuweisungen vorzunehmen. Sie ersetzt die traditionellen `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Blöcke für einfache Zuweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich. Sie ist besonders nützlich, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll.
keywords: COND Expression, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.40, Readability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode mit Chained Method Calls verwendet, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` als `RETURNING VALUE` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1 IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_methods.
    METHODS set_value2 IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_methods.
    METHODS get_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chained_calls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_calls.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chained_methods( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Chained Method Calls (Methodenketten) verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem sie es ermöglichen, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem die Methoden, die verkettet werden sollen, eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) als `RETURNING VALUE` zurückgeben.
keywords: Chained Methods, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.40, Readability

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und verwenden Sie dabei die `FOR` Expression mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_full_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_short_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_short_flight_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_short_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_short_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_full_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_short_flight_list.
    rt_short_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_short_sorted(
      FOR ls_flight IN gt_all_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_short_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_short_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_short_flights) = lo_cut->get_short_flight_list( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_short_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_short_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(ls_first_full) = VALUE zcl_for_corresponding=>ty_sflight_full( gt_all_sflights[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(ls_first_short) = VALUE zcl_for_corresponding=>ty_sflight_short( lt_short_flights[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_short-carrid exp = ls_first_full-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_short-connid exp = ls_first_full-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR` Expression und `CORRESPONDING` ist ideal, um Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine andere zu transformieren, insbesondere wenn die Zielstruktur eine Untermenge der Quellstruktur ist oder Felder mit gleichen Namen übernommen werden sollen. `CORRESPONDING` kopiert Felder mit identischen Namen automatisch, was den Code sehr schlank und wartungsfreundlich macht. Hier wird eine `SORTED TABLE` als Quelle und Ziel verwendet, um die Effizienz zu erhalten.
keywords: FOR Expression, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Transformation, SORTED TABLE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Fügen Sie Einträge aus einer Quell-`SORTED TABLE` in eine Ziel-`SORTED TABLE` ein, wobei Duplikate basierend auf dem Schlüssel ignoriert werden sollen. Nutzen Sie hierfür `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE` mit einer `SORTED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_lines_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS merge_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_data_sorted
      CHANGING
        ct_target_table TYPE tt_data_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_lines_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_table INTO TABLE ct_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_tables_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_merge_tables_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_tables_no_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_lines_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_sorted=>tt_data_sorted(
      ( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Value A' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Value B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_sorted=>tt_data_sorted(
      ( key_field = 'C' value_field = 'Value C' )
      ( key_field = 'D' value_field = 'Value D' )
    ).

    lo_cut->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source_table = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_data) WITH KEY key_field = 'C'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value_field exp = 'Value C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_merge_tables_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_lines_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_sorted=>tt_data_sorted(
      ( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Original A' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Original B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_sorted=>tt_data_sorted(
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'New B' )
      ( key_field = 'C' value_field = 'New C' )
    ).

    lo_cut->merge_tables( EXPORTING it_source_table = lt_source CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ). " 'B' is a duplicate, so only 1 'B' and 'C' is added
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_data) WITH KEY key_field = 'B'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value_field exp = 'Original B' ). " Original entry for 'B' is kept
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO ls_data WITH KEY key_field = 'C'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value_field exp = 'New C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE` ist eine effiziente Methode, um alle Einträge einer internen Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen. Bei `SORTED TABLE`s mit `UNIQUE KEY` werden Duplikate automatisch ignoriert, d.h. Einträge aus der Quelltabelle, deren Schlüssel bereits in der Zieltabelle existieren, werden nicht hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine saubere und performante Art, Tabellen zu mergen.
keywords: INSERT LINES OF, Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, Duplicates, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von SFLIGHT-Daten und verwenden Sie dann eine `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung, um Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT gt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_lh_count = ls_count-flight_count.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lh_count > 0 ).

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_aa_count = ls_count-flight_count.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_aa_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt komplexe manuelle Gruppierungslogiken und ist besonders effizient, wenn sie auf `SORTED TABLE`s angewendet wird, da die Sortierung die Gruppierung beschleunigt. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, Grouping, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Mock-Methode in einer Klasse, die die Struktur einer RAP-Action-Implementierung innerhalb eines Behavior-Handlers nachbildet. Die Methode soll eine `SORTED TABLE` als Eingabe für die zu verarbeitenden Entitäten erhalten.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Methode, die eine `SORTED TABLE` von Entitäten als `IMPORTING` Parameter akzeptiert, ähnlich wie `FOR ACTION` Methoden in RAP.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_action_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS process_flight_action
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_key_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_action_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_action.
    " This method simulates a FOR ACTION implementation in a RAP behavior handler.
    " In a real RAP scenario, the signature would be: 
    " METHODS my_action FOR ACTION my_rap_entity~myAction IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION my_rap_entity~myAction.
    " The 'keys' parameter would be a table of entity keys.

    IF it_flight_keys IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT it_flight_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
        " Simulate some action logic, e.g., update a status or trigger an event
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Processing action for flight { ls_key-carrid } { ls_key-connid }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>write( 'No flight keys provided for action.' ).
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_action_with_keys FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_action_no_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_action_with_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_action_mock( ).
    DATA(lt_keys) = VALUE zcl_rap_action_mock=>tt_flight_key_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->process_flight_action( lt_keys ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_action_no_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_action_mock( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_keys) = VALUE zcl_rap_action_mock=>tt_flight_key_sorted( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->process_flight_action( lt_empty_keys ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel bildet die Struktur einer RAP-Action-Implementierung nach, wie sie in einer lokalen Handler-Klasse (die von `cl_abap_behavior_handler` erbt) definiert wird. Aktionen in RAP erhalten typischerweise eine `SORTED TABLE` von Schlüsseln der zu verarbeitenden Entitäten. Die Verwendung einer `SORTED TABLE` für die Eingabeparameter ist hier nicht nur konventionell, sondern auch performant für den Zugriff auf die übergebenen Schlüssel.
keywords: RAP, Action, cl_abap_behavior_handler, Object Orientation, SORTED TABLE, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von SFLIGHT-Daten und verwenden Sie die `LINE_EXISTS` Funktion, um schnell zu prüfen, ob ein bestimmter Flug in der Tabelle vorhanden ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit dem Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von SFLIGHT-Daten und verwenden Sie die `VALUE` Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `FOR` um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE`, `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `MAX` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_group_max_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_max_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_group_max_price_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    rt_max_prices = VALUE tt_carrier_max_price(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN gt_all_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( LET max_flight = REDUCE ty_sflight(
          INIT m = VALUE ty_sflight( price = 0 )
          FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT m = COND ty_sflight( WHEN member-price > m-price THEN member ELSE m )
        ) IN
        carrid = max_flight-carrid,
        max_price = max_flight-price,
        connid = max_flight-connid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_group_max_price_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_max_prices) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_max_prices ).

    " Verify for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    READ TABLE lt_max_prices INTO DATA(ls_lh_max) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_max ).
    " Manually find max price for LH in original data for comparison
    DATA(lv_expected_max_lh) = 0.0.
    LOOP AT zcl_value_group_max_price_sorted=>gt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_orig) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      IF ls_flight_orig-price > lv_expected_max_lh.
        lv_expected_max_lh = ls_flight_orig-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_max-max_price exp = lv_expected_max_lh ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von `VALUE` Expression, `FOR GROUPS OF`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um komplexe Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Es gruppiert Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und findet dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis. Dies ist eine sehr moderne, funktionale und performante Art, Daten zu verarbeiten, die traditionell viele Zeilen Code erfordert hätte.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API (z.B. JSONPlaceholder) durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück. Behandeln Sie dabei grundlegende Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und die Methoden `send` und `receive` des Clients. Überprüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create HTTP client'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to send HTTP request'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to receive HTTP response'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
    lv_reason = lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ).

    IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
      rv_response_text = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler (z.B. HTTP-Statuscode ungleich 200) mit Ausnahmebehandlung und detaillierter Fehlermeldung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_http_dest_state_error` und `client->response->get_status_code()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
        lv_reason = lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          rv_response_text = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason } - Response: { lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Communication Error: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |General Error: { lx_general_error->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken für spezifische Ausnahmen wie `cx_http_dest_state_error` und generische `cx_static_check` ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlererkennung. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Initiierung eines asynchronen HTTP-Requests. (Hinweis: Eine vollständige asynchrone Implementierung erfordert mehr als eine einfache Klasse, daher Fokus auf die Initiierung und das Konzept).
hint: Verwenden Sie `client->send( )` ohne sofortiges `receive( )` und ggf. `CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK` für den Callback.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_async_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS initiate_async_get
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_http_client) TYPE REF TO if_http_client
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

    METHODS process_async_response
      IMPORTING
        io_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_async_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD initiate_async_get.
    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = ro_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create HTTP client for async request'.
    ENDIF.

    ro_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to send async HTTP request'.
    ENDIF.

    " Client is now sending in background. Response needs to be received later.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_async_response.
    DATA: lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    io_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to receive async HTTP response'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = io_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
    lv_reason = io_http_client->response->get_reason( ).

    IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
      rv_response_text = io_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason }|.
    ENDIF.

    io_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_async_flow FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_async_flow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_async_request( ).
    DATA(lo_client) = lo_cut->initiate_async_get( 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_client msg = 'HTTP client should be bound after initiation' ).

    " In a real async scenario, there would be a wait or callback mechanism here.
    " For this unit test, we immediately try to receive, which might fail if the response isn't ready.
    " A robust test would involve a mock or a short delay.
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.

    DATA(lv_response) = lo_cut->process_async_response( lo_client ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_response msg = 'Response should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_response exp = '"id": 1' msg = 'Response should contain expected content' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel führt in das Konzept asynchroner HTTP-Requests ein. Die Methode `initiate_async_get` sendet den Request, ohne sofort auf die Antwort zu warten. Die Antwort wird später mit `process_async_response` empfangen. In einer echten Anwendung würde dies oft mit `CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK` oder einem Event-basierten Mechanismus kombiniert, um die Hauptverarbeitung nicht zu blockieren. Der Unit-Test simuliert diesen Fluss mit einer kurzen Wartezeit.
keywords: HTTP, Asynchronous, Client, Background Processing, Performance

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und parsen Sie die JSON-Antwort direkt in eine ABAP-Struktur oder interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` oder `cl_abap_unit_json=>deserialize` (falls verfügbar) oder `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_todo,
             userid TYPE i,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             completed TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_todo.

    METHODS get_and_parse_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_todo) TYPE ty_todo
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_parse_json.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_string TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_reason      TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create HTTP client'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send( ).
    lo_http_client->receive( ).

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
    lv_reason = lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ).

    IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
      lv_json_string = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
      /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json_string CHANGING data = rs_todo ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |HTTP Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_reason }|.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflights      TYPE tt_sflight,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col           TYPE i VALUE 1.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>create_document( ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHTS Data' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 4 ip_value = 'Currency' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument mit zwei Sheets. Das erste Sheet enthält `SFLIGHTS`-Daten, das zweite Sheet `SCARR`-Daten. Formatieren Sie die Kopfzeilen beider Sheets fett.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_sheet` mehrmals und `cl_xlsx_style` mit `set_font_bold` für die Formatierung der Kopfzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             currcode TYPE scarr-currcode,
             url      TYPE scarr-url,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES: tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multi_sheet_xlsx
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS add_data_to_sheet
      IMPORTING
        io_worksheet TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet
        it_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_header_row TYPE i
        iv_header_col TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet_sflight TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_worksheet_scarr   TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflights          TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_scarr             TYPE tt_scarr.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    SELECT carrid, carrname, currcode, url
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_scarr
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>create_document( ).

    " Sheet 1: SFLIGHTS
    lo_worksheet_sflight = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    add_data_to_sheet( io_worksheet = lo_worksheet_sflight
                       it_data      = lt_sflights
                       iv_header_row = 1
                       iv_header_col = 1 ).

    " Sheet 2: SCARR
    lo_worksheet_scarr = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SCARR' ).
    add_data_to_sheet( io_worksheet = lo_worksheet_scarr
                       it_data      = lt_scarr
                       iv_header_row = 1
                       iv_header_col = 1 ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_data_to_sheet.
    DATA: lo_style TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_style,
          lv_row   TYPE i,
          lv_col   TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_data> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_style = NEW cl_xlsx_style( ).
    lo_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Add header row
    lv_row = iv_header_row.
    lv_col = iv_header_col.
    ASSIGN <fs_data>[ 1 ] TO <fs_line>.
    IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( sy-tabix ) ). " Placeholder for field name
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_style = lo_style ).
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    " A more robust way to get header names would be using RTTS.
    " For simplicity, let's just use generic headers or hardcode for this example.
    lv_col = iv_header_col.
    IF it_data IS OF tt_sflight.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = 'Price' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 4 ip_value = 'Currency' ).
      DO 5 TIMES.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + sy-index - 1 ip_style = lo_style ).
      ENDDO.
    ELSEIF it_data IS OF tt_scarr.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Carrier Name' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = 'Currency Code' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = 'URL' ).
      DO 4 TIMES.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + sy-index - 1 ip_style = lo_style ).
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT <fs_data> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      lv_col = iv_header_col.
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <fs_field> ) ).
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDDO.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die XLSX-Generierung um mehrere Sheets und grundlegende Formatierung. Die Methode `add_sheet` wird für jedes neue Arbeitsblatt aufgerufen. `cl_xlsx_style` wird verwendet, um einen Stil zu definieren (hier: fettgedruckte Schrift), der dann mit `set_cell_style` auf die Kopfzeilen angewendet wird. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols und generischen Tabellen (`STANDARD TABLE`) in der Hilfsmethode `add_data_to_sheet` zeigt eine flexible Art, Daten zu verarbeiten, auch wenn die Header-Erkennung hier vereinfacht ist.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Konzept des Lesens von Daten aus einem vorhandenen XLSX-Dokument (als XSTRING). Extrahieren Sie den Wert einer bestimmten Zelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document=>load_document` und `get_cell_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_cell_from_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_xlsx_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_name   TYPE string
        iv_row          TYPE i
        iv_column       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cell_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS create_dummy_xlsx_xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_cell_from_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet.

    IF iv_xlsx_xstring IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Input XSTRING is empty'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>load_document( iv_xlsx_xstring ).
        lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_name( iv_sheet_name ).
        IF lo_worksheet IS NOT BOUND.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Sheet '{ iv_sheet_name }' not found|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_cell_value = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = iv_row ip_column = iv_column ).

      CATCH cx_xlsx_document_error INTO DATA(lx_xlsx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |XLSX Error: { lx_xlsx_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |General Error: { lx_general_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_xlsx_xstring.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet.

    lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>create_document( ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'TestSheet' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Header1' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Header2' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'ValueA' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'ValueB' ).
    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_cell_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_read_cell_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_cell_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_read_data( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_xlsx) = lo_cut->create_dummy_xlsx_xstring( ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->read_cell_from_xlsx(
      iv_xlsx_xstring = lv_dummy_xlsx
      iv_sheet_name   = 'TestSheet'
      iv_row          = 2
      iv_column       = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'ValueA' msg = 'Expected cell value "ValueA"' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->read_cell_from_xlsx(
      iv_xlsx_xstring = lv_dummy_xlsx
      iv_sheet_name   = 'TestSheet'
      iv_row          = 1
      iv_column       = 2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Header2' msg = 'Expected cell value "Header2"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_cell_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_read_data( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_xlsx) = lo_cut->create_dummy_xlsx_xstring( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_cell_from_xlsx(
          iv_xlsx_xstring = lv_dummy_xlsx
          iv_sheet_name   = 'NonExistentSheet'
          iv_row          = 1
          iv_column       = 1
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for non-existent sheet' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'Sheet ''NonExistentSheet'' not found' msg = 'Expected sheet not found error' ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_cell_from_xlsx(
          iv_xlsx_xstring = lv_dummy_xlsx
          iv_sheet_name   = 'TestSheet'
          iv_row          = 99
          iv_column       = 99
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Reading empty cell should not raise exception' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->read_cell_from_xlsx(
          iv_xlsx_xstring = lv_dummy_xlsx
          iv_sheet_name   = 'TestSheet'
          iv_row          = 99
          iv_column       = 99
        ) exp = '' msg = 'Empty cell should return empty string' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Reading empty cell should not raise an exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Lesen von Daten aus einem XLSX-Dokument. Zuerst wird ein XSTRING, das die Excel-Datei repräsentiert, mit `load_document` geladen. Anschließend kann über `get_sheet_by_name` auf ein spezifisches Arbeitsblatt zugegriffen und mit `get_cell_value` der Inhalt einer Zelle ausgelesen werden. Die Fehlerbehandlung für nicht gefundene Sheets ist ebenfalls enthalten. Eine Hilfsmethode `create_dummy_xlsx_xstring` wird für den Unit-Test bereitgestellt, um eine Testdatei in-memory zu erstellen.
keywords: XLSX, Excel, Read, Parse, cl_xlsx_document, XSTRING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument und passen Sie die Spaltenbreite dynamisch an den Inhalt an (Auto-Fit).
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_column_width_auto` für die gewünschten Spalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_auto_column_width DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_xlsx_with_auto_width
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_auto_column_width IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_with_auto_width.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_data          TYPE tt_data,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col           TYPE i VALUE 1.

    APPEND VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Short Text' field2 = 'A very long text that needs more space' field3 = 'Medium' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Another' field2 = 'Even longer text to test auto-width functionality' field3 = 'Short' ) TO lt_data.

    lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>create_document( ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'AutoWidth Demo' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = 'Field 1' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Field 2' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = 'Field 3' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = ls_data-field1 ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = ls_data-field2 ).

CLASS zcl_xlsx_add_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_xlsx_with_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_add_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_with_table.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflights      TYPE tt_sflight,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_data_start_row TYPE i VALUE 2,
          lv_data_end_row   TYPE i.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>create_document( ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHTS Table' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 4 ip_value = 'Currency' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col     ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col + 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_data_end_row = lv_row - 1.

    " Add Excel table to the range A1:E<lv_data_end_row>
    lo_worksheet->add_table(
      ip_name        = 'SFLIGHTS_Table'
      ip_start_row   = 1
      ip_start_column = 1
      ip_end_row     = lv_data_end_row
      ip_end_column  = 5
      ip_has_header  = abap_true
      ip_show_filters = abap_true
    ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ecl_event_data,
             object_id TYPE string,
             object_type TYPE string,
             x_coord TYPE i,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_ecl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

                           WHEN 'FLIGHT' THEN |Flight { is_event_data-object_id } clicked at ({ is_event_data-x_coord },{ is_event_data-y_coord })|
                           WHEN 'AIRPORT' THEN |Airport { is_event_data-object_id } selected.|
                           WHEN 'ROUTE' THEN |Route { is_event_data-object_id } highlighted.|
                           ELSE |Unknown object type { is_event_data-object_type } clicked.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen generischen Datencontainer verwaltet. Eine Methode soll ein Feldsymbol auf den Inhalt des Containers zuweisen, den Wert ändern und anschließend das Feldsymbol unassignieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN me->mv_data TO <fs_data>` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_generic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE any.
    METHODS set_data_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_value TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_data TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_generic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE DATA mv_data LIKE iv_initial_value.
    ASSIGN mv_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_data>).
    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_data> = iv_initial_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_data_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN mv_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_data> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
      UNASSIGN <fs_data>. " Explicitly unassign
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN mv_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_data = <fs_data>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_data_dynamically FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_type_mismatch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_data_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_generic_data( 'Initial String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data( ) exp = 'Initial String' ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_data_dynamically( 'New String Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data( ) exp = 'New String Value' ).

    DATA(lo_cut_int) = NEW zcl_unassign_generic_data( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut_int->get_data( ) exp = '100' ).
    lv_success = lo_cut_int->set_data_dynamically( 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut_int->get_data( ) exp = '250' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_type_mismatch.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_generic_data( 'String' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_data_dynamically( 123 ). " Attempt to assign integer to string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_data( ) exp = 'String' ). " Value should remain unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` in einem Szenario mit generischen Datenreferenzen und Feldsymbolen. Die Klasse kann Daten beliebigen Typs speichern und dynamisch ändern. `UNASSIGN` stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach der Operation nicht mehr auf den internen Datenbereich zeigt, was bei komplexen dynamischen Szenarien wichtig sein kann. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ebenfalls modern.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf dynamischen Kriterien auswählt. Die ausgewählten Daten sollen dann für die Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_ECL_2DVIEWER` bereitgestellt werden. Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration.

CLASS zcl_ecl_dyn_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ecl_flight_display,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_ecl_flight_display.
    TYPES tt_ecl_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ecl_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_viewer
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_ecl_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_dyn_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_viewer.
    DATA lt_where_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'| TO lt_where_conditions.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'| TO lt_where_conditions.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = CONDENSE( REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR w IN lt_where_conditions NEXT s = s && ` AND ` && w ) ).
    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = |WHERE { lv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamic SELECT statement
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      #({ lv_where_clause }). " Dynamic WHERE clause (ABAP 7.50+)
    " For ABAP 7.40, dynamic WHERE would be:
    " WHERE (lv_where_clause)

    " Transform data for viewer (simplified)
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflights_raw
                          ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid
                            connid = ls_raw-connid
                            fldate = ls_raw-fldate
                            price = ls_raw-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle (Typ `ANY TABLE`) als Parameter akzeptiert. Die Methode soll dynamisch auf eine Spalte zugreifen, deren Werte in einer neuen Tabelle sammeln und das Feldsymbol nach jeder Zeilenverarbeitung unassignieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>` innerhalb einer `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS_LINE>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_dyn_table_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_column_values
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table    TYPE any table
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dyn_table_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_any_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND <fs_component> TO rt_values.
        UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Unassign component field symbol after use
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>. " Unassign line field symbol after loop
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von beliebigen Strukturen (`ANY TABLE`) nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert. Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit einem Feldsymbol und `UNASSIGN` danach.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT it_table BY (<fs_field>)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_dyn_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table  TYPE any table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dyn_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN <fs_table>[ 1 ]-*(iv_field_name) TO <fs_field>. " Assign field symbol to the component of the first row
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        SORT <fs_table> BY (<fs_field>).
        UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Unassign field symbol for the component
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_table>. " Unassign field symbol for the table
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Klasse, die die Interaktion mit einem `CL_GUI_ECL_2DVIEWER` kapselt. Eine Methode soll eine Liste von Objekten filtern, die im Viewer angezeigt werden sollen, basierend auf komplexen Kriterien. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die effiziente Datenreduktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Selektion der anzuzeigenden Objekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ecl_object,
             id    TYPE string,
             type  TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
             x     TYPE i,
             y     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_ecl_object.
    TYPES tt_ecl_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ecl_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_display_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_all_objects TYPE tt_ecl_objects
        iv_filter_type TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_filter_status TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_objects) TYPE tt_ecl_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_display_objects.
    rt_filtered_objects = FILTER #( it_all_objects USING KEY primary_key WHERE
                                    ( iv_filter_type IS INITIAL OR type = iv_filter_type ) AND
                                    ( iv_filter_status IS INITIAL OR status = iv_filter_status ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein Feldsymbol zugewiesen ist, und es bei Bedarf unassigniert. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einem Feldsymbol, das auf eine lokale Variable zeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IS ASSIGNED` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_was_assigned) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_any>.

    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_was_assigned = abap_true.
      UNASSIGN <fs_any>. " Explicitly unassign
    ELSE.
      rv_was_assigned = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lv_value TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.

    GET REFERENCE OF lv_value INTO lr_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_check( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_and_unassign( lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result ).

  METHOD test_not_assigned.

    " lr_data is not pointing to any data

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle (`ANY TABLE`) als Parameter akzeptiert und dynamisch eine neue Tabelle mit den Werten einer bestimmten Spalte erstellt. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit einem Feldsymbol und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN it_any_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_for_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_column_values_for
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table    TYPE any table
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_for_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values_for.
    rt_values = VALUE #( FOR <fs_line> IN it_any_table
                           LET lv_value = '' IN
                           ( COND #( WHEN sy-tabix = 1 AND iv_column_name IS NOT INITIAL
                                     THEN ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_component>).
                                          IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED THEN <fs_component> ELSE '' ENDIF.
                                     ELSE ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_component>).
                                          IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED THEN <fs_component> ELSE '' ENDIF. ) ) ).
    " Note: UNASSIGN is implicitly handled for local field symbols in FOR expressions.
    " Explicit UNASSIGN for <fs_component> is not directly possible within the functional FOR expression.
    " If a persistent field symbol were used, UNASSIGN would be necessary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von `CL_GUI_ECL_2DVIEWER` Objekten verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine bestimmte Aktion auf alle aktiven Viewer anwendet. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die selektive Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` um nur aktive Viewer zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_collection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_viewer_info,
             id     TYPE string,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
             " Simulate a viewer instance
             viewer_instance TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer,
           END OF ty_viewer_info.
    TYPES tt_viewer_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_viewer_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_initial_viewers TYPE tt_viewer_info.
    METHODS apply_action_to_active_viewers
      IMPORTING
        iv_action TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_viewers) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_viewers TYPE tt_viewer_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_collection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_viewers = it_initial_viewers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD apply_action_to_active_viewers.
    rt_processed_viewers = VALUE #( FOR ls_viewer IN mt_viewers
                                    WHERE ( is_active = abap_true )
                                    ( COND #( WHEN ls_viewer-viewer_instance IS BOUND
                                              THEN |Action '{ iv_action }' applied to viewer { ls_viewer-id }|
                                              ELSE |Action '{ iv_action }' simulated for viewer { ls_viewer-id } (instance not bound)| ) ) ).
    " In a real scenario, you would call a method on ls_viewer-viewer_instance here.
    " E.g., ls_viewer-viewer_instance->do_something( iv_action ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_array_of_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_array_of_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flights.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    lo_parser->parse( iv_json_string = iv_json_string ).

    " Assuming get_array_size and get_value_as_string with indexed path access
    DATA(lv_array_size) = lo_parser->get_array_size( '/flights' ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 UNTIL i >= lv_array_size
                          LET lv_path_prefix = `/flights[` && i && `]` IN
                          ( carrid   = lo_parser->get_value_as_string( lv_path_prefix && '/carrid' )
                            connid   = lo_parser->get_value_as_string( lv_path_prefix && '/connid' )
                            cityfrom = lo_parser->get_value_as_string( lv_path_prefix && '/cityfrom' )
                            cityto   = lo_parser->get_value_as_string( lv_path_prefix && '/cityto' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, bis die kumulierte Sitzplatzkapazität einen Wert von 1000 überschreitet. Sammeln Sie die Flugnummern der berücksichtigten Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine WHILE-Schleife und inline-Deklarationen. Beachten Sie, dass SFLIGHTS eine Standardtabelle ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_capacity TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flights.
    DATA: lv_current_capacity TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      WHILE lv_current_capacity <= iv_max_capacity.
        lv_current_capacity = lv_current_capacity + ls_sflight-seatsocc.
        APPEND ls_sflight-fldate TO rt_flight_numbers.
        EXIT.
      ENDWHILE.
      IF lv_current_capacity > iv_max_capacity.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_aggregate_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_flights( iv_max_capacity = 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Should be initial if no flights meet criteria or logic needs adjustment

    " To make this test more robust, we need to ensure SFLIGHTS has data.
    " For a real scenario, you'd mock SFLIGHTS or ensure test data exists.
    " Let's assume SFLIGHTS has data and test for a non-empty result.
    DATA(lt_result_large) = lo_cut->aggregate_flights( iv_max_capacity = 10000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result_large ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result_large ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen String, bis eine nicht-numerische Zeichenfolge oder das Ende des Strings erreicht ist. Verwenden Sie eine WHILE-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Offsets und die `COND` oder `SWITCH` Anweisung zur Prüfung des Zeichens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_num_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_numbers) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_num_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_char   TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    WHILE lv_offset < strlen( iv_input ).
      lv_char = iv_input+lv_offset(1).
      IF lv_char CA '0123456789'.
        rv_numbers = rv_numbers && lv_char.
        lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_string_num_extractor( ).
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( '123abc456' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = '123' msg = 'Sollte nur führende Zahlen extrahieren' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( 'Hello123World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '' msg = 'Sollte leeren String zurückgeben, wenn keine führenden Zahlen' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( '789' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = '789' msg = 'Sollte alle Zahlen extrahieren' ).

    DATA(lv_result4) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result4 exp = '' msg = 'Sollte leeren String für leeren Input zurückgeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine WHILE-Schleife, um Zeichen eines Strings sequenziell zu verarbeiten. Die `strlen()`-Funktion und String-Offsets sind effizient für die Zeichenmanipulation. Die String-Verkettung mit `&&` ist die moderne Syntax.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) haben und deren Sitzplatzbelegung (SEATSOCC) über einem Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie die funktionale FILTER-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer passenden WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc > iv_min_seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seatsocc = 100 ).

    " Assuming some LH flights with > 100 seatsocc exist in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Test with a non-existent carrier
    DATA(lt_result_empty) = lo_filter->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_seatsocc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result_empty ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result_high_threshold ).
