Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen Cursor, um Datensätze aus `SFLIGHTS` zu lesen und diese dann zu löschen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Cursor nach dem Lesen geschlossen wird und die Löschoperationen in einer Transaktion durchgeführt werden.
hint: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, fetchen Sie die relevanten Daten, führen Sie `DELETE` durch und schließen Sie den Cursor. Verwenden Sie `COMMIT WORK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_before_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA: lt_keys_to_delete TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    " 1. Cursor öffnen, um die zu löschenden Schlüssel zu identifizieren
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        WHERE fldate < @iv_before_date.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_key TO lt_keys_to_delete.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    " 2. Löschen der Datensätze basierend auf den gesammelten Schlüsseln
    LOOP AT lt_keys_to_delete INTO DATA(ls_key).
      DELETE FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @ls_key-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_key-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_key-fldate.
      ADD sy-dbcnt TO rv_deleted_count.
    ENDLOOP.

    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_old_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_old_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_delete( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_initial_count) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_count_after_delete) TYPE i.

    " Testdaten vorbereiten: Sicherstellen, dass alte Flüge vorhanden sind
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20200101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20200102' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_initial_count.

    lv_deleted_count = lo_cut->delete_old_flights( '20210101' ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_count_after_delete.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted_count exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge gelöscht worden sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_after_delete exp = lv_initial_count - 2 msg = 'Anzahl der Flüge nach dem Löschen ist falsch.' ).

    " Aufräumen: Gelöschte Flüge wiederherstellen, falls nötig für andere Tests
    ROLLBACK WORK. " Oder explizit wieder einfügen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung eines Cursors, um Datensätze für eine `DELETE`-Operation zu identifizieren. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Löschkriterien komplex sind oder wenn eine große Anzahl von Datensätzen gelöscht werden muss, die nicht direkt über eine einfache `WHERE`-Klausel im `DELETE`-Statement identifiziert werden können. `CLOSE CURSOR` ist nach dem Fetchen der Schlüssel obligatorisch. `COMMIT WORK` stellt die Transaktionssicherheit sicher. Hostvariablen (`@iv_before_date`, `@ls_key-carrid`) sind moderne ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, DELETE, Database Access, Transaction, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie man programmatisch Attribute eines Code Inspector Checks ausliest, z.B. die Parameter eines bestimmten Checks in einer Variante. Verwenden Sie hierfür die Klasse `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES` und einen bekannten Check wie 'CHECK_ABAP_SYNTAX'.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attributes_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ci_attribute,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_ci_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_ci_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ci_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_check_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_variant_name TYPE sci_chkv
        iv_check_name   TYPE sci_check
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_ci_attributes
      RAISING
        cx_sci_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attributes_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_check_attributes.

    lo_ci_query->set_check_variant( iv_variant_name ).
    lo_ci_query->set_check_name( iv_check_name ).

    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_attr>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_ci_attribute(
        name = <fs_attr>-attribute_name
        value = <fs_attr>-attribute_value
      ) TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_update IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator, um z.B. die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Basierend auf diesem Ergebnis, aktualisieren Sie einen Status in `SFLIGHTS` für Fluggesellschaften, die einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und eine `LOOP AT` mit `UPDATE` für die bedingte Aktualisierung.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_seats,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats_occ TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_carr_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carr_seats TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carr_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS update_status_by_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE s_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_by_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = REDUCE tt_carr_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carr_seats( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_index = result[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-total_seats_occ IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carr_seats(
        FOR ls_agg IN result
        ( ls_agg )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          total_seats_occ = lv_index + ls_flight-seatsocc )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrids_to_update) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY(
      FOR ls_agg IN lt_aggregated_seats
      WHERE ( total_seats_occ > iv_threshold )
      ( ls_agg-carrid )
    ).

    IF lt_carrids_to_update IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflights SET planetype = 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrids_to_update.
      rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`-Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien mit dem `FILTER` Operator und aktualisieren Sie dann die entsprechenden Einträge in der Datenbank.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats_occ TYPE s_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_flights_to_update) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc < iv_min_seats_occ
    ).

    " Modify the filtered data in memory before updating the database
    LOOP AT lt_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-planetype = 'SMALL_PLANE'. " Example: Change planetype
    ENDLOOP.

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update
      CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Flugdatensatz aus `SFLIGHTS`. Aktualisieren Sie ein Feld dieses Datensatzes basierend auf einer Bedingung, indem Sie den `COND` Operator verwenden, um den neuen Wert zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_new_value) = COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` zur bedingten Wertzuweisung.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_conditionally.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight-seatsocc = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc < 50 THEN ls_flight-seatsocc + 10
                                   WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc >= 50 AND ls_flight-seatsocc < 100 THEN ls_flight-seatsocc + 5
                                   ELSE ls_flight-seatsocc ).

      UPDATE sflights FROM @ls_flight.
      rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_nested_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             details TYPE BEGIN OF ty_details,
                        planetype TYPE s_planety,
                        seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
                      END OF ty_details,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_with_nested_table
      IMPORTING
        it_update_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_nested_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_with_nested_table.
    " Note: Direct update from nested structure is not supported by Open SQL
    " The internal table must match the flat structure of the database table.
    " This example demonstrates how to flatten a nested structure for update.

    DATA(lt_flat_update) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_nested IN it_update_data
      ( carrid = ls_nested-carrid,
        connid = ls_nested-connid,
        fldate = ls_nested-fldate,
        planetype = ls_nested-details-planetype,
        seatsocc = ls_nested-details-seatsocc )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flat_update
      CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @lt_flat_update.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      INSERT sflights FROM ls_flight_orig.

    DATA(lt_nested_data) = VALUE zcl_sflights_nested_update=>tt_flight_data(

        details = VALUE #( planetype = 'B787' seatsocc = 280 ) )

CLASS zcl_sflights_case_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflights_case_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_with_case_expression.
    UPDATE sflights SET
      planetype = CASE WHEN seatsocc < 100 THEN 'SMALL_JET'
                       WHEN seatsocc >= 100 AND seatsocc < 200 THEN 'MID_JET'
                       ELSE 'LARGE_JET' END,
      seatsocc = CASE WHEN seatsocc < 50 THEN seatsocc + 20
                      ELSE seatsocc END
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_join_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflights_join_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_from_join.
    " This example assumes a hypothetical ZFLIGHT_CONFIG table exists
    " with fields like CARRID, CONNID, NEW_PLANETYPE, NEW_SEATSOCC
    " For demonstration, we'll simulate this with a direct value.

    " In a real scenario, ZFLIGHT_CONFIG would be a custom table.
    " For this example, we'll update all flights of a carrier to a fixed value
    " as a direct JOIN update is not supported in ABAP Open SQL for UPDATE statements.
    " The closest modern approach is to SELECT with JOIN into an internal table,
    " modify the internal table, and then UPDATE FROM TABLE.

    DATA: lt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~planetype, s~seatsocc
      FROM sflights AS s
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.

    LOOP AT lt_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      " Simulate join logic: e.g., get new values from a config table
      " For this example, we'll just set a new planetype and seatsocc
      <fs_flight>-planetype = 'UPDATED_VIA_JOIN_LOGIC'.
      <fs_flight>-seatsocc = <fs_flight>-seatsocc + 5.
    ENDLOOP.

    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update
      CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Direkte `UPDATE ... JOIN` Syntax ist in ABAP Open SQL nicht verfügbar. Der moderne Ansatz besteht darin, die benötigten Daten (einschließlich der aus dem Join resultierenden Werte) zuerst mit einer `SELECT ... JOIN` Anweisung in eine interne Tabelle zu laden. Diese interne Tabelle wird dann im Anwendungsserver modifiziert und anschließend mit `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @(internal_table)` in die Datenbank zurückgeschrieben. Dies ist eine gängige und performante Methode, um komplexe Aktualisierungen zu realisieren.
keywords: UPDATE, SFLIGHTS, Open SQL, JOIN, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für eine vorgegebene Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS aus.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers   TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_capacity_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_capacity_data.
    TYPES: tt_capacity_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_capacity_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_carriers   TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_capacity) TYPE tt_capacity_data.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.

    SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_capacity
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_capacity.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Anzahl von Einträgen (z.B. 3) aus einer gegebenen internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren, und FOR-Ausdrücke, um die Elemente zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_elements
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_string_table
        iv_count        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_elements) TYPE ty_string_table
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_elements.
    IF it_source_table IS INITIAL OR iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_source_table ).
    IF iv_count > lv_table_size.
      iv_count = lv_table_size. " Don't try to get more elements than available
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).

    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = NEW HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      " Ensure unique indices
      WHILE lt_selected_indices IS NOT INITIAL AND line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_random_idx ] ).
        lv_random_idx = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_random_idx INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
    ENDDO.

    " Extract elements using the selected unique indices
    rt_random_elements = VALUE #( FOR idx IN lt_selected_indices ( it_source_table[ idx ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für eine zufällig ausgewählte Teilmenge von 2 Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie zuerst alle verfügbaren Fluggesellschaften, wählen Sie dann zufällig 2 davon aus und verwenden Sie diese für FOR ALL ENTRIES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_fae_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_random_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_carriers TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_fae_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_random_carriers.
    DATA: lt_all_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_carriers.

    IF lt_all_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_all_carriers ).
    IF iv_num_carriers > lv_table_size.
      iv_num_carriers = lv_table_size.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = NEW HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lt_random_carriers) = NEW STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO iv_num_carriers TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      WHILE lt_selected_indices IS NOT INITIAL AND line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_random_idx ] ).
        lv_random_idx = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_random_idx INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
      APPEND lt_all_carriers[ lv_random_idx ] TO lt_random_carriers.
    ENDDO.

    IF lt_random_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_random_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @lt_random_carriers-table_line
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge aus, die eine Verbindung in einer bestimmten Stadt haben, und demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von FOR ALL ENTRIES im Vergleich zu einer Subquery (obwohl FAE hier nicht direkt eine Subquery ersetzt, zeigt es eine ähnliche Filterlogik).
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES, um Flüge zu finden, deren Zielort in einer Liste von Abflugorten anderer Flüge enthalten ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_subquery_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connecting_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_subquery_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connecting_flights.
    DATA: lt_departure_cities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-cityfrom WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Get all departure cities for the given city
    SELECT DISTINCT cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityto = @iv_city
      INTO TABLE @lt_departure_cities.

    IF lt_departure_cities IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Now find flights that depart from these cities
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_departure_cities
      WHERE cityfrom = @lt_departure_cities-table_line
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige alphanumerische Zeichenkette (UUID) von einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_UUID, um eine UUID zu generieren, und passen Sie diese bei Bedarf an die gewünschte Länge an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_uuid_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_uuid_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_uuid_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_uuid_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_uuid_string.
    DATA(lo_uuid) = cl_abap_uuid_manager=>get_uuid_x16( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_raw) = lo_uuid->if_uuid_x16~get_uuid_x16( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid_char) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_x2x_writer( )->convert( lv_uuid_raw ).

    " Remove hyphens and ensure desired length
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN lv_uuid_char WITH ''.
    IF iv_length > 0.
      rv_uuid_string = substring( val = lv_uuid_char off = 0 len = iv_length ).
    ELSE.
      rv_uuid_string = lv_uuid_char.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften und mit einer Mindestkapazität aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS aus.

CLASS zcl_fae_multi_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_fae_multi_cond IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Elemente einer internen Tabelle zufällig (Shuffle).
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Positionen für den Austausch von Elementen zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE ty_string_table
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    IF ct_table IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( ct_table ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).

    DO lv_table_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_idx) = sy-index.
      DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Swap elements
      DATA(lv_temp) = ct_table[ lv_current_idx ].
      ct_table[ lv_current_idx ] = ct_table[ lv_random_idx ].
      ct_table[ lv_random_idx ] = lv_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_single_element_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_string_table(
      ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ( 'F' ) ( 'G' ) ( 'H' ) ( 'I' ) ( 'J' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lt_original.

    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_shuffled ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled )
      exp = lines( lt_original )
      msg = 'Die Anzahl der Elemente sollte nach dem Mischen gleich bleiben.'
    ).
    " Check if all original elements are still present (just in different order)
    LOOP AT lt_original INTO DATA(ls_orig_element).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( line_exists( lt_shuffled[ table_line = ls_orig_element ] ) )
        msg = 'Alle ursprünglichen Elemente sollten nach dem Mischen noch vorhanden sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Assert that it's highly probable the order has changed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lt_original <> lt_shuffled )
      msg = 'Die Tabelle sollte nach dem Mischen eine andere Reihenfolge haben (statistisch wahrscheinlich).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_copy) = lt_empty.

    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_empty_copy ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_empty_copy
      msg = 'Eine leere Tabelle sollte nach dem Mischen leer bleiben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_single_element_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_single) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_string_table( ( 'Single' ) ).
    DATA(lt_single_copy) = lt_single.

    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_single_copy ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_single_copy
      exp = lt_single
      msg = 'Eine Tabelle mit einem Element sollte unverändert bleiben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das zufällige Mischen (Shuffling) einer internen Tabelle ist eine häufige Anforderung. Dieses Beispiel implementiert den Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus unter Verwendung von CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT für die Zufallszahlengenerierung. Die direkte Manipulation der Tabellenelemente mit Indizes und die Verwendung von CHANGING-Parametern sind hier effizient. Die moderne Syntax für Inline-Deklarationen wird ebenfalls verwendet.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Shuffle, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Algorithm

Instructions: Wählen Sie die neuesten Flüge für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus, wobei Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES und eine Subquery für die Datumsfilterung kombinieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES für die Fluggesellschaften und eine Subquery (oder eine weitere FAE-Stufe) für das maximale Datum pro Fluggesellschaft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_latest_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers   TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_latest_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flights_by_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lt_max_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_carrid_max_date TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-fldate WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    " Get the maximum flight date for each carrier
    SELECT carrid, MAX( fldate ) AS max_fldate
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_max_dates_per_carrier).

    IF lt_max_dates_per_carrier IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Now select flights matching these max dates for each carrier
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_max_dates_per_carrier
      WHERE carrid = @lt_max_dates_per_carrier-carrid
        AND fldate = @lt_max_dates_per_carrier-max_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_latest_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_latest_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_latest_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_latest_flights=>tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_latest_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    DATA(lt_checked_carriers) = NEW HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' )
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte AA oder LH sein.'
      ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_checked_carriers[ table_line = ls_flight-carrid ] ).
        " For each carrier, verify that the date is indeed the maximum
        SELECT MAX( fldate ) AS max_fldate
          FROM sflight
          WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid
          INTO @DATA(lv_max_fldate).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-fldate
          exp = lv_max_fldate
          msg = 'Flugdatum sollte das maximale Datum für die Fluggesellschaft sein.'
        ).
        INSERT ls_flight-carrid INTO TABLE lt_checked_carriers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_latest_flights( ).

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine mehrstufige Datenbankabfrage, bei der FOR ALL ENTRIES zweimal verwendet wird. Zuerst werden die maximalen Flugdaten pro Fluggesellschaft ermittelt, und dann werden diese Ergebnisse verwendet, um die eigentlichen Flüge zu selektieren. Dies ist eine performante Methode, um 'Top-N-per-Group'-Szenarien in ABAP zu lösen, ohne auf komplexe Datenbankfunktionen oder Cursor zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, SELECT, MAX, GROUP BY, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, Multi-stage Query

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Stichprobe von N Einträgen aus einer internen Tabelle, ohne Duplikate und ohne die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge zu ändern (wenn N < Tabellengröße).
hint: Generieren Sie zufällige Indizes und verwenden Sie eine HASHED TABLE, um Duplikate zu vermeiden, bevor Sie die Elemente extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sample DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sample
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_string_table
        iv_sample_size  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample) TYPE ty_string_table
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sample IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sample.
    IF it_source_table IS INITIAL OR iv_sample_size <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_source_table ).
    IF iv_sample_size > lv_table_size.
      iv_sample_size = lv_table_size.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).

    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = NEW HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_sample_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      WHILE line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_random_idx ] ).
        lv_random_idx = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_random_idx INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
    ENDDO.

    " Extract elements using the selected unique indices
    " Sort indices to maintain original relative order if desired, or just iterate
    DATA(lt_sorted_indices) = VALUE SORTED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                 FOR idx IN lt_selected_indices ( idx ).

    rt_sample = VALUE #( FOR idx IN lt_sorted_indices ( it_source_table[ idx ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_sample FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sample_size_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sample_size_larger_than_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_sample.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_random_sample=>ty_string_table(
      ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ( 'F' ) ( 'G' ) ( 'H' ) ( 'I' ) ( 'J' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_sample_size) = 5.
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_source_table = lt_source iv_sample_size = lv_sample_size ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sample )
      exp = lv_sample_size
      msg = 'Die Stichprobengröße sollte der angeforderten Größe entsprechen.'
    ).
    DATA(lt_unique_elements) = NEW HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_sample INTO DATA(ls_element).
      INSERT ls_element INTO TABLE lt_unique_elements.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( line_exists( lt_source[ table_line = ls_element ] ) )
        msg = 'Stichprobenelement sollte in der Quelltabelle vorhanden sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_elements )
      exp = lv_sample_size
      msg = 'Alle Elemente in der Stichprobe sollten eindeutig sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sample_size_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_random_sample=>ty_string_table( ( 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_source_table = lt_source iv_sample_size = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_sample
      msg = 'Bei Stichprobengröße 0 sollte eine leere Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sample_size_larger_than_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_random_sample=>ty_string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sample_size) = 5.
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_source_table = lt_source iv_sample_size = lv_sample_size ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sample )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Wenn die Stichprobengröße größer als die Tabelle ist, sollten alle Elemente zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine zufällige Stichprobe von Elementen aus einer internen Tabelle gezogen werden kann, wobei die Eindeutigkeit der Elemente gewährleistet ist. Die Kombination aus CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT zur Indexgenerierung, einer HASHED TABLE zur effizienten Verwaltung eindeutiger Indizes und einem FOR-Ausdruck zur Konstruktion der Ergebnistabelle ist ein modernes und robustes Muster. Das Sortieren der Indizes vor dem Extrahieren stellt sicher, dass die relative Reihenfolge der Elemente aus der Originaltabelle beibehalten wird.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Sampling, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Hashed Table, FOR-Expression

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die in einem bestimmten Zeitraum liegen und von einer zufällig ausgewählten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die zufällige Auswahl einer Fluggesellschaft mit FOR ALL ENTRIES und Datumsbedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_fae_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_carrier_flights_in_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_end_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_fae_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_carrier_flights_in_period.
    DATA: lt_all_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_carriers.

    IF lt_all_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_all_carriers ).
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_table_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
    DATA(lv_random_carrier) = lt_all_carriers[ lv_random_idx ].

    DATA(lt_single_carrier) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( lv_random_carrier )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_single_carrier
      WHERE carrid = @lt_single_carrier-table_line
        AND fldate BETWEEN @iv_start_date AND @iv_end_date
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_in_period FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_period FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_in_period FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_in_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_fae_date_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20000101'. " Adjust dates based on SFLIGHTS data
    DATA(lv_end_date) = '20001231'.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_carrier_flights_in_period( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_start_date AND ls_flight-fldate <= lv_end_date )
        msg = 'Flugdatum sollte im angegebenen Zeitraum liegen.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_fae_date_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20000101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date) = '19991231'. " End date before start date
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_random_carrier_flights_in_period( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Bei ungültigem Zeitraum sollten keine Flüge gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_in_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_fae_date_filter( ).

    DATA(lv_end_date) = '99991231'.

      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Bei einem Zeitraum ohne Flüge sollten keine Flüge gefunden werden.'
    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die zufällige Auswahl eines einzelnen Kriteriums (Fluggesellschaft) mit einer FOR ALL ENTRIES-Abfrage und zusätzlichen WHERE-Bedingungen für einen Datumsbereich. Es zeigt, wie dynamische und zufällige Filterkriterien in effiziente Datenbankabfragen integriert werden können. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und Hostvariablen ist hier ebenfalls Standard.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte Sprachdatei, die Schlüssel-Wert-Paare (z.B. 'KEY=Value') enthält, und parsen Sie diese in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'OPEN DATASET' zum Lesen und 'VALUE' in Kombination mit einem 'FOR'-Loop und String-Funktionen für die Tabellenkonstruktion.

CLASS zcl_file_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_language_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_entries) TYPE tt_language_entries
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_language_file.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Could not open file'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_line TO lt_file_content.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

    rt_entries = VALUE #( FOR <line> IN lt_file_content
                          LET lv_key = substring_before( val = <line> sep = '=' )
                              lv_value = substring_after( val = <line> sep = '=' ) IN
                          ( key = lv_key value = lv_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_file_not_found FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_test_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mv_test_file_path = '/tmp/test_lang_file.txt'. " Temporäre Datei für Tests
    DATA(lv_content) = 'HELLO=Hallo' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                       'GOODBYE=Auf Wiedersehen'.
    OPEN DATASET mv_test_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER lv_content TO mv_test_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_success.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_file_parser( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = lo_parser->parse_language_file( mv_test_file_path ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_entries )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 entries' ).

    DATA(ls_entry1) = lt_entries[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry1-key
      exp = 'HELLO'
      msg = 'Expected key HELLO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry1-value
      exp = 'Hallo'
      msg = 'Expected value Hallo' ).

    DATA(ls_entry2) = lt_entries[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry2-key
      exp = 'GOODBYE'
      msg = 'Expected key GOODBYE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry2-value
      exp = 'Auf Wiedersehen'
      msg = 'Expected value Auf Wiedersehen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_file_not_found.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_file_parser( ).
    TRY.
        lo_parser->parse_language_file( '/tmp/non_existent_file.txt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for file not found' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode 'parse_language_file' liest eine Datei zeilenweise und verwendet dann den 'VALUE'-Operator in Kombination mit einem 'FOR'-Loop und den String-Funktionen 'substring_before' und 'substring_after', um die Schlüssel-Wert-Paare zu extrahieren und direkt in eine interne Tabelle zu füllen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Daten zu transformieren. 'cl_cts_language_file_io' würde intern ähnliche Dateizugriffe kapseln.
keywords: FILE_IO, VALUE, FOR, STRING_FUNCTIONS, INTERNAL_TABLES

Instructions: Nehmen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Sprachschlüsseln und -werten und schreiben Sie diese in ein Dateiformat (z.B. 'KEY=Value' pro Zeile).
hint: Nutzen Sie 'REDUCE' und String-Templates, um den Dateinhalt zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_language_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS write_language_file
      IMPORTING
        it_entries   TYPE tt_language_entries
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_language_file.
    DATA(lv_file_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <entry> IN it_entries
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ <entry>-key }={ <entry>-value }|
                            ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <entry>-key }={ <entry>-value }| ) ).

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Could not open file for writing'.
    ENDIF.

    TRANSFER lv_file_content TO iv_file_path.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Could not write to file'.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = lv_read_content
      exp = lv_expected_content
      msg = 'File content mismatch' ).

    DATA: lv_read_content TYPE string.

explanation: Die 'write_language_file'-Methode nutzt den 'REDUCE'-Operator, um die interne Tabelle mit Sprachschlüsseln und -werten effizient in einen einzelnen String umzuwandeln, der das Dateiformat darstellt. String-Templates ('|...|') werden verwendet, um die Zeilen klar und lesbar zu formatieren. Der 'COND'-Operator innerhalb von 'REDUCE' sorgt dafür, dass der Zeilenumbruch ('cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf') nur zwischen den Einträgen hinzugefügt wird. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art der String-Aggregation. 'cl_cts_language_file_io' würde diese Art von formatierten Daten verarbeiten.
keywords: FILE_IO, REDUCE, STRING_TEMPLATES, COND, INTERNAL_TABLES

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Sprachschlüsseln und -werten, um nur Einträge zu erhalten, deren Schlüssel ein bestimmtes Muster enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'FILTER'-Operator in Kombination mit 'CP' (Contains Pattern).
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_language_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_key_pattern
      IMPORTING
        it_all_entries TYPE tt_language_entries
        iv_pattern     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_entries) TYPE tt_language_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_key_pattern.
    rt_filtered_entries = FILTER #( it_all_entries USING KEY primary_key WHERE key CP iv_pattern ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-key
      exp = 'MSG_ERROR'
      msg = 'Expected key MSG_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE tt_language_entries(
      ( key = 'MSG_HELLO' value = 'Hallo' )
      ( key = 'TXT_GOODBYE' value = 'Auf Wiedersehen' ) ).

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_lang_filter( ).

      it_all_entries = lt_entries

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE tt_language_entries( ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_lang_filter( ).

      act = lt_filtered
      msg = 'Expected empty table for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der 'FILTER'-Operator ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um alle Einträge zu finden, deren Schlüssel dem angegebenen Muster ('iv_pattern') entsprechen. Die Verwendung von 'USING KEY primary_key' ist optional, aber gute Praxis, um die Performance zu optimieren, wenn ein Primärschlüssel definiert ist. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und kürzer als ein traditioneller 'LOOP AT ... WHERE'. Daten, die von 'cl_cts_language_file_io' gelesen werden, könnten so effizient verarbeitet werden.
keywords: FILTER, INTERNAL_TABLES, STRING_PROCESSING, DECLARATIVE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Dateipfad dynamisch basierend auf einem Basisverzeichnis, einem Dateinamen und einer optionalen Sprachkennung.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den 'COND'-Operator für bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_path_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_language_file_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_dir   TYPE string
        iv_file_name  TYPE string
        iv_language   TYPE spras OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_path_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_language_file_path.
    rv_full_path = |{ iv_base_dir }/{ iv_file_name }|.
    rv_full_path = COND string(
      WHEN iv_language IS NOT INITIAL
      THEN |{ rv_full_path }.{ iv_language }|
      ELSE rv_full_path ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

String-Templates ermöglichen eine einfache und lesbare Interpolation von Variablen in Strings. Der 'COND'-Operator ersetzt hier eine traditionelle 'IF'-Anweisung und erlaubt es, den Pfad bedingt zu erweitern, falls eine Sprachkennung vorhanden ist. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Dateizugriffsklassen wie 'cl_cts_language_file_io', die dynamische Pfade benötigen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer simulierten Sprachdatei von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse 'cl_abap_codepage' für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_encoding_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_file_encoding
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_file_path TYPE string
        iv_target_file_path TYPE string
        iv_source_codepage  TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_codepage  TYPE abap_codepage
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_encoding_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_file_encoding.
    DATA: lv_source_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_target_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Read source file as binary
    OPEN DATASET iv_source_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open source file'.
    ENDIF.
    READ DATASET iv_source_file_path INTO lv_source_xstring.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_source_file_path.

    " Convert encoding
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter(
          codepage = iv_source_codepage
          endian   = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little ).
        DATA(lv_string_content) = lo_conv_in->convert_from(
          source = lv_source_xstring ).

        DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter(
          codepage = iv_target_codepage
          endian   = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little ).
        lv_target_xstring = lo_conv_out->convert_to(
          source = lv_string_content ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_conv_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Write target file as binary
    OPEN DATASET iv_target_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open target file'.
    ENDIF.
    TRANSFER lv_target_xstring TO iv_target_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_target_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_convert_utf8_to_iso FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_source_file_path TYPE string,
          mv_target_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mv_source_file_path = '/tmp/source_lang_file.txt'.
    mv_target_file_path = '/tmp/target_lang_file.txt'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_source_file_path.
    DELETE DATASET mv_target_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lv_utf8_content) = 'Hallo Welt €' ##ENCODING UTF-8.
    OPEN DATASET mv_source_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    TRANSFER lv_utf8_content TO mv_source_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_source_file_path.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_encoding_converter( ).
    lo_converter->convert_file_encoding(
      iv_source_file_path = mv_source_file_path
      iv_target_file_path = mv_target_file_path
      iv_source_codepage  = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_codepage  = '1100' ). " 1100 = ISO-8859-1

    DATA(lv_read_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    OPEN DATASET mv_target_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    READ DATASET mv_target_file_path INTO lv_read_xstring.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_target_file_path.

    DATA(lo_conv_back) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter(
      codepage = '1100'
      endian   = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little ).
    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_conv_back->convert_from(
      source = lv_read_xstring ).

    " Note: Euro symbol might not convert correctly to ISO-8859-1, so test without it or expect replacement char
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = 'Hallo Welt ?'
      msg = 'Converted content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Konvertierung von Dateiinhalten zwischen verschiedenen Codepages unter Verwendung der Klasse 'cl_abap_codepage'. Die Datei wird binär gelesen und geschrieben, um die Rohdaten zu erhalten. Die Methoden 'create_converter', 'convert_from' und 'convert_to' ermöglichen eine flexible und robuste Handhabung von Zeichenkodierungen. Dies ist entscheidend beim Umgang mit Sprachdateien, die in unterschiedlichen Systemen oder mit verschiedenen Standards erstellt wurden, wie es bei 'cl_cts_language_file_io' der Fall sein könnte.
keywords: ENCODING, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, FILE_IO, XSTRING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Sprachschlüsseln und -werten aus einer Liste von Strings, die jeweils ein Schlüssel-Wert-Paar enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den 'VALUE'-Operator mit einem 'FOR'-Loop und String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_language_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_lang_table_from_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_string_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_entries) TYPE tt_language_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_lang_table_from_strings.
    rt_entries = VALUE #( FOR <line> IN it_string_list
                          LET lv_key = substring_before( val = <line> sep = '=' )
                              lv_value = substring_after( val = <line> sep = '=' ) IN
                          ( key = lv_key value = lv_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_success.
    DATA(lt_string_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string(
      ( 'MSG_WELCOME=Willkommen' )
      ( 'MSG_ERROR=Fehler aufgetreten' ) ).

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = lo_creator->create_lang_table_from_strings( lt_string_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_entries )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_entries[ 1 ]-key
      exp = 'MSG_WELCOME'
      msg = 'Expected key MSG_WELCOME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_entries[ 1 ]-value
      exp = 'Willkommen'
      msg = 'Expected value Willkommen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_empty_list.
    DATA(lt_string_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ).
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = lo_creator->create_lang_table_from_strings( lt_string_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_entries
      msg = 'Expected empty table for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_malformed_entry.
    DATA(lt_string_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string(
      ( 'ONLYKEY' )
      ( 'KEY=VALUE' ) ).

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_table_creator( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für Dateizugriffe, die eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'TRY...CATCH' für Ausnahmen und 'MESSAGE' in Kombination mit 'DATA()' für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_robustly
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_robustly.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string,
          lt_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE e001(sy) WITH iv_file_path INTO DATA(lv_error_msg).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lv_error_msg.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lv_line TO lt_content.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
        rv_content = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR <line> IN lt_content NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <line> }| ) ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Sprachschlüssel-Wert-Paare nach einem Präfix des Schlüssels (z.B. 'MSG_', 'TXT_') in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY' mit einem String-Offset für das Präfix.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_language_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_entry,
             prefix TYPE string,
             entries TYPE tt_language_entries,
           END OF ty_grouped_entry.
    TYPES tt_grouped_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_by_key_prefix
      IMPORTING
        it_all_entries TYPE tt_language_entries
        iv_prefix_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_entries) TYPE tt_grouped_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_key_prefix.
    LOOP AT it_all_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry) GROUP BY ( prefix = ls_entry-key(iv_prefix_length) ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_entry(
        prefix = group_key-prefix
        entries = VALUE tt_language_entries( FOR <member> IN group_key ( <member> ) ) )
        TO rt_grouped_entries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining für eine Sequenz von Operationen auf Dateiinhalten (z.B. Lesen, Transformieren, Schreiben).
hint: Designen Sie Methoden, die die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben ('ME->').
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS read_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_file_processor
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

    METHODS transform_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_char TYPE c
        iv_new_char TYPE c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_file_processor.

    METHODS write_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_file_processor
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

    METHODS get_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialisierung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_file.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string,
          lt_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open file for reading'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_line TO lt_content.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

    mv_content = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR <line> IN lt_content NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <line> }| ) ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_content.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_char IN mv_content WITH iv_new_char.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_file.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open file for writing'.
    ENDIF.
    TRANSFER mv_content TO iv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_content.
    rv_content = mv_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS clean_file_line
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_line) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_file_line.
    rv_cleaned_line = iv_raw_line.
    " Entferne führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen
    rv_cleaned_line = strip( val = rv_cleaned_line corresponding = CONV string( ' ' ) ).
    " Entferne Zeilenumbrüche
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf IN rv_cleaned_line WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>lf IN rv_cleaned_line WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr IN rv_cleaned_line WITH ''.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_merger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_language_entry
          WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS merge_language_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_base_entries TYPE tt_language_entries
        it_new_entries  TYPE tt_language_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_entries) TYPE tt_language_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_merger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_language_entries.
    rt_merged_entries = it_base_entries.

    LOOP AT it_new_entries INTO DATA(ls_new_entry).
      INSERT ls_new_entry INTO TABLE rt_merged_entries ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
      IF sy-subrc = 4. " Duplicate key, update existing entry
        rt_merged_entries[ KEY key COMPONENTS ls_new_entry-key ] = ls_new_entry.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Platzhalter (z.B. '&1', '&2') aus einem Sprachstring und geben Sie diese in einer Liste zurück.

CLASS zcl_placeholder_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_placeholders) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_placeholder_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_placeholders.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '&\d+' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_group( index = 0 ) TO rt_placeholders.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine Datei existiert und ob sie nicht leer ist, bevor Sie sie verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'CHECK DATASET' und 'GET DATASET PROPERTY'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_file_valid_for_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_file_valid_for_processing.
    DATA: lv_file_size TYPE i.

    " Check if file exists
    CHECK DATASET iv_file_path.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get file size to check if it's empty
    GET DATASET PROPERTY iv_file_path SIZE lv_file_size.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_file_size = 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_is_valid = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das Änderungsdatum einer Datei und formatieren Sie es in ein benutzerfreundliches Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'GET DATASET PROPERTY' und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_file_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_file_date.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    GET DATASET PROPERTY iv_file_path DATE lv_date TIME lv_time.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not get file date/time'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_formatted_date = |{ lv_date DATE = USER } { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_formatted_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_file_not_found FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_test_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mv_test_file_path = '/tmp/file_date_test.txt'.
    OPEN DATASET mv_test_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER 'dummy' TO mv_test_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_formatted_date.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_file_date_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_date) = lo_formatter->get_formatted_file_date( mv_test_file_path ).

    " Get current date/time in user format for comparison
    DATA(lv_current_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_current_time) TYPE t.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_timestamp).
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE lv_current_date TIME lv_current_time.

    DATA(lv_expected_format) = |{ lv_current_date DATE = USER } { lv_current_time TIME = USER }|.

    " The exact time might differ by a few seconds, so we check if the date part is correct
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_formatted_date
      exp = |{ lv_current_date DATE = USER }|
      msg = 'Formatted date part should match current date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_not_found.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_file_date_formatter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_formatter->get_formatted_file_date( '/tmp/non_existent_date_file.txt' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for file not found' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
          act = lx_ex->get_text( )
          exp = 'Could not get file date/time'
          msg = 'Expected specific error message' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert, wie das Änderungsdatum und die Uhrzeit einer Datei mit 'GET DATASET PROPERTY' ermittelt und anschließend mit String-Templates in einem benutzerfreundlichen Format ausgegeben werden können. Die 'DATE = USER' und 'TIME = USER'-Optionen in String-Templates passen die Ausgabe automatisch an die Benutzereinstellungen an. Dies ist nützlich für Audit-Trails oder zur Anzeige von Metadaten von Sprachdateien, die von 'cl_cts_language_file_io' verwaltet werden.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Datei zeilenweise und verarbeiten Sie jede Zeile dynamisch basierend auf einem übergebenen Funktionszeiger (Lambda-Ausdruck).
hint: Verwenden Sie einen Funktionszeiger (TYPE REF TO DATA) oder eine lokale Klasse mit einer Schnittstelle für die dynamische Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_file_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_dyn_process.

    METHODS process_file_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        io_processor TYPE REF TO if_abap_dyn_process
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_lines) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_abap_dyn_process.
  METHODS process_line
    IMPORTING
      iv_line TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_processed_line) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_file_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_file_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open file'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND io_processor->process_line( lv_line ) TO rt_processed_lines.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_dyn_process~process_line.
    " Default implementation, can be overridden by local classes/lambda
    rv_processed_line = iv_line.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.

    DATA: mv_test_file_path TYPE string.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mv_test_file_path = '/tmp/dynamic_file_test.txt'.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'Line 1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Line 2'.
    OPEN DATASET mv_test_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER lv_content TO mv_test_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_processing.
    CLASS lcl_upper_case_processor DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES if_abap_dyn_process.
        METHODS if_abap_dyn_process~process_line.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_upper_case_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD if_abap_dyn_process~process_line.
        rv_processed_line = to_upper( iv_line ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_file_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_upper_case_handler) = NEW lcl_upper_case_processor( ).

    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_processor->process_file_dynamically(
      iv_file_path = mv_test_file_path
      io_processor = lo_upper_case_handler ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_processed )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 processed lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_processed[ 1 ]
      exp = 'LINE 1'
      msg = 'First line should be uppercase' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_processed[ 2 ]
      exp = 'LINE 2'
      msg = 'Second line should be uppercase' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert dynamische Programmierung durch die Übergabe eines Objekts, das eine Schnittstelle implementiert, an eine Methode. Die 'process_file_dynamically'-Methode liest eine Datei zeilenweise und ruft für jede Zeile die 'process_line'-Methode des übergebenen Objekts auf. Dies ermöglicht es, die Verarbeitungslogik zur Laufzeit auszutauschen, ohne die Hauptmethode ändern zu müssen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Muster für flexible Dateiverarbeitung, wie sie bei der Anpassung der Sprachdateiverarbeitung durch 'cl_cts_language_file_io' an spezifische Anforderungen nützlich sein könnte.

CLASS zcl_lang_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_language_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_language_entry.
    TYPES tt_language_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_language_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS get_language_value
      IMPORTING
        it_entries TYPE tt_language_entries
        iv_key     TYPE string
        iv_default TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_language_value.
    rv_value = VALUE #( it_entries[ KEY primary_key WHERE key = iv_key ]-value DEFAULT iv_default ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie Platzhalter in einem Sprachstring durch dynamisch bereitgestellte Werte.
hint: Verwenden Sie die String-Funktion 'replace' in einem 'REDUCE'-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_placeholder_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_placeholder_value,
             placeholder TYPE string,
             value       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_placeholder_value.
    TYPES tt_placeholder_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_placeholder_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_template_string TYPE string
        it_replacements    TYPE tt_placeholder_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_placeholder_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_placeholders.
    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = iv_template_string
      FOR <replacement> IN it_replacements
      NEXT s = replace( val = s sub = <replacement>-placeholder with = <replacement>-value occ = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_template) = 'Hello &1, your balance is &2 &3.'.
    DATA(lt_replacements) = VALUE tt_placeholder_values(
