      ( placeholder = '&2' value = '100' )
      ( placeholder = '&3' value = 'EUR' ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_placeholders(
      iv_template_string = lv_template
      it_replacements    = lt_replacements ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hello John, your balance is 100 EUR.'
      msg = 'Placeholders should be replaced correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_no_placeholders.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_placeholder_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_template) = 'No placeholders here.'.
    DATA(lt_replacements) = VALUE tt_placeholder_values(
      ( placeholder = '&1' value = 'Value' ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_placeholders(
      iv_template_string = lv_template
      it_replacements    = lt_replacements ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'No placeholders here.'
      msg = 'String should remain unchanged if no placeholders match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_empty_replacements.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_placeholder_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_template) = 'Hello &1.'.
    DATA(lt_replacements) = VALUE tt_placeholder_values( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_placeholders(
      iv_template_string = lv_template
      it_replacements    = lt_replacements ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hello &1.'
      msg = 'String should remain unchanged if no replacements are provided' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert das Ersetzen von Platzhaltern in einem String durch dynamisch bereitgestellte Werte. Der 'REDUCE'-Operator wird verwendet, um den String iterativ zu verarbeiten, wobei für jeden Platzhalter in der Ersetzungstabelle die String-Funktion 'replace' aufgerufen wird. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, komplexe String-Manipulationen durchzuführen, die oft beim Rendern von Sprachnachrichten oder Texten aus Sprachdateien, die von 'cl_cts_language_file_io' stammen, erforderlich ist.
keywords: STRING_PROCESSING, REPLACE, REDUCE, PLACEHOLDERS, DYNAMIC

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Datei in Chunks (Teilen) ein, um große Dateien effizienter zu verarbeiten und den Speicherverbrauch zu kontrollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'OPEN DATASET ... IN BINARY MODE' und 'READ DATASET ... LENGTH'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chunk_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_chunk_data TYPE xstring.
    TYPES tt_chunks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chunk_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_file_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chunks) TYPE tt_chunks
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chunk_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_chunk TYPE xstring,
          lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open file'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_chunk LENGTH iv_chunk_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_chunk TO rt_chunks.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_in_chunks FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_smaller_chunk_size FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_file_not_found FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_test_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mv_test_file_path = '/tmp/chunk_test_file.bin'.
    DATA(lv_content) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    OPEN DATASET mv_test_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    TRANSFER lv_content TO mv_test_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_test_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_in_chunks.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_chunk_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_chunks) = lo_reader->read_file_in_chunks(
      iv_file_path = mv_test_file_path
      iv_chunk_size = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_chunks )
      exp = 6
      msg = 'Expected 6 chunks' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = xstrlen( lt_chunks[ 1 ] )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'First chunk size incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = xstrlen( lt_chunks[ 6 ] )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Last chunk size incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = xstring_to_string( lt_chunks[ 1 ] )
      exp = 'ABCDE'
      msg = 'First chunk content incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_smaller_chunk_size.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_chunk_file_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_chunks) = lo_reader->read_file_in_chunks(
      iv_file_path = mv_test_file_path
      iv_chunk_size = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_chunks )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Expected 3 chunks' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = xstrlen( lt_chunks[ 1 ] )
      exp = 10
      msg = 'First chunk size incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = xstrlen( lt_chunks[ 3 ] )
      exp = 6
      msg = 'Last chunk size incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_file_not_found.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_chunk_file_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->read_file_in_chunks(
          iv_file_path = '/tmp/non_existent_chunk_file.bin'
          iv_chunk_size = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for file not found' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_ex).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
          act = lx_ex->get_text( )
          exp = 'Could not open file'
          msg = 'Expected specific error message' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  " Helper to convert xstring to string for assertion
  METHOD xstring_to_string FOR TESTING.
    IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter( codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    rv_string = lo_conv->convert_from( iv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert das zeilenweise (oder besser gesagt, blockweise) Lesen großer Dateien in 'Chunks' (Teilen) im Binärmodus. Durch die Angabe einer 'LENGTH' im 'READ DATASET'-Befehl kann die Anwendung den Speicherverbrauch kontrollieren und große Dateien effizienter verarbeiten, ohne den gesamten Inhalt auf einmal in den Speicher laden zu müssen. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für die Dateiverarbeitung, die bei sehr großen Sprachdateien oder anderen Binärdateien, die von 'cl_cts_language_file_io' oder ähnlichen Klassen gehandhabt werden, von Vorteil sein kann.
keywords: FILE_IO, CHUNKS, BINARY_MODE, LARGE_FILES, PERFORMANCE

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle, nachdem diese nach einem bestimmten Feld sortiert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_delete_adj_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_duplicates IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_duplicates.
    rt_result = it_data.
    SORT rt_result BY id.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_result COMPARING id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_itb_delete_adj_dup=>tt_data,
          ls_data  TYPE zcl_itb_delete_adj_dup=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'A'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'B'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'C'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input. " Duplicate ID, different text
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'B'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input. " Exact duplicate
    ls_data-id = 3. ls_data-text = 'D'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 3. ls_data-text = 'E'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input. " Duplicate ID, different text

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_delete_adj_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_duplicates( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). " Expected: 1A, 2B, 3D (or 3E)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine klassische, aber immer noch effiziente Methode, um Duplikate in einer sortierten internen Tabelle zu entfernen. In modernen ABAP-Versionen wird sie oft in Kombination mit dem `SORT`-Statement verwendet, um die Daten vor der Duplikatsentfernung zu ordnen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, Duplicates, SORT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Zeilen der Originaltabelle enthält, außer jenen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen (z.B. ID größer als 2).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_delete_for_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_data IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data iv_threshold TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_for_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_data.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_row IN it_data WHERE ( id <= iv_threshold ) ( ls_row ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_data.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_itb_delete_for_where=>tt_data,
          ls_data  TYPE zcl_itb_delete_for_where=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'A'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'B'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 3. ls_data-text = 'C'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 4. ls_data-text = 'D'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_delete_for_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_data( it_data = lt_input iv_threshold = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und neue Tabellen zu erstellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zum expliziten `LOOP` und `APPEND` oder `DELETE` in älteren ABAP-Versionen.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, VALUE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle, um alle Zeilen zu entfernen, bei denen ein bestimmtes Feld einen bestimmten Wert hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für eine effiziente und lesbare Lösung.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid <> iv_carrid ).

ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist die modernste und deklarativste Methode, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu entfernen, indem eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle erstellt wird. Er ist sehr effizient und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer bestehenden, indem Sie Zeilen entfernen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Tabelle iterativ neu aufzubauen und unerwünschte Zeilen zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_delete_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS remove_by_reduce IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data iv_id_to_remove TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_by_reduce.
    rt_result = REDUCE #( 
      INIT r = rt_result
      FOR ls_row IN it_data
      WHERE ( ls_row-id <> iv_id_to_remove )
      NEXT r = VALUE #( BASE r ( ls_row ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_by_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_by_reduce.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_itb_delete_reduce=>tt_data,
          ls_data  TYPE zcl_itb_delete_reduce=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'A'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'B'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 3. ls_data-text = 'C'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'D'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_delete_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_by_reduce( it_data = lt_input iv_id_to_remove = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, indem man über eine bestehende iteriert und nur die gewünschten Zeilen hinzufügt. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu transformieren und unerwünschte Zeilen zu 'entfernen', ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, VALUE

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle, die zu einem bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode gehören und vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM` mit `WHERE` und Hostvariablen (`@`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_delete_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_delete_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate < @iv_fldate.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_old_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_old_flights.
    " This test requires actual database interaction and setup/teardown.
    " For demonstration, we simulate the effect or assume a clean state.
    " In a real scenario, use test doubles or a dedicated integration test framework.

    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. " Use a dummy carrier ID for testing
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Insert some test data first
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab( 
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '001' fldate = '20200101' price = 100 ) 
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '002' fldate = '20200102' price = 200 ) 
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '003' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 ) 
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2 ). " Expect 2 rows deleted

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit dem `@`-Zeichen in Open SQL-Anweisungen ist ein Merkmal von modernem ABAP (ab 7.40). Es verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit, da es die Unterscheidung zwischen ABAP-Variablen und Datenbankfeldern klarer macht und SQL-Injections vorbeugt. `sy-dbcnt` liefert die Anzahl der betroffenen Zeilen.
keywords: DELETE, Database Operations, Open SQL, Host Variables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen sprachspezifischen Text für eine gegebene Text-ID und Sprache ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>get_text_for_language`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_get_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_localized_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text_id TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_get_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_localized_text.
    " In a real scenario, iv_text_id would map to a text in a text repository (e.g., message class, custom table).
    " For this example, we simulate a simple mapping.
    CASE iv_text_id.
      WHEN 'HELLO'.
        CASE iv_language.
          WHEN 'D'. rv_text = 'Hallo'.
          WHEN 'E'. rv_text = 'Hello'.
          WHEN OTHERS. rv_text = 'Hello (default)'.
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN 'GOODBYE'.
        CASE iv_language.
          WHEN 'D'. rv_text = 'Auf Wiedersehen'.
          WHEN 'E'. rv_text = 'Goodbye'.
          WHEN OTHERS. rv_text = 'Goodbye (default)'.
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_text = |Text ID '{ iv_text_id }' not found|.
    ENDCASE.

    " cl_i18n_utils is typically used for more complex I18N scenarios like locale handling,
    " but for text retrieval, it often wraps standard text elements or custom tables.
    " This example focuses on the concept of language-specific text retrieval.
    " If a direct utility for text ID lookup existed, it would be used here.
    " For simplicity, we use a direct mapping.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_localized_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_localized_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_get_text( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_localized_text( iv_text_id = 'HELLO' iv_language = 'D' ) exp = 'Hallo' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_localized_text( iv_text_id = 'HELLO' iv_language = 'E' ) exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_localized_text( iv_text_id = 'GOODBYE' iv_language = 'D' ) exp = 'Auf Wiedersehen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_localized_text( iv_text_id = 'UNKNOWN' iv_language = 'E' ) exp = 'Text ID 'UNKNOWN' not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Internationalisierung (I18N) ist entscheidend für globale Anwendungen. Obwohl `cl_i18n_utils` selbst keine direkte Methode `get_text_for_language` bietet, ist das Konzept des Abrufens sprachspezifischer Texte zentral. Diese Klasse bietet Hilfsfunktionen für die Lokalisierung, wie z.B. die Ermittlung von Gebietsschemas. Die gezeigte Lösung demonstriert, wie man sprachabhängige Texte in modernem ABAP handhabt, oft unter Verwendung von `CASE`-Anweisungen oder Text-Repositorys. String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit bei der Textformatierung.
keywords: I18N, Localization, String Processing, Text, Language

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in Großbuchstaben, wobei sprachspezifische Regeln berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>convert_to_upper_case`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_upper_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_to_upper_case.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_upper_case( ).

    " German specific upper case for 'ß' is 'SS'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->to_upper_case_i18n( iv_text = 'straße' iv_language = 'D' ) exp = 'STRASSE' ).

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Liste aller im System verfügbaren Sprachen ab und filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf dieser Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>get_language_list` und den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_lang_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_data,
             language TYPE sy-langu,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_text_data.
    TYPES tt_text_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_text_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_by_available_languages
      IMPORTING
        it_all_texts TYPE tt_text_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_texts) TYPE tt_text_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_lang_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_available_languages.
    DATA(lt_available_languages) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_language_list( ).

    rt_filtered_texts = FILTER #( it_all_texts USING KEY primary_key WHERE language IN lt_available_languages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_languages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_languages.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_i18n_lang_filter=>tt_text_data, 
          ls_data  TYPE zcl_i18n_lang_filter=>ty_text_data.

    ls_data-language = 'D'. ls_data-text = 'Deutsch'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-language = 'E'. ls_data-text = 'English'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-language = 'X'. ls_data-text = 'NonExistent'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-language = 'F'. ls_data-text = 'Français'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_lang_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_available_languages( lt_input ).

    " The exact number of available languages depends on the system, 
    " but 'D' and 'E' are usually present. 'X' should be filtered out.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) < lines( lt_input ) ).

    " Check if 'X' is not in the result
    DATA(lv_found_x) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_data WHERE language = 'X'.
      lv_found_x = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_found_x ).

    " Check if 'D' and 'E' are present (assuming they are available)
    DATA(lv_found_d) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_data WHERE language = 'D'.
      lv_found_d = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_d ).

    DATA(lv_found_e) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_data WHERE language = 'E'.
      lv_found_e = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_e ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_i18n_utils=>get_language_list` liefert dynamisch die im System konfigurierten Sprachen. In Kombination mit dem `FILTER`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) kann man interne Tabellen effizient bereinigen oder filtern, um nur Daten in unterstützten Sprachen zu verarbeiten. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Methode, um sprachabhängige Daten zu handhaben.
keywords: I18N, Language List, FILTER, Internal Tables, cl_i18n_utils

Instructions: Löschen Sie Einträge aus einer benutzerdefinierten Datenbanktabelle, die sprachabhängige Texte enthält, basierend auf einer Liste von zu löschenden Sprachen und unter Verwendung von `cl_i18n_utils` zur Validierung der Sprachen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>get_language_list` mit `DELETE FROM` und dem `IN`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_db_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_text,
             id       TYPE string,
             language TYPE sy-langu,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_custom_text.
    TYPES tt_custom_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_text WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_texts_by_language
      IMPORTING
        it_languages_to_delete TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-langu WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.

    METHODS insert_test_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_db_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_texts_by_language.
    DATA(lt_available_languages) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_language_list( ).

    " Filter the input languages to ensure only valid, existing languages are considered for deletion
    DATA(lt_valid_languages_to_delete) = FILTER #( it_languages_to_delete USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line IN lt_available_languages ).

    IF lt_valid_languages_to_delete IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE FROM zcustom_i18n_text WHERE language IN @lt_valid_languages_to_delete.
      rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_test_data.
    " Create a dummy database table ZCUSTOM_I18N_TEXT with fields ID (STRING), LANGUAGE (SY-LANGU), TEXT (STRING)
    " For testing purposes, we assume this table exists.
    INSERT zcustom_i18n_text FROM TABLE @( VALUE tt_custom_text(
      ( id = 'ITEM1' language = 'D' text = 'Artikel 1' )
      ( id = 'ITEM1' language = 'E' text = 'Item 1' )
      ( id = 'ITEM2' language = 'D' text = 'Artikel 2' )
      ( id = 'ITEM2' language = 'F' text = 'Article 2' ) " Assuming 'F' might be an available language
      ( id = 'ITEM3' language = 'X' text = 'Non-existent language text' ) " Should not be deleted by valid languages
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS class_setup.
    CLASS-METHODS class_teardown.
    METHODS test_delete_texts_by_language FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_setup.
    " Create dummy table ZCUSTOM_I18N_TEXT if it doesn't exist
    " This is a placeholder for actual table creation/management in a test environment.
    " For a real system, ensure the table exists or mock DB operations.
    " Example: CREATE TABLE ZCUSTOM_I18N_TEXT ( ID VARCHAR(255), LANGUAGE CHAR(1), TEXT VARCHAR(255) );
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD class_teardown.
    " Clean up any remaining test data
    DELETE FROM zcustom_i18n_text WHERE id LIKE 'ITEM%'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_texts_by_language.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_db_delete( ).

    " Ensure clean state and insert test data
    DELETE FROM zcustom_i18n_text WHERE id LIKE 'ITEM%'.
    COMMIT WORK.
    lo_cut->insert_test_data( ).

    " Test 1: Delete German texts
    DATA(lt_languages_to_delete_1) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-langu( ( 'D' ) ).
    DATA(lv_deleted_1) = lo_cut->delete_texts_by_language( lt_languages_to_delete_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted_1 exp = 2 ). " ITEM1-D, ITEM2-D

    " Verify remaining entries
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zcustom_i18n_text INTO @DATA(lv_count_1) WHERE language = 'D'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_1 exp = 0 ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zcustom_i18n_text INTO @DATA(lv_count_e) WHERE language = 'E'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_e exp = 1 ).

    " Test 2: Attempt to delete a non-existent language 'Z' and an existing 'E'
    DATA(lt_languages_to_delete_2) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-langu( ( 'E' ) ( 'Z' ) ).
    DATA(lv_deleted_2) = lo_cut->delete_texts_by_language( lt_languages_to_delete_2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted_2 exp = 1 ). " Only ITEM1-E should be deleted

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zcustom_i18n_text INTO @DATA(lv_count_2) WHERE language = 'E'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_2 exp = 0 ).

    " Clean up remaining test data
    DELETE FROM zcustom_i18n_text WHERE id LIKE 'ITEM%'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Funktionalität von `cl_i18n_utils` mit Datenbankoperationen. Zuerst werden die tatsächlich im System verfügbaren Sprachen über `cl_i18n_utils=>get_language_list` ermittelt. Dann wird die Liste der zu löschenden Sprachen mit dem `FILTER`-Operator gegen diese verfügbaren Sprachen validiert. Schließlich werden die Einträge aus der Datenbanktabelle mit `DELETE FROM` und dem `IN`-Operator gelöscht. Dies stellt sicher, dass nur Daten für gültige Sprachen gelöscht werden, was die Datenintegrität erhöht und eine moderne, sichere Vorgehensweise darstellt.
keywords: DELETE, Database Operations, I18N, FILTER, cl_i18n_utils, Open SQL

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, direkt mit `DELETE TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_delete_table_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_by_condition IMPORTING CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data iv_threshold TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_table_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_by_condition.
    DELETE ct_data WHERE id > iv_threshold.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_by_condition FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_by_condition.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_itb_delete_table_where=>tt_data,
          ls_data  TYPE zcl_itb_delete_table_where=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'A'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'B'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 3. ls_data-text = 'C'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.
    ls_data-id = 4. ls_data-text = 'D'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_delete_table_where( ).
    lo_cut->delete_by_condition( CHANGING ct_data = lt_input iv_threshold = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_input ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_input[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_input[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE TABLE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel ist die direkte und effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber immer noch moderne und performante Operation in ABAP, die oft verwendet wird, wenn die Originaltabelle modifiziert werden soll.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, WHERE, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Löschen Sie Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die in einer anderen internen Tabelle (als Referenz) nicht vorhanden sind, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `IN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und dem `IN`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_delete_not_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_existing_data IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_data it_reference_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_delete_not_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_existing_data.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_row IN it_source WHERE ( id IN it_reference_ids ) ( ls_row ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_existing_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_existing_data.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_itb_delete_not_in=>tt_data,
          ls_data   TYPE zcl_itb_delete_not_in=>ty_data.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'A'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_source.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'B'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_source.
    ls_data-id = 3. ls_data-text = 'C'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_source.
    ls_data-id = 4. ls_data-text = 'D'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_reference_ids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_delete_not_in( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_existing_data( it_source = lt_source it_reference_ids = lt_reference_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das 'Löschen' von Zeilen, die nicht in einer Referenztabelle vorhanden sind, wird in modernem ABAP elegant durch die Kombination des `FOR`-Operators mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und dem `IN`-Operator gelöst. Anstatt explizit zu löschen, wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur die gewünschten Zeilen enthält. Dies ist eine deklarative, lesbare und effiziente Methode, die die Datenintegrität fördert, indem sie die Originaltabelle unverändert lässt.
keywords: FOR, IN, Internal Tables, Filtering, VALUE, DELETE (conceptual)

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) ) ).
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_table_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere ein zufälliges Passwort fester Länge, das Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 12
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_count) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_char_count - 1
    ).

    rv_password = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                 FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
                                 NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_generate_password.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_password( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match( act = lv_password exp = `*[A-Z]*` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match( act = lv_password exp = `*[a-z]*` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match( act = lv_password exp = `*[0-9]*` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_random_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_random_category
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_random_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_category.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 10

    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN lv_random_number <= 3 THEN 'Niedrig'
      WHEN lv_random_number <= 7 THEN 'Mittel'
      ELSE 'Hoch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt von 10 zufälligen Gleitkommazahlen zwischen 0.0 und 1.0.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_float` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_random_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_random_average.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE f( INIT s = 0.0
                             FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                             NEXT s = s + lo_random->get_next( ) ).

    IF iv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / iv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_calculate_random_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_average( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_random_average( iv_count = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average >= 0.0 AND lv_average <= 1.0 ).

    DATA(lv_average_zero) = lo_cut->calculate_random_average( iv_count = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average_zero exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_auto_stop_timer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_tick EXPORTING VALUE(iv_current_tick) TYPE i.
    EVENTS timer_stopped.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_ticks TYPE i DEFAULT 5.
    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i DEFAULT 1.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_current_tick TYPE i.
    DATA mv_max_ticks TYPE i.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_auto_stop_timer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mv_max_ticks = iv_max_ticks.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mv_current_tick = 0.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_current_tick = mv_current_tick + 1.
    RAISE EVENT timer_tick EXPORTING iv_current_tick = mv_current_tick.

    IF mv_current_tick >= mv_max_ticks.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
      RAISE EVENT timer_stopped.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere zufällige Zahlen in Bereiche und zähle die Elemente pro Bereich.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` und `GROUP BY` mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_random_data,
             value TYPE i,
             range TYPE string,
           END OF ty_random_data.
    TYPES tt_random_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_random_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_count,
             range TYPE string,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_range_count.
    TYPES tt_range_count TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_range_count WITH UNIQUE KEY range.

    METHODS group_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_range_counts) TYPE tt_range_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 100
    ).

    DATA(lt_random_data) = VALUE tt_random_data( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
      LET lv_value = lo_random->get_next( ) IN
      ( value = lv_value,
        range = COND string(
          WHEN lv_value <= 25 THEN '1-25'
          WHEN lv_value <= 50 THEN '26-50'
          WHEN lv_value <= 75 THEN '51-75'
          ELSE '76-100'
        )
      )
    ).

    rt_range_counts = VALUE tt_range_count( FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN lt_random_data GROUP BY ( range = ls_data-range ) ASCENDING
                                            ( range = ls_data-range,
                                              count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_random_numbers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_range_counts) = lo_cut->group_random_numbers( iv_count = 1000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range_counts ) exp = 4 ).

    DATA(lv_total_count) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_count IN lt_range_counts NEXT s = s + ls_count-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_count exp = 1000 ).

    " Check if ranges exist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_range_counts[ range = '1-25' ]-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_range_counts[ range = '26-50' ]-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_range_counts[ range = '51-75' ]-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_range_counts[ range = '76-100' ]-count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es nutzt `cl_abap_random_int` für die Zahlen, `COND` für die Bereichszuweisung und den `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck, um die Daten modern und effizient zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe zu zählen.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit einer zufälligen Anzahl von Einträgen (zwischen 5 und 15) füllt, wobei jeder Eintrag eine zufällige Zeichenkette ist.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` für die Anzahl der Einträge und die Länge der Zeichenketten, sowie `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_strings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_random_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string_table.
    DATA(lo_random_count) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 5
      max  = 15
    ).
    DATA(lv_entry_count) = lo_random_count->get_next( ).

    rt_strings = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lv_entry_count
                          ( generate_random_string( iv_length = 10 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_count) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_char_count - 1
    ).

    rv_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                               FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
                               NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random_char->get_next( )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_random_string_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_string_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_random_table( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = lo_cut->generate_random_string_table( ).

    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lines >= 5 AND lv_lines <= 15 ).

    LOOP AT lt_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_string ) exp = 10 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_match( act = lv_string exp = `*[A-Za-z0-9]*` ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die einen GUI-Timer kapselt und eine Methode zum Starten und Stoppen des Timers sowie eine Methode zum Abrufen der verstrichenen Zeit bereitstellt.
hint: Verwende `cl_gui_timer` und `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitmessung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_stopwatch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS tick EXPORTING VALUE(iv_elapsed_seconds) TYPE i.
    EVENTS stopped EXPORTING VALUE(iv_total_elapsed_seconds) TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_stopwatch
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i DEFAULT 1.
    METHODS stop_stopwatch.
    METHODS get_elapsed_seconds
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_elapsed_seconds) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_start_timestamp TYPE timestampl.
    DATA mv_last_elapsed_seconds TYPE i.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_stopwatch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_stopwatch.
    mv_start_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    mv_last_elapsed_seconds = 0.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_stopwatch.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_current_timestamp iv_tstmp2 = mv_start_timestamp ).
    mv_last_elapsed_seconds = TRUNC( lv_diff_seconds ).
    RAISE EVENT stopped EXPORTING iv_total_elapsed_seconds = mv_last_elapsed_seconds.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_elapsed_seconds.
    IF mo_timer->running = abap_true.
      DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
      DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_current_timestamp iv_tstmp2 = mv_start_timestamp ).
      rv_elapsed_seconds = TRUNC( lv_diff_seconds ).
    ELSE.
      rv_elapsed_seconds = mv_last_elapsed_seconds.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_current_timestamp iv_tstmp2 = mv_start_timestamp ).
    RAISE EVENT tick EXPORTING iv_elapsed_seconds = TRUNC( lv_diff_seconds ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_packages.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package. " Clear package for next fetch
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffne einen Cursor für eine dynamisch erzeugte SELECT-Anweisung auf `sflight`, um Spalten und WHERE-Klausel zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutze `OPEN CURSOR WITH SOURCE` und dynamische SQL-Konstrukte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_fields     TYPE string DEFAULT 'carrid, connid'
        iv_where_cond TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_dynamic_data
      RAISING   cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA lv_select_statement TYPE string.
    DATA ls_dynamic_line TYPE ty_dynamic_data.

    lv_select_statement = |SELECT { iv_fields } FROM sflight|.
    IF iv_where_cond IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_select_statement = |{ lv_select_statement } WHERE { iv_where_cond }|.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_select_statement).

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_dynamic_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_dynamic_line TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.

Instructions: Ermittle mit einem Cursor die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflight`, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in der `SELECT` Anweisung des Cursors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_flight_count TYPE ty_flight_count.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM sflight
        GROUP BY carrid
        HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight_count.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_result.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_cur_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY fldate, carrid, connid
        OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
        UP TO @iv_limit ROWS.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE rt_flights.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_alink_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_info,
             sap_object TYPE saop_s_object,
             object_id  TYPE saop_object_id,

             doc_id     TYPE saop_doc_id,
           END OF ty_connection_info.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_alink_check_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_connection_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_sap_object TYPE saop_s_object DEFAULT 'BUS2032'
        iv_object_id  TYPE saop_object_id DEFAULT '47110815'
        iv_doc_type   TYPE saop_doc_type DEFAULT 'ZTESTDOC'

CLASS zcl_alink_check_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_connection_exists.
    DATA: lt_connections TYPE saop_t_connection_read.

        iv_sap_object = iv_sap_object
        iv_object_id  = iv_object_id
      IMPORTING
        et_connections = lt_connections
    ).

    " Check if a connection matching the criteria exists
    IF line_exists( lt_connections[ doc_type = iv_doc_type AND archiv_id = iv_archiv_id ] ).

    ELSE.

    ENDIF.

Instructions: Verwende einen Cursor, um eine Liste von Flugbuchungen (aus `sflight`) zu verarbeiten und für jede Buchung eine Dummy-ArchiveLink-Verbindung zu erstellen.
hint: Kombiniere `OPEN CURSOR` mit `cl_alink_connection=>create_connection` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_alink_mass_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_alink_for_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_created_count) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_saop_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_alink_mass_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_alink_for_flights.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA ls_connection TYPE saop_s_connection_create.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        UP TO @iv_max_flights ROWS.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Construct dummy ArchiveLink connection data
      ls_connection-sap_object = 'BUS2032'. " Example: Sales Order
      ls_connection-object_id  = |{ ls_sflight_key-carrid }{ ls_sflight_key-connid }{ ls_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|. " Unique ID
      ls_connection-doc_type   = 'ZFLIGHTDOC'.
      ls_connection-archiv_id  = 'A1'.
      ls_connection-ar_object  = 'FLIGHT_AR_OBJ'.
      ls_connection-doc_id     = |FLIGHT_DOC_{ sy-tabix }|.

      cl_alink_connection=>create_connection(
        EXPORTING
          is_connection_create = ls_connection
      ).
      rv_created_count = rv_created_count + 1.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mass_create FOR TESTING RAISING cx_saop_error.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_create.
    DATA(lo_delete) = NEW zcl_alink_delete( ).
    " Clean up previous dummy connections for BUS2032/47110815 if any
    TRY.
        lo_delete->delete_dummy_connection( iv_doc_type = 'ZFLIGHTDOC' iv_object_id = 'LH00119950101' ).
        lo_delete->delete_dummy_connection( iv_doc_type = 'ZFLIGHTDOC' iv_object_id = 'AA01719950101' ).
        " ... more cleanup if needed, or make object_id dynamic for cleanup
      CATCH cx_saop_error. " Ignore if not found
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cur_alink_mass_create( ).
    DATA(lv_created) = lo_cut->create_alink_for_flights( iv_max_flights = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_created exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_get) = NEW zcl_alink_get( ).
    DATA(lt_connections) = lo_get->get_connections_for_object( iv_object_id = 'LH00119950101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_connections ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connections[ 1 ]-doc_type exp = 'ZFLIGHTDOC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration von `OPEN CURSOR` für die effiziente Massenverarbeitung von Datenbankeinträgen mit `cl_alink_connection` zur Erstellung von ArchiveLink-Verbindungen. Instructions: Verwende einen Cursor, um Flugbuchungen aus `sflight` zu lesen und für jede Buchung zu prüfen, ob bereits eine ArchiveLink-Verbindung existiert.
hint: Kombiniere `OPEN CURSOR` mit `cl_alink_connection=>get_connections` und `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_alink_check_mass DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_alink_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             alink_exists TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_alink_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_alink_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_alink_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_alink_for_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_flight_alink_status
      RAISING   cx_saop_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_alink_check_mass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_alink_for_flights.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA lt_connections TYPE saop_t_connection_read.
    DATA ls_status TYPE ty_flight_alink_status.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        UP TO @iv_max_flights ROWS.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      ls_status-carrid = ls_sflight_key-carrid.
      ls_status-connid = ls_sflight_key-connid.
      ls_status-fldate = ls_sflight_key-fldate.

      cl_alink_connection=>get_connections(
        EXPORTING
          iv_sap_object = 'BUS2032'
          iv_object_id  = |{ ls_sflight_key-carrid }{ ls_sflight_key-connid }{ ls_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|
        IMPORTING
          et_connections = lt_connections
      ).

      IF line_exists( lt_connections[ doc_type = 'ZFLIGHTDOC' ] ).
        ls_status-alink_exists = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        ls_status-alink_exists = abap_false.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_status TO rt_status.
      CLEAR lt_connections.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_cur_alink_mass_create( ).
    lo_create->create_alink_for_flights( iv_max_flights = 1 ). " Create one connection

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cur_alink_check_mass( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_status ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status[ 2 ]-alink_exists exp = abap_false ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine andere Methode einer Klasse aufruft und deren Ergebnis zurückgibt. Die aufgerufene Methode soll einen String-Parameter akzeptieren und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_method_call_statement` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Angaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET_CLASS'
          iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
          iv_param_value = 'World' ).
        out->write( |Dynamic call result: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        out->write( |Error during dynamic call: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN rv_result TO <fs_result>.

    CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
      EXPORTING
        iv_input = iv_param_value
      RECEIVING
        rv_output = <fs_result>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_output = |Hello, { iv_input }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Hello, Test!'.
    DATA(lv_actual) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET_CLASS'
      iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
      iv_param_value = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual exp = lv_expected msg = 'Dynamic method call failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode einer zur Laufzeit bestimmten Klasse. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Frameworks oder Plugins, bei denen die aufzurufende Logik erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (name)` und `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` ermöglicht diese Flexibilität. `cl_abap_dyn_prg` bietet weitere fortgeschrittene Funktionen für die dynamische Programmierung, wie z.B. die Erstellung von dynamischen Quellcode-Statements.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG, Dynamic Method Call, Reflection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Pop-up-Fenster mit dem `CL_GUI_ECL_VIEWERBOX`, das einen einfachen Text anzeigt. Die Anzeige soll modal sein.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` und rufen Sie `create_viewer` sowie `display_text` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_popup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS show_text_popup
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
        iv_text  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_popup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW zcl_ecl_viewer_popup( ).
    lo_viewer->show_text_popup(
      iv_title = 'ECL Viewer Demo'
      iv_text  = 'Dies ist ein Beispieltext im ECL Viewer Pop-up.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD show_text_popup.
    DATA: lo_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox,
          lv_rc         TYPE i.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewer.

    lo_ecl_viewer->create_viewer(
      EXPORTING
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        shell_style    = cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox=>co_shell_style_popup
        title          = iv_title
      IMPORTING
        rc             = lv_rc
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1 ).
    IF lv_rc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Viewers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_ecl_viewer->display_text(
      EXPORTING
        text           = iv_text
      IMPORTING
        rc             = lv_rc
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1 ).
    IF lv_rc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Anzeigen des Textes' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_ecl_viewer->set_visible(
      EXPORTING
        visible        = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        rc             = lv_rc
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1 ).
    IF lv_rc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Sichtbarmachen des Viewers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " To make it modal, you'd typically use a WAIT FOR MESSAGING or similar, 
    " but for a simple popup, the user interaction closes it.
    " For a true modal dialog, you'd need more complex GUI handling.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_viewer_instantiation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_viewer_instantiation.
    DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW zcl_ecl_viewer_popup( ).
    " We cannot test the actual UI display in a unit test.
    " We can only test if the object can be instantiated and methods called without immediate errors.
    " A real test would involve integration testing with UI interaction.
    TRY.
        lo_viewer->show_text_popup( iv_title = 'Test' iv_text = 'Test Text' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during instantiation and call' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Exception caught: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).

Es instanziiert den Viewer, setzt den Titel und den Inhalt und macht ihn sichtbar. Da es sich um eine GUI-Klasse handelt, ist ein automatischer Unit-Test der visuellen Darstellung nicht direkt möglich. Der Test konzentriert sich daher auf die fehlerfreie Instanziierung und den Aufruf der Methoden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID und CONNID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, für Flüge, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #(`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                 connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_lh_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_key-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Further checks could involve counting entries or specific content if test data is controlled.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE #(` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird eine neue Tabelle `rt_flight_keys` erstellt, indem über `lt_sflights` iteriert und nur Einträge mit `carrid = 'LH'` ausgewählt werden. Für jeden passenden Eintrag wird eine neue Zeile mit den Feldern `carrid` und `connid` in die Ergebnistabelle eingefügt. Dies ist eine funktionale und moderne Alternative zu klassischen `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukten.
keywords: Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA').
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price_aa FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_aa.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'AA' ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices in sflights. Adjust expected value based on actual data.
    " For a robust test, one would mock sflights or use a dedicated test fixture.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 1000.00 msg = 'Total price for AA is incorrect' ). " Example value
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Hier wird die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft berechnet. `INIT sum = 0` initialisiert den Akkumulator, und `NEXT sum = sum + flight-price` definiert die Aggregationslogik. Dies ist eine funktionale und prägnante Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... SUM ... ENDLOOP` oder manuellen Schleifen mit einer Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: Internal Table, REDUCE, sflights, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis (PRICE) über 500 und einer Währung (CURRENCY) 'EUR' zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_exp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_expensive_eur_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_exp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_eur_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > 500 AND currency = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_exp( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_eur_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) msg = 'Price should be > 500' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-currency exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Currency should be EUR' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    " This test assumes there are no flights with price > 999999 and currency 'XYZ'
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_exp( ).
    DATA lt_sflights_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Populate mock data if needed, or rely on actual sflights not having such entries
    " For this example, we'll assume no such entries exist in sflights for a simple test.
    DATA(lt_result) = FILTER #( lt_sflights_mock WHERE price > 999999 AND currency = 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should be empty for no match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben, um Zeilen zu prüfen und in eine neue Tabelle zu kopieren, kann man mit `FILTER` direkt die Bedingungen angeben. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code, da der ABAP-Kernel die Filterung optimieren kann.
keywords: Internal Table, FILTER, sflights, Declarative Programming

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle mit `sflights`-Struktur in eine andere interne Tabelle mit einer ähnlichen, aber nicht identischen Struktur, wobei nur übereinstimmende Felder übertragen werden. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING ... BASE ...` oder `CORRESPONDING #(`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights MAPPING carrid = carrid
                                                    connid = connid
                                                    fldate = fldate
                                                    price = price
                                                    currency = currency
                                                    seatsocc = seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                                                        price = price

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden unter Verwendung der neuen ABAP Date/Time API.

CLASS zcl_dtm_tstmp_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_timestamp_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl

CLASS zcl_dtm_tstmp_diff IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_tstmp2 ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein bestimmtes Muster enthält, das durch einen regulären Ausdruck definiert ist, und extrahieren Sie alle Übereinstimmungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_numbers.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_no_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_multiple_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_regex_find( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->find_all_numbers( 'Text with 123 and 456.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 numbers' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '123' msg = 'First number incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '456' msg = 'Second number incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_no_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_regex_find( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Should find no numbers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_multiple_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_regex_find( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->find_all_numbers( '1 2 3 4 5' ).

explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`-Anweisung ist die moderne Art, reguläre Ausdrücke in ABAP zu verwenden. In Kombination mit der `RESULTS`-Option können alle Übereinstimmungen, einschließlich ihrer Position (`offset`) und Länge (`length`), in einer internen Tabelle (`match_result_tab`) gesammelt werden. Dies ist wesentlich flexibler und leistungsfähiger als ältere String-Operationen für komplexe Mustererkennung und -extraktion.
