Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie für jeden Flug eine formatierte Zeichenkette aus, die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum enthält. Verwenden Sie String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(wa)` und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_info) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_info.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| TO rt_formatted_info.
    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = '\d+' " Matches one or more digits
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher(
      text = iv_text
    ).

    DATA(lt_match_results) TYPE match_result_tab.
    lo_matcher->find_all(
      EXPORTING
        offset = 0
      IMPORTING
        results = lt_match_results
    ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <match_result> IN lt_match_results
        ( substring( val = iv_text off = <match_result>-offset len = <match_result>-length ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer Logzeile strukturierte Informationen (Timestamp, Level, Message) mithilfe benannter Regex-Gruppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` und die Methode `get_group` nach einem erfolgreichen Match.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE string,
             level     TYPE string,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

    METHODS parse_log_line
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry
      RAISING
        cx_abap_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_line.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '^\s*(?<timestamp>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+\[(?<level>\w+)\]\s+(?<message>.*)$'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = lv_pattern
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher(
      text = iv_log_line
    ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_log_entry-timestamp = lo_matcher->get_group( name = 'timestamp' ).
      rs_log_entry-level     = lo_matcher->get_group( name = 'level' ).
      rs_log_entry-message   = lo_matcher->get_group( name = 'message' ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle case where no match is found, e.g., raise an exception or return initial structure
      CLEAR rs_log_entry.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines Regex-Delimiters (z.B. ein oder mehrere Leerzeichen, Kommas oder Semikolons) in eine Tabelle von Strings auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `cl_abap_matcher` in Kombination mit `find_all` und `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_delimiter_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = iv_delimiter_pattern
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher(
      text = iv_text
    ).

    DATA(lt_match_results) TYPE match_result_tab.
    lo_matcher->find_all(
      EXPORTING
        offset = 0
      IMPORTING
        results = lt_match_results
    ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) TYPE i = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match_result).
      IF ls_match_result-offset > lv_last_offset.
        APPEND substring( val = iv_text off = lv_last_offset len = ls_match_result-offset - lv_last_offset ) TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = ls_match_result-offset + ls_match_result-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add the remaining part after the last delimiter
    IF lv_last_offset < strlen( iv_text ).
      APPEND substring( val = iv_text off = lv_last_offset ) TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.

    " Handle case where string starts or ends with delimiter, or multiple delimiters
    " Remove empty strings if they are not desired (e.g., from 'A,,B' -> 'A', '', 'B')
    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance einer `LOOP AT` Schleife mit einer `FOR`-Expression für das Füllen einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit beider Ansätze separat mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_performance_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_fill
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_performance_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_fill.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE ty_data_tab,
          lt_target_loop TYPE ty_data_tab,
          lt_target_for  TYPE ty_data_tab.

    " Prepare source data
    lt_source_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_count ( id = i text = |Item { i }| ) ).

    " Measure LOOP AT performance
    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_source_data INTO DATA(ls_source).
      APPEND ls_source TO lt_target_loop.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_loop) = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    " Measure FOR expression performance
    DATA(lv_start_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_target_for = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN lt_source_data ( ls_source ) ).
    DATA(lv_end_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_for) = lv_end_for - lv_start_for.

    " Return results as an anonymous data object
    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_runtimes> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.
    INSERT VALUE string-int_map( key = 'LOOP_AT_US' value = lv_runtime_loop ) INTO TABLE <fs_runtimes>.
    INSERT VALUE string-int_map( key = 'FOR_EXPRESSION_US' value = lv_runtime_for ) INTO TABLE <fs_runtimes>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_comparison_results FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_comparison_results.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_performance_comparer( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_table_fill( 100000 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_runtimes> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.

    DATA(lv_loop_runtime) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_for_runtime) TYPE i.

    READ TABLE <fs_runtimes> WITH TABLE KEY key = 'LOOP_AT_US' INTO DATA(ls_map_loop).
    lv_loop_runtime = ls_map_loop-value.

    READ TABLE <fs_runtimes> WITH TABLE KEY key = 'FOR_EXPRESSION_US' INTO DATA(ls_map_for).
    lv_for_runtime = ls_map_for-value.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_loop_runtime > 0 ) msg = 'LOOP AT runtime should be positive' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_for_runtime > 0 ) msg = 'FOR expression runtime should be positive' ).
    " Often FOR expressions are faster, but not always guaranteed depending on context
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_for_runtime < lv_loop_runtime ) msg = 'FOR expression should be faster' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance zweier gängiger ABAP-Programmierstile: die traditionelle `LOOP AT`-Schleife und die moderne `FOR`-Expression. Durch die präzise Zeitmessung mit `cl_abap_runtime` können Entwickler die Auswirkungen ihrer Designentscheidungen auf die Laufzeit objektiv bewerten. Die `FOR`-Expression ist oft, aber nicht immer, effizienter und führt zu kompakterem Code.
keywords: RUNTIME, PERFORMANCE, COMPARISON, LOOP, FOR, INTERNAL_TABLES, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine konfigurierbare Arbeitslast (z.B. komplexe String-Operationen) und messen Sie deren Ausführungszeit, um Benchmarking-Szenarien zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit String-Templates und `cl_abap_runtime` zur Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workload_simulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_string_workload
      IMPORTING
        iv_iterations TYPE i
        iv_string_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workload_simulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_string_workload.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DATA(lv_base_string) = 'A'.
    DO iv_string_length - 1 TIMES.
      lv_base_string = lv_base_string && 'A'.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_result_string) TYPE string.
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      " Simulate complex string operations
      lv_result_string = |{ lv_base_string }-{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT }-{ lv_base_string }|.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'A' IN lv_result_string WITH 'B'.
      FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX 'B+' IN lv_result_string.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_workload_scaling FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workload_runtime.
    DATA(lo_simulator) = NEW zcl_workload_simulator( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_simulator->simulate_string_workload( iv_iterations = 1000 iv_string_length = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_runtime > 0 ) msg = 'Runtime should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_workload_scaling.
    DATA(lo_simulator) = NEW zcl_workload_simulator( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_small) = lo_simulator->simulate_string_workload( iv_iterations = 100 iv_string_length = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_large) = lo_simulator->simulate_string_workload( iv_iterations = 1000 iv_string_length = 100 ).
    " Expect larger workload to take significantly longer
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_runtime_large > lv_runtime_small ) msg = 'Larger workload should take longer' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Simulation einer komplexen Arbeitslast (hier: String-Manipulationen mit String-Templates, `REPLACE` und `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`) und die Messung der Ausführungszeit können Entwickler die Performance von Code-Änderungen oder verschiedenen Algorithmen unter kontrollierten Bedingungen bewerten. Dies ist entscheidend für die Optimierung kritischer Prozesse.
keywords: PERFORMANCE, BENCHMARK, WORKLOAD, RUNTIME, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, STRING_TEMPLATES, REGEX

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine IP-Adresse (IPv4) mithilfe eines regulären Ausdrucks.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Regex-Muster, das die Struktur einer IPv4-Adresse genau abbildet, und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher=>match`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ipv4_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_ipv4
      IMPORTING
        iv_ip_address TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ipv4_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_ipv4.
    " Regex for IPv4: (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.
    "                  (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.
    "                  (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.
    "                  (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)
    DATA(lv_octet_pattern) = '(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)'.
    DATA(lv_ipv4_pattern) = |^{ lv_octet_pattern }\.{ lv_octet_pattern }\.{ lv_octet_pattern }\.{ lv_octet_pattern }$|.

    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = lv_ipv4_pattern
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher(
      text = iv_ip_address
    ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1' ) msg = 'Valid IP 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '0.0.0.0' ) msg = 'Valid IP 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255' ) msg = 'Valid IP 3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '10.0.0.1' ) msg = 'Valid IP 4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '256.0.0.1' ) msg = 'Invalid IP (octet > 255)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1' ) msg = 'Invalid IP (too few octets)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1.1' ) msg = 'Invalid IP (too many octets)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( 'abc.def.ghi.jkl' ) msg = 'Invalid IP (non-numeric)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1. 1' ) msg = 'Invalid IP (space)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '' ) msg = 'Empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `cl_abap_matcher` zur Validierung komplexer String-Formate wie IPv4-Adressen. Durch die Zerlegung des Regex-Musters in kleinere, wiederverwendbare Teile (hier: `lv_octet_pattern`) und die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) wird das Pattern lesbarer und einfacher zu warten. Die `match`-Methode prüft, ob der gesamte String dem Muster entspricht.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_MATCHER, VALIDATION, IPV4, STRING_TEMPLATES

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance von `READ TABLE` mit `TABLE_LINE` und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Prüfung auf Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Messen Sie beide Ansätze mit `cl_abap_runtime` über eine große Anzahl von Iterationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exist_check_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_item_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS compare_existence_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_size TYPE i
        iv_iterations TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exist_check_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_existence_check.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE ty_item_tab.

    " Fill hashed table with data
    lt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_table_size ( key_field = |KEY_{ i }| value = |Value { i }| ) ).

    " Measure READ TABLE performance
    DATA(lv_start_read) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_search_key_read) = |KEY_{ ( sy-index MOD iv_table_size ) + 1 }|.
      READ TABLE lt_data WITH TABLE KEY key_field = lv_search_key_read TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      DATA(lv_found_read) = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_read) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_read) = lv_end_read - lv_start_read.

    " Measure LINE_EXISTS performance (ABAP 7.50+)
    DATA(lv_start_line_exists) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_search_key_line_exists) = |KEY_{ ( sy-index MOD iv_table_size ) + 1 }|.
      DATA(lv_found_line_exists) = line_exists( lt_data[ key_field = lv_search_key_line_exists ] ).
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_end_line_exists) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_line_exists) = lv_end_line_exists - lv_start_line_exists.

    " Return results as an anonymous data object
    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_runtimes> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.
    INSERT VALUE string-int_map( key = 'READ_TABLE_US' value = lv_runtime_read ) INTO TABLE <fs_runtimes>.
    INSERT VALUE string-int_map( key = 'LINE_EXISTS_US' value = lv_runtime_line_exists ) INTO TABLE <fs_runtimes>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_existence_check_runtimes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existence_check_runtimes.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_exist_check_comparer( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_existence_check( iv_table_size = 10000 iv_iterations = 100000 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_runtimes> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.

    DATA(lv_read_runtime) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_line_exists_runtime) TYPE i.

    READ TABLE <fs_runtimes> WITH TABLE KEY key = 'READ_TABLE_US' INTO DATA(ls_map_read).
    lv_read_runtime = ls_map_read-value.

    READ TABLE <fs_runtimes> WITH TABLE KEY key = 'LINE_EXISTS_US' INTO DATA(ls_map_line_exists).
    lv_line_exists_runtime = ls_map_line_exists-value.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_read_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'READ TABLE runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_line_exists_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'LINE_EXISTS runtime should be non-negative' ).
    " LINE_EXISTS is generally more performant and readable for existence checks
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_line_exists_runtime <= lv_read_runtime ) msg = 'LINE_EXISTS should be faster or equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht zwei moderne Ansätze zur Prüfung der Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle: die traditionelle `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und die seit ABAP 7.50 verfügbare `LINE_EXISTS`-Funktion. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Performance beider Methoden über eine große Anzahl von Iterationen zu messen. `LINE_EXISTS` ist in der Regel nicht nur performanter, sondern auch deutlich lesbarer und kompakter, was es zur bevorzugten Methode für Existenzprüfungen macht.
keywords: RUNTIME, PERFORMANCE, INTERNAL_TABLES, READ_TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, ABAP_750

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige URL enthält, die mit 'http://' oder 'https://' beginnt und mindestens einen Punkt im Domainnamen hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` mit einem Regex-Muster, das die URL-Struktur validiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_url.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '^(http|https):\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3}(\/\S*)?$'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = lv_pattern
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher(
      text = iv_url
    ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_urls FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_urls FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_urls.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_url_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'http://www.example.com' ) msg = 'Valid URL 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'https://sub.domain.co.uk/path/to/page?param=value' ) msg = 'Valid URL 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'http://localhost:8080/app' ) msg = 'Valid URL 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_urls.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_url_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'www.example.com' ) msg = 'Invalid URL (missing protocol)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'ftp://example.com' ) msg = 'Invalid URL (wrong protocol)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'http://example' ) msg = 'Invalid URL (no top-level domain)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( 'just text' ) msg = 'Invalid URL (not a URL)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_url_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_url( '' ) msg = 'Empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Validierung von URLs mit `cl_abap_matcher`. Ein komplexes Regex-Muster wird verwendet, um die Struktur einer gültigen URL zu überprüfen, einschließlich des Protokolls (http/https), des Domainnamens und optionaler Pfade/Parameter. Die `case_sensitive = abap_false` Option ist hier sinnvoll, da Domainnamen oft Groß- und Kleinschreibung ignorieren.
keywords: REGEX, CL_ABAP_MATCHER, VALIDATION, URL, STRING

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer `REDUCE`-Expression im Vergleich zu einer `LOOP`-basierten Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für präzise Zeitmessungen und aggregieren Sie numerische Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_loop_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             id    TYPE i,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value,
           ty_value_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_loop_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE ty_value_tab.

    " Prepare source data
    lt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_table_size ( id = i amount = i ) ).

    " Measure LOOP-based aggregation
    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_loop) TYPE i = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lv_sum_loop = lv_sum_loop + ls_data-amount.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_loop) = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    " Measure REDUCE-expression aggregation (ABAP 7.50+)
    DATA(lv_start_reduce) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_reduce) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_data IN lt_data NEXT s = s + ls_data-amount ).
    DATA(lv_end_reduce) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_reduce) = lv_end_reduce - lv_start_reduce.

    " Return results as an anonymous data object
    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_runtimes> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.
    INSERT VALUE string-int_map( key = 'LOOP_AGGREGATION_US' value = lv_runtime_loop ) INTO TABLE <fs_runtimes>.
    INSERT VALUE string-int_map( key = 'REDUCE_AGGREGATION_US' value = lv_runtime_reduce ) INTO TABLE <fs_runtimes>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation_runtimes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_runtimes.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_reduce_loop_comparer( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_aggregation( iv_table_size = 100000 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_runtimes> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string-int_map.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.

    DATA(lv_loop_runtime) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_reduce_runtime) TYPE i.

    READ TABLE <fs_runtimes> WITH TABLE KEY key = 'LOOP_AGGREGATION_US' INTO DATA(ls_map_loop).
    lv_loop_runtime = ls_map_loop-value.

    READ TABLE <fs_runtimes> WITH TABLE KEY key = 'REDUCE_AGGREGATION_US' INTO DATA(ls_map_reduce).
    lv_reduce_runtime = ls_map_reduce-value.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_loop_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'LOOP aggregation runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_reduce_runtime >= 0 ) msg = 'REDUCE aggregation runtime should be non-negative' ).
    " REDUCE is generally more performant and readable for aggregations
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_reduce_runtime <= lv_loop_runtime ) msg = 'REDUCE should be faster or equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der `REDUCE`-Expression (ABAP 7.50+) mit der traditionellen `LOOP`-basierten Aggregation. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Ausführungszeiten beider Ansätze präzise zu messen. `REDUCE` ist nicht nur syntaktisch kompakter und lesbarer für Aggregationsaufgaben, sondern oft auch performanter, da es intern optimiert ist. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil in ABAP.
keywords: RUNTIME, PERFORMANCE, REDUCE, LOOP, AGGREGATION, INTERNAL_TABLES, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, ABAP_750

Instructions: Berechne den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert und einer Iteration über die Flugtabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price = 0.00
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total_price = total_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_calculator=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200.50'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '300.50'
      msg = 'Total price should be 300.50'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Zeile, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... SUM`-Konstrukte.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Arithmetic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis mehrerer Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Änderungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @(lt_flight_updates)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES tt_flight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_updates TYPE tt_flight_updates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @(it_flight_updates).
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Testdaten in SFLIGHT einfügen
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Testdaten aus SFLIGHT löschen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate = '20251201'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_flight_updater=>tt_flight_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '120.00' ) TO lt_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' price = '180.00' ) TO lt_updates.

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_rows) = lo_updater->update_flight_prices( it_flight_updates = lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_updated_rows
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Two rows should be updated'
    ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Preise korrekt aktualisiert wurden
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_price_0400)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20251201'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_0400 exp = '120.00' msg = 'Price for 0400 incorrect' ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_price_0401)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20251201'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_0401 exp = '180.00' msg = 'Price for 0401 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @(internal_table)`-Syntax ermöglicht eine effiziente Massenaktualisierung von Datenbanktabellen direkt aus einer internen Tabelle, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `FOR ALL ENTRIES`, was die Performance verbessert und den Code vereinfacht.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, Internal Tables, Database

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabattpreis basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und dem ursprünglichen Preis unter Verwendung von `COND` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` für die Fluggesellschaft und `COND` für die Rabattlogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    rv_discounted_price = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
      WHEN 'LH' THEN COND #( WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN iv_price * '0.90' ELSE iv_price ) " 10% Rabatt über 500 EUR
      WHEN 'AA' THEN COND #( WHEN iv_price > 300 THEN iv_price * '0.95' ELSE iv_price ) " 5% Rabatt über 300 EUR
      ELSE iv_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_discount_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discount_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( ).

    " Testfall LH
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price = '600.00' ) exp = '540.00' msg = 'LH 600 should be 540' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price = '400.00' ) exp = '400.00' msg = 'LH 400 should be 400' ).

    " Testfall AA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_price = '400.00' ) exp = '380.00' msg = 'AA 400 should be 380' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_price = '200.00' ) exp = '200.00' msg = 'AA 200 should be 200' ).

    " Testfall unbekannte Airline
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_price = '100.00' ) exp = '100.00' msg = 'XX 100 should be 100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COND` und `SWITCH` sind funktionale Operatoren, die komplexe bedingte Logik in einem Ausdruck zusammenfassen. Dies macht den Code prägnanter und vermeidet verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: COND, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, Arithmetic

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges um einen festen Betrag direkt in der `UPDATE`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen SQL-Ausdruck im `SET`-Teil der `UPDATE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS adjust_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_amount TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflight SET price = price + @iv_amount
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status von Flügen in `SFLIGHT`, deren `carrid` und `connid` in einer internen Tabelle vorhanden sind.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
        iv_new_status  TYPE sflight-status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    IF it_flight_keys IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflight SET status = @iv_new_status
        WHERE carrid = sflight~carrid
          AND connid = sflight~connid
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_flight_keys
        WHERE sflight~carrid = @it_flight_keys-carrid
          AND sflight~connid = @it_flight_keys-connid.
      rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` zum Vorfiltern der Tabelle und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_avg_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_avg_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_filtered.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT total = 0.00
        FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
        NEXT total = total + flight-price
      ).
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.00.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis von Flügen in `SFLIGHT` basierend auf einer komplexen Logik, die in einer internen Tabelle definiert ist, unter Verwendung von `UPDATE` mit `FROM @(internal_table)` und `CASE` im `SET`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @(lt_updates)` und einen `CASE`-Ausdruck im `SET`-Teil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_price_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_rule,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             rule_type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'I' for increase, 'D' for decrease
             amount   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_price_rule.
    TYPES tt_price_rules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_rule WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS apply_price_rules
      IMPORTING
        it_rules TYPE tt_price_rules
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_price_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_price_rules.
    IF it_rules IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflight FROM @(it_rules) AS rules
        SET price = CASE rules~rule_type
                      WHEN 'I' THEN sflight~price + rules~amount
                      WHEN 'D' THEN sflight~price - rules~amount
                      ELSE sflight~price
                    END
        WHERE sflight~carrid = rules~carrid
          AND sflight~connid = rules~connid
          AND sflight~fldate = rules~fldate.
      rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife innerhalb von `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_squares) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum_squares = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + ( number * number )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Maximalwert aus einer Liste von Zahlen unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und vergleichen Sie den aktuellen Wert mit dem nächsten Element.

CLASS zcl_max_value_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_max_value
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_value_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max_value.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_value = 0. " Oder eine andere geeignete Standardantwort
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_value = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_val = it_numbers[ 1 ]
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN number > max_val THEN number ELSE max_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`).
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um die Summe der Preise und die Anzahl der Flüge zu aggregieren, und anschließend `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                          count_flights = 0
                                  FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price
                                       count_flights = ls_aggregation-count_flights + 1 ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count_flights > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_distribution DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_distribution_result,
             per_item_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             remainder       TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_distribution_result.

    METHODS distribute_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE decfloat16
        iv_num_items    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_distribution_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD distribute_amount.
    IF iv_num_items <= 0.
      " Handle invalid number of items, e.g., return zeros
      rs_result-per_item_amount = 0.
      rs_result-remainder = iv_total_amount.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_result-per_item_amount = iv_total_amount / iv_num_items.
    rs_result-remainder = iv_total_amount MOD iv_num_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine Division durch, aber fange die vordefinierte Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ab, die bei einer Division durch Null auftritt.

CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE decfloat16
        iv_denominator TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safely.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Handle division by zero specifically
        MESSAGE 'Division by zero attempted!' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " Handle other arithmetic errors
        MESSAGE lx_arith_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Skaliere eine Liste von numerischen Werten in einer internen Tabelle, indem du jeden Wert durch einen gegebenen Faktor teilst. Verwende dabei eine funktionale Programmierung mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_itab_scaling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS scale_values
      IMPORTING
        it_original_values TYPE tt_values
        iv_factor          TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_scaled_values) TYPE tt_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_scaling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD scale_values.
    IF iv_factor = 0.
      " Return original values or raise an exception, depending on requirements
      rt_scaled_values = it_original_values.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_scaled_values = VALUE #( FOR value IN it_original_values
                                 ( value / iv_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_external_url.
    DATA: lo_html_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_html_viewer.

Instructions: Berechne den Anteil eines Werts an einem Gesamtbetrag als Dezimalzahl (nicht als Prozent), wobei das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen gerundet werden soll. Behandle Division durch Null.
hint: Verwende `DIVIDE` und die Funktion `ROUND` oder `CEIL`/`FLOOR` in Kombination mit Multiplikation/Division für die Rundung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_rounded_ratio DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_rounded_ratio
      IMPORTING
        iv_value  TYPE decfloat16
        iv_total  TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ratio) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_rounded_ratio IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_rounded_ratio.
    IF iv_total = 0.
      rv_ratio = 0.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_raw_ratio) = iv_value / iv_total.
      rv_ratio = round( val = lv_raw_ratio dec = 2 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exact_ratio FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rounded_ratio FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_total FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exact_ratio.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_rounded_ratio( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_ratio( iv_value = '50' iv_total = '200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.25' msg = 'Exact ratio' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rounded_ratio.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_rounded_ratio( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_ratio( iv_value = '1' iv_total = '3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.33' msg = 'Rounded ratio' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_total.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_rounded_ratio( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_ratio( iv_value = '10' iv_total = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0' msg = 'Zero total' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_rounded_ratio( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0' msg = 'Zero value' ).

Instructions: Berechne den prozentualen Anteil jedes Flugpreises an der Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights`. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit Flugnummer und dem prozentualen Anteil sein.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `FOR` mit `DIVIDE` zur Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_price_share DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_share,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             percentage TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_share.
    TYPES tt_flight_share TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_share WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_shares
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shares) TYPE tt_flight_share.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_price_share IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_price_shares.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflight_data( iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).

    IF lv_total_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_shares = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                           ( connid = <fs_sflight>-connid,
                             percentage = ( <fs_sflight>-price / lv_total_price ) * 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_shares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_shares.
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data for 'AA' with prices 100, 200, 300
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_price_share( ).
    DATA(lt_shares) = lo_cut->get_price_shares( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_shares msg = 'Shares table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shares ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 shares' ).

    DATA(ls_share_1) = lt_shares[ connid = '0017' ]. " Assuming connid 0017 has price 100
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_share_1-percentage exp = '16.67' msg = 'Share for 0017' ).

    DATA(ls_share_2) = lt_shares[ connid = '0064' ]. " Assuming connid 0064 has price 200
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_share_2-percentage exp = '33.33' msg = 'Share for 0064' ).

    DATA(ls_share_3) = lt_shares[ connid = '0016' ]. " Assuming connid 0016 has price 300
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_share_3-percentage exp = '50.00' msg = 'Share for 0016' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_price_share( ).
    DATA(lt_shares) = lo_cut->get_price_shares( 'XX' ). " Non-existent airline
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shares msg = 'Shares for non-existent flights should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_total_price.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHTS data to return flights with price 0
    " For simplicity, we assume real SFLIGHTS data has non-zero prices.
    " If all prices are 0, the result should be an empty table or all percentages 0.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_price_share( ).
    DATA(lt_shares) = lo_cut->get_price_shares( 'LH' ). " Assuming LH has non-zero prices
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_shares msg = 'Should not be empty for LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es berechnet den prozentualen Anteil jedes Flugpreises am Gesamtpreis, was ein häufiges Szenario in der Datenanalyse ist. Die funktionale Syntax macht den Code sehr prägnant und lesbar.

CLASS zcl_datfm_tzone_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_datetime_tzone
      IMPORTING
        iv_date      TYPE sy-datum
        iv_time      TYPE sy-uzeit
        iv_from_tzone TYPE tznzone
        iv_to_tzone   TYPE tznzone
      EXPORTING
        ev_to_date   TYPE sy-datum
        ev_to_time   TYPE sy-uzeit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datfm_tzone_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_datetime_tzone.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    lo_datfm->convert_tstmp_to_tzone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date     = iv_date
        iv_time     = iv_time
        iv_tzone    = iv_from_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_tstmp    = DATA(lv_timestamp_utc)
    ).

    lo_datfm->convert_tstmp_to_tzone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp    = lv_timestamp_utc
        iv_tzone    = iv_to_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date     = ev_to_date
        ev_time     = ev_to_time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_tzone_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_tzone_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datfm_tzone_convert( ).
    DATA: lv_to_date TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_to_time TYPE sy-uzeit.

    " Example: Convert 2023-03-26 01:00:00 from CET (UTC+1, DST starts) to UTC
    lo_cut->convert_datetime_tzone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date      = '20230326'
        iv_time      = '010000'
        iv_from_tzone = 'CET'
        iv_to_tzone   = 'UTC'
      IMPORTING
        ev_to_date   = lv_to_date
        ev_to_time   = lv_to_time
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_to_date
      exp = '20230326'
      msg = 'Date conversion with timezone failed (date)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_to_time
      exp = '000000'
      msg = 'Time conversion with timezone failed (time)'
    ).

    " Another example: Convert 2023-03-26 03:00:00 from CET (after DST) to UTC
    lo_cut->convert_datetime_tzone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date      = '20230326'
        iv_time      = '030000'
        iv_from_tzone = 'CET'
        iv_to_tzone   = 'UTC'
      IMPORTING
        ev_to_date   = lv_to_date
        ev_to_time   = lv_to_time
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_to_date
      exp = '20230326'
      msg = 'Date conversion with timezone failed (date after DST)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_to_time
      exp = '010000'
      msg = 'Time conversion with timezone failed (time after DST)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_attach_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_attachment_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfkey
        iv_doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp " e.g., 'URL', 'RAW' (for documents)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_type) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_attach_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_attachment_type.
    DATA(lo_query) = cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_attachments) = lo_query->get_attachment_list(
      is_object = VALUE sibfbori(
        objtype = iv_object_type
        objkey  = iv_object_key
      )
    ).

    " Modern ABAP: Check if any attachment matches the document type
    IF line_exists( lt_attachments[ obj_type = iv_doc_type ] ).

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_attachments_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfkey
        iv_date_from   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_attachments_after_date.
    DATA(lo_query) = cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = lo_query->get_attachment_list(
      is_object = VALUE sibfbori(
        objtype = iv_object_type
        objkey  = iv_object_key
      )
    ).

    " Modern ABAP: Filter attachments created after a specific date
    DATA(lt_filtered_attachments) = FILTER #( lt_all_attachments USING KEY default
                                              WHERE creat_date >= iv_date_from ).

    rv_count = lines( lt_filtered_attachments ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

        lo_column->set_long_text( 'Flugnummer' ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Bedingung (z.B. 'Flüge mit mehr als 100 freien Sitzen') erfüllen, unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um eine Zählvariable zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc > iv_min_free_seats )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_flight_keys( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS INTO lv_expected_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_keys ) exp = lv_expected_count ).

explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ist ideal, um neue interne Tabellen oder Strukturen basierend auf vorhandenen Daten zu initialisieren und zu füllen. Dies ersetzt die Notwendigkeit, eine leere Tabelle zu deklarieren und dann in einer Schleife Zeile für Zeile mit `APPEND` zu füllen. Der Code wird dadurch deutlich kürzer und ausdrucksstärker.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Status-String ('Verfügbar' oder 'Ausgebucht') basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze eines Fluges zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für eine bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_free TYPE sflight-seatsocc " seatsocc is occupied, so we need seatsmax - seatsocc
        iv_seats_max  TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = iv_seats_max - iv_seats_free.
    rv_status = COND #( WHEN lv_free_seats > 0 THEN 'Verfügbar' ELSE 'Ausgebucht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zur `IF`-Anweisung für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen. Er macht den Code kompakter und funktionaler, da der Wert direkt zugewiesen wird, anstatt eine separate Variable in einem `IF`-Block zu setzen. Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variable einen Rabattprozentsatz basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft zu (z.B. 'LH' -> 10%, 'UA' -> 5%, andere -> 0%).

CLASS zcl_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Er ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF-ELSE IF`-Strukturen oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn der zu prüfende Wert ein einzelner Ausdruck ist.

Er erspart das manuelle Zuweisen jedes einzelnen Feldes und ist besonders vorteilhaft bei vielen Feldern oder wenn sich die Feldlisten ändern. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY ...` um die Gruppierung und Aggregation in einem Schritt durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid
                             flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

    " Example: Check if 'LH' has a count
    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Verify total count matches original table size (if no filtering)
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS INTO lv_total_flights.

    DATA(lv_sum_grouped_flights) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR count_entry IN lt_counts
      NEXT sum = sum + count_entry-flight_count
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_grouped_flights exp = lv_total_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY ...`-Syntax ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion in ABAP, um interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ermöglicht es, Gruppierung und die Erstellung einer neuen Ergebnistabelle in einem einzigen, lesbaren Ausdruck zu definieren. `GROUP SIZE` ist eine spezielle Variable, die die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe zurückgibt, was hier für die Zählung verwendet wird.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, COUNT, Aggregation

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit den meisten freien Sitzen für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflights` unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `MAX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY ...` und innerhalb der Gruppe den `MAX`-Operator, um den gewünschten Flug zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_best_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_best_flight.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_best_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_best_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_best_flight_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_best_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_best_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_best_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_best_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                                LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                  connid = REDUCE sflight-connid(
                                             INIT best_connid = ''
                                                  max_free_seats = -1
                                             FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                             LET current_free_seats = member-seatsmax - member-seatsocc IN
                                             NEXT best_connid = COND #( WHEN current_free_seats > max_free_seats THEN member-connid ELSE best_connid )
                                                  max_free_seats = COND #( WHEN current_free_seats > max_free_seats THEN current_free_seats ELSE max_free_seats ) )
                                  free_seats = REDUCE i(
                                             INIT max_free_seats = -1
                                             FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                             LET current_free_seats = member-seatsmax - member-seatsocc IN
                                             NEXT max_free_seats = COND #( WHEN current_free_seats > max_free_seats THEN current_free_seats ELSE max_free_seats ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_max_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_max_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_max( ).
    DATA(lt_best_flights) = lo_cut->get_best_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_best_flights ).

    " Example: Check for 'LH' entry and its free seats
    READ TABLE lt_best_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_best_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_best_flight-free_seats >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_best_flight-connid ).
    ENDIF.

    " More robust test would involve comparing with manually calculated max for a specific carrier
    DATA: lv_max_free_seats_lh TYPE i VALUE -1.
    DATA: lv_best_connid_lh TYPE sflight-connid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) AS free_seats
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      ORDER BY free_seats DESCENDING
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO ( @DATA(lv_carrid_tmp), @lv_best_connid_lh, @lv_max_free_seats_lh ).
    ENDSELECT.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE lt_best_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO ls_lh_best_flight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_best_flight-free_seats exp = lv_max_free_seats_lh ).
        " Note: If multiple flights have the same max free seats, connid might differ, so only check free_seats
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY ...` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator innerhalb der Gruppe, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. Für jede Gruppe (Fluggesellschaft) wird der `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um den Flug mit den meisten freien Sitzen zu finden. Dies ist ein sehr fortgeschrittener und funktionaler Ansatz, der die Datenverarbeitung in internen Tabellen extrem flexibel und ausdrucksstark macht, ohne explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen auf Gruppenebene.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, MAX, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Anzahl der Felder einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data()` und die Methode `get_components()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_count
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_count.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
        rv_count = lines( lt_components ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        rv_count = 0. " Not a structure or error in RTTI
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_field_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_field_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_count( ).

    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lv_sflight_fields) = lo_cut->get_field_count( REF #( ls_sflight ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sflight_fields exp = 17 ). " SFLIGHT has 17 fields

    DATA: lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_string_fields) = lo_cut->get_field_count( REF #( lv_string ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_fields exp = 0 ). " String is not a structure

    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_struct,
            field1 TYPE i,
            field2 TYPE string,
          END OF ls_test_struct.
    DATA(lv_test_struct_fields) = lo_cut->get_field_count( REF #( ls_test_struct ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_test_struct_fields exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Typinformationen von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit dynamisch abzufragen. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref()` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components()` ist der moderne Weg, um die Struktur und die Anzahl der Felder einer beliebigen Struktur zu ermitteln. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Programme und Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, Dynamic Programming, Type Information, COUNT

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_adj_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    rt_output = it_input.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_output COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_adj_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_adj_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_adj_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. `COMPARING ALL FIELDS` stellt sicher, dass alle Felder der Zeilen für den Vergleich herangezogen werden.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, Data Cleansing

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist und deren Flugnummer kleiner als '0400' ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights.

CLASS zcl_while_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_while_simple IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen aus einem String, ohne die eingebauten Funktionen `CONDENSE` oder `STRIP` zu verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und String-Offsets.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_trim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_trim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).

    " Remove leading spaces
    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length AND iv_input+lv_offset(1) = ` `.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove trailing spaces
    WHILE lv_length > lv_offset AND iv_input+lv_length-1(1) = ` `.
      lv_length = lv_length - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_length > lv_offset.
      rv_output = iv_input+lv_offset(lv_length - lv_offset).
    ELSE.
      rv_output = ``.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Stack-Funktionalität (LIFO) für Strings unter Verwendung einer internen Tabelle und `WHILE` für die Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND` und `DELETE INDEX` für Push/Pop und eine `WHILE`-Schleife zum Leeren des Stacks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_stack DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_stack_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS push
      IMPORTING
        iv_item TYPE string.

    METHODS pop
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_item) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

    METHODS is_empty
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_empty) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS process_all_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_stack TYPE ty_stack_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_stack IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD push.
    APPEND iv_item TO mt_stack.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pop.
    IF is_empty( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
    READ TABLE mt_stack INDEX lines( mt_stack ) INTO rv_item.
    DELETE TABLE mt_stack INDEX lines( mt_stack ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_empty.
    rv_empty = xsdbool( lines( mt_stack ) = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_all_items.
    DATA lv_item TYPE string.
    WHILE NOT is_empty( ).
      TRY.
          lv_item = pop( ).
          APPEND lv_item TO rt_processed_items.
        CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
          " Should not happen if is_empty is checked
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_stack) = NEW zcl_while_stack( ).
    lo_stack->push( 'First' ).
    lo_stack->push( 'Second' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_stack->pop( ) exp = 'First' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_stack->is_empty( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_stack.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed exp = lt_expected ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_stack->is_empty( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_stack) = NEW zcl_while_stack( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung einer Stack-Datenstruktur (Last-In, First-Out) unter Verwendung einer internen Tabelle. Die `WHILE`-Schleife in `process_all_items` wird verwendet, um alle Elemente vom Stack zu entnehmen, bis dieser leer ist. `APPEND` fügt Elemente hinzu, während `READ TABLE ... INDEX lines( mt_stack )` und `DELETE TABLE ... INDEX lines( mt_stack )` das oberste Element entnehmen.

hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` mit `CONTINUE` und `EXIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_control_flow DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_control_flow IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( it_numbers ).
    DATA lv_current_number TYPE i.

    WHILE lv_index <= lv_max_index.
      READ TABLE it_numbers INDEX lv_index INTO lv_current_number.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Should not happen if lv_index is controlled correctly
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_number < 0.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        CONTINUE. " Skip negative numbers
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_number > 100.
        EXIT. " Stop processing if number > 100
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_current_number TO rt_processed_numbers.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Initialisieren Sie ein Ergebnis mit 1 und multiplizieren Sie es in der Schleife herunter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 1.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
