Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Ziffern aus einem String und geben Sie sie als einen neuen String zurück, wobei Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwenden.
hint: Iterieren Sie mit `WHILE` über den String und prüfen Sie jedes Zeichen mit `IS DIGIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_extract_digits DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_digits
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_digits) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_extract_digits IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_digits.
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    DATA lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    WHILE lv_index < lv_length.
      lv_char = iv_input+lv_index(1).
      IF lv_char CA '0123456789'. " Check if character is a digit
        rv_digits = rv_digits && lv_char.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie die größte gemeinsame Teiler (ggT) von zwei positiven ganzen Zahlen mit dem Euklidischen Algorithmus, implementiert mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Der Euklidische Algorithmus verwendet wiederholte Modulo-Operationen in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_gcd DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_gcd
      IMPORTING
        iv_a TYPE i
        iv_b TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_gcd) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_gcd IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_gcd.
    IF iv_a <= 0 OR iv_b <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_a) = iv_a.
    DATA(lv_b) = iv_b.
    DATA lv_remainder TYPE i.

    WHILE lv_b <> 0.
      lv_remainder = lv_a MOD lv_b.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_remainder.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_gcd = lv_a.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Mindestpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(wa) WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '500' ).

    " Assert that some flights are returned (assuming LH has flights > 500)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'No flights found for LH > 500'
      compress = abap_true
      reverse = abap_true ).

    " Assert that all returned flights match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-price >= 500 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(wa)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Arbeitsstruktur, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Die `WHERE`-Klausel im `LOOP` filtert die Einträge direkt während der Iteration, was effizienter ist als ein nachträgliches `IF`.
keywords: LOOP, WHERE, Inline Declaration, Internal Table, Filtering

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group) = VALUE ty_flight_group( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_group TO rt_flight_groups.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = lines( lt_result )

      compress = abap_true

    " Assert specific group counts if known, or just check structure
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.

    ENDIF.

explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Klausel in `LOOP AT` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht eine elegante und performante Gruppierung von Daten direkt während der Iteration. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. Dies ersetzt manuelle Schleifen und Hilfstabellen für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern von Flügen enthält, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden und deren Preis unter einem bestimmten Wert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR` Expression mit `WHERE` und `( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                              WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price < iv_max_price )
                              ( ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

      msg = 'No filtered connids found for AA < 300'

      reverse = abap_true ).

    " Assert that a specific connid might be present if known
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = '0017' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der `FOR`-Expression filtert die Einträge, und die Klammern `( ... )` definieren, welche Felder in die neue Tabelle übernommen werden sollen. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und lesbare Art, Tabellen zu transformieren.
keywords: FOR, Filtering, Mapping, Internal Table, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    " Assert that the total price is greater than 0 for existing carriers
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_price_lh > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_price_aa > 0 ).

    " Assert that for a non-existent carrier, the price is 0
    DATA(lv_total_price_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_xx exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) ist ideal für Aggregationsaufgaben. Sie ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem sie über die Einträge iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable (`sum_price`) aktualisiert. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von `sflights` nach `carrid` und `connid` und füllen Sie diese.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Tabelle als `SORTED TABLE` mit `WITH UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS create_sorted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    " Populate the sorted table. Entries are automatically sorted and duplicates checked.
    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->create_sorted_flights( ).

    " Assert that the table is not empty
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Sorted table is empty'
      compress = abap_true
      reverse = abap_true ).

    " Assert that the table is indeed sorted by the key
    DATA: lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
          lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ( ls_flight-carrid > lv_prev_carrid OR
                  ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid > lv_prev_connid ) )
          msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `SORTED TABLE` (ABAP 7.40+) hält ihre Einträge immer nach dem definierten Schlüssel sortiert. Beim Einfügen (`INSERT`) oder Zuweisen (`VALUE #(...)`) werden die Einträge automatisch an der korrekten Position eingefügt. Dies gewährleistet eine hohe Performance bei Lesezugriffen über den Schlüssel. `WITH UNIQUE KEY` stellt zudem sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge existieren.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Table, Unique Key, Performance, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Flug aus der sortierten Tabelle basierend auf `carrid` und `connid`.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_flight.
    DATA(lo_create_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ). " Re-use creation logic
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_create_cut->create_sorted_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_read_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).

    " Test existing flight
    DATA(ls_flight_found) = lo_read_cut->get_flight_details(
                               it_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights
                               iv_carrid = 'AA'
                               iv_connid = '0017' ). " Assuming this flight exists in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_found-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_found-connid exp = '0017' ).

    " Test non-existing flight
    DATA(ls_flight_not_found) = lo_read_cut->get_flight_details(
                                   it_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights
                                   iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                   iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight_not_found-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight_not_found-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Das Lesen aus einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` ist extrem performant, da ABAP einen binären Suchalgorithmus verwendet. Dies ist die effizienteste Methode, um auf einzelne Einträge in einer sortierten Tabelle zuzugreifen, da die Sortierung bereits durch die Tabellendefinition gewährleistet ist.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, Table Key, Performance, Binary Search, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Ändern Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges in einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS modify_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid         TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price      TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_sorted_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_flight.
    DATA(lo_create_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_create_cut->create_sorted_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_modify_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_old_price) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '999.99'.

    " Find an existing flight to modify
    READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_orig) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_old_price = ls_flight_orig-price.

      lo_modify_cut->modify_flight_price(
        EXPORTING
          iv_carrid         = ls_flight_orig-carrid
          iv_connid         = ls_flight_orig-connid
          iv_new_price      = lv_new_price
        CHANGING
          ct_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights ).

      READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_modified)
        WITH TABLE KEY carrid = ls_flight_orig-carrid connid = ls_flight_orig-connid.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_modified-price exp = lv_new_price ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_flight_modified-price exp = lv_old_price ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Could not find a flight to test modification.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Modifizieren von Einträgen in einer `SORTED TABLE` erfolgt am effizientesten über ein Field-Symbol, das mit `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ermittelt wird. Änderungen am Field-Symbol wirken sich direkt auf den Tabelleneintrag aus. Alternativ kann `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` verwendet werden, was jedoch bei sortierten Tabellen weniger performant sein kann, wenn der Schlüssel nicht vollständig angegeben wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, Field-Symbol, Performance, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine sortierte Tabelle von Flügen und geben Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Zusammenfassung aus.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle und verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_control_break DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_control_break IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lv_current_total_price TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA: lv_current_flight_count TYPE i.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      AT NEW carrid.
        lv_current_total_price = 0.
        lv_current_flight_count = 0.
      ENDAT.

      lv_current_total_price = lv_current_total_price + ls_flight-price.
      lv_current_flight_count = lv_current_flight_count + 1.

      AT END OF carrid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
          carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
          total_flights = lv_current_flight_count
          total_price   = lv_current_total_price
        ) TO rt_summaries.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_control_break( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'No carrier summaries found'
      compress = abap_true
      reverse = abap_true ).

    " Check if summary for 'LH' exists and has positive values
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary_lh-total_flights > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary_lh-total_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `AT NEW` und `AT END OF` Kontrollstrukturen innerhalb einer `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglichen die Verarbeitung von Datenblöcken, die nach bestimmten Feldern gruppiert sind. Voraussetzung ist, dass die interne Tabelle zuvor nach diesen Feldern sortiert wurde. Dies ist eine klassische, aber immer noch effiziente Methode zur Erstellung von Zwischensummen oder Gruppenübersichten.
keywords: LOOP, AT NEW, AT END OF, Control Break, Internal Table, Grouping, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` mit zusätzlichen Informationen aus einer sortierten Hilfstabelle (z.B. Fluggesellschaftsnamen) kombiniert.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` für den Lookup innerhalb einer `FOR` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_text,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_text.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_text_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_text WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE tt_flight_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lt_carrier_texts TYPE tt_carrier_text_sorted.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_carrier_texts.

    rt_flights_with_name = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    LET ls_carrier_text = lt_carrier_texts[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] IN
                                    ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      carrname = ls_carrier_text-carrname,
                                      connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                      fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                      price    = ls_flight-price,
                                      currency = ls_flight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Kombination einer `FOR`-Expression mit einer `SORTED TABLE` für Lookups (ABAP 7.50+) ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Technik. Durch die `LET`-Anweisung kann ein temporäres Arbeitsfeld für den Lookup definiert werden. Der Zugriff auf die `SORTED TABLE` über den Schlüssel ist extrem schnell, was diese Methode ideal für das Anreichern von Daten aus anderen Tabellen macht, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `READ TABLE` Anweisungen zu benötigen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, Lookup, Performance, Internal Table, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, dessen Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, und geben Sie dessen Flugnummer zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_find_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_first_expensive_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_find_first IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_expensive_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_price_threshold.
      rv_connid = ls_flight-connid.
      EXIT. " Found the first one, exit loop
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_first_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_first_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_find_first( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has flights with price > 500, and '0400' is one of them
    DATA(lv_connid_found) = lo_cut->find_first_expensive_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price_threshold = '500' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_connid_found ).

    " Test for a carrier/price combination that should not exist
    DATA(lv_connid_not_found) = lo_cut->find_first_expensive_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_price_threshold = '1000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_connid_not_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Suchen des ersten passenden Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle kann effizient mit `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` und einer `EXIT`-Anweisung erfolgen. Sobald der erste Treffer gefunden wurde, wird die Schleife beendet, was unnötige Iterationen vermeidet. Dies ist eine einfache und effektive Methode, um den ersten passenden Eintrag zu finden.
keywords: LOOP, WHERE, EXIT, Internal Table, Search, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

        iv_connid         TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_exists)  TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rb_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( it_sorted_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_create_cut->create_sorted_flights( ).

    DATA(lo_exists_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_exists( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Da der Zugriff über den Schlüssel erfolgt, wird eine binäre Suche verwendet, die sehr performant ist. Es wird kein Arbeitsbereich benötigt, und der Code ist sehr prägnant.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften enthält, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `COND`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                          WHERE ( GROUP SIZE > iv_min_flights )
                          ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carriers_with_many_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_filter( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and 'AA' have more than 10 flights
    DATA(lt_result_many) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_many_flights( iv_min_flights = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result_many )
      msg = 'No carriers with many flights found'
      compress = abap_true
      reverse = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result_many[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result_many[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) ).

    " Test with a very high threshold, expecting no results
    DATA(lt_result_few) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_many_flights( iv_min_flights = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result_few ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ... WHERE ...` Expression (ABAP 7.50+) ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu gruppieren und gleichzeitig zu filtern. Sie ermöglicht es, Gruppen basierend auf Aggregationskriterien (`GROUP SIZE`) zu filtern und dann die Schlüssel der verbleibenden Gruppen in eine neue Tabelle zu mappen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Alternative zu komplexen `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Konstrukten mit nachfolgender Filterung.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Filtering, Internal Table, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_filter_004 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency,

           END OF ty_currency.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_filter_007 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS lc_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_filter_007 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = lc_carrid )

  ENDMETHOD.

    CONSTANTS lc_min_free_seats TYPE s_seatsocc VALUE 50.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE sflight_tab.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_filter_008 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_many_free_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsocc < ( lt_all_flights[1]-seatsmax - lc_min_free_seats ) ). " Annahme: seatsmax ist für alle Flüge gleich oder ähnlich
    " Besser wäre: WHERE seatsmax - seatsocc > lc_min_free_seats
    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > lc_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Flügen, die mehr als 200 freie Sitze haben, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, belegten Sitzen, maximalen Sitzen und freien Sitzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i DEFAULT 200
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc > iv_min_free_seats )
                          ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                            connid    = flight-connid
                            seatsocc  = flight-seatsocc
                            seatsmax  = flight-seatsmax
                            seatsfree = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 200 ).

    " Assert that all returned flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsfree > 200 )
        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } has { ls_flight-seatsfree } free seats, expected > 200.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that if flights with >200 free seats exist, some are returned
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 200 INTO DATA(lv_count_db).
    IF lv_count_db > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found with >200 free seats, but they exist in DB' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukte.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Declarative

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_op( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'. " Lufthansa

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( lv_carrier ).

    " Assert that all returned flights belong to the specified carrier
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = lv_carrier
        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } does not match carrier { lv_carrier }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that if LH flights exist, some are returned
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrier INTO DATA(lv_count_db).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count_db msg = 'Number of filtered flights does not match DB count' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_op( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'XX'. " Non-existent carrier

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'No flights should be returned for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine prägnante und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist optimiert für die Performance und verbessert die Lesbarkeit im Vergleich zu manuellen `LOOP` Anweisungen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Tabelle von Strings in einen einzelnen, durch Kommas getrennten String, wobei jeder String in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `CONCAT_LINES_OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS join_and_upper
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_and_upper.
    rv_result_string = CONCAT_LINES_OF(
                              VALUE string_table( FOR text IN it_strings ( to_upper( text ) ) )
                              SEPARATED BY ',' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_and_upper FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_element FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_and_upper.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_join( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'hello' ) ( 'world' ) ( 'abap' ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = 'HELLO,WORLD,ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->join_and_upper( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Incorrect string join and upper' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_join( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_expected) = ''.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->join_and_upper( lt_input ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` eine Zeile enthält, die die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den prozentualen Anteil der belegten Sitze anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und berechnen Sie den Prozentsatz direkt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             occupancy_pct TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            WHERE ( flight-seatsmax > 0 ) " Avoid division by zero
                            ( carrid        = flight-carrid
                              connid        = flight-connid
                              occupancy_pct = ( CONV decfloat34( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flights_with_zero_seatsmax_skipped FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy( ).

    " Assert that results are returned if sflights has data with seatsmax > 0
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE seatsmax > 0 INTO DATA(lv_expected_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Number of occupancy entries does not match expected count' ).

    " Check general range for percentages
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_occupancy).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_occupancy-occupancy_pct >= 0 AND ls_occupancy-occupancy_pct <= 100 )
        msg = |Occupancy percentage { ls_occupancy-occupancy_pct } out of range for { ls_occupancy-carrid } { ls_occupancy-connid }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flights_with_zero_seatsmax_skipped.
    " This test verifies that flights with seatsmax = 0 are correctly skipped by the WHERE clause.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy( ).

    " Count flights in sflights where seatsmax is 0
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE seatsmax = 0 INTO DATA(lv_zero_seatsmax_count).

    " Count all flights in sflights
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_total_flights).

    " The number of results should be total flights minus those with seatsmax = 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = lv_total_flights - lv_zero_seatsmax_count
      msg = 'Flights with seatsmax = 0 were not correctly skipped.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )` ermöglicht eine elegante und effiziente Transformation von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle mit einer neuen Struktur und berechneten Feldern. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für deklarative Programmierung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Data Transformation, Internal Tables, Calculations

CLASS zcl_json_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD serialize_flight_data.
    TRY.
        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = is_flight_data pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_serialize_flight.

Die Methode `serialize` ist einfach zu verwenden und unterstützt Optionen wie `pretty_print` für bessere Lesbarkeit. Dies ist der bevorzugte Weg für JSON-Operationen in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, filtern Sie diese nach einer Fluggesellschaft und serialisieren Sie die gefilterten Daten als JSON-Array von Objekten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filter_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_as_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        /ui2/cl_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_as_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_data(
                                   lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                   WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_filtered_flights pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_serialize FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_filter_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'AA'. " American Airlines

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_as_json( lv_carrier ).

    " Assert that the JSON is a valid array and contains expected carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '[' act = lv_json msg = 'JSON is not an array' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = ']' act = lv_json msg = 'JSON is not an array' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '"CARRID": "AA"' act = lv_json msg = 'Filtered carrier not found in JSON' ).

    " Verify the number of entries
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrier INTO DATA(lv_expected_count).
    DATA(lt_check_table) = VALUE zcl_json_filter_serialize=>tt_flight_data( ).
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json CHANGING data = lt_check_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_table ) exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Number of JSON objects does not match filtered count' ).

    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'ZZ'. " Non-existent carrier

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = '[]' msg = 'Empty filter result should serialize to empty JSON array' ).

Die gefilterte interne Tabelle wird direkt an `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize` übergeben, die sie automatisch in ein JSON-Array von Objekten umwandelt. Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen ungültigen JSON-String zu deserialisieren und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit der Ausnahme `/ui2/cl_json_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_json_format.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                   CHANGING  data = rs_data ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Log the error or handle it as needed
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING invalid_json_format.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Valid JSON deserialization failed for field2' ).

    ).

  METHOD test_empty_json_string.

explanation: Die explizite Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen der Klasse `/ui2/cl_json_error` ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen, die mit externen JSON-Daten interagieren. Dies ermöglicht es, ungültige Eingaben abzufangen und angemessen darauf zu reagieren, anstatt einen Programmabbruch zu verursachen. Das Auslösen einer eigenen Ausnahme (`invalid_json_format`) kapselt die technische JSON-Fehlerursache.

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne und bevorzugte Methode zur String-Verkettung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen die einfache Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken direkt in den String, was den Code wesentlich lesbarer und wartbarer macht als die Verwendung von `CONCATENATE` oder dem `&`-Operator. Formatierungsoptionen wie `DATE = USER` verbessern die Benutzerfreundlichkeit.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, Concatenation, Readability

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Schnittstelle mit einer Standardimplementierung für eine Methode, die von implementierenden Klassen überschrieben werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES ... DEFAULT METHODS` und `REDEFINITION`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.

  METHODS log_error
    IMPORTING
      iv_error_message TYPE string.

  " Default implementation for log_error
  CLASS METHODS class_constructor.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zif_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message.
    " Default implementation: write to system log
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Default Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_error.
    " Default implementation: write to system log with error prefix
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Default ERROR: { iv_error_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD class_constructor.
    " No specific class constructor logic needed for this example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Custom implementation: write to a simulated file
    cl_demo_output=>display( |File Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  " log_error uses default implementation from interface
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_implementation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_custom_implementation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_implementation.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'This is an error message'.

    " Capture output of cl_demo_output (requires test double or specific setup)
    " For simplicity, we'll assert that the method can be called without dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_does_not_raise(
      act = CLASS cx_root
      msg = 'Default log_error should not dump'
      ( lo_logger->zif_logger~log_error( lv_message ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_custom_implementation.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'This is a custom log message'.

    " Capture output of cl_demo_output (requires test double or specific setup)
    " For simplicity, we'll assert that the method can be called without dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_does_not_raise(
      act = CLASS cx_root
      msg = 'Custom log_message should not dump'
      ( lo_logger->zif_logger~log_message( lv_message ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Möglichkeit, Standardimplementierungen für Interface-Methoden zu definieren (`DEFAULT METHODS`), ist ein mächtiges Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.50). Es reduziert den Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen, da nur Methoden überschrieben werden müssen, die eine spezifische Logik erfordern. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und vereinfacht die Wartung von Interfaces.
keywords: Interfaces, Default Methods, Object Orientation, Redefinition, Code Reusability

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `ADD_DAYS` der Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_days_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    rv_future_date = lv_current_date + iv_days_to_add.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die direkte Datumsarithmetik (`d + n`) ist eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, Datumsberechnungen in ABAP durchzuführen. Sie ist seit ABAP 7.40 verfügbar und macht die Verwendung komplexerer Funktionsbausteine oder Klassen für grundlegende Additionen/Subtraktionen von Tagen überflüssig. Dies führt zu kürzerem und verständlicherem Code.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_seat_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_seat_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats_for_carrier) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                  FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                       total_seats = lv_total_seats_for_carrier ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_aggregate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_aggregate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_seat_summary( ).

    " Assert that results are returned if sflights has data
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_expected_groups).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = lv_expected_groups msg = 'Number of carrier groups does not match expected' ).

    " Verify aggregation for a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH')
    DATA(lv_test_carrier) = 'LH'.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_test_carrier INTO DATA(lv_expected_lh_sum).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = lv_test_carrier.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats exp = lv_expected_lh_sum msg = 'Total seats for LH is incorrect' ).
    ELSE.
      " If LH is not in sflights, this is fine, but if it is, we should find it.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_test_carrier INTO DATA(lv_lh_flights_exist).
      IF lv_lh_flights_exist > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Carrier { lv_test_carrier } not found in summary, but exists in sflights.| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflights.
    " This test would ideally mock sflights to be empty.
    " For now, we assume sflights is not empty, but if it were, the result should be empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_seat_summary( ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_total_flights).
    IF lv_total_flights = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) msg = 'Empty sflights should result in empty summary' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Operator innerhalb der Gruppenschleife ermöglicht dies komplexe Aggregationen pro Gruppe in einer sehr deklarativen und effizienten Weise, die traditionelle Ansätze mit temporären Tabellen oder Hashes übertrifft.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

Instructions: Erstellen und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` um die Tabelle zu konstruieren und zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid    = flight-carrid
        connid    = flight-connid
        fldate    = flight-fldate
        planetype = flight-planetype ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'All entries should be LH' 
                                        act = lines( lt_flights )
                                        exp = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( flight ) ) ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Füllung einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... APPEND` Konstrukte.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, sflights, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` in eine neue Tabelle, die nur `carrid`, `connid` und `price` enthält, wobei der Preis um 10% erhöht wird. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )` und berechnen Sie den neuen Preis direkt im Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flight_prices.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        price  = flight-price * '1.10' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flight_prices( it_flights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of lines mismatch' act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH price mismatch' act = ls_flight1-price exp = '110.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA price mismatch' act = ls_flight2-price exp = '220.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Jede Zeile der Quelltabelle wird verarbeitet und in ein neues Format in der Zieltabelle überführt, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE type( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )` um die Summe zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN sflights
      NEXT total = total + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_total.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total passengers mismatch' act = lv_total exp = lv_expected_total ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen und verbessert die Funktionalität und Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: REDUCE, VALUE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`UA`) und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FILTER ... WHERE ( ... ) )` um die Tabelle zu filaptern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
        WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats )
      ( carrid = carrid
        connid = connid
        seatsocc = seatsocc
        seatsmax = seatsmax ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_min_free_seats = 50
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Not enough free seats' act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 50 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= 50
      INTO lv_expected_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered count mismatch' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` bietet eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Dies ist eine deklarative Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... DELETE` oder `LOOP AT ... INTO ... IF ... ENDIF`.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seiner `connid` einen Status-Text zu. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE type( SWITCH ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_value_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_value_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status_text = VALUE string(
      SWITCH iv_connid
        WHEN '0017' THEN 'New York Flight'
        WHEN '0400' THEN 'Frankfurt Flight'
        WHEN '0001' THEN 'Local Shuttle'
        ELSE 'Unknown Destination'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_value_switch( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status for 0017 mismatch' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( '0017' ) exp = 'New York Flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status for 0400 mismatch' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( '0400' ) exp = 'Frankfurt Flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status for 0001 mismatch' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( '0001' ) exp = 'Local Shuttle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status for unknown mismatch' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( '9999' ) exp = 'Unknown Destination' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator, verwendet mit `VALUE`, ermöglicht eine prägnante und ausdrucksstarke Implementierung von bedingten Zuweisungen. Er ersetzt längere `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` oder `CASE ... WHEN ... ENDCASE` Strukturen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei der Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen.
keywords: SWITCH, VALUE, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seiner Auslastung (`seatsocc` im Verhältnis zu `seatsmax`) einen Status-Text zu (z.B. 'Full', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'). Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE type( COND ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_value_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_occupancy_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_value_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percentage) = COND decfloat34(
      WHEN iv_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( iv_seatsocc / iv_seatsmax ) * 100
      ELSE 0
    ).

    rv_status_text = VALUE string(
      COND #(
        WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 90 THEN 'Full'
        WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 70 THEN 'High Occupancy'
        WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 40 THEN 'Medium Occupancy'
        ELSE 'Low Occupancy'
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine einfache Struktur (z.B. Flugschlüssel) in ein 'Tiny Data'-Format und deserialisieren Sie diese zurück unter Verwendung der Klasse `/UI2/BASIS_TINY_DATA`.

CLASS zcl_ui2_tiny_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und gruppieren Sie diese nach `carrid` und `connid`. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_header,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_header.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_header TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group_header.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights BY ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ) 
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_group( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped table should not be empty' act = lt_grouped ).

    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights GROUP BY carrid, connid INTO lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of groups mismatch' act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = lv_expected_count ).

    DATA(lv_total_passengers_grouped) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR group_header IN lt_grouped NEXT s = s + group_header-total_passengers ).
    DATA(lv_total_passengers_sflights) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflights INTO lv_total_passengers_sflights.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total passengers sum mismatch' act = lv_total_passengers_grouped exp = lv_total_passengers_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen `LOOP AT ... AT NEW ... ENDAT` Konstrukten und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: GROUP BY, VALUE, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_itb_value_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
