Instructions: Parse eine XML-Zeichenkette und extrahiere den Wert eines bestimmten Knotens. Demonstriere dabei die Verwendung der iXML-Bibliothek und erwähne die Bedeutung von `cl_secxml_helper` für Sicherheitsprüfungen.
hint: Nutze `cl_xml_document` und `cl_ixml_parser`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser_secure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_extract
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_node_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser_secure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_extract.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory
                                              istream        = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ) ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    TRY.
        lo_parser->parse( ).
        " Hier könnte cl_secxml_helper für spezifische Sicherheitsprüfungen integriert werden,
        " z.B. zur Verhinderung von XXE-Angriffen oder zur Validierung gegen ein sicheres Schema.
        " Beispiel (konzeptionell):
        " DATA(lo_sec_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
        " lo_sec_helper->check_for_xxe( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_node_name ).
        IF lo_node_list IS BOUND AND lo_node_list->get_length( ) > 0.
          DATA(lo_node) = lo_node_list->get_item( 0 ).
          IF lo_node IS BOUND.
            rv_node_value = lo_node->get_first_child( )->get_value( ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_ixml_error INTO DATA(lx_ixml_error).
        " XML-Parsing-Fehler behandeln
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_abap_message_digest
            previous = lx_ixml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser_secure( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Value1</item><item>Value2</item></data>`. 
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->parse_and_extract( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Value1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser_secure( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Value1</item></data>`. 
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->parse_and_extract( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'nonexistent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser_secure( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Value1</item>`. "Malformed XML
    TRY.
        lo_cut->parse_and_extract( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_node_name = 'item' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest. " Catch the re-raised exception
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Test passed, exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die iXML-Bibliothek ist der Standard für die XML-Verarbeitung in ABAP. Die Verwendung von `DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance()` und `NEW` für Objekte ist moderner Stil. `TRY...CATCH` sorgt für robuste Fehlerbehandlung. `cl_secxml_helper` wird konzeptionell erwähnt, um die Notwendigkeit von Sicherheitsprüfungen bei der XML-Verarbeitung hervorzuheben.
keywords: XML, iXML, Parsing, Security, cl_secxml_helper, DATA, NEW, TRY-CATCH

Instructions: Führe eine XSLT-Transformation auf einer XML-Zeichenkette durch und übergebe dabei einen Parameter an das XSLT-Stylesheet. Dies kann zur Filterung oder zur sicheren Konfiguration der Transformation verwendet werden.
hint: Nutze `cl_xslt_processor` und `set_parameter`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xslt_transform_secure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xslt_string TYPE string
        iv_param_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xslt_transform_secure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).

    DATA(lo_source_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_source_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory
                                                     istream        = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ) ).
    lo_source_parser->set_document( lo_source_document ).
    lo_source_parser->parse( ).

    DATA(lo_xslt_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_xslt_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory
                                                   istream        = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xslt_string ) ).
    lo_xslt_parser->set_document( lo_xslt_document ).
    lo_xslt_parser->parse( ).

    DATA(lo_xslt_processor) = NEW cl_xslt_processor( ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_source_document( lo_source_document ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_stylesheet_document( lo_xslt_document ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_parameter( name = iv_param_name value = iv_param_value ).

    DATA(lo_result_stream) = lo_stream_factory->create_ostream_string( ).
    lo_xslt_processor->set_result_stream( lo_result_stream ).

    TRY.
        lo_xslt_processor->transform( ).
        rv_transformed_xml = lo_result_stream->get_string( ).
      CATCH cx_xslt_error INTO DATA(lx_xslt_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_abap_message_digest
            previous = lx_xslt_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_with_param FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xslt_transform_secure( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Hello</item></data>`. 
    DATA(lv_xslt) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <output><xsl:value-of select="/data/item"/></output>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>`. 
    DATA(lv_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_xml( iv_xml_string = lv_xml
                                                  iv_xslt_string = lv_xslt
                                                  iv_param_name = ''
                                                  iv_param_value = '' ).

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein XML-Dokument ein bestimmtes Element enthält und ob dessen Wert einem erwarteten Muster entspricht. Erwähne die Rolle von `cl_secxml_helper` bei der Validierung von XML-Strukturen gegen Sicherheitsrichtlinien.
hint: Nutze `cl_ixml_document` und `get_elements_by_tag_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_validator_secure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_element_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_element_name TYPE string
        iv_expected_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_validator_secure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_element_content.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory
                                              istream        = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ) ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    TRY.
        lo_parser->parse( ).
        " cl_secxml_helper könnte hier für komplexere Schema- oder Sicherheitspolitik-Validierungen verwendet werden
        " DATA(lo_sec_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
        " lo_sec_helper->validate_document_security( lo_document ). " Konzeptioneller Aufruf

        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_element_name ).
        IF lo_node_list IS BOUND AND lo_node_list->get_length( ) > 0.
          DATA(lo_node) = lo_node_list->get_item( 0 ).
          IF lo_node IS BOUND.
            DATA(lv_content) = lo_node->get_first_child( )->get_value( ).
            IF lv_content CP iv_expected_pattern. " CP für Mustervergleich
              rv_is_valid = abap_true.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_ixml_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entferne ein spezifisches, potenziell sensibles Element aus einer XML-Struktur, bevor diese weiterverarbeitet oder gespeichert wird.
hint: Nutze `cl_ixml_document` und `remove_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_manipulator_secure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_sensitive_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_node_to_remove TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_manipulator_secure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_sensitive_node.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml_factory=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory
                                              istream        = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ) ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    lo_parser->set_document( lo_document ).

    TRY.
        lo_parser->parse( ).
        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_node_to_remove ).
        IF lo_node_list IS BOUND.
          LOOP AT 0 UP TO lo_node_list->get_length( ) - 1 INTO DATA(idx).
            DATA(lo_node) = lo_node_list->get_item( idx ).
            IF lo_node IS BOUND.
              DATA(lo_parent) = lo_node->get_parent( ).
              IF lo_parent IS BOUND.
                lo_parent->remove_child( lo_node ).
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_renderer) = lo_ixml->create_renderer( ostream = lo_stream_factory->create_ostream_string( )
                                                      document = lo_document ).
        lo_renderer->render( ).
        rv_cleaned_xml = lo_renderer->get_ostream( )->get_string( ).

      CATCH cx_ixml_error INTO DATA(lx_ixml_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>cx_abap_message_digest
            previous = lx_ixml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere die Überprüfung einer XML-Signatur, um die Integrität eines XML-Dokuments zu gewährleisten. Erwähne, dass `cl_secxml_helper` für tatsächliche Signaturprüfungen verwendet werden kann.
hint: Fokus auf die konzeptionelle Logik, da echte Signaturprüfung komplex ist. Nutze `cl_secxml_helper` als Referenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_signature_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_xml_integrity
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_expected_hash TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_signature_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_xml_integrity.
    " In einer realen Anwendung würde hier cl_secxml_helper verwendet werden,
    " um eine digitale Signatur innerhalb des XML-Dokuments zu verifizieren.
    " Dies würde kryptographische Operationen und Zertifikatsprüfungen umfassen.
    " Beispiel (konzeptionell):
    " DATA(lo_sec_helper) = NEW cl_secxml_helper( ).
    " rv_is_valid = lo_sec_helper->verify_xml_signature( iv_xml_string ).

    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir eine Integritätsprüfung durch einen einfachen Hash-Vergleich
    " (nicht kryptographisch sicher für echte Signaturen, nur zur Demonstration des Konzepts).
    DATA(lv_calculated_hash) = cl_abap_message_digest=>calculate_hash_for_string(
                                  i_algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
                                  i_string    = iv_xml_string ).

    IF lv_calculated_hash = iv_expected_hash.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_is_valid ).

Instructions: Aggregiere Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft. Bereite diese Daten für eine Diagrammdarstellung vor.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG(price) AS average_price
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_summary).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN lt_raw_summary
                          ( carrid = <fs>-carrid
                            total_flights = <fs>-total_flights
                            average_price = <fs>-average_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung beim Versuch, eine `cl_gui_chart_engine_win`-Instanz zu erstellen, falls der GUI-Container ungültig ist.
hint: Nutze `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung bei der Objektinstanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_chart_engine_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart_engine) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win
      RAISING
        cx_gui_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_chart_engine_safely.
    TRY.
        IF iv_container IS NOT BOUND.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_gui_error=>cn_error_message
              message = 'GUI Container ist nicht gebunden.'.
        ENDIF.

        ro_chart_engine = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
                              parent = iv_container
                              lifetime = cl_gui_control=>lifetime_dynpro
                              no_autofree = abap_false ).

      CATCH cx_gui_error INTO DATA(lx_gui_error).
        " Fehler beim Erstellen des Chart-Engines oder ungültiger Container
        MESSAGE lx_gui_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_gui_error=>cn_error_message
            previous = lx_gui_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_error.

    ENDTRY.

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten, um flexible Datenstrukturen für Diagramme zu unterstützen.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für dynamische Typen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_chart_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_def.
    TYPES tt_column_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_column_definitions TYPE tt_column_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS add_row_to_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
        it_row_data TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_chart_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_column_definitions INTO DATA(ls_col_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_col_def-name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_col_def-type ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_row_to_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_row>   TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <ls_row> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_row> TO <ls_row>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    LOOP AT it_row_data INTO DATA(lv_value).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_index OF STRUCTURE <ls_row> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field> = lv_value.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    APPEND <ls_row> TO <lt_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Preise für Flüge aus `sflights` für jede Fluggesellschaft und speichere das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Nutze den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrid_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrid_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_sums) TYPE tt_carrid_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_carrid_sums = REDUCE tt_carrid_sum(
      INIT lt_result = VALUE tt_carrid_sum( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      " ( key = ls_flight-carrid )
      " ( total_price = SUM( ls_flight-price ) )
      " The above commented lines are for a direct group by and sum, but REDUCE is more flexible.
      NEXT lt_result = VALUE tt_carrid_sum(
                          BASE lt_result
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                                            INIT lv_sum = 0
                                            FOR <fs> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                            NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + <fs>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_sums) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sums ).
    " Überprüfe, ob die Summe für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft plausibel ist
    DATA(ls_aa_sum) = lt_sums[ carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT `carrid = '', total_price = 0` ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_sum-total_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_sum-total_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    " Für diesen Test müsste sflights leer sein oder gemockt werden.
    " Da sflights eine Standardtabelle ist, wird hier nur die Funktionalität bei leeren Eingaben geprüft.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_reduce( ).
    " Da die Methode direkt auf sflights zugreift, können wir hier keine leere Tabelle simulieren.
    " Der Test prüft, ob die Methode ohne Fehler läuft und ein Ergebnis liefert.
    DATA(lt_sums) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Test passed if no dump
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP (ab 7.50) zur Aggregation und Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ermöglicht er komplexe Gruppierungen und Summierungen auf eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Weise, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Bestimme basierend auf dem Preis eines Fluges aus `sflights`, ob es sich um einen 'günstigen', 'normalen' oder 'teuren' Flug handelt. Nutze den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_category,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price TYPE s_price,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                                        price = ls_flight-price
                                        category = COND string(
                                                     WHEN ls_flight-price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
                                                     WHEN ls_flight-price >= 200 AND ls_flight-price < 500 THEN 'Normal'
                                                     ELSE 'Teuer' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_highest_price_flight) TYPE ty_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    TRY.
        rs_highest_price_flight = lt_all_flights[ MAX of price ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Keine Flüge für die angegebene Fluggesellschaft gefunden
        CLEAR rs_highest_price_flight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `MAX OF <field>` innerhalb eines Tabellenausdrucks (ab ABAP 7.40, SP08) ermöglicht das direkte Auffinden der Zeile mit dem maximalen Wert eines bestimmten Feldes, ohne explizite Schleifen oder Sortierungen. `TRY...CATCH` wird verwendet, um den Fall abzufangen, dass keine passende Zeile gefunden wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, Tabellenausdrücke, MAX, DATA, NEW, TRY-CATCH, sflights

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                          ( carrid = to_lower( ls_sflight-carrid ),
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Nutzen Sie den Konstruktorausdruck `REDUCE #(...)` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ...` und einer Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sum_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming there are flights for 'LH' and prices are positive
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price should be greater than 0' act = lv_total_price > 0 ).

    " Test with a carrier that might not exist or has no flights
    DATA(lv_total_price_no_flights) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' act = lv_total_price_no_flights exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE #(...)` Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum_price`) und iteriert über die Tabelle (`FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`), wobei in jedem Schritt die Variable aktualisiert wird (`NEXT sum_price = ...`). Dies ersetzt eine explizite `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisung und ist deutlich lesbarer.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum, WHERE

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' durchgeführt werden und deren Flugpreis (PRICE) über 200 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Konstruktorausdruck `FILTER #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).

Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die den angegebenen Bedingungen entsprechen. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY primary_key` ist optional, kann aber die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die mit 'L' beginnen, als kommaseparierte Liste enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ...` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_string_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_list_as_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_string_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_list_as_string.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_carrier_list = |
      { REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
          WHERE ( carrid CP 'L*' )
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_sflight-carrid ELSE s && ', ' && ls_sflight-carrid ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_string_list( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_list_as_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result string should not be empty' act = lv_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result string should contain L-carriers' act = lv_result CP '*L*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result string should be comma-separated' act = lv_result CP '*, *' OR lv_result NP '*, *' AND lv_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit einem String Template, um eine dynamische, kommaseparierte Liste zu erstellen. Das `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` sorgt dafür, dass das Komma nur zwischen den Elementen hinzugefügt wird. String Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und flexible Art, Strings zu formatieren.
keywords: String Templates, REDUCE, FOR, COND, String Processing

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ...` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `REDUCE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  flight_count = GROUP SIZE,
                                  avg_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                            FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP
                                                            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_group_flight-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Grouped table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count should be positive' act = ls_group-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price should be positive' act = ls_group-avg_price > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for a specific carrier if known to exist
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flight count should be positive' act = ls_lh_group-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ...` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Aggregationen wie `GROUP SIZE` (Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe) direkt zu verwenden und komplexere Aggregationen wie den Durchschnittspreis mit `REDUCE` über die `GROUP` zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, REDUCE, VALUE

CLASS zcl_sflight_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_sflight_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

Er ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` und bietet zusätzliche Flexibilität durch explizites `MAPPING` oder `EXCEPT`.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Festwerte einer DDIC-Domäne (z.B. 'S_CARR_ID') mithilfe der Klasse `cl_reca_ddic_doma` aus. Da `cl_reca_ddic_doma` eine spezifische Klasse ist, wird hier eine simulierte Nutzung gezeigt, die auf dem erwarteten Muster für solche DDIC-Zugriffe basiert.
hint: Instanziieren Sie die Klasse `cl_reca_ddic_doma` und verwenden Sie eine Methode, um die Festwerte zu erhalten. Da die Klasse nicht öffentlich dokumentiert ist, wird ein generischer Ansatz für den Zugriff auf Domänenwerte verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_domain_value,
             domvalue_l TYPE dd07v-domvalue_l,
             ddtext     TYPE dd07v-ddtext,
           END OF ty_domain_value.
    TYPES tt_domain_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_domain_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_domain_fixed_values
      IMPORTING iv_domname TYPE dd07v-domname
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_domain_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_domain_fixed_values.
    " In a real scenario, you would instantiate cl_reca_ddic_doma
    " and call a method like get_fixed_values().
    " Example: DATA(lo_domain) = NEW cl_reca_ddic_doma( iv_domname ).
    "          rt_fixed_values = lo_domain->get_fixed_values().

    " For demonstration purposes, we simulate reading from DD07V directly
    " as cl_reca_ddic_doma is an internal class and its public API is not guaranteed.
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE rt_fixed_values
      WHERE domname = iv_domname
        AND ddlanguage = sy-langu
        AND as4local = 'A'. " Active version

    " Modern ABAP for filtering/transforming if needed after direct select
    rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_value IN rt_fixed_values
                                ( domvalue_l = ls_value-domvalue_l,
                                  ddtext     = ls_value-ddtext ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_domain_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_domain_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_domain_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = lo_cut->get_domain_fixed_values( 'S_CARR_ID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Domain values for S_CARR_ID should not be empty' act = lt_values IS INITIAL ).
    IF lines( lt_values ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First domain value should not be initial' act = lt_values[ 1 ]-domvalue_l ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_non_existent_domain) = lo_cut->get_domain_fixed_values( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent domain should return empty table' act = lt_non_existent_domain IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man Festwerte einer DDIC-Domäne abrufen könnte. Obwohl `cl_reca_ddic_doma` eine interne Klasse ist, folgt die simulierte Implementierung dem Muster, das man von einer solchen Utility-Klasse erwarten würde. Der `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` Ausdruck wird hier verwendet, um die gelesenen Daten in die Zielstruktur zu transformieren, was eine moderne und flexible Datenverarbeitung ermöglicht.
keywords: DDIC, Domain, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden, und erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (CARRID) und den Flugpreis (PRICE) der gefilterten Flüge enthält, wobei der Preis um 10% erhöht wird. CLASS zcl_sflight_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für jede Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ... IN ...` mit `REDUCE #(...)` und `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_flight.
    TYPES tt_max_price_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_max_price_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_max_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                               GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 connid = REDUCE s_conn_id(
                                            INIT max_connid = ''
                                            max_price = 0
                                            FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP
                                            NEXT max_connid = COND s_conn_id( WHEN ls_group_flight-price > max_price THEN ls_group_flight-connid ELSE max_connid ),
                                                 max_price = COND sflight-price( WHEN ls_group_flight-price > max_price THEN ls_group_flight-price ELSE max_price ) ),
                                 fldate = REDUCE s_date(
                                            INIT max_fldate = '00000000'
                                            max_price = 0
                                            FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP
                                            NEXT max_fldate = COND s_date( WHEN ls_group_flight-price > max_price THEN ls_group_flight-fldate ELSE max_fldate ),
                                                 max_price = COND sflight-price( WHEN ls_group_flight-price > max_price THEN ls_group_flight-price ELSE max_price ) ),
                                 max_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                               INIT max_price = 0
                                               FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP
                                               NEXT max_price = nmax( max_price, ls_group_flight-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_max_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Max price flights table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be positive' act = ls_flight-max_price > 0 ).
      " Further checks could involve comparing with direct SELECT MAX(PRICE) for a carrier
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die erweiterte `FOR GROUPS` Syntax in Kombination mit mehreren `REDUCE` Ausdrücken, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. Für jede Gruppe (Fluggesellschaft) wird der Flug mit dem höchsten Preis gefunden. Die Verwendung von `nmax` und `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, nicht nur den Maximalwert, sondern auch die zugehörigen Felder zu ermitteln. solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_exception_messages.
  INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message. " For behavior messages

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_exceptions. " This interface provides standard message handling
    INTERFACES zif_my_exception_messages. " Custom interface for specific messages

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        msgv1 TYPE sy-msgv OPTIONAL
        msgv2 TYPE sy-msgv OPTIONAL.

    DATA mv_msgv1 TYPE sy-msgv READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_msgv2 TYPE sy-msgv READ-ONLY.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_msgv1 = msgv1.
    me->mv_msgv2 = msgv2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS raise_custom_exception
      RAISING zcx_my_custom_exception.

      EXPORTING
        textid = zcx_my_custom_exception=>t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '002' )

        msgv2  = 'Detailinfo'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_exc_msg_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_helper) TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_msg_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    ro_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    TRY.
        IF iv_input < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_custom_exception
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_my_custom_exception=>t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '003' )
              msgv1  = |Input { iv_input }|
              msgv2  = 'Negativwert'.
        ENDIF.
        ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '004'
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgv1 = |Input { iv_input }|
        ).
      CATCH zcx_my_custom_exception INTO DATA(lx_custom).
        ro_message_helper->add_exception_message( lx_custom ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Ausnahmen auslösen kann, und fangen Sie diese in einem `CATCH` Block ab, der auf das Interface `IF_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS` prüft, um die Nachrichten zentral zu verwalten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_exc_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_scenario TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_helper) TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _raise_specific_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_scenario TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_my_custom_exception
        cx_sy_zerodivide. " Example of a standard exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_exc_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    ro_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    TRY.
        _raise_specific_exception( iv_scenario ).
        ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '004'
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgv1 = |Szenario { iv_scenario }|
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) TYPE if_abap_exceptions. " Catch any exception implementing IF_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS
        ro_message_helper->add_exception_message( lx_root ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx_root. " Fallback for exceptions not implementing IF_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS
        ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _raise_specific_exception.
    CASE iv_scenario.
      WHEN 1.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_custom_exception
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_my_custom_exception=>t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '003' )
            msgv1  = 'Szenario 1'
            msgv2  = 'Benutzerdefiniert'.
      WHEN 2.
        DATA(lv_result) = 10 / 0. " Will raise cx_sy_zerodivide
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " No exception, or another type
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_constants_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_msgid_app TYPE sy-msgid VALUE 'ZMSG',
      gc_msgno_info TYPE sy-msgno VALUE '006',
      gc_msgno_warn TYPE sy-msgno VALUE '007',

      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i

CLASS zcl_msg_constants_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_messages.
    ro_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_value = 0.
      ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
        i_msgid = gc_msgid_app
        i_msgno = gc_msgno_error
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgv1 = 'Wert ist Null'
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_value < 10.
      ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
        i_msgid = gc_msgid_app
        i_msgno = gc_msgno_warn
        i_msgty = 'W'
        i_msgv1 = |Wert { iv_value } ist klein|
      ).
    ELSE.
      ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
        i_msgid = gc_msgid_app
        i_msgno = gc_msgno_info
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgv1 = |Wert { iv_value } ist OK|
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslöst, und fangen Sie diese mit einem `CATCH` Block ab, der die Ausnahme direkt in eine `cl_message_helper` Instanz umwandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH ... INTO DATA(lx_exception)` und `cl_message_helper=>add_exception_message( lx_exception )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_to_msg_direct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_param TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_helper) TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _risky_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_param TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_my_custom_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_to_msg_direct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_risky_operation.
    ro_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    TRY.
        _risky_method( iv_param ).
        ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '004'
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgv1 = |Operation für { iv_param } erfolgreich|
        ).
      CATCH zcx_my_custom_exception INTO DATA(lx_custom_exc).
        ro_message_helper->add_exception_message( lx_custom_exc ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_exc).
        ro_message_helper->add_t100_message(
          i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = lx_root_exc->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _risky_method.
    IF iv_param < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_custom_exception
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_my_custom_exception=>t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '003' )
          msgv1  = |Parameter { iv_param }|
          msgv2  = 'Negativwert nicht erlaubt'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD trigger_critical_error.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

        i_msgno = '008'

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `MESSAGE` Anweisungen mit dem Zusatz `RAISING` in einer Methode, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen, die dann abgefangen werden kann.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MESSAGE ... RAISING cx_static_check` oder eine eigene Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_raising_exc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_my_custom_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_raising_exc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      MESSAGE ID 'ZMSG' TYPE 'E' NUMBER '003'
              WITH |Wert { iv_value }| 'Negativwert'
              RAISING zcx_my_custom_exception.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate successful processing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_raised FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_exception_raised FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_raised.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_raising_exc( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_value( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_my_custom_exception INTO DATA(lx_custom).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_custom->if_abap_exceptions~get_msgid( ) exp = 'ZMSG' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_custom->if_abap_exceptions~get_msgno( ) exp = '003' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_custom->mv_msgv1 exp = 'Wert -5' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Wrong exception type caught.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception_raised.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_raising_exc( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_value( 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No exception raised for valid input.' ).
      CATCH zcx_my_custom_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `RAISING`-Zusatz bei der `MESSAGE`-Anweisung ermöglicht es, eine Ausnahme auszulösen, anstatt das Programm direkt zu beenden oder eine Dialogmeldung anzuzeigen. Dies ist eine moderne Methode, um Fehler in Methoden zu signalisieren, die dann von aufrufendem Code abgefangen und behandelt werden können, was die Kontrolle über den Fehlerfluss verbessert. (Voraussetzung: Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG mit Nachricht 003 'Ungültiger Input: &1 ist ein &2' existiert und zcx_my_custom_exception ist definiert).
keywords: MESSAGE RAISING, Exception Handling, Error Handling, Control Flow

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten in ein CSV-Format als XSTRING, um sie als E-Mail-Anhang zu versenden. Die Spaltenüberschriften sollen ebenfalls enthalten sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_XSTRING` nach der Erzeugung des CSV-Strings. Die CSV-Erzeugung kann mit `REDUCE` und `String Templates` erfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = `Airline;Flugnr.;Datum;Preis;Währung` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lv_csv_rows) = REDUCE string(
      INIT csv_data = ``
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT csv_data = csv_data &&
        `"` && ls_sflight-carrid && `";"` && ls_sflight-connid && `";"` && ls_sflight-fldate && `";"` && ls_sflight-price && `";"` && ls_sflight-currency && `"` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_string) = lv_csv_header && lv_csv_rows.

    rv_csv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = lv_csv_string
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_xstring=>ty_sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_xstring=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_csv_string) = `Airline;Flugnr.;Datum;Preis;Währung` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && `"LH";"0400";"20251224";"123.45";"EUR"` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( iv_string = lv_expected_csv_string iv_codepage = '4103' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein Eingabeparameter einen ungültigen Wert hat. Die Ausnahme soll eine spezifische Fehlermeldung und den ungültigen Wert enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit einer selbstdefinierten Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und eine zusätzliche Attribut für den Fehlerwert besitzt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_input_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_input_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_input_value = iv_input_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          iv_input_value = iv_value
          textid         = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Further processing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_demo->process_value( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not raised for invalid input.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_invalid_input->mv_input_value
          exp = '-5'
          msg = 'Incorrect input value in exception'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_demo->process_value( 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( 'Valid input should not raise an exception.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception raised for valid input.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Definition und Verwendung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme (`zcx_invalid_input`), die von `cx_static_check` erbt. Die Methode `process_value` löst diese Ausnahme explizit mit `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` aus, wenn der Eingabewert ungültig ist. Dies ermöglicht eine präzise Fehlerbehandlung und eine klare Kommunikation von Fehlerzuständen.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Custom Exception, Exception Handling, Class, Object Orientation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft nicht existiert, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die den `THROW`-Ausdruck verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Tabellenverarbeitung und `THROW` innerhalb eines `COND` Ausdrucks, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_carrier_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL

    DATA mv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_carrier_id = iv_carrier_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        zcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Check if carrier exists using a functional expression with THROW
    DATA(lv_carrier_exists) = COND abap_bool(
        WHEN line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrier_id ] ) THEN abap_true
        ELSE THROW zcx_carrier_not_found(
                 textid = zcx_carrier_not_found=>default_text
                 iv_carrier_id = iv_carrier_id )
    ).

    " If carrier exists, filter the table
    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ). " Assuming 'AA' exists in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Should return flights for existing carrier'
      compress = abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_filter->get_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ). " Assuming 'XX' does not exist
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was not raised for non-existing carrier.' ).
      CATCH zcx_carrier_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_not_found->mv_carrier_id
          exp = 'XX'
          msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID in exception'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `THROW`-Ausdrucks innerhalb eines `COND`-Operators (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50), um eine Ausnahme auszulösen, wenn eine Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Fehlerbehandlung direkt in Ausdrücken, anstatt separate `IF`-Blöcke zu verwenden. Die `FILTER`-Anweisung wird ebenfalls für moderne Tabellenverarbeitung genutzt.

  ENDMETHOD.

" Define an assertion ID (e.g., Z_PRECONDITION_CHECK) in transaction SAAB
" and activate it for 'Break' or 'Log' for testing.
CLASS zcl_precondition_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_precondition_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_precondition.
    " Simulate a precondition: iv_data must not be empty
    IF iv_data IS INITIAL.
      ASSERT ID z_precondition_check FIELDS iv_data. " This will trigger an assertion
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assert
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assert=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Further processing if precondition is met
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_precondition_violation.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_precondition_checker( ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Assertion exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assert INTO DATA(lx_assert).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( 'Assertion exception raised successfully.' ).
        " You could further check lx_assert->get_text() for specific assertion details
    ENDTRY.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination von `ASSERT ID` mit `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assert`. `ASSERT ID` dient dazu, Vorbedingungen oder Annahmen im Code zu überprüfen. Wenn eine Assertion fehlschlägt, kann dies je nach Konfiguration zu einem Breakpoint, einem Log-Eintrag oder einem Shortdump führen. Hier wird zusätzlich eine `cx_sy_assert` Ausnahme ausgelöst, um die Fehlerbehandlung programmatisch zu steuern und den Fehlerfluss zu lenken.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Konvertieren Sie dabei das Feld `PRICE` (Typ `s_price`, CURR mit 2 Dezimalstellen) in einen `DECFLOAT34`-Typ für weitere Berechnungen, während Sie die Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle übertragen. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `CONV`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `CONV` für die Typumwandlung innerhalb des Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dec,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price_df TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_dec.
    TYPES tt_flights_dec TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_dec WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_dec_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_dec.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_dec_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flights_dec(
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid   = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
          price_df = CONV decfloat34( ls_sflight-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht, das `PRICE`-Feld vom Typ `s_price` (CURR) direkt in `DECFLOAT34` zu konvertieren, was für präzise finanzielle Berechnungen vorteilhaft ist. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Strings, die Zahlen darstellen, in eine Liste von Integer-Werten. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `CONV`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu aggregieren, und `CONV` für die Typumwandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_integers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_string_list_to_int
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE tt_integers
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_list_to_int.
    TRY.
        rt_integers = REDUCE tt_integers(
            INIT r = VALUE tt_integers( )
            FOR ls_string IN it_strings
            NEXT r = VALUE tt_integers( BASE r ( CONV i( ls_string ) ) )
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE zcl_conv_string_list=>tt_strings( ( '10' ) ( '20' ) ( '30' ) ).
    DATA(lt_integers) = lo_converter->convert_string_list_to_int( lt_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_integers[ 1 ] exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_integers[ 3 ] exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_list_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_string_list( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE zcl_conv_string_list=>tt_strings( ( '10' ) ( 'abc' ) ( '30' ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_converter->convert_string_list_to_int( lt_strings ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Conversion error exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( 'Conversion error exception raised successfully.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_string_list( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE zcl_conv_string_list=>tt_strings( ).
    DATA(lt_integers) = lo_converter->convert_string_list_to_int( lt_strings ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) in Kombination mit `CONV`, um eine Liste von Strings in eine Liste von Integern zu transformieren. `REDUCE` ist eine funktionale Art, eine neue Tabelle zu aggregieren, indem es über die Elemente einer Quelltabelle iteriert und dabei `CONV` für die Typumwandlung jedes Elements verwendet. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` stellt sicher, dass ungültige String-Eingaben abgefangen werden.
keywords: CONV, REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Processing, Type Conversion, Functional Programming, Exception Handling

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in einen Integer. Wenn der String nicht in einen Integer konvertiert werden kann, soll ein Standardwert (0) zurückgegeben werden, ohne eine Ausnahme auszulösen. Verwenden Sie `CONV` mit `COND` und `THROW`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` mit einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block und `THROW` innerhalb des `CATCH`-Blocks, um den Fehler abzufangen und einen Standardwert zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_safe_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_int_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_safe_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int_safe.
    rv_integer = COND i(
        TRY
            THEN CONV i( iv_string )
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error
            THEN 0 " Return default value on error
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
