explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Fehlerbehandlung bei Typumwandlungen. Der `COND`-Operator wird verwendet, um bedingt einen Wert zuzuweisen. Innerhalb des `COND` wird ein `TRY...CATCH`-Block eingesetzt. Wenn `CONV i(iv_string)` eine `cx_sy_conversion_error` auslöst, wird der `CATCH`-Zweig ausgeführt, der einen Standardwert (0) zurückgibt, anstatt die Ausnahme weiterzuleiten. Dies ist eine elegante Lösung für 'safe conversion' ohne explizite `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: CONV, COND, THROW, Exception Handling, String, Integer, Functional Programming, Safe Conversion

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode einer anderen Klasse aufruft. Wenn die aufgerufene Methode eine Ausnahme auslöst, soll diese abgefangen und eine generische Ausnahme mit Details zur ursprünglichen Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Zusätzen und `CATCH OTHERS` für die Ausnahmebehandlung. Die generische Ausnahme sollte die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als `PREVIOUS` enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcx_dynamic_call_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_class_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_method_name TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_class_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_method_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_dynamic_call_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_class_name = iv_class_name.
    me->mv_method_name = iv_method_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS risky_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD risky_method.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate some operation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_dynamic_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_target_object TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_target_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lo_target_object)->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dynamic_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous     = lx_root
            iv_class_name  = iv_class_name
            iv_method_name = iv_method_name
            textid       = zcx_dynamic_call_error=>default_text.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_dynamic_call_error.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_error.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    TRY.
        lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
          iv_method_name = 'RISKY_METHOD'
          iv_input       = 0 " This will cause an arithmetic error
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Dynamic call error was not caught and re-raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_dynamic_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dynamic_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( 'Dynamic call error caught and re-raised successfully.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_dynamic_error->mv_class_name
          exp = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_dynamic_error->mv_method_name
          exp = 'RISKY_METHOD'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
          act = lx_dynamic_error->previous
          msg = 'Previous exception should be set'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_success.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    TRY.
        lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TARGET'
          iv_method_name = 'RISKY_METHOD'
          iv_input       = 10
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_pass( 'Dynamic call successful, no error expected.' ).
      CATCH zcx_dynamic_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected dynamic call error.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf (`CALL METHOD (object)->(method)`) und die robuste Fehlerbehandlung dabei. Es fängt alle Ausnahmen (`CATCH cx_root`) ab, die während des dynamischen Aufrufs auftreten können, und kapselt sie in eine spezifische benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`zcx_dynamic_call_error`). Die ursprüngliche Ausnahme wird als `PREVIOUS` in der neuen Ausnahme gespeichert, was eine vollständige Fehlerkette für die Analyse ermöglicht.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Exception Handling, CATCH OTHERS, PREVIOUS

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer internen Tabelle zu und ändern Sie deren Wert. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights` und ändern Sie den Wert des Feldes `carrid` für eine bestimmte Zeile.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer Schleife mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS change_carrid_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD change_carrid_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_field_name TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID'.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      IF <fs_sflight>-connid = iv_connid.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_carrid.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_change_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_change_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_component( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->change_carrid_dynamically( iv_connid = '0017' iv_new_carrid = 'LH' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>) WITH KEY connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_result>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_result> WITH KEY connid = '0000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf eine Komponente einer internen Tabelle mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`. Dies ist nützlich, wenn der Feldname zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ist der moderne und effiziente Weg, um interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten, da keine unnötigen Datenkopien entstehen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen festen Prozentsatz. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR ... IN ... ASSIGNING <fs>`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Expression mit `ASSIGNING` und greifen Sie direkt auf die Feld-Symbol-Komponenten zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_for_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percent TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_for_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percent / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_increase FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_increase.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_for_assigning( ).
    DATA(lv_original_price) = 0.0.
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.0.

    DATA(lt_sflights_initial) = lo_cut->increase_price_for_carrier( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_percent = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights_initial ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_initial>) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_original_price = <fs_initial>-price.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_sflights_modified) = lo_cut->increase_price_for_carrier( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_percent = 10 ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights_modified ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_modified>) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_expected_price = lv_original_price * 1.1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_modified>-price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Price should be increased by 10%' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No flight found for carrier AA' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>`-Syntax ist die bevorzugte Methode zur Iteration und Modifikation interner Tabellen in modernem ABAP. Sie vermeidet das Kopieren von Daten in einen Workarea, was die Performance verbessert und den Speicherverbrauch reduziert. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der Schleife filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen effizient.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, FOR, Internal Tables, Iteration, SFLIGHT, Performance

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit in einem Field-Symbol gespeichert ist. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)` oder `CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(lv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _get_hello_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS _get_world_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_message.
    DATA: lo_self TYPE REF TO zcl_fds_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_method_name> TYPE string.

    lo_self = me.
    ASSIGN iv_method_name TO <fs_method_name>.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_self->(<fs_method_name>) RECEIVING RESULT rv_message.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_message = 'Error: Method not found or callable'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_hello_message.
    rv_message = 'Hello'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_world_message.
    rv_message = 'World'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Syntax `CALL METHOD lo_self->(<fs_method_name>)` ermöglicht es, die aufzurufende Methode flexibel zu bestimmen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Typnamen (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Greifen Sie anschließend über ein Field-Symbol auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und `ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs_table>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_num_entries) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <fs_table>
        UP TO 5 ROWS.
      rv_num_entries = lines( <fs_table> ).
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 0 AND iv_type_name = 'SCARR'.
      SELECT carrid, carrname
        FROM scarr
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <fs_table>
        UP TO 3 ROWS.
      rv_num_entries = lines( <fs_table> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_num_entries = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression und Field-Symbols.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und greifen Sie auf `<fs>-price` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.0.
    DATA: lt_sflights_temp TYPE zcl_fds_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices) WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    LOOP AT lt_prices ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + <fs_price>-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Total price should match sum of AA flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ). "Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Total price should be 0 for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.50) für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ermöglicht sie eine prägnante und effiziente Verarbeitung der Tabellenzeilen ohne explizite Workareas. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und performanterem Code.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API (z.B. `jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1`) durch und lesen Sie den JSON-Antworttext.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url`, `send`, `receive` und `response->get_cdata()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_response) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_get ).
    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_invalid_url FOR TESTING RAISING cx_http_dest_state_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_request( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
    DATA(lv_response) = ''.

    TRY.
        lv_response = lo_cut->get_json_data( lv_url ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_response msg = 'Response should not be empty' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_response exp = 'userId' msg = 'Response should contain JSON data' ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_client_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'HTTP request failed unexpectedly' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_invalid_url.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_request( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://invalid.url.example.com'.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_json_data( lv_url ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_http_dest_state_error for invalid URL' ).
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ). "Assert that the exception was caught
      CATCH cx_http_client_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Caught wrong exception type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_http_client` für einen GET-Request. Die Klasse bietet eine standardisierte Schnittstelle für die HTTP-Kommunikation. Die Verwendung von `create_by_url` vereinfacht die Client-Erstellung. Wichtig ist die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für potenzielle Kommunikationsfehler (`cx_http_dest_state_error`, `cx_http_client_error`).

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an einen Endpunkt (z.B. `jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts`) und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Setzen Sie den Content-Type Header auf `application/json` und verwenden Sie `request->set_cdata` für den JSON-Body.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_data,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userId TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_data.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        is_post_data TYPE ty_post_data
        iv_url       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_response) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_json_request TYPE string.

    " Convert ABAP structure to JSON string
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_post_data
        pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_request
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( data = lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für einen fehlgeschlagenen HTTP-Request, z.B. wenn der Host nicht erreichbar ist oder ein Timeout auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_http_dest_state_error` und `cx_http_client_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_request_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_request_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
        ENDIF.

        rv_error_message = 'Request successful'.

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rv_error_message = |HTTP Destination State Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_client_error).
        rv_error_message = |HTTP Client Error: { lx_client_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_error_message = |General Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    FINALLY.
      IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
        lo_http_client->close( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_request FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_host_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_request.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_request_with_error_handling( lv_url ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Request successful' msg = 'Successful request should return success message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_host_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://nonexistent.host.example.com'.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung ist bei der Kommunikation mit externen Systemen unerlässlich. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `TRY...CATCH` verschiedene Ausnahmen abfängt, die bei der Verwendung von `cl_http_client` auftreten können, insbesondere `cx_http_dest_state_error` (für Probleme mit der Verbindung oder dem Host) und `cx_http_client_error` (für allgemeine Client-Fehler). Die `FINALLY`-Block sorgt dafür, dass der HTTP-Client immer geschlossen wird, um Ressourcen freizugeben.
keywords: HTTP, Error Handling, Exception, cl_http_client, TRY-CATCH

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Note: httpbin.org echoes back request headers in its response JSON body.
    " For a real scenario, you'd read a specific response header.
    " This example reads the response body to verify the sent header.
    DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    IF lv_response_body IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW /ui2/cl_json_parser( lv_response_body ).
      TRY.
          lo_json_parser->parse( ).
          DATA(lo_json_data) = lo_json_parser->get_data( ).
          DATA(lv_headers_json) = lo_json_data->get_member( 'headers' )->get_string( iv_header_name ).
          rv_response_header_value = lv_headers_json.
        CATCH cx_root.
          rv_response_header_value = 'Error parsing JSON or header not found'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_with_query_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url TYPE string
        iv_param_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_response) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_with_query_params.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_full_url TYPE string.

    " Option 1: Manually construct URL (simpler for few params)
    lv_full_url = |{ iv_base_url }?{ iv_param_name }={ iv_param_value }|.

    " Option 2: Use set_query_parameter (more robust for multiple params, encoding)
    " cl_http_client=>create_by_url( ... )
    " lo_http_client->request->set_query_parameter( name = iv_param_name value = iv_param_value ).
    " lo_http_client->request->set_uri_path( iv_base_url ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = lv_full_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_get ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und deserialisieren Sie die JSON-Antwort direkt in eine ABAP-Struktur oder interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_deserialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post,
             userId TYPE i,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post.
    TYPES tt_posts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_post WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_deserialize_posts
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_posts) TYPE tt_posts
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_state_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_deserialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_deserialize_posts.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_json_response TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_state_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_client=>co_request_method_get ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    " Deserialize JSON to ABAP table
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = lv_json_response
        pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
      CHANGING
        data        = rt_posts
    ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    DATA(lo_json_serializer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_serializer->serialize( lt_flights ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_table_type_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_type_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      ( carrier = carrier_group-carrid,
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN carrier_group-*
                                      NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-price ),
        num_flights = lines( carrier_group-* ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS create_and_validate_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynamic_key   TYPE string
        iv_dynamic_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_validated_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_validate_json.
    DATA(lv_json_template) = |
      {
        "staticField": "Hello",
        "{ iv_dynamic_key }": "{ iv_dynamic_value }",
        "number": { 123 }
      }
    |.

    DATA lo_json_processor TYPE REF TO /ui2/cl_abap2json.
    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_json_processor.

    " Deserialize to a generic data reference to validate the JSON structure
    lo_json_processor->deserialize( EXPORTING json_string = lv_json_template IMPORTING abap_data = lr_data ).

    " Re-serialize to get a canonical, validated JSON string
    rv_validated_json = lo_json_processor->serialize( lr_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Deserialisierung eines fehlerhaften JSON-Strings und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_JSON_PARSER_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    DATA(lo_json_deserializer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).

    TRY.
        lo_json_deserializer->deserialize( EXPORTING json_string = iv_json_string IMPORTING abap_data = ls_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_invalid_json FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = '{"field":"value"'. " Missing closing brace
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_error( lv_invalid_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_error exp = 'JSON parser error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_json) = '{"field":"value"}'.
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_error( lv_valid_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Verarbeitung von externen JSON-Daten ist eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_JSON_PARSER_ERROR` abgefangen werden kann, die auftritt, wenn der JSON-String syntaktisch fehlerhaft ist. Der `TRY...CATCH`-Block ermöglicht es, auf solche Fehler zu reagieren und den Programmablauf kontrolliert fortzusetzen, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (`SFLIGHTS`) in eine einzelne Struktur mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator und serialisieren Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`, um eine Summe oder eine konsolidierte Struktur zu bilden, bevor Sie `/UI2/CL_ABAP2JSON` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_json_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_stats,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_price   TYPE s_price,
             avg_price     TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_stats.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_json_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(ls_stats) = REDUCE ty_flight_stats(
      INIT
        total_flights = 0
        total_price   = 0
        avg_price     = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        total_flights = total_flights + 1,
        total_price   = total_price + ls_flight-price ).

    IF ls_stats-total_flights > 0.
      ls_stats-avg_price = ls_stats-total_price / ls_stats-total_flights.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_json_serializer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_serializer->serialize( ls_stats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation_and_json FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_json_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flight_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"TOTAL_FLIGHTS"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"TOTAL_PRICE"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"AVG_PRICE"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um Daten aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um Flugstatistiken (Gesamtzahl, Gesamtpreis) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` zu berechnen. Das Ergebnis, eine einzelne Statistikstruktur, wird dann in einen JSON-String serialisiert. Dies zeigt eine funktionale und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, JSON, Serialization, /UI2/CL_ABAP2JSON, SFLIGHTS, TYPES

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (`SFLIGHTS`) basierend auf Kriterien mit dem `FILTER`-Operator und serialisieren Sie das gefilterte Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER`, um relevante Daten vor der JSON-Serialisierung auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_json_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_json_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_json.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 50 ROWS )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_info(
      lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

    DATA(lo_json_serializer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_serializer->serialize( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_json_lh) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_json( 'LH' ).

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Klasse mit komplexen Attributen (Strukturen, Tabellen) in einen JSON-String.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Attribute der Klasse öffentlich sind oder über Getter-Methoden zugänglich sind, damit `/UI2/CL_ABAP2JSON` sie serialisieren kann.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_address,
             street TYPE string,
             city   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_address.

    DATA mv_name    TYPE string READ-ONLY.

        iv_id    TYPE string
        iv_name  TYPE string
        is_address TYPE ty_address
        it_contacts TYPE tt_contacts.

    METHODS to_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_object IMPLEMENTATION.

    mv_name = iv_name.
    ms_address = is_address.
    mt_contacts = it_contacts.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_json.
    DATA(lo_json_serializer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD deserialize_dynamic_json.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"product":"Laptop","price":1200,"features":["SSD","8GB RAM"]}'.
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_dynamic_json( lv_json ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_product> TYPE any,
                   <lv_product_name> TYPE any,
                   <lt_features> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <lv_feature> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_product>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_product> ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_features> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_features> ).

    READ TABLE <lt_features> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <lv_feature>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_feature> exp = 'SSD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine neue Struktur und serialisieren Sie diese, wobei Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung nutzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` oder `DEEP` für die effiziente Zuweisung zwischen Strukturen mit ähnlichen Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_report_item,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             departure_date TYPE s_date,
             booking_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_report_item.
    TYPES: tt_flight_report_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_report_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_report_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_report_json.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_report_items) = VALUE tt_flight_report_items(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( flight_id = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }| )
                         ls_sflight MAPPING departure_date = fldate
                                          booking_price = price ) ) ).

    DATA(lo_json_serializer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_serializer->serialize( lt_report_items ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_flight_report_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FLIGHT_ID"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"DEPARTURE_DATE"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"BOOKING_PRICE"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist ein sehr nützliches Feature für die Zuweisung von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit ähnlichen, aber nicht identischen Feldnamen. In diesem Beispiel wird er in Kombination mit `BASE` und `MAPPING` verwendet, um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine neue Berichtsstruktur zu transformieren, bevor diese in JSON serialisiert wird. Dies vereinfacht die Datenanpassung erheblich und macht den Code robuster gegenüber Änderungen in den Quellstrukturen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Transformation, Internal Table, JSON, Serialization, /UI2/CL_ABAP2JSON, SFLIGHTS, TYPES, MAPPING
